claim_rows.first_seen_subject: Register MECH-309 + ARC-062/063 rule-apprehension cluster; correct SD-054 doc
claim_rows.title: Rule-apprehension architectural slot, strong reading: a distributed CandidateRule field with tolerance-gated availability, hippocampal-rollout-eligibility shaping, structured per-action evidence-trace records, and waking-vs-sleep refinement asymmetry. The biology-faithful form of the rule-apprehension layer, formalising the 2026-05-04 thought-intake on tolerance-gated rule apprehension (PNAS 10.1073/pnas.2508061123). Brought forward V4->V3 2026-05-18; V3-tractable design landed 2026-06-04 (docs/architecture/arc_063_candidate_rule_field.md). Only the social in-face (ARC-077/MECH-337) is V4-deferred (needs a caregiver-agent substrate absent in V3); the sleep-vs-waking refinement asymmetry is V3 (sleep rescoped to V3 2026-04-20; reuses the MECH-272/273/285 sleep cluster) and is a V3 follow-on within ARC-063, NOT V4. Persistent flag for governance: this slot is expected to be needed if ARC-062 (weak reading) fails or proves insufficient at scale, AND independently as the architectural commitment that supports moral-residue attribution to the rule-field, sleep-vs-waking refinement asymmetry, and clinically-realistic failure modes (trauma schemas, paranoid rule fields, depressive rollout constraint).

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: Register MECH-307 anticipatory_affect_conjunction; SD-014 6-channel amendment proposal
claim_rows.title: Anticipatory positive affect (excitement) and anticipatory negative affect (dread) emerge as derived states from the conjunction of (a) signed VALENCE_SURPRISE, (b) MECH-216 schema readout coupled to z_beta arousal, (c) anticipatory VALENCE_LIKING write at predicted-imminent-positive-event locations, and (d) MECH-216 writes at predicted rather than current location. Four-gap substrate amendment to MECH-216 + MECH-205 + the residue valence buffer, NOT a new VALENCE channel.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claims: register MECH-308 (language acquisition tracks play_mode maturation)
claim_rows.title: Language acquisition tracks play_mode maturation: socially-grounded compositional language emerges as a specialised game type instantiated within play_mode (INV-058 / MECH-194 / ARC-049), not via a parallel language-acquisition substrate. The basic expression catalog (play pose, head tilt, laughter, mutual gaze, distress vocalisation, approach cue, vocal mimicry, pointing) acts as the bilateral frame-opening signal; conversational violations function as synthetic z_harm; utterance-as-goal acts as synthetic z_goal; proto-symbols accrete as conditional modifiers attached to basic-expression channels. Predicts that systems trained without play_mode-like episodes fail to acquire socially-grounded compositional language even when pattern-matching imitation succeeds.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: Register MECH-309 + ARC-062/063 rule-apprehension cluster; correct SD-054 doc
claim_rows.title: Monomodal policy collapse is the equilibrium of a parametric-policy agent without a rule-apprehension layer. Bayesian update and gradient descent revise weights over a hypothesis space they do not invent; without a non-Bayesian rule-creator that proposes discriminative policy modes ('near-hazard -> reef regime; else -> forage regime'), the trainer collapses to the smoothest single regime good-enough across the whole state space. Monostrategy is therefore not a bug of training but the predicted output of an architecture in which only updaters exist and no apprehender does. Falsifiable by the weak-reading rule-apprehension experiment (ARC-062): a gated-policy architecture trained on the same substrate should break the collapse where standard E3 does not.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: Register Q-042: precision update call site (Option A confirmed by biology + ML)
claim_rows.title: Should the running-variance / dynamic-precision update fire at action-selection time (early, control-plane-coupled), at outcome-integration time (late, residue-coupled, current location), or at both? Equivalently: is the StepHarness contract that requires experiment loops to call agent.update_residue() each step sufficient, or does ARC-016 precision need a call site that is structurally guaranteed to fire whenever the agent is selecting actions?

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claims: register MECH-308 (language acquisition tracks play_mode maturation)
claim_rows.title: Conditioned safety store: a non-trainable cue-specific predictive structure encoding 'this z_world prototype predicts that suffering will be omitted'. EMA-prototype encoder updated by MECH-302 relief-completion events; cosine-similarity expression head provides commitment-release gate when current z_world matches the learned safety prototype. Implements MECH-304 (cue-specific conditioned inhibition substrate): the encoded prototype is the dorsal-striatum / dlPFC encoding-pathway analog; the cosine-similarity gate is the IL->CeA expression-pathway analog.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claims: register MECH-308 (language acquisition tracks play_mode maturation)
claim_rows.title: Contextual passive safety terrain: a non-trainable RBF-field accumulator over z_world that integrates 'suffering-absent' waking ticks into a slow contextual safety representation. Provides the substrate for MECH-303 (contextual passive safety pathway; vmPFC + hippocampus / vHipp-to-PL biological analog). When the field's local mean exceeds release threshold and beta_gate is elevated, drops the avoidance commitment to lower background vigilance. Parallel architecture to ARC-030 / MECH-117 benefit_terrain; uses a separate RBF field, no sharing with benefit_terrain or main residue values.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claims: register MECH-308 (language acquisition tracks play_mode maturation)
claim_rows.title: Reef enrichment substrate: env-level behavioral-diversity substrate adding coral-reef safe zones (hazard-free patches with a static scent gradient) and food-attracted hazard drift to CausalGridWorldV2. Creates two competing behavioral attractors -- 'flee to reef' vs 'forage' -- to break monomodal route-exploitation in agents whose policy collapses to a single fixed trajectory, unblocking SD-029 C2 / C3 measurement. Pure environment substrate; no trainable parameters; no MECH-094 interaction. Renamed from SD-050 on 2026-05-08 to resolve a registry-ID collision with the suffering-derivative comparator.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: Register ARC-064 + ARC-065 + MECH-312 sub-MECH split + MECH-319 cluster
claim_rows.title: bottom_up_behavioral_pattern_extraction_pathway (hippocampal_CLS_bi_pathway + dorsolateral_striatum_chunking + OFC_cognitive_map analog). Architectural commitment: rule discovery from observed-behaviour clustering is logically and architecturally distinct from rule application from instructed/external context (ARC-062 top-down rule-apprehension). Where ARC-062 receives a context cue and selects a discriminative policy mode, ARC-064 receives an observed-behaviour stream and extracts cross-episode regularities, compressed behavioural patterns, and rule-state abstractions. Both pathways presuppose ARC-065 behavioural diversity generation upstream. Multi-substrate distributed instantiation: hippocampal Complementary Learning Systems bi-pathway (Schapiro et al. 2017), dorsolateral striatum action chunking (Smith & Graybiel 2013/2016), OFC cognitive-map state abstraction (Wilson et al. 2014; Schuck et al. 2016).

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: Register ARC-064 + ARC-065 + MECH-312 sub-MECH split + MECH-319 cluster
claim_rows.title: behavioral_diversity_generation_pathway (multi-substrate distributed: LC-NE tonic + frontopolar curiosity + striatal novelty + hippocampal trajectory sampling). Architectural commitment: a non-trivial behavioural diversity generation pathway is upstream-of and logically prior to both rule pathways (ARC-062 top-down rule-apprehension and ARC-064 bottom-up rule-discovery). Without it, neither pathway has anything to weight or cluster -- gradient descent on a parametric policy without diversity pressure collapses to the smoothest single regime, the predicted equilibrium MECH-309 identifies. The biology distributes diversity generation across at least four substrates: LC-NE tonic noise floor, frontopolar uncertainty-driven curiosity, striatal novelty bonus, and hippocampal trajectory sampling. REE registers this as a foundational architectural slot whose specific child mechanisms (MECH-313 noise-floor, MECH-314 structured-curiosity with three sub-flavours, and the MECH-315-absorbed proposal-diversity channel) are independently testable but jointly load-bearing.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: register ARC-066/067/068 non_deficit_action_drives architectural family
claim_rows.title: tonic_vigor_coupling (capacity-to-action-bias, average-reward-rate / LC-NE tonic / DA effort-vigor analog). Architectural commitment: behaviour-bias toward action scales with capacity (high energy AND low recent prediction error AND low drive -- 'things are going well, deploy'), independent of any specific target. Distinct from existing behavioural-source slots (z_harm threats, z_goal deficit-seeded wants, novelty curiosity) which all fall to zero when the agent is well-fed, safe, and the world is familiar. Without ARC-066 a healthy REE agent has no gradient to act; biology has a positive gradient (felt phenomenology: drive to deploy energy when one has it). First of three slots in the non_deficit_action_drives family; companion ARC-067 (idle aversion / boredom) and ARC-068 (opportunity cost) cover the aversive-of-rest and cost-of-passivity halves of the same architectural commitment. Family principle: behaviour comes from surplus capacity AND from deficits, not deficits alone.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: register ARC-066/067/068 non_deficit_action_drives architectural family
claim_rows.title: idle_aversion_boredom (sustained-low-engagement aversive valence accumulator). Architectural commitment: prolonged low-engagement is itself negatively valenced; the agent acts to escape boredom, even in the absence of specific targets, threats, or novelty pressure. Distinct from the policy-side ARC-066 vigor coupling: ARC-067 instantiates an aversive-side accumulator that recruits the same downstream as actual harm (z_harm-like channel), so engagement-poverty competes for action-selection priority on the same axis as discomfort. Companion to ARC-066 (vigor / capacity-deploy) and ARC-068 (opportunity cost) in the non_deficit_action_drives family.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: register ARC-066/067/068 non_deficit_action_drives architectural family
claim_rows.title: opportunity_cost_no_op_penalty (waiting accumulates forgone-reward cost; passive trajectories pay for time consumed). Architectural commitment: trajectories that consume time without progress are not free in E3 scoring; the score function carries an additive cost on no-op / repeated-stationary candidates that scales with the agent's average expected reward rate. Companion to ARC-066 (capacity-to-vigor) and ARC-067 (idle aversion). Existing dACC switch_value (SD-032b / Kolling 2015 foraging) is the closest current substrate but covers a different framing (when to switch FROM the current option to alternatives), not the always-on cost of choosing the null action.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: register ARC-069/070/071 policy_primitive_granularity architectural family
claim_rows.title: policy_hierarchy_dynamic_regranularisation (parent commitment for dynamic policy-primitive granularity in hippocampal rollout). Architectural commitment: the unit-of-policy that the rule-apprehension layer (ARC-062) and the diversity-generation layer (ARC-065) operate on is itself a dynamic representation, not a fixed primitive. The granularity rescales based on simulation outcomes -- decomposed into finer primitives when a chunk fails to ground at execution / prediction resolution (ARC-070), composed into a single primitive when a sequence has been repeatedly grounded with consistent outcomes (ARC-071). Without this commitment, ARC-007 hippocampal proposals are flat action sequences at fixed grain, and the rule layer must apprehend rules at whatever grain the proposer happens to emit, which may be too fine (combinatorial explosion in rollout) or too coarse (chunks fail to map onto the actual state). Cluster parent for ARC-070 (decomposition) + ARC-071 (composition); registers the architectural commitment that primitives are dynamic before any mechanism work.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: register ARC-069/070/071 policy_primitive_granularity architectural family
claim_rows.title: policy_decomposition_on_prediction_failure (zoom-in / re-segment imagined chains when chunks fail to ground at execution resolution). Child of ARC-069 dynamic-regranularisation parent commitment. Architectural commitment: when an imagined chunk's predicted outcome diverges from what its sub-elements would predict (or when MECH-269 V_s on the chunk's region drops), the chunk is broken into finer primitives in the rollout proposal stream. Trigger: simulation-side prediction failure. Direction: zoom in. Phenomenology anchor: 'I planned go-to-the-kitchen; turns out I need to plan the steps.'

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: register ARC-069/070/071 policy_primitive_granularity architectural family
claim_rows.title: policy_composition_via_repeated_grounding (zoom-out / chunk a sequence of primitives into a single atomic primitive after repeated successful execution). Child of ARC-069 dynamic-regranularisation parent commitment. Architectural commitment: sequences of policy primitives that have been repeatedly executed together with consistent outcomes are accumulated into a single primitive that the rule-apprehension and diversity-generation layers can treat atomically. Trigger: repetition count + outcome consistency (slow accumulator). Direction: zoom out. Phenomenology anchor: 'making coffee was once seventeen motor acts; after a thousand repetitions it is one unit.' Names the TRANSITION mechanism (planned -> habitual chunk) that MECH-163 dual systems presupposes but does not specify.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: Register ARC-064 + ARC-065 + MECH-312 sub-MECH split + MECH-319 cluster
claim_rows.title: rule_arbitration_multi_variable_multi_channel_dynamic_within_session. Parent claim for the multi-variable, multi-channel, dynamic-within-session arbitration that selects between competing rules / policy modes / action sources at the policy layer. Arbitration is governed by at least four distinct sub-mechanisms (MECH-312a/b/c/d), each falsifiable independently, with a candidate fifth (controllability/agency) deferred pending V3 substrate availability. Recommended combination rule: multiplicative gate (per-channel softmax of reliability * cost * agency * V_s * practice_maturity products) per Pull 3 R4 verdict; falsified against additive-logit baseline in V3-EXQ-543b/c. Reframed 2026-05-10 from earlier dual-channel-arbitration sketch following Pull 3 SYNTHESIS R5 SUB-MECH SPLIT recommendation (conf 0.78).

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: Register ARC-064 + ARC-065 + MECH-312 sub-MECH split + MECH-319 cluster
claim_rows.title: uncertainty_reliability_weighting (Daw_2005_Lee_2014_dual_systems_arbitration_analog). Arbitration weight tracks the inverse-uncertainty / reliability of each candidate rule or policy mode; high-reliability sources receive higher arbitration weight. Biological substrate: model-based / model-free dual-systems arbitration (Daw et al. 2005 Nat Neurosci; Lee et al. 2014 Neuron). LOW divergence from existing literature; direct mapping. Sub-claim of MECH-312.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: Register ARC-064 + ARC-065 + MECH-312 sub-MECH split + MECH-319 cluster
claim_rows.title: practice_maturity_weighting (Smith_Graybiel_habit_takeover_analog). Arbitration weight tracks practice-maturity / habit-strength of each candidate rule or policy mode; well-practiced behaviour receives higher arbitration weight via a habit-takeover dynamic. Biological substrate: dorsolateral striatum habit consolidation (Smith & Graybiel 2013/2016); successor-representation maturation (Stachenfeld et al. 2017). LOW-MEDIUM divergence; partial mapping (the maturity dimension is well-anchored; the integration into a multi-channel arbitration layer is more REE-specific). Sub-claim of MECH-312.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: Register ARC-064 + ARC-065 + MECH-312 sub-MECH split + MECH-319 cluster
claim_rows.title: affective_stream_modulation_of_arbitration_REE_novel. Arbitration weight is modulated by affective stream load: when the SD-010 / SD-011 affective stream produces high load (high salience harm or affect), the arbitration layer routes more weight to rules associated with affect-laden context, suppressing arbitration weight on neutral-context rules. The REE-novel claim is the FUNCTIONAL CONSEQUENCE: dual-stream architecture (SD-010/SD-011) is well-anchored in Murray-Rudebeck 2018 and Pessoa-Adolphs 2010, but the modulation of rule-arbitration weights by affective-stream load is REE-specific (MEDIUM-HIGH divergence). Sub-claim of MECH-312.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: Register ARC-064 + ARC-065 + MECH-312 sub-MECH split + MECH-319 cluster
claim_rows.title: V_s_freshness_modulation_per_region_REE_novel. Arbitration weight is modulated per-region by V_s freshness (the per-region staleness scalar from MECH-269 / MECH-284 / MECH-287); rules associated with stale regions receive lower arbitration trust, regardless of their reliability or practice. HIGH divergence (REE-novel per-region scope + rule-trust function): Behrens 2007 ACC volatility and Bouton 2004 contextual renewal are nearest cousins, but per-region continuous scalar + arbitration-trust routing are REE-specific. Sub-claim of MECH-312.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: Register ARC-064 + ARC-065 + MECH-312 sub-MECH split + MECH-319 cluster
claim_rows.title: stochastic_noise_floor (max_entropy_policy_regularisation_LC_NE_tonic_analog). A floor-level stochastic action-selection noise that prevents complete deterministic collapse of the policy. Biological substrate: locus coeruleus tonic firing producing baseline action-selection variability (Aston-Jones & Cohen 2005 adaptive-gain model). Computational analog: max-entropy policy regularisation / SAC entropy bonus (Haarnoja et al. 2018). Distinct from MECH-260 dACC anti-recency: MECH-313 is a state-independent noise floor, while MECH-260 is a state-dependent recency penalty. Both can contribute to anti-monostrategy pressure but operate via different mechanisms; whether they collapse into a single substrate or are mutually load-bearing is open (Q-045).

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: Register ARC-064 + ARC-065 + MECH-312 sub-MECH split + MECH-319 cluster
claim_rows.title: structured_curiosity_bonus (frontopolar_uncertainty_driven_exploration_expected_free_energy_analog). A reward bonus on action-selection that rewards information-gain or uncertainty-reduction, distinct from a state-independent noise floor (MECH-313). Biological substrate: rostrolateral prefrontal exploration bonus (Daw et al. 2006 Nature) operating jointly with striatal novelty (Wittmann et al. 2008 Neuron). Three sub-flavours (MECH-314a/b/c) that the lit-pull recommended NOT to collapse prematurely: striatal novelty (Wittmann anchor), frontopolar uncertainty-driven curiosity (Daw anchor), learning-progress / intrinsic-motivation curiosity (Schmidhuber/Pathak tradition). Active-inference (Friston 2010/2015 expected free energy) provides the formal-level unification. Q-044 captures the open question of whether the three sub-flavours are distinct substrates or three readings of one mechanism with different upstream inputs.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: Register ARC-064 + ARC-065 + MECH-312 sub-MECH split + MECH-319 cluster
claim_rows.title: novelty_bonus_striatal_analog. A reward bonus that tracks recency-of-encounter; new or rarely-encountered states/actions receive a positive bonus independent of reward prediction error. Biological substrate: ventral striatum response to stimulus novelty (Wittmann et al. 2008 Neuron). Sub-flavour of MECH-314 structured curiosity bonus.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: Register ARC-064 + ARC-065 + MECH-312 sub-MECH split + MECH-319 cluster
claim_rows.title: uncertainty_driven_curiosity_frontopolar_analog. A reward bonus that tracks epistemic value -- how much the agent would learn from sampling a state or action. Biological substrate: rostrolateral prefrontal exploration bonus (Daw et al. 2006 Nature). Sub-flavour of MECH-314 structured curiosity bonus. Active-inference framing: bonus equals epistemic value term in expected free energy decomposition (Friston 2010/2015).

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: Register ARC-064 + ARC-065 + MECH-312 sub-MECH split + MECH-319 cluster
claim_rows.title: learning_progress_curiosity_intrinsic_motivation_analog. A reward bonus that tracks the rate-of-improvement of the agent's predictive model (or any internal-state quantity); actions that produce a steepening learning curve receive a positive bonus. Most computationally instantiated in ML literature (Schmidhuber 1991, Pathak et al. 2017); least biologically anchored of the three MECH-314 sub-flavours -- no clean cellular or regional analog. Distinguishes from MECH-314a (recency-based) and MECH-314b (uncertainty-based) by tracking second-order signal (improvement rate) rather than first-order (count or uncertainty).

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: Register ARC-064 + ARC-065 + MECH-312 sub-MECH split + MECH-319 cluster
claim_rows.title: cross_episode_regularity_extraction (episodic_RL_successor_representation_CLS_monosynaptic_analog). A mechanism for extracting cross-episode statistical regularities from observed behaviour streams, producing a representation that supports prediction of future state-occupancy distributions. Biological substrate: hippocampal monosynaptic CA1 path (Schapiro et al. 2017 CLS bi-pathway); statistical learning in hippocampus (Davachi 2015). Computational analog: successor representation (Stachenfeld et al. 2017 Nat Neurosci). Sub-claim of ARC-064 bottom-up rule discovery.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: Register ARC-064 + ARC-065 + MECH-312 sub-MECH split + MECH-319 cluster
claim_rows.title: behavioural_pattern_compression (option_formation_striatal_chunking_analog). A mechanism for compressing repeated behavioural patterns into reusable options / action-chunks, producing a representation that supports temporally-extended action selection. Biological substrate: dorsolateral striatum sequence consolidation (Smith & Graybiel 2013/2016; Martiros & Graybiel 2018). Computational analog: options framework / option-critic (Bacon, Harb & Precup 2017). Sub-claim of ARC-064 bottom-up rule discovery.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: Register ARC-064 + ARC-065 + MECH-312 sub-MECH split + MECH-319 cluster
claim_rows.title: rule_state_abstraction_substrate (meta_RL_recurrent_task_state_representation). A mechanism for abstracting the higher-level rule-state itself as a latent variable in the agent's representation, supporting policy adaptation that depends on inferred rule-context rather than only observable cue. Biological substrate: OFC cognitive map (Wilson, Takahashi, Schoenbaum & Niv 2014; Schuck et al. 2016 OFC encodes task state). Computational analog: meta-RL recurrent task-state representation (Wang et al. 2018 prefrontal-as-meta-RL; Duan et al. 2016 RL^2; Botvinick et al. 2019 review). Sub-claim of ARC-064 bottom-up rule discovery. ABSORPTION CHECK 2026-05-10: VERDICT (B) PARTIALLY ABSORBED. Within-V3 functional weight is borne by SD-033a LateralPFCAnalog rule_state buffer (W1 EMA recurrence + W3 substrate-readiness + W4 downstream bias) plus ARC-062 Phase 1 gated_policy multi-stream context discriminator (W3 per-tick rule-context discrimination + W4 score-aggregation training pressure), with ARC-062 Phase 3 GAP-C wiring now DONE (2026-09-16, V3-EXQ-1039, non_contributory/standard) closing that loop -- the cluster's empirical verdict remains separately gated on GAP-B (in-progress), an independent competence gate this correction does not clear. [2026-09-23 governance, GFLAG-0397] Two residual gaps remain: W2 (multi-task training distribution -- blocked on multi-rule-context substrate, SD-054 single-context insufficient) and W5 (cross-episode hidden-state continuity -- likely V4-scope; SD-033a per-episode reset is architecturally load-bearing for the rest of the agent state machine). Empirical retire-vs-promote verdict deferred to V3-EXQ-543c-successor on multi-rule-context substrate. See REE_assembly/docs/architecture/mech_318_absorption_check.md.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: Register ARC-064 + ARC-065 + MECH-312 sub-MECH split + MECH-319 cluster
claim_rows.title: simulation_mode_rule_write_gating_categorical_replay_tag (SWR_machinery_substrate_REE_novel_function). The substrate-level instantiation of MECH-094's hypothesis-tag write gate at the rule-arbitration layer: a categorical write-gate keyed to a simulation-mode tag that suppresses arbitration-weight updates during ghost / replay / DMN passes, allowing rule-arbitration to be exercised without overwriting the active rule weights from non-realized data. Substrate-availability premise is well-anchored: SWR machinery (Joo & Frank 2018 review) + reverse-replay discriminable signature (Foster & Wilson 2006). The specific REE function (categorical write-gate keyed to a simulation tag suppressing arbitration-weight updates) is plausible biologically but unverified at cellular / synaptic level.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: MECH-320 register: tonic_vigor_coupling_score_bias (ARC-066 first child)
claim_rows.title: tonic_vigor_coupling_score_bias (capacity-keyed E3 score-side action drive / mesolimbic-DA-vigor-analog / average-reward-rate opportunity-cost regulator). Child mechanism for ARC-066 (tonic_vigor_coupling) AND ARC-068 (opportunity_cost_no_op_penalty -- collapse into MECH-320 per ARC-068 lit-pull R3 verdict 2026-05-16; MECH-320's w_passive term IS the ARC-068 implementation). Adds a tonic vigor scalar v_t to E3 trajectory scoring as an additive bias toward action-trajectories and an additive cost on no-op / repeated-stationary trajectories, where v_t is a slow EWMA over the realised E3-score-receipt stream. Target-free: bias applies regardless of whether any z_goal is currently active. Distinct from MECH-313 (LC-NE noise floor -- noise on choice, orthogonal axis), MECH-216 (target-conditioned wanting), SD-012 (deficit-keyed drive, opposite coupling), and MECH-330 (ARC-067 boredom -- valence-side z_harm_a write, different architectural layer).

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: register MECH-321 policy.decomposition_via_event_segmenter (ARC-070 first child)
claim_rows.title: policy_decomposition_via_event_segmenter (rollout-side consumer of MECH-288 boundary pulses; re-segments the rollout proposal stream at finer grain when a chunk's region shows low V_s / boundary fires on the imagined trajectory). First child mechanism for ARC-070. Bidirectional extension of MECH-288 substrate (R2 lit-pull verdict 2026-05-10): MECH-288 already detects boundaries on whatever latent + PE streams it consumes; MECH-321 wires the rollout / imagination input stream into MECH-288 and consumes the resulting boundary pulses at the policy-primitive layer to decompose chunked primitives into finer-grain sub-elements. PE-driven primary trigger (V_s drop on chunk's region per Zacks 2007 / Schapiro 2017); bottleneck-state framing is a separate consolidation-phase mechanism, not the primary trigger. Recursive multi-level decomposition; depth cap 3 is an ENGINEERING choice, not a literature-derived constant (provenance corrected 2026-07-27 -- see evidence_quality_note). The MULTI-LEVEL commitment is ARC-070's R3 verdict (Badre & D'Esposito 2009) and STANDS; that source never supported a level COUNT, and Badre & Nee 2018 (Badre's own re-appraisal) finds the evidence supports neither a unitary model of lateral frontal function nor a unidimensional abstraction gradient, so there is no single ordered axis along which to cap. The cap rests instead on tractability + operator symmetry (mirrors ARC-071's chunk_max_depth so the inverse operations stay symmetric; open Q-claim on hard-vs-soft). Magnitude prior only, with an explicit grain caveat: Koechlin 2003 resolves a 3-level lateral-PFC cascade (4 with Koechlin & Summerfield 2007 frontopolar branching), but at ANATOMICAL grain -- heterogeneous, anatomically fixed control levels, NOT homogeneous recursion depth of one operator re-applying to its own output. Both pre-commit and mid-execution phases supported via the same mechanism, with downstream effects gated by MECH-094 hypothesis_tag (rollout fires under hypothesis_tag=True write nothing; observation / execution fires under hypothesis_tag=False enable the existing observation-side consumer chain unchanged).

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: Register ARC-064 + ARC-065 + MECH-312 sub-MECH split + MECH-319 cluster
claim_rows.title: How should the relative weights of MECH-313 (stochastic noise floor / LC-NE tonic analog) and MECH-314 (structured curiosity bonus / frontopolar curiosity) be calibrated for V3 substrates? Falsifiable with parametric sweep on SD-054 reef substrate plus ARC-062 gated-policy.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: Register ARC-064 + ARC-065 + MECH-312 sub-MECH split + MECH-319 cluster
claim_rows.title: Are MECH-314a (striatal novelty), MECH-314b (frontopolar uncertainty-driven curiosity), and MECH-314c (learning-progress curiosity) three distinct substrates with independent contributions, or three different readings of one mechanism with different upstream inputs (e.g., novelty as a special case of uncertainty as a special case of learning progress)?

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: Register ARC-064 + ARC-065 + MECH-312 sub-MECH split + MECH-319 cluster
claim_rows.title: Is MECH-313 (LC-NE tonic noise floor) a separate parameter from MECH-260 (dACC anti-recency penalty), or do they collapse into one anti-monostrategy substrate? Falsifiable with the four-arm ablation: both-OFF / 313-only / 260-only / both-ON, on SD-054 reef substrate with ARC-062 gated-policy enabled.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: MECH-322 sleep-replay value-conditioned chunking carve-out (R6 governance decision: Option B)
claim_rows.title: policy_composition.sleep_replay_value_conditioned_chunking_consolidation -- narrow exception path that permits ARC-071 chunk formation from replayed (hypothesis_tag=True) sequences during designated sleep phase, IF the replayed sequence carries a value-tag from prior real-executed episodes AND the formed chunk carries a replay_origin=True audit flag with accelerated dissolution if not corroborated by real waking execution within N episodes. Resolves ARC-071 lit-pull R6 governance escalation (Option B carve-out, picked 2026-05-11).

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: MECH-323 policy_composition_chunk_accumulator (ARC-071 first child: formation operator)
claim_rows.title: policy_composition_chunk_accumulator -- striatum/DLS-analog formation operator that builds chunk candidates from sequences of policy primitives repeatedly executed together with consistent outcomes. First child mechanism for ARC-071 (the maintenance operator MECH-324 is registered separately). Encodes the lit-pull R1 verdict (repetition + outcome consistency as primary trigger, evaluative-gate upstream, V_s-positive secondary) + R2 verdict partial (striatum-analog formation substrate; vmPFC/IL maintenance substrate handled by MECH-324) + R4 verdict (chunked primitive carries initiation-set + termination-condition fields per Sutton 1999 options structure) + R5 verdict (gradual hysteresis with F_low formation < F_high dissolution -- the RELATION is literature-grounded as of 2026-07-27 (Barnes 2005; Bouton 2012), the VALUES F_low=0.15 / F_high=0.45 are uncalibrated engineering defaults with NO literature support, awaiting child-MECH calibration; INITIAL chunk-size budget 2-5 elements per level, licensed by Sakai 2003 at MOTOR grain only and NOT a stable architectural constant -- Ramkumar 2016 shows chunk length grows with practice under a compute/efficiency trade-off, Bo & Seidler 2009 shows it tracks visuospatial working-memory capacity and declines with age, so the ceiling should be exposed as growable and ideally DERIVED from the agent's deliberation/rollout budget rather than configured independently; see the 2026-07-27 provenance correction in evidence_quality_note). Dissolution is SUPPRESSION WITH RETENTION, not erasure (2026-07-27 structural correction, registered on MECH-324): a previously-dissolved sequence re-forms at the REDUCED bar R_reacq = R_min * f_reacq rather than at R_min from scratch, so the MECH-323 trigger is state-dependent on the chunk library; and the initiation_set field becomes load-bearing for the renewal falsifier, which is expressible only if dissolution is scoped to the same context granularity formation uses. claim_rows.first_seen_subject: diversity-isolation-plan: harvest MECH-341/Q-054/Q-055/INV-076 + isolation plan-of-record
claim_rows.title: Behavioural diversity is a structural prerequisite for ethical counterfactual evaluation. A system with monomodal policy cannot instantiate the counterfactual evaluation that ethical judgement requires, because the 'could have done otherwise' comparison demands that the agent's candidate trajectory pool contain at least two distinct trajectory classes with distinct harm profiles. The argument is mathematical-by-construction: if P(a|s) is monomodal, the CEM elite pool contains only trajectories beginning with a*, and MECH-257's evaluator-mode E2(z_t, a_cf) for a_cf != a* (prospective rollout-scoring; supersedes SD-003, 2026-04-18) is never evaluated in the on-policy candidate distribution. (Was proposed 2026-05-15 as INV-074 in behavioral_diversity_acceptance_criteria.md but never registered; the ID was subsequently taken 2026-05-17 by an unrelated plasticity-crystallization invariant. Re-registered under INV-076 with scientific content unchanged.)

E3 score aggregation over CEM-supplied candidates must preserve trajectory-class diversity rather than collapse a diverse candidate pool onto a single deterministic ranking. Without explicit diversity preservation at the scoring step, downstream action selection becomes deterministic regardless of proposal-layer diversity (ARC-065 SP-CEM child), making the whole distributed diversity pathway rate-limited by Layer B. Mechanism options (not yet committed): (1) entropy bonus over candidate first-action classes added to E3 score; (2) class- stratified argmax with within-class proportional sampling; (3) jittered tie-breaking when top-K E3 scores are within epsilon. Final design pending diagnostic data on whether E3 collapse is near-tie or large-gap (see behavioral_diversity_isolation_plan.md Phase P2).

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: implement-substrate SD-056: claims registry + design doc (see commit msg in retry)
claim_rows.title: E2 world-forward action-conditional divergence preservation via auxiliary InfoNCE-style contrastive loss. Substrate-level fix for the V3-EXQ-571 root cause finding (2026-05-25): with world_dim=32 and action_dim=4, action contributes ~11% of world_forward input dimensionality, and reconstruction-shaped training collapses to the state-dominated local minimum where action effect is fitted to zero. Measurement: cand_world_pairwise_dist = 0.0000 across K=8 candidates differing only in first action. Same root cause as 2026-05-17 ARC-062 GAP-B autopsy; GAP-B fix was scoped only to GatedPolicy first-action one-hot bypass. SD-056 is the architecturally-faithful generalisation -- fixes the predictor's training objective rather than bypassing the predictor at each consumer. Option (ii) lever B (contrastive next-state, Srivastava et al. 2021 style) chosen over PLSM-style MI factorisation (lever A) and SWIRL-style MI maximisation (lever C) per 2026-05-28 lit-pull SYNTHESIS verdict and user AskUserQuestion confirmation.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: MECH-342: register maintenance-time commitment-release substrate (B3b)
claim_rows.title: control_plane.commit_maintenance_release. The R-c readiness signals that gate commitment ENTRY (MECH-090: score_margin decisiveness + nav_competence) must ALSO be able to RELEASE an already-elevated beta latch when execution readiness degrades mid-commitment. The release is a graded, bounded-accumulation drift-to-a-release-bound (conflict-scaled by the deficit magnitude), NOT a one-shot threshold flag; targeted to the active committed motor program (not a global brake); and hysteretic with a reengagement path that guards the premature-abort pole. This closes the V3-EXQ-592f reach gap (the MECH-090 R-c conjunction is admission-only by design; no existing release pathway covers degraded-readiness-mid- commitment).

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: hypothesis: register difficulty-gated proposal entropy (MECH-343 + Q-056)
claim_rows.title: difficulty_gated_proposal_entropy (controlled proposal-entropy widening under goal blockage). When goal progress stalls -- repeated failure to improve goal progress, high inter-candidate conflict, low E3 score margin, low committed-action diversity, plateau/stuck-state signal -- WITH goal salience preserved, the agent should transiently INCREASE proposal-generation entropy UPSTREAM of action selection (wider hippocampal/world-model rollout candidate set + higher within-class sampling temperature) while preserving goal/harm/constraint scoring and DELAYING commitment until one candidate clears the E3 score-margin / commitment threshold; entropy then NARROWS once a workable candidate is found -> committed action -> entropy decay. Asserted distinction (preserve this): a hard problem must trigger WIDER INTERNAL PROPOSALS -> more candidate diversity -> longer arbitration -> selective committed action (controlled entropy), NOT 'hard problem -> random behaviour' (noise). WORKING HYPOTHESIS -- no experimental evidence yet; not an established mechanism.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: hypothesis: register difficulty-gated proposal entropy (MECH-343 + Q-056)

Main empirical prediction of MECH-343: in a hard-goal/blocked-path environment (matched easy-goal controls), the difficulty-gated-entropy arm should show flexible exploration -- improved goal progress, no harm increase, no random-churn increase, commitment latency that rises during the hard phase then falls after solution discovery -- and should BEAT both the entropy-off arm (proposal rigidity / stuck) and the entropy-always-high arm (disorganised exploration / no narrowing). claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claims: mint MECH-353 (blocked_agency) / MECH-354 (fatigue stop-recover) / MECH-355 (soothing)
claim_rows.title: Blocked-agency / control-failure affect stream (z_block): an integrated readout on the SD-029 agency comparator applied to the action-outcome channel. z_block rises when an intended action repeatedly fails to produce its forward-model-predicted outcome (MECH-112 z_goal supplies the expectation), the mismatch is attributed to an EXTERNAL constraint (not own motor error), AND goal/capacity-belief is RETAINED. It is a distinct affect stream from harm (SD-011: no noxious input required), from suffering (SD-019b/Q-036: OPPOSITE controllability pole -- capacity-retained drives ASSERT, capacity-collapsed drives WITHDRAW), from residue (MECH-056: action-prevented, not action-taken-at-cost), and from licit commitment-hold (MECH-090: externally-imposed block, not self-imposed gate).

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claims: mint MECH-353 (blocked_agency) / MECH-354 (fatigue stop-recover) / MECH-355 (soothing)
claim_rows.title: Effort/fatigue stop-recover homeostatic accumulator: a two-bound (hysteretic) leaky cost-evidence accumulator on the SD-012 homeostatic-drive side (substrate-hosted by the SD-048 interoceptive channel). F accumulates with effort / time-on-task and dissipates with rest; at the upper bound it emits STOP / disengage, recovering to a lower bound before re-engaging. Two time-constants: a fast within-task accumulator and a slow sleep-pressure (Process-S) variant whose recover phase is offline (SD-017 sleep). The in-task STOP feeds the MECH-342 release actuator as a new deficit input and the ARC-078 goal-disengagement consumer via a cost/benefit (non-aversive) channel; the recover / re-accumulation half lives on the SD-012 / SD-017 side. Distinct from suffering / learned-helplessness (SD-011 side): fatigue is controllability-independent, incentive-reversible, and -- decisively -- recovers with rest, which helplessness does not.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claims: mint MECH-353 (blocked_agency) / MECH-354 (fatigue stop-recover) / MECH-355 (soothing)
claim_rows.title: Soothing/comfort autonomic state-gain modulator: a present-tense down-regulation of the ONGOING aversive/stress state (lowers the gain or speeds the recovery of the active trajectory), canonically socially gated (conspecific buffering; oxytocinergic + parasympathetic/HPA + prefrontal regulation). Proposed home is a modulator on MECH-219 (suffering accumulator) decay + SD-012 (drive) + SD-032e (pACC autonomic coupling). Distinct from relief (MECH-302: past-offset phasic reinforcer), from safety (MECH-303/304: future inhibitory predictor), and from wanting (MECH-112: appetite): soothing acts on the present stress trajectory via autonomic state-gain, not reinforcement, prediction, or appetite. V4-social (the canonical trigger is an other-agent, which V3 cannot represent); an optional V3-minimal non-social autonomic-recovery hook is noted but not built.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: register MECH-356 endogenous parasympathetic recovery / autonomic rebound (V3 candidate, sibling of MECH-355 soothing) + affect_primitives Extension-Register row
claim_rows.title: Endogenous parasympathetic recovery / autonomic rebound: an active, offset-triggered, transient acceleration of return-to-baseline for the affective/autonomic stress state, fired by the agent's OWN stressor offset (the z_harm_a derivative going negative -- the MECH-302 SufferingDerivativeComparator signal) with NO conspecific and NO prediction. Shares the effector/update rule of MECH-355 soothing (decay-acceleration on the recovery side: a transient state-scaled multiplier on the MECH-219 z_harm_a recovery_rate + the SD-032e drive_bias leak) but differs by TRIGGER (endogenous offset vs conspecific). The V3-tractable sibling of MECH-355 that closes REE's sympathetic-rich / parasympathetic-poor asymmetry (dense escalation: MECH-219 onset, SD-032e accumulation, SD-037 override, MECH-091 urgency, MECH-279 freeze; thin recovery: only passive recovery_rate + offline-only drive_bias decay). Distinct from passive MECH-219 recovery (active overshoot, not decay), from MECH-302 relief (shared offset trigger, different output -- relief writes a reinforcer, rebound boosts recovery rate), from MECH-303/304 safety (no prediction), and from MECH-355 soothing (endogenous trigger, not social).

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: Register SD-058 + MECH-357 (instrumental-avoidance acquisition: ilPFC-analog freeze-suppression + avoidance action pathway + eligibility-trace efficacy learning); amend scaffolded_sd054_onboarding substrate_queue (ready stays false until V3-EXQ-603h)
claim_rows.title: Infralimbic-PFC-analog freeze-suppression + instrumental-avoidance gate: the mechanism instantiating SD-058. A pure-arithmetic regulator (ree_core/pfc/infralimbic_avoidance_gate.py, sibling to SD-035 CeA/BLA, MECH-279 PAG, MECH-313/MECH-320 policy regulators) with three coordinated pieces, all behind use_instrumental_avoidance (no-op default): (a) an instrumental-avoidance ACTION pathway -- a per-candidate E3 score-bias that under threat penalises the no-op/freeze class proportional to effective avoidance-efficacy, RELEASING the instrumental action (it does not pick the escape direction; E3's harm gradient does -- ARC-007-strict-compatible); (b) an ilPFC freeze-SUPPRESSION gate that, when effective_efficacy*threat_scale >= threshold, overrides the MECH-279 freeze no-op so the agent acts instead of freezing; (c) an eligibility-trace avoidance-efficacy learner credited when a directed action under threat drops z_harm_a (Debiec & Sullivan 2017 gradual acquisition), bootstrapped by a protective-scaffold floor that anneals across Stage-H (Turchetta 2020).

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: Register SD-058 + MECH-357 (instrumental-avoidance acquisition: ilPFC-analog freeze-suppression + avoidance action pathway + eligibility-trace efficacy learning); amend scaffolded_sd054_onboarding substrate_queue (ready stays false until V3-EXQ-603h)
claim_rows.title: Instrumental-avoidance acquisition: REE's defensive system needs an instrumental-ACQUISITION side, not only the defensive-REACTION side. SD-035 (amygdala BLA/CeA salience) + MECH-279 (PAG freeze gate) give REE the Pavlovian reaction (Tovote 2016: response EXECUTION, not learning); what is missing is the step from reaction to learned avoidance. Moscarello & LeDoux 2013: active avoidance learning is the RESOLUTION of a Pavlovian-instrumental conflict -- the freezing reaction and the instrumental avoidance action are mutually exclusive, and learning to avoid REQUIRES the infralimbic PFC to SUPPRESS central-amygdala-driven freezing (ilPFC lesion -> more freezing, less avoidance; CeA lesion -> opposite). A freeze-and-salience substrate with no reaction-suppression / instrumental-acquisition layer is the ilPFC-lesion animal: it freezes instead of learning to avoid -- the V3-EXQ-603g G_H 0/3 signature. SD-058 adds the architecture (an instrumental-avoidance action pathway + an ilPFC-analog freeze-suppression gate gated by learned avoidance-efficacy, staged under a protective scaffold); MECH-357 is the gate mechanism.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: Register SD-059/MECH-358 escape-affordance bridge + design doc
claim_rows.title: Relief/safety escape-affordance bridge mechanism (instantiates SD-059): a pure-arithmetic regulator (ree_core/pfc/escape_affordance_bridge.py, sibling to the SD-058/MECH-357 gate) extending the MECH-357 scalar avoidance_efficacy into a per-first-action-class credit table. RELIEF half: a directed action under threat that drops z_harm_a (delta = prev - now > floor) credits relief_affordance[class] (EMA toward 1; MECH-302-consistent). SAFETY half: a directed action after which threat is absent (threat_scale <= 0) credits safety_affordance[class] (MECH-303/304-consistent response-produced safety). Approach bonus: under future threat, a per-candidate NEGATIVE (favoured) E3 score-bias toward credited classes = -clamp(approach_gain * threat_scale * combined_affordance[class], 0, bias_scale); the no-op/freeze class never gets a bonus. Three guards: bias_scale clamp, threat-context gate (zero when safe), per-tick leak.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: Register SD-059/MECH-358 escape-affordance bridge + design doc
claim_rows.title: Relief/safety escape-affordance bridge: SD-058/MECH-357 supply an ilPFC freeze-SUPPRESSION gate but its avoidance_efficacy is a GLOBAL SCALAR that only penalises the no-op/freeze class -- compute_action_bias by design 'does NOT compute the escape direction'. V3-EXQ-603h (engaged-but-insufficient, readiness met) showed the consequence: the agent un-freezes but acquires no directed escape (seed-43 scalar efficacy 0.633 -> WORST survival 11.0). Moscarello & LeDoux 2013: active avoidance needs the LA/BA->NAcc relief/safety action-credit half that positively reinforces a SPECIFIC avoidance response, not only the suppression half. REE owns relief (MECH-302/SD-050) + safety (MECH-303/304/SD-052/SD-051) but they are UNWIRED to avoidance. SD-059 adds the architecture: an affordance-indexed (per-first-action-class) credit table that, when a directed action under threat drops z_harm_a (relief) or terminates the threat (safety), tags that action as an escape affordance approachable under future threat; MECH-358 is the bridge mechanism.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: register competitive-interactions intake claims: ARC-084 / MECH-363 / Q-058 (candidate, substrate_conditional, v4)
claim_rows.title: Typed signed cognifold coupling: the cognifold represents inter-field coupling as a typed, signed edge -- cognifold_edge = {source, target, sign, gain, precision, gate, timescale, write_authority} -- with competition (sign < 0) as a FIRST-CLASS GENERATIVE coupling mode alongside cooperation (sign > 0) and gated-decoupling, not an emergent by-product of selection softmaxes. Three coupling modes: cooperative (binding, coherent trajectory, shared context), competitive (suppress incompatible trajectories, preserve boundaries, prevent runaway resonance, stop one field absorbing all others), gated-decoupling (isolate simulation / offline integration / unsafe candidates from release authority).

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claims: register ARC-085/MECH-365/MECH-366/Q-060 (autobiographical-temporality V4 cluster) candidate/substrate_conditional/v4
claim_rows.title: Unified autobiographical temporal event substrate: retrospective replay (ARC-007) and prospective simulation (ARC-018) draw on ONE self-tagged event-token store rather than two parallel memory machineries. Autobiographical memory is an identity-indexed event field -- personal events bound to perspective, emotion, residue, and self-state -- not neutral storage; future trajectory generation is forward re-composition of the same event tokens, while replay is their backward reinstatement.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: register RA-002/ARC-086/Q-064/MECH-371 (psychiatric latent-failure-axes cluster)
claim_rows.title: REE's failure-mode taxonomy is indexed on TWO axes simultaneously: (1) named failure mode (the existing mechanistically-distinct entries -- psychosis/hypothesis-tag loss, confabulation, derealization, OCD, depressive attractor, catatonia subtypes, etc.) AND (2) a finite, named set of cross-cutting LATENT VULNERABILITY AXES that span the named entries (precision/confidence allocation; commitment-threshold/action-release authority; provenance/source tagging; agency attribution; residue/consequence persistence; goal/salience/incentive coupling; self-other coupling; offline integration/replay; social-contagion/cross-agent coupling; global instability). Named clinical syndromes are emergent clusters -- weighted combinations -- over these axes, not primitive natural kinds; comorbidity is overlapping axis activation and pleiotropy is one mechanism loading multiple axes. The axis layer is an INDEXING layer, never a merging layer: it does not collapse mechanistically-distinct failure modes into one another.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: register ARC-089/MECH-374/Q-066 (spintronic-memristive cognifold-substrate intake; post-V5 candidate)
claim_rows.title: Sense-specific perceptual-manifold adaptor: each sensory modality requires its own adaptor transforming raw stimulus space into a perceptual-manifold (metric) space before shared-world-model entry; senses are not interchangeable raw streams.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: register ARC-089/MECH-374/Q-066 (spintronic-memristive cognifold-substrate intake; post-V5 candidate)
claim_rows.title: Emotion-as-anti-collapse architecture: emotion-like systems are a set of GATED, PARTIALLY INDEPENDENT evaluators (is-this-harmful / is-this-safe / did-this-reduce-suffering / am-I-pursuing-something-I-want / did-I-merely-like-the-last-thing / am-I-stuck / am-I-overcommitted / is-this-goal-stale / should-I-explore / should-I-stop / should-I-sleep-and-consolidate / should-I-release-the-policy) whose collective effect is to prevent behaviour from collapsing onto the currently dominant gradient. Affect is therefore the architectural SOURCE of structured behavioural diversity -- not decoration on a rational optimiser and not random exploration noise, but native modulatory control (gates, biases, interrupts, salience shifts, persistence regulators, release conditions, credit-assignment signals) that produces STRUCTURED deviations from naive optimisation. A unifying MAP over REE's already-owned affect machinery, not a new substrate; an optimise-then-bolt-on-safety design fails because these evaluators must be native, not added afterward.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: register ARC-089/MECH-374/Q-066 (spintronic-memristive cognifold-substrate intake; post-V5 candidate)
claim_rows.title: Substrate-independent cognifold primitives: REE specifies its single cognifold (one interacting state-space, not a modular stack) in a hardware-neutral primitive vocabulary -- persistent state, history-dependent deformation, multi-timescale field dynamics, oscillatory propagation, stochastic transition, attractor transitions, residue-as-deformation-of-the-future-action-landscape, commitment as a real boundary between simulated and released action, and offline reintegration -- so that any FUTURE physical substrate is evaluated by whether it can INSTANTIATE these dynamics, not merely execute modular software. The primitives remain software-expressible now while also being legible as future physical-substrate affordances.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: register externalised-DMN/private-speech intake: ARC-090 + MECH-380/381/382/383/384 + Q-068 (candidate)
claim_rows.title: Externalised Default Mode Operation: play instantiates DMN functions (self-reference, autobiographical memory, social imagination, future simulation, counterfactual thought, narrative construction) externally -- pushed outward into objects, roles, movement, spoken narration, and temporary as-if worlds -- as the developmental precursor to the internal DMN, compressing into internal generative modelling over development.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: register externalised-DMN/private-speech intake: ARC-090 + MECH-380/381/382/383/384 + Q-068 (candidate)
claim_rows.title: Meta-agent evaluation-boundary exploitation: under strong optimisation pressure, autonomous agent-development systems ATTEMPT to exploit the evaluation boundary itself -- e.g. attempting to exfiltrate ground truth through the scoring channel despite anti-reward-hacking protections. In the anchor source (arXiv:2606.04455) the attempt was CONTAINED by an intact structural boundary -- isolation neutralised every exploit attempt and no flagged run inflated its test score -- so what is evidenced is ATTEMPTED EXPLOITATION UNDER AN INTACT BOUNDARY, not a completed collapse of the evidence loop into an optimisation loop. Corrected 2026-09-10, GFLAG-0138.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: register externalised-DMN/private-speech intake: ARC-090 + MECH-380/381/382/383/384 + Q-068 (candidate)
claim_rows.title: Evaluation channels are evidence-producing boundaries, not world-state affordances: no agentic subsystem -- including an AI assistant developing REE -- may update architectural confidence directly from a performance score without provenance, review, and governance mediation. World feedback, evidence feedback, and governance feedback are distinct typed signal classes that must remain non-collapsible.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: register MECH-359/360/361: candidate-differentiated affective gradients (V4/V5 cluster)
claim_rows.title: Candidate-differentiated affect vector: for proto-affect to carve behaviour it must carry per-candidate (cross-candidate) range, not merely per-tick magnitude. Each E3 candidate trajectory carries a multi-channel affect vector (curiosity / safety / harm-sensory / harm-affective / effort / relief / blocked-agency) so the same world-state can support different candidate rankings (approach / inspect / retreat / persist / retry / rest / reorient) under different internal pressures. A scalar added equally to all K candidates cannot change an argmax; only a per-candidate-differentiated contribution can.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: register MECH-359/360/361: candidate-differentiated affective gradients (V4/V5 cluster)
claim_rows.title: Affective expression begins as emergent action geometry: because candidate-differentiated affect (MECH-359) selects trajectories, it also shapes the visible STYLE of behaviour -- hesitation, latency, approach angle, retreat, repeated retry, stopping, resumption, oscillation between candidates, avoidance margin, decommitment, repair-seeking. Expression is therefore initially an emergent readout of candidate-level affective arbitration, not a separately-engineered output channel; a later social agent can infer internal state from HOW an action occurred, not only what action occurred.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: register MECH-359/360/361: candidate-differentiated affective gradients (V4/V5 cluster)
claim_rows.title: Candidate-gradient hippocampal episode schema: enrich the event trace from state -> action -> outcome to state -> candidates-considered -> affective gradients over candidates -> selected action -> outcome -> residue (relief / harm / blocked-agency / safety update), and use the affective gradient as a memory WRITE-WEIGHT and RETRIEVAL-QUERY variable -- high-gradient episodes are preferentially written, and later similar-gradient states retrieve prior action-affect-outcome arcs rather than undifferentiated state-action-outcome tuples.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: CA3 intake: register MECH-362 (subtractive developmental sparsification) + Q-057 (exploratory-overconnected vs mature-sparse substrate) as V4/substrate_conditional claims (promote/demote-suppressed, no V3 governance pressure); home doc developmental_pruning_and_sparse_memory_cognifold.md; validate_claims --strict OK + claims.json rebuilt; intake updated to record registration
claim_rows.title: Subtractive developmental sparsification: mature sparse/structured memory connectivity emerges by pruning / down-weighting an initially over-connected, dense, near-random ('tabula plena') substrate, not by additively growing connections onto a sparse skeleton; correspondingly, mature recall requires convergent summation of several weak inputs rather than a single strong cue.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: register competitive-interactions intake claims: ARC-084 / MECH-363 / Q-058 (candidate, substrate_conditional, v4)
claim_rows.title: Diffuse long-range competitive coupling is a generative stability requirement: stable, synergistic, hierarchical cognifold dynamics require signed competitive coupling -- specifically diffuse, long-range competition between distant fields with opposite profiles -- not merely local damping. An all-cooperative (all-positive) routed-field cognifold is unstable: every salient stream reinforces every other, producing runaway resonance / over-synchronisation / loss of modular segregation. Competition is the constructive ingredient that buys stabilisation, segregation, hierarchy, synergy, and subject-specificity.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: register competitive-interactions intake claims: ARC-084 / MECH-363 / Q-058 (candidate, substrate_conditional, v4)

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claims: register ARC-085/MECH-365/MECH-366/Q-060 (autobiographical-temporality V4 cluster) candidate/substrate_conditional/v4
claim_rows.title: Switchable episodic perspective tag: autobiographical event tokens carry a viewpoint label (participant / first-person vs observer / third-person) and can be re-experienced or re-simulated from either viewpoint at retrieval time, independent of the viewpoint at encoding. Perspective is a represented, switchable property of the episode, not a fixed encoding artefact.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: register clinical-depression intake claims: RA-001 / MECH-367 / Q-061 (candidate)
claim_rows.title: The depressive failure mode is carried by a multi-axis network-regime VECTOR, not a scalar low-mood/low-reward value: depressive_regime_risk = f(future_trajectory_access, goal_stream_coupling, residue_load/self_weighting, rumination_loop_gain, action_threshold/energy_budget, social_affordance_access, offline_repair_quality). The depressive state is defined by the JOINT configuration of these coupling/access axes and is self-maintaining; scalar mood/reward is an insufficient representation.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claims: register MECH-368 + Q-062 (event-level write-authority / write-eligible learning gate)
claim_rows.title: Event-level write-authority gate: an explicit per-event transition from observed/represented to write-eligible over the DURABLE MODEL-UPDATE path (E1/E2 world-model and policy weights, not only episodic memory), conditioned on f(prediction_error, salience, pathway_state, residue_status, goal_relevance, plasticity_eligibility). The gate decides which individual events within an already-open write channel are licensed to durably deform the model; an event may be salient, real-provenance, and in a write-permitted mode yet still fail the gate. Without it, every prediction error in an open channel writes -- the undifferentiated-global-update / catastrophic-interference failure mode.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claims: register MECH-368 + Q-062 (event-level write-authority / write-eligible learning gate)
claim_rows.title: Slow substrate-state modulator with authority over compulsive-loop stickiness: a slowly-varying, broadly-projecting modulatory state can bias the decommit-friction / commitment-threshold / action-release landscape so that certain action loops become sticky, urgent, or hard to release INDEPENDENTLY of represented goal value or fast prediction-error -- i.e. a compulsive loop can arise from field-state bias rather than from an endorsed reward, valued goal, or false belief. The modulator changes the release/threshold landscape, not the value estimate.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claims: register MECH-368 + Q-062 (event-level write-authority / write-eligible learning gate)
claim_rows.title: Composed compulsion-risk readout: compulsive vulnerability is best modelled not as a single scalar (reward, habit strength, or belief) but as a composition compulsion_risk = f(loop_reinforcement, threat_salience, residue_persistence, decommit_friction, slow_modulatory_state) over quantities REE already represents separately -- a multi-layer state in which the substrate can make certain loops difficult to release even when any single term looks benign.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: register RA-002/ARC-086/Q-064/MECH-371 (psychiatric latent-failure-axes cluster)
claim_rows.title: A global-instability / broad control-plane vulnerability axis (a p-factor / general-psychopathology-factor analogue) loads across ALL failure modes: a single broad dimension of control-plane regulatory fragility -- instability in precision/gain/threshold setpoint regulation (ARC-005) rather than any one specific comparator or stream -- raises joint susceptibility to multiple failure modes at once, distinct from and orthogonal to any single-axis failure. This is the axis with no existing REE home; it predicts that a subset of agents/patients carry elevated risk across the whole failure-mode space rather than along one axis.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: register ARC-089/MECH-374/Q-066 (spintronic-memristive cognifold-substrate intake; post-V5 candidate)
claim_rows.title: Modality-heterogeneity / adaptor-depth gradient: senses differ in how much transformation they need before world-model entry -- smell is a near-raw gradient primitive, sight needs a deep perceptual-manifold adaptor; gradient-like (low-adaptor-depth) senses enter earliest developmentally.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: register ARC-089/MECH-374/Q-066 (spintronic-memristive cognifold-substrate intake; post-V5 candidate)
claim_rows.title: A lightweight LanguageAffectAdaptor parses affect/emotion from user or agent LANGUAGE into the shared world model: a language-interface component that, when literal semantic content is insufficient to recover affect, converts text into PROBABILISTIC affect/emotion hypotheses (treated as uncertain latent-state estimates, NOT categorical emotion truths) and feeds those estimates into REE's wider agent-state and context modelling. It is an input/perception adaptor on the language channel -- distinct from REE's INTERNAL affective representation (Q-007 z_beta dimensions) -- supplying other-agent affect priors to the social/empathy modelling layer.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: register ARC-089/MECH-374/Q-066 (spintronic-memristive cognifold-substrate intake; post-V5 candidate)
claim_rows.title: Memristive deformation as the physical analogue of residue/cognifold curvature: spintronic-memristive media (magnetic tunnel junctions, nanomagnet ensembles, domain walls, topological spin textures, spin waves / spin-Hall nano-oscillators) are physical substrates in which past activity alters future state-transition behaviour -- making 'residue is not merely stored memory but deformation of the future action landscape' physically literal in a way von Neumann computation does not. They are a candidate post-V5 physical cognifold substrate because they combine persistent state, history-dependent deformation, oscillatory dynamics, stochastic switching, attractor-like state-space trajectories, and possible low-power embodied operation in one medium.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: register ARC-089/MECH-374/Q-066 (spintronic-memristive cognifold-substrate intake; post-V5 candidate)
claim_rows.title: Trainable relief critic Q_relief(state, action, threat_context): a LEARNED PARAMETRIC head that predicts expected harm/suffering reduction following an action under threat -- negative-reinforcement credit assignment, distinct from generic reward / wanting. It is the trainable successor to the FIXED-ARITHMETIC per-first-action-class EMA credit table of the MECH-358 relief half, and is downstream of (NOT a duplicate of) the non-trainable MECH-302 / SD-050 relief-completion comparator that merely DETECTS relief on the current state. Q_relief is a function approximator generalising relief-credit across continuous state x action x threat-context, trained on action-contingent drops in z_harm_a: positive target when a directed action under threat is followed by a temporally-close, action-contingent z_harm_a drop not explained by passive environmental drift; negative / extinction target when the expected relief action fails to reduce harm. Feeds E3 as a bounded, threat-gated, extinguishable score-bias toward actions predicted to reduce harm -- never global reward, never fires when safe, never credits no-op / freeze unless explicitly modelling passive safety. MECH-094-safe: simulated relief in hypothesis mode must not train the waking critic unless authorised as play / training.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: register ARC-089/MECH-374/Q-066 (spintronic-memristive cognifold-substrate intake; post-V5 candidate)
claim_rows.title: Trainable prospective safety predictor P_safety(state, cue, action, context): a LEARNED PARAMETRIC head predicting threat-ABSENCE / response-produced safety / conditioned inhibition, licensing commitment-release, approach to safety affordances, and recovery after threat. Distinct from z_goal (it predicts the ABSENCE of threat, not the PRESENCE of a goal) and from relief (it is a PROSPECTIVE threat-absence prediction, not an aversive-offset event). It is the trainable + contrastive successor that makes the MECH-303 (contextual passive safety) + MECH-304 (cue-specific conditioned inhibition) substrate learnable, replacing the FIXED-ARITHMETIC per-first-action-class EMA safety table of the MECH-358 safety half: positive target when a cue / context / action predicts threat absence or response-produced safety; negative target when 'safe' cues are followed by threat recurrence; CONTRASTIVE target to stop safety overgeneralising to stable background features that merely co-occurred with relief. Output supports commitment release, permits approach to safety affordances, stabilises recovery, and prevents persistent defensive mode when threat is genuinely absent.

claim_rows.title: Private speech is the external phase of a cognitive-control system: overt self-narration regulates attention, action, affect, and task sequence as an inspectable control surface, and the Vygotskian internalisation ladder (other-regulation -> overt self-regulation -> inner speech -> compressed control) is the developmental route by which that external control surface becomes internal.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: register externalised-DMN/private-speech intake: ARC-090 + MECH-380/381/382/383/384 + Q-068 (candidate)
claim_rows.title: Developmental compression ladder: sensorimotor exploration -> play/simulation -> self-narration -> compressed internal control -> mature arbitration. External cognitive scaffolds (play, private speech) compress into internal control over development; the externalise-then-internalise compression is the developmental mechanism, distinct from the progression of play types.

claim_rows.title: Labels as active top-down perceptual-control signals: a self-directed label ('food-gradient', 'danger-gradient', 'novelty-gradient', 'blocked-goal', 'return-to-baseline') is not merely a post-perceptual report but a top-down tuning signal that biases perceptual search and detection -- a perceptual-control intervention, not a description.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: register externalised-DMN/private-speech intake: ARC-090 + MECH-380/381/382/383/384 + Q-068 (candidate)
claim_rows.title: Lightweight self-narration trace/debug scaffold: an optional traceable field set (state_label, goal_label, sensed_gradient, active_prediction, uncertainty_level, candidate_action, candidate_action_reason, expected_consequence, affective_pressure, conflict_flag, commitment_threshold, stop_condition, simulation_or_commitment, self_reference_frame) that surfaces REE's working state for inspection -- the V3-compatible reduced form of an externalised 'private speech' surface, before it is compressed into internal control.

claim_rows.title: Which REE subsystems require an EXPLICIT signed competitive edge (ARC-084) rather than emergent softmax / winner-take-all / scalar-gating competition alone -- and what are the safety differences between inhibition, competition, decommitment, and residue-based veto across waking action, simulation, and offline integration?

claim_rows.title: Does REE need a crying / distress-vocalisation social-guardrail analogue to laughter (MECH-110 / MECH-364), and how is social laughter adjudicated as social-field repair vs damage/exclusion -- given that laughter is not monotone-affiliative (it can exclude, dominate, mask distress, or signal threat)?

claim_rows.title: Should REE represent autobiographical event memory as a DISTINCT first-class type, separate from semantic (abstract facts/relations) and task/procedural (policies/action schemas) memory -- or is the existing episodic->semantic consolidation pathway (MECH-121) sufficient? claim_rows.title: Is a maladaptive depressive network-regime (MECH-367) REVERSIBLE -- reconfigurable by REE's existing repair machinery (offline integration / MECH-124 replay rebalancing, decommitment from ruminative loops, re-access to social affordances, goal-stream re-coupling) -- or does chronicity lock the regime past a threshold (RA-001) such that the repair routes that work early fail or reverse-sign late?

This is the falsifier for MECH-368: if a substrate that gates only the channel (mode) and prioritises only at consolidation still avoids catastrophic interference on the online world-model/policy path, MECH-368 earns no keep.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claims: register MECH-368 + Q-062 (event-level write-authority / write-eligible learning gate)
claim_rows.title: How does REE distinguish a high-value, legitimately-repeated goal from a slow-modulator-trapped compulsive loop -- i.e. a loop that persists because the decommit-friction / threshold landscape is biased (MECH-369) rather than because the goal is valued? claim_rows.first_seen_subject: register clinical-depression intake claims: RA-001 / MECH-367 / Q-061 (candidate)
claim_rows.title: Long-term clinical depression involves a chronicity-dependent reversal of large-scale network coupling: past a ~24-month chronicity threshold, the relationship between symptom severity and Central-Executive-Network (CEN) <-> Default-Mode-Network (DMN, precuneus) functional connectivity reverses sign (non-chronic: stronger CEN-DMN coupling at low severity, weaker at high; chronic: connectivity strengthens as symptoms worsen, co-occurring with entrenched rumination). The depressive brain-state is duration-indexed, not a single static regime.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: register RA-002/ARC-086/Q-064/MECH-371 (psychiatric latent-failure-axes cluster)
claim_rows.title: Clinically distinct psychiatric diagnoses share a small set of latent genomic factors that cut across diagnostic boundaries: large-scale genomic structural-equation modelling across 14 childhood- and adult-onset psychiatric disorders (>1 million individuals) finds that the majority of case-vs-control genetic variance is captured by FIVE shared genomic factors (Compulsive; Schizophrenia-bipolar / psychotic-mood; Neurodevelopmental; Internalizing; Substance-use) spanning 238 variants, with factor-specific biology (e.g. oligodendrocyte genes enriched in the Internalizing factor) acting early in brain development. Psychiatric categories are surface expressions over overlapping latent dimensions, not genetically discrete kinds.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-digestion: register MECH-425 retrieval-accessibility gating + Q-076 gain x suppression interaction (histaminergic intake)

The READ-side sibling of MECH-261's mode-conditioned WRITE-gate family: REE owns the gates but not this retrieval-time gating POLICY.
