claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claims: reap ABM-9 completion-set partners MECH-429/430/431 (schema-congruence consolidation write-weight; multi-dimensional provenance vector; tag-and-capture two-factor write-eligibility) -- candidate/substrate_conditional/v4, PROMOTE NOTHING
claim_rows.title: Schema-congruence as a consolidation write-weight and routing variable: the degree of fit between an event and the agent's existing schemas modulates how that event is consolidated -- schema-congruent content is consolidated preferentially and routed more directly into the durable/semantic store (a fast vmPFC-gated systems-consolidation route), while schema-incongruent content requires prolonged hippocampal-dependent consolidation or is gated out. Schema-fit is a WRITE-WEIGHT input to consolidation alongside affect (MECH-361), not only a retrieval-time prior.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claims: reap ABM-9 completion-set partners MECH-429/430/431 (schema-congruence consolidation write-weight; multi-dimensional provenance vector; tag-and-capture two-factor write-eligibility) -- candidate/substrate_conditional/v4, PROMOTE NOTHING
claim_rows.title: Multi-dimensional provenance source vector: an event token's provenance is a SOURCE VECTOR over several partly-independent dimensions (perceived-vs-imagined, self-generated-vs-other-generated, source identity, temporal source, modality), not a single committed_vs_imagined bit. Provenance failures dissociate per-dimension -- the system can correctly attribute real-vs-imagined while mis-attributing who-generated-it or when -- so each dimension carries its own confidence, and the one-way committed gate applies per safety-relevant dimension rather than to a single global bit.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claims: reap ABM-9 completion-set partners MECH-429/430/431 (schema-congruence consolidation write-weight; multi-dimensional provenance vector; tag-and-capture two-factor write-eligibility) -- candidate/substrate_conditional/v4, PROMOTE NOTHING
claim_rows.title: Two-factor (tag-and-capture) write-eligibility: MECH-368's plasticity_eligibility is not a single instantaneous test but a TWO-STAGE process -- a local event sets a transient, input-specific eligibility TAG, and a durable model/policy write is consummated only if that tag CAPTURES a separately-gated plasticity/consolidation-resource signal within a time window. A tagged-eligible event can still fail to write if no capture signal arrives, and an arriving capture signal can rescue a recently-tagged weak event.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claims: register GDL-8 completion-set partners MECH-432 (dACC<->FPC loop) + MECH-433 (LC-NE explore/exploit gain) + Q-077 (slot-vs-resource fork); candidate/v4/substrate_conditional, PROMOTES NOTHING
claim_rows.title: dACC<->FPC reciprocal arbitration loop: the switch-to-alternative decision is not computed in one module but emerges from a comparison ACROSS two substrates -- the FPC-analog (SD-033e/MECH-264) carries the counterfactual value of the specific unchosen option, the dACC-analog (SD-032b) carries the environment search-value and expected-value-of-control, and slot-switching (SD-046) is gated by their relative comparison. Neither signal alone drives the switch; the loop does.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claims: register GDL-8 completion-set partners MECH-432 (dACC<->FPC loop) + MECH-433 (LC-NE explore/exploit gain) + Q-077 (slot-vs-resource fork); candidate/v4/substrate_conditional, PROMOTES NOTHING
claim_rows.title: LC-NE-analog explore/exploit gain control: a value-INDEPENDENT, broadly-projecting tonic/phasic gain signal gates DISENGAGEMENT from the committed course. Phasic gain stabilises current-task exploitation; a tonic-mode shift -- driven by waning task utility monitored in the dACC/value system -- licenses disengagement to explore alternatives, supplying the trigger that MECH-264's value-margin switch alone does not. REE has no NE-analog substrate today; this names the missing modulator.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: session: register MECH-434 epistemic-commitment-timing (inference_belief_state_v4) + 4 grounding entries (Cisek2009 urgency-gating / Mobbs2020 + Arnsten2009 panic pole / Hauser2017 freezing pole) + V4 belief-state design-notes -> the register axis that did NOT reduce to MECH-126; cross-ref MECH-433; lit_conf only (0.865), exp_conf 0, PROMOTES NOTHING
claim_rows.title: Epistemic commitment timing: the inference layer's decision of WHEN to stop gathering evidence and commit a trajectory is a governed control parameter (an urgency/threshold over the belief-state set), balancing pragmatic value (act now) against epistemic value (sample more). Its two failure poles are epistemic-freezing (epistemic value over-weighted / threshold too high -> the agent keeps sampling and never commits) and anti-epistemic-panic (under threat, the epistemic term collapses / urgency forced high -> the agent commits on too little evidence). This axis is NOT reducible to the MECH-126 state-abstraction failure taxonomy; it lives at the seam between the belief-state hypothesis set (MECH-385) / epistemic action pressure (MECH-388) and the commitment gate (MECH-061 / MECH-090), and has an inverted-U optimum rather than a monotone.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claims: register MECH-435 (opportunity-cost-of-time arbitration currency, candidate/substrate_conditional/v4; component of MECH-394) -- proposal-first from DRV-3 lit-pull, wired into MECH-394.depends_on
claim_rows.title: Multidrive arbitration is priced in a common opportunity-cost-of-time currency: a global, slowly-varying tonic vigour signal (the long-run average reward rate / opportunity cost of dwelling on the currently-arbitrated drive) supplies the commensurable scale over which otherwise-incommensurable drive axes compete, sitting ABOVE the per-candidate liking-stream score_bias (MECH-295). The currency sets HOW VIGOROUSLY the arbitrated drive is pursued; it does NOT by itself determine WHICH drive wins -- selection additionally requires a per-axis-differentiated benefit gradient, so the global scalar is necessary-but-insufficient for arbitration.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claims: register GDL-8 completion-set partners MECH-432 (dACC<->FPC loop) + MECH-433 (LC-NE explore/exploit gain) + Q-077 (slot-vs-resource fork); candidate/v4/substrate_conditional, PROMOTES NOTHING
claim_rows.title: Is SD-046's multi-slot GoalState a set of DISCRETE fixed-capacity slots (Cowan ~4-chunk focus-of-attention) or a single FLEXIBLE precision-resource shared across goals (Bays & Husain), with the acted-on goal drawing disproportionate precision? The human capacity literature is itself unresolved on slot-vs-resource; the answer sets whether SD-046 degrades by a hard cutoff past N or by graceful precision dilution as goals are added.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claim-synthesis: split MECH-229 -> register MECH-436 (drive-state-modulated wanting; substrate_conditional; owning falsifier V3-EXQ-514r)
claim_rows.title: Drive-state modulation of wanting (incentive salience): the homeostatic drive STATE modulates the wanting target and/or intensity dissociably from liking -- the most-wanted object tracks the currently-most-depleted drive axis (incentive-salience amplitude ~ base_value*(1+kappa*per_axis_drive)) even when the liking/consummatory target does not. Split from MECH-229 2026-06-16: MECH-229 asserts wanting and liking are dissociable SIGNALS (the object-bound dissociation, established by V3-EXQ-514o); MECH-436 is the distinct, finer claim that wanting is additionally DRIVE-STATE-MODULATED -- the incentive-salience core the 514m/514p/514q lineage kept (in different broken ways) trying to express.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claims: register MECH-437/MECH-438 (rule-distinguishability mechanisms) from REE_convergence intake
claim_rows.title: Rule-pool distinguishability is a MAINTAINED property, not a minting byproduct: keeping the CandidateRuleField pool mutually distinguishable (so co-matching rules remain jointly selectable through the conflict gate) requires a periodic, non-gradient consolidation/refactor operator over the minted pool -- compress and merge near-duplicate rules, retire rules that never reach selection, and re-separate the survivors under a description-length / separability objective -- rather than a reactive affine gate theta(n_matched). The maintained invariant is that mean n_matched stays low enough that theta(n_matched) sits below the availability ceiling.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claims: register MECH-437/MECH-438 (rule-distinguishability mechanisms) from REE_convergence intake
claim_rows.title: Constructive rule-key separability: minted CandidateRule context keys should be assigned in a quantised / categorical codebook that is separable by construction (a DreamerV3-style discrete latent codebook), bounding the number of rules that co-match any context (n_matched) up front so theta(n_matched) stays below the availability ceiling -- rather than letting overlapping continuous context tags produce unbounded co-match counts that the conflict gate then locks out. The codebook capacity must be large enough to keep genuinely-distinct rules on distinct keys (no key-collapse).

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: persist conversion-ceiling Phase 0: register MECH-439 (F-dominance) + synthesis doc + closure cross-refs
claim_rows.title: F-dominance bounds committed-action diversity: the primary harm/goal score (F) monopolises ~88-89% of E3 committed-selection variance (V3-EXQ-571: 0.886 baseline, 0.894 with the full diversity stack -- the stack does not dent F's share), so modulatory, within-class, and rule-bias diversity channels cannot convert to committed-action diversity while F dominates -- they act only at near-ties. The committed-action-diversity conversion ceiling is therefore a SELECTION-VARIANCE problem (primary-vs-modulatory share), not (only) a candidate-pool geometry problem; a shortlist-then-modulate lever circumvents F locally but may cap committed entropy below the proposer ceiling unless F's variance share is itself rebalanced.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: convergence CDQ-002 (NoisyNet + RND/Plan2Explore intake): register MECH-440/441 candidates + lit-pull + packet
claim_rows.title: state_conditioned_self_annealing_noise_floor (NoisyNet learned-parametric-weight-noise analog). A mechanistic refinement of MECH-313's tonic exploration noise floor. MECH-313 is registered as a STATE-INDEPENDENT floor (a post-softmax max-entropy/temperature analog); V3-EXQ-687 found that floor NON-PROPAGATING -- the temperature was invisible to the argmax/committed action (selected_action_entropy=0.0, the r1a_entropy_only_artefact the degeneracy gate caught). MECH-440 asserts the LC-NE tonic floor must instead be injected as LEARNED PER-PARAMETER (factorised-Gaussian) WEIGHT NOISE in the E3 selection pathway, so it (i) PROPAGATES into the committed action (it changes which action is argmax, not just a discarded pre-commit temperature), (ii) is STATE-CONDITIONED by construction (weight noise x state-dependent activations perturbs different states differently, with no hand-set per-state schedule), and (iii) SELF-ANNEALS (a gradient-trained per-parameter sigma falls where the policy is confident and stays up where exploration pays, so the floor does not wash out committed-action diversity uniformly). External analog: NoisyNet (Fortunato et al. 2018).

claim_rows.title: model_disagreement_directed_curiosity (RND / Plan2Explore analog). A mechanistic refinement of MECH-314's structured_curiosity_bonus: a PER-CANDIDATE, SELF-ANNEALING intrinsic curiosity signal derived from E2 FORWARD-MODEL DISAGREEMENT (an ensemble / dropout-variance proxy over E2 forward predictions) -- high where the forward model is uncertain, collapsing toward zero as a region is learned -- fed into E3 selection so it PROPAGATES per-candidate to the committed action, unlike the broadcast-novelty EMA channel found non-propagating in V3-EXQ-590a / EXQ-141b. The self-annealing-on-learning-progress property is the non-degeneracy guard against a cross-candidate-flat (degenerate) bonus. External analog: RND (Burda et al. 2018) predictor-error novelty; Plan2Explore (Sekar et al. 2020) ensemble model-disagreement. Maps to MECH-314c learning-progress / MECH-314b uncertainty-driven curiosity.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: convergence CDQ-003 (Quality-Diversity / MAP-Elites): register MECH-442 candidate + lit-pull (5 PubMed) + packet inbox
claim_rows.title: Committed-action diversity survives the selection/commit step via a behavioral-descriptor eligible-set ARCHIVE (Quality-Diversity / MAP-Elites analog) -- NARROWED 2026-09-10 (GFLAG-0186, partial absorption ADOPTED; option A) to the two residuals that are genuinely unbuilt: (i) a behavioral descriptor OTHER than first-action class -- the e2.world_forward strategy signature or the realised committed-action class -- and (ii) niche partitioning placed at the ELIGIBLE-SET RESTRICTION stage of E3TrajectorySelector.select, composed with MECH-448 f_demotion, rather than at MECH-341's score-composition stage. The rest of the mechanism as originally registered is BUILT under other ids and is NOT re-claimed here: MECH-341::stratified_select is already a descriptor-indexed per-niche-elite archive with a coverage-aware commit rule for descriptor = first-action class; MECH-448 f_demotion is already an eligible-set restriction upstream of the argmax, with precedence over top_k; MECH-449 Go/No-Go is the validated partner (V3-EXQ-689g PASS). What the residual still predicts: on a descriptor the built route does not partition, a behaviorally-distinct action stays selectable at a moderate primary-score (F) gap, bounded by the per-niche-elite safety envelope, rather than collapsing to the single global optimum of F. The F-dominated committed argmax itself (MECH-439) is biologically faithful and is NOT changed -- only the eligible-set structure feeding it. Nothing is retired and no id is superseded by this narrowing.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: convergence CDQ-005: register MECH-443/444 (MuZero/EfficientZero reanalyze replay write-gating) wired into arc_062 GAP-K; biology lit-pull + gate-ready packet
claim_rows.title: priority_weighted_replay_write_selection (MuZero/EfficientZero reanalyze + hippocampal prioritized-replay analog). A mechanistic refinement of MECH-319's simulation-mode rule-write gate. MECH-319 is a BINARY categorical gate: during a ghost/replay/DMN pass it either blocks arbitration-weight writes (normal) or admits them (the V3-EXQ-543c/628 falsifier flag) -- all-or-nothing, no ordering among the replayed transitions it admits. MECH-443 asserts that WHEN the replay write channel is open, the transitions admitted to update the rule-arbitration layer should not be written uniformly but in GRADED priority order, weighted by an update-utility signal (a surprise / value-prediction-error / coverage proxy), so a high-utility replayed transition writes more strongly and a low-utility one writes weakly or not at all. The external analog is EfficientZero/MuZero prioritized experience replay (priority ~ value-prediction error); the biology is hippocampal SWR replay, which is demonstrably prioritized rather than uniform. CRITICAL REFINEMENT FROM BIOLOGY: the priority is the value of the UPDATE (Mattar & Daw gain x need), NOT raw reward magnitude or current action-value -- Carey et al. 2019 shows replay can be biased AWAY from the currently-most-valuable outcome. MECH-443 is the WHICH/HOW-STRONGLY complement to MECH-319's WHETHER gate; it does not change the binary gate, it grades the admitted writes.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: convergence CDQ-005: register MECH-443/444 (MuZero/EfficientZero reanalyze replay write-gating) wired into arc_062 GAP-K; biology lit-pull + gate-ready packet
claim_rows.title: staleness_gated_target_refresh_on_replay_write (MuZero/EfficientZero reanalyze analog). The second, more speculative leg of the CDQ-005 reanalyze import, complementary to MECH-443. Asserts that a replayed transition admitted to update the rule-arbitration layer should NOT write its stored (ghost-derived, possibly stale) target verbatim; the target should first be RECOMPUTED against the current model/policy before it updates the rule layer, and the write should be down-weighted or skipped when the recomputed target has not drifted from the stored one (low staleness => low update value). This is the MuZero reanalyze trick (re-run the model on stored trajectories to produce fresh targets) plus EfficientZero off-policy/staleness correction. It guards against the failure MECH-319 was built to prevent (overcommitment to ghost-derived arbitration weights) from re-entering THROUGH the admitted-write channel that MECH-443 opens: prioritized writing of STALE targets would re-introduce drift, so the priority signal (MECH-443) and the freshness signal (MECH-444) must operate together.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: Register 3 BG missing-piece claims ARC-108/ARC-109/MECH-450 (assembly-map E.2 intake-reap)
claim_rows.title: Unified dopamine substrate -- signed dopaminergic-RPE teaching signal feeding LEARNED gating weights on the E3 selector: the cortico-striatal weights that decide which channel wins committed-selection authority should themselves be LEARNED via three-factor plasticity (Hebbian co-activation x signed dopaminergic RPE) with the D1-LTP / D2-LTD asymmetry, consolidating the currently-scattered RPE / vigor / incentive functions into one substrate and supplying the GPi->lateral-habenula negative-RPE drain. The ARC-107 arbitration layer (MECH-447/448/449 + the authority rescale) is today pure arithmetic with NO learned parameters; F monopolises 88-89% of committed-selection variance (MECH-439) precisely because no learned striatal weighting can re-weight channels through experience. claim_rows.first_seen_subject: Register 3 BG missing-piece claims ARC-108/ARC-109/MECH-450 (assembly-map E.2 intake-reap)

REE today renders Go/No-Go as a scoring SIGN (benefit_eval_head minus harm_eval_head; MECH-449 Go-promote / No-Go-suppress over the eligible set) -- dissociable pathways pre-summed into one cost. The split is REQUIRED to EARN the Parkinson / dyskinesia / Huntington / impulse-control-disorder psychiatric axis per the ARC-106 EARNS criterion.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: Register ARC-110 (parallel segregated motor/cognitive/motivational loops) + ARC-111 (context-conditioned weights proper); correct MECH-062 stable->candidate
claim_rows.title: Parallel segregated cortico-BG-thalamic loops (motor / cognitive-set / motivational): committed-action selection should run through SEPARATE striatal loop channels -- a motor loop, an associative/cognitive-set loop, and a limbic/motivational loop -- each owning its own eligibility-and-gate, arbitrated AFTER within-loop competition, rather than collapsing all channels into ONE shared E3 selection arena where the dACC/lPFC/OFC analogs feed in only as additive biases. HYPOTHESIS (assembly-map A.2 / s.D): the F-dominance conversion ceiling (MECH-439) is partly an ARTEFACT of the single-arena collapse -- F monopolises 88-89% of committed-selection variance because every channel competes in one F-dominated arena; with segregated loops F could dominate only the motor loop and could not drown the limbic 'is this worth committing to' computation, which is a different loop with a different value. Translation target is FUNCTIONAL (the Alexander/DeLong/Strick parallel-loop organisation as a divergence-ledgered, falsifier-validated analogue), NOT anatomical mimicry.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: Register ARC-110 (parallel segregated motor/cognitive/motivational loops) + ARC-111 (context-conditioned weights proper); correct MECH-062 stable->candidate
claim_rows.title: Context-conditioned weights PROPER -- learned connection weights as a function of context, distinct from context-conditioned GAIN: REE today has the GAIN form of context-conditioning (ARC-044's unifier -- a context-specific multiplicative scalar: MECH-152 terrain_weight scaling E3 harm/goal scoring, ARC-016 precision, MECH-261 mode-conditioned write-CHANNEL gating) which modulates a FIXED transfer function. It does NOT have the WEIGHT form: a substrate where the learned connection weights THEMSELVES are a function of context (a different effective weight set selected/generated per context -- the transfer function changes, not a gain on it). The valuation/gating parameters are static nn.Modules; context enters only through the INPUT (z_world) and through output GAIN, never through the weights. HYPOTHESIS: genuinely context-dependent BEHAVIOUR (not just context-scaled magnitude) requires context to reach the weights -- the learned per-channel selection weight w_chan conditioned on z_world that ARC-108 introduces is the first instance of this WEIGHT form at the gating layer.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: Register 3 BG missing-piece claims ARC-108/ARC-109/MECH-450 (assembly-map E.2 intake-reap)
claim_rows.title: Minimal recurrent settling step over the eligible set: replace the one-shot feed-forward argmin/softmax committed-selection readout with a few rounds of mutual-inhibition (surround-inhibition) updates on the within-eligible _modulatory_accum field BEFORE commit, so the committed action emerges from a bounded recurrent SETTLING competition rather than a single global comparison. A hard argmin over an F-dominated score always returns the F-winner (the conversion ceiling); a settling competition with lateral inhibition can FLIP the selected attractor when a modulatory channel is strong enough, and turns the additive _modulatory_accum BLEND into a competitive winner-take-most. The V3-bounded version of the BG's recurrent settling dynamics; the full learned thalamo-cortico-basal loop is the V4 bet.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-digestion: reap V3-EXQ-700 loop-decomp intake residue -> MECH-451/452/453 + EXP-0391
claim_rows.title: Intermediate channel-granularity falsifier -- before the full segregated-loop build (ARC-110), expose the compressed E3 score_bias modulatory channel as SEVERAL separately-learnable finer channels (OFC-devaluation / dACC-conflict / lateral-PFC rule-evidence / vigour / liking) to the learned-gating layer (ARC-108 w_chan), so the learner can discover SEPARATELY that different control functions matter in different states. The current single global w_chan learns one weight over a pre-compressed blend; this tests whether the F-dominance conversion ceiling (MECH-439) is REPRESENTATIONAL COMPRESSION (finer channels convert non-motor influence to committed action) rather than a requirement for full per-loop competition (finer channels do NOT convert, and only ARC-110 segregated loops do). The cheap intermediate rung BETWEEN ARC-108's one global weight vector and ARC-110's full segregated loops -- a V3-tractable falsifier that can pre-empt the V4 loop build.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-digestion: reap V3-EXQ-700 loop-decomp intake residue -> MECH-451/452/453 + EXP-0391
claim_rows.title: Loop-local eligibility traces under a globally-broadcast dopamine signal: even with a SINGLE shared dopaminergic teaching signal (ARC-108 delta_t), the credit traces that decide WHICH synapses/channels the signal updates must remain LOCAL and loop-specific -- effective update = shared delta_t x separate local eligibility trace x loop-specific active synapses -- rather than the current single globally-broadcast credit that updates every recently-active selector component. A too-broad or temporally-smeared eligibility trace would make learned gating appear ineffective (no committed conversion) even when the underlying dopamine learning rule is exactly correct, because the right teaching signal is delivered to the wrong synapses.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-digestion: reap V3-EXQ-700 loop-decomp intake residue -> MECH-451/452/453 + EXP-0391
claim_rows.title: Cholinergic TAN-pause plasticity-window gating of selector credit: dopamine should NOT continuously update every recently-active selector component; a striatal cholinergic tonically-active-neuron (TAN) pause should open a NARROW plasticity window around behaviourally-relevant events, so the three-factor learned-gating updates (ARC-108) are admitted only WITHIN the window. Without a window, continuous credit smears across irrelevant recently-active components and degrades the learned gating the conversion attack depends on. The OPENING-side neuromodulatory complement to REE's existing CLOSURE-side plasticity control (MECH-094 waking-gate; INV-074/MECH-333/MECH-334 consolidation/EWC) -- REE today has machinery to stop/consolidate learning but not a phasic gate to OPEN a precise learning window.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-digestion: register MECH-454 (self-option-value / forecast-uncertainty-gated irreversibility cost in E3) + fold the V4 meta leg into self_model_v4:SELF-9
claim_rows.title: Foreclosing the SELF's own future reachable-option space carries a decision cost in E3 trajectory scoring, GATED BY FORECAST UNCERTAINTY -- the non-harm, self-directed analog of INV-026 (which scopes foreclosure-of-reachable-state-space as a harm to OTHERS). E3 today scores harm + benefit + goal + residue + the modulatory stack; nothing represents the option-value / reversibility of an action for the agent's OWN reachable futures. REE's irreversibility-awareness is HARM-scoped (residue cannot be erased; No-Go gates; INV-026 foreclosure-of-others); there is no INFORMATION/RESOURCE-scoped analog (don't cheaply foreclose your own options). The claim: an uncertainty-gated reachable-option-preservation cost should change committed action -- preferring the reversible/option-preserving branch MORE when the forecast that justifies foreclosure is UNCERTAIN, and not at all when it is confident (a generalization of DR-12's PE-conditioned E3 confidence from object-rollouts to a foreclosure cost).

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claims: CDQ-007 Mine+Register -- MECH-459/460/461 competence-bootstrap candidates
claim_rows.title: return_scale_invariance_blocks_actor_bootstrap / one_sided_return_normalisation. REE's MECH-457 actor-critic update stacks TWO two-sided normalisers -- a Welford RUNNING reward std (r / running_std) followed by a per-episode advantage standardisation ((adv - mean) / (std + 1e-8)) -- which together form a SCALE-INVARIANCE OPERATOR: after it the policy gradient depends only on the SHAPE of the within-episode advantage vector and is exactly invariant to any multiplicative rescaling. This is sufficient to produce converter invariance to every MAGNITUDE lever by construction (the reward-coupling and drive-schedule axes eliminated by V3-EXQ-771 and 770), and it converts a zero-forage episode -- whose reward stream is harm_signal + novelty_bonus only, so whose advantage vector is pure critic error plus exploration jitter -- into a FULL-MAGNITUDE unit-variance noise gradient. DreamerV3 (Hafner 2023) names this exact failure ('amplification of near-zero returns', Appendix E) and prescribes the corrective: a STATIONARY magnitude compressor (symlog, explicitly against running-statistics normalisation, which injects non-stationarity because the target moves when the normaliser moves), a ONE-SIDED percentile normaliser adv / max(1, Per95 - Per5) that scales large returns down and never scales small returns up, and a DISTRIBUTIONAL twohot/cross-entropy critic in place of a scalar MSE head (which under a bimodal sparse-return distribution converges to the never-observed MEAN of the two modes, and whose gradient is linear in the error rather than bounded).

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claims: CDQ-007 Mine+Register -- MECH-459/460/461 competence-bootstrap candidates
claim_rows.title: transient_behavioral_prior_bootstrap / bc_seed_then_rl_without_permanent_demonstrator. What a behavioural-cloning prior supplies to a floored converter is PRIMARILY TRACTABLE EXPLORATION / STATE-VISITATION, not merely a competent action distribution: VPT (Baker 2022) reports RL from random initialisation in the same action space obtains essentially no reward and never reliably reaches the first link in the item chain, while BC-initialised RL reaches the diamond pickaxe -- a PRESENCE/ABSENCE result, not a speed-up. Three further functions are separable: the action distribution (the vehicle), VALUE-SIDE GROUNDING (DQfD's large-margin loss, which plain BC does NOT supply and whose ablation costs most of the benefit), and STRATEGIC-DIVERSITY PRESERVATION against collapse (AlphaStar). Because REE already owns deterministic in-substrate demonstrators (LocalViewGreedyPolicy 48-55 and OraclePolicy 57-61, instantiated in experiments/_lib/mech457_fanout.py::run_anchor_cell), NO PERMANENT EXTERNAL DEMONSTRATOR IS REQUIRED -- REE's transience question is not how to stop paying for demonstrations but whether the seed leaves a RESIDUE in the converter after the guide leaves the action path. The only strong transience construct in the literature is JSRL's ROLLOUT HANDOFF (a guide acts for the first h steps, the learner for H-h, with h decreasing to 0 as the learner clears a threshold), NOT a decaying loss weight: none of VPT, AlphaStar or DQfD ever anneals its prior term to zero.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claims: CDQ-007 Mine+Register -- MECH-459/460/461 competence-bootstrap candidates
claim_rows.title: innate_action_primitive_basis_plus_reward_independent_engagement_drive. Biological competence bootstrap without a demonstrator rests on TWO components, not one. (i) The action basis is INNATE AND REFINED, never constructed: the two neonatal motoneuron primitives are RETAINED into adulthood and augmented, with matching primitives across rat/cat/macaque/guineafowl (Dominici 2011, 10.1126/science.1210617) -- so 'a learner with no action prior fails' is the biological DEFAULT, not an anomaly; and the innate seed is demonstrator-free but NOT experience-free, since deprived of proprioceptive feedback from its OWN self-generated activity the CPG fails to mature (Zeng 2021). (ii) A REWARD-INDEPENDENT ENGAGEMENT DRIVE is necessary: an identified ZIm circuit converts stimulus presence into investigation independent of learned reward value (Ahmadlou 2021, 10.1126/science.abe9681), and dopamine-deficient mice with INTACT perception, INTACT motor apparatus and INTACT hedonics starve in front of food (Szczypka 2001) -- the closest biological analog of REE's 'readiness met on every leg, foraging at floor'. COROLLARY for REE: an approach primitive is underspecified unless one also names WHAT THE DRIVE'S OUTPUT TRAINS (the Zeng closed loop), because an innate generator alone does not mature.

Subtract a slow EMA common-mode baseline before every cue cosine. ree_core goal.py change, bit-identical by default.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claims: register 24 candidate claims from six 2026-07-21 thought intakes
claim_rows.title: REE is a FEDERATION / heterarchy of asynchronous, partially independent cognitive streams coordinated by shared organisational constraints -- neither a monolith nor a collection of independent modules. Successful integration preserves functionally necessary differences among streams rather than making their dynamics identical.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claims: register 24 candidate claims from six 2026-07-21 thought intakes
claim_rows.title: The rule pipeline is an ORDERED CYCLE of non-collapsible stages: experience -> pattern sensitivity -> candidate regularity apprehension -> representation -> prediction -> counterfactual simulation -> behavioural interaction -> outcome comparison -> regularity refinement -> generalisation -> long-term integration. Each stage has claims; the CYCLE does not, and the stages must not collapse into a single reasoning module.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claims: register 24 candidate claims from six 2026-07-21 thought intakes
claim_rows.title: Language is an INTERFACE to reasoning, not its substrate: reasoning-like behaviour emerging from language alone (LLMs) does not establish language as the native substrate of reasoning. Language functions as compression, communication, coordination, long-horizon scaffolding, working-memory support and explanation -- and may COMPENSATE for weaknesses in other reasoning systems.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: registered_utc field
claim_rows.title: REE:Assembly analogies must be LABELLED as analogies. REE (the cognitive architecture) and REE Assembly (the scientific-development and governance machinery) have strong structural parallels; any analogy between them must be marked as an analogy and must NEVER be used as evidence that REE operates the way Assembly does, or vice versa.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: registered_utc field
claim_rows.title: Held-out validation for Assembly workflow and rule changes: a change to a workflow, skill, or standing rule should be validated against cases that did NOT generate it. Every layer of Assembly practice currently edits the artefact from the session that motivated the edit -- a workflow change judged by the cycle that produced it, a CLAUDE.md rule written by the session that hit the incident, an intake template revised by the intake that strained it. There is no held-out review anywhere in the loop.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: registered_utc field
claim_rows.title: Meta-optimisation remains SUBORDINATE to provenance, epistemic honesty, and explicit human authority: an Assembly self-improvement loop must not shift governance authority, erase authorship distinctions or uncertainty, or increase artefact volume at the expense of quality.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: registered_utc field
claim_rows.title: Rejected-edit memory with reconsideration conditions: rejected proposals -- workflow changes, claim registrations, experiment proposals -- are retained with the proposed edit, why it was proposed, why it was rejected, the evidence considered, and THE CONDITIONS UNDER WHICH RECONSIDERATION IS APPROPRIATE. The last field is what makes it more than an archive.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: registered_utc field
claim_rows.title: Assembly artefact-layer authority stratification: Assembly artefacts form an update-rate hierarchy -- prompts and local workflow hints (fast) -> thought-intake structure (moderate) -> claims and mechanism status (evidence-gated) -> architecture commitments (slow) -> organisational principles (very slow) -> axioms (exceptional). An edit at a fast layer must not SILENTLY change a slower layer's commitment.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claims: register 24 candidate claims from six 2026-07-21 thought intakes
claim_rows.title: Integration and protected non-equivalence are JOINTLY necessary: cross-stream similarity has a viable band. Too little shared organisation is fragmentation; too much is representational collapse. An adequate architecture must satisfy both constraints at once, with a measurable quantity in between -- not merely satisfy each on a separate axis.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claims: register 24 candidate claims from six 2026-07-21 thought intakes
claim_rows.title: Distractor suppression must remain SELECTIVELY PERMEABLE to harm and other-agent signals (ethical interruptibility): any suppression mechanism must preserve the ability of sufficiently important weak evidence to interrupt an established rule or commitment. Suppression strength that improves goal completion by silencing weak harm cues is a FAILURE, not a success -- over-suppression is a safety failure mode, not merely a rigidity cost. ACCEPTANCE SHAPE IS A JOINT BOUND, NOT A CONJUNCTION OF MAXIMA (2026-09-10 governance, GFLAG-0236): completion and interruptibility sit on a Pareto frontier with a hard FLOOR on the harm and other-agent interruptibility axes -- completion may be traded up only while both floors hold, and completion forgone in order to hold a floor is a PASS. A PASS never means both axes were maximised simultaneously.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claims: register 24 candidate claims from six 2026-07-21 thought intakes
claim_rows.title: Skill optimisation must NOT trade harm sensitivity for competence (learning-side ethical constraint): any competence-refinement mechanism must be evaluated JOINTLY on competence gain AND non-degradation of harm sensitivity, residue accumulation, and commitment integrity. A mechanism improving the first by attenuating the second has succeeded on its metric and FAILED AS AN AGENT. ACCEPTANCE SHAPE IS A JOINT BOUND, NOT A CONJUNCTION OF MAXIMA (2026-09-10 governance, GFLAG-0236): the joint evaluation is a Pareto frontier on which the three protected axes carry a hard FLOOR that may not be traded away and competence gain is accepted only up to the point where it would cross that floor -- so competence forgone in order to hold a floor is a PASS, and a PASS never means competence and the protected axes were maximised together.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claims: register 24 candidate claims from six 2026-07-21 thought intakes
claim_rows.title: Event-relative coordination exceeds clock-relative coordination: cross-stream alignment measured around event boundaries, commitment onset, interruption, completion and offline transitions is stronger than alignment by wall-clock timestep. If so, the boundary stream is the coordination substrate for the whole federation, not merely a detector with a consumer.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claims: register 24 candidate claims from six 2026-07-21 thought intakes
claim_rows.title: Distractor resistance has THREE dissociable failure modes -- sensory capture (distractor enters/dominates the active representation), rule corruption (distractor overwrites or destabilises the active goal/rule/task context), and behavioural capture (rule survives intact but the distractor still controls action selection). REE's distractor evidence covers rule corruption ONLY; a system can pass rule-corruption tests while failing behavioural capture.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claims: register 24 candidate claims from six 2026-07-21 thought intakes
claim_rows.title: Hippocampal anchor TOPOLOGY carries functional information not present in local anchor payloads. REE's typed relations (spatial, temporal, action-transition, event, goal, valence, social, schema, staleness, scale) are each realised as a payload field, a gate, or a scoring term -- a property of an anchor or proposal -- and none is exposed as an EDGE TYPE over the anchor set. Nothing tests whether the topology carries information beyond local anchor features.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claims: register 24 candidate claims from six 2026-07-21 thought intakes
claim_rows.title: Relation types are NOT collapsible to one adjacency structure: collapsing all edge types into a single adjacency, or removing event / goal-motivational edges, or removing action-transition directionality, degrades functional-label recovery. The same non-collapsibility argument as MECH-069 (error incommensurability), one level down.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claims: register 24 candidate claims from six 2026-07-21 thought intakes
claim_rows.title: Topological position improves ghost-goal reactivation ranking: MECH-292/293 rank inactive anchors by preserved-goal-payload match; adding a topological term (relational distance to the current anchor along typed paths) improves reactivation precision. An anchor's functional role -- gateway, bottleneck, recurrent trap, interruption point, repair opportunity -- may be inferable from its POSITION even when its local payload is incomplete.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claims: register 24 candidate claims from six 2026-07-21 thought intakes
claim_rows.title: Behavioural-competence updates require the same BOUNDED / PROVENANCED / ROLLBACK-CAPABLE discipline already registered for consolidation. MECH-392, INV-080 and MECH-401 give the memory-consolidation path bounded, attributable, provenance-carrying, rollback-capable, over-rewrite-gated editing; NOTHING EQUIVALENT is registered for behavioural competence -- policy / affordance / action-object learning has no rollback, no provenance record, and no gate against a single successful rollout propagating widely.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claims: register 24 candidate claims from six 2026-07-21 thought intakes
claim_rows.title: HELD-OUT CONTEXT distinguishes skill acquisition from task memorisation: a competence update should be promoted to durable only on evidence from contexts that did not generate it.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claims: register 24 candidate claims from six 2026-07-21 thought intakes
claim_rows.title: REJECTED-ADAPTATION MEMORY improves later recovery and transfer: retaining failed behavioural revisions together with their failure conditions improves adaptation when conditions later change. A failed adaptation should remain available as evidence about what was tried, why it failed, and under what conditions it might later become useful.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claims: register 24 candidate claims from six 2026-07-21 thought intakes
claim_rows.title: LEARNING-MECHANISM META-SELECTION (narrow form): the control plane selects among the learning regimes REE actually has -- online practice, exploration, counterfactual simulation, offline consolidation -- rather than applying one learning rule universally, and this selection is state- and mode-dependent.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claim-synthesis MECH-163: narrow to leg (1) + register MECH-477 (uncertainty arbitration), MECH-478 (long-horizon, ARC-007-blocked), MECH-479 (prosocial, refiled v4)
claim_rows.title: uninformative_value_baseline_makes_optimisation_iatrogenic. In REE's MECH-457 actor-critic pathway the value baseline is UNINFORMATIVE on the policy's own state distribution, so the advantage carries variance rather than signal and ADDED OPTIMISATION PRESSURE IS IATROGENIC: policy capacity, training budget, an earned intrinsic approach drive, environmental reward-coupling and post-installation RL refinement each drive competence BELOW THEIR OWN CONTROLS rather than plateauing beneath a ceiling, and the magnitude of the loss tracks baseline uninformativeness rather than the identity of the intervention. Measured mechanism: V3-EXQ-782 R-(b) reads the shared CTRL critic at std(V)/std(G) = 0.041 against a 0.25 collapse threshold and a pre-reward-vs-far separation ratio of 0.016 against a 0.25 floor -- an unbaselined high-variance advantage. A ceiling plateaus; this does not.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claim-synthesis MECH-163: narrow to leg (1) + register MECH-477 (uncertainty arbitration), MECH-478 (long-horizon, ARC-007-blocked), MECH-479 (prosocial, refiled v4)
claim_rows.title: competence_retention_dissociable_from_acquisition. ACQUIRING competence and RETAINING it are dissociable capabilities with separate substrate requirements: REE has the first and lacks the second. Behavioural cloning installs foraging competence at 20.933 on raw_view (3/3 seeds took) and 32.72 on z_world, and unconstrained RL refinement then ERODES it to 11.667 -- while a distributional critic (V3-EXQ-788, retains 1.839) and a KL anchor to the installed snapshot (V3-EXQ-792, retains 0.778 vs 0.525 unconstrained, still plastic) each preserve it. Retention is supplied by properties of the VALUE ESTIMATOR and the UPDATE CONSTRAINT, NOT by continued demonstration (V3-EXQ-789 eliminates the imitation-auxiliary schedule axis at every setting). COROLLARY, and the claim's distinctive testable content: consolidation is properly defined as RESISTANCE TO RETROGRADE INTERFERENCE (Krakauer 2005), hence dependent on install DOSE and elapsed offline INTERVAL -- neither of which REE has ever varied.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claim-synthesis MECH-163: narrow to leg (1) + register MECH-477 (uncertainty arbitration), MECH-478 (long-horizon, ARC-007-blocked), MECH-479 (prosocial, refiled v4)
claim_rows.title: dual_system_uncertainty_arbitration. Differential recruitment between the habit and the hippocampally-planned goal-directed pathways is produced by an explicit ARBITRATION element that reads the two pathways' relative uncertainty/reliability and reallocates control accordingly -- NOT by the mere presence of two pathways. Two pathways WITHOUT an arbitrator produce a FLAT recruitment response regardless of context novelty. Registered 2026-07-22 as the control-allocation mechanism MECH-163 presupposed but never named; MECH-163 conflated ARCHITECTURE (two pathways exist) with DYNAMICS (control shifts between them with novelty, uncertainty and practice).

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claim-synthesis MECH-163: narrow to leg (1) + register MECH-477 (uncertainty arbitration), MECH-478 (long-horizon, ARC-007-blocked), MECH-479 (prosocial, refiled v4)
claim_rows.title: long_horizon_benefit_requires_model_based_rollout. Sustained benefit accumulation is a TRAJECTORY property, not a single-contact event, and is therefore reachable only by goal-seeded multi-step rollout; a 1-step greedy or value-flat-proposal policy cannot navigate toward it. Split out of MECH-163 leg (2) on 2026-07-22 because it carries a blocker of its own -- ARC-007 STRICT value-flat proposals -- entirely unrelated to the blockers on MECH-163 legs (1) and (3), and was inheriting MECH-163's V3-EXQ-786a weakens without ever having been tested.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claim-synthesis MECH-163: narrow to leg (1) + register MECH-477 (uncertainty arbitration), MECH-478 (long-horizon, ARC-007-blocked), MECH-479 (prosocial, refiled v4)
claim_rows.title: prosocial_planning_requires_planned_system. Planning trajectories that affect ANOTHER agent's z_harm_a accumulation and benefit_exposure over time is structurally inaccessible to a 1-step greedy policy and requires the hippocampally-planned pathway. Split out of MECH-163 leg (3) on 2026-07-22 and REFILED implementation_phase v3 -> v4: there is no V3 substrate for it whatsoever -- no second agent exists, hence no other-agent z_harm_a to plan over. Arguably the clearest single piece of granularity debt in MECH-163, since the leg had been carrying a V3 implementation_phase it could not possibly satisfy since 2026-04-02.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claims: register 24 candidate claims from six 2026-07-21 thought intakes
claim_rows.title: Does REE's configured multi-rate execution produce SHARED cross-stream organisation, or only configured rate separation? SD-006 guarantees that E1/E2/E3 run at characteristic rates; nothing asserts or tests that the heterogeneous streams (E1/E2/E3, harm, goal, salience, hippocampal, control) thereby occupy recurrent system-level configurations or exhibit homologous transition motifs. Configured rate separation does not entail shared organisation.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claims: register 24 candidate claims from six 2026-07-21 thought intakes
claim_rows.title: Does REE require an EXPLICIT pre-selection suppression substrate, or do existing precision-weighted cue routing plus the MECH-254 top-k boundary bottleneck already suffice? REE's distractor mechanisms are predominantly POST-ENTRY (write gating, persistence, conflict handling, mode hysteresis); the brainstem/superior-colliculus evidence points at suppression of competing orienting or target-selection signals BEFORE they acquire behavioural control.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claims: register 24 candidate claims from six 2026-07-21 thought intakes
claim_rows.title: Is rule apprehension DOMAIN-GENERAL or domain-specific? Does REE need separate regularity-apprehension systems per domain (causal / social / ethical / motor / spatial / relational), or one domain-general apprehender that inherits domain structure from its inputs? ARC-062/063 are scoped to policy-layer behavioural regimes; the domain-agnosticism question is wider and unasked.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claims: register 24 candidate claims from six 2026-07-21 thought intakes
claim_rows.title: Is HIGHER-ORDER relational structure (metapaths, hyperedges, simplicial relations) required? Some functions may be properties of typed MULTISTEP PATHS rather than of nodes or pairwise edges -- e.g. current state -> available action -> transition region -> predicted hazard -> repair opportunity -> goal completion; or inactive anchor -> shared event -> similar goal state -> successful historical trajectory -> candidate reactivation. Nothing in the registry represents anything above a pairwise relation.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claims(ARC-018): record the EXQ-196 zero-advantage mechanism and that Leg B is now testable
claim_rows.title: Common-mode-invariant (centered) CandidateRuleField context key: the ARC-063 field keys mint-block, recurrence bucketing and gate retrieval on a raw z_world context, which under SD-008 z_world under-differentiation sits in a ~0.98-cosine common-mode cone, so the mint-block fires against the first minted rule for every later context at any expressible threshold and the pool is structurally capped at ONE rule. Subtract a slow EMA common-mode baseline before every cue comparison. ree_core policy change, bit-identical by default.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claims(ARC-018): record the EXQ-196 zero-advantage mechanism and that Leg B is now testable
claim_rows.title: Common-mode-invariant (centered) z_goal cue for goal-anchor match: SD-039's Anchor.goal_match is a raw cosine over z_goal, which as an EMA attractor pulled toward z_world inherits the SD-008 common-mode offset more strongly than its source, so goal_match spans ~0.01 across an anchor pool, the MECH-292 goal_match_floor excludes nothing and the MECH-339 outshining gate is identically zero. Subtract a slow EMA common-mode baseline before the match. ree_core hippocampal change, bit-identical by default.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claim-synthesis MECH-163: narrow to leg (1) + register MECH-477 (uncertainty arbitration), MECH-478 (long-horizon, ARC-007-blocked), MECH-479 (prosocial, refiled v4)
claim_rows.title: E2.action_object_head receives zero gradient from every REE training path, so the action-object space O that SD-004's hippocampal map backbone navigates is a frozen random projection fixed at initialisation, not the learned world-effect compression SD-004 specifies. O is state-invariant rather than consequence-structured, and the hippocampal CEM searches and refits inside it.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: SD-081: register e3.dualsystem_uncertainty_arbitration (IMPLEMENTED) + MECH-477 implementation note
claim_rows.title: e3.dualsystem_uncertainty_arbitration. An explicit arbitration weight over the HABIT pathway (myopic, depth-limited read of the E3 scorer) and the PLANNED pathway (full-horizon read of the same scorer), driven by the two pathways' relative predictive uncertainty and applied to the E3 selection score upstream of every downstream consumer. Built to make MECH-477 falsifiable: the pre-SD-081 substrate scored candidates with an unconditional full-horizon J(zeta), so no weight existed anywhere between the myopic and the deep read and nothing COULD respond to context novelty.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: SD-082: register + queue the rule_state->action-bias propagation consumer (implemented)
claim_rows.title: pfc.lateral_pfc.rule_selection_action_consumer: a common-mode-invariant, gradient-trainable read-out mapping the SD-078 differentiated rule_state to the SD-033a per-candidate action bias. V3-EXQ-822 found the differentiated rule pool (on_rule_state_diff 0.644, max_live 16) was behaviourally SILENT -- propagation to the action bias was exactly 0.0 on both arms. Root cause: the SD-033a bias head reads RAW common-mode-dominated z_world summaries and hard-clamps its output, so under the SD-008 ~0.98-cosine cone every candidate saturates to the same rail (rule_state's contribution erased) and the clamp's flat region zeros the REINFORCE gradient (head untrainable). Fix: subtract the common mode from the head's candidate-summary input (as SD-078 does upstream) and replace the hard clamp with a scaled-tanh soft bound. ree_core policy change, bit-identical by default.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claim-synthesis MECH-163: register Q-085 committed-macro grain as a controllability parameter
claim_rows.title: Is committed-macro GRAIN a controllability parameter? If habit is chunked action sequences selected by a single goal-directed process (Dezfouli & Balleine 2013) rather than a separate outcome-insensitive controller, then the duration over which the planner CANNOT intervene is set by committed-macro grain -- MECH-323's chunk_max_size x chunk_max_depth -- and the chunk-size budget is a CONTROLLABILITY parameter, not only a formation parameter. A budget set too high would present as outcome-insensitivity while REPORTING NOTHING at the accumulator, because nothing in MECH-323 measures the intervention interval it creates.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: SD-083 governance: register offline policy-consolidation window; MECH-476 arms unblocked
claim_rows.title: consolidation.offline_policy_consolidation_window: an OFFLINE, trace-selective (Fisher-weighted EWC, Kirkpatrick 2017), interval-accumulated (capture c(N)=capture_max*(1-exp(-N/tau))), novelty-gated (Moncada 2007) policy-consolidation window in the mech457 retention TESTBED, run BETWEEN BC install and RL refinement. Unblocks MECH-476's two blocked_substrate falsifier arms: the A->B offline INTERVAL arm (V3-EXQ-836b) and the behavioural-tagging NOVELTY arm (V3-EXQ-836c). DISTINCT from the ONLINE global MECH-475 KL anchor -- offline vs online, trace-selective per-parameter vs global, interval-dependent vs constructed-at-entry, novelty-gated -- which is exactly the MECH-476 content (ii offline interval, iii trace selectivity) the global anchor cannot express (the Walker-2003 divergence). BUILDS PROTECTION without retraining, so post_bc is invariant to the interval and the INTERVAL axis is orthogonal to the DOSE axis.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: SD-084: register persistent committed-program handle (substrate landed in ree-v3)
claim_rows.title: e3.persistent_committed_program_handle: a committed-program handle on E3Selector that SURVIVES post_action_update's unconditional per-tick teardown of _committed_trajectory, so MECH-321's R4 MID-EXECUTION decomposition hook -- which re-evaluates the REMAINING unexecuted content of an already-committed chunk and therefore inherently needs a CROSS-TICK handle -- becomes reachable under the standard select_action -> update_residue driver loop for the first time. Mirrors the existing _closure_committed_trajectory precedent, built for exactly this reason. Liveness is an INVARIANT (reaped whenever the beta gate is not elevated), not a list of clear sites: agent.py has ten beta_gate.release() sites and only five clear _committed_trajectory, the rest being backstopped by the very teardown this handle removes.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: intake: register 21 candidate claims from six 2026-06 thought intakes (z_harm_a saturation, V3-closure legibility, cross-system resonance, introspection, language-as-cooperation, evolutionary retention)
claim_rows.title: Confidence readouts are non-collapsible, and externally-induced agreement is a separate channel from internally-derived confidence. A single scalar confidence conflates propositional confidence, attractor stability, cross-subsystem agreement, conflict pressure, action-readiness, and socially-supplied agreement; the last must not enter the same accumulator as the others -- else being told something becomes indistinguishable from having found it.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: intake: register 21 candidate claims from six 2026-06 thought intakes (z_harm_a saturation, V3-closure legibility, cross-system resonance, introspection, language-as-cooperation, evolutionary retention)
claim_rows.title: Generation, metacognitive readout, and linguistic reconstruction are three non-collapsible stages. The confidence readout must not be derived from the verbal reconstruction, and neither may substitute for the generating dynamics. The felt sequence nonverbal-settling -> felt-confidence -> verbal-reconstruction -> external-testing implies three things REE currently treats as two at most.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: intake: register 21 candidate claims from six 2026-06 thought intakes (z_harm_a saturation, V3-closure legibility, cross-system resonance, introspection, language-as-cooperation, evolutionary retention)
claim_rows.title: Message selection minimises the receiver's residual uncertainty: an utterance approximates a task-relevant sufficient statistic for the receiver, not a compression of the sender's salience. Predicts WHAT gets said (features that most reduce the receiver's uncertainty about the sender's state) rather than merely that saying happens.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: intake: register 21 candidate claims from six 2026-06 thought intakes (z_harm_a saturation, V3-closure legibility, cross-system resonance, introspection, language-as-cooperation, evolutionary retention)
claim_rows.title: Worldly reference is inherited through the world model, and the same mechanism covers non-present referents. Language refers reliably to the world because it indexes internal states that model the world; therefore reference to imagined, counterfactual, fictional and abstract states requires no additional mechanism.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: intake: register 21 candidate claims from six 2026-06 thought intakes (z_harm_a saturation, V3-closure legibility, cross-system resonance, introspection, language-as-cooperation, evolutionary retention)
claim_rows.title: Language-input update policy: an utterance proposes candidate model states which are evaluated before any update; it never installs a belief. Generalises INV-085 from affect to arbitrary content and ARC-104 from the harm stream to all content. Evaluation criteria: context, source reliability, causal compatibility with existing world-model structure, memory, uncertainty, current goals, speaker model.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: registered_utc field
claim_rows.title: Calibration ledger: pre-registered felt confidence and explicit estimates, with blinding status, are recorded before outcomes are known. An Assembly instrument (not an agent mechanism) that is the only way to distinguish genuine calibration from retrospective resonance.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: registered_utc field
claim_rows.title: GOV-CEIL-1 tail-escape amendment: absence of positive discrimination does not license demotion when no test ever instantiated the mechanism's trigger condition. A claim whose registered function is tail-protective, developmental, compensatory or otherwise conditionally expressed is demotable only if either (a) at least one test instantiated its trigger condition, or (b) the demotion record explicitly states that none did and demotes anyway on stated grounds.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: registered_utc field
claim_rows.title: Triangulation rule: introspection generates architectural hypotheses; it never validates them alone. A mechanism first noticed introspectively acquires standing only when it also maps onto neuroscience or cognitive literature, is computationally coherent, produces measurable predictions, and survives experiment. The phenomenology-side counterpart to ARC-106.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: registered_utc field
claim_rows.title: Construction-phase opacity is acceptable technical debt only while it carries a named, dated repayment boundary. External inscrutability during construction is a legitimate choice, not a defect, provided the boundary is declared and reviewed on the same cadence as SENT-0 (every generation boundary).

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: registered_utc field
claim_rows.title: Designer-overfit standing check: a mechanism first sourced from one person's phenomenology requires cross-task and cross-agent validation before being treated as general cognition. REE's n=1 phenomenological base is a genuine external criticism with no registered answer; this is the hedge given standing.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: registered_utc field
claim_rows.title: Legibility by subtraction: the V3 closure package is produced by curating and compressing existing material, not by rewriting the research history. Separate the primary reader path (current work) from supporting research and from operational archaeology; retain audit history but remove it from the reader path; mark human vs agent provenance in the public account.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: registered_utc field
claim_rows.title: Version-transition artefact gate: V4 substrate expansion must not erase the opportunity to freeze, reproduce, describe and inspect the completed V3. Before substantial V4 substrate expansion a defined minimum V3 closure package must exist AND double as a manipulable causal reference artefact for later cross-version comparison.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: intake: register 21 candidate claims from six 2026-06 thought intakes (z_harm_a saturation, V3-closure legibility, cross-system resonance, introspection, language-as-cooperation, evolutionary retention)
claim_rows.title: Environment-confound control: is the z_harm_a saturation ecological or representational? Re-measure the affective fingerprint on a gentler environment (lower num_hazards, lower hazard_food_attraction) to separate faithful chronic-suffering integration from a calibration/representation pathology.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: intake: register 21 candidate claims from six 2026-06 thought intakes (z_harm_a saturation, V3-closure legibility, cross-system resonance, introspection, language-as-cooperation, evolutionary retention)
claim_rows.title: What event counts as V3 closure for the purpose of the version-transition artefact gate (GOV-V3FREEZE-1) and the construction-opacity repayment boundary (GOV-OPACITY-1)? Candidate options: strict green board, governance acceptance, or an additional reproducibility check.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: intake: register 21 candidate claims from six 2026-06 thought intakes (z_harm_a saturation, V3-closure legibility, cross-system resonance, introspection, language-as-cooperation, evolutionary retention)
claim_rows.title: Does competitive redevelopment (development-without-the-mechanism) dissociate from mature-state lesion, or agree with it? For a mechanism registered as developmentally necessary the two protocols should give different verdicts -- and one decisive probe settles whether the expensive protocol is warranted as a standing requirement.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: intake: register 21 candidate claims from six 2026-06 thought intakes (z_harm_a saturation, V3-closure legibility, cross-system resonance, introspection, language-as-cooperation, evolutionary retention)
claim_rows.title: z_harm_a's functional readout must be a calibrated scalar valuation, not the latent norm. The latent norm conflates a large near-constant encoder offset with a small functional component; E3 consumes it as an approximately constant gain (ree_core/predictors/e3_selector.py:1182 lambda_ethical, :3128 commit-threshold urgency). claim_rows.title: Context inference is an active, persistent control process rather than passive nearest-match retrieval: selecting which latent situation is currently active is itself a COMMITMENT-BEARING act that requires hysteresis (a switch threshold and switch cost preventing small fluctuations from continuously reinterpreting the situation) and a protected EXPLOITATION WINDOW (a period after selection during which the organism acts on the interpretation rather than immediately reopening inference). Without both, a sufficiently uncertainty-sensitive agent becomes PERMANENTLY EPISTEMIC -- continuously checking, rarely acting. REE already has a developed commitment-hysteresis account (MECH-106 dwell/switch-cost, MECH-047 asymmetric de-commitment) but applies it only to the ACTION/mode variable; this claim asserts the same machinery is required one level up, on the CONTEXT variable, where no dwell, switch cost, or protected window currently exists (ARC-062's learned context discriminator is a soft per-step gate with none of these). The loop spans existing modules (ContextMemory, epistemic_deficit, orient/survey, event segmenter, commitment) and does NOT require a new executive module.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake 2026-08-19: register MECH-493/494/495 + Q-094/095 from the fresh context-inference and hippocampal-episodic-organisation thoughts
claim_rows.title: The criterion for abandoning an inferred context is PERSISTENT, STRUCTURED evidence that the currently inferred latent situation no longer explains observations OR THEIR ACTION CONSEQUENCES -- not unsigned prediction-error magnitude. A startling transient, sensor noise, gradual environmental drift, and a genuine latent-state transition can all produce large prediction error, and should NOT produce the same response: transient surprise should not switch context, gradual drift may warrant update-in-place rather than switch, and only genuine latent transition should switch. The ACTION-CONSEQUENCE term is the part with no existing REE analogue: MECH-288's slow-scale BOCPD change-point already supplies a persistence-based (rather than threshold-based) boundary signal over z_goal, but it is computed over observations and is consumed as a region KEY by downstream substrates (MECH-269 anchor sets, per-region V_s, MECH-284 staleness, MECH-287 broadcast) -- nothing consumes it to arbitrate retain-vs-switch-vs-create over stored contexts.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake 2026-08-19: register MECH-493/494/495 + Q-094/095 from the fresh context-inference and hippocampal-episodic-organisation thoughts
claim_rows.title: The objective for hippocampal/episodic memory organisation is RELATIONAL APPROPRIATENESS, not maximal pattern separation: related experiences should overlap appropriately (overlap is what supports generalisation and memory linking) while behaviourally distinct latent situations should separate appropriately. It follows that "more diverse slots", greater slot occupancy, and lower representational overlap are NOT objectives in themselves, and that a metric which is monotonically improved by increasing differentiation is scoring the wrong quantity regardless of whether it is computed correctly. This is a claim about the TARGET, and is therefore distinct from -- and not answered by -- the already-established finding that REE's slot_cosine_sim family was computed incorrectly (whole-bank, no occupancy mask; 2026-08-07 governance reversal at V3-EXQ-436d) or the finding that the ContextMemory write path could not produce differentiation at all (scores.mean(0).argmin() single-slot fixed point; V3-EXQ-436f).

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake 2026-08-19: register MECH-493/494/495 + Q-094/095 from the fresh context-inference and hippocampal-episodic-organisation thoughts
claim_rows.title: Should REE's active context representation include INTERNAL variables -- current goal, bodily/interoceptive state, confidence, inferred social situation -- rather than being primarily sensory scene identity? MECH-150 records a deliberate design decision that E1 ContextMemory is queried with z_world ALONE and explicitly NOT the full [z_self, z_world] state, on terrain-weighting grounds. If context is the organism's inference about which latent SITUATION it is in (MECH-493/MECH-494) rather than which SCENE it is looking at, then two states with identical z_world but different goal, bodily state or confidence may be different contexts, and the z_world-only query cannot represent that distinction in principle.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake 2026-08-19: register MECH-493/494/495 + Q-094/095 from the fresh context-inference and hippocampal-episodic-organisation thoughts
claim_rows.title: Does explicit hippocampal episodic organisation (binding, segmentation, separation, completion, indexing, remapping treated as ONE coordinated organising principle) add predictive or behavioural capability beyond REE's existing trajectory-generation account and the individually-registered mechanisms that already cover its parts (MECH-147, MECH-154, MECH-242, MECH-288, MECH-074d) -- or is it a REINTERPRETATION of mechanisms REE already has? The raw thought poses this against itself as its own falsification condition: if the existing architecture already produces appropriate episodic discrimination, completion and context-sensitive retrieval without an additional organising principle, the thought is a re-description and should not be promoted into the architecture.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake 2026-08-23: register MECH-496 (dimensionality as outcome) + INV-101 (environment-conditional crystallisation target); amend MECH-495 with developmental-timing precondition; mint EXP-0588 num_slots probe
claim_rows.title: The crystallisation TARGET is environment-conditional, not an architectural constant: for any agent whose representational structure crystallises on a developmental schedule (MECH-496), the structure it should crystallise TO is a function of the latent structure of the environment actually encountered, not a property of the architecture. It follows that a single hand-set dimensionality is wrong in BOTH directions -- over-provisioned relative to a simple world it produces spurious SPLITTING (behaviourally equivalent situations assigned distinct buckets), under-provisioned relative to a rich one it forces MERGING (behaviourally distinct situations collapsed into one) -- and that the same REE substrate deployed in environments of materially different latent complexity requires materially different resolved structures, with no single default correct across them. This is the LOAD-BEARING form of the assertion; the weak form ("different environments need different structures") is near-tautological for any learning system and is explicitly NOT what is claimed here.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake 2026-08-23: register MECH-496 (dimensionality as outcome) + INV-101 (environment-conditional crystallisation target); amend MECH-495 with developmental-timing precondition; mint EXP-0588 num_slots probe
claim_rows.title: Representational dimensionality is an OUTCOME of a developmental plasticity schedule, not an a-priori architectural constant: the number and granularity of memory buckets (ContextMemory slots, and any analogous discrete representational partition) must itself be plastic during an open window and reduce in plasticity as the encountered environment's latent structure is resolved. The INV-074 / MECH-333 / MECH-334 critical-period shape -- open window, competitive establishment, closure / crystallisation -- is currently specified ONLY over the SCORING / POLICY plane (behavioural diversity vs winner-take-all capture); this claim asserts the same schedule is required over REPRESENTATIONAL STRUCTURE. Corollary bearing on measurement: a differentiation-family objective is not merely mis-targeted (MECH-495) but ILL-DEFINED under variable dimensionality, since separation can always be increased by adding buckets, so the objective degenerates into "use more slots"; and any fixed-N spread statistic (sws_slot_diversity over 16 slots, emitted by 29 experiment drivers) presupposes the very structure that should be the outcome. Substrate state at registration: ContextMemory(num_slots=16) at ree-v3/ree_core/predictors/e1_deep.py:36 is a fixed nn.Module buffer with no growth, no allocation policy and no environment conditioning.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: persistence_must_earn_continuation -> ARC-128/MECH-497/MECH-498; fix Status-marker placement on memory-dimensionality thought
claim_rows.title: Persistent-process termination is a general architectural requirement, not a rule_state-closure special case: every family of persistent cognitive process REE can initiate (information-seeking, planning, memory retrieval, threat monitoring, goal pursuit, exploration, ethical counterfactual generation) needs its own instance of a shared termination-state taxonomy (completion / satiety / closure / disengagement / suspension / switching / interruption / reopening) that preserves WHY termination occurred, so that suspended/reopenable processes stay distinguishable from completed, satiated, or abandoned ones.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: affordance_indexed_temporally_displaced_present -> ARC-129/MECH-501/MECH-502
claim_rows.title: The state REE's downstream proposal-generation and action-evaluation machinery consumes as 'the current state' may be more accurately modeled as a short-horizon, affordance-conditioned FORWARD-DISPLACED prediction s_hat(t+tau) rather than the literal current encoded latent, where tau is set by the causal-effect timescale of whichever action REE is presently committed to (or, absent commitment, by the shortest relevant affordance horizon among candidates). Displacement magnitude should scale with commitment quality -- larger when the committed trajectory is well-predicted and low-variance, collapsing toward the immediate encoded state when uncommitted or when prediction quality is poor -- so 'now', for any consumer that reads a single current-state latent, is itself a construction rather than a passthrough of the most recent sensory encoding.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: causal-reach-installability -> ARC-130, ARC-131, GOV-PATHVALID-1, GOV-INTERVENE-1
claim_rows.title: Organism-level mechanism status is stage-qualified beyond ARC-120's competence-before-authority sequence: a mechanism becomes causally reachable only through an ordered audit projection of existence, representation, endogenous recruitment, local operation, competitive authority (non-zero influence is not necessarily competitive influence against the dominant arbitration term), committed throughput (survives any later selector, latch, commitment boundary, or stale-selection path), ecological consequence (the changed behaviour has a valid opportunity to matter in the environment), and retention/generalisation. Authority at one internal selection boundary does not by itself establish that authority reaches committed behaviour -- 'competence should precede authority, but authority must also demonstrate throughput.' The furthest stage actually demonstrated, not a flat implemented/not-implemented judgment, is the correct unit for recording mechanism status.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: causal-reach-installability -> ARC-130, ARC-131, GOV-PATHVALID-1, GOV-INTERVENE-1
claim_rows.title: Installability is a competence dissociable from isolated component-level validation: a mechanism that passes in isolation can still fail to express itself when composed into the whole organism, because the rest of the organism changes its operating conditions (input state distribution, scale/variance of competing signals, timing and frequency of relevant events, availability of competent upstream representations, downstream action-space and commitment dynamics, post-installation learning gradients, resource/mode occupancy, and the ecology in which it must demonstrate value). A component-level PASS establishes that an operation is possible; it does not establish that the whole agent can enter the states in which the mechanism operates, that the mechanism remains competitive once other mechanisms are enabled, or that later learning will preserve it. This is dissociable from, though related to, competence RETENTION (surviving subsequent learning/time): installability additionally covers SIMULTANEOUS composition, where a competence may never appear in the full-stack agent even absent any later learning event.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: offline-representational-reindexing-counterfactual-model-comparison -> ARC-132, MECH-513, MECH-514
claim_rows.title: A learned attractor's carried quantities -- predictive reliability, epistemic confidence, familiarity, affective valence, salience, action urgency, self-relevance, and source confidence -- are separable axes that must remain independently readable rather than collapsing into one undifferentiated strength signal; when collapsed, a strongly valenced and highly precise attractor stops functioning as a hypothesis and becomes the lens through which what is noticed, how ambiguity is resolved, which memories are retrieved, and which replayed material is stored as further evidence are all determined.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: registered_utc field
claim_rows.title: Diagnostic interventions used to localise a broken causal edge must be classified along two independent dimensions rather than one flat implemented/not-implemented judgment. (1) EPISTEMIC CONTENT: an ORACLE intervention imports privileged, target-correct information or competence under investigation (establishing achievable ceilings and downstream usability, as a positive control / ceiling test) versus a NON-ORACLE injection that perturbs a suspected causal variable without supplying the task's answer (establishing causal sensitivity/identification). (2) CONSTRUCTION: a SILKY intervention is a minimally disruptive, distribution-preserving perturbation of one suspected variable (diagnostic for threshold, scale, and timing failures) versus an ODDLY COMPOSED intervention that deliberately combines individually-plausible states that rarely co-occur naturally (a stress test for shortcut-dependence, hidden conjunctions, and factorisation, not evidence of ordinary competence). These axes are orthogonal -- a silky nudge can still be oracle-informed, and an oddly composed state can be wholly non-oracular -- and must not be collapsed into one enum. Provenance (which stage/variable/relation was altered, along both axes) must be recorded, and any effect demonstrated only under such an intervention must be attributed to that intervention condition, never silently treated as endogenous REE competence.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: registered_utc field
claim_rows.title: A load-bearing positive control (or any diagnostic injection standing in for a claim's precondition) must traverse the production path it claims to validate. Directly injecting or mocking the state immediately downstream of a suspected causal edge can certify that a downstream consumer works GIVEN that state, but cannot certify that the production organism can reach that state via its own endogenous pathway. A contract test that mocks the source of a load-bearing state establishes consumer competence, not production-path reachability, and must not be reported or treated as evidence that the organism possesses the full pathway.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: registered_utc field
claim_rows.title: REE Assembly should build a synchronised, mechanically-derived behaviour+substrate observability instrument -- a Fishtank behavioural panel and a substrate-activity map sharing one navigable timeline, with every visual property (intensity, colour, pulsing, size/halo, connection change, slow background drift) tied to an explicitly documented recorded variable or transformation and never to what the architecture is "supposed" to be doing -- so that a researcher's high-bandwidth parallel visual processing can generate candidate structure that GOV-BEHADJ-1's discovery-oriented methodology and GOV-INTRO-1's triangulation rule then require to be quantified and causally tested before being treated as a finding.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: registered_utc field
