claim_rows.title: Once REE substrate activity is observable (GOV-SUBIMG-1), Assembly should apply a behaviour-linked substrate-association methodology that aligns internal state to behavioural events (event-related analysis across event types, repeated occurrences, and organisms), extends the alignment window across many temporal offsets from t-1 to t-1000+ steps rather than only the immediate surround, treats distributed multivariate substrate-state patterns -- not single variables -- as the primary unit of analysis (representational-similarity-style comparison across current behaviour, location, goal, recent history, developmental age, and subsequent behaviour), tracks how internal-behavioural signatures change across a long individual REE lifetime (longitudinal artificial-organism analysis), and moves from association to causal claims only via checkpoint branch-and-replay intervention against a matched unperturbed sibling branch -- following the same discovery-then-confirmation discipline GOV-BEHADJ-1 already requires for purely behavioural adjudication.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: other-agent-provenance-bounded-animistic-prior -> INV-102, MECH-504
claim_rows.title: In a world containing other predictive agents, causal-model selection over an observation must include a distinct OTHER-agent-caused hypothesis (alongside world-caused, self-caused, and jointly-caused) with non-zero but bounded prior probability -- a signal-detection-theory calibration target, not a fixed threshold -- and once evidence is attributed to another agent's action with sufficient probability, downstream belief-updating on whatever that evidence appears to support about the world must be discounted or reweighted conditional on a shallow, recursion-bounded model of that agent's likely goal in producing it (teach, warn, cooperate, deceive, conceal, or no strategic intent at all). This generalizes INV-012 Leg 4's single-agent self-solicited-evidence discounting to the multi-agent case, and is distinct from ARC-010/MECH-031/MECH-274's existing machinery for DETECTING and aggregating other-agent causation, which currently feeds only empathy/harm-coupling (MECH-036) and other-model stabilisation, not evidential-weight discounting of the observation's apparent world-content.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: compression-decompression-prospective-attractors-barrett-miller-convergence -> MECH-507, MECH-508, MECH-509, MECH-510, MECH-511, MECH-512, INV-103
claim_rows.title: No injection may directly set the truth-state of E1. External injections -- testimony from another agent, direct sensory evidence, an internally generated counterfactual, and an externally injected datum -- may share representational format without becoming epistemically identical; an injection may supply evidence capable of MODIFYING E1 only through ordinary precision-, provenance-, and learning-eligibility machinery (MECH-043, MECH-511), never by overwriting E1's belief state directly.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: persistence_must_earn_continuation -> ARC-128/MECH-497/MECH-498; fix Status-marker placement on memory-dimensionality thought
claim_rows.title: A persistent cognitive process can degrade the very confidence/evidence variable that gates its own termination condition, producing a positive-feedback failure to stop: repeated verification/checking reduces subjective recollective confidence while leaving objective accuracy largely intact, so the stopping condition ('sufficiently confident') becomes progressively harder to satisfy the more it is checked. This self-referential-measurement failure is mechanistically distinct from MECH-080's attractor-lock-in account of OCD (deep locked rollout basin via BG/ACh gate dynamics); the two may co-occur but a substrate fix for one does not by itself fix the other.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: persistence_must_earn_continuation -> ARC-128/MECH-497/MECH-498; fix Status-marker placement on memory-dimensionality thought
claim_rows.title: Continuation of a persistent process should be gated jointly on marginal expected return relative to available alternatives (Marginal Value Theorem framing) AND on the observed RATE of progress -- whether uncertainty, goal-distance, or informational yield is actually decreasing under continued investment, not only its current absolute level -- so that a process whose marginal progress has collapsed increasingly loses justification for further resource allocation even while absolute uncertainty/value remains high. This is the disengagement-direction complement to MECH-343/SD-061's difficulty-gated proposal-entropy WIDENING response to stall: it covers the case where widening the search ALSO fails to restore progress.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake 2026-08-25: register MECH-499/500 (ephaptic aggregation hippocampal now + commitment readiness) from 2026-08-12 raw thought
claim_rows.title: Ephaptic/oscillatory field-level coherence functions as a fast, non-synaptic CONTENT-AGGREGATION mechanism -- not merely the confidence/eligibility readout MECH-270 already covers -- synthesising distributed oscillatory information (amplitude, phase, relative phase, frequency, synchrony, cross-frequency relationships) into the temporally-coherent 'actionable now' state that seeds hippocampal proposal generation. The field need not 'understand' anything; its attraction as a mechanism is that the physical substrate may perform part of the aggregation automatically, fast enough that proposal generation is not stale by the time candidate futures are produced.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake 2026-08-25: register MECH-499/500 (ephaptic aggregation hippocampal now + commitment readiness) from 2026-08-12 raw thought
claim_rows.title: Content authority (which candidate future should win commitment -- already REE's existing architecture via MECH-090/MECH-341/ARC-003) and temporal/readiness authority (whether a candidate future has become sufficiently coherent, in the cross-system field-coherence sense, for commitment to be permitted to land AT ALL) are distinct constitutional questions that may require different mechanisms. Fast cross-system field coherence (extending MECH-499's content-aggregation function) is a candidate mechanism for the readiness axis specifically -- locating the moving frontier at which a previously branching predicted future becomes sufficiently well-predicted for commitment to land -- distinct from MECH-434's evidence/posterior-driven epistemic commitment timing at the inference layer, and distinct from MECH-090's beta-gated propagation of an already-decided commit.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: affordance_indexed_temporally_displaced_present -> ARC-129/MECH-501/MECH-502
claim_rows.title: Interruption of a committed trajectory by a sufficiently consequential prediction violation should trigger an explicit BACKWARD RECONSTRUCTION of the current-state estimate proposed by ARC-129 -- a measurable discontinuity in which the forward-displaced predicted-now s_hat(t+tau) is replaced by a less-displaced, evidence-corrected estimate closer to s_hat(t) -- distinct from, and downstream of, gate re-opening (MECH-090) and decommitment (MECH-342), which govern behavioral/ACTION authority but say nothing about what happens to the STATE REPRESENTATION consumed as 'now' at the moment of interrupt. Expected corollary: unexpected interruption of a highly predictable action-linked sequence should produce stronger state-estimate reconstruction than an expected within-trajectory correction of the same magnitude.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: affordance_indexed_temporally_displaced_present -> ARC-129/MECH-501/MECH-502
claim_rows.title: Because REE can hold multiple simultaneously-active commitments at different behavioural scales (e.g., a fine-grained motor/action-level commitment nested within a longer path/sequence-level commitment, itself nested within a longer goal-level commitment), the displaced-present construction proposed by ARC-129 should not be modeled as one global scalar displacement but as potentially several concurrently-active, differently-scoped forward-displacement horizons -- with local interrupt/correction at a fine-grained level (e.g., a single-step prediction-error correction) plausibly not requiring re-opening of a coarser-grained commitment, and vice versa. This is a nesting-of-DISPLACEMENT-HORIZONS claim, distinct from ARC-070/MECH-321's nesting of POLICY-DECOMPOSITION depth (which recursively re-segments candidate action primitives, not the temporal position of the consumed current-state estimate).

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: reusable-computational-motifs -> SD-101, MECH-503
claim_rows.title: Motif selection and content binding: given a typed control demand or task requirement, the control plane should select a reusable computational motif (an operation such as maintain, compare, accumulate, sequence, retrieve, or estimate-uncertainty) from a repertoire and dynamically bind task-relevant content to it, as a step distinct from and inserted before/ alongside coalition/topology instantiation (MECH-481). Content binding and coalition/topology selection are proposed as separable causal axes: correct-coalition/wrong-binding and wrong-coalition/correct-binding should produce dissociable failure signatures if the axes are genuinely distinct.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: other-agent-provenance-bounded-animistic-prior -> INV-102, MECH-504
claim_rows.title: Developmental specialisation of the scientist-agent principle (MECH-276) for other-agent / responsive-entity discovery: parallel to MECH-278's stage-2 object-schema formation via experimental intervention on passive world-features, an agent discovers candidate other- minds by performing actions and testing which environmental entities' subsequent behaviour covaries with those actions (I-move to entity-responds; I-stop to entity-changes-behaviour; I-approach to entity-withdraws; I-pursue to entity-evades; I-signal to entity-changes-state), producing the RESPONSIVE-entity discrimination that a purely passive-world-focused curriculum (static hazards and resources only) cannot supply. This is the "V4 social-intervention mechanism (parallel to MECH-278 for other-agents)" MECH-276's own notes already name as a known specialisation but do not register.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: behaviour_linked_substrate_imaging_longitudinal_artificial_organism_neuroscience -> GOV-SUBIMG-1, GOV-SUBIMG-2
claim_rows.title: Fast-empathy other-harm transfer into REE's own valuation/action-selection must be a GATED channel, regulated along (at minimum) six axes -- mapping fidelity, self/other identity preservation, gain control (regulatable transfer magnitude), context gating (familiarity, attachment, kinship, threat, competition, role), timescale differentiation (brief resonance vs. sustained caregiving), and graded action-selection authority (able to suppress self-serving action or trigger costly protection when warranted) -- with interaction history able to update future transfer, rather than an undifferentiated scalar leak from other-harm to self-harm.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: behaviour_linked_substrate_imaging_longitudinal_artificial_organism_neuroscience -> GOV-SUBIMG-1, GOV-SUBIMG-2
claim_rows.title: An entity crosses an operational "vulnerable goal-directed other" threshold when convergent evidence shows (a) diverse behaviour compactly predicted by persistent latent goals and (b) systematic, adaptive alteration of subsequent behaviour in response to harm, threat, goal-frustration, damage, or restoration -- a functional/behavioural criterion sufficient for protective treatment while explicitly preserving uncertainty about subjective experience, and distinct from both MECH-031's self-model-possession criterion and EXT-009/INV-072's similarity-based ethical-inclusion criterion.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: compression-decompression-prospective-attractors-barrett-miller-convergence -> MECH-507, MECH-508, MECH-509, MECH-510, MECH-511, MECH-512, INV-103
claim_rows.title: E1's persistent context should be reframed as an explicit RECIPROCAL compression/decompression bridge, not merely a latent representation with compression left implicit inside ordinary representation learning: high-dimensional experience, autobiographical history, and body state compress into a lower-dimensional organising state z_t, and z_t decompresses into higher- dimensional predictions and candidate sensorimotor futures. Compression is what makes different high-dimensional situations become functionally equivalent when they imply sufficiently similar action-relevant consequences; decompression is what turns that summary back into usable prospective content for downstream planning.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: compression-decompression-prospective-attractors-barrett-miller-convergence -> MECH-507, MECH-508, MECH-509, MECH-510, MECH-511, MECH-512, INV-103
claim_rows.title: An REE attractor is best formalised as a compressed, history-conditioned GENERATIVE DISPOSITION defining a family and probability distribution over possible sensorimotor trajectories -- not a stored proposition (e.g. "this is threat") and not a fixed memory object -- whose precision controls how strongly it constrains interpretation and future generation, and into which incoming precision-weighted evidence may select, modify, or (if sufficiently consequential) remodel or displace. Its pathology separates into two independent failure axes that can co-occur but must not be conflated: EXCESSIVE PRECISION (the attractor is treated as extremely certain, strongly constraining interpretation/retrieval/generation -- the "perceptual lens" failure, where material the attractor itself generates or biases gets counted as independent confirming evidence) and EXCESSIVE COMPRESSION (too many distinct situations are collapsed into one action-relevant equivalence class, independent of how confident the system is in that collapsed class).

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: compression-decompression-prospective-attractors-barrett-miller-convergence -> MECH-507, MECH-508, MECH-509, MECH-510, MECH-511, MECH-512, INV-103
claim_rows.title: A cheap, E1-context-conditioned decompression stage should generate a structured POSSIBILITY FIELD -- a proposal distribution over plausible sensorimotor futures, P(possible futures | z_t, current context) -- from which a SMALLER NUMBER of candidate trajectories are sampled for expensive hippocampal/E2 rollout, rather than rollout sampling from an unconstrained space. The possibility field is a computational claim about staging (cheap generative field BEFORE expensive trajectory simulation), not a claim that an explicit long-horizon rollout mechanism has been biologically identified.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: compression-decompression-prospective-attractors-barrett-miller-convergence -> MECH-507, MECH-508, MECH-509, MECH-510, MECH-511, MECH-512, INV-103
claim_rows.title: Prediction precision -- how strongly a generative attractor constrains interpretation and proposal generation -- and prediction-error precision/salience -- how much a discrepancy is trusted to drive correction or learning -- are separable control-plane quantities that need not move together and should be routable independently. An overprecise prediction combined with underweighted error produces capture (the attractor dominates regardless of contrary evidence); noisy but highly salient errors can produce instability (the system is destabilised by unreliable discrepancies). REE already treats precision as heterogeneous rather than scalar (MECH-043, MECH-054); this claim proposes GENERATIVE/interpretive precision as a further, independently-routable axis distinct from both the unsigned-error channel MECH-043 names and the signed harm/benefit valence split MECH-054 names.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: compression-decompression-prospective-attractors-barrett-miller-convergence -> MECH-507, MECH-508, MECH-509, MECH-510, MECH-511, MECH-512, INV-103
claim_rows.title: Durable ("deep") revision of E1 or a deep attractor should be gated by a LEARNING ELIGIBILITY function of (error, error precision, predicted future/control relevance, organism-or-other consequence, evidence provenance, current mode) -- not by raw error magnitude alone. Candidate routing: low-consequence mismatch -> local correction; significant mismatch -> retained as pending integration material; high-confidence/high-consequence mismatch -> waking adaptation and active information-seeking; contradiction of a deep attractor -> preserve and contest rather than immediately rewrite; accumulated or structurally important contradiction -> counterfactual reprocessing and possible offline revision. Whether a deep update actually occurred should be measured by whether the EQUIVALENCE CLASSES an attractor uses to generate future possibilities changed, not merely by whether stored content changed -- a corollary measurement criterion, since content can change without the generative structure changing.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: compression-decompression-prospective-attractors-barrett-miller-convergence -> MECH-507, MECH-508, MECH-509, MECH-510, MECH-511, MECH-512, INV-103
claim_rows.title: The level of abstraction / compression depth selected when compressing experience into an attractor or context representation is a MOMENTARY, functionally consequential control variable -- too much compression overgeneralises (distinct contexts collapsed into one action-relevant class); too little compression prevents useful generalisation and leaves the system overly concrete or uncertain. This momentary compression-depth axis is separable both from prediction confidence/precision (MECH-510) and from total representational CAPACITY -- distinguished explicitly from MECH-496/INV-101's slower DEVELOPMENTAL crystallisation of bucket COUNT: MECH-496/INV-101 concern how many buckets an architecture resolves to over a training-scale critical-period schedule; this claim concerns how much a GIVEN instance of compression discards versus retains at inference time, which could vary moment to moment even under a fixed bucket count.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: offline-representational-reindexing-counterfactual-model-comparison -> ARC-132, MECH-513, MECH-514
claim_rows.title: Representation-version reindexing for episodic memory: when the representational primitives used to index memory change -- a bucket splits, several buckets merge, ContextMemory's effective dimensionality crystallises to a different count (MECH-496), or the underlying encoder is otherwise updated -- previously stored episodes must be explicitly reinstated and reindexed under the new scheme via an ADDITIVE, versioned relationship rather than an overwrite: the episode, its source, and its original indexing remain independently recoverable, the new indexing is created as a distinct version with provenance back to the change that produced it, and the episode should remain interpretable under both the historical and the current representational scheme.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: offline-representational-reindexing-counterfactual-model-comparison -> ARC-132, MECH-513, MECH-514
claim_rows.title: Counterfactual replay for attractor testing: an offline-preferred process that (1) separates preserved, externally-grounded evidence from a dominant model's interpretation of it, (2) temporarily reduces that dominant attractor's influence over retrieval and interpretation, (3) constructs a small set of bounded alternative explanatory models, (4) replays the SAME anchored evidence through the dominant and alternative models to generate predictions that would distinguish them, and (5) compares the models against held-out or subsequent waking evidence before any resulting reindexing is granted full action or memory authority. Every replay-derived item carries provenance to its originating evidence and generating model so that repeated simulations from one episode cannot be counted as multiple independent confirmatory samples, and the process selecting what gets replayed must have some independence from the attractor under test.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: responsibility_as_epistemic_hygiene -> INV-012 Leg 4 + Q-096; cross-reference ARC-015/MECH-095/INV-077
claim_rows.title: Does REE's evaluation-channel-integrity discipline (INV-077) generalize beyond REE's own development process to an ordinary human-AI conversational dyad, where sycophancy can weaken the error signal and let a coupled human-AI cognitive system mistake internally-generated coherence for external confirmation?

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claims: fix EXT-009's stale Q-032 cross-reference
claim_rows.title: What mechanism should estimate an interacting agent's mimicry/deception risk and feed it into EXT-009's liberal care-gate criterion -- i.e. how does (or should) REE detect that a candidate mind is an adversarial agent mimicking mind-signals to extract undeserved care, tightening the criterion's false-positive-cost term (Axiom 8 deception) without collapsing the liberal floor that protects genuine-but-ambiguous minds from exclusion?

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: reusable-computational-motifs -> SD-101, MECH-503
claim_rows.title: Control plane should be able to represent computational ROLE (a reusable operation such as maintain, compare, accumulate, sequence, retrieve, or estimate-uncertainty) independently of the REPRESENTATIONAL CONTENT currently bound to it -- a third compositional axis alongside coalition/topology control (SD-091's graph-valued output G_t) and parametric modulation, distinct from and complementary to both. A conceptual object may need separate role (F), bound-content (X_t), substrate (S_t), coalition-membership (G_t), and parameter-state (theta_t) identities rather than assuming these collapse into one another.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: 2026-08-26 representation->authority->selection -> ARC-133/134, MECH-516..521 (two registered as explicit rivals to MECH-278 and INV-088/MECH-458)
claim_rows.title: Selection-relevance is a legitimate object-individuation criterion: an object may be individuated by what it is FOR -- its usefulness relative to goals, harm, and interoceptive/metabolic state -- rather than (only) by the causal coherence of its features under intervention. This is RIVAL to MECH-278 and the two disagree on real cases: causally-identical-but-functionally-distinct items are one object under MECH-278 and two under ARC-133; causally-distinct-but-functionally-identical items (a hazard that bites, a hazard that falls) are two under MECH-278 and one under ARC-133. The sharpest divergence is drive-relative re-individuation -- the same world carves differently when hungry, thirsty or injured -- which a causal criterion cannot deliver and which is precisely what MECH-359 asserts selection requires.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: 2026-08-26 representation->authority->selection -> ARC-133/134, MECH-516..521 (two registered as explicit rivals to MECH-278 and INV-088/MECH-458)
claim_rows.title: The unit of PERCEPT is a dynamic representation, not a fixed primitive: perceptual grain rescales with circumstance, so that the same scene is individuated coarsely or finely depending on demand. This is the perceptual analogue of ARC-069's already-accepted policy-side commitment, and ARC-069's rationale transfers axis-independently -- a fixed grain is either too fine (combinatorial explosion in what must be tracked and bound) or too coarse (units fail to map onto the actual state). REE has made this commitment for policy (ARC-069/070/071) and for context slots offline (MECH-166) but never for online perception, where the unit remains fixed.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claims: register MECH-515 (multi-agent strategic cost of delay), resolving deferred check from 2026-08-12 persistence-must-earn-continuation thought intake
claim_rows.title: In multi-agent settings, the cost of continued deliberation is not only an opportunity cost against a passive, unchanging world (the internal expected-value-of-information trade MECH-434 already governs) but a STRATEGIC cost that another goal-directed agent can actively impose: a competing mind can occupy a contested resource, block a route, infer REE's objective from its information-seeking behaviour, conceal or manufacture evidence, or prepare an attack while REE continues gathering evidence. A commitment-timing mechanism that weighs only pragmatic-vs-epistemic value against a static environment will systematically over-deliberate whenever another agent is present and can act on REE's delay; the commitment threshold/urgency term must therefore also be sensitive to detected other-agent presence and behaviour, not internal information value alone.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: 2026-08-26 representation->authority->selection -> ARC-133/134, MECH-516..521 (two registered as explicit rivals to MECH-278 and INV-088/MECH-458)
claim_rows.title: Argmax collapse at the incentive-to-goal interface: the per-object drive-conditioned value structure wanting[k] is computed over ALL stored objects and then reduced by most_wanted()'s ARGMAX to a single winner before it reaches selection, so z_goal is seeded from one object embedding and every candidate trajectory is scored against that one target. The comparative structure that would let candidates differ from one another for a value-relevant reason is destroyed upstream of the selector, not absent from it -- predicting that a downstream readout is FLAT in upstream wanting range except at rank flips, and becomes sloped when the argmax is replaced by a norm-matched graded read.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: 2026-08-26 representation->authority->selection -> ARC-133/134, MECH-516..521 (two registered as explicit rivals to MECH-278 and INV-088/MECH-458)
claim_rows.title: Interface before representation: a representation improvement is undetectable through a collapsing interface, so representation-side experiments run before the consumer interface is fixed return nulls that cannot be interpreted. This is RIVAL to the standing differentiate-first ordering (differentiate z_world per INV-088, THEN apply diversity pressure). The two give opposite readings of the same result: V3-EXQ-817a verifiably improved O's consequence structure and produced no behavioural change, which differentiate-first reads as consequence structure does not help, and this claim reads as the measurement could not have detected help.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: 2026-08-26 representation->authority->selection -> ARC-133/134, MECH-516..521 (two registered as explicit rivals to MECH-278 and INV-088/MECH-458)
claim_rows.title: One tensor, two masters: E2.action_object_head's output O is simultaneously the semantic compression (what o_t means) and the search coordinate system the hippocampal CEM samples in (ao_mean + ao_std*noise, decoded to actions), so an objective that improves the first can degrade the second by reallocating a shared fixed budget -- O's variance. Measured in V3-EXQ-817a: ao_M5_r2_explained_by_action_alone fell from ~0.995 to ~0.721, moving roughly 28 percent of O's variance out of action-coding, while the consequence-ordering metric M6 remained weak and sign-unstable (mean ~+0.12, negative on 2 of 5 seeds). O stopped being a clean action code without becoming a reliable consequence code.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: 2026-08-26 representation->authority->selection -> ARC-133/134, MECH-516..521 (two registered as explicit rivals to MECH-278 and INV-088/MECH-458)
claim_rows.title: SD-057's object-bound incentive tokens and SD-049's per-axis drive CANNOT carry epistemic value: the object-side carrier is written by a contact benefit-pulse, and the only epistemic pulse the environment supplies is a visit-count novelty proxy, which is disqualified by the gain x need constraint (Mattar and Daw 2018; Carey 2019 -- replay can be biased AWAY from the currently-most-valuable outcome). This is the NEGATIVE half only, and is the non-redundant content: the positive half (the quantity IS gain x need on transitions) is MECH-443's premise, inherited rather than added. Logically independent of MECH-443, whose subject is the replay write channel rather than the drive/goal pathway.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: 2026-08-26 representation->authority->selection -> ARC-133/134, MECH-516..521 (two registered as explicit rivals to MECH-278 and INV-088/MECH-458)
claim_rows.title: Predictive obligation is the anti-collapse constraint on a value-carved representation: a representation compressed toward selection-relevance ALONE degenerates, because value is a near-scalar projection and a pure value-carving objective admits solutions that discard everything not currently useful. Requiring the higher-order latents to remain PREDICTIVE across the ARC-004 temporal spread supplies a constraint the value objective lacks -- cross-horizon prediction demands retained state structure that value alone does not -- so the combination holds perception open where value-carving alone would collapse it.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: 2026-08-26 representation->authority->selection -> ARC-133/134, MECH-516..521 (two registered as explicit rivals to MECH-278 and INV-088/MECH-458)
claim_rows.title: Perceptual slot OCCUPANCY is an emergent order parameter of a coupling-versus-lateral-inhibition settling competition, bounded above by an independently-set CAPACITY -- so capacity and occupancy are two distinct regulators rather than one. Occupancy is not read off coherence by counting related coherencies, which is circular (the relatedness criterion IS the grain decision) and ill-posed (coherence nests rather than partitions). Mechanism-agnostic about what sets the coupling constant.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: digestion wave 1 applied: MECH-516 narrowed to instance 1 (2 of 4 instances withdrawn as false), MECH-517 deferred w/ digestion_note, MECH-518 instrument corrected + EXP-0589 minted, MECH-521 split (MECH-522 minted), ARC-133 fourth-facet framing withdrawn
claim_rows.title: Ephaptic field strength is the COUPLING CONSTANT of the perceptual settling competition that sets slot occupancy (MECH-521), not a quantity that is measured and counted. A physical field does not enumerate domains; it sets the interaction strength from which the domain count emerges -- and because coherence is a property of each population separately, a field-derived setter is natively HETEROGENEOUS (different streams settling into different domain counts simultaneously) rather than imposing the single ordered abstraction axis that Badre and Nee 2018 reports the evidence does not support. This is a THIRD ephaptic function, distinct from MECH-499 (what the actionable now CONTAINS) and MECH-500 (WHEN a branching future is coherent enough to commit): at what GRAIN the now is carved.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: digestion wave 2 applied: MECH-465 -> testable-now + residual DV + EXP-0590; MECH-464/ARC-134/MECH-519/MECH-520 corrected; MECH-523 registered (compression sites systematically untrained)
claim_rows.title: REE's designated compression sites are systematically UNTRAINED, so representational-ceiling results measured at them are uninterpretable as capacity findings. Verified 2026-08-26 at three independent sites: (a) E2.action_object_head, SD-004's action-object bottleneck that the hippocampal CEM searches inside, receives zero gradient from every REE training path and is a frozen random projection with ~99.5% of its variance explained by the action label (SD-080); (b) the ARC-004 higher-order latent stack -- beta_encoder, theta_encoder and delta_encoder appear ZERO times in agent.py, have no loss, no optimiser and no predictive head at any horizon, and are an untrained random-projection cascade smoothed by one hardcoded shared EMA (alpha_shared = 0.3); (c) no value-shaped objective reaches any encoder at all -- compute_benefit_eval_loss reads z_world.detach() and trains only E3.benefit_eval_head. The corollary is methodological: a null measured at an untrained compression site is evidence about the absence of a training signal, not about the representation's capacity or about the sufficiency of the architecture.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: developmental integration programme -> register GOV-CAPCONTRACT-1, ARC-135
claim_rows.title: 'Long life' in an artificial organism is not one property but at least four separable continuities -- cognitive/affective/mnemonic state continuity, parameter/plasticity continuity, body/homeostatic continuity, and ecological/world continuity -- which can be held or broken independently of one another. A persistent-organism experiment must therefore declare which of the four it preserves, because duration under a broken continuity is not developmental opportunity: an organism whose cognitive state persists while its body and world regenerate at every boundary is not aging in a world, and an organism observed for many ticks with its parameters frozen is not developing. The decomposition separates four confounds that a scalar 'lifespan' or 'ticks survived' cannot: age from layout luck, learning from reset effects, injury/recovery from death, and memory accumulation from environmental regeneration.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: registered_utc field
claim_rows.title: A run is not admissible as negative evidence for a claim unless the organism instantiated for that run was demonstrably able to express -- and, where the claim is learning- or development-dependent, to acquire -- the faculty under test. Each organism-level experiment must therefore DECLARE, and a preflight must machine-verify against the instantiated organism, at minimum: the canonical profile identity and every explicit deviation from it; the mechanisms and capabilities the hypothesis presupposes; whether those mechanisms were constructed, enabled and reached on the production path; whether their decisive readouts engaged often enough for the test to be non-vacuous; whether their output could compete at the relevant arbitration surface at the scale present in the run; which forms of change were permitted (parameters, policy/value, E1/E2 representations, memory state, residue/EMA state, offline updates); and, where online learning is load-bearing, whether gradients were enabled, whether the intended trainable parameters were in an optimizer, and whether a parameter-delta witness confirms an actual update path. A run failing any declared precondition self-routes to a capability-precondition diagnostic status and MUST NOT be recorded as evidence against the claim. 'It did not learn' and 'it could not have learned' are different scientific outcomes.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: lit-pull: register interrupted-task-resumption claim family (MECH-524, Q-098) + 6 literature entries
claim_rows.title: Capacity-triggered resumption reseeding: at the moment a task is interrupted, REE captures an interruption_snapshot (z_world + z_self + z_goal + CEM planning stage + rule-arbitration weights + what-was-attempted) that is richer than, and distinct from, SD-039's existing dual-trace anchor goal-snapshot payload. When a spare-compute signal (low SD-037 broadcast-override + low z_harm_a + low dACC choice_difficulty) or sleep entry indicates freed processing capacity, the interruption_snapshot is re-seeded into MECH-293's awake ghost-goal probes and MECH-285's sleep-replay sampler, so that resumption is a reorient-from-snapshot rather than a restart-from-scratch. This is the backward-direction complement to REE's existing forward direction, in which world-change invalidates stale model content (MECH-269 anchor V_s + MECH-284 staleness -> MECH-287 broadcast -> anchors inactive): the forward direction discards stale content when the world moves on without the agent; MECH-524 is what lets the agent pick its own paused work back up once capacity to attend to it returns.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claims: register ARC-092 children MECH-525/526 + Q-099/100 (imagination-licit-vs-forbidden learning); update 2026-08-07 responsibility thought intake to reflect MECH-487's same-day registration
claim_rows.title: Schema integration during offline/imagination-adjacent consolidation (MECH-272 probe-channel routing, MECH-273 sleep-half self-model aggregation) is constrained to recombining waking-derived trace primitives: the material a schema-integration pass restructures must trace back to real, committed (hypothesis_tag=False) waking experience, and a schema update computed from one imagination/consolidation cycle's output must not itself become input material for a later cycle's schema integration without an intervening waking-encoded checkpoint. Without this constraint, successive offline cycles could compound self-amplification of imagined content into schema structure -- confabulation by accretion rather than by single-event failure.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claims: register ARC-092 children MECH-525/526 + Q-099/100 (imagination-licit-vs-forbidden learning); update 2026-08-07 responsibility thought intake to reflect MECH-487's same-day registration
claim_rows.title: Outputs of counterfactual exploration (imagined/simulated candidate rollouts scored during E3 selection or equivalent planning) are LICIT only as priors for future waking testing -- i.e. as inputs to policy/value preference (which action to prefer, which hypothesis to test next) -- and are FORBIDDEN from being treated as knowledge: they must not be written into the world-model's own predictive parameters, used to validate or score a REAL prediction's accuracy, or logged as an established fact. This is REE's architectural analogue of expected-free-energy policy scoring (Friston et al. 2015): imagining a candidate's likely outcome to choose among candidates is a distinct operation from updating the model that did the imagining, and the two must not be allowed to collapse into one write path.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: lit-pull: register interrupted-task-resumption claim family (MECH-524, Q-098) + 6 literature entries
claim_rows.title: MECH-524's interruption_snapshot captures z_world at the moment of interruption. By the time a spare-compute or sleep-entry trigger re-seeds it into MECH-293/MECH-285, real time has passed during which the actual world may have changed (REE's forward direction: MECH-269 V_s + MECH-284 staleness -> MECH-287 broadcast -> anchors inactive). How should resumption reconcile the snapshot's SAVED V_s against V_s as CURRENTLY computed? Candidates: (a) current-only -- discard the saved V_s and let MECH-269 recompute cold, keeping only the snapshot's non-V_s content (CEM stage, rule-arbitration weights, what-was-attempted); (b) max(current, saved*decay) -- treat the saved V_s as a decaying floor rather than a fresh read, structurally transplanting MECH-284's spatial region-staleness decay logic onto this temporal/episodic case; (c) abort-on-divergence guard -- compare saved vs current V_s and refuse the snapshot-primed resumption path (fall back toward restart-from-scratch) if divergence exceeds a threshold, functioning as a targeted application of MECH-287's existing anchors-inactive broadcast rather than a new invalidation mechanism; (d) context-dependent -- the correct rule depends on interruption duration, interruption cause (hazard vs. voluntary capacity reallocation), or domain volatility, and no single rule suffices.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claims: register ARC-092 children MECH-525/526 + Q-099/100 (imagination-licit-vs-forbidden learning); update 2026-08-07 responsibility thought intake to reflect MECH-487's same-day registration
claim_rows.title: ARC-092 licenses plan optimisation (choosing among imagined candidate action sequences) as LICIT, while forbidding durable world-model updates driven by imagined content. But plan optimisation and world-model update are not always cleanly separable in a single learned system: if E3's candidate-scoring pathway shares parameters, representations, or a training signal with the world-model/predictor (E1/E2), then IMPROVING plan optimisation performance could, as a side effect, also shift world-model parameters -- exactly the FORBIDDEN path, smuggled in through a shared substrate rather than an explicit write. Where, mechanistically, does plan-optimisation's LICIT gradient/update signal stop and the world-model's FORBIDDEN one begin, in REE's actual (not merely intended) parameter-sharing architecture?

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: claims: register ARC-092 children MECH-525/526 + Q-099/100 (imagination-licit-vs-forbidden learning); update 2026-08-07 responsibility thought intake to reflect MECH-487's same-day registration
claim_rows.title: ARC-064 extracts cross-episode behavioural regularities, compressed patterns, and rule-state abstractions from an observed-behaviour stream (hippocampal CLS bi-pathway / dorsolateral striatum chunking / OFC cognitive-map analog). Under ARC-092, that observed-behaviour stream could in principle be either real waking behaviour or imagined/simulated (e.g. E3 counterfactual) trajectories. Are rules extracted from IMAGINED trajectories architecturally EQUIVALENT to rules extracted from WAKING trajectories -- i.e. does ARC-064's extraction mechanism operate identically regardless of source, with licitness enforced only at a separate downstream commit/write-gate step (MECH-094-style) -- or does rule extraction ITSELF need a provenance-aware carve-out (e.g. imagined-trajectory-derived rules held as lower-confidence/provisional/prior-only until corroborated by real execution, per MECH-322's template), because letting an unvalidated imagined trajectory silently seed the same rule-state abstraction a validated waking trajectory would is itself a FORBIDDEN-adjacent risk (confabulated RULES, not merely confabulated episodic facts)?

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: 7-thought backlog clear -> GOV-V4CUT-1, GOV-METAB-1, GOV-UMPIRE-1, MECH-527/528/529, ARC-136 (milestone: no claims)
claim_rows.title: Play as emergent developmental information hunger: play-like behaviour emerges WITHOUT a dedicated play module when basic viability is secure, no urgent commitment dominates action selection, spare behavioural capacity is available, reachable states contain learnable (reducible) uncertainty, and exploration is predicted to produce learning progress -- and the FRONTIER of play MIGRATES across affordance spaces (bodily -> object -> compositional/causal -> social -> symbolic/counterfactual -> abstract) as learning progress in earlier spaces saturates, yielding an endogenous developmental curriculum rather than externally imposed stages. Mastery moves curiosity rather than extinguishing it; human neoteny is read as preservation of the developmental exploratory mode with progressively abstract objects. Explicitly NOT the strong equation play = information gain (play also serves bonding, practice, regulation, signalling).

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: registered_utc field
claim_rows.title: Unapplied confirmed-autopsy recommendation rule: a CONFIRMED failure-autopsy verdict that was reviewed but never APPLIED decays into a positive claim, so the registry must be scanned for confirmed recommendations claims.yaml does not reflect.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: registered_utc field
claim_rows.title: Epistemic-category completeness rule: a confirmed failure-autopsy target carrying claim_ids must also carry recommended_epistemic_category, because the claim-keyed counters silently skip a target where it is absent and thereby UNDER-count in the direction that suppresses a demotion.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: registered_utc field
claim_rows.title: Dry-run adjudication leak rule: a governance verdict must never rest on a --dry-run smoke, so confirmed autopsies and substrate_queue entries are scanned for citations of dry manifests carrying an ASSERTING evidence stamp.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: registered_utc field
claim_rows.title: Granularity-debt recurrence rule: N or more structurally-DIFFERENT confirmed failures on one claim indicate the claim is mis-grained rather than merely unlucky, and it should be re-grained rather than re-run.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: registered_utc field
claim_rows.title: Endogenous productive/consolidative cadence: the research programme alternates between evidence-production and evidence-assimilation modes, with the switch gated on measured consolidation pressure (autopsy debt, recurring symptom classes, queue starvation despite backlog, coordination fraction, stale premises) rather than calendar; the optimisation target is scientifically useful progress per unit cognitive resource while preserving interpretability -- not continuous utilisation. Restart criteria are part of consolidation: its output is a better initial state for the next productive phase, not merely a smaller backlog.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: registered_utc field
claim_rows.title: Skill-improvement recurrence rule: when a non-outcome LESSON recurs across N or more failure autopsies and no skill checklist has absorbed it, the recurrence is evidence of a missing procedural guard rather than N independent incidents.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: registered_utc field
claim_rows.title: Substrate-path overlap rule: for every still-open severity:corrupting substrate_queue entry, already-COMPLETED runs whose driver touches its substrate_paths and which finished after the entry was raised must be surfaced as candidates for re-review.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: registered_utc field
claim_rows.title: Canonical readiness umpire: REE maintains an explicit, inspectable process for recognising when a reproducible organism has become sufficiently coherent and competent that formal reference-organism review is warranted -- while remaining structurally unable to answer that question itself. The detector observes/derives/reports/escalates state transitions (NO_WARRANT / ADMISSION_PASS_WARRANTED / REFERENCE_ORGANISM_REVIEW_WARRANTED / USER_DECISION_REQUIRED / CANONICAL_OBSERVED) over explicit gates (identifiable organism; admission-doctrine candidate substrate; COEXISTENCE of mechanisms in the same animal; whole-organism non-degeneracy; behavioural evidence; reproducibility) -- never a readiness percentage, never self-canonisation. Warrants are withdrawable; profile-admission readiness and reference-organism readiness remain separate thresholds; for developmental REEs the reproducible object may be the developmental recipe and constitution rather than the adult state.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: registered_utc field
claim_rows.title: V4 prerequisite cut: the V3->V4 scientific cutover is gated by qualification of the smallest transitive set of V3 capabilities/claims whose truth or functional adequacy V4 actually assumes -- each either sufficiently demonstrated or bounded-and-instrumented (known failure mode detectable and distinguishable from V4-specific effects) -- adjudicated by a dedicated cutover review, never by a global closure percentage. Version labels name organism/design generations; closure describes validation state; version membership is not inheritance, and inheritance is not closure membership. After qualification the programme legitimately occupies two states at once: V3 as validated simple reference organism, V4 as active development organism.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: 7-thought backlog clear -> GOV-V4CUT-1, GOV-METAB-1, GOV-UMPIRE-1, MECH-527/528/529, ARC-136 (milestone: no claims)
claim_rows.title: Stuckness-triggered attractor-escape exploration: a triggered, organism-level annealing analogue in which persistent CONFIDENCE-WITHOUT-RESOLUTION (settled attractor, repeated failure to reduce the active need/goal error -- natural trigger substrate: MECH-482's epistemic_deficit accumulator) transiently injects variation ABOVE the immediate-action level -- perturbing candidate trajectories, strategy proposals, retrieved attractors, goal decompositions, and the precision/authority of the currently dominant attractor, with escalating breadth under continued stuckness -- to escape a false bottom (a locally stable but persistently inadequate basin), then decays after successful resolution. Distinct from tonic or near-tie action noise: the trigger is unresolvedness, not uncertainty; two well-understood, similarly-good actions warrant NO exploration, while a high-confidence failing strategy warrants it strongly.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: 7-thought backlog clear -> GOV-V4CUT-1, GOV-METAB-1, GOV-UMPIRE-1, MECH-527/528/529, ARC-136 (milestone: no claims)
claim_rows.title: Self-relative affordance uncertainty: the model under calibration is P(outcome | self-state, world-state, action), not P(outcome | world-state, action) -- E1/E2 maintain uncertainty over action consequences conditional on the CURRENT SELF-STATE, so a change in the self (growth, capability change, damage) selectively makes previously learned environmental relations uncertain again and selectively reopens exploration of the AFFECTED affordance regions without a global novelty reset.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: 7-thought backlog clear -> GOV-V4CUT-1, GOV-METAB-1, GOV-UMPIRE-1, MECH-527/528/529, ARC-136 (milestone: no claims)
claim_rows.title: Replay-driven rebucketing: accumulated consequential-divergence evidence -- typed insufficiency signals from decision outcomes (prediction/consequence mismatch, harm or goal error, repeated veto/conflict, divergent outcomes following apparently equivalent E1 states), never category labels -- drives split / merge / feature-reweighting / relation-discovery / event-boundary-revision / abstraction-change over E1's equivalence classes, via REPLAY of non-contiguous episodes under a common evaluative frame (retrospective representation learning: later experience revises how earlier experiences are bucketed). Candidate rebucketings are COUNTERFACTUALLY tested before adoption (does representing the distinction improve predictions under relevant alternative actions and contexts?), and consequential revisions preferentially complete in a decoupled/sleep phase whose job includes RE-INDEXING episodic traces so autobiographical addressability survives the representational change -- sleep as safe maintenance of the representational coordinate system itself. E3 must not become E1's teacher: downstream selection changes the learning conditions and evidence pressure on E1, never its truth content directly (non-oracular).

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: GOV-V4CUT-1 F3 (GFLAG-0103): register MECH-530, partial split off MECH-529
claim_rows.title: E3's decision-outcome signals to any downstream consumer (including a future rebucketing mechanism such as MECH-529) are typed, continuous insufficiency measures -- prediction/consequence mismatch, harm/goal cost, veto/conflict magnitude and count, commit/threshold state -- never semantic category labels. This is an interface contract on E3's EXISTING output surface (SelectionResult, harm_eval/benefit_eval, last_score_diagnostics), holding independently of whether a rebucketing consumer is ever built: E3 already emits only continuous/boolean/count-typed diagnostics keyed by descriptive strings, and preserving that property is what MECH-529's non-oracularity requirement needs to continue holding as more downstream consumers are added.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: GOV-V4CUT-1 F1/F2 (GFLAG-0101/GFLAG-0102): register MECH-531, MECH-532 -- user-approved split registrations
claim_rows.title: A merge/split operator over the existing EntityObservation boundary must exist and be corrigible by consequence evidence, at FIXED capacity -- no dynamic per-population regulation, no settling competition. This is the minimal P0 substrate floor ARC-134 and MECH-529 both name as currently absent: `ree_core/entities/object_file_buffer.py` has no merge or split of tokens anywhere, and matching is strict 1:1 greedy over a caller-built List[EntityObservation]. Distinguished from MECH-521/MECH-522: this claim asserts only that a corrigible operator exists and responds to consequence-divergence evidence (MECH-126's overmerge/oversplit taxonomy), not that occupancy is an emergent order parameter of a settling competition, and not that capacity itself is dynamically regulated -- those remain MECH-521/522's richer, explicitly v4/v5-deferred claims.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: GOV-V4CUT-1 F1/F2 (GFLAG-0101/GFLAG-0102): register MECH-531, MECH-532 -- user-approved split registrations
claim_rows.title: At least one of REE's designated compression sites (MECH-523) must be paired with an explicit TRAINED decompression/readout stage before representational-ceiling nulls measured there are interpretable as capacity findings -- this is the v3-testable core of MECH-507's reciprocal compression/decompression bridge, independent of the full E1 reframing MECH-507 itself remains scoped to. Two site-specific halves of this pattern already exist as registered but unvalidated/unbuilt v3 work: SD-056 (E2.world_forward trained via a contrastive divergence-preservation loss, coded 2026-05-29 in ree_core/predictors/e2_fast.py, default OFF, never re-queued for validation) supplies the decompression half at the z_world site, paired with SD-070's anti-collapse encoder-training recipe for the compression half at the same site. Separately, the P4 training-debt cluster at E2.action_object_head/O -- SD-080's zero-gradient finding, MECH-518's dual-role variance contention, MECH-517's interface-collapse ordering -- names the same repair owed at a second, independent compression site. This claim asserts the general requirement and is satisfied by confirming it at either site.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: sleep_as_deferred_reorganisation_and_behavioural_access_repair -> ARC-137 (typed offline-transformation taxonomy: retention/reorganisation/recalibration/access-repair, each with write target, provenance class, distal readout), MECH-533 (developmental co-maturation of offline frequency and offline competence); shared MECH-094 question merged into Q-102; measurement doctrine subsection inserted into sleep_substrate_plan.md (names V3-EXQ-994's link-2/3 failure)
claim_rows.title: Offline integration is a protected family of TYPED transformations, not a unitary replay update: retention/interference repair, representational reorganisation, recalibration/attribution repair, and behavioural-access repair are distinct offline OUTCOMES (a partition by what changed, not by which phase ran), and each requires its own declared WRITE TARGET, its own PROVENANCE CLASS for the content it may consume, and its own DISTAL WAKING READOUT. Replay is a transport and sampling operation shared by all four, never a sufficient description of the transformation any of them performs. Consequently a readout appropriate to one operation is not evidence about another: retention is shown by preserved or recovered competence after interference on old and transfer cases; reorganisation by changed relational transfer, equivalence-class behaviour, generalisation or state construction WITH trace/index continuity; recalibration by improved calibration or causal attribution under held-out outcomes, never by narrower uncertainty alone (a sharper but wrong posterior is a failure, and reduced ambivalence from attractor collapse or gate lockout must be separated from reduced ambivalence from evidence integration); and access repair by restored endogenous recruitment, fresh commitment, executed behaviour and ecological consequence while upstream content is held fixed.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: registered_utc field
claim_rows.title: Bridge-organism preservation: when a version-boundary substrate expansion bundles more than one boundary capacity together, checkpoint and retain intermediate 'bridge' organism states -- each adding one boundary capacity, or one coherent capacity cluster, on top of the prior generation -- as first-class comparison artefacts, not merely as engineering scaffolding discarded once the full expansion lands. Bridge organisms need not become public release numbers; their purpose is causal isolation, so that a downstream behavioural or substrate phenotype observed after a multi-capacity transition can still be attributed to the specific capacity that produced it, the way a knock-in or mutant strain isolates one genetic change in model-organism research.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: registered_utc field
claim_rows.title: Lowest-capacity preparation rule: for a given scientific question, prefer running the experiment on the lowest-capacity retained organism preparation (a canonical reference organism, a bridge organism, or a full version generation) that still contains the phenomenon the question requires, over a higher-capacity preparation that would also work. This is a precautionary Replacement-specific refinement of SENT-2's replacement/reduction/refinement welfare budget, applied to the choice of WHICH organism preparation to instantiate for an experiment rather than only to caps on within-experiment negative-valence exposure -- motivated by higher capacities (social attribution, language) introducing compound explanatory confounds (reputation, imitation, reciprocity, strategic impression management, rationalisation, cultural inheritance) alongside their added behavioural capability, which can make the causal origin of an observed phenomenon harder to identify even as the organism becomes easier to interrogate.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: registered_utc field
claim_rows.title: Claim rotation (epistemic representation layer, not a second evidence ledger): REE's claim system may hold multiple explicit representations of one canonical claim -- architectural, transformation, behavioural, developmental, biological-analogue -- each exposing a different diagnostic question / observable / intervention point, while the canonical claim retains a SINGLE evidence and promotion state across all of them (multiple views, ONE truth state); when translating a claim into an alternative view exposes empirical content the original wording did not entail, that content becomes a NEW claim with its own evidence record and must NEVER inherit the parent claim's evidence.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: sleep_as_deferred_reorganisation_and_behavioural_access_repair -> ARC-137 (typed offline-transformation taxonomy: retention/reorganisation/recalibration/access-repair, each with write target, provenance class, distal readout), MECH-533 (developmental co-maturation of offline frequency and offline competence); shared MECH-094 question merged into Q-102; measurement doctrine subsection inserted into sleep_substrate_plan.md (names V3-EXQ-994's link-2/3 failure)
claim_rows.title: Developmental co-maturation of offline scheduling and offline competence: the benefit of frequent early offline phases is CONDITIONAL on the maturity of the offline machinery itself, so offline FREQUENCY and offline COMPETENCE develop together and cannot be substituted for one another. Early agents may need frequent protected windows precisely because traces are fragile and representations change rapidly, while their replay selection, sequence fidelity, cross-episode aggregation, and re-indexing competence are still immature -- so adding sleep cycles to an agent whose replay content, sequencing, or write-address discrimination is degenerate produces cycles without transformation. A developmental test must therefore CROSS frequency with competence and hold apart at least seven things that are routinely conflated: sleep-cycle frequency; amount and diversity of waking content; replay coverage and sequence fidelity; ContextMemory content discrimination; transformation competence; behavioural access after waking; and a stage-appropriate ecology in which the result can be expressed. Firing many empty or degenerate cycles is not developmental consolidation, and longer observation under no_grad() is not development if no relevant learning update occurs.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: versioned_organisms_capacity_boundaries_and_retained_lineages -> GOV-BRIDGE-1, GOV-LOWPREP-1, Q-101 (bridge-organism preservation; lowest-capacity preparation rule; ontogenetic-vs-architectural ancestry open question)
claim_rows.title: Does a later-capable REE architecture's eventual social- and language-mind outcomes depend on which solitary (V3-like) and enduring-individual (V4-like) developmental regime it actually passed through before other minds became cognitively meaningful -- i.e. does ONTOGENETIC ancestry (the developmental regime actually lived through) shape later social-mind development independent of ARCHITECTURAL ancestry (which mechanisms were inherited into the larger architecture) -- such that retained lower-version developmental regimes would become machinery required to build later organisms coherently, rather than merely historical artefacts kept for comparison?

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: decision_useful_counterfactual_world_models_under_uncertainty -> Q-102 (imagined-trajectory behavioural-access repair under MECH-094 provenance; registered once for this and the sleep thought); notes-only cross-refs on SD-056 (CQM precedent, lever D, teacher-forcing route, absolute-channel caveat), MECH-510, ARC-002, MECH-033, ARC-130/131; IMPL-022 field addition NOT applied (chipped)
claim_rows.title: Can REE use internally generated (imagined, replayed, or model-generated) trajectories to preserve or repair BEHAVIOURAL ACCESS -- the route by which retained predictive or procedural knowledge again reaches proposal, competitive authority, selection, fresh commitment and execution -- by updating retrieval, readout, ranking or eligibility mappings, while those trajectories remain categorically barred from acquiring the autobiographical, residue-write, realized-reward, reinforcement and direct-authority status of experienced events; and if so, what is the safe update target and what provenance rules make the separation machine-checkable rather than conventional?

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: 2026-09-04 batch (13 raw thoughts, 3 intakes) -> ARC-138 (regulation-first representational organisation), INV-104 (organism-relevant distinction preservation across compression), GOV-MATCHAUX-1 (matched-auxiliary-control + scaffold-removal admissibility rule), MECH-534 (L-space authority field as dynamic causal geometry), Q-103 (routing-only vs representational field); 2 architecture stubs; sweep regen
claim_rows.title: Regulation-first representational organisation: the developmental ordering is machine -> regulation -> interaction -> organised experience -> knowledge -- a mature, detached, portable world model is a developmental ACHIEVEMENT reached only through interaction that the organism's own enduring regulatory constraints (continued existence, structural integrity, internal-state regulation, vulnerability, ability to effect change, control, attachment, causal uncertainty) generate and select, so the earliest useful organising axes of z_world are relations between external regularities and those constraints (what changes me / what I can change / what predicts harm or benefit / what is controllable / what persists / what belongs together); non-redundant prediction: agents with matched sensory statistics but different vulnerabilities or affordances develop systematically different latent organisations of the same environment, and if objective scene structure suffices they do not.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: registered_utc field
claim_rows.title: Claim-graph edge types are split: `depends_on` is a DIRECTED prerequisite edge (build order / evidential support) and MUST be acyclic; `coupled_with` is an UNDIRECTED reciprocal-coupling edge (co-defining architecture, mutual explanation) and is never a prerequisite. A cycle in depends_on is a registry defect -- it means one edge on the cycle is coupling mislabelled as prerequisite -- and is an ERROR in validate_claims.py, not a tolerated feature of a 'conceptual dependency web'.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: registered_utc field
claim_rows.title: Matched-auxiliary-control and scaffold-removal admissibility rule: a result is admissible as evidence that a representation objective (auxiliary head, anchoring target, contrastive shaping, any added loss) ORGANISES a latent in a specific way -- rather than that extra supervision helps -- only if obtained against BOTH (1) a matched arbitrary-auxiliary control (same head capacity, loss budget, update frequency and training examples; target with learnable but organism-irrelevant structure; any entropy/difficulty mismatch REPORTED, never silently accepted) and (2) an evaluation with the auxiliary head removed, scored on downstream organism-level measures (rollout at consequential transitions, behavioural competence, transfer when consequences change but sensory statistics do not, counterfactual separability, perturbation recovery), never on the objective's own probe accuracy or loss; in its offline-mechanism form, a durable sleep/replay/compression mechanism is adopted only on held-out causal attribution, intervention choice, transfer or calibration, never on training loss or replay reconstruction.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: 2026-09-04 batch (13 raw thoughts, 3 intakes) -> ARC-138 (regulation-first representational organisation), INV-104 (organism-relevant distinction preservation across compression), GOV-MATCHAUX-1 (matched-auxiliary-control + scaffold-removal admissibility rule), MECH-534 (L-space authority field as dynamic causal geometry), Q-103 (routing-only vs representational field); 2 architecture stubs; sweep regen
claim_rows.title: Organism-relevant distinction preservation across representational compression: any compression, abstraction or consolidation step on the observation -> z_world -> E1/E2 path (and any offline schema-compression of episodes) must preserve, or leave recoverable through its dynamics, five classes of distinction consequential to the organism across time -- (1) consequence and opportunity/threat, (2) controllability and agency incl. internal-state consequence invisible in the scene, (3) persistence and temporal relation, (4) causal ancestry / intervention handles (agent identity, action class, preconditions, uncertainty over causal contribution), (5) independently evolving trajectories -- as PRESERVATION REQUIREMENTS, not latent dimensions; a step that destroys downstream access to one of them is a developmental regression regardless of reconstruction or prediction loss; auxiliary heads enforcing a class are removable SCAFFOLDS and the ontology within a class must remain free to split, merge and reweight over development.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: 2026-09-04 batch (13 raw thoughts, 3 intakes) -> ARC-138 (regulation-first representational organisation), INV-104 (organism-relevant distinction preservation across compression), GOV-MATCHAUX-1 (matched-auxiliary-control + scaffold-removal admissibility rule), MECH-534 (L-space authority field as dynamic causal geometry), Q-103 (routing-only vs representational field); 2 architecture stubs; sweep regen
claim_rows.title: Authority field: the moment-to-moment functional conformation of L-space -- the effective directed distance / permeability / gain between representational regions, its asymmetry, persistence and decay, the compatibility of simultaneously active routes, and a local coalition's capacity to recruit wider participation -- is a STATE VARIABLE in its own right: continuous, graded, state-dependent, endogenously recruited from the organism's own prediction error, goal progress, residue and learned relevance, with its own competition and dynamics, and not identical to stored content, to the slow regulatory/neuromodulatory field, or to the final policy; falsifiable consequence: two runs with materially similar content state but different field state differ systematically in retrieval, commitment and distractor recovery, and an equally-parameterised static scalar or global gate cannot reproduce the same context-sensitive behaviour across matched tasks and seeds.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: 2026-09-04 batch (13 raw thoughts, 3 intakes) -> ARC-138 (regulation-first representational organisation), INV-104 (organism-relevant distinction preservation across compression), GOV-MATCHAUX-1 (matched-auxiliary-control + scaffold-removal admissibility rule), MECH-534 (L-space authority field as dynamic causal geometry), Q-103 (routing-only vs representational field); 2 architecture stubs; sweep regen
claim_rows.title: Routing-only or representational field: does the trajectory of L-space's coupling/authority state (MECH-534) itself carry task-relevant relational structure -- spatial relations, sequence, recent history -- beyond the instantaneous content state it gates, or does it only set eligibility, gain and topology over content stored elsewhere, or both? Pre-registered discriminator: on the SAME stored representations, controlled for parameter count and training exposure, an instantaneous decoder over r(t) versus a trajectory decoder over r(t-k:t) plus the authority variables; the representational branch is supported only if the trajectory decoder predicts current global structure, the appropriate retrieved path, or the next committed action better.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: SD-104 + SD-105: register the two phasic/headroom regulator claims; narrow + advance the substrate entry
claim_rows.title: Phasic burst refractory duty bound: the SD-069 phasic_surprise_burst envelope must be given a REFRACTORY (event firing suppressed for N waking ticks after an event, while the envelope keeps decaying -- carry-mode decay) and an EXTINCTION LEVEL (a decayed envelope snaps to exactly 0.0), so that "the burst is active" is a regulator-side predicate rather than a floor each consumer picks for itself, and so that the realised burst duty cycle is bounded BY CONSTRUCTION -- A = 1 + floor(ln(extinction_level) / ln(1 - decay)); duty <= min(1, A / (refractory_ticks + 1)) -- rather than being a function of the surprise stream. Without this the burst is re-armed by max(decayed, drive) before it can decay on a warmed agent, and the MECH-063 (ii) tonic/phasic dissociation has no separable transient to measure.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: SD-104 + SD-105: register the two phasic/headroom regulator claims; narrow + advance the substrate entry
claim_rows.title: Selection-entropy headroom floor: a TONIC behavioural-variability set-point on the E3 selection softmax temperature -- a one-sided integral controller in log-temperature that raises the effective tonic temperature only as far as needed to hold realised normalized selection entropy at a floor, never lowering it below the uncoalitioned value. Where MECH-313 noise_floor adds a state-INDEPENDENT constant lift, this is the state-dependent form that survives a warmup which has made the policy confident. Without it, the SD-074 warmup drives baseline selection entropy to 0.0195-0.153 (against 0.152-0.610 on a colder agent), pinning the R5 headroom gate at its 0.02 floor and leaving a SHARPENING manipulation ~2% of the readout's range to move into, so any null is uninterpretable.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: direction_blind_reactive_ambitendency -> MECH-535, MECH-536
claim_rows.title: Direction-blind reactive ambitendency (catatonia route III): a memoryless reactive actor reading a state representation that carries goal PROXIMITY MAGNITUDE but not goal DIRECTION produces, from one frozen policy and selected only by initial condition, either a two-cell approach/withdraw limit cycle (ambitendency: one step toward the goal, one step away, repeated) or a boundary-press fixed point (stupor); the catatonic phenotype therefore has a REPRESENTATIONAL generative route that requires no commitment gate to malfunction and no harm-stream lock, distinct from MECH-202B (gate frozen at maximum threshold) and SD-036 subtype II (harm-stream lock-in upstream of an intact gate).

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: direction_blind_reactive_ambitendency -> MECH-535, MECH-536
claim_rows.title: Basal-ganglia-like action persistence (a post-commit latch / commitment hysteresis) is PROTECTIVE against representational degradation rather than NECESSARY for competence: with an adequate directional representation a memoryless greedy actor forages competently with no latch at all (V3-EXQ-978 local_view_greedy anchor, 45.75 res/ep), whereas with a direction-blind representation (MECH-535) a latch abolishes the ambitendency limit cycle but yields perseveration (straight runs into the boundary) with no rise in competence. Predicted dissociating signature: adding k>=2-step action persistence to the direction-blind actor removes the two-cell cycle AND leaves resources/episode flat; a competence rise under the latch would instead indicate a gating deficit.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: mutual-legibility trio (2026-09-07) -> ARC-139, MECH-537/538/539/540, INV-105
claim_rows.title: Integration does not require representational sameness, it requires selective mutual legibility: specialised cognitive subsystems may preserve distinct high-dimensional PRIVATE internal representations while coordinating through low-dimensional, context-sensitive communication subspaces and low-complexity transformations, so development can raise local specialisation and cross-system legibility AT THE SAME TIME rather than trading one against the other. Non-redundant prediction: a maturing REE shows rising local competence in E1/E2/hippocampus/E3 while GLOBAL representational similarity between them stays flat or falls, and increasing representational similarity between subsystems must therefore NOT be used as the default marker of maturation. This is an explicit ALTERNATIVE framing to ARC-121's shared epistemic-state object, not a refutation of it: one common object, specialised objects with a shared interface format, specialised objects joined by context-specific translation, and a hybrid invariant-core-plus-private-dimensions architecture all remain live, and ARC-121 must not be used to prejudge the question.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: recovery-without-restoration (2026-09-06) -> ARC-140, MECH-541
claim_rows.title: Compensatory realizability -- recovery without restoration: an adaptive organism should not be REQUIRED to recover by reconstructing its former internal state; the target property is the capacity to preserve or recover a useful function by REORGANIZING CAUSAL RESPONSIBILITY across internal processes rather than returning to one canonical implementation. Operational criterion: after perturbation, recovered behaviour must be accompanied by a demonstrably ALTERED DISTRIBUTION OF CAUSAL IMPORTANCE, not a hidden reconstruction of the original pathway -- evidenced by the original route remaining observably impaired, a different internal process becoming NECESSARY (selective re-ablation removes the recovered competence), and later restoration of the original route producing competition/redundancy/reorganisation rather than revealing it had silently returned. Requires a four-arm design -- no-intervention, restorative-normalization analogue, compensatory-amplification analogue (lesion left in place, the recruited substitute selectively strengthened), and a CONTROL-AMPLIFICATION arm strengthening a comparably sized non-compensatory process -- because without the fourth arm 'generic added capacity' is an unexcluded explanation of any recovery.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: culture-as-distributed-precommit (2026-09-07) -> ARC-141, MECH-542/543/544
claim_rows.title: Culture as a distributed precommit workspace: culture functions partly as a shared precommit space in which many minds collectively generate, exchange, mutate and evaluate candidate beliefs, identities, norms and futures BEFORE those representations acquire full epistemic or behavioural commitment -- candidate trajectories need not originate within the individual organism, because another mind can construct a trajectory and transmit enough of its structure for a receiving predictive system to instantiate it. Fiction, drama, humour and science fiction are on this account not peripheral products of cognition but specialised cultural technologies for making otherwise costly regions of possibility space cognitively traversable, and the driver is that SEARCH IS MUCH CHEAPER THAN COMMITMENT. Proposed (explicitly non-universal, non-monotonic) cultural progression: unrepresentable -> representable only under protection -> hypothetically discussable -> socially negotiable -> propositionally credible -> behaviourally actionable -> committed. Science fiction is the clearest instance: externally generated long-horizon candidate trajectories reach E1/E3-like evaluation before the corresponding state has ever been directly sampled.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: deriving_the_cognitive_contract -> ARC-142, GOV-CONTRACT-1, MECH-545, MECH-546, Q-104
claim_rows.title: The cognitive contract: a unified mind built from heterogeneous engines (E1 / E2 / E3 / hippocampus and later specialists, differing in representational geometry, temporal scale, compression level, learning dynamics and uncertainty representation) requires not a common latent space but an INVARIANT-PRESERVING CONTRACT -- a small set of relations I such that for any lossy translation x_A -> C_A(x_A) -> T_AB -> D_B -> x'_B, I(x_A) ~ I(x'_B), even though x'_B = x_A is meaningless across different spaces. The contract is relational / semantic, not representational: each engine may encode an invariant differently (explicit scalar, trajectory position, recurrent-state relation, geometric direction, ordering relation) so long as the relation is recoverable at the boundary when needed. It sits ABOVE the translation machinery and ABOVE schemas (cognitive contract -> representation / translation machinery -> schemas -> particular concepts, memories and environmental models): a schema rewrite, including offline reorganisation during sleep, changes WHAT the organism knows; contract failure changes WHETHER its subsystems can still understand one another. The contract specifies RECOVERABLE RELATIONSHIPS, never a fixed data structure or ontology -- engines encode invariants differently, new representational systems can be added, schemas reorganise, and contract dimensions may be added or retired. Its two failure poles are representation collapse (one canonical latent forced on every engine, destroying the specialisation that makes multiple engines useful) and cognitive fragmentation (engines keep exchanging tensors while progressively losing shared meaning -- computationally active, no longer one mind). Unity does not require representational sameness; it requires preservation of the relations that keep representations about the same cognitive world.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: registered_utc field
