claim_rows.title: Cognitive-contract invariant admissibility rule: a candidate contract invariant (ARC-142) acquires ARCHITECTURAL standing only by consilience -- independent support from at least two of six evidence domains: (1) cross-linguistic typology (recurrent, obligatorily encoded across unrelated languages), (2) pre-linguistic developmental cognition (present before language or explicit instruction), (3) neuroscience (modality- or subsystem-independent representation, or a known translation mechanism that retains it), (4) comparative cognition (present in species with different sensory / behavioural ecologies), (5) independently trained artificial agents (discovered without being specified; removal produces characteristic failure), and (6) REE-internal necessity (an engine boundary that cannot learn or translate around it). Every candidate must be CLASSIFIED architectural / embodied-ecological / human-linguistic-convention / uncertain, with the alternative explanation (embodiment, culture, task structure) recorded. Cross-linguistic universality ALONE is inadmissible as architectural evidence: shared bodies, sensory systems, ecology and phylogeny explain human universals without cognitive universality. Developmental precedence -- required before substantial learning can occur -- is the strongest single-domain signal. A negative finding (an apparently fundamental invariant shown unnecessary, or translatable-around) is a first-class preserved result, not a discard. The contract must be DERIVED INDEPENDENTLY of REE_assembly's own claims / evidence / provenance / dependency invariant machinery (docs/architecture/invariant_types.md, claim_evidence) -- deriving it from that machinery is circular -- and any structural convergence between the two is logged as an empirical clue under GOV-ANALOGY-1, never assumed. Each candidate carries a twelve-field evidence record (candidate, definition, linguistic, developmental, neural, comparative, artificial-agent, REE evidence, lesion prediction, alternative explanation, classification, confidence); the objective is the smallest defensible set, never the longest list.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: registered_utc field
claim_rows.title: Predictive-equivalence envelope for claim rotation (the checksum GOV-ROTATE-1 lacks): two representations of one canonical claim count as the SAME claim -- and may share one truth state -- only while the experimentally relevant predictions they license remain compatible over an EXPLICITLY DECLARED domain of contexts, interventions, observables, scales and auxiliary assumptions (the equivalence envelope); equivalence is earned by surviving discriminating interventions, never assumed from the wording reading as a paraphrase, and when a discriminating intervention reveals divergence the divergence MUST be classified (scope condition / hidden auxiliary assumption / underspecified parent claim / invalid rotation / genuinely new proposition) BEFORE any evidence is allowed to transfer between the two representations.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: registered_utc field
claim_rows.title: Predictive sharpening is not a new claim (the over-splitting guard that pairs with GOV-ROTATE-1's smuggling guard): a rotated representation that makes a SHARPER prediction than the canonical claim -- a sign rather than a magnitude, a causal ordering, a conditional dependence, a timescale, a locus, a developmental window, a falsifiable inequality -- remains an inferential refinement of the SAME claim, sharing its truth state, when the sharper prediction follows from the canonical claim plus already-accepted background assumptions (C + B); it becomes a DISTINCT claim (C AND A), which must be split and must NOT inherit C's evidence, exactly when the sharper prediction requires a NEW empirical assumption A introduced during the rotation. The test is which auxiliary assumptions are needed to make the predictions agree, not how different the sentences sound or how much more precise the new one is.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: mutual-legibility trio (2026-09-07) -> ARC-139, MECH-537/538/539/540, INV-105
claim_rows.title: The latent-access evidence ladder: a variable's status in a latent space is not one property but seven, which must never be collapsed -- encoded (statistically present) != decodable (recoverable by an external probe) != natively accessible (usable by the system's existing consumer) != bridgeable (usable through a constrained map between frozen endpoints) != pairing-specific (useful specifically when the correct sender state is paired with the correct receiver situation) != causally used (interventions on its content alter downstream computation) != behaviourally beneficial (that causal use improves adaptive performance). Two evidential consequences bind rather than advise: (1) a content-transmission claim about any internal channel or bridge REQUIRES correct-vs-mismatched-vs-zero-vs-moment-matched-random controls, because a channel can be strongly load-bearing while its example-specific content is barely load-bearing; (2) a null measured on a COMPRESSED representation requires a dimensionality-matched RANDOM-PROJECTION floor, not a zero floor, before it can be read as information loss.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: mutual-legibility trio (2026-09-07) -> ARC-139, MECH-537/538/539/540, INV-105
claim_rows.title: Communication-subspace routing failure -- encoded but not exposed: a task variable can be strongly encoded in the FULL sender latent while being weakly represented in the CONSUMER-FACING subspace, producing the phenotype `external probe succeeds -> native behaviour fails` with no information having been destroyed. This is a third failure category strictly between 'information absent from the sender' and 'information used by the receiver', and it is distinct from MECH-517 (the decoder collapses) and MECH-532 (the compression site has no trained decompression stage): routing failure requires neither a collapse nor a missing readout, because the consumer can be reading a perfectly healthy low-rank subspace that simply does not carry the distinction. Operationalised by cross-validated Reduced Rank Regression from sender activity to the ACTUAL consumer input tensor, comparing task decodability in the full sender, inside the estimated communication subspace, and in its orthogonal complement; the diagnostic signature is `target decodable from X` but `poorly decodable from P_comm X`.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: mutual-legibility trio (2026-09-07) -> ARC-139, MECH-537/538/539/540, INV-105
claim_rows.title: Minimum bridge complexity as the measure of mutual legibility: for systems A and B and a family of constrained mappings of increasing expressiveness (native readout -> orthogonal/Procrustes -> affine -> low-rank affine -> constrained nonlinear -> high-capacity upper bound), define L(A -> B) = the minimum bridge complexity achieving a predeclared HELD-OUT functional criterion between FROZEN endpoints; lower L means greater mutual legibility, and the simpler the bridge that works the stronger the evidence that the sender already held an appropriately structured representation -- a high-capacity bridge that succeeds may be performing new cognition and is therefore evidence about the bridge, not about the endpoints. L must never be read alone: two systems that became identical because one LOST its specialisation would show falling L with worsening cognition, so development is tracked on two axes (local specialisation/competence, and cross-system legibility). Non-redundant developmental prediction: sender and receiver each improve local competence WHILE global representational similarity stays flat or falls, task information concentrates in the consumer-facing subspace, and minimum bridge rank falls -- coordination without homogenisation.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: mutual-legibility trio (2026-09-07) -> ARC-139, MECH-537/538/539/540, INV-105
claim_rows.title: Dynamic interface compatibility: between PREDICTIVE systems, pointwise state correspondence across an interface is insufficient -- a mapping must additionally satisfy that receiver_transition(T(x_t), a_t) is compatible with T(x_(t+1)) under the relevant action/context, because a bridge can succeed pointwise while destroying transition geometry. The registered diagnostic separation is: map ONLY the initial state and let the receiver evolve natively, versus repeatedly mapping sender rollout states -- this distinguishes a bridge that supplies a compatible starting condition from one that must continually correct incompatible dynamics. Failure signature `good static + bad dynamic` routes to transition-geometry work rather than to representation work; `good one-step + degrading long-horizon` indicates compounding dynamics mismatch; `good dynamic but poor behaviour` routes downstream to valuation/selection.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: mutual-legibility trio (2026-09-07) -> ARC-139, MECH-537/538/539/540, INV-105
claim_rows.title: Sleep as selective interface maintenance -- the third offline job: MECH-529 gives offline consolidation two functions, revising the representation (split/merge/reweight over equivalence classes) and re-indexing episodic traces so autobiographical addressability survives that revision. This claim adds a THIRD: adjusting or stabilising the INTERFACE -- the subspace through which another subsystem reads the revised representation. The prediction is explicitly NOT global alignment but a PLASTICITY/STABILITY DIVISION OF LABOUR across interfaces: some reconfigure because recent learning demands it, others remain stable because downstream continuity matters more, so the strongest test compares at least TWO interfaces with different predicted plasticity rather than asking whether all systems become more similar after sleep. Four distinguishable post-sleep signatures: S1 representational retuning (interface metrics move only because the sender moved), S2 interface recalibration (local competence stable, communication subspace or bridge complexity improves), S3 stable scaffold (representations move, mapping holds), S4 maladaptive homogenisation (similarity rises while local competence or task-specific differentiation worsens).

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: recovery-without-restoration (2026-09-06) -> ARC-140, MECH-541
claim_rows.title: Maladaptive over-stabilized compensation as a distinct pathology mechanism: pathology may arise not only because an original mechanism is damaged, but because an ADAPTATION TO that damage becomes over-stabilized -- a workaround that was initially adaptive becomes over-strengthened, over-generalized or too persistent, trapping the organism in a distorted solution after the original problem has changed or resolved. Predicted routes: the compensatory pathway acquires excessive precision or gain, dominates ambiguous perception, becomes resistant to counterfactual correction, persists after the initiating lesion resolves, recruits memory and sleep processes that progressively stabilise the workaround, or reduces flexibility by making one emergency solution the default policy. REGISTERED DETECTION SIGNATURE: improved LOCAL performance accompanied by POORER generalization, flexibility, calibration or counterfactual revision -- a compensation that improves everything is not this failure mode. Diagnostic is hysteresis: the compensatory solution persisting even after the original route is restored.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: culture-as-distributed-precommit (2026-09-07) -> ARC-141, MECH-542/543/544
claim_rows.title: Source-sensitive selective permeability -- INV-011 decomposed: `imagination without belief update` must NOT be implemented as `hypothetical -> learning OFF`, because 'belief update' is too unitary a category applied literally across every representational layer. A hypothetical/fictional source should PROTECT one set of variables -- autobiographical occurrence (this happened to me), historical occurrence (this event actually occurred), source truth (the narrator's proposition describes reality), responsibility attribution (I performed this action), and responsibility-bearing residue -- while PERMITTING update of another: possibility estimates, causal expectations, representations of other agents and their possible motivations, policy repertoire, harm/benefit expectations, social contingencies, counterfactual vocabulary, and the range of trajectories available for later simulation. Three otherwise-conflated properties must be free to dissociate: REPRESENTABILITY (can this state enter the generative system at all), EPISTEMIC COMMITMENT (does the system treat it as describing the actual world), and BEHAVIOURAL COMMITMENT (has an action been selected and owned on its basis). REGISTERED FALSIFIER -- the prediction is explicitly NOT 'fiction causes no update' but 'epistemic framing determines WHICH components are authorised to update': inject semantically identical event content under different source frames (direct observation / testimony / fiction / counterfactual / prediction / joke / memory / committed experience) and measure DIFFERENTIAL change across world-state belief, source confidence, E1 expectations, E2 predictions, other-agent models, harm-benefit expectations, policy availability, hippocampal trajectory repertoire, E3 evaluation, precision allocation, residue and subsequent behaviour. WRONG IN BOTH DIRECTIONS: if REE learns equally from fiction and observation across EVERY component the architecture is wrong, and if REE learns NOTHING transferable from fiction or counterfactual trajectories it is also wrong.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: culture-as-distributed-precommit (2026-09-07) -> ARC-141, MECH-542/543/544
claim_rows.title: Drama runs OWN generative machinery under another agent's boundary conditions, where fiction only simulates another's trajectory: reading about an agent primarily requires modelling its trajectory, whereas ENACTING a role may temporarily recruit parts of one's own action and social machinery under the constraints of another identity or situation. Non-redundant prediction: enacted role-play should produce partially overlapping but DISTINGUISHABLE update fingerprints from semantically equivalent descriptive narrative -- specifically on other-model formation, policy availability, and affective prediction -- and role enactment should therefore be a more powerful route to exploring what another person could experience, without permanently confusing self and other.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: culture-as-distributed-precommit (2026-09-07) -> ARC-141, MECH-542/543/544
claim_rows.title: Permeability pathology and source-fidelity loss: the same selective permeability that enables cultural learning (MECH-542) necessarily creates its failure modes, and this is NOT an accidental weakness but plausibly the unavoidable price of a system that can learn from counterfactual experience -- a fully impermeable hypothetical system learns nothing from imagination, a fully permeable one cannot distinguish imagination from reality, and the useful system lies between. Predicted routes: repeated fictional trajectories distorting perceived likelihood; emotionally powerful narratives acquiring inappropriate precision; propaganda altering other-agent models without adequate evidence; humour gradually reducing the effective cost of previously prohibited representations; imagined threats modifying expectations of groups never directly encountered; cultural availability mistaken for environmental frequency. REGISTERED SIGNATURE -- SOURCE-FIDELITY LOSS: source information becomes less reliable while narrative structure is retained, producing characteristic errors in which retained narrative becomes progressively harder to distinguish from experienced or testified information; the underlying mechanism (stored-tag decay vs reconstructed-at-retrieval misattribution, per Johnson, Hashtroudi and Lindsay 1993) is left open pending the D6 discriminating test. The architectural requirement is therefore NOT to prevent hypothetical material from influencing cognition, but to keep the KIND and MAGNITUDE of update appropriate to the epistemic status of the representation.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: deriving_the_cognitive_contract -> ARC-142, GOV-CONTRACT-1, MECH-545, MECH-546, Q-104
claim_rows.title: Contract-lesion assays: the decisive test of a candidate cognitive-contract invariant (ARC-142) is not its presence in successful cognition but a BOUNDARY LESION -- a translation between two engines that preserves content but deletes one relation -- producing a predicted, invariant-specific fragmentation signature. Five pre-registered signatures: IDENTITY lesion (two representations cannot determine whether they concern the same entity) -> broken persistence, duplicated selves / objects, incoherent credit assignment, unstable memory integration; TEMPORAL lesion (content without temporal relation) -> cause / effect inversion, present-state vs anticipated-state confusion, confused planning, memory / prediction contamination; REALITY-STATUS lesion (observed, remembered, simulated and counterfactual states indistinct across the boundary) -> confabulation-like behaviour, false commitment to imagined states, impaired counterfactual learning, psychosis-like representational error; AGENCY lesion (events representable, controllability and actor relation lost) -> poor action learning, internal / external attribution errors, impaired responsibility assignment, failure of intentional planning; CONFIDENCE lesion (content translates, uncertainty does not) -> overcommitment, under-reaction to reliable predictions, inappropriate belief updating, failure of precision-sensitive integration. Predictions: each lesion applied at ONE inter-engine boundary yields a signature distinct from the other four and from generic information loss (scored against a dimensionality-matched random-projection floor, INV-105), and an invariant whose boundary lesion produces NO reproducible deficit is struck from the contract, with the negative result preserved (GOV-CONTRACT-1).

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: deriving_the_cognitive_contract -> ARC-142, GOV-CONTRACT-1, MECH-545, MECH-546, Q-104
claim_rows.title: Grammar inherits the cognitive contract: some grammar-like relational structure -- agency / role marking, tense and aspect, modality and evidentiality, negation, reference and number, causation and conditionals -- emerges in a communication channel because external transmission between minds inherits the same relations that internal translation between engines must already preserve (ARC-142). Chain: cognitive invariants -> internal representational contracts -> repeated compression / translation pressure -> proto-grammatical relational structure -> external language. Two-directional test: (a) invariants derived from cognition or REE-internal necessity should be over-represented among recurrently grammaticalised distinctions; (b) recurrently grammaticalised distinctions lacking developmental, comparative or computational support should classify as embodied or cultural, not contract. Prediction: agents required to transmit invariant-rich cognitive states efficiently over a low-cost channel develop grammar-like structure for exactly the contract relations and not for schema content; agreement across (a) and (b) is the evidence, either direction alone is not.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: receiver_conditioned_translation_and_recurrent_interface_stability -> MECH-547, MECH-548
claim_rows.title: Receiver-conditioned translation: what a sender should expose to a consumer is a function of the receiver's current state, not of the sender alone -- translated content = T(sender state, receiver state, receiver position / context) -- so the communication subspace (MECH-537) is CONTEXT-INDEXED rather than one globally fixed cross-system alignment. The sender may support several potential read surfaces, and which one is active may depend on receiver mode, current goal or task-loop context, uncertainty, the action or candidate under evaluation, retrieved episodic context, temporal phase and the receiver's current predicted state. CONSTRAINT that keeps this from becoming a hidden cognitive module: receiver-conditioning determines WHICH PART of already-present sender information is exposed and HOW it is expressed; it must not let the bridge solve the task independently. Confirming signature: T(A,B) > T(A) on held-out data at MATCHED capacity AND receiver-state permutation destroys the gain; if permutation barely matters, the gain is extra capacity, not conditioning, and the result is evidence about the bridge (MECH-538). Candidate REE loci: z_world -> E1 versus z_world -> E2 (different read surfaces of one sender), E1 <-> E2 conditioned on the candidate action / horizon under evaluation, hippocampal retrieval -> consumer conditioned on the consumer's present query state, ContextMemory -> downstream reader expressed relative to current context rather than injected as a fixed latent message, and waking versus offline interfaces using different receiver-conditioned geometry.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: receiver_conditioned_translation_and_recurrent_interface_stability -> MECH-547, MECH-548
claim_rows.title: Recurrent interface stability: an interface can be statically useful yet recurrently unstable -- a bridge with one-step utility > 0 can fail repeated closed-loop application, and REE traverses most interfaces repeatedly over trajectories, episodes and recurrent prediction loops. Two mechanisms, to be distinguished experimentally: (a) OFF-MANIFOLD COMPOUNDING -- a bridge trained on native receiver states emits a slightly off-distribution receiver state, the next application treats it as ordinary input, and B_0 -> T(A_0,B_0) = B_1' -> T(A_1,B_1') = B_2' accumulates displacement into a regime the bridge never saw; (b) SEMANTIC DOUBLE-COUNTING -- content already injected is not recognised as present and is re-amplified, escalating gain. Design corollary: CUMULATIVE translation (each step operates on the previously translated receiver state) versus CLEAN-BASE translation (each step computed against an unmodified native receiver state, the residual held as a temporary gated overlay) -- translated information should first be tested as an overlay or gated read surface, never as an irreversible rewrite of the receiver's core latent state. Adds an EIGHTH rung to INV-105's ladder, RECURRENTLY STABLE: repeated use preserves receiver-state validity, information calibration and functional behaviour over the timescale the system actually uses the interface -- assessed BEFORE behavioural usefulness is read as architecturally meaningful in a dynamical system. Sleep corollary for MECH-540: offline interface recalibration must improve or preserve closed-loop stability when waking dynamics resume; a sleep-induced change that improves a static probe but destabilises the next waking trajectory is a failure, not consolidation. Signatures: one-step rescue + cumulative collapse + clean-base stability = recurrent interface instability; cumulative stability + correct-pair specificity = a functionally coherent recurrent bridge; both fixed and conditioned bridges failing while richer source information succeeds = upstream representation deficiency remains more likely.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: deriving_the_cognitive_contract -> ARC-142, GOV-CONTRACT-1, MECH-545, MECH-546, Q-104
claim_rows.title: Cognifold versus braidling: at what point does invariant-preserving translation between cognitive systems constitute INTERNAL cognition (one cognifold) rather than communication between agents (a braidling)? Proposed discriminator, conceptual not yet formal: two systems form a BRAIDLING if each remains an independently coherent cognitive entity when communication is severed, however effective their coordination while joined; they are parts of ONE COGNIFOLD if their normal cognition depends on invariant-preserving transformations across the boundary and they jointly maintain one persistent self / world structure, so that severance degrades coherence on both sides rather than merely coordination. Does the cognitive contract (ARC-142) operationalise this -- through contract-dimension dependency, MECH-538 bridge complexity, or a severance assay -- and does the resulting criterion place REE's E1 / E2 / E3 / hippocampus on the cognifold side while placing two communicating REE agents on the braidling side?

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: governance: apply 54 adjudicated flag edits (gov-flagbacklog-20260909)
claim_rows.title: Environmental entropy deprivation predicts a psychiatric risk gradient: low-entropy environments (straight lines, routine, little novelty -- characteristic of urban and institutional settings) systematically deplete the raw material that offline sleep function consumes, producing progressive failure modes across anxiety, depression and cognitive-rigidity dimensions; high-entropy environments (nature, fractal structure, novel sensory complexity) supply that material and are predicted to be protective.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: SD-106: register encoder.generic_bottleneck_variance_preservation (design doc + claim + queue status)
claim_rows.title: Generic bottleneck variance preservation at the observation->z_world encoder: a SCALE-NORMALISED reconstruction term (fraction-of-variance-unexplained, with its own linear decoder) plus a zero-initialised linear bypass around the world encoder's ReLU stack. The successor SHAPE to SD-018, which supervises ONE NAMED FEATURE (resource proximity) and returned NULL at V3-EXQ-978. Addresses the CONFIRMED H-F-content-discarded-at-encode verdict of V3-EXQ-1010: the shipped P0 objective supplies no gradient toward decision-relevant content, leaving the latent at or below its own random-initialisation quality.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: developmental_overcapacity_pruning_sparse_interfaces -> ARC-143, MECH-549, MECH-550, MECH-551
claim_rows.title: The DEVELOPMENTAL capacity envelope is a design variable distinct from the MATURE capacity envelope, and REE must not infer the first from the second: the connection count, the number of candidate mappings, the size of the accessible transformation repertoire and the permissiveness of an interface that a developing organism needs in order to DISCOVER a useful organisation may each legitimately exceed what the mature organism retains, so imposing the mature bottleneck at developmental time zero can prevent the organism from discovering which distinctions and interfaces deserve to survive. This generalises MECH-362's subtractive trajectory from RECURRENT MEMORY CONNECTIVITY to the whole set of REE loci the thought names -- z_world, the E1/E2 interfaces, the hippocampal/replay pathways, goal/directive influence and E3 selection -- and states the consequence as a curriculum-design discipline: a developmental programme must declare, per locus, its developmental search capacity SEPARATELY from its mature architectural constraint, and the two need not be identical.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: candidate_cognitive_invariants -> ARC-144, GOV-CONTRACT-2, GOV-CONTRACT-3, MECH-557 (14 ledger candidates stay ledger-only)
claim_rows.title: The cognitive contract is BOUNDARY-INDEXED, not one flat universal header: for a handoff from subsystem A to subsystem B the obligation is I_AB = the relations B requires that B cannot cheaply and reliably reconstruct locally, so the contract is properly written as a family of TYPED OBLIGATIONS, C = { A -> B : I_AB, tolerated distortion, receiver capability, fallback behaviour }, one entry per directed interface. A sensory-to-world-model handoff, a hippocampal replay handoff, an E1-to-E2 predictive handoff and a control-plane handoff need not carry the same relational payload, and a relation may be obligatory at one boundary while being locally reconstructable -- and therefore omissible -- at another. The consequence that makes this more than bookkeeping: a DEEP SHARED CORE, if one exists, is an EMPIRICAL OVERLAP to be measured across many heterogeneous interfaces, never a premise; candidates such as value, salience, confidence, commitment and priority may be crucial at particular boundaries without being universal invariants of every internal representation, and a universal reading of the contract systematically over-states their status. Falsifier for the contract programme itself: if useful obligations exist at each boundary but their OVERLAP across the cognitive graph is negligible, boundary-specificity defeats a shared core and the contract is a set of interface specifications rather than an architecture of cognition.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: dynamic-information-governance (3) + hippocampal campaign (5) -> ARC-145, MECH-560, MECH-561, Q-106; INV-109, INV-110, MECH-562, Q-107
claim_rows.title: Dynamic information governance: a complete inter-engine interface in REE requires THREE properties, not two -- (1) the decision-relevant content survives the sender's encoding, (2) sender and receiver are mutually legible so a constrained transformation between frozen endpoints exists (ARC-139 / MECH-537 / MECH-538), and (3) the exchange occurs under a routing state that grants the sender causal privilege over that receiver AT THAT MOMENT. Property (3) -- jurisdiction, or temporal/state ACCESS -- is a separate organisational level from content and from legibility, so a representation can be present, decodable, structurally connected to a downstream system, and still unable to affect it; and the corresponding repair is different in kind from an encoder fix or a bridge. The architectural consequence is that REE's effective interface graph is CONSTRUCTED rather than possessed: G_eff(t) is a function of wiring, representational geometry, control state and history, so the same computational substrate can belong to different effective networks at different times. SEPARABILITY FALSIFIER, which is the whole content of the commitment: if a static bridge between frozen endpoints restores the full behavioural phenotype irrespective of when the message is made available, level (3) is unnecessary and this commitment should be withdrawn in favour of ARC-139 plus MECH-539 alone.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: registered_utc field
claim_rows.title: Contract-invariant promotion ladder: GOV-CONTRACT-1's >= 2-of-6-domain consilience quorum is STAGE 1 of six, not the whole standard, and clearing it confers a LEDGER STATUS ("admitted") and nothing else -- in particular no claims.yaml entry, no architectural commitment, and no licence to implement. The ladder: Stage 0 named canonical candidate (the relation has a governed ledger record); Stage 1 cross-domain recurrence (the GOV-CONTRACT-1 quorum); Stage 2 transferable RECEIVER-ACCESSIBLE recoverability (the relation is recoverable by a plausible receiver, not merely by a researcher's probe, across held-out content, tasks or remappings -- graded on INV-105's ladder, never on external decodability alone); Stage 3 causal handoff dependence (selective, nuisance-controlled corruption at a relevant interface produces the predicted deficit, MECH-545); Stage 4 irreducibility under constrained reconstruction (a smaller already-supported basis cannot reproduce the function within the receiver's rate, decoder, context, latency and robustness budget -- adjudicated under the reduction-admissibility rule); Stage 5 adaptation-aware characterisation (compensation, alternative-pathway recruitment and rescue understood well enough to separate functional necessity from mechanism uniqueness, ARC-140); Stage 6 boundary scope established (which handoffs require the relation and which can reconstruct or omit it, ARC-144). A candidate becomes CLAIM-SHAPED at Stage 4 and eligible for architectural treatment only after Stage 5; before that its canonical home is its ledger record id. Composite candidates remain candidates however strong their recurrence, and a negative result at any stage is recorded in the ledger, never deleted.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: registered_utc field
claim_rows.title: Reduction admissibility for the cognitive contract (the anti-cheating rule the pruning clause lacks): counting primitives is not minimality, and a proposed MERGE, demotion or derivation of one candidate from another counts only if it lowers TOTAL TRANSFERABLE COMPLEXITY rather than relocating it. The quantity to be reduced is minimal sufficient transferable information under CONSTRAINED encoders and receivers -- informally contract cost ~= information rate + encoder/decoder complexity + context or side-channel complexity + reconstruction distortion + computational and latency cost + robustness cost -- not the number of English nouns in the basis. A reduction is therefore INADMISSIBLE when the lost distinctions reappear inside the definition of the surviving relation, a more powerful decoder, hidden context tags, unconstrained numerical precision, recurrent hidden state, task-specific side channels, or expensive reconstruction machinery. Three requirements for any proposed collapse: (1) lower total description or rate cost under fixed assumptions about precision and decoder power; (2) preserve DISCRIMINATING predictions -- the reduced model must still predict distinct failure signatures when different information is corrupted; (3) improve transfer or efficiency relative to an unconstrained equivalent-capacity code. The standard of reducibility is OPERATIONAL, not logical: logical reducibility (a mathematician can derive it) and information-theoretic reducibility (the information exists somewhere) are both inadmissible, and only computational reducibility (the receiver can derive it with plausible resources) and operational reducibility (reliably and quickly enough for the behaviour in question) decide. Corollary that makes the rule bite: rewriting several candidates as one typed relational graph, one latent, or one universal relation is a RENAMING, not a reduction, and is refused unless all three requirements are demonstrated.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: provenance_errors_false_evidence_multiplication_and_psychosis -> INV-107, MECH-552, MECH-553, MECH-554, Q-105
claim_rows.title: Dependency structure among evidence must be REPRESENTED and conditioned on, and independence must never be INFERRED from the absence of a recorded dependency. Any representation that can later influence belief, confidence, closure or action must carry enough (uncertain, compressed) causal genealogy that the descendants of a hypothesis cannot be counted as witnesses independent of it. The rule is binding in its NEGATIVE form only -- a hypothesis must not cite its own descendants as independent witnesses -- and is explicitly NOT the positive rule "descendants should be collapsed to one vote": where a structural dependency exists but the observations across it are partial or contradicting, dependent reports can support a hypothesis MORE than independent ones would, so maximal discounting is the larger error. The invariant therefore constrains the REPRESENTATION (dependency must be expressible and readable), not the arithmetic (no fixed discount is mandated). Unknown provenance is not independent provenance; uncertain source is not confidently external source.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: convergence-signal family (5 thoughts) -> MECH-558, MECH-559, INV-108; insight claim deferred
claim_rows.title: Convergence must be DETECTED over a preserved diversity, never TRAINED into the evaluators: any architecture that treats agreement among partly independent routes as evidence thereby creates a gradient toward making those routes agree, and acting on that gradient destroys exactly the independence that gave the agreement its evidential value -- agreement among clones is cheap, agreement among competent differences is not. The constraint therefore binds in five parts: (i) no agreement or consensus objective may be optimised into the evaluators themselves, and a convergence estimator must never become a teacher of its own evidence base; (ii) convergence is computed DIAGNOSTICALLY over evaluator outputs and is an EVENT over diversity, not an endpoint or a training target; (iii) dependency provenance and disagreement history must be preserved rather than compressed away, because they are what make a later agreement interpretable; (iv) a competent dissenting route must retain a protected path to attention that a confident majority cannot close, and protected-veto and irreversibility structure must not be purchasable by many weak agreeing votes; (v) the objective is preservation of COMPETENT NON-REDUNDANT routes -- unique predictive coverage, unique error detection, distinct failure sets, distinct causal paths -- and explicitly NOT maximum diversity, which is satisfiable by noise or contrarian output, nor maximum agreement. The diversity that matters for this purpose is ERROR and CAUSAL diversity, not geometric representational dissimilarity: two systems can differ geometrically and fail identically, or look similar and respond differently under intervention.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: dynamic-information-governance (3) + hippocampal campaign (5) -> ARC-145, MECH-560, MECH-561, Q-106; INV-109, INV-110, MECH-562, Q-107
claim_rows.title: A reproduced deterministic RECIPE is not a frozen ENDPOINT: re-running a documented training recipe reconstitutes an operating REGIME, which licenses a within-run paired comparison and nothing whatever about the identity of the artifact a PRIOR run measured. Any claim naming a specific earlier endpoint -- "decoded the 1002/1008 latent", "the same frozen encoder", "the banked representation" -- requires that endpoint's weights and observations to have been PERSISTED and LOADED, not re-derived; where they were re-derived, the admissible statement is bounded to the regime ("the consumer-width values fall in the declared band and the participation ratios match"), and the endpoint-identity claim must be withdrawn. The discriminator is mechanical and cheap: a recorded state hash at both endpoints, re-verified at every evaluation boundary, with a mismatch aborting rather than warning. A pinned substrate COMMIT is not a substitute -- it constrains the code that produced the endpoint, never the endpoint's realised weights, which is why a commit-pinned run can and does report substrate_stable_across_run false.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: dynamic-information-governance (3) + hippocampal campaign (5) -> ARC-145, MECH-560, MECH-561, Q-106; INV-109, INV-110, MECH-562, Q-107
claim_rows.title: The interface-repair adjudication standard: a claim that some maintenance process REPAIRED a cross-system mapping -- as opposed to strengthening a memory, triggering a completion, or riding a subspace that never broke -- is admissible only from a single design, or one tightly integrated series, that closes all six links itself, because the confounds differ across preparations and therefore do not cancel when rows are stacked: (1) MEASURED CHANGE in a transfer-relevant direction, which excludes unit turnover, registration noise, behavioural change, and any rotation preserving the receiver-potent subspace; (2) LOCAL PRESERVATION of sender information, sender-local use, and receiver-local memory and competence, at the moment of the cross-system test; (3) ACCESS LOSS measured by a causal receiver-dependent output, never by decodability or correlation; (4) PAIR-SPECIFIC MAINTENANCE, compared against a within-context permutation preserving event count, state occupancy, marginal content, firing and plasticity opportunity and breaking only which sender event pairs with which receiver state; (5) CAUSAL RESTORATION on held-out episodes; (6) RIVAL EXCLUSION at matched budgets. Two consequences bind. First, a GATE-0 LESION PROOF precedes every maintenance arm: the imposed change must degrade causal receiver use while leaving both endpoints locally intact AND be restorable by a known oracle inverse -- if the oracle cannot restore use the lesion is not an interface lesion and the drift model is invalid, if magnitude-matched null-subspace drift degrades use the subspace identification is invalid, and if task-relevant drift does not degrade use there is nothing to repair and the experiment stops. Second, the estimand is the correctly-paired arm beating the MAXIMUM of the permuted-pair, receiver-local-adaptation and local-rehearsal arms, never the unmaintained floor: a correct-pair advantage over the floor alone is equally explained by generic plasticity, extra rehearsal and homeostatic adaptation. Local-memory equivalence is a PROSPECTIVE constraint tested by equivalence tests, never a covariate regressed out afterwards, because conditioning on a treatment-affected memory score is a collider.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: developmental_overcapacity_pruning_sparse_interfaces -> ARC-143, MECH-549, MECH-550, MECH-551
claim_rows.title: Developmental-history irreducibility at matched final capacity: some mature cognitive organisations may be historically inaccessible from their own final architecture -- a system that develops through a transiently larger capacity envelope and is progressively reduced to a target architecture can outperform an identical target architecture trained from initialisation under the identical curriculum, so developmental history contributes something the final architecture alone does not reproduce. The claim is stated with its own discriminating control and is confirmable ONLY by that control: a four-arm design of (A) mature size throughout, (B) overcapacity progressively reduced to the mature size, (C) overcapacity retained, and (D) arm B's final architecture, sparsity mask and interface structure REINITIALISED and trained from the start under the same curriculum. B > A alone is consistent with the rival "pruning found a better small architecture"; only B > D at architecture(B) ~= architecture(D) and final capacity(B) = final capacity(D) establishes the claim. Corollary: premature representational or interface compression should selectively impair distinctions whose relevance is revealed only later in the curriculum, even where the same compressed form works well after maturation.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: developmental_overcapacity_pruning_sparse_interfaces -> ARC-143, MECH-549, MECH-550, MECH-551
claim_rows.title: Functional persistence, not weight magnitude, is the retention criterion for developmental capacity reduction: which relationships, mappings or routes survive a developmental reduction should be determined by repeated demonstrated usefulness under prediction, action, regulation and replay -- predictive contribution, reduction of persistent prediction error, harm/benefit relevance, controllability discrimination, counterfactual usefulness, action-selection contribution, replay recurrence, transfer across contexts, stability across developmental stages, utility to more than one downstream consumer, and maintenance of uncertainty where premature collapse would be dangerous. The prediction is comparative and has a named rival that must be run as a control rather than assumed away: relevance-guided reduction should outperform indiscriminate magnitude pruning at matched final capacity; if it does not, functional selection is not what the developmental reduction is doing and the effect reduces to capacity annealing.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: developmental_overcapacity_pruning_sparse_interfaces -> ARC-143, MECH-549, MECH-550, MECH-551
claim_rows.title: Capacity reduction concurrent with representational change is a COORDINATION problem, and offline replay is the proposed coordination site: while a representation is still being revised, a route can appear unnecessary only because its consumer has not yet adapted to the new representation, and an apparently useful route can be preserving an obsolete coding convention -- so the retention decision read online during representational change is systematically unreliable in both directions. The proposal is that offline/replay periods provide the safer setting for it, because they permit testing which old episodes remain reconstructable, comparing alternative candidate mappings without immediate behavioural cost, re-indexing memories after representational change, stabilising newly useful communication subspaces, weakening redundant routes, and checking that a reduction has not destroyed counterfactual or regulatory distinctions. Falsifiable prediction with its matched control stated: at equal aggressiveness of reduction AND matched update count, replay-coupled reduction should preserve more transfer and causal structure than online-only reduction; the strong form is that replay permits GREATER compression at equal or better transfer.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: provenance_errors_false_evidence_multiplication_and_psychosis -> INV-107, MECH-552, MECH-553, MECH-554, Q-105
claim_rows.title: False evidence multiplication: a provenance error can change the apparent CARDINALITY of evidence and not only its source label. One internally generated hypothesis H produces descendants through prediction, hippocampal replay, counterfactual simulation, retrieved memory and ambiguous perceptual interpretation; if shared ancestry is lost, those descendants are counted as several mutually corroborating observations and confidence in H rises with no corresponding increase in world evidence. Two consequences are asserted to be separable and must not be collapsed: a phenomenological branch (self-generated content losing evidence of self-generation acquires external/perceptual status) and an epistemic branch (descendants losing shared ancestry inflate posterior confidence and shorten information-seeking). LOCUS CORRECTION, carried in the claim rather than deferred: the operative variable is the READOUT'S DEFAULT FOR UNKNOWN ANCESTRY, not the corruption event itself -- an architecture that treats unrecorded dependency as independence will inflate whether or not any genealogy was ever corrupted.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: provenance_errors_false_evidence_multiplication_and_psychosis -> INV-107, MECH-552, MECH-553, MECH-554, Q-105
claim_rows.title: Compressed causal genealogy as the representation that discharges the dependency-representation invariant: provenance is a GRAPH over representations, not a vector of attributes on each one. The proposed structure is bounded rather than a full history -- shared-ancestor probability between any two evidence-bearing items, an externally-anchored-observation flag with its own confidence, a hypothetical / replay lineage marker, an already-counted-evidence-family marker recording whether an item has already contributed to the current belief update, and a context-conditioned dependency estimate -- and each genealogy edge carries its own confidence so that ancestry can be uncertain without being absent. This extends the per-token provenance source vector from attributes of one token to relations between tokens, which is the level at which evidence cardinality is defined.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: provenance_errors_false_evidence_multiplication_and_psychosis -> INV-107, MECH-552, MECH-553, MECH-554, Q-105
claim_rows.title: Recursive replay amplification of false independence: when genealogy is corrupted or absent, repeated replay / reinstatement of internally stored content converts remembered or simulated material into apparent new evidence, so confidence in a hypothesis rises monotonically with replay count while external evidence is held fixed, and the belief becomes self-maintaining. The dangerous signature is specifically an ancestry-by-replay-count INTERACTION, not a replay-count main effect: healthy replay must be able to improve retrieval fidelity and representation quality with the effective independent-source count staying flat. Admissible only under two controls -- replay stratified by kind (single-episode content rehearsal, cross-episode relational linking, prediction-generated descendants), and retrieval quality matched across ancestry conditions, since a corrupted-ancestry arm that also retrieves better yields a retrieval effect wearing a provenance label.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: shared_reference_frames_and_temporal_gates -> MECH-555, MECH-556
claim_rows.title: Reference-frame mediation as a separable interface factor: two systems can each contain a task distinction, expose it through a healthy communication subspace (MECH-537), and still fail to communicate because they index that distinction against INCOMPATIBLE RELATIONAL COORDINATES -- egocentric versus allocentric, current-position-relative versus trajectory-origin-relative, observation-time versus predicted-action-time, absolute location versus action-conditioned displacement, episode-identity versus elapsed-tick. The interface decomposition is therefore content x communication subspace x REFERENCE FRAME x receiver context x temporal gate, and the frame is a THIRD selection variable alongside which directions are exposed (MECH-537) and which read surface the receiver's state selects (MECH-547). Registered failure class RF-F (an eighth entry in the location doc's F1-F7 routing table): an external probe succeeds on sender AND receiver, the information is not missing and the subspace is not collapsed, yet native cross-system use fails -- routing to a relational re-indexing rather than to more sender capacity or a higher bridge rung. The DISCRIMINATOR that makes this more than a redescription is a frame permutation that preserves content: permute the frame labels or anchors between episodes or positions while holding sender-state distribution, marginal difficulty and content statistics fixed (intact >> frame-permuted, while the target stays decodable in both, is the confirming signature; intact ~= frame-permuted says the frame is incidental at that interface). Two non-redundant predictions: frame alignment should LOWER the minimum bridge rung L(A -> B) (MECH-538) without requiring a higher-capacity bridge, and a frame permutation may disrupt only ONE downstream consumer, in which case reference frames are consumer-specific rather than globally shared -- which forbids inferring one global workspace or one canonical coordinate system from several consumers sharing an indexing relation.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: shared_reference_frames_and_temporal_gates -> MECH-555, MECH-556
claim_rows.title: Temporal-gate adequacy as a separable interface factor, and the mistimed-interface false negative: an inter-system mapping can be representationally adequate -- source content present, receiver-facing geometry adequate, bridge low-complexity, correct-pair specificity satisfied, receiver on-manifold -- and still produce NO downstream effect because it is engaged outside the phase in which the receiver is receptive, plastic, replaying the relevant episode, or evaluating the relevant candidate. This separates HAVING a compatible interface from ENGAGING it at the phase in which its content can alter another system. Registered failure class TG-F (a ninth entry in the location doc's F1-F7 routing table) and the binding evidential consequence that is this claim's real content, deliberately of the same shape as INV-105's two: a null measured at an interface whose engagement phase was NOT a controlled variable does not license the reading "the interface is semantically useless" or "the information was lost", until the same correctly paired content has been delivered at a target phase versus early-shifted, late-shifted and phase-shuffled conditions AT MATCHED communication energy, event count and update magnitude -- so that timing, not quantity, is what varied. Corollary that keeps this from licensing new machinery: the manipulation is expected to be expressible by REE's EXISTING wake / sleep / control-plane substrate, and a finding that it is not is itself the result -- do not add a gate mechanism to make the test runnable.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: candidate_cognitive_invariants -> ARC-144, GOV-CONTRACT-2, GOV-CONTRACT-3, MECH-557 (14 ledger candidates stay ledger-only)
claim_rows.title: The 3 + 2 reduction hypothesis: the fourteen canonical cognitive-contract candidates (evidence/planning/cognitive_contract_invariant_ledger.v1.json) may not be fourteen independent primitives but may largely generate from THREE STRUCTURAL FAMILIES plus TWO ATTACHED WEIGHTING FIELDS. Structural: (A) CORRESPONDENCE / BINDING -- which token, event, state or relation in one representation corresponds to which in another or across time, with identity as correspondence plus continuity and persistence constraints, and equivalence as correspondence under a specified transformation (absorbing CCI-001, CCI-006); (B) DIRECTED EVENT / TRAJECTORY STRUCTURE -- event or token instances, ordered or partially ordered succession, reachable transition relations, persistence across transitions, and optional typed intervention edges, rather than a scalar clock plus a separate graph (absorbing CCI-002, CCI-007 and, if action-labelled edges suffice to reconstruct controllability, much of CCI-004); (C) GENERATIVE CONTEXT / ANCHORING / LINEAGE -- which process produced a representation, which branch it belongs to, whether that branch is anchored to the current sensory worldline, and how it relates to other generated alternatives, so that "actual" is a relation to the currently anchored worldline rather than a primitive category (absorbing CCI-003, CCI-012 and the unnumbered provenance/ownership hypotheses). Attached fields: (D) EPISTEMIC WEIGHT over states, edges or translations, obligatory only where the producer holds reliability information the receiver cannot cheaply reconstruct (reclassifying CCI-005 from content primitive to boundary-specific field); (E) REGULATORY / VIABILITY WEIGHT -- predicted relation to viable or preferred states plus direction of change plus horizon, from which signed value, goal relation and priority may derive (reclassifying CCI-009 and bearing on CCI-010, CCI-014). CROSSED PREDICTION, which is what makes this falsifiable rather than a re-labelling: structural families should survive object or world remapping when the world relation is unchanged despite altered surface features, whereas attached fields should vary strongly with current uncertainty, needs, goals, physiology and task regime AT FIXED STRUCTURE -- so holding structure fixed while changing confidence, holding structure fixed while changing viability, holding confidence fixed while changing branch lineage, holding value fixed while changing controllability, and holding sensory content fixed while changing generative path should dissociate along the structure/field boundary. If structural and weighting variables cannot be dissociated by that crossed design, the 3 + 2 model is wrong or too simple.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: convergence-signal family (5 thoughts) -> MECH-558, MECH-559, INV-108; insight claim deferred
claim_rows.title: Vote count is not evidence count -- independence-aware convergence over heterogeneous evaluators: when several partly independent evaluators favour the same candidate, the epistemic weight of that agreement depends on how many EFFECTIVELY INDEPENDENT evidential routes produced it, and a bounded system that retains a COARSE representation of its evaluators' dependency TOPOLOGY -- which routes share upstream representation, training signal, ancestry, or residual error -- recovers materially more of the exact joint-inference answer than either (a) a marginal-reliability-only combiner, which counts one duplicated reason N times, or (b) a single global dependence scalar, which cannot separate a correlated coalition plus genuinely independent specialists from uniform moderate dependence. The claimed object is a TOPOLOGY, not a scalar convergence score: at minimum who supports what, how reliable each route is in the current domain, which routes share ancestry or error, which credible routes remain independent, and what structured dissent survives. Three bindings keep this from becoming a new scalar ruler. (1) CEILING BINDING: exact Bayesian aggregation over the true joint dependency model remains the normative ceiling and this claim explicitly does NOT assert that any convergence heuristic beats it -- the assertion is bounded-resource COMPRESSION, that coarse topology approaches the exact decision and confidence at materially lower structural cost and degrades gracefully when dependency estimates are stale or wrong. (2) NON-REPLACEMENT BINDING: independence correction is additive to, never a substitute for, evaluator reliability/relevance weighting and protected-veto structure -- independence-aware convergence is not majority rule and must not become more majority-dominated than a reliability baseline. (3) NON-TAUTOLOGY BINDING: a convergence quantity must be validated by an INDEPENDENT consequence (held-out decision accuracy, calibration, robustness under evaluator dropout or distribution shift), never by a transformation that forces agreement -- normalising every evaluator to equal scale and then observing equal contribution is not evidence.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: convergence-signal family (5 thoughts) -> MECH-558, MECH-559, INV-108; insight claim deferred
claim_rows.title: Evidence-dependency topology and downstream-leverage topology are SEPARATE, state-conditioned variables and conflating them misallocates information seeking: "how many genuinely independent reasons do I currently hold" (the evidence-source dependency graph) and "how many distinct consequential consumers would change if this uncertainty were resolved" (the downstream-leverage graph) are different relations over the same subsystems, so a policy that uses either as a proxy for the other allocates queries, rollouts or experiments badly -- five statistically independent routes can all update one downstream decision, and one correlated cluster can control several genuinely distinct consequences. Four bindings. (1) STRUCTURED DIVERGENCE IS NOT INFORMATION VALUE: disagreement earns allocation weight only after multiplication by expected REDUCIBILITY and decision CONSEQUENCE and correction for how much of the current evidence is genuinely independent; raw disagreement is attracted to irreducible noise and to broken or out-of-domain evaluators, and a divergence signal must separate useful, irreducible and broken-view divergence. (2) COMPETENCE IS DOMAIN-INDEXED: an evaluator must not carry one global trust weight when its competence depends on the current representational or behavioural domain. (3) UNCERTAIN PROVENANCE MUST BE REPRESENTED AS UNCERTAIN: treating noisy ancestry metadata as categorical dependency labels degrades worse than carrying soft dependency probabilities, and the soft form wins by making less COSTLY errors rather than by hitting the optimum more often. (4) BOTH GRAPHS ARE STATE-CONDITIONED: two routes redundant in one context can be independent in another, and two named downstream consumers can be functionally redundant in one state and distinct in another, so a static average relation graph is insufficient. As in MECH-558, exact value-of-information over the true joint model is the ceiling and is not contested.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: dynamic-information-governance (3) + hippocampal campaign (5) -> ARC-145, MECH-560, MECH-561, Q-106; INV-109, INV-110, MECH-562, Q-107
claim_rows.title: Governed selectivity beats transfer volume: competent integrated behaviour in REE tracks the SELECTIVITY, STABILITY, REPERTOIRE and causal TIMING of directed influence between engines, not the AMOUNT of inter-engine information transferred -- so the decisive experimental signature is a DISSOCIATION at matched traffic, in which endpoint-local content remains decodable, endpoint-local competence remains intact, total inter-module transfer is matched or INCREASED, and integrated behaviour nonetheless degrades in proportion to lost directional selectivity, route stability or motif repertoire. Three degradation modes are predicted to be distinguishable rather than one: FLATTENING (all channels similarly permissive, high volume, no selectivity), DOMINATION (one slow global mode monopolises routing authority, high coherence, low repertoire) and FRAGMENTATION (routes form but do not persist long enough to complete a multi-step transfer; local decodability intact, long-horizon coordination poor). PRIMARY FALSIFIER: if performance is fully explained by total transmitted activity or message count, and route selectivity adds nothing once traffic is matched, this claim is refuted and no routing layer is warranted. SECOND FALSIFIER: if total transfer always FALLS whenever behaviour falls, the high-traffic/low-tuning regime does not exist in REE and the claim's discriminating signature is unreachable.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: dynamic-information-governance (3) + hippocampal campaign (5) -> ARC-145, MECH-560, MECH-561, Q-106; INV-109, INV-110, MECH-562, Q-107
claim_rows.title: Phase as an addressing coordinate: the receiver-potent communication subspace between two REE subsystems is indexed by an ENDOGENOUS CYCLIC coordinate that belongs to neither endpoint -- S_comm(A -> B | phi, c) rather than S_comm(A -> B) -- so a sender dimension can lie INSIDE the receiver-potent subspace at one phase and OUTSIDE it at another with no change whatever in the sender's representation, and information can be continuously decodable from the sender while its downstream causal effect varies systematically with phi. COROLLARY, which is the sharper and more falsifiable half: TEMPORAL separability can substitute for GEOMETRIC separability, so two concurrently represented streams need not be near-orthogonal in population geometry if they become receiver-effective at different temporal addresses -- predicting a measurable trade-off in which the principal angle between two stream subspaces and their phase-conditioned overlap with S_comm move in opposite directions while behavioural intrusion stays flat. FOUR-CELL VERDICT GRID, pre-registered: GEOMETRY-ONLY (angle changes, phase conditioning adds nothing) / TIMING-ONLY (geometry flat, causal impact alternates with phase) / JOINT (both reorganise and jointly predict intrusion) / NULL (neither beats a static consumer model at matched complexity). FALSIFIERS: a static subspace explains receiver activity and behaviour as well as any phase-conditioned model at matched complexity; a global scalar gain explains it without receiver-specific temporal structure; RANDOM temporal labels do as well as the endogenous coordinate; or the dependence disappears after controlling for ordinary task context, action identity, arousal, or trivial periodicity in environment sampling.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: dynamic-information-governance (3) + hippocampal campaign (5) -> ARC-145, MECH-560, MECH-561, Q-106; INV-109, INV-110, MECH-562, Q-107
claim_rows.title: Receiver-local self-healing is the standing rival to every cross-system interface-repair result: a consumer can restore its use of a drifting sender WITHOUT any episodic pair identity, any cross-system label, or any offline replay, by adjusting afferent weights from presynaptic sender activity and its own postsynaptic output under homeostatic error against fixed pre-drift output statistics -- and because this produces the SAME observable as interface repair (downstream performance restored despite upstream change), any REE result attributing a rescue to correctly paired replay must beat a faithful implementation of it at a matched update budget. Its preconditions are its predictions, and they are what make it falsifiable rather than a residual explanation: it needs redundant smooth tuning that continues to tile the represented variable, incremental rather than abrupt change, plasticity at least as fast as drift, and enough sampling or reactivation to estimate the correlations and output statistics -- so its advantage is a function of the DRIFT-RATE-TO-MAINTENANCE-INTERVAL RATIO, and an unswept timescale silently chooses the winner. Three regimes weaken it and are where a genuine pairing effect should be sought: large infrequent drift, drift of the receiver's own scaffold or decoder, and continuous symmetries permitting an unanchored global rotation. Its more durable variants -- population response normalisation, and a stable recurrent predictive model supplying covariance structure -- are NOT free local plasticity: they assume a receiver scaffold that is fixed or changes far more slowly than the feed-forward representation, and that assumption is itself a testable architectural commitment, not a background condition.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: provenance_errors_false_evidence_multiplication_and_psychosis -> INV-107, MECH-552, MECH-553, MECH-554, Q-105
claim_rows.title: Are source attribution and evidence cardinality DISSOCIABLE readouts of one provenance manipulation, or does a change in either always drag the other? Specifically: can P(external | representation) move without the effective independent-source count moving (a hallucination-like outcome with no confidence inflation), can the effective source count and calibration move without any change in external-source attribution (a delusion-like outcome with no altered phenomenology), and does a broader self-monitoring failure move both? A null on the dissociation is itself informative, because it would mean provenance errors alter source labels only and evidence cardinality is protected some other way -- which would retire the false-evidence-multiplication branch while leaving the source-monitoring account intact.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: dynamic-information-governance (3) + hippocampal campaign (5) -> ARC-145, MECH-560, MECH-561, Q-106; INV-109, INV-110, MECH-562, Q-107
claim_rows.title: Endogenous or exogenous routing generation: does CLOSING the loop -- letting the routing state be generated partly by the aggregate activity of the very subsystems whose effective connectivity it sets, so that local activity -> field state -> altered effective connectivity -> new activity -> updated field state -- confer any capability that a matched OPEN-LOOP routing schedule cannot reproduce? Pre-registered discriminator: two routing generators whose OUTPUT marginal statistics are matched (gain distribution, temporal autocorrelation, motif dwell time, transition entropy) and whose parameter and compute budgets are matched, one supplied independently of module activity and one evolved from it, compared on robustness to perturbation, speed of reconfiguration after a context change, adaptive routing in unseen contexts, and recovery after a transient lesion -- never on raw task score, which the extra recurrence alone can move. A null here is informative and expected to be common: if both perform identically, endogenous field feedback is unnecessary and the simpler scheduled field should be kept.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: dynamic-information-governance (3) + hippocampal campaign (5) -> ARC-145, MECH-560, MECH-561, Q-106; INV-109, INV-110, MECH-562, Q-107
claim_rows.title: Can a system distinguish a change in its own code from a change in the world that code represents -- and if it cannot, what is a maintenance mechanism entitled to preserve? A label-free adaptive readout is blind to the difference between a drifting upstream encoding and a genuine change in the latent cause being encoded, so a self-repairing receiver can "correct" a TRUTHFUL update away, restoring an obsolete mapping and reporting it as stability; and an experimenter who scores only restored downstream performance cannot tell those apart either. The question has a sharp REE form: any claim that a maintenance process REPAIRED a mapping must show that the pre-drift mapping was still the CORRECT one, not merely that the receiver converged on something self-consistent -- which requires an anchor outside both endpoints (a ground-truth task target, a preserved external referent, or an explicit provenance marker on the change) that REE does not currently represent anywhere. Whether such an anchor is necessary, or whether self-consistency plus behavioural adequacy is the only coherent criterion available to an embedded system, is open.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: registered_utc field
claim_rows.title: Deletion-pressure rule: construction earns a later obligation to attempt simplification. Once several individually validated local repairs coexist in one organism (representation-preservation objectives, routing bridges, selection-authority boosts, replay repair, provenance tracking, goal-anchor normalisation, compensatory control loops), the mature bundle must periodically be challenged by mechanism removal, low-complexity replacement, consolidation of redundant routes, reduction of bridge capacity, and removal of downstream compensation after an upstream repair -- and competence retained after removal is recorded as a POSITIVE architectural result, not as lost work. Two mechanisms do not both keep conceptual credit when one has become unnecessary; this is the architectural counterpart of not double-counting evidence. A mechanism is not protected from deletion by having once passed its own isolated assay.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: registered_utc field
claim_rows.title: Seeds-versus-worlds reporting rule: random-seed replication and ecological (world-family) replication are different evidence and MUST be reported separately -- "stochastic replication: N seeds" and "world-family replication: N environment families / N orthogonal perturbation classes" -- and a result may not be described as general, robust or transferable solely because it survived more seeds. Seeds test robustness within ONE world family; ecological replication tests whether the mechanism survives when the world itself changes along a PREDECLARED axis (map geometry, hazard or resource prevalence and topology, cue-to-consequence mapping, transition dynamics, temporal delays, observation or sensor layout, action costs, affordance structure, partial observability, actor structure). Where such a suite is used as a promotion target it must be FROZEN before use, or it becomes another training distribution. Until a frozen ecological suite exists, world-family replication is a NAMED DEBT on every claim promoted on seeds alone, never an implied property.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: registered_utc field
claim_rows.title: H-other / model-misspecification route: every important hypothesis-space discrimination programme (a question in hypothesis_space_registry.v1.json) must preserve an explicit route OUTSIDE its registered partition -- "H-other: the pattern is not explained by any registered hypothesis and the partition itself may be wrong" -- so that a well-designed frozen hypothesis ledger does not become a closed ontology in which reality is assumed to choose among the enumerated legs. The route is NOT a catch-all after an ordinary null; it becomes salient on PATTERN-level signals: no registered leg explains the full outcome; different seeds or environments select incompatible explanations; the effect appears only in interaction with another subsystem; timing or developmental history omitted from the partition explains the variance; several registered legs are simultaneously required; or every surviving leg needs a rescue clause. When it fires, the required next action is to rotate the claim (GOV-ROTATE-1) or expand the partition as a LABELLED growth event (GOV-FROZEN-1 invariant 3a / failure-autopsy Mode C) BEFORE another rescue run is queued -- never "the same hypothesis with more compute".

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: registered_utc field
claim_rows.title: Evidence-domain jurisdiction rule: evidence receives no broader jurisdiction than the experiment earned. Organism-level validation is a PROFILE over eight orthogonal evidence domains -- D0 instrument validity, D1 local mechanism validity, D2 local causal consequence, D3 closed-loop behavioural consequence, D4 ecological (world-family, not seed) generalisation, D5 developmental validity, D6 integrated compatibility and simplification, D7 adaptive recovery from a materially wrong internal model -- never a scalar ladder and never one "intelligence score". Whenever a result is promoted UPWARD -- into a roadmap or closure-plan node, an architectural recommendation, a milestone or progress summary (CURRENT_FRONT, insights_report, morning digest, a governance cycle's headline), a default-on decision, or any statement that REE itself has become more competent -- the promoting text MUST carry an explicit line of the form "Evidence domain reached: D? / Domains not tested: ..." naming the SPECIFIC untested domains that matter for that claim. A frozen-latent decoder result establishes at most D1; a live selection perturbation at most D2; seven seeds in one world family do not reach D4. Raw manifests and per-run autopsies are exempt; the rule binds the SUMMARY layer, where mechanism validity is most easily narrated as organismal progress.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: local_mechanism_success_vs_organism_level_intelligence -> GOV-JURIS-1, GOV-ECOL-1, GOV-HOTHER-1, GOV-DELETE-1, Q-108 (organism-level validation doctrine anchor page; process-change review in intake s.8-9)
claim_rows.title: What would constitute a minimal-working-intelligence EVENT for REE -- a single non-oracular adaptive-recovery episode in which a previously useful internal model becomes materially wrong, the organism detects the mismatch, allocates information-seeking or computation toward it, updates the relevant representation or interface without being told which subsystem failed, recovers closed-loop competence above a preregistered threshold, retains still-valid knowledge, transfers some advantage to a second related perturbation, and loses the advantage when the proposed adaptive machinery is ablated -- and which perturbation class (cue remapping, resource-contingency reversal, hidden transition change, memory or provenance corruption, interface drift, sensor or affordance change) is first NON-VACUOUS on the substrate REE actually has? Such an event is qualitatively different from an accumulation of local PASSes; passing one tiny-world challenge would establish an integrated adaptive episode, not general intelligence.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: intake-hygiene: register gated-check survivors -> ARC-146, MECH-563, MECH-564, MECH-565, ARC-147; 12 candidates stay gated (plasticity x11, lateralisation MECH x1)
claim_rows.title: Dorsal high-fidelity structured symbolic routing is architecturally distinct from the affective-coupling system, and a ventral interface binds affect to symbol: the pathway that carries language's structure and sequencing and the pathway that carries graded affective coupling are separate systems joined by a binding interface, so REE must not implement affect as a property of the symbolic route nor symbolic routing as a property of the affect stream. The claim is limited to the DISSOCIATION, which has clinical anchors (conduction aphasia impairs structured repetition while preserving comprehension; right-hemisphere lesions impair affective prosody while sparing propositional language), and deliberately does NOT assert the broader "lateralisation = incompatible-regime separation" or precision-vs-flexibility principle.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: intake-hygiene: register gated-check survivors -> ARC-146, MECH-563, MECH-564, MECH-565, ARC-147; 12 candidates stay gated (plasticity x11, lateralisation MECH x1)
claim_rows.title: Commits are TYPED: REE's commitment machinery must distinguish at least symbolic, embodied, social-witnessed, repair, grief, boundary and rumination commit types, because each carries a different cost, a different mismatch source (or none), a different residue consequence and a different arbitration-update path -- a single untyped commit-boundary token cannot represent that a symbolic partial commit and an embodied full commit of the same trajectory carry different risk and teach different things.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: intake-hygiene: register gated-check survivors -> ARC-146, MECH-563, MECH-564, MECH-565, ARC-147; 12 candidates stay gated (plasticity x11, lateralisation MECH x1)
claim_rows.title: Subjective now is the temporal convergence point of E1 perceptual prediction and hippocampal trajectory rollout, not the moment of raw sensory arrival: the convergence sits AHEAD of real-time input (supplying the motor-execution buffer), plan origins are anchored where the two streams first agree, and backward hippocampal rollouts that converge on that point constitute retroactive causal inference over candidate pasts.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: intake-hygiene: register gated-check survivors -> ARC-146, MECH-563, MECH-564, MECH-565, ARC-147; 12 candidates stay gated (plasticity x11, lateralisation MECH x1)
claim_rows.title: Verbal or symbolic representation of an undifferentiated affective action-pressure is itself a low-risk PARTIAL commit: it discharges the pressure into a cheap committed trajectory, and when that symbolic commit produces prediction mismatch (the articulated expectation fails) or social witnessing (another agent responds to it), the mismatch updates future trajectory-arbitration scoring for the affect's full-cost action alternatives -- which is the mechanism by which articulating an urge changes what the agent later does.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: intake-hygiene: register gated-check survivors -> ARC-146, MECH-563, MECH-564, MECH-565, ARC-147; 12 candidates stay gated (plasticity x11, lateralisation MECH x1)
claim_rows.title: Rumination is a mismatchless symbolic-commit loop: repeated symbolic commits (verbal or imagined rehearsal of an affective pressure) that generate NO prediction mismatch and NO social witnessing fail to re-rank the candidate set, so the same trajectory is re-proposed and re-committed symbolically while arbitration never updates -- a perseveration signature distinct from over-persistence of an EMBODIED commitment, and the discriminator between therapeutic articulation and rumination is whether a symbolic commit changes subsequent arbitration scores.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: CDQ-010 Register: MECH-566/567/568 transfer mechanisms, wired into SD-106.depends_on
claim_rows.title: objective_consumer_transfer_blocked_by_readout_reparameterisation_invariance. SD-106's preservation term is ||W f(x) - x||^2 / var with W a FREELY-TRAINED linear decoder optimised jointly with the encoder (ree-v3 ree_core/latent/zworld_p0.py:556-558, head_params joined to the same Adam). That loss is EXACTLY invariant to the general linear group acting on the 32-dim code: for any invertible A, the pair (A.f, W.A^-1) attains an identical loss. The objective therefore cannot distinguish two codes in the same GL(32) orbit and cannot prefer a well-conditioned representative over an arbitrarily ill-conditioned one.
