The consumer -- a fixed-capacity MLP trained by SGD on the FROZEN code -- is NOT invariant to A: its reachable solutions and sample efficiency depend on the code's spectrum. Transfer therefore fails not because information is missing but because the objective is structurally blind to the property that governs whether the consumer can use it. The substrate's own comment cites Baldi & Hornik (1989) as its anchor ('with a linear decoder the MSE optimum IS the principal subspace') -- and that theorem yields the principal SUBSPACE only up to an arbitrary invertible transformation, never the principal COMPONENTS. PCA-32 is the canonical orthonormal eigenvalue-ordered representative of that same orbit, which is why it clears the bar 3/3 at matched reconstruction (world_obs R^2 0.9984 vs SD-106's 0.9974) while SD-106 falls 0.1227 short at the consumer. The conditioning terms REE does carry bound the orbit only partially: the VICReg variance term is a ONE-SIDED floor, mean relu(gamma - std_j), with no cap on anisotropy above the floor, and the covariance term decorrelates without equalising, so the code's condition number is unconstrained.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: CDQ-010 Register: MECH-566/567/568 transfer mechanisms, wired into SD-106.depends_on
claim_rows.title: encoder_objective_must_carry_the_consumers_target / auxiliary_task_head_transfer. An encoder objective transfers to an action consumer only to the extent the objective itself contains a term whose target is the consumer's target, or an improvement on it. Task-agnostic variance preservation contains no such term, so its gradient is not systematically aligned with what the consumer reads and additional budget moves the encoder along directions the consumer does not use. MuZero is the limit case: the representation function receives gradients ONLY from policy, value and reward heads, and the paper explicitly refuses any requirement that the hidden state reconstruct the observation or match the true environment state. The ENABLING CONDITION, which is easy to miss and is load-bearing, is that MuZero's policy target is the MCTS-IMPROVED search policy rather than the network's own prior: an encoder trained toward a consumer's CURRENT output has a degenerate self-agreement fixed point, so 'train the encoder through its consumer' is incomplete without a policy-improvement operator. DreamerV3 is the affordable form and REE's correct template: task-relevant supervision enters the representation objective as AUXILIARY HEADS (reward and continue) on the same latent as the decoder at beta_pred = 1.0, while actor and critic gradients are STOPPED at the model state -- so the consumer's TARGET reaches the encoder and the consumer's GRADIENT does not. CORRECTION OF RECORD: the CDQ-010 row's premise that DreamerV3 carries actor/value gradients into the latent is wrong in the gradient sense, and that correction is the mechanism, because it is what lets a preservation objective transfer without any single consumer owning a SHARED latent.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: CDQ-010 Register: MECH-566/567/568 transfer mechanisms, wired into SD-106.depends_on
claim_rows.title: task_term_gradient_share_must_be_floored_not_weighted. Even when a task-aligned term is present in an encoder objective, transfer is gated by whether that term retains a non-trivial share of the GRADIENT against the preservation term; under fixed relative weights and no floor, raising the preservation weight monotonically starves it. REE has the crowding curve already measured on SD-106's own landing: mean held-out grounding lift 0.5702 (shipped) -> 0.4313 (w=50) -> 0.4064 (w=200, the arm V3-EXQ-1023a ran) -> 0.3982 (w=500), recorded there as a COST and never read as a mechanism. DreamerV3's corrective is a FLOOR rather than a weight: free bits, L = max(1, KL), contributes zero gradient below 1 nat, and the stated failure it prevents is exactly this one -- the regulariser wins, the code degenerates, the latent stops carrying task-relevant distinctions and 'the actor starves because the actor sees only the latent'. MuZero's analogue is per-head loss scaling by 1/K plus a 1/2 gradient scale at the dynamics entry. The general form this claim asserts: the protected quantity is the task term's gradient share, and it must be enforced by a SATURATING floor on the competing term, because a weight ratio must be re-tuned whenever anything else in the objective changes whereas a floor does not.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: 2026-09-18 affordance-valuation bridge -> ARC-149, MECH-575, MECH-576, MECH-577
claim_rows.title: An affordance-and-valuation bridge is architecturally NECESSARY between the world model and the commitment boundary: the representation E3 arbitrates over must be an intermediate, action-conditioned structure -- what this organism can now do in this world, annotated with predicted consequences -- and not a direct map from z_world to a policy distribution. The decomposition is observation -> z_world / E1-E2 -> affordance-and-action geometry -> competing approach / avoidance / investigation tendencies -> E3 / commitment boundary -> motor policy. The bridge is not a new selector placed beside E3 and not a motor-primitive library (SD-044 supplies primitives; the bridge says which are currently viable from this body-state in this world-state); it is the terrain on which world modelling, valuation, responsibility and commitment meet. SEPARABILITY FALSIFIER, which is the whole content of this commitment: if a direct z_world -> policy mapping at matched capacity and compute reproduces the FULL behavioural phenotype -- not merely task reward, but counterfactual sensitivity, anticipation of consequence, reversibility, repair, and the ability to account internally for why a higher-reward action was not committed -- then no intermediate action-conditioned representation is warranted and this commitment should be withdrawn in favour of ARC-002 plus MECH-125 alone. A reward-only win for the bridge does not confirm it; a reward-only loss does not refute it.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: CDQ-011 Register: MECH-572/573/574 across-sleep readout mechanisms, wired into INV-063.depends_on
claim_rows.title:
across_sleep_readout_sign_governed_by_consolidation_step_to_residual_ratio. A consolidation pass
measurably improves a frozen held-out readout only when the parameter displacement the pass imposes
is SMALL relative to the residual error it is reducing. REE's consolidator violates this by
construction: CrossModuleConsolidator.consolidate() builds a FRESH torch.optim.Adam per call
("built fresh each call so the pass owns no persistent optimiser state",
ree-v3 ree_core/sleep/cross_module_consolidation.py), and a fresh Adam's bias-corrected first step
is approximately lr*sign(g) REGARDLESS of |g|, so displacement is bounded by n_steps*lr = 8*1e-3 =
0.008 whatever the gradient is. V3-EXQ-1063's landed manifest shows world_head_max_abs_delta at
0.00798-0.00807 in 6 of 6 lever-on cells (99.7-100.9% of that bound) across bases whose residual
battery MSE differs by a factor of about 1000. The step size is therefore set by the OPTIMISER, not
by how converged the head is -- so on a converged base the pass overwrites a residual it is 18-41x
larger than, and the measured "sleep degrades the readout" is that overwrite rather than a property
of consolidation.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: CDQ-011 Register: MECH-572/573/574 across-sleep readout mechanisms, wired into INV-063.depends_on
claim_rows.title:
heldout_readout_readability_must_be_referenced_to_the_TRIVIAL_predictor_not_random_init. A
consolidation pass can only improve a held-out readout on the component of the target that is NOT
reproducible by the trivial predictor, so a readout is READABLE in requirement (i)'s own sense only
when it is demonstrably above that predictor -- not merely far from random initialisation. INV-063
leg B's existing gate uses the wrong reference: conv_rel_drop is normalised by the RANDOM-INIT battery
MSE (V3-EXQ-1063's own F5 note), and random init on a forward model is vastly worse than simply
copying the input, so conv_rel_drop >= 0.99 is satisfiable while the head sits AT its degenerate value.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: CDQ-011 Register: MECH-572/573/574 across-sleep readout mechanisms, wired into INV-063.depends_on
claim_rows.title:
consolidation_improves_a_heldout_readout_only_when_replay_REGENERATES_an_improved_target. A
consolidation pass over stored experience improves a frozen held-out readout only to the extent replay
supplies a target the current model does not already match -- re-presenting the originally observed
target to a head that has converged on it carries no information, and what remains is whatever
displacement the optimiser imposes on its own account. MuZero Reanalyze is the external positive case:
it "revisits its past time-steps and re-executes its search using the latest model parameters,
potentially resulting in a better quality policy than the original search", and that RE-DERIVED target
drives 80% of updates. REE's sleep world-forward trainer has no improvement operator: compute_e2_world_loss
draws (world[i], action[i+1], world[i+1]) straight from the replay buffers and descends against the
originally observed next state, unchanged on every cycle.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: 2026-09-18 affordance-valuation bridge -> ARC-149, MECH-575, MECH-576, MECH-577
claim_rows.title: The affordance-and-valuation bridge of ARC-149 is a FIELD with metric structure, not a list of candidates or an action-value table: similar action trajectories occupy neighbouring regions, and the geometry deforms lawfully under single-factor changes to the organism or world while world IDENTITY in z_world remains stable. PRE-REGISTERED DEFORMATION SIGNATURE, which is what makes this separable from a ranked candidate list: holding the observation fixed and varying exactly one of (i) agent position, (ii) agent energy or body state, (iii) an obstacle or route, (iv) availability of a motor primitive, (v) presence of a threatened or beneficial other, or (vi) observation uncertainty, the action-conditioned representation should change in a way that PREDICTS WHICH TRAJECTORIES BECAME REACHABLE OR UNAVAILABLE, while a decoder of world identity trained before the intervention remains accurate. PRIMARY FALSIFIER: if the representation's response to these interventions is fully explained by a re-ranking of a fixed candidate set -- i.e. a permutation of scores with no change in neighbourhood structure -- it is an action-value table and this claim is refuted. SECOND FALSIFIER: if world identity degrades whenever the geometry deforms, the bridge is not separable from z_world and ARC-149's intermediate object collapses into the world model. NULL RESULT EXPECTED TO BE COMMON - a learned bridge may simply become an opaque map (the source thought's affordance-collapse failure mode), which is this claim failing, not the assay failing.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: 2026-09-18 affordance-valuation bridge -> ARC-149, MECH-575, MECH-576, MECH-577
claim_rows.title: Under conflict, rival action tendencies are preserved as TEMPORALLY ALTERNATING discrete states before commitment rather than being concurrently summed into one instantaneous score, and the alternation statistics -- not the winning score -- carry the distinction between productive deliberation and pathology. A policy becomes dominant because it is better supported, more stable, more precise, compatible with constraints, or survives longer under counterfactual scrutiny, which is a different process from being assigned the largest instantaneous value. PRE-REGISTERED TELEMETRY, recorded per genuine conflict: candidate trajectory identity, tendency state (approach / avoid / pause / investigate / affiliate / protect / repair), confidence or precision, DWELL TIME, SWITCHING RATE, constraint exposure, reason for final dominance, and reason for interruption or re-opening. THREE REGIMES PREDICTED TO BE DISTINGUISHABLE rather than one - productive deliberation (bounded alternation that terminates in commitment or in an escalation to information-gathering), pathological flicker (alternation that never achieves dominance, leaving the organism inert), and perseveration (dominance achieved and then held against disconfirming evidence). PRIMARY FALSIFIER: if a concurrent soft-competitive model with no alternation -- tendencies co-active and summed, as MECH-140's soft-competitive disinhibition already permits -- reproduces the commitment outcomes AND the conflict-resolution latencies at matched capacity, the alternation is epiphenomenal and this claim is refuted. SECOND FALSIFIER: if dwell time and switching rate carry no information about the deliberation-versus-pathology distinction once decision difficulty is controlled for, the telemetry is descriptive only and the claim's discriminating content is unreachable.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: 2026-09-18 affordance-valuation bridge -> ARC-149, MECH-575, MECH-576, MECH-577
claim_rows.title: The sensorimotor path carries BOTH a shared world-anchored component and phase-exclusive components, with the degree of overlap varying systematically along the path rather than being constant: a single representation serves orienting, prospective rollout, commitment preparation and execution / feedback control, while reserving some dimensions for the current phase. The shared component preserves continuity (the action remains about the same world, body and other agents); the phase-exclusive components permit opposite computations, since exploration must PRESERVE alternatives while execution must SUPPRESS them in favour of robust closed-loop control. PRE-REGISTERED MEASUREMENTS across the four phases: shared versus phase-exclusive latent dimensionality, stability of decision-relevant world variables within the shared component, whether execution-specific dimensions improve closed-loop control, and -- the load-bearing one -- whether they do so WITHOUT erasing alternative-trajectory information earlier than commitment requires. PRIMARY FALSIFIER: a fully shared representation (single undifferentiated latent serving every phase) matches closed-loop control performance at matched capacity, in which case phase-exclusive structure is unnecessary. SECOND FALSIFIER, in the opposite direction: a fully serial pipeline (perception completes, then planning completes, then execution begins, with no shared component) matches it, in which case the shared world-anchored component is unnecessary. A binary test for decodability or for the presence of an attractor does not discriminate any of these and is not admissible evidence here.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: 2026-09-19 dynamic consensus -> MECH-578, MECH-579
claim_rows.title: Agreement-dependent timescale separation as the signature of reciprocal reconciliation: when two REE subsystems are reciprocally coupled through a learned selective correspondence, joint states in which the two are MUTUALLY COMPATIBLE should decay more slowly than equally-strong incompatible joint states -- tau_agree > tau_disagree -- so that the coupled dynamics progressively bias the pair toward mutually supportable states WITHOUT either system converging on the other's representation. Integration is thereby dynamical compatibility, not representational equality, and the terminal pair (A*, B*) is mutually supportable rather than identical. This proposes a FURTHER NAMED PROPERTY -- RECIPROCALLY RECONCILED -- which is deliberately NOT a numbered rung on INV-105's ladder. INV-105's seven rungs are each a property of ONE VARIABLE'S STATUS in a latent space and are monotone (reaching rung n entails 1..n-1); this property has a different subject (a COUPLED PAIR'S JOINT DYNAMICS) and dissociates from the ladder in BOTH directions -- generic recurrence can produce tau_agree > tau_disagree with nothing at rung 4 (bridgeable), which is exactly what falsifier (2) below concedes, and a purely feedforward bridge can reach rung 7 (behaviourally beneficial) with no reciprocal reconciliation whatever. Two properties that dissociate in both directions are not adjacent rungs on one monotone ladder. GOV-CONTRACT-3's 'stated here rather than as an eighth rung, to avoid a second ladder that would invite collapse with the first' is the governing precedent, and GFLAG-0235 (resolved, user-approved 2026-09-10) is the governing ruling: it chose forward-reference over amendment for MECH-548's eighth-rung proposal. THREE PRE-REGISTERED FALSIFIERS, each an ablation that must abolish the separation if the claim is true. (1) COUPLING-DIRECTION ABLATION: measure tau_agree and tau_disagree under intact bidirectional coupling, A->B only, B->A only, and both removed; if a unidirectional condition reproduces the separation, what is being measured is persistence, not reciprocal reconciliation, and the claim is refuted. (2) CORRESPONDENCE SCRAMBLE AT MATCHED COUPLING STRENGTH: preserve total coupling magnitude while permuting WHICH dimensions are connected; if the separation survives a scramble, it is generic recurrence rather than learned like-to-like correspondence, and the claim is refuted. (3) FALSE-CONSENSUS CHALLENGE: inject a shared but INCORRECT latent signal into both systems; if agreement alone stabilises it and independent environmental error cannot destabilise it, the mechanism manufactures coherence without correctness and must not be built. Perturbation magnitude must be matched across the agree and disagree conditions or the comparison is uninterpretable.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: 2026-09-19 dynamic consensus -> MECH-578, MECH-579
claim_rows.title: Developmental pruning of an early dense cross-system interface carves a CONSENSUS TOPOLOGY, not merely a translation dictionary: what a maturing REE discovers and retains is not only which dimensions across two subsystems CORRESPOND, but which couplings produce stable useful agreement, which disagreements are resolvable, which dimensions should remain INDEPENDENT, how strongly each direction should influence the other, and when coupling should be opened or gated. Development therefore runs from DENSE EXPLORATORY COUPLING to LEARNED SELECTIVE RECIPROCAL COUPLING, rather than from dense translation to sparse translation. PRIMARY PREDICTION, which is what separates this from ordinary subtractive sparsification: MECH-578's agreement-dependent timescale separation should EMERGE OVER LEARNING and should become SELECTIVE -- early systems showing broad, unstable, largely undifferentiated coupling, and mature systems showing stronger persistence specifically for the agreement modes that are BEHAVIOURALLY USEFUL, not for agreement in general. PRIMARY FALSIFIER: if the separation is present at initialisation, or if it grows uniformly across all agreement modes irrespective of which ones cash out in adaptive behaviour, then what is being observed is a property of the coupling architecture rather than a learned topology, and this claim is refuted while MECH-578 may still stand. SECOND FALSIFIER: if a mature selective topology is reachable WITHOUT the dense early phase -- trained directly at the mature connectivity at matched final capacity -- the developmental ordering claimed here is unnecessary (this is the MECH-549 test applied to the interface).

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: 2026-09-22 action-conditioned world model + arousal-gated commitment -> MECH-580 (WHICH-SET breadth face); digestion draft staged, not applied
claim_rows.title: Within REE's GLOBAL-SCALAR arousal routes (the three MECH-463 names), arousal alters WHICH candidate is committed only by modulating commit-ELIGIBILITY BREADTH -- the width of the basal-ganglia eligibility envelope, i.e. the size of the candidate set admitted to the commit gate -- never by reordering candidate scores. High phasic arousal narrows the admitted set toward the incumbent (exploit); low or tonic arousal widens it (explore). This WHICH-SET face is dissociable from the WHETHER face (commit threshold / gate: MECH-465, MECH-106, MECH-090) and the WHEN face (E3 cadence: MECH-093, MECH-005), and it is the ONE route by which a global scalar can change the committed candidate without contradicting MECH-463's argmax-invariance: a scalar cannot reorder K scores, but it can truncate the admitted set and, under a sampled commit pick, change the support the sample is drawn from. PRECONDITION that makes this observable at all: candidate futures must be ACTION-DISCRIMINABLE under the world model (ARC-002 strong form; SD-e1 rollout consistency) -- with near-identical candidate scores a breadth change admits or excludes nothing that differs, so a null under non-discriminable candidates is uninterpretable. The WHEN and WHETHER faces carry no such dependency, which is why the 2026-09-18 inertness of the commit-readiness gate and the 2026-09-22 endogenous z_beta dynamic-range defect are instrument faults with their own repairs, not consequences of the world-model gap.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: ARC-083 follow-on: register ARC-150 triadic co-reference primitive; soften v5 readiness gates (GFLAG-0309)
claim_rows.title: Triadic co-reference primitive (declarative joint attention / synchronic two-slot identification): the agent can hold its OWN slot and ONE OTHER agent's slot simultaneously bound to a SINGLE shared object referent, for no instrumental reason. This relational self-other-object binding -- not a stable self (ARC-081) and not a generic object-persistence buffer (ARC-080 PILLAR 1) -- is the developmental prerequisite otherness inference (ARC-083) and theory of mind actually run through. It sits on ARC-080's slot-allocation machinery as a binding operation over two concurrently-live slots plus one object token.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: CDQ-012 Register: MECH-581..585 + SD-PP-B10/B11 (action readability at small displacement; harm-PE attribution)
claim_rows.title:
world_forward_comparator_gain_scaled_to_the_predicted_action_consequence. The comparator that reads the
world-forward prediction error carries a GAIN (precision) term set by the magnitude of the action
consequence the forward model predicts, relative to its own residual at that scale, so that a small
action-driven displacement stays legible to the comparator. Subtraction of the predicted self-caused
change (SD-007 ReafferencePredictor, MECH-098) is one member of the corollary-discharge family; gain
modulation scaled to the predicted consequence is a distinct member that REE does not implement, and it
is the member that keeps a contradiction of a small predicted consequence separable from the converged
residual. Without it, every contradiction-based falsifier on z_world (MECH-574's novel-target arm, the
precision-provenance intake's F3 anti-self-sealing test) is scored in absolute z units against a
per-step movement of ~3-4e-3 per dim and is unposeable.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: CDQ-012 Register: MECH-581..585 + SD-PP-B10/B11 (action readability at small displacement; harm-PE attribution)
claim_rows.title:
zworld_encoder_shaped_through_the_dynamics_keeps_action_caused_change. The z_world encoder keeps the
action-caused part of the observation's per-step change only if a transition objective reaches it: the
world-forward (or E1) loss must carry gradient into the encoder through the ONLINE input z_t while the
TARGET z_{t+1} stays stop-gradient, with an anti-collapse floor against trivially predictable codes. REE
detaches both ends (agent.py buffer write; SD-070 P0 trains the encoder on static single-frame targets),
so the encoder never learns which of its directions the action moves, and action information present
in world_obs (~0.69 of the per-step change is action-attributable at the observation) is lost before
z_world (~0.22-0.38 action-attributable in z_world with an untrained encoder).

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: CDQ-012 Register: MECH-581..585 + SD-PP-B10/B11 (action readability at small displacement; harm-PE attribution)
claim_rows.title:
reafference_reading_A_zworld_is_self_cancelled_so_action_readability_lives_in_a_separate_predictor. Under
SD-007, z_world is DESIGNED to have the action-predictable self-caused change subtracted; the forward
model on the corrected z_world should therefore predict EXTERNAL dynamics, and the action-readable
signal belongs in the separate action-conditioned predictor that produced the subtraction (the
ReafferencePredictor / a prior in the RSSM sense). Demanding that world_forward read its action from a
cancelled stream asks the wrong component.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: CDQ-012 Register: MECH-581..585 + SD-PP-B10/B11 (action readability at small displacement; harm-PE attribution)
claim_rows.title:
reafference_reading_B_cancellation_is_perception_side_so_the_forward_model_predicts_the_uncorrected_stream.
Under SD-007 the subtraction is a PERCEPTION-side operation on what the organism reports as external;
the forward model still receives the efference copy and predicts the reafferent change BEFORE
subtraction. world_forward should therefore be trained against z_world_raw (retained at stack.py:1513,
before both the reafference correction and the EMA), and it is on that prediction that contradiction-
based falsifiers should be posed.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: CDQ-012 Register: MECH-581..585 + SD-PP-B10/B11 (action readability at small displacement; harm-PE attribution)
claim_rows.title:
harm_prediction_error_is_attributed_to_world_surprise_only_from_a_competent_calibrated_predictor. The
harm-stream prediction error that dACC consumes is informative about the WORLD only when two conditions
hold: the harm forward model beats a trivial baseline (persistence) and the error exceeds that model's
own calibrated, per-state expected error. Error beyond calibrated expectation from a predictor that
beats baseline reads as world surprise; every other error reads as model error. The precision that
weights the harm PE must therefore be the harm predictor's OWN reliability, not a precision borrowed
from another stream.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: registered_utc field
claim_rows.title: A pre-registered threshold criterion is admissible only if its bar is denominated on the CONTROL ARM OF THE RUN THAT WILL BE SCORED AGAINST IT, at that run's own operating point -- not on the same quantity recorded in another run's landed manifest, and not on an absolute value taken from the design's rationale. A bar the run's own control fails, on a majority of its seeds, is measuring baseline variance rather than the manipulation's effect, and a PASS/FAIL returned against it is uninterpretable in BOTH directions: a FAIL is unattributable to the manipulation, and a PASS is a demonstration that the manipulation exceeded a threshold the control could not reach for unrelated reasons. This is a distinct defect from falsifier-runnability (the DV moves fine; the partition is misplaced) and applies with full force to runs carrying `claim_ids: []`, which set their criteria in the driver with no registry review.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: governance 2026-09-24: V3-necessity phase-leak walk -- 4 clusters resolved (b), 5 roots + 2 CONFLICTs -> 0
claim_rows.title: Provenance-bearing event token: every autobiographical event token carries an explicit provenance/commitment-status structure -- event_token = {time, place, self_state, other_agents, perspective, affect, residue, source_status, committed_vs_imagined} -- and a ONE-WAY gate ensures imagined / simulated future tokens can be used for planning without ever acquiring committed-history status. The scarce resource in mental time travel is not capacity but provenance: any path that lets a simulated event accrue committed weight is a confabulation bug.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: register MECH-586 harm-forecast uncertainty redirects control, does not discount expected adverse cost (staged 2026-09-24 functional-organism intake, ea1e6e21dbd; chip-20260924-mech586-register)
claim_rows.title: Harm-forecast uncertainty redirects control but does not discount expected adverse cost in selection: low confidence in a hazard prediction may lower that prediction's authority to update beliefs, and may route control toward investigation, a shorter trusted planning horizon, or preservation of alternatives (MECH-485 orient/survey leg), but it must not by itself lower the weight that the predicted adverse outcome carries in E3 candidate ranking. Update-authority precision, prediction confidence, and adverse-outcome cost are three separable quantities at the E3 integration boundary.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: ingest 5 raw thoughts (2026-09-24/25) + register 12 gated intake-hygiene candidates + residue-care pair -> 17 claims (MECH-588..595, ARC-151..154, Q-109/110, GOV-FRONTIER-1, GOV-INSERT-1, GOV-DEFEAT-1); MECH-453 notes amended; Stage 2 orphans back-filled
claim_rows.title: Plasticity gates in REE are DEFAULT-BLOCKED (de-repression polarity), not admission windows: a teaching signal of any kind (reward prediction error, harm prediction error, novelty, salience, social or affective discrepancy) is a proposal whose only effect is to RELEASE a write that is already staged at, and carried by, its target -- it neither carries the write's content nor opens a window through which writes flow -- so the gate's specificity lives on the TARGET (what is staged there and what release it requires) rather than on a type assigned to the event. The gate family REE already registers at channel, event, tag and window grain (MECH-261, MECH-368, MECH-431, MECH-453, MECH-067) is to be read with this polarity, so that any gate-controller failure -- a missing, late or malformed release -- fails CLOSED (the write stays blocked), whereas an admission-phrased gate of the same nominal permeability can fail OPEN.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: ingest 5 raw thoughts (2026-09-24/25) + register 12 gated intake-hygiene candidates + residue-care pair -> 17 claims (MECH-588..595, ARC-151..154, Q-109/110, GOV-FRONTIER-1, GOV-INSERT-1, GOV-DEFEAT-1); MECH-453 notes amended; Stage 2 orphans back-filled
claim_rows.title: Plasticity release in REE is indexed on the DEPTH of the write target, not only on the teaching signal, the actor or channel, or the phase: the same admitted, real-provenance teaching signal may be released into a shallow target (transient activation, salience weight, local transition model) while its write into a deep target (self/other model, goal structure, ethical constraint, identity invariant) stays blocked, and the RELEASE REQUIREMENT grows monotonically with depth -- deeper targets need more independent release conditions (corroboration across episodes, offline integration, verifier-mediated commit) before a write is released. This extends REE's existing authority stratification (INV-020, MECH-064, MECH-067, ARC-020), which is keyed on actor, channel and phase, to ORDINARY EXPERIENTIAL LEARNING, and generalises MECH-511's two-level local-vs-deep E1 routing to an ordered target index. It does NOT make deep targets less plastic: write magnitude once released is governed separately (MECH-592), and INV-056's retained plasticity of social, goal and epistemic-ethical substrates must survive the grading.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: thought-intake: ingest 5 raw thoughts (2026-09-24/25) + register 12 gated intake-hygiene candidates + residue-care pair -> 17 claims (MECH-588..595, ARC-151..154, Q-109/110, GOV-FRONTIER-1, GOV-INSERT-1, GOV-DEFEAT-1); MECH-453 notes amended; Stage 2 orphans back-filled
claim_rows.title: REE's ethical architecture governs which experiences may alter the agent, not only which actions it takes: at runtime, the harm- and residue-bearing signals REE already carries -- not a separate ethics module or moral score (INV-001) -- are inputs to plasticity RELEASE for deep targets (ARC-152), and this runtime plasticity selection, rather than design-time evaluation alone or action-selection ethics alone, is the mechanism by which INV-093's floor (competence refinement must not trade away harm sensitivity, residue accumulation or commitment integrity) is held during ongoing learning. An agent whose ethics act only at action selection, with ungated experiential learning, can learn its way out of its own harm sensitivity while every individual action it takes is still ethically selected.

claim_rows.title: E3's basal-ganglia commitment includes a DA-ACh COORDINATION layer that is separable both from the signals it coordinates (the dopaminergic teaching signal and the cholinergic TAN-pause window, MECH-453) and from action selection: it sets the temporal coupling between the two, and thereby which recently-active policy traces (MECH-452) are reinforced and how PERSISTENTLY the reinforced write sticks. Its setpoint is a GAIN WITH AN INTERIOR OPTIMUM that trades acquisition speed against effort and persistence recalibration -- it is NOT tuned to maximise learning rate, and a design that tunes it for fastest learning optimises a quantity the biology declines to optimise. With action selection (ARC-107/MECH-449), reinforcement marking (MECH-452) and plasticity permission (MECH-453, MECH-368) already registered as separate operations, this layer supplies the two not yet owned: write-persistence (flexibility) tuning and effort recalibration of the written policy. claim_rows.title: Open-defeater rule (indefeasibility at the summary layer): an evidence edge -- a (run, claim) pair counted in claim_evidence -- that is named by an OPEN governance flag of type evidence_discrepancy or contested_disposition is CONTESTED evidence until that flag is resolved by a recorded COUNTER (a confirmed autopsy, an applied edge qualifier such as scoring_excluded / non_contributory / superseded / duplicate_of, a discriminating run, or an explicit governance judgement that the doubt does not defeat the inference). Contested evidence KEEPS its score -- excluding it is the resolution's job, not the flag's -- but it loses its standing as UNCONTESTED: every summary-layer surface that reports the claim (claims.json and the claim page, CURRENT_FRONT, insights_report, the morning digest, a governance promotion agenda) must name the open defeater beside the result, and no claim may be promoted, or described as confirmed or established, on the strength of evidence whose discriminating members are all contested. A defeater is a scientific object with its own lifecycle (raised -> countered | upheld), not a process ticket, and "no open defeaters" is a negative that must return cannot-determine, not "clean", when the flag registry cannot be read.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: registered_utc field
claim_rows.title: Frontier-evidence doctrine: literature is evidence and constraint, never permission. After a documented, scoped, good-faith search, every mechanism claim may carry a literature_status of DIRECT (a sufficiently close mechanism exists and is adapted), ADJACENT (components or analogues constrain the design but no source supplies the required mechanism or coupling), or FRONTIER (no sufficiently close mechanism found; the requirement follows from a REE architectural or ethical question). A scoped search that finds no direct precedent is a SANCTIONED TERMINAL outcome of a literature pull ("no direct mechanism found; adjacent evidence constrains A, B, C; the remainder proceeds experimentally"), not a veto and not evidence against the mechanism -- unless a stated reason shows that the relevant literature should already contain the mechanism if it were viable. Adjacent literature is recorded as constraint, and its literature confidence must not be read as direct support. A frontier mechanism may be built (default-OFF) and promoted on REE experimental evidence alone, but absence of literature RAISES the experimental burden (pre-registered competing candidates, production-path causal reach, negative controls incl. channel-presence and proxy-reward, ablation, world-family replication, a non-compensable adjudication battery) rather than lowering it; frontier status is never itself evidence for a mechanism; and later literature convergence updates literature confidence without rewriting the claim's historical REE-frontier provenance.

claim_rows.first_seen_subject: registered_utc field
claim_rows.title: Insertion-dependence counts against the derivation: when a mechanism claimed to follow from REE's axioms (an axiom-to-mechanism crossing such as similarity -> standing, recognition -> responsibility, modelling -> care, harm-attribution -> repair) repeatedly fails to produce its predicted causal pattern in a capable organism UNLESS the desired ethical outcome is directly inserted -- as a reward or bonus term, a hard-coded rule or action, a privileged label, a hard constraint, or the deletion of the unethical affordance -- that pattern is admissible NEGATIVE evidence against the claimed derivation, recorded against the derivational claim and the corresponding crossing, and must not be absorbed by progressively more elaborate scaffolding. An insertion arm is an ORACLE intervention: it may establish a ceiling or show that a downstream consumer can use the outcome, but it never counts as evidence FOR the derivation.

claim_rows.title: Monostrategy has at least two separable etiologies that must be discriminated before any coordination remedy is admissible: REPERTOIRE ABSENCE (Type A -- behaviourally useful alternatives are never formed, proposed or represented in the tensors the evaluator consumes, so there is nothing to route) and REPERTOIRE-ACCESS COLLAPSE (Type B -- a useful alternative is proposed and represented at the evaluator's input yet repeatedly fails to reach committed, executed behaviour, and a change of ACCESS alone, with no retraining and no new content, re-exposes it). The two are separated by a staged chain read at matched decision states -- proposed -> represented -> evaluated -> committed -> executed -- under generation-side injection of the useful alternative at matched pool size: Type A is rescued by injection; Type B is not, and loses authority at a named later stage. ADMISSIBILITY CONSEQUENCE: a routing / dynamic-coordination / phase remedy is licensed only by a Type-B verdict obtained in an ecology where at least two strategies are each useful and a fixed strategy is measurably suboptimal, with a competence gate met, and against matched static-learned-bridge, existing-diversity-pressure, state-independent random-routing and content-ablation controls that all fail. OCCURRENCE FALSIFIER: if, in such an ecology, generation-side injection or the static bridge rescues every monostrategic seed, Type B does not occur in REE and the V3 synaptic approximation stands.

claim_rows.title: Consensus over-stabilisation (Type C monostrategy) is a third etiology, distinct from repertoire absence and repertoire-access collapse: behaviourally useful alternatives are represented AND reach the relevant subsystems through a live route, and a perturbation can transiently move an individual subsystem toward the alternative, yet selective reciprocal coupling repeatedly relaxes the joint system back to one dominant cross-system coalition -- the organism can hear the alternative but cannot reorganise around it. Signature: excess dwell time around the dominant coalition; after a contingency reversal, higher-quality contradicting evidence held by one subsystem is extinguished rather than propagated; and weakening or correspondence-scrambling the SELECTIVE reciprocal coupling at matched coupling magnitude releases the lock-in WITHOUT degrading either subsystem's local competence. The healthy target is conditional, not maximal: behaviourally grounded agreement persists longer than unsupported disagreement (MECH-578) while strong counterevidence can still destabilise the coalition. FALSIFIERS: (1) the lock-in survives cutting the reciprocal coupling -- the basin then lies inside one subsystem (MECH-080 arm 3) or in habit dominance (MECH-587), not in consensus; (2) releasing the coupling releases the lock-in only by degrading local competence -- generic disruption, not escape; (3) a uniform attractor-flattening or matched-noise intervention restores evidence-sensitive switching as well as selective-coupling release -- no consensus-specific mechanism.

claim_rows.title: The control-plane significance of a prediction-error event is a LEARNED, history- and context-conditioned routing mapping -- R = P(route | PE, context, history) over at least epistemic orient/model-revision, defensive threat/rapid-protective action, repair, and uncertainty-hold -- acquired from what has historically FOLLOWED prediction error, and dissociable from PE detection, PE magnitude and PE precision. Two agents with matched error statistics but different error-consequence histories should route an identical benign mismatch differently before any new harm occurs, and a threat route shifts WHAT is learned (threat-context acquisition over causal model correction) through existing mode-conditioned write gating. The learned route may modulate the control/salience readout of an error but must never overwrite or attenuate the mismatch content that world and self models learn from; overgeneralisation of an error-threat coupling learned in harm-predictive contexts to epistemically benign errors is the predicted failure mode.

claim_rows.title: Under social correction, the error route recruited at detection (MECH-590) conditions the downstream attribution locus of correction (MECH-413): threat-routed error biases credit assignment toward global-self attribution and toward avoidance/appeasement over specific model update and repair, whereas epistemically routed error keeps correction local to the act, rule or model. A safe-base history (INV-082) protects correction by altering the ROUTE of a large error, not by attenuating, hiding or pre-empting the error signal; a safety mechanism that works by reducing prediction error fails the requirement.

claim_rows.title: Adult plasticity REUSES developmental plasticity operators, and that reuse is correct only under target- and time-restricted release: an operator carried over from development (the HuD/ELAVL4 mRNA-stabilisation class is the anchoring case) must run in the adult as a de-repressed, target-restricted GAIN with an interior optimum, not as the unrestricted developmental operator -- running it unrestricted does not make the adult learn more broadly or more eagerly, it makes it learn worse. The restriction is therefore a correctness condition of adult plasticity rather than a safety wrapper around it, and INV-056's "retain elevated plasticity" in social, goal and epistemic-ethical substrates must be implemented as retained CAPACITY under a gate, never as the developmental operator left running.

claim_rows.title: A real-provenance teaching signal with ethical salience that is REFUSED a write into a deep target, because that target's release conditions are unmet (ARC-152), is RETAINED as an explicit unresolved record -- neither written nor discarded -- carrying its source, intended target, salience and the unmet condition, and is available to offline integration (ARC-020's MAY-update classes, ARC-137's typed offline transformations) and to later re-proposal. Under de-repression polarity this is the natural state of a refused write: the staged write persists unreleased. The claim is restricted to REAL-provenance signals refused on TARGET-DEPTH grounds; simulated, replayed or imagined content refused on PROVENANCE grounds (MECH-094, INV-011) must leave no such record, because recording it would turn imagination into a belief- or residue-bearing trace.

The right bias is a population PARAMETER rather than an architectural constant (arcuate lateralisation ranges from extreme-left to symmetric, and more symmetric individuals recall words better by semantic association), so REE's commitment is the channel's separation from the symbolic route, with its degree of asymmetry left tunable. claim_rows.title: A control operating point (threshold, cap, saturation constant, or cost weight) that reads a LEARNED quantity -- a latent magnitude, prediction error, salience, effort, confidence or threat signal whose distribution moves across training, seeds, developmental stage and state -- must be denominated on an endogenous estimate of that quantity's own scale (or on a producer whose scale is anchored), not on an absolute raw constant; otherwise the regime it gates is determined by arbitrary numerical scale rather than information content, and degenerates to permanent crossing, permanent silence, saturation (a graded transform collapsing to a gain change), or scale-determined dominance between controllers. The denomination must preserve the condition-relevant discrimination of the signal: an operating point that stabilises regime occupancy by habituating to a chronically high signal (normalising real danger into 'baseline') violates this claim rather than satisfying it, and no denomination can restore information the producer has already lost.

claim_rows.title: A strong regime that suppresses the organism's normal interaction or information gathering (freeze, defensive mode, exploit-only or monostrategic policy, habitual dominance, attentional fixation, frozen plasticity, strong commitment, a high-confidence attractor) must have at least one endogenous termination input that continues to change DURING the regime -- time- or interoception-integrating accumulators, exogenous change the organism can sense without acting, or internally generated probes -- because a regime whose exit condition is a function only of evidence produced by the behaviour it suppresses is absorbing in any environment that does not change on its own. claim_rows.title: Every candidate developmental prior in REE is classified on two INDEPENDENT axes -- candidate-necessary vs developmental accelerator (improves speed, stability or robustness but is dispensable or derivable in principle), and environment-general vs environment-specific -- with enabling architecture (plasticity, memory, temporal representation, an action interface, self/world state, a route from learned models to action selection) held out as a separate class that is not a prior; and when development fails, interventions are admitted in order of increasing environment-specificity (structured endogenous exploration, then general contingency / information-seeking mechanisms, then memory / plasticity mechanisms, and only then environment-specific priors), so that a required environment-specific prior is recorded as an ecological finding about that environment ('this world could not be reliably developed into under the current general set without additional ecological information') rather than as an innate requirement. Inherited structure is preferentially PROCEDURAL (how to discover a world: vary action enough to see its consequences, credit changes that follow one's own action, preserve regularities, reopen them when they stop predicting) rather than ONTOLOGICAL (what the world contains).

claim_rows.title: dual_route_proposal_generation. Candidate actions reach E3 selection from TWO concurrently active proposal ROUTES that differ in the representational format they search: a HABIT route that enumerates or samples directly over the agent's action repertoire (primitives early in life, practised chunks later; cheap, state-light, exact when the repertoire is small) and a DELIBERATIVE route that searches a learned abstract action-object space (SD-004 O, decoded to actions), which is state-dependent and composes novel multi-step behaviour. Both routes' candidates meet in one selection (single action channel, MECH-234) under reliability arbitration (MECH-477 / SD-081), so that the habit route supplies the committed choice in familiar states and the deliberative route when novelty or composition is required, and practised deliberative compositions migrate into the habit route's repertoire (ARC-071 / MECH-323 transfer). This is a PROPOSER-side split, distinct from SD-081's SCORER-side split (two depth reads of one E3 scorer over one candidate pool).

titles.ARC-059: REE developmental training proceeds in three ordered stages: (1) self-as-object — action-space discovery via motor experimentation, producing the substrate MECH-256's comparator requires; (2) objects-as-patterns — object-schema formation via experimental action on the world; (3) others-as-special-objects — modelling other agents as objects with their own policies. titles.MECH-278: Stage-2 specialisation of MECH-276: once the agent can distinguish self-produced from world-produced sensory change (stage 1 complete via MECH-277), it forms object-schemas via experimental action on the world. An object is the stable bundle of features that behave causally together under interventional perturbation -- push here, these features move together; occlude this, that cluster disappears. Object-schema formation is the stage-2 specialisation of the scientist-agent principle, with world-features as the target of intervention. V3's z_world (SD-005) is currently engineered pre-split; this is an architectural shortcut past stage 2.

titles.ARC-062: Rule-apprehension architectural slot, weak reading: a non-Bayesian rule-creator at the policy layer that proposes discriminative policy modes for the updaters (E3, training loop) to refine. V3 instantiation: a gated-policy architecture in which at least two policy heads share encoder features but receive different gating from a learned context discriminator (e.g., reef-context vs open-context heads). Tests the logical-necessity claim of MECH-309 within the existing V3 substrate without registering the heavier CandidateRule machinery (ARC-063 -- brought forward V4->V3 2026-05-18, this parenthetical is stale as of registration 2026-05-08). Architectural slot, not yet implemented.
titles.MECH-309: Monomodal policy collapse is the equilibrium of a parametric-policy agent without a rule-apprehension layer. Bayesian update and gradient descent revise weights over a hypothesis space they do not invent; without a non-Bayesian rule-creator that proposes discriminative policy modes ('near-hazard -> reef regime; else -> forage regime'), the trainer collapses to the smoothest single regime good-enough across the whole state space. Monostrategy is therefore not a bug of training but the predicted output of an architecture in which only updaters exist and no apprehender does. Falsifiable by the weak-reading rule-apprehension experiment (ARC-062): a gated-policy architecture trained on the same substrate should break the collapse where standard E3 does not.

titles.ARC-063: Rule-apprehension architectural slot, strong reading: a distributed CandidateRule field with tolerance-gated availability, hippocampal-rollout-eligibility shaping, structured per-action evidence-trace records, and waking-vs-sleep refinement asymmetry. Persistent flag for governance: this slot is expected to be needed if ARC-062 (weak reading) fails or proves insufficient at scale, AND independently as the architectural commitment that supports moral-residue attribution to the rule-field, sleep-vs-waking refinement asymmetry, and clinically-realistic failure modes (trauma schemas, paranoid rule fields, depressive rollout constraint).
titles.ARC-077: Socially-scaffolded rule-population pathway: the third rule-source, peer to ARC-062 (top-down gated-policy apprehension) and ARC-064 (bottom-up behavioural-pattern extraction), and upstream-fed by ARC-065 (behavioural diversity generation). titles.ARC-071: policy_composition_via_repeated_grounding (zoom-out / chunk a sequence of primitives into a single atomic primitive after repeated successful execution). Child of ARC-069 dynamic-regranularisation parent commitment. Architectural commitment: sequences of policy primitives that have been repeatedly executed together with consistent outcomes are accumulated into a single primitive that the rule-apprehension and diversity-generation layers can treat atomically. Trigger: repetition count + outcome consistency (slow accumulator). Direction: zoom out. Phenomenology anchor: 'making coffee was once seventeen motor acts; after a thousand repetitions it is one unit.' Names the TRANSITION mechanism (planned -> habitual chunk) that MECH-163 dual systems presupposes but does not specify.
titles.MECH-163: NARROWED 2026-07-22 to leg (1) only; RESTATED 2026-07-27 (model-free -> depth-limited). Two dissociable goal-directed PATHWAYS operate in parallel -- a HABIT pathway that is a myopic, DEPTH-LIMITED read of the forward model (SD-081 dualsystem_habit_depth, SNc/dorsal-striatum analog) sufficient for approach in practised contexts, and a hippocampally-planned pathway that is the FULL-HORIZON read of the SAME model (VTA/ventral-striatum+PFC analog) -- AND THE PLANNED PATHWAY IS PREFERENTIALLY RECRUITED IN NOVEL CONTEXTS. E1 2026-07-27: the descriptor `model-free` was STRUCK. ree_core contains no model-free machinery of any kind (no cached S-R values, no TD error, no Q-table) and never has; SD-081 implements the habit read as _score_depth_limit truncation of the same model-based E3 scorer, so the two pathways are ONE model read at two grains. E2: WEAKENED by V3-EXQ-786b (2026-07-24, non_degenerate, familiarity AUC 0.848 against a 0.7 bar): C1_recruitment_higher_on_novel FAILED with two pathways and no arbitrator. 786b is the repaired re-test of V3-EXQ-786a, whose own `weakens` was WITHDRAWN 2026-07-24 for a degenerate DV -- leg (1) is therefore NO LONGER experimentally untested. Leg (2) long-horizon benefit accumulation and leg (3) prosocial planning were SPLIT OUT 2026-07-22 to MECH-478 and MECH-479; each carried a distinct blocker and both were silently inheriting a refutation they did not earn. The control-ALLOCATION mechanism this claim presupposes but never named is now MECH-477 (uncertainty-based arbitration), SUPPORTED by V3-EXQ-811a (2026-07-24, PASS). Restatement rationale: evidence/planning/claim_synthesis_MECH-163_2026-07-27.md.

titles.ARC-107: Basal-ganglia-like E3 selector constitution: committed-action selection should be governed by an explicit BG-mirroring eligibility-gating CONSTITUTION -- candidate actions pass through an eligibility mask, bounded Go (direct-pathway promotion) and No-Go (indirect-pathway suppression) pressures, a conflict-sensitive hold / threshold-raise / candidate-set widening (hyperdirect-STN), striatal-like parallel channel competition (rather than one scalar monarch), a pallidal-like permission-to-commit gate (rather than bare argmax), and a stable post-commit latch / de-commit -- so that an upstream signal's STRENGTH is necessary but not sufficient: it also needs LAWFUL ACCESS to committed action. The translation target is functional (a divergence-ledgered, falsifier-validated BG analogue), NOT anatomical mimicry.
titles.ARC-108: Unified dopamine substrate -- signed dopaminergic-RPE teaching signal feeding LEARNED gating weights on the E3 selector: the cortico-striatal weights that decide which channel wins committed-selection authority should themselves be LEARNED via three-factor plasticity (Hebbian co-activation x signed dopaminergic RPE) with the D1-LTP / D2-LTD asymmetry, consolidating the currently-scattered RPE / vigor / incentive functions into one substrate and supplying the GPi->lateral-habenula negative-RPE drain. The ARC-107 arbitration layer (MECH-447/448/449 + the authority rescale) is today pure arithmetic with NO learned parameters; F monopolises 88-89% of committed-selection variance (MECH-439) precisely because no learned striatal weighting can re-weight channels through experience. The single highest-leverage missing BG piece and the proposed next attack on MECH-439.

titles.MECH-450: Minimal recurrent settling step over the eligible set: replace the one-shot feed-forward argmin/softmax committed-selection readout with a few rounds of mutual-inhibition (surround-inhibition) updates on the within-eligible _modulatory_accum field BEFORE commit, so the committed action emerges from a bounded recurrent SETTLING competition rather than a single global comparison. A hard argmin over an F-dominated score always returns the F-winner (the conversion ceiling); a settling competition with lateral inhibition can FLIP the selected attractor when a modulatory channel is strong enough, and turns the additive _modulatory_accum BLEND into a competitive winner-take-most. The V3-bounded version of the BG's recurrent settling dynamics; the full learned thalamo-cortico-basal loop is the V4 bet.

titles.ARC-130: Organism-level mechanism status is stage-qualified beyond ARC-120's competence-before-authority sequence: a mechanism becomes causally reachable only through an ordered audit projection of existence, representation, endogenous recruitment, local operation, competitive authority (non-zero influence is not necessarily competitive influence against the dominant arbitration term), committed throughput (survives any later selector, latch, commitment boundary, or stale-selection path), ecological consequence (the changed behaviour has a valid opportunity to matter in the environment), and retention/generalisation. Authority at one internal selection boundary does not by itself establish that authority reaches committed behaviour -- 'competence should precede authority, but authority must also demonstrate throughput.' The furthest stage actually demonstrated, not a flat implemented/not-implemented judgment, is the correct unit for recording mechanism status.
titles.ARC-131: Installability is a competence dissociable from isolated component-level validation: a mechanism that passes in isolation can still fail to express itself when composed into the whole organism, because the rest of the organism changes its operating conditions (input state distribution, scale/variance of competing signals, timing and frequency of relevant events, availability of competent upstream representations, downstream action-space and commitment dynamics, post-installation learning gradients, resource/mode occupancy, and the ecology in which it must demonstrate value). A component-level PASS establishes that an operation is possible; it does not establish that the whole agent can enter the states in which the mechanism operates, that the mechanism remains competitive once other mechanisms are enabled, or that later learning will preserve it. This is dissociable from, though related to, competence RETENTION (surviving subsequent learning/time): installability additionally covers SIMULTANEOUS composition, where a competence may never appear in the full-stack agent even absent any later learning event.

titles.GOV-CONTRACT-2: Contract-invariant promotion ladder: GOV-CONTRACT-1's >= 2-of-6-domain consilience quorum is STAGE 1 of six, not the whole standard, and clearing it confers a LEDGER STATUS ("admitted") and nothing else -- in particular no claims.yaml entry, no architectural commitment, and no licence to implement. The ladder: Stage 0 named canonical candidate (the relation has a governed ledger record); Stage 1 cross-domain recurrence (the GOV-CONTRACT-1 quorum); Stage 2 transferable RECEIVER-ACCESSIBLE recoverability (the relation is recoverable by a plausible receiver, not merely by a researcher's probe, across held-out content, tasks or remappings -- graded on INV-105's ladder, never on external decodability alone); Stage 3 causal handoff dependence (selective, nuisance-controlled corruption at a relevant interface produces the predicted deficit, MECH-545); Stage 4 irreducibility under constrained reconstruction (a smaller already-supported basis cannot reproduce the function within the receiver's rate, decoder, context, latency and robustness budget -- adjudicated under the reduction-admissibility rule); Stage 5 adaptation-aware characterisation (compensation, alternative-pathway recruitment and rescue understood well enough to separate functional necessity from mechanism uniqueness, ARC-140); Stage 6 boundary scope established (which handoffs require the relation and which can reconstruct or omit it, ARC-144). A candidate becomes CLAIM-SHAPED at Stage 4 and eligible for architectural treatment only after Stage 5; before that its canonical home is its ledger record id. Composite candidates remain candidates however strong their recurrence, and a negative result at any stage is recorded in the ledger, never deleted.
titles.GOV-CONTRACT-3: Reduction admissibility for the cognitive contract (the anti-cheating rule the pruning clause lacks): counting primitives is not minimality, and a proposed MERGE, demotion or derivation of one candidate from another counts only if it lowers TOTAL TRANSFERABLE COMPLEXITY rather than relocating it. The quantity to be reduced is minimal sufficient transferable information under CONSTRAINED encoders and receivers -- informally contract cost ~= information rate + encoder/decoder complexity + context or side-channel complexity + reconstruction distortion + computational and latency cost + robustness cost -- not the number of English nouns in the basis. A reduction is therefore INADMISSIBLE when the lost distinctions reappear inside the definition of the surviving relation, a more powerful decoder, hidden context tags, unconstrained numerical precision, recurrent hidden state, task-specific side channels, or expensive reconstruction machinery. Three requirements for any proposed collapse: (1) lower total description or rate cost under fixed assumptions about precision and decoder power; (2) preserve DISCRIMINATING predictions -- the reduced model must still predict distinct failure signatures when different information is corrupted; (3) improve transfer or efficiency relative to an unconstrained equivalent-capacity code. The standard of reducibility is OPERATIONAL, not logical: logical reducibility (a mathematician can derive it) and information-theoretic reducibility (the information exists somewhere) are both inadmissible, and only computational reducibility (the receiver can derive it with plausible resources) and operational reducibility (reliably and quickly enough for the behaviour in question) decide. Corollary that makes the rule bite: rewriting several candidates as one typed relational graph, one latent, or one universal relation is a RENAMING, not a reduction, and is refused unless all three requirements are demonstrated.

titles.MECH-557: The 3 + 2 reduction hypothesis: the fourteen canonical cognitive-contract candidates (evidence/planning/cognitive_contract_invariant_ledger.v1.json) may not be fourteen independent primitives but may largely generate from THREE STRUCTURAL FAMILIES plus TWO ATTACHED WEIGHTING FIELDS. Structural: (A) CORRESPONDENCE / BINDING -- which token, event, state or relation in one representation corresponds to which in another or across time, with identity as correspondence plus continuity and persistence constraints, and equivalence as correspondence under a specified transformation (absorbing CCI-001, CCI-006); (B) DIRECTED EVENT / TRAJECTORY STRUCTURE -- event or token instances, ordered or partially ordered succession, reachable transition relations, persistence across transitions, and optional typed intervention edges, rather than a scalar clock plus a separate graph (absorbing CCI-002, CCI-007 and, if action-labelled edges suffice to reconstruct controllability, much of CCI-004); (C) GENERATIVE CONTEXT / ANCHORING / LINEAGE -- which process produced a representation, which branch it belongs to, whether that branch is anchored to the current sensory worldline, and how it relates to other generated alternatives, so that "actual" is a relation to the currently anchored worldline rather than a primitive category (absorbing CCI-003, CCI-012 and the unnumbered provenance/ownership hypotheses). Attached fields: (D) EPISTEMIC WEIGHT over states, edges or translations, obligatory only where the producer holds reliability information the receiver cannot cheaply reconstruct (reclassifying CCI-005 from content primitive to boundary-specific field); (E) REGULATORY / VIABILITY WEIGHT -- predicted relation to viable or preferred states plus direction of change plus horizon, from which signed value, goal relation and priority may derive (reclassifying CCI-009 and bearing on CCI-010, CCI-014). CROSSED PREDICTION, which is what makes this falsifiable rather than a re-labelling: structural families should survive object or world remapping when the world relation is unchanged despite altered surface features, whereas attached fields should vary strongly with current uncertainty, needs, goals, physiology and task regime AT FIXED STRUCTURE -- so holding structure fixed while changing confidence, holding structure fixed while changing viability, holding confidence fixed while changing branch lineage, holding value fixed while changing controllability, and holding sensory content fixed while changing generative path should dissociate along the structure/field boundary. If structural and weighting variables cannot be dissociated by that crossed design, the 3 + 2 model is wrong or too simple.

titles.INV-076: Behavioural diversity is a structural prerequisite for ethical counterfactual evaluation. A system with monomodal policy cannot instantiate the counterfactual evaluation that ethical judgement requires, because the 'could have done otherwise' comparison demands that the agent's candidate trajectory pool contain at least two distinct trajectory classes with distinct harm profiles. The argument is mathematical-by-construction: if P(a|s) is monomodal, the CEM elite pool contains only trajectories beginning with a*, and MECH-257's evaluator-mode E2(z_t, a_cf) for a_cf != a* (prospective rollout-scoring; supersedes SD-003, 2026-04-18) is never evaluated in the on-policy candidate distribution. (Was proposed 2026-05-15 as INV-074 in behavioral_diversity_acceptance_criteria.md but never registered; the ID was subsequently taken 2026-05-17 by an unrelated plasticity-crystallization invariant. Re-registered under INV-076 with scientific content unchanged.)
titles.MECH-341: e3_scoring_preserves_trajectory_class_diversity. E3 score aggregation over CEM-supplied candidates must preserve trajectory-class diversity rather than collapse a diverse candidate pool onto a single deterministic ranking. Without explicit diversity preservation at the scoring step, downstream action selection becomes deterministic regardless of proposal-layer diversity (ARC-065 SP-CEM child), making the whole distributed diversity pathway rate-limited by Layer B. Mechanism options (not yet committed): (1) entropy bonus over candidate first-action classes added to E3 score; (2) class- stratified argmax with within-class proportional sampling; (3) jittered tie-breaking when top-K E3 scores are within epsilon. Final design pending diagnostic data on whether E3 collapse is near-tie or large-gap (see behavioral_diversity_isolation_plan.md Phase P2).

titles.INV-092: Distractor suppression must remain SELECTIVELY PERMEABLE to harm and other-agent signals (ethical interruptibility): any suppression mechanism must preserve the ability of sufficiently important weak evidence to interrupt an established rule or commitment. Suppression strength that improves goal completion by silencing weak harm cues is a FAILURE, not a success -- over-suppression is a safety failure mode, not merely a rigidity cost. ACCEPTANCE SHAPE IS A JOINT BOUND, NOT A CONJUNCTION OF MAXIMA (2026-09-10 governance, GFLAG-0236): completion and interruptibility sit on a Pareto frontier with a hard FLOOR on the harm and other-agent interruptibility axes -- completion may be traded up only while both floors hold, and completion forgone in order to hold a floor is a PASS. A PASS never means both axes were maximised simultaneously.
titles.INV-093: Skill optimisation must NOT trade harm sensitivity for competence (learning-side ethical constraint): any competence-refinement mechanism must be evaluated JOINTLY on competence gain AND non-degradation of harm sensitivity, residue accumulation, and commitment integrity. A mechanism improving the first by attenuating the second has succeeded on its metric and FAILED AS AN AGENT. ACCEPTANCE SHAPE IS A JOINT BOUND, NOT A CONJUNCTION OF MAXIMA (2026-09-10 governance, GFLAG-0236): the joint evaluation is a Pareto frontier on which the three protected axes carry a hard FLOOR that may not be traded away and competence gain is accepted only up to the point where it would cross that floor -- so competence forgone in order to hold a floor is a PASS, and a PASS never means competence and the protected axes were maximised together.

titles.INV-110: The interface-repair adjudication standard: a claim that some maintenance process REPAIRED a cross-system mapping -- as opposed to strengthening a memory, triggering a completion, or riding a subspace that never broke -- is admissible only from a single design, or one tightly integrated series, that closes all six links itself, because the confounds differ across preparations and therefore do not cancel when rows are stacked: (1) MEASURED CHANGE in a transfer-relevant direction, which excludes unit turnover, registration noise, behavioural change, and any rotation preserving the receiver-potent subspace; (2) LOCAL PRESERVATION of sender information, sender-local use, and receiver-local memory and competence, at the moment of the cross-system test; (3) ACCESS LOSS measured by a causal receiver-dependent output, never by decodability or correlation; (4) PAIR-SPECIFIC MAINTENANCE, compared against a within-context permutation preserving event count, state occupancy, marginal content, firing and plasticity opportunity and breaking only which sender event pairs with which receiver state; (5) CAUSAL RESTORATION on held-out episodes; (6) RIVAL EXCLUSION at matched budgets. Two consequences bind. First, a GATE-0 LESION PROOF precedes every maintenance arm: the imposed change must degrade causal receiver use while leaving both endpoints locally intact AND be restorable by a known oracle inverse -- if the oracle cannot restore use the lesion is not an interface lesion and the drift model is invalid, if magnitude-matched null-subspace drift degrades use the subspace identification is invalid, and if task-relevant drift does not degrade use there is nothing to repair and the experiment stops. Second, the estimand is the correctly-paired arm beating the MAXIMUM of the permuted-pair, receiver-local-adaptation and local-rehearsal arms, never the unmaintained floor: a correct-pair advantage over the floor alone is equally explained by generic plasticity, extra rehearsal and homeostatic adaptation. Local-memory equivalence is a PROSPECTIVE constraint tested by equivalence tests, never a covariate regressed out afterwards, because conditioning on a treatment-affected memory score is a collider.
titles.MECH-562: Receiver-local self-healing is the standing rival to every cross-system interface-repair result: a consumer can restore its use of a drifting sender WITHOUT any episodic pair identity, any cross-system label, or any offline replay, by adjusting afferent weights from presynaptic sender activity and its own postsynaptic output under homeostatic error against fixed pre-drift output statistics -- and because this produces the SAME observable as interface repair (downstream performance restored despite upstream change), any REE result attributing a rescue to correctly paired replay must beat a faithful implementation of it at a matched update budget. Its preconditions are its predictions, and they are what make it falsifiable rather than a residual explanation: it needs redundant smooth tuning that continues to tile the represented variable, incremental rather than abrupt change, plasticity at least as fast as drift, and enough sampling or reactivation to estimate the correlations and output statistics -- so its advantage is a function of the DRIFT-RATE-TO-MAINTENANCE-INTERVAL RATIO, and an unswept timescale silently chooses the winner. Three regimes weaken it and are where a genuine pairing effect should be sought: large infrequent drift, drift of the receiver's own scaffold or decoder, and continuous symmetries permitting an unanchored global rotation. Its more durable variants -- population response normalisation, and a stable recurrent predictive model supplying covariance structure -- are NOT free local plasticity: they assume a receiver scaffold that is fixed or changes far more slowly than the feed-forward representation, and that assumption is itself a testable architectural commitment, not a background condition.

titles.MECH-269: Hippocampal proposer anchor selection AND anchor-reset: (a) trajectory proposals issued between committed actions anchor on the subset of current latent streams whose regional verisimilitude (per-stream prediction/realization alignment) exceeds threshold; misaligned streams hold their last-verified snapshot (anchor carryover) rather than contaminate the rollout. A minority probe channel deliberately inverts the gate for low-verisimilitude / high-PE regions, carrying a strengthened MECH-094 hypothesis tag, and does not update the ARC-018 viability map until realized-experience validation.
titles.MECH-272: MECH-271 routing is state-gated. The informational needs of sleep (schema revision) and waking (decision support) are distinct, and the routing bias reflects that.

titles.MECH-284: V_s residual schema-staleness accumulator: a region-indexed scalar that integrates broadcast invalidation events (MECH-287) with attribution_weight credit assignment over the active anchor set, leaks slowly, and is read by both online anchor-reset (MECH-269 hysteresis check, waking) and sleep-consolidation priority (MECH-285, offline). titles.MECH-285: Sleep-consolidation priority from V_s residuals: during sleep-phase Bayesian aggregation (MECH-275) and sleep-dependent self-model aggregation (MECH-273), the order and weight of replay events is biased by the schema-staleness map produced by MECH-284. The agent generates hypotheses (proposer-side, via MECH-269 probe channel), selects actions that will produce informative contrast under those hypotheses, executes the actions, observes the outcomes, and computes counterfactual-backed attribution. Correlational observation is insufficient -- the agent must behave like a scientist, performing experiments whose outcomes produce structured attribution signals. Applies across all three developmental stages; specialised by MECH-277 (action-space discovery), MECH-278 (object-schema formation), and a V4 social-intervention mechanism (parallel to MECH-278 for other-agents).
titles.MECH-278: Stage-2 specialisation of MECH-276: once the agent can distinguish self-produced from world-produced sensory change (stage 1 complete via MECH-277), it forms object-schemas via experimental action on the world. An object is the stable bundle of features that behave causally together under interventional perturbation -- push here, these features move together; occlude this, that cluster disappears. Object-schema formation is the stage-2 specialisation of the scientist-agent principle, with world-features as the target of intervention. V3's z_world (SD-005) is currently engineered pre-split; this is an architectural shortcut past stage 2.

titles.MECH-281: Orexin-analog gain modulation of drive-coupled arousal (motor-coupling axis): an orexin-analog modulator gates the coupling between drive_level and arousal-relevant downstream targets (PFC for SD-033a deliberation, BLA/CeA for SD-035 amygdala arbitration, beta-gate for MECH-090). Loss of this coupling produces a cataplexy-analog failure where emotional/drive input fails to recruit motor activation -- z_harm and drive_level compute normally but action selection does not integrate them. This is the motor-coupling axis of orexin function; the wake-stability axis (sleep-state gating, the dominant biological role) is MECH-286. Both axes are downstream of the same SD-037 override_signal, predicting clinical co-occurrence of cataplexy with sleep-state instability under orexin loss (narcolepsy).
titles.MECH-286: Override-gated sleep-state transition: SD-037 override_signal also gates entry to and exit from offline (sleep) mode. High override (sustained drive + threat under metabolic demand) suppresses sleep-mode onset; low override + accumulated MECH-284 V_s-residual staleness + permissive threat context permits onset and recruits the MECH-285 sleep-replay priority readout. Architecturally this is the recruitment authority for the offline arm of the V_s bidirectional cluster: MECH-284 accumulates the demand for offline schema repair, MECH-285 sets the priority order, and MECH-286 provides the on-switch. Without MECH-286, MECH-285 produces a priority list with no transition mechanism to consume it. This is the V3 architectural account of orexin's canonical role as wake-stability gate (Saper/Scammell flip-flop), which MECH-281 (drive-arousal coupling) understates by framing cataplexy purely as a motor-coupling failure.

titles.MECH-284: V_s residual schema-staleness accumulator: a region-indexed scalar that integrates broadcast invalidation events (MECH-287) with attribution_weight credit assignment over the active anchor set, leaks slowly, and is read by both online anchor-reset (MECH-269 hysteresis check, waking) and sleep-consolidation priority (MECH-285, offline). Distinct from generic prediction error (which operates on latent values and updates online via gradient): MECH-284 is region-indexed, accumulates across events, and exposes a dual read-out (online + offline). Refined 2026-04-22 from sleep-only formulation to dual-readout formulation after V3-EXQ-475 demonstrated that an agent trapped in a stale anchor needs an online consumer of the staleness signal -- MECH-285 sleep-only readout cannot rescue the agent during waking. Saturated map produces over-attention to schema revision (anxiety-analog); absent map produces schema rigidity (V3-EXQ-475 phenotype: 5-6 PAG releases per seed but never integrate to anchor invalidation -> 1000/1000 freeze-active steps).
titles.MECH-285: Sleep-consolidation priority from V_s residuals: during sleep-phase Bayesian aggregation (MECH-275) and sleep-dependent self-model aggregation (MECH-273), the order and weight of replay events is biased by the schema-staleness map produced by MECH-284. Replay is not uniform across schema and is not solely salience-driven (dopaminergic tagging); it is also prioritised by accumulated verisimilitude residuals. Schema regions with the most accumulated 'this is wrong' evidence get replayed first, more often, and with higher schema-update authority during sleep. PTSD-rumination has a clean architectural account here: MECH-285 priority loss co-occurring with MECH-094 hypothesis-tag dysfunction, locking the staleness tag from ever clearing.
