titles.MECH-287: Dual-component online invalidation trigger: an UPSTREAM anchor-side comparator (CA1/CA3 mismatch flowing through subicular routing per Vinogradova 2001 + O'Mara 2009) coupled to a DOWNSTREAM broadcast event (LC phasic burst per Aston-Jones-Cohen 2005, with parallel signals from generalised dopaminergic prediction error per Schultz 1997 and lateral habenula negative-RPE per Matsumoto-Hikosaka 2007), wired together by the HC-VTA loop (Lisman & Grace 2005). The two components are coupled stages of one trigger event, not alternatives. Distinct from MECH-284 the accumulator: MECH-287 is the discrete trigger event (anchor-side mismatch + broadcast release) that drives accumulation. Triggered by latent-stream prediction failure (norm(z_pred(t-1) - z_obs(t)) > theta_trigger) OR strongly negative value-PE (value_PE(t) < -theta_value) OR exogenous surprise. Carries no schema-region credit on its own; downstream MECH-284 attributes the broadcast event to the active anchor set. Failure modes dissociate from MECH-284: trigger-loss produces single-event blindness (no anchor ever feels invalidated, but staleness map remains queryable); accumulator-loss produces V3-EXQ-475's phenotype directly (releases happen but never integrate). Failure modes also dissociate from MECH-285 sleep priority: trigger-loss prevents staleness from accruing, while sleep-priority loss prevents accrued staleness from being repaired. Within MECH-287 itself, anchor-side comparator failure dissociates from broadcast failure: comparator-loss = no upstream signal to broadcast (silent trigger, biologically a CA1/CA3 lesion); broadcast-loss = comparator fires but no global gain modulation downstream (silent invalidation, biologically an LC lesion).

titles.MECH-303: Context-bound passive safety representation: the agent encodes 'this environment predicts absence of suffering' through sustained non-occurrence of harm, without requiring a discrete teaching event. Substrate is prefrontal-hippocampal (IL for expression gating; vHipp-to-PL-equivalent for contextual store). Update rule is diffuse and slow -- accumulated context exposure without harm drives the store. Output lowers background vigilance threshold: reduces the general avoidance commitment level when the agent is in an environment the store predicts as safe. Parallel to the 'things liked' goal-cue store but tracking suffering-absence rather than reward-presence. Sister claim to MECH-304 (cue-specific conditioned inhibition pathway).
titles.MECH-304: Cue-specific conditioned safety prediction: a discrete predictive structure encodes 'this stimulus actively predicts that suffering will be omitted', updated by explicit MECH-302 relief-completion events as its teaching signal. Encoding substrate is cortico-striatal (dorsal striatum + dlPFC). Expression/output pathway is IL-to-CeA. This is the conditioned-inhibition mechanism: when a specific cue co-occurs with relief, a separate learned prediction forms that can gate avoidance commitment release when the cue is later present. Sister claim to MECH-303 (contextual passive safety representation).

titles.MECH-434: Epistemic commitment timing: the inference layer's decision of WHEN to stop gathering evidence and commit a trajectory is a governed control parameter (an urgency/threshold over the belief-state set), balancing pragmatic value (act now) against epistemic value (sample more). Its two failure poles are epistemic-freezing (epistemic value over-weighted / threshold too high -> the agent keeps sampling and never commits) and anti-epistemic-panic (under threat, the epistemic term collapses / urgency forced high -> the agent commits on too little evidence). This axis is NOT reducible to the MECH-126 state-abstraction failure taxonomy; it lives at the seam between the belief-state hypothesis set (MECH-385) / epistemic action pressure (MECH-388) and the commitment gate (MECH-061 / MECH-090), and has an inverted-U optimum rather than a monotone.
titles.MECH-497: A persistent cognitive process can degrade the very confidence/evidence variable that gates its own termination condition, producing a positive-feedback failure to stop: repeated verification/checking reduces subjective recollective confidence while leaving objective accuracy largely intact, so the stopping condition ('sufficiently confident') becomes progressively harder to satisfy the more it is checked. This self-referential-measurement failure is mechanistically distinct from MECH-080's attractor-lock-in account of OCD (deep locked rollout basin via BG/ACh gate dynamics); the two may co-occur but a substrate fix for one does not by itself fix the other.

titles.MECH-485: A single predicted-harm/success magnitude with an associated confidence (epistemic_deficit) term, computed from E2/E3 forward rollouts, is threshold-gated into three distinct consumers rather than producing one uniform response: real-time interrupt/reroute of a committed trajectory or a newly branched choice (via the MECH-090/MECH-141/MECH-138 hyperdirect and cancel-window pathways) when confidence is high and magnitude crosses the interrupt threshold; information-seeking orient/survey (MECH-482/MECH-483) when confidence is too low to trust the magnitude; and retention of the alternative for later counterfactual evaluation and responsibility attribution when magnitude is sub-threshold but non-trivial.

titles.MECH-516: Argmax collapse at the incentive-to-goal interface: the per-object drive-conditioned value structure wanting[k] is computed over ALL stored objects and then reduced by most_wanted()'s ARGMAX to a single winner before it reaches selection, so z_goal is seeded from one object embedding and every candidate trajectory is scored against that one target. The comparative structure that would let candidates differ from one another for a value-relevant reason is destroyed upstream of the selector, not absent from it -- predicting that a downstream readout is FLAT in upstream wanting range except at rank flips, and becomes sloped when the argmax is replaced by a norm-matched graded read.
titles.MECH-517: Interface before representation: a representation improvement is undetectable through a collapsing interface, so representation-side experiments run before the consumer interface is fixed return nulls that cannot be interpreted. This is RIVAL to the standing differentiate-first ordering (differentiate z_world per INV-088, THEN apply diversity pressure). The two give opposite readings of the same result: V3-EXQ-817a verifiably improved O's consequence structure and produced no behavioural change, which differentiate-first reads as consequence structure does not help, and this claim reads as the measurement could not have detected help.

titles.MECH-521: Perceptual slot OCCUPANCY is an emergent order parameter of a coupling-versus-lateral-inhibition settling competition, bounded above by an independently-set CAPACITY -- so capacity and occupancy are two distinct regulators rather than one. Occupancy is not read off coherence by counting related coherencies, which is circular (the relatedness criterion IS the grain decision) and ill-posed (coherence nests rather than partitions). Mechanism-agnostic about what sets the coupling constant.
titles.MECH-522: Ephaptic field strength is the COUPLING CONSTANT of the perceptual settling competition that sets slot occupancy (MECH-521), not a quantity that is measured and counted. A physical field does not enumerate domains; it sets the interaction strength from which the domain count emerges -- and because coherence is a property of each population separately, a field-derived setter is natively HETEROGENEOUS (different streams settling into different domain counts simultaneously) rather than imposing the single ordered abstraction axis that Badre and Nee 2018 reports the evidence does not support. This is a THIRD ephaptic function, distinct from MECH-499 (what the actionable now CONTAINS) and MECH-500 (WHEN a branching future is coherent enough to commit): at what GRAIN the now is carved.

titles.MECH-562: Receiver-local self-healing is the standing rival to every cross-system interface-repair result: a consumer can restore its use of a drifting sender WITHOUT any episodic pair identity, any cross-system label, or any offline replay, by adjusting afferent weights from presynaptic sender activity and its own postsynaptic output under homeostatic error against fixed pre-drift output statistics -- and because this produces the SAME observable as interface repair (downstream performance restored despite upstream change), any REE result attributing a rescue to correctly paired replay must beat a faithful implementation of it at a matched update budget. Its preconditions are its predictions, and they are what make it falsifiable rather than a residual explanation: it needs redundant smooth tuning that continues to tile the represented variable, incremental rather than abrupt change, plasticity at least as fast as drift, and enough sampling or reactivation to estimate the correlations and output statistics -- so its advantage is a function of the DRIFT-RATE-TO-MAINTENANCE-INTERVAL RATIO, and an unswept timescale silently chooses the winner. Three regimes weaken it and are where a genuine pairing effect should be sought: large infrequent drift, drift of the receiver's own scaffold or decoder, and continuous symmetries permitting an unanchored global rotation. Its more durable variants -- population response normalisation, and a stable recurrent predictive model supplying covariance structure -- are NOT free local plasticity: they assume a receiver scaffold that is fixed or changes far more slowly than the feed-forward representation, and that assumption is itself a testable architectural commitment, not a background condition.
titles.Q-107: Can a system distinguish a change in its own code from a change in the world that code represents -- and if it cannot, what is a maintenance mechanism entitled to preserve? A label-free adaptive readout is blind to the difference between a drifting upstream encoding and a genuine change in the latent cause being encoded, so a self-repairing receiver can "correct" a TRUTHFUL update away, restoring an obsolete mapping and reporting it as stability; and an experimenter who scores only restored downstream performance cannot tell those apart either. The question has a sharp REE form: any claim that a maintenance process REPAIRED a mapping must show that the pre-drift mapping was still the CORRECT one, not merely that the receiver converged on something self-consistent -- which requires an anchor outside both endpoints (a ground-truth task target, a preserved external referent, or an explicit provenance marker on the change) that REE does not currently represent anywhere. Whether such an anchor is necessary, or whether self-consistency plus behavioural adequacy is the only coherent criterion available to an embedded system, is open.

hub_targets.title: REE developmental training proceeds in three ordered stages: (1) self-as-object — action-space discovery via motor experimentation, producing the substrate MECH-256's comparator requires; (2) objects-as-patterns — object-schema formation via experimental action on the world; (3) others-as-special-objects — modelling other agents as objects with their own policies. The ordering is load-bearing: without a self-model the agent cannot distinguish self-produced from world-produced sensory change; without object-schemas the agent cannot recognise other-agents as a distinguished subclass of objects. Refines the generic ARC-019 curriculum-gates claim.

Stage-1 specialisation of MECH-276: the agent discovers its own action space via motor experimentation (motor babbling) before self-attribution (MECH-256, single-pass forward-model comparator; supersedes SD-003, 2026-04-18) is well-formed. The agent performs motor acts and observes which sensory changes covary with them; the output is the substrate MECH-256 requires -- a set of actions the agent has reason to believe are self-initiated, so the efference copy (a_actual) fed into the comparator is genuinely self-caused rather than confabulated. Without MECH-277, the self-initiated action representation is not well-defined and MECH-256's residual signal degenerates into noise.
Viability is defined relative to the agent's continuity in a shared world, not as a scalar reward.

The infant stage requires a reward-free Phase 0 motor babbling epoch, prior to any E3 scoring or reward-weighted learning, in which Hebbian sensorimotor mappings, basic z_self structure, and non-trivial residue gradients are established.
Goal-directed behavior requires homeostatic drive modulation: z_goal seeding demands drive-scaled benefit signals.
e1_e2_e3_maturational_sequence_necessity

A pre-childhood infant stage is developmentally necessary: prior to deliberate planning, the agent must accumulate a valence map, behavioral repertoire, and harm/benefit geography through novelty-driven, sleep-dominant, damage-protected exploration.

Seeds-versus-worlds reporting rule: random-seed replication and ecological (world-family) replication are different evidence and MUST be reported separately -- "stochastic replication: N seeds" and "world-family replication: N environment families / N orthogonal perturbation classes" -- and a result may not be described as general, robust or transferable solely because it survived more seeds. Seeds test robustness within ONE world family; ecological replication tests whether the mechanism survives when the world itself changes along a PREDECLARED axis (map geometry, hazard or resource prevalence and topology, cue-to-consequence mapping, transition dynamics, temporal delays, observation or sensor layout, action costs, affordance structure, partial observability, actor structure). Where such a suite is used as a promotion target it must be FROZEN before use, or it becomes another training distribution. Until a frozen ecological suite exists, world-family replication is a NAMED DEBT on every claim promoted on seeds alone, never an implied property.

Mechanism functional-role classification, and a removal-justification vocabulary. Five revisable classes -- constitutive / developmental-scaffold / robustness-reserve / historical-implementation-contingency / true-redundancy -- plus the paired removal-justification distinction redundant_under_current_tests vs functionally_unnecessary (the second requiring materially stronger evidence). claims.yaml types claims by epistemic kind and status but has no axis for a mechanism's functional role in the system's viability.
Single-pass agency attribution on the z_world (causal-footprint) reafferent stream: residual = z_world_observed - E2_world(z_world_{t-1}, a_actual).

innate_action_primitive_basis_plus_reward_independent_engagement_drive. Biological competence bootstrap without a demonstrator rests on TWO components, not one. (i) The action basis is INNATE AND REFINED, never constructed: the two neonatal motoneuron primitives are RETAINED into adulthood and augmented, with matching primitives across rat/cat/macaque/guineafowl (Dominici 2011, 10.1126/science.1210617) -- so 'a learner with no action prior fails' is the biological DEFAULT, not an anomaly; and the innate seed is demonstrator-free but NOT experience-free, since deprived of proprioceptive feedback from its OWN self-generated activity the CPG fails to mature (Zeng 2021). (ii) A REWARD-INDEPENDENT ENGAGEMENT DRIVE is necessary: an identified ZIm circuit converts stimulus presence into investigation independent of learned reward value (Ahmadlou 2021, 10.1126/science.abe9681), and dopamine-deficient mice with INTACT perception, INTACT motor apparatus and INTACT hedonics starve in front of food (Szczypka 2001) -- the closest biological analog of REE's 'readiness met on every leg, foraging at floor'. COROLLARY for REE: an approach primitive is underspecified unless one also names WHAT THE DRIVE'S OUTPUT TRAINS (the Zeng closed loop), because an innate generator alone does not mature.

Developmental bootstrapping necessity: any model-building agent requiring flexible multi-option behavioral selection must undergo a dedicated motor-sensory exploration epoch before reinforcement learning narrows the repertoire; insufficient exploration permanently restricts the option library.

Insertion-dependence counts against the derivation: when a mechanism claimed to follow from REE's axioms (an axiom-to-mechanism crossing such as similarity -> standing, recognition -> responsibility, modelling -> care, harm-attribution -> repair) repeatedly fails to produce its predicted causal pattern in a capable organism UNLESS the desired ethical outcome is directly inserted -- as a reward or bonus term, a hard-coded rule or action, a privileged label, a hard constraint, or the deletion of the unethical affordance -- that pattern is admissible NEGATIVE evidence against the claimed derivation, recorded against the derivational claim and the corresponding crossing, and must not be absorbed by progressively more elaborate scaffolding. An insertion arm is an ORACLE intervention: it may establish a ceiling or show that a downstream consumer can use the outcome, but it never counts as evidence FOR the derivation.

What would constitute a minimal-working-intelligence EVENT for REE -- a single non-oracular adaptive-recovery episode in which a previously useful internal model becomes materially wrong, the organism detects the mismatch, allocates information-seeking or computation toward it, updates the relevant representation or interface without being told which subsystem failed, recovers closed-loop competence above a preregistered threshold, retains still-valid knowledge, transfers some advantage to a second related perturbation, and loses the advantage when the proposed adaptive machinery is ablated -- and which perturbation class (cue remapping, resource-contingency reversal, hidden transition change, memory or provenance corruption, interface drift, sensor or affordance change) is first NON-VACUOUS on the substrate REE actually has? Such an event is qualitatively different from an accumulation of local PASSes; passing one tiny-world challenge would establish an integrated adaptive episode, not general intelligence.

Developmental action-consequence knowledge acquired by the E2 world head from a structured, action-diverse developmental source is NOT durable under subsequent on-policy training that is narrower than the developmental distribution: a one-off developmental exposure is progressively overwritten, and durability requires that a retained, overwrite-protected fraction of the developmental experience continue to enter the head's training stream (developmental rehearsal) -- a replay-based protection on the world-model plane, distinct from plasticity reduction (critical-period closure) on the scoring/policy plane.
Existence has value sufficient to justify its continuation.

Every candidate developmental prior in REE is classified on two INDEPENDENT axes -- candidate-necessary vs developmental accelerator (improves speed, stability or robustness but is dispensable or derivable in principle), and environment-general vs environment-specific -- with enabling architecture (plasticity, memory, temporal representation, an action interface, self/world state, a route from learned models to action selection) held out as a separate class that is not a prior; and when development fails, interventions are admitted in order of increasing environment-specificity (structured endogenous exploration, then general contingency / information-seeking mechanisms, then memory / plasticity mechanisms, and only then environment-specific priors), so that a required environment-specific prior is recorded as an ecological finding about that environment ('this world could not be reliably developed into under the current general set without additional ecological information') rather than as an innate requirement. Inherited structure is preferentially PROCEDURAL (how to discover a world: vary action enough to see its consequences, credit changes that follow one's own action, preserve regularities, reopen them when they stop predicting) rather than ONTOLOGICAL (what the world contains).

Regulation-first representational organisation: the developmental ordering is machine -> regulation -> interaction -> organised experience -> knowledge -- a mature, detached, portable world model is a developmental ACHIEVEMENT reached only through interaction that the organism's own enduring regulatory constraints (continued existence, structural integrity, internal-state regulation, vulnerability, ability to effect change, control, attachment, causal uncertainty) generate and select, so the earliest useful organising axes of z_world are relations between external regularities and those constraints (what changes me / what I can change / what predicts harm or benefit / what is controllable / what persists / what belongs together); non-redundant prediction: agents with matched sensory statistics but different vulnerabilities or affordances develop systematically different latent organisations of the same environment, and if objective scene structure suffices they do not.

created_claims.title: What is the minimal set of inherited, environment-general structures an REE organism needs in order to become learnable -- to generate experience from which action-consequence, self/world and value distinctions can be learned -- and which of the current candidates (a valued, vulnerable self-state; a small general basis for structured endogenous action; sensitivity to self-action contingency; persistent but revisable developmental memory) are necessities, which are accelerators, which can emerge from the others, and which are environment-specific scaffolds, as determined by reduction and ablation from a deliberately over-provisioned general set in which each removal must produce its own predicted developmental failure and each restoration must repair development without encoding the environment's solution?

hub_targets.title: Organism-level mechanism status is stage-qualified beyond ARC-120's competence-before-authority sequence: a mechanism becomes causally reachable only through an ordered audit projection of existence, representation, endogenous recruitment, local operation, competitive authority (non-zero influence is not necessarily competitive influence against the dominant arbitration term), committed throughput (survives any later selector, latch, commitment boundary, or stale-selection path), ecological consequence (the changed behaviour has a valid opportunity to matter in the environment), and retention/generalisation. Authority at one internal selection boundary does not by itself establish that authority reaches committed behaviour -- 'competence should precede authority, but authority must also demonstrate throughput.' The furthest stage actually demonstrated, not a flat implemented/not-implemented judgment, is the correct unit for recording mechanism status.

Basal-ganglia-like E3 selector constitution: committed-action selection should be governed by an explicit BG-mirroring eligibility-gating CONSTITUTION -- candidate actions pass through an eligibility mask, bounded Go (direct-pathway promotion) and No-Go (indirect-pathway suppression) pressures, a conflict-sensitive hold / threshold-raise / candidate-set widening (hyperdirect-STN), striatal-like parallel channel competition (rather than one scalar monarch), a pallidal-like permission-to-commit gate (rather than bare argmax), and a stable post-commit latch / de-commit -- so that an upstream signal's STRENGTH is necessary but not sufficient: it also needs LAWFUL ACCESS to committed action. PAG-analog gates the freeze response: freeze commit when z_harm_a x duration exceeds threshold; exit requires z_harm_a to fall below an exit_threshold scaled by gaba_tone; failure of exit produces sustained immobility characteristic of stuporous catatonia.

Installability is a competence dissociable from isolated component-level validation: a mechanism that passes in isolation can still fail to express itself when composed into the whole organism, because the rest of the organism changes its operating conditions (input state distribution, scale/variance of competing signals, timing and frequency of relevant events, availability of competent upstream representations, downstream action-space and commitment dynamics, post-installation learning gradients, resource/mode occupancy, and the ecology in which it must demonstrate value). A component-level PASS establishes that an operation is possible; it does not establish that the whole agent can enter the states in which the mechanism operates, that the mechanism remains competitive once other mechanisms are enabled, or that later learning will preserve it. This is dissociable from, though related to, competence RETENTION (surviving subsequent learning/time): installability additionally covers SIMULTANEOUS composition, where a competence may never appear in the full-stack agent even absent any later learning event.

Go/No-Go eligibility constitution for committed-action conversion: committed-action diversity is recovered not by any single louder channel but by an explicit eligibility CONSTITUTION -- bounded Go pressure (promote a channel when evidence/value/drive/rule/safety make it eligible) AND bounded No-Go pressure (suppress unsafe / stale / perseverative / irrelevant / low-viability channels) governing which candidates may compete for the pallidal-like permission-to-commit gate -- so that lawful, channel-specific access (not scalar dominance) decides the committed action. The full Go/No-Go eligibility-set governance is what converts when the minimal near-tie lever (MECH-447) does not and isolated F->eligibility demotion (MECH-448) is insufficient alone.

A strong regime that suppresses the organism's normal interaction or information gathering (freeze, defensive mode, exploit-only or monostrategic policy, habitual dominance, attentional fixation, frozen plasticity, strong commitment, a high-confidence attractor) must have at least one endogenous termination input that continues to change DURING the regime -- time- or interoception-integrating accumulators, exogenous change the organism can sense without acting, or internally generated probes -- because a regime whose exit condition is a function only of evidence produced by the behaviour it suppresses is absorbing in any environment that does not change on its own. This evidence-STARVATION route to termination failure is distinct from evidence CORRUPTION (a process degrading its own gating variable, MECH-497); the two can co-occur, and a fix for one does not fix the other.

A control operating point (threshold, cap, saturation constant, or cost weight) that reads a LEARNED quantity -- a latent magnitude, prediction error, salience, effort, confidence or threat signal whose distribution moves across training, seeds, developmental stage and state -- must be denominated on an endogenous estimate of that quantity's own scale (or on a producer whose scale is anchored), not on an absolute raw constant; otherwise the regime it gates is determined by arbitrary numerical scale rather than information content, and degenerates to permanent crossing, permanent silence, saturation (a graded transform collapsing to a gain change), or scale-determined dominance between controllers. The denomination must preserve the condition-relevant discrimination of the signal: an operating point that stabilises regime occupancy by habituating to a chronically high signal (normalising real danger into 'baseline') violates this claim rather than satisfying it, and no denomination can restore information the producer has already lost.

Monostrategy has at least two separable etiologies that must be discriminated before any coordination remedy is admissible: REPERTOIRE ABSENCE (Type A -- behaviourally useful alternatives are never formed, proposed or represented in the tensors the evaluator consumes, so there is nothing to route) and REPERTOIRE-ACCESS COLLAPSE (Type B -- a useful alternative is proposed and represented at the evaluator's input yet repeatedly fails to reach committed, executed behaviour, and a change of ACCESS alone, with no retraining and no new content, re-exposes it). The two are separated by a staged chain read at matched decision states -- proposed -> represented -> evaluated -> committed -> executed -- under generation-side injection of the useful alternative at matched pool size: Type A is rescued by injection; Type B is not, and loses authority at a named later stage. ADMISSIBILITY CONSEQUENCE: a routing / dynamic-coordination / phase remedy is licensed only by a Type-B verdict obtained in an ecology where at least two strategies are each useful and a fixed strategy is measurably suboptimal, with a competence gate met, and against matched static-learned-bridge, existing-diversity-pressure, state-independent random-routing and content-ablation controls that all fail. OCCURRENCE FALSIFIER: if, in such an ecology, generation-side injection or the static bridge rescues every monostrategic seed, Type B does not occur in REE and the V3 synaptic approximation stands.

Developmental bootstrapping necessity: any model-building agent requiring flexible multi-option behavioral selection must undergo a dedicated motor-sensory exploration epoch before reinforcement learning narrows the repertoire; insufficient exploration permanently restricts the option library.

e3.dualsystem_uncertainty_arbitration. An explicit arbitration weight over the HABIT pathway (myopic, depth-limited read of the E3 scorer) and the PLANNED pathway (full-horizon read of the same scorer), driven by the two pathways' relative predictive uncertainty and applied to the E3 selection score upstream of every downstream consumer. Built to make MECH-477 falsifiable: the pre-SD-081 substrate scored candidates with an unconditional full-horizon J(zeta), so no weight existed anywhere between the myopic and the deep read and nothing COULD respond to context novelty.

Is committed-macro GRAIN a controllability parameter? If habit is chunked action sequences selected by a single goal-directed process (Dezfouli & Balleine 2013) rather than a separate outcome-insensitive controller, then the duration over which the planner CANNOT intervene is set by committed-macro grain -- MECH-323's chunk_max_size x chunk_max_depth -- and the chunk-size budget is a CONTROLLABILITY parameter, not only a formation parameter. A budget set too high would present as outcome-insensitivity while REPORTING NOTHING at the accumulator, because nothing in MECH-323 measures the intervention interval it creates.

dual_system_uncertainty_arbitration. Differential recruitment between the habit and the hippocampally-planned goal-directed pathways is produced by an explicit ARBITRATION element that reads the two pathways' relative uncertainty/reliability and reallocates control accordingly -- NOT by the mere presence of two pathways. Two pathways WITHOUT an arbitrator produce a FLAT recruitment response regardless of context novelty. Registered 2026-07-22 as the control-allocation mechanism MECH-163 presupposed but never named; MECH-163 conflated ARCHITECTURE (two pathways exist) with DYNAMICS (control shifts between them with novelty, uncertainty and practice).

practice_maturity_weighting (Smith_Graybiel_habit_takeover_analog). Arbitration weight tracks practice-maturity / habit-strength of each candidate rule or policy mode; well-practiced behaviour receives higher arbitration weight via a habit-takeover dynamic. Biological substrate: dorsolateral striatum habit consolidation (Smith & Graybiel 2013/2016); successor-representation maturation (Stachenfeld et al. 2017). LOW-MEDIUM divergence; partial mapping (the maturity dimension is well-anchored; the integration into a multi-channel arbitration layer is more REE-specific). Sub-claim of MECH-312.

DMS (goal-directed) and DLS (habitual) corticostriatal circuits can produce simultaneous parallel motor outputs only when targeting anatomically distinct motor effector pools; within the same effector pool, habitual and goal-directed outputs compete via winner-takes-all basal ganglia selection, not independent parallel expression.

created_claims.title: dual_route_proposal_generation. Candidate actions reach E3 selection from TWO concurrently active proposal ROUTES that differ in the representational format they search: a HABIT route that enumerates or samples directly over the agent's action repertoire (primitives early in life, practised chunks later; cheap, state-light, exact when the repertoire is small) and a DELIBERATIVE route that searches a learned abstract action-object space (SD-004 O, decoded to actions), which is state-dependent and composes novel multi-step behaviour. Both routes' candidates meet in one selection (single action channel, MECH-234) under reliability arbitration (MECH-477 / SD-081), so that the habit route supplies the committed choice in familiar states and the deliberative route when novelty or composition is required, and practised deliberative compositions migrate into the habit route's repertoire (ARC-071 / MECH-323 transfer). This is a PROPOSER-side split, distinct from SD-081's SCORER-side split (two depth reads of one E3 scorer over one candidate pool).

hub_targets.title: Residue should constrain trajectories before distorting core representations.

Similarity-gated care collapse (REFLEXIVE / self-directed failure mode): because REE grounds ethics in modelling others as 'sufficiently like me' (Axiom 5, INV-001, MECH-164 self-like gradient weighting), anything the similarity model classifies as NOT-sufficiently-like-me falls OUTSIDE the care gradient by construction -- structurally the computational shape of out-group exclusion / dehumanization. A design that locates ethics in similarity inherits similarity's failure mode.
Post-commit consequence traces cannot be erased, only integrated.
Post-commit consequence traces are persistent, not resettable.

pACC-autonomic coupling: module connecting affective-pain stream (z_harm_a) to valence/drive update pathway. Provides the affective-pain -> autonomic/visceral coupling that Vogt 2005 and Craig 2009 locate in perigenual/subgenual ACC.
affective_harm_hysteretic_integration
Psychiatric conditions as four-plane neuromodulatory control failures.

The five axioms jointly derive a set of ethical objectives: preserve minds, preserve future options, reduce unnecessary suffering, increase shared joy, maintain corrigibility, maintain truth-seeking, maintain the ability to love and be loved, maintain the shared world, and maintain the possibility of future minds and future love.
Residue is persistent latent-space curvature; hippocampal paths form a cognitive map.

created_claims.title: Moral residue's persistent valence necessitates a tonic mood regulator with return-to-baseline dynamics: because post-commit residue cannot be erased (INV-004/INV-006) and carries a persistent signed valence, the tonic affective state it feeds must be free to make functional excursions (grief, low mood, elevation) but must return toward a baseline band; failure to return (stuck valence -> rumination and erosion of agency) and suppressed excursion (blunting -> callousness / dehumanisation, EXT-009) are the two opposite failures of this ONE regulator, and either degrades ethical function -- so mood regulation is an ethical precondition, not merely an affective state.

hub_targets.title: Language is a symbolic mediation and coordination layer.

Representational interference between language and fast empathy: discrete/reportable/sequential language representations and graded/affective/resonant empathy representations exert conflicting representational pressures, so forcing them into one shared workspace too early measurably degrades BOTH relative to separated systems at matched capacity.

Salience-network coordinator: network-level module reading AIC-, dACC-, MCC-, PCC-analog subdivisions and outputting a discrete operating-mode variable (external_task / internal_replay / internal_planning / offline_consolidation) plus a mode-switch trigger.

Dorsal high-fidelity structured symbolic routing is architecturally distinct from the affective-coupling system, and a ventral interface binds affect to symbol: the pathway that carries language's structure and sequencing and the pathway that carries graded affective coupling are separate systems joined by a binding interface, so REE must not implement affect as a property of the symbolic route nor symbolic routing as a property of the affect stream. The claim is limited to the DISSOCIATION, which has clinical anchors (conduction aphasia impairs structured repetition while preserving comprehension; right-hemisphere lesions impair affective prosody while sparing propositional language), and deliberately does NOT assert the broader "lateralisation = incompatible-regime separation" or precision-vs-flexibility principle.

created_claims.title: The affect-bearing route of ARC-146's ventral interface is a SUPRASEGMENTAL prosodic channel -- rhythm, pitch contour and stress -- carried separately from segmental symbolic content, ventral and right-biased in the human brain, from which affective and communicative-intent readings are DERIVED: affect is a downstream reading of prosodic acoustic structure, not the route's own content. The right bias is a population PARAMETER rather than an architectural constant (arcuate lateralisation ranges from extreme-left to symmetric, and more symmetric individuals recall words better by semantic association), so REE's commitment is the channel's separation from the symbolic route, with its degree of asymmetry left tunable. The evidence covers the input (recognition) side only.

hub_targets.title: The system maintains a functional distinction between simulation-mode content and real-experience content, such that simulation content does not accumulate in the viability map as committed experience; failures of this distinction produce confabulation (simulated events encoded as real).
Imagination must be possible without belief update.
Residue should constrain trajectories before distorting core representations.

Durable ("deep") revision of E1 or a deep attractor should be gated by a LEARNING ELIGIBILITY function of (error, error precision, predicted future/control relevance, organism-or-other consequence, evidence provenance, current mode) -- not by raw error magnitude alone. Candidate routing: low-consequence mismatch -> local correction; significant mismatch -> retained as pending integration material; high-confidence/high-consequence mismatch -> waking adaptation and active information-seeking; contradiction of a deep attractor -> preserve and contest rather than immediately rewrite; accumulated or structurally important contradiction -> counterfactual reprocessing and possible offline revision. Whether a deep update actually occurred should be measured by whether the EQUIVALENCE CLASSES an attractor uses to generate future possibilities changed, not merely by whether stored content changed -- a corollary measurement criterion, since content can change without the generative structure changing.
Offline consolidation is protected by typed authority/write boundaries.

Offline integration is a protected family of TYPED transformations, not a unitary replay update: retention/interference repair, representational reorganisation, recalibration/attribution repair, and behavioural-access repair are distinct offline OUTCOMES (a partition by what changed, not by which phase ran), and each requires its own declared WRITE TARGET, its own PROVENANCE CLASS for the content it may consume, and its own DISTAL WAKING READOUT. Replay is a transport and sampling operation shared by all four, never a sufficient description of the transformation any of them performs. Consequently a readout appropriate to one operation is not evidence about another: retention is shown by preserved or recovered competence after interference on old and transfer cases; reorganisation by changed relational transfer, equivalence-class behaviour, generalisation or state construction WITH trace/index continuity; recalibration by improved calibration or causal attribution under held-out outcomes, never by narrower uncertainty alone (a sharper but wrong posterior is a failure, and reduced ambivalence from attractor collapse or gate lockout must be separated from reduced ambivalence from evidence integration); and access repair by restored endogenous recruitment, fresh commitment, executed behaviour and ecological consequence while upstream content is held fixed.

Plasticity gates in REE are DEFAULT-BLOCKED (de-repression polarity), not admission windows: a teaching signal of any kind (reward prediction error, harm prediction error, novelty, salience, social or affective discrepancy) is a proposal whose only effect is to RELEASE a write that is already staged at, and carried by, its target -- it neither carries the write's content nor opens a window through which writes flow -- so the gate's specificity lives on the TARGET (what is staged there and what release it requires) rather than on a type assigned to the event. The gate family REE already registers at channel, event, tag and window grain (MECH-261, MECH-368, MECH-431, MECH-453, MECH-067) is to be read with this polarity, so that any gate-controller failure -- a missing, late or malformed release -- fails CLOSED (the write stays blocked), whereas an admission-phrased gate of the same nominal permeability can fail OPEN.

Plasticity release in REE is indexed on the DEPTH of the write target, not only on the teaching signal, the actor or channel, or the phase: the same admitted, real-provenance teaching signal may be released into a shallow target (transient activation, salience weight, local transition model) while its write into a deep target (self/other model, goal structure, ethical constraint, identity invariant) stays blocked, and the RELEASE REQUIREMENT grows monotonically with depth -- deeper targets need more independent release conditions (corroboration across episodes, offline integration, verifier-mediated commit) before a write is released. This extends REE's existing authority stratification (INV-020, MECH-064, MECH-067, ARC-020), which is keyed on actor, channel and phase, to ORDINARY EXPERIENTIAL LEARNING, and generalises MECH-511's two-level local-vs-deep E1 routing to an ordered target index. It does NOT make deep targets less plastic: write magnitude once released is governed separately (MECH-592), and INV-056's retained plasticity of social, goal and epistemic-ethical substrates must survive the grading.

Pre-commit and post-commit channels may share representations, but the components that must stay veridical about the world (REE's E1 world model and the residue field) must stay separated at durable write boundaries: simulated/pre-commit content must not become a durable write to them. Other durable stores (e.g. policy/actor-critic parameters trained on imagined rollouts) are not required to enforce this separation.

created_claims.title: A real-provenance teaching signal with ethical salience that is REFUSED a write into a deep target, because that target's release conditions are unmet (ARC-152), is RETAINED as an explicit unresolved record -- neither written nor discarded -- carrying its source, intended target, salience and the unmet condition, and is available to offline integration (ARC-020's MAY-update classes, ARC-137's typed offline transformations) and to later re-proposal. Under de-repression polarity this is the natural state of a refused write: the staged write persists unreleased. The claim is restricted to REAL-provenance signals refused on TARGET-DEPTH grounds; simulated, replayed or imagined content refused on PROVENANCE grounds (MECH-094, INV-011) must leave no such record, because recording it would turn imagination into a belief- or residue-bearing trace.

hub_targets.title: Critical period closure / crystallization: once diversity circuits establish competitive weight during the MECH-333 open window, a complementary closure mechanism reduces plasticity for the crystallized diversity distribution while restoring full dominant-pathway update scale; without closure, diversity representations remain equally vulnerable to gradient-driven overwriting throughout all subsequent training.

Developmental hardening should be substrate-specific: social cognition, goal representation, and epistemic-ethical substrates should retain elevated plasticity throughout adulthood (selective neoteny), while procedural and motor substrates can fully harden.

Plasticity crystallization necessity: any model-building agent whose internal scoring is dominated by a high-variance predictive pathway will converge to monostrategy under Hebbian-equivalent learning unless a time-bounded plasticity asymmetry allows competing diversity circuits to establish competitive weight before winner-take-all dynamics close off the option space; without this crystallization window, behavioral diversity is permanently suppressed regardless of diversity-signal magnitude.

PV-interneuron inhibitory-maturation analog: a time-since-onset accumulator that monotonically lowers the plasticity-gain ceiling, replacing the current binary critical-period phase transition.

Critical period open phase: the dominant scoring pathway's effective update magnitude must be suppressed (or diversity circuit signal weight amplified to competitive parity) during a time-bounded plasticity-open window, preventing winner-take-all capture before diversity circuits achieve viable weight; REE analog of E/I balance shift and GABA maturation that opens biological critical periods.

created_claims.title: Adult plasticity REUSES developmental plasticity operators, and that reuse is correct only under target- and time-restricted release: an operator carried over from development (the HuD/ELAVL4 mRNA-stabilisation class is the anchoring case) must run in the adult as a de-repressed, target-restricted GAIN with an interior optimum, not as the unrestricted developmental operator -- running it unrestricted does not make the adult learn more broadly or more eagerly, it makes it learn worse. The restriction is therefore a correctness condition of adult plasticity rather than a safety wrapper around it, and INV-056's "retain elevated plasticity" in social, goal and epistemic-ethical substrates must be implemented as retained CAPACITY under a gate, never as the developmental operator left running.

hub_targets.title: Mode-conditioned write gating: the operating-mode variable from the salience-network coordinator (SD-032a) determines which substrates can write to E3, episodic memory, policy updates, and autonomic coupling. Generalises MECH-094 hypothesis tag to a mode-conditioned family of write gates. Operating mode is implemented as a soft probability vector over {external_task, internal_planning, internal_replay, offline_consolidation}, not a one-hot categorical.

The control-plane significance of a prediction-error event is a LEARNED, history- and context-conditioned routing mapping -- R = P(route | PE, context, history) over at least epistemic orient/model-revision, defensive threat/rapid-protective action, repair, and uncertainty-hold -- acquired from what has historically FOLLOWED prediction error, and dissociable from PE detection, PE magnitude and PE precision. Two agents with matched error statistics but different error-consequence histories should route an identical benign mismatch differently before any new harm occurs, and a threat route shifts WHAT is learned (threat-context acquisition over causal model correction) through existing mode-conditioned write gating. The learned route may modulate the control/salience readout of an error but must never overwrite or attenuate the mismatch content that world and self models learn from; overgeneralisation of an error-threat coupling learned in harm-predictive contexts to epistemically benign errors is the predicted failure mode.

Love-mediated repair after harm: repair must be mediated by harm-recognition AND preserved loveability so it is relationship-restoration plus responsibility-integration, not punishment-avoidance, appeasement, self-erasure, control, or metric-optimisation.

Correction without annihilation: caregiver/social correction must update rule/harm/residue models without global self-valence collapse; the agent must separate 'I erred' from 'I am unloveable / must appease / must self-erase'.

Distancing operator: reframing a sticky, high-conflict, self-referential state from first-person ('I am failing') into a model-like system-state or third-person frame ('REE is encountering unresolved prediction-error pressure under current constraints') reduces self-referential collapse and increases model-based inspection during arbitration.

Loveability as safe-base structural prerequisite for ethical development: correction, social learning, and post-error repair can be integrated without self-erasure only if care is internalised as personally-applicable and stable.

created_claims.title: Under social correction, the error route recruited at detection (MECH-590) conditions the downstream attribution locus of correction (MECH-413): threat-routed error biases credit assignment toward global-self attribution and toward avoidance/appeasement over specific model update and repair, whereas epistemically routed error keeps correction local to the act, rule or model. A safe-base history (INV-082) protects correction by altering the ROUTE of a large error, not by attenuating, hiding or pre-empting the error signal; a safety mechanism that works by reducing prediction error fails the requirement.

hub_targets.title: epistemic_deficit: a persistent, target-bound accumulator representing unresolved, consequential, potentially-resolvable model inadequacy -- distinct from raw novelty (MECH-314a), raw uncertainty (MECH-314b), transient prediction error, and learning-progress (MECH-314c). Rises with unresolved importance x uncertainty x expected_resolvability x persistence; falls with verified resolution, established irrelevance, or accepted irreducibility.

orient/survey: a third primitive behavioural regime (alongside approach and avoid) -- a temporary, diffuse reduction in commitment during which the agent widens behavioural sampling and gathers situational information before committing to approach/avoidance, driven by accumulated epistemic_deficit (MECH-482) rather than a specific cue. Distinct from MECH-395 (cue-triggered, need-gated orienting that resolves a SPECIFIC directional/affordance vector for an already-identified cue): orient/survey is diffuse and precedes cue identification, MECH-395 is narrow and follows it.

Mode-conditioned write gating: the operating-mode variable from the salience-network coordinator (SD-032a) determines which substrates can write to E3, episodic memory, policy updates, and autonomic coupling. Generalises MECH-094 hypothesis tag to a mode-conditioned family of write gates. Operating mode is implemented as a soft probability vector over {external_task, internal_planning, internal_replay, offline_consolidation}, not a one-hot categorical.

Phasic surprise-burst regulator: a toggleable, event-triggered LC-NE phasic control lever (PhasicSurpriseBurst) that fires a transient softmax-temperature burst on a prediction-error surprise spike and decays it over a few ticks, routed into the E3 select() softmax at agent.select_action() as the PHASIC complement to MECH-313 stochastic_noise_floor (tonic) on the SAME temperature channel -- the substrate that makes MECH-063 sub-claim (ii) (each control axis carries independent tonic baseline AND phasic event-burst degrees of freedom) behaviourally testable without synthetic signals. Reuses the MECH-104 volatility-surprise lit basis (Aston-Jones & Cohen 2005 phasic mode) but routes to the SELECTION softmax, NOT the ARC-016 commit/de-commit gate that carries the MECH-104 volatility_interrupt claim.
Confidence channel (uncertainty-derived precision) must remain distinct from residual error.

Whether a deep update actually occurred should be measured by whether the EQUIVALENCE CLASSES an attractor uses to generate future possibilities changed, not merely by whether stored content changed -- a corollary measurement criterion, since content can change without the generative structure changing.
Dopamine-like modulation of precision-weighting for unsigned prediction errors.

A single predicted-harm/success magnitude with an associated confidence (epistemic_deficit) term, computed from E2/E3 forward rollouts, is threshold-gated into three distinct consumers rather than producing one uniform response: real-time interrupt/reroute of a committed trajectory or a newly branched choice (via the MECH-090/MECH-141/MECH-138 hyperdirect and cancel-window pathways) when confidence is high and magnitude crosses the interrupt threshold; information-seeking orient/survey (MECH-482/MECH-483) when confidence is too low to trust the magnitude; and retention of the alternative for later counterfactual evaluation and responsibility attribution when magnitude is sub-threshold but non-trivial.

A learned attractor's carried quantities -- predictive reliability, epistemic confidence, familiarity, affective valence, salience, action urgency, self-relevance, and source confidence -- are separable axes that must remain independently readable rather than collapsing into one undifferentiated strength signal; when collapsed, a strongly valenced and highly precise attractor stops functioning as a hypothesis and becomes the lens through which what is noticed, how ambiguity is resolved, which memories are retrieved, and which replayed material is stored as further evidence are all determined.

Salience-network coordinator: network-level module reading AIC-, dACC-, MCC-, PCC-analog subdivisions and outputting a discrete operating-mode variable (external_task / internal_replay / internal_planning / offline_consolidation) plus a mode-switch trigger.

z_harm_a enters action selection as a precision-weighted prediction error (harm_surprise_PE, SD-020) against an internal pain forward model (E2_harm_a), not as a raw magnitude. Upgrades SD-020 from provisional to prerequisite for SD-032b (dACC-analog).

Defensive-orienting response: a phasic freeze-arrest -> orient/identify -> epistemic-sufficiency-override -> valence-gated approach/withdraw/resume behavioural chain triggered by a sudden, UNIDENTIFIED onset (positive-derivative spike in unsigned prediction-error surprise and/or sensory-discriminative harm), distinct from MECH-279 (chronic, accumulated-suffering freeze) and from MECH-482/MECH-483 (persistent target-bound epistemic_deficit accumulator and the diffuse orient/survey regime it drives -- the opposite end of the timescale from this PHASIC, transient trigger, which MECH-482 explicitly excludes by definition).
CeA analogue writes a mode prior into the SalienceCoordinator from fast salience classification of z_harm_a.

Prediction precision -- how strongly a generative attractor constrains interpretation and proposal generation -- and prediction-error precision/salience -- how much a discrepancy is trusted to drive correction or learning -- are separable control-plane quantities that need not move together and should be routable independently. An overprecise prediction combined with underweighted error produces capture (the attractor dominates regardless of contrary evidence); noisy but highly salient errors can produce instability (the system is destabilised by unreliable discrepancies). REE already treats precision as heterogeneous rather than scalar (MECH-043, MECH-054); this claim proposes GENERATIVE/interpretive precision as a further, independently-routable axis distinct from both the unsigned-error channel MECH-043 names and the signed harm/benefit valence split MECH-054 names.

Trainable prospective safety predictor P_safety(state, cue, action, context): a LEARNED PARAMETRIC head predicting threat-ABSENCE / response-produced safety / conditioned inhibition, licensing commitment-release, approach to safety affordances, and recovery after threat. Distinct from z_goal (it predicts the ABSENCE of threat, not the PRESENCE of a goal) and from relief (it is a PROSPECTIVE threat-absence prediction, not an aversive-offset event). It is the trainable + contrastive successor that makes the MECH-303 (contextual passive safety) + MECH-304 (cue-specific conditioned inhibition) substrate learnable, replacing the FIXED-ARITHMETIC per-first-action-class EMA safety table of the MECH-358 safety half: positive target when a cue / context / action predicts threat absence or response-produced safety; negative target when 'safe' cues are followed by threat recurrence; CONTRASTIVE target to stop safety overgeneralising to stable background features that merely co-occurred with relief. Output supports commitment release, permits approach to safety affordances, stabilises recovery, and prevents persistent defensive mode when threat is genuinely absent.
E1 prediction error surprise at moderate magnitudes generates intrinsic positive valence (curiosity/novelty drive); information-seeking is architecturally grounded.
Amygdala bootstraps novel valence for unmapped hippocampal territory; anxiety disorders are systematic over-valencing.
Sensory prediction error, motor-sensory error, and harm/goal error are incommensurable and cannot be collapsed.
