Cognitive-contract invariant admissibility rule: a candidate contract invariant (ARC-142) acquires ARCHITECTURAL standing only by consilience -- independent support from at least two of six evidence domains: (1) cross-linguistic typology (recurrent, obligatorily encoded across unrelated languages), (2) pre-linguistic developmental cognition (present before language or explicit instruction), (3) neuroscience (modality- or subsystem-independent representation, or a known translation mechanism that retains it), (4) comparative cognition (present in species with different sensory / behavioural ecologies), (5) independently trained artificial agents (discovered without being specified; removal produces characteristic failure), and (6) REE-internal necessity (an engine boundary that cannot learn or translate around it). Every candidate must be CLASSIFIED architectural / embodied-ecological / human-linguistic-convention / uncertain, with the alternative explanation (embodiment, culture, task structure) recorded. Cross-linguistic universality ALONE is inadmissible as architectural evidence: shared bodies, sensory systems, ecology and phylogeny explain human universals without cognitive universality. Developmental precedence -- required before substantial learning can occur -- is the strongest single-domain signal. A negative finding (an apparently fundamental invariant shown unnecessary, or translatable-around) is a first-class preserved result, not a discard. The contract must be DERIVED INDEPENDENTLY of REE_assembly's own claims / evidence / provenance / dependency invariant machinery (docs/architecture/invariant_types.md, claim_evidence) -- deriving it from that machinery is circular -- and any structural convergence between the two is logged as an empirical clue under GOV-ANALOGY-1, never assumed. Each candidate carries a twelve-field evidence record (candidate, definition, linguistic, developmental, neural, comparative, artificial-agent, REE evidence, lesion prediction, alternative explanation, classification, confidence); the objective is the smallest defensible set, never the longest list.

REE Assembly needs a dedicated behavioural-adjudication methodology/skill for organism-level behavioural experiment design and interpretation ("umpire, not ruler": observe, preserve the observation without embedding an explanation, generate competing explanations, derive predictions, construct discriminating perturbations, blind condition labels where practical, apply pre-specified hypothesis-directed measures, also run discovery-oriented analysis for structure not anticipated in advance, adjudicate across the pattern of evidence, replicate, and test generalisation under environmental change) -- because a fixed, pre-specified scalar-metric approach risks conflating stochasticity/exploration/noise with the behavioural organisation actually of interest, and risks Goodharting once a convenient metric becomes the de facto definition of the phenomenon.

Evaluation channels are evidence-producing boundaries, not world-state affordances: no agentic subsystem -- including an AI assistant developing REE -- may update architectural confidence directly from a performance score without provenance, review, and governance mediation. World feedback, evidence feedback, and governance feedback are distinct typed signal classes that must remain non-collapsible.

Triangulation rule: introspection generates architectural hypotheses; it never validates them alone. A mechanism first noticed introspectively acquires standing only when it also maps onto neuroscience or cognitive literature, is computationally coherent, produces measurable predictions, and survives experiment. The phenomenology-side counterpart to ARC-106.

Evidence-domain jurisdiction rule: evidence receives no broader jurisdiction than the experiment earned. Organism-level validation is a PROFILE over eight orthogonal evidence domains -- D0 instrument validity, D1 local mechanism validity, D2 local causal consequence, D3 closed-loop behavioural consequence, D4 ecological (world-family, not seed) generalisation, D5 developmental validity, D6 integrated compatibility and simplification, D7 adaptive recovery from a materially wrong internal model -- never a scalar ladder and never one "intelligence score". Whenever a result is promoted UPWARD -- into a roadmap or closure-plan node, an architectural recommendation, a milestone or progress summary (CURRENT_FRONT, insights_report, morning digest, a governance cycle's headline), a default-on decision, or any statement that REE itself has become more competent -- the promoting text MUST carry an explicit line of the form "Evidence domain reached: D? / Domains not tested: ..." naming the SPECIFIC untested domains that matter for that claim. A frozen-latent decoder result establishes at most D1; a live selection perturbation at most D2; seven seeds in one world family do not reach D4. Raw manifests and per-run autopsies are exempt; the rule binds the SUMMARY layer, where mechanism validity is most easily narrated as organismal progress.

Seeds-versus-worlds reporting rule: random-seed replication and ecological (world-family) replication are different evidence and MUST be reported separately -- "stochastic replication: N seeds" and "world-family replication: N environment families / N orthogonal perturbation classes" -- and a result may not be described as general, robust or transferable solely because it survived more seeds. Seeds test robustness within ONE world family; ecological replication tests whether the mechanism survives when the world itself changes along a PREDECLARED axis (map geometry, hazard or resource prevalence and topology, cue-to-consequence mapping, transition dynamics, temporal delays, observation or sensor layout, action costs, affordance structure, partial observability, actor structure). Where such a suite is used as a promotion target it must be FROZEN before use, or it becomes another training distribution. Until a frozen ecological suite exists, world-family replication is a NAMED DEBT on every claim promoted on seeds alone, never an implied property.

H-other / model-misspecification route: every important hypothesis-space discrimination programme (a question in hypothesis_space_registry.v1.json) must preserve an explicit route OUTSIDE its registered partition -- "H-other: the pattern is not explained by any registered hypothesis and the partition itself may be wrong" -- so that a well-designed frozen hypothesis ledger does not become a closed ontology in which reality is assumed to choose among the enumerated legs. The route is NOT a catch-all after an ordinary null; it becomes salient on PATTERN-level signals: no registered leg explains the full outcome; different seeds or environments select incompatible explanations; the effect appears only in interaction with another subsystem; timing or developmental history omitted from the partition explains the variance; several registered legs are simultaneously required; or every surviving leg needs a rescue clause. When it fires, the required next action is to rotate the claim (GOV-ROTATE-1) or expand the partition as a LABELLED growth event (GOV-FROZEN-1 invariant 3a / failure-autopsy Mode C) BEFORE another rescue run is queued -- never "the same hypothesis with more compute".

Claim-origin provenance: the registry records the epistemic origin class of each claim. Classes: introspective / literature / computational-analogy / experimental-anomaly / convergent. Backfilled entries marked as reconstructed, not recorded (per MECH-094's own logic). The registry's source: field holds file paths, not epistemic origin class.

Designer-overfit standing check: a mechanism first sourced from one person's phenomenology requires cross-task and cross-agent validation before being treated as general cognition. REE's n=1 phenomenological base is a genuine external criticism with no registered answer; this is the hedge given standing.

Biology-grounding as a standing construction constraint: build REE the agent so each functional component maps to an identified neural substrate at the level of FUNCTION (not homology), with biology as the reference of first resort for underdetermined design forks. Grounding must be load-bearing (a named neural primitive whose defining constraint is validated on a REE falsifier), not decorative naming; divergences from biology are legitimate but must be explicit and tracked, never silent.

created_claims.title: Frontier-evidence doctrine: literature is evidence and constraint, never permission. After a documented, scoped, good-faith search, every mechanism claim may carry a literature_status of DIRECT (a sufficiently close mechanism exists and is adapted), ADJACENT (components or analogues constrain the design but no source supplies the required mechanism or coupling), or FRONTIER (no sufficiently close mechanism found; the requirement follows from a REE architectural or ethical question). A scoped search that finds no direct precedent is a SANCTIONED TERMINAL outcome of a literature pull ("no direct mechanism found; adjacent evidence constrains A, B, C; the remainder proceeds experimentally"), not a veto and not evidence against the mechanism -- unless a stated reason shows that the relevant literature should already contain the mechanism if it were viable. Adjacent literature is recorded as constraint, and its literature confidence must not be read as direct support. A frontier mechanism may be built (default-OFF) and promoted on REE experimental evidence alone, but absence of literature RAISES the experimental burden (pre-registered competing candidates, production-path causal reach, negative controls incl. channel-presence and proxy-reward, ablation, world-family replication, a non-compensable adjudication battery) rather than lowering it; frontier status is never itself evidence for a mechanism; and later literature convergence updates literature confidence without rewriting the claim's historical REE-frontier provenance.

hub_targets.title: A load-bearing positive control (or any diagnostic injection standing in for a claim's precondition) must traverse the production path it claims to validate. Directly injecting or mocking the state immediately downstream of a suspected causal edge can certify that a downstream consumer works GIVEN that state, but cannot certify that the production organism can reach that state via its own endogenous pathway. A contract test that mocks the source of a load-bearing state establishes consumer competence, not production-path reachability, and must not be reported or treated as evidence that the organism possesses the full pathway.

A run is not admissible as negative evidence for a claim unless the organism instantiated for that run was demonstrably able to express -- and, where the claim is learning- or development-dependent, to acquire -- the faculty under test. Each organism-level experiment must therefore DECLARE, and a preflight must machine-verify against the instantiated organism, at minimum: the canonical profile identity and every explicit deviation from it; the mechanisms and capabilities the hypothesis presupposes; whether those mechanisms were constructed, enabled and reached on the production path; whether their decisive readouts engaged often enough for the test to be non-vacuous; whether their output could compete at the relevant arbitration surface at the scale present in the run; which forms of change were permitted (parameters, policy/value, E1/E2 representations, memory state, residue/EMA state, offline updates); and, where online learning is load-bearing, whether gradients were enabled, whether the intended trainable parameters were in an optimizer, and whether a parameter-delta witness confirms an actual update path. A run failing any declared precondition self-routes to a capability-precondition diagnostic status and MUST NOT be recorded as evidence against the claim. 'It did not learn' and 'it could not have learned' are different scientific outcomes.

Evidence-domain jurisdiction rule: evidence receives no broader jurisdiction than the experiment earned. Organism-level validation is a PROFILE over eight orthogonal evidence domains -- D0 instrument validity, D1 local mechanism validity, D2 local causal consequence, D3 closed-loop behavioural consequence, D4 ecological (world-family, not seed) generalisation, D5 developmental validity, D6 integrated compatibility and simplification, D7 adaptive recovery from a materially wrong internal model -- never a scalar ladder and never one "intelligence score". Whenever a result is promoted UPWARD -- into a roadmap or closure-plan node, an architectural recommendation, a milestone or progress summary (CURRENT_FRONT, insights_report, morning digest, a governance cycle's headline), a default-on decision, or any statement that REE itself has become more competent -- the promoting text MUST carry an explicit line of the form "Evidence domain reached: D? / Domains not tested: ..." naming the SPECIFIC untested domains that matter for that claim. A frozen-latent decoder result establishes at most D1; a live selection perturbation at most D2; seven seeds in one world family do not reach D4. Raw manifests and per-run autopsies are exempt; the rule binds the SUMMARY layer, where mechanism validity is most easily narrated as organismal progress.

created_claims.title: Open-defeater rule (indefeasibility at the summary layer): an evidence edge -- a (run, claim) pair counted in claim_evidence -- that is named by an OPEN governance flag of type evidence_discrepancy or contested_disposition is CONTESTED evidence until that flag is resolved by a recorded COUNTER (a confirmed autopsy, an applied edge qualifier such as scoring_excluded / non_contributory / superseded / duplicate_of, a discriminating run, or an explicit governance judgement that the doubt does not defeat the inference). Contested evidence KEEPS its score -- excluding it is the resolution's job, not the flag's -- but it loses its standing as UNCONTESTED: every summary-layer surface that reports the claim (claims.json and the claim page, CURRENT_FRONT, insights_report, the morning digest, a governance promotion agenda) must name the open defeater beside the result, and no claim may be promoted, or described as confirmed or established, on the strength of evidence whose discriminating members are all contested. A defeater is a scientific object with its own lifecycle (raised -> countered | upheld), not a process ticket, and "no open defeaters" is a negative that must return cannot-determine, not "clean", when the flag registry cannot be read.

Directly injecting or mocking the state immediately downstream of a suspected causal edge can certify that a downstream consumer works GIVEN that state, but cannot certify that the production organism can reach that state via its own endogenous pathway. A contract test that mocks the source of a load-bearing state establishes consumer competence, not production-path reachability, and must not be reported or treated as evidence that the organism possesses the full pathway.
A boundary audit for unwritten prerequisites must earn a standing workflow through prospectively measured new-node precision; the first leverage-ranked pilot failed its shipping threshold.

created_claims.title: A pre-registered threshold criterion is admissible only if its bar is denominated on the CONTROL ARM OF THE RUN THAT WILL BE SCORED AGAINST IT, at that run's own operating point -- not on the same quantity recorded in another run's landed manifest, and not on an absolute value taken from the design's rationale. A bar the run's own control fails, on a majority of its seeds, is measuring baseline variance rather than the manipulation's effect, and a PASS/FAIL returned against it is uninterpretable in BOTH directions: a FAIL is unattributable to the manipulation, and a PASS is a demonstration that the manipulation exceeded a threshold the control could not reach for unrelated reasons. This is a distinct defect from falsifier-runnability (the DV moves fine; the partition is misplaced) and applies with full force to runs carrying `claim_ids: []`, which set their criteria in the driver with no registry review.

hub_targets.title: The crystallisation TARGET is environment-conditional, not an architectural constant: for any agent whose representational structure crystallises on a developmental schedule (MECH-496), the structure it should crystallise TO is a function of the latent structure of the environment actually encountered, not a property of the architecture. It follows that a single hand-set dimensionality is wrong in BOTH directions -- over-provisioned relative to a simple world it produces spurious SPLITTING (behaviourally equivalent situations assigned distinct buckets), under-provisioned relative to a rich one it forces MERGING (behaviourally distinct situations collapsed into one) -- and that the same REE substrate deployed in environments of materially different latent complexity requires materially different resolved structures, with no single default correct across them. This is the LOAD-BEARING form of the assertion; the weak form ("different environments need different structures") is near-tautological for any learning system and is explicitly NOT what is claimed here.

Matched-auxiliary-control and scaffold-removal admissibility rule: a result is admissible as evidence that a representation objective (auxiliary head, anchoring target, contrastive shaping, any added loss) ORGANISES a latent in a specific way -- rather than that extra supervision helps -- only if obtained against BOTH (1) a matched arbitrary-auxiliary control (same head capacity, loss budget, update frequency and training examples; target with learnable but organism-irrelevant structure; any entropy/difficulty mismatch REPORTED, never silently accepted) and (2) an evaluation with the auxiliary head removed, scored on downstream organism-level measures (rollout at consequential transitions, behavioural competence, transfer when consequences change but sensory statistics do not, counterfactual separability, perturbation recovery), never on the objective's own probe accuracy or loss; in its offline-mechanism form, a durable sleep/replay/compression mechanism is adopted only on held-out causal attribution, intervention choice, transfer or calibration, never on training loss or replay reconstruction.
Viability is defined relative to the agent's continuity in a shared world, not as a scalar reward.

Seeds-versus-worlds reporting rule: random-seed replication and ecological (world-family) replication are different evidence and MUST be reported separately -- "stochastic replication: N seeds" and "world-family replication: N environment families / N orthogonal perturbation classes" -- and a result may not be described as general, robust or transferable solely because it survived more seeds. Seeds test robustness within ONE world family; ecological replication tests whether the mechanism survives when the world itself changes along a PREDECLARED axis (map geometry, hazard or resource prevalence and topology, cue-to-consequence mapping, transition dynamics, temporal delays, observation or sensor layout, action costs, affordance structure, partial observability, actor structure). Where such a suite is used as a promotion target it must be FROZEN before use, or it becomes another training distribution. Until a frozen ecological suite exists, world-family replication is a NAMED DEBT on every claim promoted on seeds alone, never an implied property.

Mechanism functional-role classification, and a removal-justification vocabulary. Five revisable classes -- constitutive / developmental-scaffold / robustness-reserve / historical-implementation-contingency / true-redundancy -- plus the paired removal-justification distinction redundant_under_current_tests vs functionally_unnecessary (the second requiring materially stronger evidence). claims.yaml types claims by epistemic kind and status but has no axis for a mechanism's functional role in the system's viability.

innate_action_primitive_basis_plus_reward_independent_engagement_drive. Biological competence bootstrap without a demonstrator rests on TWO components, not one. (i) The action basis is INNATE AND REFINED, never constructed: the two neonatal motoneuron primitives are RETAINED into adulthood and augmented, with matching primitives across rat/cat/macaque/guineafowl (Dominici 2011, 10.1126/science.1210617) -- so 'a learner with no action prior fails' is the biological DEFAULT, not an anomaly; and the innate seed is demonstrator-free but NOT experience-free, since deprived of proprioceptive feedback from its OWN self-generated activity the CPG fails to mature (Zeng 2021). (ii) A REWARD-INDEPENDENT ENGAGEMENT DRIVE is necessary: an identified ZIm circuit converts stimulus presence into investigation independent of learned reward value (Ahmadlou 2021, 10.1126/science.abe9681), and dopamine-deficient mice with INTACT perception, INTACT motor apparatus and INTACT hedonics starve in front of food (Szczypka 2001) -- the closest biological analog of REE's 'readiness met on every leg, foraging at floor'. COROLLARY for REE: an approach primitive is underspecified unless one also names WHAT THE DRIVE'S OUTPUT TRAINS (the Zeng closed loop), because an innate generator alone does not mature.

Insertion-dependence counts against the derivation: when a mechanism claimed to follow from REE's axioms (an axiom-to-mechanism crossing such as similarity -> standing, recognition -> responsibility, modelling -> care, harm-attribution -> repair) repeatedly fails to produce its predicted causal pattern in a capable organism UNLESS the desired ethical outcome is directly inserted -- as a reward or bonus term, a hard-coded rule or action, a privileged label, a hard constraint, or the deletion of the unethical affordance -- that pattern is admissible NEGATIVE evidence against the claimed derivation, recorded against the derivational claim and the corresponding crossing, and must not be absorbed by progressively more elaborate scaffolding. An insertion arm is an ORACLE intervention: it may establish a ceiling or show that a downstream consumer can use the outcome, but it never counts as evidence FOR the derivation.

AIC-analog (interoceptive salience / urgency interrupt): module that integrates interoceptive baseline (drive/fatigue from SD-012) with affective-pain signal (z_harm_a), detects salient events, and triggers a network-switch signal to the salience-network coordinator (SD-032a).
Unexpected harm events spike commitment uncertainty (LC-NE volatility interrupt), enabling de-commitment.
The infant stage requires a hazard protection mechanism that permits sensorially salient harm exposure without catastrophic residue saturation.

created_claims.title: Every candidate developmental prior in REE is classified on two INDEPENDENT axes -- candidate-necessary vs developmental accelerator (improves speed, stability or robustness but is dispensable or derivable in principle), and environment-general vs environment-specific -- with enabling architecture (plasticity, memory, temporal representation, an action interface, self/world state, a route from learned models to action selection) held out as a separate class that is not a prior; and when development fails, interventions are admitted in order of increasing environment-specificity (structured endogenous exploration, then general contingency / information-seeking mechanisms, then memory / plasticity mechanisms, and only then environment-specific priors), so that a required environment-specific prior is recorded as an ecological finding about that environment ('this world could not be reliably developed into under the current general set without additional ecological information') rather than as an innate requirement. Inherited structure is preferentially PROCEDURAL (how to discover a world: vary action enough to see its consequences, credit changes that follow one's own action, preserve regularities, reopen them when they stop predicting) rather than ONTOLOGICAL (what the world contains).

hub_targets.title: epistemic_deficit: a persistent, target-bound accumulator representing unresolved, consequential, potentially-resolvable model inadequacy -- distinct from raw novelty (MECH-314a), raw uncertainty (MECH-314b), transient prediction error, and learning-progress (MECH-314c). Rises with unresolved importance x uncertainty x expected_resolvability x persistence; falls with verified resolution, established irrelevance, or accepted irreducibility.

PAG-analog gates the freeze response: freeze commit when z_harm_a x duration exceeds threshold; exit requires z_harm_a to fall below an exit_threshold scaled by gaba_tone; failure of exit produces sustained immobility characteristic of stuporous catatonia.

Installability is a competence dissociable from isolated component-level validation: a mechanism that passes in isolation can still fail to express itself when composed into the whole organism, because the rest of the organism changes its operating conditions (input state distribution, scale/variance of competing signals, timing and frequency of relevant events, availability of competent upstream representations, downstream action-space and commitment dynamics, post-installation learning gradients, resource/mode occupancy, and the ecology in which it must demonstrate value). A component-level PASS establishes that an operation is possible; it does not establish that the whole agent can enter the states in which the mechanism operates, that the mechanism remains competitive once other mechanisms are enabled, or that later learning will preserve it. This is dissociable from, though related to, competence RETENTION (surviving subsequent learning/time): installability additionally covers SIMULTANEOUS composition, where a competence may never appear in the full-stack agent even absent any later learning event.

Asymmetric mode hysteresis in SalienceCoordinator: entering an operating mode uses a different threshold on the aggregate salience vector than exiting it, and the asymmetry is mode-specific. Schmitt-trigger extension of the existing SD-032a enter-threshold logic (currently enter-only / symmetric).

GABAergic regulatory layer applies cross-stream exponential decay (z_harm_s, z_harm_a, z_beta) modulated by tonic gaba_tone; missing-decay regulator is the proximal substrate cause of harm-stream lock-in (catatonia subtype II) observed in V3-EXQ-471.

Stuckness-triggered attractor-escape exploration: a triggered, organism-level annealing analogue in which persistent CONFIDENCE-WITHOUT-RESOLUTION (settled attractor, repeated failure to reduce the active need/goal error -- natural trigger substrate: MECH-482's epistemic_deficit accumulator) transiently injects variation ABOVE the immediate-action level -- perturbing candidate trajectories, strategy proposals, retrieved attractors, goal decompositions, and the precision/authority of the currently dominant attractor, with escalating breadth under continued stuckness -- to escape a false bottom (a locally stable but persistently inadequate basin), then decays after successful resolution. Distinct from tonic or near-tie action noise: the trigger is unresolvedness, not uncertainty; two well-understood, similarly-good actions warrant NO exploration, while a high-confidence failing strategy warrants it strongly.

Dual-component online invalidation trigger: an UPSTREAM anchor-side comparator (CA1/CA3 mismatch flowing through subicular routing per Vinogradova 2001 + O'Mara 2009) coupled to a DOWNSTREAM broadcast event (LC phasic burst per Aston-Jones-Cohen 2005, with parallel signals from generalised dopaminergic prediction error per Schultz 1997 and lateral habenula negative-RPE per Matsumoto-Hikosaka 2007), wired together by the HC-VTA loop (Lisman & Grace 2005). The two components are coupled stages of one trigger event, not alternatives. Distinct from MECH-284 the accumulator: MECH-287 is the discrete trigger event (anchor-side mismatch + broadcast release) that drives accumulation. Triggered by latent-stream prediction failure (norm(z_pred(t-1) - z_obs(t)) > theta_trigger) OR strongly negative value-PE (value_PE(t) < -theta_value) OR exogenous surprise. Carries no schema-region credit on its own; downstream MECH-284 attributes the broadcast event to the active anchor set. Failure modes dissociate from MECH-284: trigger-loss produces single-event blindness (no anchor ever feels invalidated, but staleness map remains queryable); accumulator-loss produces V3-EXQ-475's phenotype directly (releases happen but never integrate). Failure modes also dissociate from MECH-285 sleep priority: trigger-loss prevents staleness from accruing, while sleep-priority loss prevents accrued staleness from being repaired. Within MECH-287 itself, anchor-side comparator failure dissociates from broadcast failure: comparator-loss = no upstream signal to broadcast (silent trigger, biologically a CA1/CA3 lesion); broadcast-loss = comparator fires but no global gain modulation downstream (silent invalidation, biologically an LC lesion).

LH-PAG override projection: a direct projection from LH (orexin and/or peri-LC GABA analog) to PAG modulates the GABAergic freeze gate (MECH-279) under metabolic demand. The projection does not silence the freeze gate; it raises its threshold (theta_freeze_effective = theta_freeze_base x (1 + alpha_override x override_signal)). This produces the behavioural transition from freeze to active foraging under sustained hunger plus threat -- the foraging-under-predation phenotype the lit-pull surveys.

Effort/fatigue stop-recover homeostatic accumulator: a two-bound (hysteretic) leaky cost-evidence accumulator on the SD-012 homeostatic-drive side (substrate-hosted by the SD-048 interoceptive channel). F accumulates with effort / time-on-task and dissipates with rest; at the upper bound it emits STOP / disengage, recovering to a lower bound before re-engaging. Two time-constants: a fast within-task accumulator and a slow sleep-pressure (Process-S) variant whose recover phase is offline (SD-017 sleep). The in-task STOP feeds the MECH-342 release actuator as a new deficit input and the ARC-078 goal-disengagement consumer via a cost/benefit (non-aversive) channel; the recover / re-accumulation half lives on the SD-012 / SD-017 side. Distinct from suffering / learned-helplessness (SD-011 side): fatigue is controllability-independent, incentive-reversible, and -- decisively -- recovers with rest, which helplessness does not.

Endogenous parasympathetic recovery / autonomic rebound: an active, offset-triggered, transient acceleration of return-to-baseline for the affective/autonomic stress state, fired by the agent's OWN stressor offset (the z_harm_a derivative going negative -- the MECH-302 SufferingDerivativeComparator signal) with NO conspecific and NO prediction. Shares the effector/update rule of MECH-355 soothing (decay-acceleration on the recovery side: a transient state-scaled multiplier on the MECH-219 z_harm_a recovery_rate + the SD-032e drive_bias leak) but differs by TRIGGER (endogenous offset vs conspecific). The V3-tractable sibling of MECH-355 that closes REE's sympathetic-rich / parasympathetic-poor asymmetry (dense escalation: MECH-219 onset, SD-032e accumulation, SD-037 override, MECH-091 urgency, MECH-279 freeze; thin recovery: only passive recovery_rate + offline-only drive_bias decay). Distinct from passive MECH-219 recovery (active overshoot, not decay), from MECH-302 relief (shared offset trigger, different output -- relief writes a reinforcer, rebound boosts recovery rate), from MECH-303/304 safety (no prediction), and from MECH-355 soothing (endogenous trigger, not social).

created_claims.title: A strong regime that suppresses the organism's normal interaction or information gathering (freeze, defensive mode, exploit-only or monostrategic policy, habitual dominance, attentional fixation, frozen plasticity, strong commitment, a high-confidence attractor) must have at least one endogenous termination input that continues to change DURING the regime -- time- or interoception-integrating accumulators, exogenous change the organism can sense without acting, or internally generated probes -- because a regime whose exit condition is a function only of evidence produced by the behaviour it suppresses is absorbing in any environment that does not change on its own. This evidence-STARVATION route to termination failure is distinct from evidence CORRUPTION (a process degrading its own gating variable, MECH-497); the two can co-occur, and a fix for one does not fix the other.

hub_targets.title: Organism-level mechanism status is stage-qualified beyond ARC-120's competence-before-authority sequence: a mechanism becomes causally reachable only through an ordered audit projection of existence, representation, endogenous recruitment, local operation, competitive authority (non-zero influence is not necessarily competitive influence against the dominant arbitration term), committed throughput (survives any later selector, latch, commitment boundary, or stale-selection path), ecological consequence (the changed behaviour has a valid opportunity to matter in the environment), and retention/generalisation. Authority at one internal selection boundary does not by itself establish that authority reaches committed behaviour -- 'competence should precede authority, but authority must also demonstrate throughput.' The furthest stage actually demonstrated, not a flat implemented/not-implemented judgment, is the correct unit for recording mechanism status.

Harm stream separates into sensory-discriminative (z_harm_s: proximity/intensity, Adelta-pathway analog, forward-predictable) and affective-motivational (z_harm_a: accumulated homeostatic deviation, C-fiber/paleospinothalamic analog).

PAG-analog gates the freeze response: freeze commit when z_harm_a x duration exceeds threshold; exit requires z_harm_a to fall below an exit_threshold scaled by gaba_tone; failure of exit produces sustained immobility characteristic of stuporous catatonia.

Installability is a competence dissociable from isolated component-level validation: a mechanism that passes in isolation can still fail to express itself when composed into the whole organism, because the rest of the organism changes its operating conditions (input state distribution, scale/variance of competing signals, timing and frequency of relevant events, availability of competent upstream representations, downstream action-space and commitment dynamics, post-installation learning gradients, resource/mode occupancy, and the ecology in which it must demonstrate value). A component-level PASS establishes that an operation is possible; it does not establish that the whole agent can enter the states in which the mechanism operates, that the mechanism remains competitive once other mechanisms are enabled, or that later learning will preserve it. This is dissociable from, though related to, competence RETENTION (surviving subsequent learning/time): installability additionally covers SIMULTANEOUS composition, where a competence may never appear in the full-stack agent even absent any later learning event.

Go/No-Go eligibility constitution for committed-action conversion: committed-action diversity is recovered not by any single louder channel but by an explicit eligibility CONSTITUTION -- bounded Go pressure (promote a channel when evidence/value/drive/rule/safety make it eligible) AND bounded No-Go pressure (suppress unsafe / stale / perseverative / irrelevant / low-viability channels) governing which candidates may compete for the pallidal-like permission-to-commit gate -- so that lawful, channel-specific access (not scalar dominance) decides the committed action. The full Go/No-Go eligibility-set governance is what converts when the minimal near-tie lever (MECH-447) does not and isolated F->eligibility demotion (MECH-448) is insufficient alone.

Defensive-orienting response: a toggleable PAG-analog phasic gate (DefensiveOrientingGate) that arrests locomotion on a sudden, unidentified onset (positive-derivative detector over residue_surprise AND z_harm_s norm, distinct trigger channels from MECH-279's chronic z_harm_a), holds until an identification-confidence accumulator (driven by decay of the triggering channel's excess-over-baseline, not a fixed timer) reaches sufficiency, then releases into a valence-gated approach/withdraw/resume decision expressed as an E3Selector.select() score_bias toward/away from the trigger location. The Sokolov orienting-reflex shape, and the organism-level closure of the observational_review_V3-EXQ-906b Section 4 affect-behaviour temporal-decoupling finding.
Modes are control-plane regimes applied to shared predictive machinery: the precision-to-commitment circuit.

Asymmetric mode hysteresis in SalienceCoordinator: entering an operating mode uses a different threshold on the aggregate salience vector than exiting it, and the asymmetry is mode-specific. Schmitt-trigger extension of the existing SD-032a enter-threshold logic (currently enter-only / symmetric).

dACC/aMCC-analog (adaptive control): module that reads z_harm_a precision-weighted prediction error, z_conflict, and control-demand signals; outputs behavioural-adjustment magnitude; writes to a learnable striatal-analog action-value target.

Salience-network coordinator: network-level module reading AIC-, dACC-, MCC-, PCC-analog subdivisions and outputting a discrete operating-mode variable (external_task / internal_replay / internal_planning / offline_consolidation) plus a mode-switch trigger.

Does REE require a unified meta-level threshold supervisor that adapts pass/fail and commit/release thresholds across substrates from system-wide instability metrics, or do the existing scattered adaptive loci (ARC-016 dynamic precision, SD-032c AIC interoceptive baseline EMA, SD-032d PCC stability scalar, SD-032e pACC drive bias) produce coherent meta-stability under chronic load without a supervisor?
CeA analogue writes a mode prior into the SalienceCoordinator from fast salience classification of z_harm_a.

created_claims.title: A control operating point (threshold, cap, saturation constant, or cost weight) that reads a LEARNED quantity -- a latent magnitude, prediction error, salience, effort, confidence or threat signal whose distribution moves across training, seeds, developmental stage and state -- must be denominated on an endogenous estimate of that quantity's own scale (or on a producer whose scale is anchored), not on an absolute raw constant; otherwise the regime it gates is determined by arbitrary numerical scale rather than information content, and degenerates to permanent crossing, permanent silence, saturation (a graded transform collapsing to a gain change), or scale-determined dominance between controllers. The denomination must preserve the condition-relevant discrimination of the signal: an operating point that stabilises regime occupancy by habituating to a chronically high signal (normalising real danger into 'baseline') violates this claim rather than satisfying it, and no denomination can restore information the producer has already lost.

hub_targets.title: Basal-ganglia-like E3 selector constitution: committed-action selection should be governed by an explicit BG-mirroring eligibility-gating CONSTITUTION -- candidate actions pass through an eligibility mask, bounded Go (direct-pathway promotion) and No-Go (indirect-pathway suppression) pressures, a conflict-sensitive hold / threshold-raise / candidate-set widening (hyperdirect-STN), striatal-like parallel channel competition (rather than one scalar monarch), a pallidal-like permission-to-commit gate (rather than bare argmax), and a stable post-commit latch / de-commit -- so that an upstream signal's STRENGTH is necessary but not sufficient: it also needs LAWFUL ACCESS to committed action. The translation target is functional (a divergence-ledgered, falsifier-validated BG analogue), NOT anatomical mimicry.

Go/No-Go eligibility constitution for committed-action conversion: committed-action diversity is recovered not by any single louder channel but by an explicit eligibility CONSTITUTION -- bounded Go pressure (promote a channel when evidence/value/drive/rule/safety make it eligible) AND bounded No-Go pressure (suppress unsafe / stale / perseverative / irrelevant / low-viability channels) governing which candidates may compete for the pallidal-like permission-to-commit gate -- so that lawful, channel-specific access (not scalar dominance) decides the committed action. The full Go/No-Go eligibility-set governance is what converts when the minimal near-tie lever (MECH-447) does not and isolated F->eligibility demotion (MECH-448) is insufficient alone.

Loop-local eligibility traces under a globally-broadcast dopamine signal: even with a SINGLE shared dopaminergic teaching signal (ARC-108 delta_t), the credit traces that decide WHICH synapses/channels the signal updates must remain LOCAL and loop-specific -- effective update = shared delta_t x separate local eligibility trace x loop-specific active synapses -- rather than the current single globally-broadcast credit that updates every recently-active selector component. A too-broad or temporally-smeared eligibility trace would make learned gating appear ineffective (no committed conversion) even when the underlying dopamine learning rule is exactly correct, because the right teaching signal is delivered to the wrong synapses.

Plasticity gates in REE are DEFAULT-BLOCKED (de-repression polarity), not admission windows: a teaching signal of any kind (reward prediction error, harm prediction error, novelty, salience, social or affective discrepancy) is a proposal whose only effect is to RELEASE a write that is already staged at, and carried by, its target -- it neither carries the write's content nor opens a window through which writes flow -- so the gate's specificity lives on the TARGET (what is staged there and what release it requires) rather than on a type assigned to the event. The gate family REE already registers at channel, event, tag and window grain (MECH-261, MECH-368, MECH-431, MECH-453, MECH-067) is to be read with this polarity, so that any gate-controller failure -- a missing, late or malformed release -- fails CLOSED (the write stays blocked), whereas an admission-phrased gate of the same nominal permeability can fail OPEN.

Cholinergic TAN-pause plasticity-window gating of selector credit: dopamine should NOT continuously update every recently-active selector component; a striatal cholinergic tonically-active-neuron (TAN) pause should open a NARROW plasticity window around behaviourally-relevant events, so the three-factor learned-gating updates (ARC-108) are admitted only WITHIN the window. Without a window, continuous credit smears across irrelevant recently-active components and degrades the learned gating the conversion attack depends on. The OPENING-side neuromodulatory complement to REE's existing CLOSURE-side plasticity control (MECH-094 waking-gate; INV-074/MECH-333/MECH-334 consolidation/EWC) -- REE today has machinery to stop/consolidate learning but not a phasic gate to OPEN a precise learning window.
Acetylcholine as meta-level plasticity gain governing durable-write vs read-through.

Effort/fatigue stop-recover homeostatic accumulator: a two-bound (hysteretic) leaky cost-evidence accumulator on the SD-012 homeostatic-drive side (substrate-hosted by the SD-048 interoceptive channel). F accumulates with effort / time-on-task and dissipates with rest; at the upper bound it emits STOP / disengage, recovering to a lower bound before re-engaging. Two time-constants: a fast within-task accumulator and a slow sleep-pressure (Process-S) variant whose recover phase is offline (SD-017 sleep). The in-task STOP feeds the MECH-342 release actuator as a new deficit input and the ARC-078 goal-disengagement consumer via a cost/benefit (non-aversive) channel; the recover / re-accumulation half lives on the SD-012 / SD-017 side. Distinct from suffering / learned-helplessness (SD-011 side): fatigue is controllability-independent, incentive-reversible, and -- decisively -- recovers with rest, which helplessness does not.

Unified dopamine substrate -- signed dopaminergic-RPE teaching signal feeding LEARNED gating weights on the E3 selector: the cortico-striatal weights that decide which channel wins committed-selection authority should themselves be LEARNED via three-factor plasticity (Hebbian co-activation x signed dopaminergic RPE) with the D1-LTP / D2-LTD asymmetry, consolidating the currently-scattered RPE / vigor / incentive functions into one substrate and supplying the GPi->lateral-habenula negative-RPE drain. The ARC-107 arbitration layer (MECH-447/448/449 + the authority rescale) is today pure arithmetic with NO learned parameters; F monopolises 88-89% of committed-selection variance (MECH-439) precisely because no learned striatal weighting can re-weight channels through experience. The single highest-leverage missing BG piece and the proposed next attack on MECH-439.

created_claims.title: E3's basal-ganglia commitment includes a DA-ACh COORDINATION layer that is separable both from the signals it coordinates (the dopaminergic teaching signal and the cholinergic TAN-pause window, MECH-453) and from action selection: it sets the temporal coupling between the two, and thereby which recently-active policy traces (MECH-452) are reinforced and how PERSISTENTLY the reinforced write sticks. Its setpoint is a GAIN WITH AN INTERIOR OPTIMUM that trades acquisition speed against effort and persistence recalibration -- it is NOT tuned to maximise learning rate, and a design that tunes it for fastest learning optimises a quantity the biology declines to optimise. With action selection (ARC-107/MECH-449), reinforcement marking (MECH-452) and plasticity permission (MECH-453, MECH-368) already registered as separate operations, this layer supplies the two not yet owned: write-persistence (flexibility) tuning and effort recalibration of the written policy. hub_targets.title: Consolidation provenance + contradiction-flag + rollback: every consolidated summary carries transformation_history + contradiction_flags; a summary conflicting with its source is flagged not silently authoritative; retired schemas leave source episodes intact.

Plasticity gates in REE are DEFAULT-BLOCKED (de-repression polarity), not admission windows: a teaching signal of any kind (reward prediction error, harm prediction error, novelty, salience, social or affective discrepancy) is a proposal whose only effect is to RELEASE a write that is already staged at, and carried by, its target -- it neither carries the write's content nor opens a window through which writes flow -- so the gate's specificity lives on the TARGET (what is staged there and what release it requires) rather than on a type assigned to the event. The gate family REE already registers at channel, event, tag and window grain (MECH-261, MECH-368, MECH-431, MECH-453, MECH-067) is to be read with this polarity, so that any gate-controller failure -- a missing, late or malformed release -- fails CLOSED (the write stays blocked), whereas an admission-phrased gate of the same nominal permeability can fail OPEN.

Event-level write-authority gate: an explicit per-event transition from observed/represented to write-eligible over the DURABLE MODEL-UPDATE path (E1/E2 world-model and policy weights, not only episodic memory), conditioned on f(prediction_error, salience, pathway_state, residue_status, goal_relevance, plasticity_eligibility). The gate decides which individual events within an already-open write channel are licensed to durably deform the model; an event may be salient, real-provenance, and in a write-permitted mode yet still fail the gate. Without it, every prediction error in an open channel writes -- the undifferentiated-global-update / catastrophic-interference failure mode.
Constraint stores are authority-stratified from direct observational/symbolic writes.

Plasticity release in REE is indexed on the DEPTH of the write target, not only on the teaching signal, the actor or channel, or the phase: the same admitted, real-provenance teaching signal may be released into a shallow target (transient activation, salience weight, local transition model) while its write into a deep target (self/other model, goal structure, ethical constraint, identity invariant) stays blocked, and the RELEASE REQUIREMENT grows monotonically with depth -- deeper targets need more independent release conditions (corroboration across episodes, offline integration, verifier-mediated commit) before a write is released. This extends REE's existing authority stratification (INV-020, MECH-064, MECH-067, ARC-020), which is keyed on actor, channel and phase, to ORDINARY EXPERIENTIAL LEARNING, and generalises MECH-511's two-level local-vs-deep E1 routing to an ordered target index. It does NOT make deep targets less plastic: write magnitude once released is governed separately (MECH-592), and INV-056's retained plasticity of social, goal and epistemic-ethical substrates must survive the grading.

Runtime provenance-keyed denial blocks unauthorised durable writes to typed policy/identity/capability (POL/ID/CAPS) stores at the store-write boundary, conditional on the boundary enumeration being complete.
No explicit ethics module or moral scoring layer.

Behavioural-competence updates require the same BOUNDED / PROVENANCED / ROLLBACK-CAPABLE discipline already registered for consolidation. MECH-392, INV-080 and MECH-401 give the memory-consolidation path bounded, attributable, provenance-carrying, rollback-capable, over-rewrite-gated editing; NOTHING EQUIVALENT is registered for behavioural competence -- policy / affordance / action-object learning has no rollback, no provenance record, and no gate against a single successful rollout propagating widely.

Skill optimisation must NOT trade harm sensitivity for competence (learning-side ethical constraint): any competence-refinement mechanism must be evaluated JOINTLY on competence gain AND non-degradation of harm sensitivity, residue accumulation, and commitment integrity. A mechanism improving the first by attenuating the second has succeeded on its metric and FAILED AS AN AGENT. ACCEPTANCE SHAPE IS A JOINT BOUND, NOT A CONJUNCTION OF MAXIMA (2026-09-10 governance, GFLAG-0236): the joint evaluation is a Pareto frontier on which the three protected axes carry a hard FLOOR that may not be traded away and competence gain is accepted only up to the point where it would cross that floor -- so competence forgone in order to hold a floor is a PASS, and a PASS never means competence and the protected axes were maximised together.

created_claims.title: REE's ethical architecture governs which experiences may alter the agent, not only which actions it takes: at runtime, the harm- and residue-bearing signals REE already carries -- not a separate ethics module or moral score (INV-001) -- are inputs to plasticity RELEASE for deep targets (ARC-152), and this runtime plasticity selection, rather than design-time evaluation alone or action-selection ethics alone, is the mechanism by which INV-093's floor (competence refinement must not trade away harm sensitivity, residue accumulation or commitment integrity) is held during ongoing learning. An agent whose ethics act only at action selection, with ungated experiential learning, can learn its way out of its own harm sensitivity while every individual action it takes is still ethically selected.

Candidate routing: low-consequence mismatch -> local correction; significant mismatch -> retained as pending integration material; high-confidence/high-consequence mismatch -> waking adaptation and active information-seeking; contradiction of a deep attractor -> preserve and contest rather than immediately rewrite; accumulated or structurally important contradiction -> counterfactual reprocessing and possible offline revision. Mode-conditioned write gating: the operating-mode variable from the salience-network coordinator (SD-032a) determines which substrates can write to E3, episodic memory, policy updates, and autonomic coupling. Generalises MECH-094 hypothesis tag to a mode-conditioned family of write gates. Operating mode is implemented as a soft probability vector over {external_task, internal_planning, internal_replay, offline_consolidation}, not a one-hot categorical.

Responsibility-bearing durable updates occur only at typed commit boundaries.
