hub_targets.title: Object identity is a cross-cutting representational primitive. An object is a token-bound identity representation that persists across time and perceptual gaps, generalising z_object/z_resource into an object-file/binding layer (ARC-006), defined by causal feature-coherence under intervention (MECH-278), and consumed by drive/goal (SD-057), hippocampal planning (MECH-262), and the self/other special-object cases. The four planned object capabilities -- (1) permanence, (2) self-as-object, (3) tools/affordances, (4) others-as-object -- are specialisations of one primitive, not four separate mechanisms.
Social cognition uses mirror modelling and coupling.

created_claims.title: Triadic co-reference primitive (declarative joint attention / synchronic two-slot identification): the agent can hold its OWN slot and ONE OTHER agent's slot simultaneously bound to a SINGLE shared object referent, for no instrumental reason. This relational self-other-object binding -- not a stable self (ARC-081) and not a generic object-persistence buffer (ARC-080 PILLAR 1) -- is the developmental prerequisite otherness inference (ARC-083) and theory of mind actually run through. It sits on ARC-080's slot-allocation machinery as a binding operation over two concurrently-live slots plus one object token.

hub_targets.title: Dynamic information governance: a complete inter-engine interface in REE requires THREE properties, not two -- (1) the decision-relevant content survives the sender's encoding, (2) sender and receiver are mutually legible so a constrained transformation between frozen endpoints exists (ARC-139 / MECH-537 / MECH-538), and (3) the exchange occurs under a routing state that grants the sender causal privilege over that receiver AT THAT MOMENT. Property (3) -- jurisdiction, or temporal/state ACCESS -- is a separate organisational level from content and from legibility, so a representation can be present, decodable, structurally connected to a downstream system, and still unable to affect it; and the corresponding repair is different in kind from an encoder fix or a bridge. The architectural consequence is that REE's effective interface graph is CONSTRUCTED rather than possessed: G_eff(t) is a function of wiring, representational geometry, control state and history, so the same computational substrate can belong to different effective networks at different times. SEPARABILITY FALSIFIER, which is the whole content of the commitment: if a static bridge between frozen endpoints restores the full behavioural phenotype irrespective of when the message is made available, level (3) is unnecessary and this commitment should be withdrawn in favour of ARC-139 plus MECH-539 alone.

Self-relative affordance uncertainty: the model under calibration is P(outcome | self-state, world-state, action), not P(outcome | world-state, action) -- E1/E2 maintain uncertainty over action consequences conditional on the CURRENT SELF-STATE, so a change in the self (growth, capability change, damage) selectively makes previously learned environmental relations uncertain again and selectively reopens exploration of the AFFECTED affordance regions without a global novelty reset.

The state REE's downstream proposal-generation and action-evaluation machinery consumes as 'the current state' may be more accurately modeled as a short-horizon, affordance-conditioned FORWARD-DISPLACED prediction s_hat(t+tau) rather than the literal current encoded latent, where tau is set by the causal-effect timescale of whichever action REE is presently committed to (or, absent commitment, by the shortest relevant affordance horizon among candidates). Displacement magnitude should scale with commitment quality -- larger when the committed trajectory is well-predicted and low-variance, collapsing toward the immediate encoded state when uncommitted or when prediction quality is poor -- so 'now', for any consumer that reads a single current-state latent, is itself a construction rather than a passthrough of the most recent sensory encoding.
E2 is the fast forward predictor of affordances.

E3 trajectory selection is currently COMPENSATORY, not veto-based: candidates are ranked by a single weighted sum over goal, harm/residue, feasibility/resource, coherence and epistemic terms, and commitment is gated by one precision (PE-variance) threshold (ARC-016). No per-candidate, per-space veto exists in the V3 substrate, so a large cost in one space can be outweighed by gains elsewhere. Multi-constraint VETO viability (any one space independently rejecting a trajectory) is the intended biological design, not a description of V3.

The cue-indexed E1 context vector (MECH-150) projects to an action_bias signal that is added to E2.action_object() outputs, producing top-down contextual weighting of the action-affordance manifold prior to HippocampalModule search.

Tools/affordances as object->action binding (PILLAR 3 of ARC-080): an object's afforded actions are bound to its object-file. The V3 SUBSTRATE EXISTS BUT IS UNGROUNDED -- SD-016 cue_action_proj is inert (V3-EXQ-449 found 0.0 gradient; the non-differentiable CEM blocks the path before E3.select; EXP-0155 queued to instrument). GROUNDING STRADDLES V3 on its own existing track (EXP-0155 instrumentation + the SD-055 differentiable-CEM dependency). FULL object->action binding via the object-file -- afforded actions keyed to a token-instance object-file slot -- IS V4, once the generalised object-file exists.

Motor primitive substrate at the bottom of the action-representation hierarchy: a small fixed dictionary of force-field-like primitive activations that vectorially combine to produce the action_object that E2 consumes. Required only when REE moves to continuous limb-like control.

created_claims.title: An affordance-and-valuation bridge is architecturally NECESSARY between the world model and the commitment boundary: the representation E3 arbitrates over must be an intermediate, action-conditioned structure -- what this organism can now do in this world, annotated with predicted consequences -- and not a direct map from z_world to a policy distribution. The decomposition is observation -> z_world / E1-E2 -> affordance-and-action geometry -> competing approach / avoidance / investigation tendencies -> E3 / commitment boundary -> motor policy. The bridge is not a new selector placed beside E3 and not a motor-primitive library (SD-044 supplies primitives; the bridge says which are currently viable from this body-state in this world-state); it is the terrain on which world modelling, valuation, responsibility and commitment meet. SEPARABILITY FALSIFIER, which is the whole content of this commitment: if a direct z_world -> policy mapping at matched capacity and compute reproduces the FULL behavioural phenotype -- not merely task reward, but counterfactual sensitivity, anticipation of consequence, reversibility, repair, and the ability to account internally for why a higher-reward action was not committed -- then no intermediate action-conditioned representation is warranted and this commitment should be withdrawn in favour of ARC-002 plus MECH-125 alone. A reward-only win for the bridge does not confirm it; a reward-only loss does not refute it.

hub_targets.title: Three BG-like loops operate at characteristic thalamic heartbeat rates.
E1, E2, and E3 run at characteristic rates (async multi-rate) rather than lockstep.

created_claims.title: Three-loop rate separation survives real asynchronous load (SD-006 phase 2).

hub_targets.title: A run is not admissible as negative evidence for a claim unless the organism instantiated for that run was demonstrably able to express -- and, where the claim is learning- or development-dependent, to acquire -- the faculty under test. Each organism-level experiment must therefore DECLARE, and a preflight must machine-verify against the instantiated organism, at minimum: the canonical profile identity and every explicit deviation from it; the mechanisms and capabilities the hypothesis presupposes; whether those mechanisms were constructed, enabled and reached on the production path; whether their decisive readouts engaged often enough for the test to be non-vacuous; whether their output could compete at the relevant arbitration surface at the scale present in the run; which forms of change were permitted (parameters, policy/value, E1/E2 representations, memory state, residue/EMA state, offline updates); and, where online learning is load-bearing, whether gradients were enabled, whether the intended trainable parameters were in an optimizer, and whether a parameter-delta witness confirms an actual update path. A run failing any declared precondition self-routes to a capability-precondition diagnostic status and MUST NOT be recorded as evidence against the claim. 'It did not learn' and 'it could not have learned' are different scientific outcomes.

REE Assembly needs a dedicated behavioural-adjudication methodology/skill for organism-level behavioural experiment design and interpretation ("umpire, not ruler": observe, preserve the observation without embedding an explanation, generate competing explanations, derive predictions, construct discriminating perturbations, blind condition labels where practical, apply pre-specified hypothesis-directed measures, also run discovery-oriented analysis for structure not anticipated in advance, adjudicate across the pattern of evidence, replicate, and test generalisation under environmental change) -- because a fixed, pre-specified scalar-metric approach risks conflating stochasticity/exploration/noise with the behavioural organisation actually of interest, and risks Goodharting once a convenient metric becomes the de facto definition of the phenomenon.

REE's designated compression sites are systematically UNTRAINED, so representational-ceiling results measured at them are uninterpretable as capacity findings. Verified 2026-08-26 at three independent sites: (a) E2.action_object_head, SD-004's action-object bottleneck that the hippocampal CEM searches inside, receives zero gradient from every REE training path and is a frozen random projection with ~99.5% of its variance explained by the action label (SD-080); (b) the ARC-004 higher-order latent stack -- beta_encoder, theta_encoder and delta_encoder appear ZERO times in agent.py, have no loss, no optimiser and no predictive head at any horizon, and are an untrained random-projection cascade smoothed by one hardcoded shared EMA (alpha_shared = 0.3); (c) no value-shaped objective reaches any encoder at all -- compute_benefit_eval_loss reads z_world.detach() and trains only E3.benefit_eval_head. The corollary is methodological: a null measured at an untrained compression site is evidence about the absence of a training signal, not about the representation's capacity or about the sufficiency of the architecture.

Evidence-domain jurisdiction rule: evidence receives no broader jurisdiction than the experiment earned. Organism-level validation is a PROFILE over eight orthogonal evidence domains -- D0 instrument validity, D1 local mechanism validity, D2 local causal consequence, D3 closed-loop behavioural consequence, D4 ecological (world-family, not seed) generalisation, D5 developmental validity, D6 integrated compatibility and simplification, D7 adaptive recovery from a materially wrong internal model -- never a scalar ladder and never one "intelligence score". Whenever a result is promoted UPWARD -- into a roadmap or closure-plan node, an architectural recommendation, a milestone or progress summary (CURRENT_FRONT, insights_report, morning digest, a governance cycle's headline), a default-on decision, or any statement that REE itself has become more competent -- the promoting text MUST carry an explicit line of the form "Evidence domain reached: D? / Domains not tested: ..." naming the SPECIFIC untested domains that matter for that claim. A frozen-latent decoder result establishes at most D1; a live selection perturbation at most D2; seven seeds in one world family do not reach D4. Raw manifests and per-run autopsies are exempt; the rule binds the SUMMARY layer, where mechanism validity is most easily narrated as organismal progress.

Compensatory realizability -- recovery without restoration: an adaptive organism should not be REQUIRED to recover by reconstructing its former internal state; the target property is the capacity to preserve or recover a useful function by REORGANIZING CAUSAL RESPONSIBILITY across internal processes rather than returning to one canonical implementation. Operational criterion: after perturbation, recovered behaviour must be accompanied by a demonstrably ALTERED DISTRIBUTION OF CAUSAL IMPORTANCE, not a hidden reconstruction of the original pathway -- evidenced by the original route remaining observably impaired, a different internal process becoming NECESSARY (selective re-ablation removes the recovered competence), and later restoration of the original route producing competition/redundancy/reorganisation rather than revealing it had silently returned. Requires a four-arm design -- no-intervention, restorative-normalization analogue, compensatory-amplification analogue (lesion left in place, the recruited substitute selectively strengthened), and a CONTROL-AMPLIFICATION arm strengthening a comparably sized non-compensatory process -- because without the fourth arm 'generic added capacity' is an unexcluded explanation of any recovery.

Stuckness-triggered attractor-escape exploration: a triggered, organism-level annealing analogue in which persistent CONFIDENCE-WITHOUT-RESOLUTION (settled attractor, repeated failure to reduce the active need/goal error -- natural trigger substrate: MECH-482's epistemic_deficit accumulator) transiently injects variation ABOVE the immediate-action level -- perturbing candidate trajectories, strategy proposals, retrieved attractors, goal decompositions, and the precision/authority of the currently dominant attractor, with escalating breadth under continued stuckness -- to escape a false bottom (a locally stable but persistently inadequate basin), then decays after successful resolution. Distinct from tonic or near-tie action noise: the trigger is unresolvedness, not uncertainty; two well-understood, similarly-good actions warrant NO exploration, while a high-confidence failing strategy warrants it strongly.

Dependency structure among evidence must be REPRESENTED and conditioned on, and independence must never be INFERRED from the absence of a recorded dependency. Any representation that can later influence belief, confidence, closure or action must carry enough (uncertain, compressed) causal genealogy that the descendants of a hypothesis cannot be counted as witnesses independent of it. The rule is binding in its NEGATIVE form only -- a hypothesis must not cite its own descendants as independent witnesses -- and is explicitly NOT the positive rule "descendants should be collapsed to one vote": where a structural dependency exists but the observations across it are partial or contradicting, dependent reports can support a hypothesis MORE than independent ones would, so maximal discounting is the larger error. The invariant therefore constrains the REPRESENTATION (dependency must be expressible and readable), not the arithmetic (no fixed discount is mandated). Unknown provenance is not independent provenance; uncertain source is not confidently external source.

Canonical readiness umpire: REE maintains an explicit, inspectable process for recognising when a reproducible organism has become sufficiently coherent and competent that formal reference-organism review is warranted -- while remaining structurally unable to answer that question itself. The detector observes/derives/reports/escalates state transitions (NO_WARRANT / ADMISSION_PASS_WARRANTED / REFERENCE_ORGANISM_REVIEW_WARRANTED / USER_DECISION_REQUIRED / CANONICAL_OBSERVED) over explicit gates (identifiable organism; admission-doctrine candidate substrate; COEXISTENCE of mechanisms in the same animal; whole-organism non-degeneracy; behavioural evidence; reproducibility) -- never a readiness percentage, never self-canonisation. Warrants are withdrawable; profile-admission readiness and reference-organism readiness remain separate thresholds; for developmental REEs the reproducible object may be the developmental recipe and constitution rather than the adult state.

Can a system distinguish a change in its own code from a change in the world that code represents -- and if it cannot, what is a maintenance mechanism entitled to preserve? A label-free adaptive readout is blind to the difference between a drifting upstream encoding and a genuine change in the latent cause being encoded, so a self-repairing receiver can "correct" a TRUTHFUL update away, restoring an obsolete mapping and reporting it as stability; and an experimenter who scores only restored downstream performance cannot tell those apart either. The question has a sharp REE form: any claim that a maintenance process REPAIRED a mapping must show that the pre-drift mapping was still the CORRECT one, not merely that the receiver converged on something self-consistent -- which requires an anchor outside both endpoints (a ground-truth task target, a preserved external referent, or an explicit provenance marker on the change) that REE does not currently represent anywhere. Whether such an anchor is necessary, or whether self-consistency plus behavioural adequacy is the only coherent criterion available to an embedded system, is open.

created_claims.title: What would constitute a minimal-working-intelligence EVENT for REE -- a single non-oracular adaptive-recovery episode in which a previously useful internal model becomes materially wrong, the organism detects the mismatch, allocates information-seeking or computation toward it, updates the relevant representation or interface without being told which subsystem failed, recovers closed-loop competence above a preregistered threshold, retains still-valid knowledge, transfers some advantage to a second related perturbation, and loses the advantage when the proposed adaptive machinery is ablated -- and which perturbation class (cue remapping, resource-contingency reversal, hidden transition change, memory or provenance corruption, interface drift, sensor or affordance change) is first NON-VACUOUS on the substrate REE actually has? Such an event is qualitatively different from an accumulation of local PASSes; passing one tiny-world challenge would establish an integrated adaptive episode, not general intelligence.

hub_targets.title: Replay-driven rebucketing: accumulated consequential-divergence evidence -- typed insufficiency signals from decision outcomes (prediction/consequence mismatch, harm or goal error, repeated veto/conflict, divergent outcomes following apparently equivalent E1 states), never category labels -- drives split / merge / feature-reweighting / relation-discovery / event-boundary-revision / abstraction-change over E1's equivalence classes, via REPLAY of non-contiguous episodes under a common evaluative frame (retrospective representation learning: later experience revises how earlier experiences are bucketed). Candidate rebucketings are COUNTERFACTUALLY tested before adoption (does representing the distinction improve predictions under relevant alternative actions and contexts?), and consequential revisions preferentially complete in a decoupled/sleep phase whose job includes RE-INDEXING episodic traces so autobiographical addressability survives the representational change -- sleep as safe maintenance of the representational coordinate system itself. E3 must not become E1's teacher: downstream selection changes the learning conditions and evidence pressure on E1, never its truth content directly (non-oracular).

Sleep as selective interface maintenance -- the third offline job: MECH-529 gives offline consolidation two functions, revising the representation (split/merge/reweight over equivalence classes) and re-indexing episodic traces so autobiographical addressability survives that revision. This claim adds a THIRD: adjusting or stabilising the INTERFACE -- the subspace through which another subsystem reads the revised representation. The prediction is explicitly NOT global alignment but a PLASTICITY/STABILITY DIVISION OF LABOUR across interfaces: some reconfigure because recent learning demands it, others remain stable because downstream continuity matters more, so the strongest test compares at least TWO interfaces with different predicted plasticity rather than asking whether all systems become more similar after sleep. Four distinguishable post-sleep signatures: S1 representational retuning (interface metrics move only because the sender moved), S2 interface recalibration (local competence stable, communication subspace or bridge complexity improves), S3 stable scaffold (representations move, mapping holds), S4 maladaptive homogenisation (similarity rises while local competence or task-specific differentiation worsens).

Imagination-learning constraint principle: simulated/imagined experience may license only LICIT forms of learning (consistency checking, plan optimisation, schema integration) and is FORBIDDEN from driving durable world-model updates, prediction validation, or novel-fact generation. The provenance gate (MECH-365 committed-vs-imagined field) is the mechanism that enforces this principle; the principle states WHAT learning imagination may and may not produce, independent of any single gate's implementation.

Receiver-local self-healing is the standing rival to every cross-system interface-repair result: a consumer can restore its use of a drifting sender WITHOUT any episodic pair identity, any cross-system label, or any offline replay, by adjusting afferent weights from presynaptic sender activity and its own postsynaptic output under homeostatic error against fixed pre-drift output statistics -- and because this produces the SAME observable as interface repair (downstream performance restored despite upstream change), any REE result attributing a rescue to correctly paired replay must beat a faithful implementation of it at a matched update budget. Its preconditions are its predictions, and they are what make it falsifiable rather than a residual explanation: it needs redundant smooth tuning that continues to tile the represented variable, incremental rather than abrupt change, plasticity at least as fast as drift, and enough sampling or reactivation to estimate the correlations and output statistics -- so its advantage is a function of the DRIFT-RATE-TO-MAINTENANCE-INTERVAL RATIO, and an unswept timescale silently chooses the winner. Three regimes weaken it and are where a genuine pairing effect should be sought: large infrequent drift, drift of the receiver's own scaffold or decoder, and continuous symmetries permitting an unanchored global rotation. Its more durable variants -- population response normalisation, and a stable recurrent predictive model supplying covariance structure -- are NOT free local plasticity: they assume a receiver scaffold that is fixed or changes far more slowly than the feed-forward representation, and that assumption is itself a testable architectural commitment, not a background condition.

Predictive-equivalence envelope for claim rotation (the checksum GOV-ROTATE-1 lacks): two representations of one canonical claim count as the SAME claim -- and may share one truth state -- only while the experimentally relevant predictions they license remain compatible over an EXPLICITLY DECLARED domain of contexts, interventions, observables, scales and auxiliary assumptions (the equivalence envelope); equivalence is earned by surviving discriminating interventions, never assumed from the wording reading as a paraphrase, and when a discriminating intervention reveals divergence the divergence MUST be classified (scope condition / hidden auxiliary assumption / underspecified parent claim / invalid rotation / genuinely new proposition) BEFORE any evidence is allowed to transfer between the two representations.

The interface-repair adjudication standard: a claim that some maintenance process REPAIRED a cross-system mapping -- as opposed to strengthening a memory, triggering a completion, or riding a subspace that never broke -- is admissible only from a single design, or one tightly integrated series, that closes all six links itself, because the confounds differ across preparations and therefore do not cancel when rows are stacked: (1) MEASURED CHANGE in a transfer-relevant direction, which excludes unit turnover, registration noise, behavioural change, and any rotation preserving the receiver-potent subspace; (2) LOCAL PRESERVATION of sender information, sender-local use, and receiver-local memory and competence, at the moment of the cross-system test; (3) ACCESS LOSS measured by a causal receiver-dependent output, never by decodability or correlation; (4) PAIR-SPECIFIC MAINTENANCE, compared against a within-context permutation preserving event count, state occupancy, marginal content, firing and plasticity opportunity and breaking only which sender event pairs with which receiver state; (5) CAUSAL RESTORATION on held-out episodes; (6) RIVAL EXCLUSION at matched budgets. Two consequences bind. First, a GATE-0 LESION PROOF precedes every maintenance arm: the imposed change must degrade causal receiver use while leaving both endpoints locally intact AND be restorable by a known oracle inverse -- if the oracle cannot restore use the lesion is not an interface lesion and the drift model is invalid, if magnitude-matched null-subspace drift degrades use the subspace identification is invalid, and if task-relevant drift does not degrade use there is nothing to repair and the experiment stops. Second, the estimand is the correctly-paired arm beating the MAXIMUM of the permuted-pair, receiver-local-adaptation and local-rehearsal arms, never the unmaintained floor: a correct-pair advantage over the floor alone is equally explained by generic plasticity, extra rehearsal and homeostatic adaptation. Local-memory equivalence is a PROSPECTIVE constraint tested by equivalence tests, never a covariate regressed out afterwards, because conditioning on a treatment-affected memory score is a collider.

created_claims.title: Can a system distinguish a change in its own code from a change in the world that code represents -- and if it cannot, what is a maintenance mechanism entitled to preserve? A label-free adaptive readout is blind to the difference between a drifting upstream encoding and a genuine change in the latent cause being encoded, so a self-repairing receiver can "correct" a TRUTHFUL update away, restoring an obsolete mapping and reporting it as stability; and an experimenter who scores only restored downstream performance cannot tell those apart either. The question has a sharp REE form: any claim that a maintenance process REPAIRED a mapping must show that the pre-drift mapping was still the CORRECT one, not merely that the receiver converged on something self-consistent -- which requires an anchor outside both endpoints (a ground-truth task target, a preserved external referent, or an explicit provenance marker on the change) that REE does not currently represent anywhere. Whether such an anchor is necessary, or whether self-consistency plus behavioural adequacy is the only coherent criterion available to an embedded system, is open.

hub_targets.title: Authority field: the moment-to-moment functional conformation of L-space -- the effective directed distance / permeability / gain between representational regions, its asymmetry, persistence and decay, the compatibility of simultaneously active routes, and a local coalition's capacity to recruit wider participation -- is a STATE VARIABLE in its own right: continuous, graded, state-dependent, endogenously recruited from the organism's own prediction error, goal progress, residue and learned relevance, with its own competition and dynamics, and not identical to stored content, to the slow regulatory/neuromodulatory field, or to the final policy; falsifiable consequence: two runs with materially similar content state but different field state differ systematically in retrieval, commitment and distractor recovery, and an equally-parameterised static scalar or global gate cannot reproduce the same context-sensitive behaviour across matched tasks and seeds.

Ephaptic/oscillatory field-level coherence functions as a fast, non-synaptic CONTENT-AGGREGATION mechanism -- not merely the confidence/eligibility readout MECH-270 already covers -- synthesising distributed oscillatory information (amplitude, phase, relative phase, frequency, synchrony, cross-frequency relationships) into the temporally-coherent 'actionable now' state that seeds hippocampal proposal generation. The field need not 'understand' anything; its attraction as a mechanism is that the physical substrate may perform part of the aggregation automatically, fast enough that proposal generation is not stale by the time candidate futures are produced.

Content authority (which candidate future should win commitment -- already REE's existing architecture via MECH-090/MECH-341/ARC-003) and temporal/readiness authority (whether a candidate future has become sufficiently coherent, in the cross-system field-coherence sense, for commitment to be permitted to land AT ALL) are distinct constitutional questions that may require different mechanisms. Fast cross-system field coherence (extending MECH-499's content-aggregation function) is a candidate mechanism for the readiness axis specifically -- locating the moving frontier at which a previously branching predicted future becomes sufficiently well-predicted for commitment to land -- distinct from MECH-434's evidence/posterior-driven epistemic commitment timing at the inference layer, and distinct from MECH-090's beta-gated propagation of an already-decided commit.

Routing-only or representational field: does the trajectory of L-space's coupling/authority state (MECH-534) itself carry task-relevant relational structure -- spatial relations, sequence, recent history -- beyond the instantaneous content state it gates, or does it only set eligibility, gain and topology over content stored elsewhere, or both? Pre-registered discriminator: on the SAME stored representations, controlled for parameter count and training exposure, an instantaneous decoder over r(t) versus a trajectory decoder over r(t-k:t) plus the authority variables; the representational branch is supported only if the trajectory decoder predicts current global structure, the appropriate retrieved path, or the next committed action better.

Ephaptic field strength is the COUPLING CONSTANT of the perceptual settling competition that sets slot occupancy (MECH-521), not a quantity that is measured and counted. A physical field does not enumerate domains; it sets the interaction strength from which the domain count emerges -- and because coherence is a property of each population separately, a field-derived setter is natively HETEROGENEOUS (different streams settling into different domain counts simultaneously) rather than imposing the single ordered abstraction axis that Badre and Nee 2018 reports the evidence does not support. This is a THIRD ephaptic function, distinct from MECH-499 (what the actionable now CONTAINS) and MECH-500 (WHEN a branching future is coherent enough to commit): at what GRAIN the now is carved.

created_claims.title: Endogenous or exogenous routing generation: does CLOSING the loop -- letting the routing state be generated partly by the aggregate activity of the very subsystems whose effective connectivity it sets, so that local activity -> field state -> altered effective connectivity -> new activity -> updated field state -- confer any capability that a matched OPEN-LOOP routing schedule cannot reproduce? Pre-registered discriminator: two routing generators whose OUTPUT marginal statistics are matched (gain distribution, temporal autocorrelation, motif dwell time, transition entropy) and whose parameter and compute budgets are matched, one supplied independently of module activity and one evolved from it, compared on robustness to perturbation, speed of reconfiguration after a context change, adaptive routing in unseen contexts, and recovery after a transient lesion -- never on raw task score, which the extra recurrence alone can move. A null here is informative and expected to be common: if both perform identically, endogenous field feedback is unnecessary and the simpler scheduled field should be kept.

hub_targets.title: The system maintains a functional distinction between simulation-mode content and real-experience content, such that simulation content does not accumulate in the viability map as committed experience; failures of this distinction produce confabulation (simulated events encoded as real).

Source monitoring (frontoparietal network; Johnson-Raye tradition) is a candidate biological implementation of the simulation/real distinction required by MECH-094 -- distinguishing internally generated from externally received content at the level of memory encoding and attribution.
Psychosis is a precision-weighting failure where prior beliefs persistently dominate sensory evidence; the generative model becomes self-sealing and sensory update is suppressed.

False evidence multiplication: a provenance error can change the apparent CARDINALITY of evidence and not only its source label. One internally generated hypothesis H produces descendants through prediction, hippocampal replay, counterfactual simulation, retrieved memory and ambiguous perceptual interpretation; if shared ancestry is lost, those descendants are counted as several mutually corroborating observations and confidence in H rises with no corresponding increase in world evidence. Two consequences are asserted to be separable and must not be collapsed: a phenomenological branch (self-generated content losing evidence of self-generation acquires external/perceptual status) and an epistemic branch (descendants losing shared ancestry inflate posterior confidence and shorten information-seeking). LOCUS CORRECTION, carried in the claim rather than deferred: the operative variable is the READOUT'S DEFAULT FOR UNKNOWN ANCESTRY, not the corruption event itself -- an architecture that treats unrecorded dependency as independence will inflate whether or not any genealogy was ever corrupted.
Hallucination is a generative-model dominance failure where top-down predictions produce percepts without corresponding bottom-up sensory grounding.

created_claims.title: Are source attribution and evidence cardinality DISSOCIABLE readouts of one provenance manipulation, or does a change in either always drag the other? Specifically: can P(external | representation) move without the effective independent-source count moving (a hallucination-like outcome with no confidence inflation), can the effective source count and calibration move without any change in external-source attribution (a delusion-like outcome with no altered phenomenology), and does a broader self-monitoring failure move both? A null on the dissociation is itself informative, because it would mean provenance errors alter source labels only and evidence cardinality is protected some other way -- which would retire the false-evidence-multiplication branch while leaving the source-monitoring account intact.

hub_targets.title: REE developmental training proceeds in three ordered stages: (1) self-as-object — action-space discovery via motor experimentation, producing the substrate MECH-256's comparator requires; (2) objects-as-patterns — object-schema formation via experimental action on the world; (3) others-as-special-objects — modelling other agents as objects with their own policies. The ordering is load-bearing: without a self-model the agent cannot distinguish self-produced from world-produced sensory change; without object-schemas the agent cannot recognise other-agents as a distinguished subclass of objects. Refines the generic ARC-019 curriculum-gates claim.
Social cognition uses mirror modelling and coupling.

hub_targets.title: z_world P0 anti-collapse encoder-training recipe: a mini-batched P0 that trains the SD-005 split-encoder world path on STATIC scene-structure targets derived from world_obs alone (hazard/resource presence + bucketed nearest-Chebyshev distance), with class-balanced CE and a VICReg-style variance/covariance anti-collapse penalty, replacing the SD-009 event-contrastive + SD-018 P0 that was measured to COLLAPSE z_world to participation ratio ~1.06 at world_dim=128. Supplies the trained encoder that SD-031 / E2WorldForward P1 and V3-EXQ-783 both require.

created_claims.title: task_term_gradient_share_must_be_floored_not_weighted. Even when a task-aligned term is present in an encoder objective, transfer is gated by whether that term retains a non-trivial share of the GRADIENT against the preservation term; under fixed relative weights and no floor, raising the preservation weight monotonically starves it. REE has the crowding curve already measured on SD-106's own landing: mean held-out grounding lift 0.5702 (shipped) -> 0.4313 (w=50) -> 0.4064 (w=200, the arm V3-EXQ-1023a ran) -> 0.3982 (w=500), recorded there as a COST and never read as a mechanism. DreamerV3's corrective is a FLOOR rather than a weight: free bits, L = max(1, KL), contributes zero gradient below 1 nat, and the stated failure it prevents is exactly this one -- the regulariser wins, the code degenerates, the latent stops carrying task-relevant distinctions and 'the actor starves because the actor sees only the latent'. MuZero's analogue is per-head loss scaling by 1/K plus a 1/2 gradient scale at the dynamics entry. The general form this claim asserts: the protected quantity is the task term's gradient share, and it must be enforced by a SATURATING floor on the competing term, because a weight ratio must be re-tuned whenever anything else in the objective changes whereas a floor does not.

created_claims.title: encoder_objective_must_carry_the_consumers_target / auxiliary_task_head_transfer. An encoder objective transfers to an action consumer only to the extent the objective itself contains a term whose target is the consumer's target, or an improvement on it. Task-agnostic variance preservation contains no such term, so its gradient is not systematically aligned with what the consumer reads and additional budget moves the encoder along directions the consumer does not use. MuZero is the limit case: the representation function receives gradients ONLY from policy, value and reward heads, and the paper explicitly refuses any requirement that the hidden state reconstruct the observation or match the true environment state. The ENABLING CONDITION, which is easy to miss and is load-bearing, is that MuZero's policy target is the MCTS-IMPROVED search policy rather than the network's own prior: an encoder trained toward a consumer's CURRENT output has a degenerate self-agreement fixed point, so 'train the encoder through its consumer' is incomplete without a policy-improvement operator. DreamerV3 is the affordable form and REE's correct template: task-relevant supervision enters the representation objective as AUXILIARY HEADS (reward and continue) on the same latent as the decoder at beta_pred = 1.0, while actor and critic gradients are STOPPED at the model state -- so the consumer's TARGET reaches the encoder and the consumer's GRADIENT does not. CORRECTION OF RECORD: the CDQ-010 row's premise that DreamerV3 carries actor/value gradients into the latent is wrong in the gradient sense, and that correction is the mechanism, because it is what lets a preservation objective transfer without any single consumer owning a SHARED latent.

created_claims.title: objective_consumer_transfer_blocked_by_readout_reparameterisation_invariance. SD-106's preservation term is ||W f(x) - x||^2 / var with W a FREELY-TRAINED linear decoder optimised jointly with the encoder (ree-v3 ree_core/latent/zworld_p0.py:556-558, head_params joined to the same Adam). That loss is EXACTLY invariant to the general linear group acting on the 32-dim code: for any invertible A, the pair (A.f, W.A^-1) attains an identical loss. The objective therefore cannot distinguish two codes in the same GL(32) orbit and cannot prefer a well-conditioned representative over an arbitrarily ill-conditioned one. The consumer -- a fixed-capacity MLP trained by SGD on the FROZEN code -- is NOT invariant to A: its reachable solutions and sample efficiency depend on the code's spectrum. Transfer therefore fails not because information is missing but because the objective is structurally blind to the property that governs whether the consumer can use it. The substrate's own comment cites Baldi & Hornik (1989) as its anchor ('with a linear decoder the MSE optimum IS the principal subspace') -- and that theorem yields the principal SUBSPACE only up to an arbitrary invertible transformation, never the principal COMPONENTS. PCA-32 is the canonical orthonormal eigenvalue-ordered representative of that same orbit, which is why it clears the bar 3/3 at matched reconstruction (world_obs R^2 0.9984 vs SD-106's 0.9974) while SD-106 falls 0.1227 short at the consumer. The conditioning terms REE does carry bound the orbit only partially: the VICReg variance term is a ONE-SIDED floor, mean relu(gamma - std_j), with no cap on anisotropy above the floor, and the covariance term decorrelates without equalising, so the code's condition number is unconstrained.

hub_targets.title: Residue should constrain trajectories before distorting core representations.

control_plane.commit_maintenance_release. The R-c readiness signals that gate commitment ENTRY (MECH-090: score_margin decisiveness + nav_competence) must ALSO be able to RELEASE an already-elevated beta latch when execution readiness degrades mid-commitment. The release is a graded, bounded-accumulation drift-to-a-release-bound (conflict-scaled by the deficit magnitude), NOT a one-shot threshold flag; targeted to the active committed motor program (not a global brake); and hysteretic with a reengagement path that guards the premature-abort pole. This closes the V3-EXQ-592f reach gap (the MECH-090 R-c conjunction is admission-only by design; no existing release pathway covers degraded-readiness-mid- commitment).

Verbal or symbolic representation of an undifferentiated affective action-pressure is itself a low-risk PARTIAL commit: it discharges the pressure into a cheap committed trajectory, and when that symbolic commit produces prediction mismatch (the articulated expectation fails) or social witnessing (another agent responds to it), the mismatch updates future trajectory-arbitration scoring for the affect's full-cost action alternatives -- which is the mechanism by which articulating an urge changes what the agent later does.

Basal-ganglia-like action persistence (a post-commit latch / commitment hysteresis) is PROTECTIVE against representational degradation rather than NECESSARY for competence: with an adequate directional representation a memoryless greedy actor forages competently with no latch at all (V3-EXQ-978 local_view_greedy anchor, 45.75 res/ep), whereas with a direction-blind representation (MECH-535) a latch abolishes the ambitendency limit cycle but yields perseveration (straight runs into the boundary) with no rise in competence. Predicted dissociating signature: adding k>=2-step action persistence to the direction-blind actor removes the two-cell cycle AND leaves resources/episode flat; a competence rise under the latch would instead indicate a gating deficit.

created_claims.title: Rumination is a mismatchless symbolic-commit loop: repeated symbolic commits (verbal or imagined rehearsal of an affective pressure) that generate NO prediction mismatch and NO social witnessing fail to re-rank the candidate set, so the same trajectory is re-proposed and re-committed symbolically while arbitration never updates -- a perseveration signature distinct from over-persistence of an EMBODIED commitment, and the discriminator between therapeutic articulation and rumination is whether a symbolic commit changes subsequent arbitration scores.

Any agent that builds a model of the world, acts in that world, and learns from experience cannot safely update its world model while using it to navigate the world; it therefore requires periodic offline phases in which action is suspended and the model is reorganised via replay and simulation -- this is not a biological contingency but a general computational necessity for model-building agents.
Subjective now is a control surface across temporal horizons.
V(t): Verisimilitude is the precision-weighted, phase-aligned, hierarchical correspondence between ascending sensory-constrained and descending model-based signals.

created_claims.title: Subjective now is the temporal convergence point of E1 perceptual prediction and hippocampal trajectory rollout, not the moment of raw sensory arrival: the convergence sits AHEAD of real-time input (supplying the motor-execution buffer), plan origins are anchored where the two streams first agree, and backward hippocampal rollouts that converge on that point constitute retroactive causal inference over candidate pasts.

hub_targets.title: Integration does not require representational sameness, it requires selective mutual legibility: specialised cognitive subsystems may preserve distinct high-dimensional PRIVATE internal representations while coordinating through low-dimensional, context-sensitive communication subspaces and low-complexity transformations, so development can raise local specialisation and cross-system legibility AT THE SAME TIME rather than trading one against the other. Non-redundant prediction: a maturing REE shows rising local competence in E1/E2/hippocampus/E3 while GLOBAL representational similarity between them stays flat or falls, and increasing representational similarity between subsystems must therefore NOT be used as the default marker of maturation. This is an explicit ALTERNATIVE framing to ARC-121's shared epistemic-state object, not a refutation of it: one common object, specialised objects with a shared interface format, specialised objects joined by context-specific translation, and a hybrid invariant-core-plus-private-dimensions architecture all remain live, and ARC-121 must not be used to prejudge the question.

Communication-subspace routing failure -- encoded but not exposed: a task variable can be strongly encoded in the FULL sender latent while being weakly represented in the CONSUMER-FACING subspace, producing the phenotype `external probe succeeds -> native behaviour fails` with no information having been destroyed. This is a third failure category strictly between 'information absent from the sender' and 'information used by the receiver', and it is distinct from MECH-517 (the decoder collapses) and MECH-532 (the compression site has no trained decompression stage): routing failure requires neither a collapse nor a missing readout, because the consumer can be reading a perfectly healthy low-rank subspace that simply does not carry the distinction. Operationalised by cross-validated Reduced Rank Regression from sender activity to the ACTUAL consumer input tensor, comparing task decodability in the full sender, inside the estimated communication subspace, and in its orthogonal complement; the diagnostic signature is `target decodable from X` but `poorly decodable from P_comm X`.

Minimum bridge complexity as the measure of mutual legibility: for systems A and B and a family of constrained mappings of increasing expressiveness (native readout -> orthogonal/Procrustes -> affine -> low-rank affine -> constrained nonlinear -> high-capacity upper bound), define L(A -> B) = the minimum bridge complexity achieving a predeclared HELD-OUT functional criterion between FROZEN endpoints; lower L means greater mutual legibility, and the simpler the bridge that works the stronger the evidence that the sender already held an appropriately structured representation -- a high-capacity bridge that succeeds may be performing new cognition and is therefore evidence about the bridge, not about the endpoints. L must never be read alone: two systems that became identical because one LOST its specialisation would show falling L with worsening cognition, so development is tracked on two axes (local specialisation/competence, and cross-system legibility). Non-redundant developmental prediction: sender and receiver each improve local competence WHILE global representational similarity stays flat or falls, task information concentrates in the consumer-facing subspace, and minimum bridge rank falls -- coordination without homogenisation.

Sleep as selective interface maintenance -- the third offline job: MECH-529 gives offline consolidation two functions, revising the representation (split/merge/reweight over equivalence classes) and re-indexing episodic traces so autobiographical addressability survives that revision. This claim adds a THIRD: adjusting or stabilising the INTERFACE -- the subspace through which another subsystem reads the revised representation. The prediction is explicitly NOT global alignment but a PLASTICITY/STABILITY DIVISION OF LABOUR across interfaces: some reconfigure because recent learning demands it, others remain stable because downstream continuity matters more, so the strongest test compares at least TWO interfaces with different predicted plasticity rather than asking whether all systems become more similar after sleep. Four distinguishable post-sleep signatures: S1 representational retuning (interface metrics move only because the sender moved), S2 interface recalibration (local competence stable, communication subspace or bridge complexity improves), S3 stable scaffold (representations move, mapping holds), S4 maladaptive homogenisation (similarity rises while local competence or task-specific differentiation worsens).

Recurrent interface stability: an interface can be statically useful yet recurrently unstable -- a bridge with one-step utility > 0 can fail repeated closed-loop application, and REE traverses most interfaces repeatedly over trajectories, episodes and recurrent prediction loops. Two mechanisms, to be distinguished experimentally: (a) OFF-MANIFOLD COMPOUNDING -- a bridge trained on native receiver states emits a slightly off-distribution receiver state, the next application treats it as ordinary input, and B_0 -> T(A_0,B_0) = B_1' -> T(A_1,B_1') = B_2' accumulates displacement into a regime the bridge never saw; (b) SEMANTIC DOUBLE-COUNTING -- content already injected is not recognised as present and is re-amplified, escalating gain. Design corollary: CUMULATIVE translation (each step operates on the previously translated receiver state) versus CLEAN-BASE translation (each step computed against an unmodified native receiver state, the residual held as a temporary gated overlay) -- translated information should first be tested as an overlay or gated read surface, never as an irreversible rewrite of the receiver's core latent state. Adds an EIGHTH rung to INV-105's ladder, RECURRENTLY STABLE: repeated use preserves receiver-state validity, information calibration and functional behaviour over the timescale the system actually uses the interface -- assessed BEFORE behavioural usefulness is read as architecturally meaningful in a dynamical system. Sleep corollary for MECH-540: offline interface recalibration must improve or preserve closed-loop stability when waking dynamics resume; a sleep-induced change that improves a static probe but destabilises the next waking trajectory is a failure, not consolidation. Signatures: one-step rescue + cumulative collapse + clean-base stability = recurrent interface instability; cumulative stability + correct-pair specificity = a functionally coherent recurrent bridge; both fixed and conditioned bridges failing while richer source information succeeds = upstream representation deficiency remains more likely.

created_claims.title: Receiver-local self-healing is the standing rival to every cross-system interface-repair result: a consumer can restore its use of a drifting sender WITHOUT any episodic pair identity, any cross-system label, or any offline replay, by adjusting afferent weights from presynaptic sender activity and its own postsynaptic output under homeostatic error against fixed pre-drift output statistics -- and because this produces the SAME observable as interface repair (downstream performance restored despite upstream change), any REE result attributing a rescue to correctly paired replay must beat a faithful implementation of it at a matched update budget. Its preconditions are its predictions, and they are what make it falsifiable rather than a residual explanation: it needs redundant smooth tuning that continues to tile the represented variable, incremental rather than abrupt change, plasticity at least as fast as drift, and enough sampling or reactivation to estimate the correlations and output statistics -- so its advantage is a function of the DRIFT-RATE-TO-MAINTENANCE-INTERVAL RATIO, and an unswept timescale silently chooses the winner. Three regimes weaken it and are where a genuine pairing effect should be sought: large infrequent drift, drift of the receiver's own scaffold or decoder, and continuous symmetries permitting an unanchored global rotation. Its more durable variants -- population response normalisation, and a stable recurrent predictive model supplying covariance structure -- are NOT free local plasticity: they assume a receiver scaffold that is fixed or changes far more slowly than the feed-forward representation, and that assumption is itself a testable architectural commitment, not a background condition.

hub_targets.title: The latent-access evidence ladder: a variable's status in a latent space is not one property but seven, which must never be collapsed -- encoded (statistically present) != decodable (recoverable by an external probe) != natively accessible (usable by the system's existing consumer) != bridgeable (usable through a constrained map between frozen endpoints) != pairing-specific (useful specifically when the correct sender state is paired with the correct receiver situation) != causally used (interventions on its content alter downstream computation) != behaviourally beneficial (that causal use improves adaptive performance). Two evidential consequences bind rather than advise: (1) a content-transmission claim about any internal channel or bridge REQUIRES correct-vs-mismatched-vs-zero-vs-moment-matched-random controls, because a channel can be strongly load-bearing while its example-specific content is barely load-bearing; (2) a null measured on a COMPRESSED representation requires a dimensionality-matched RANDOM-PROJECTION floor, not a zero floor, before it can be read as information loss.

Communication-subspace routing failure -- encoded but not exposed: a task variable can be strongly encoded in the FULL sender latent while being weakly represented in the CONSUMER-FACING subspace, producing the phenotype `external probe succeeds -> native behaviour fails` with no information having been destroyed. This is a third failure category strictly between 'information absent from the sender' and 'information used by the receiver', and it is distinct from MECH-517 (the decoder collapses) and MECH-532 (the compression site has no trained decompression stage): routing failure requires neither a collapse nor a missing readout, because the consumer can be reading a perfectly healthy low-rank subspace that simply does not carry the distinction. Operationalised by cross-validated Reduced Rank Regression from sender activity to the ACTUAL consumer input tensor, comparing task decodability in the full sender, inside the estimated communication subspace, and in its orthogonal complement; the diagnostic signature is `target decodable from X` but `poorly decodable from P_comm X`.

Receiver-conditioned translation: what a sender should expose to a consumer is a function of the receiver's current state, not of the sender alone -- translated content = T(sender state, receiver state, receiver position / context) -- so the communication subspace (MECH-537) is CONTEXT-INDEXED rather than one globally fixed cross-system alignment. The sender may support several potential read surfaces, and which one is active may depend on receiver mode, current goal or task-loop context, uncertainty, the action or candidate under evaluation, retrieved episodic context, temporal phase and the receiver's current predicted state. CONSTRAINT that keeps this from becoming a hidden cognitive module: receiver-conditioning determines WHICH PART of already-present sender information is exposed and HOW it is expressed; it must not let the bridge solve the task independently. Confirming signature: T(A,B) > T(A) on held-out data at MATCHED capacity AND receiver-state permutation destroys the gain; if permutation barely matters, the gain is extra capacity, not conditioning, and the result is evidence about the bridge (MECH-538). Candidate REE loci: z_world -> E1 versus z_world -> E2 (different read surfaces of one sender), E1 <-> E2 conditioned on the candidate action / horizon under evaluation, hippocampal retrieval -> consumer conditioned on the consumer's present query state, ContextMemory -> downstream reader expressed relative to current context rather than injected as a fixed latent message, and waking versus offline interfaces using different receiver-conditioned geometry.

Event-relative coordination exceeds clock-relative coordination: cross-stream alignment measured around event boundaries, commitment onset, interruption, completion and offline transitions is stronger than alignment by wall-clock timestep. If so, the boundary stream is the coordination substrate for the whole federation, not merely a detector with a consumer.
Three BG-like loops operate at characteristic thalamic heartbeat rates.

Does REE's configured multi-rate execution produce SHARED cross-stream organisation, or only configured rate separation? SD-006 guarantees that E1/E2/E3 run at characteristic rates; nothing asserts or tests that the heterogeneous streams (E1/E2/E3, harm, goal, salience, hippocampal, control) thereby occupy recurrent system-level configurations or exhibit homologous transition motifs. Configured rate separation does not entail shared organisation.
Salient events phase-reset the E3 heartbeat clock.
Respiratory rhythm (~0.2 Hz) is E3's plan-sweep oscillator — a third control-plane clock governing periodic sweeps of pre-commit hippocampal rollouts and DMN simulations.

created_claims.title: Phase as an addressing coordinate: the receiver-potent communication subspace between two REE subsystems is indexed by an ENDOGENOUS CYCLIC coordinate that belongs to neither endpoint -- S_comm(A -> B | phi, c) rather than S_comm(A -> B) -- so a sender dimension can lie INSIDE the receiver-potent subspace at one phase and OUTSIDE it at another with no change whatever in the sender's representation, and information can be continuously decodable from the sender while its downstream causal effect varies systematically with phi. COROLLARY, which is the sharper and more falsifiable half: TEMPORAL separability can substitute for GEOMETRIC separability, so two concurrently represented streams need not be near-orthogonal in population geometry if they become receiver-effective at different temporal addresses -- predicting a measurable trade-off in which the principal angle between two stream subspaces and their phase-conditioned overlap with S_comm move in opposite directions while behavioural intrusion stays flat. FOUR-CELL VERDICT GRID, pre-registered: GEOMETRY-ONLY (angle changes, phase conditioning adds nothing) / TIMING-ONLY (geometry flat, causal impact alternates with phase) / JOINT (both reorganise and jointly predict intrusion) / NULL (neither beats a static consumer model at matched complexity). FALSIFIERS: a static subspace explains receiver activity and behaviour as well as any phase-conditioned model at matched complexity; a global scalar gain explains it without receiver-specific temporal structure; RANDOM temporal labels do as well as the endogenous coordinate; or the dependence disappears after controlling for ordinary task context, action identity, arousal, or trivial periodicity in environment sampling.
