Matched-auxiliary-control and scaffold-removal admissibility rule: a result is admissible as evidence that a representation objective (auxiliary head, anchoring target, contrastive shaping, any added loss) ORGANISES a latent in a specific way -- rather than that extra supervision helps -- only if obtained against BOTH (1) a matched arbitrary-auxiliary control (same head capacity, loss budget, update frequency and training examples; target with learnable but organism-irrelevant structure; any entropy/difficulty mismatch REPORTED, never silently accepted) and (2) an evaluation with the auxiliary head removed, scored on downstream organism-level measures (rollout at consequential transitions, behavioural competence, transfer when consequences change but sensory statistics do not, counterfactual separability, perturbation recovery), never on the objective's own probe accuracy or loss; in its offline-mechanism form, a durable sleep/replay/compression mechanism is adopted only on held-out causal attribution, intervention choice, transfer or calibration, never on training loss or replay reconstruction.

Interface before representation: a representation improvement is undetectable through a collapsing interface, so representation-side experiments run before the consumer interface is fixed return nulls that cannot be interpreted. This is RIVAL to the standing differentiate-first ordering (differentiate z_world per INV-088, THEN apply diversity pressure). The two give opposite readings of the same result: V3-EXQ-817a verifiably improved O's consequence structure and produced no behavioural change, which differentiate-first reads as consequence structure does not help, and this claim reads as the measurement could not have detected help.

Authority field: the moment-to-moment functional conformation of L-space -- the effective directed distance / permeability / gain between representational regions, its asymmetry, persistence and decay, the compatibility of simultaneously active routes, and a local coalition's capacity to recruit wider participation -- is a STATE VARIABLE in its own right: continuous, graded, state-dependent, endogenously recruited from the organism's own prediction error, goal progress, residue and learned relevance, with its own competition and dynamics, and not identical to stored content, to the slow regulatory/neuromodulatory field, or to the final policy; falsifiable consequence: two runs with materially similar content state but different field state differ systematically in retrieval, commitment and distractor recovery, and an equally-parameterised static scalar or global gate cannot reproduce the same context-sensitive behaviour across matched tasks and seeds.

Dynamic information governance: a complete inter-engine interface in REE requires THREE properties, not two -- (1) the decision-relevant content survives the sender's encoding, (2) sender and receiver are mutually legible so a constrained transformation between frozen endpoints exists (ARC-139 / MECH-537 / MECH-538), and (3) the exchange occurs under a routing state that grants the sender causal privilege over that receiver AT THAT MOMENT. Property (3) -- jurisdiction, or temporal/state ACCESS -- is a separate organisational level from content and from legibility, so a representation can be present, decodable, structurally connected to a downstream system, and still unable to affect it; and the corresponding repair is different in kind from an encoder fix or a bridge. The architectural consequence is that REE's effective interface graph is CONSTRUCTED rather than possessed: G_eff(t) is a function of wiring, representational geometry, control state and history, so the same computational substrate can belong to different effective networks at different times. SEPARABILITY FALSIFIER, which is the whole content of the commitment: if a static bridge between frozen endpoints restores the full behavioural phenotype irrespective of when the message is made available, level (3) is unnecessary and this commitment should be withdrawn in favour of ARC-139 plus MECH-539 alone.

Event-relative coordination exceeds clock-relative coordination: cross-stream alignment measured around event boundaries, commitment onset, interruption, completion and offline transitions is stronger than alignment by wall-clock timestep. If so, the boundary stream is the coordination substrate for the whole federation, not merely a detector with a consumer.

Does REE's configured multi-rate execution produce SHARED cross-stream organisation, or only configured rate separation? SD-006 guarantees that E1/E2/E3 run at characteristic rates; nothing asserts or tests that the heterogeneous streams (E1/E2/E3, harm, goal, salience, hippocampal, control) thereby occupy recurrent system-level configurations or exhibit homologous transition motifs. Configured rate separation does not entail shared organisation.

created_claims.title: Governed selectivity beats transfer volume: competent integrated behaviour in REE tracks the SELECTIVITY, STABILITY, REPERTOIRE and causal TIMING of directed influence between engines, not the AMOUNT of inter-engine information transferred -- so the decisive experimental signature is a DISSOCIATION at matched traffic, in which endpoint-local content remains decodable, endpoint-local competence remains intact, total inter-module transfer is matched or INCREASED, and integrated behaviour nonetheless degrades in proportion to lost directional selectivity, route stability or motif repertoire. Three degradation modes are predicted to be distinguishable rather than one: FLATTENING (all channels similarly permissive, high volume, no selectivity), DOMINATION (one slow global mode monopolises routing authority, high coherence, low repertoire) and FRAGMENTATION (routes form but do not persist long enough to complete a multi-step transfer; local decodability intact, long-horizon coordination poor). PRIMARY FALSIFIER: if performance is fully explained by total transmitted activity or message count, and route selectivity adds nothing once traffic is matched, this claim is refuted and no routing layer is warranted. SECOND FALSIFIER: if total transfer always FALLS whenever behaviour falls, the high-traffic/low-tuning regime does not exist in REE and the claim's discriminating signature is unreachable.

hub_targets.title: epistemic_deficit: a persistent, target-bound accumulator representing unresolved, consequential, potentially-resolvable model inadequacy -- distinct from raw novelty (MECH-314a), raw uncertainty (MECH-314b), transient prediction error, and learning-progress (MECH-314c). Rises with unresolved importance x uncertainty x expected_resolvability x persistence; falls with verified resolution, established irrelevance, or accepted irreducibility.

uncertainty_driven_curiosity_frontopolar_analog. A reward bonus that tracks epistemic value -- how much the agent would learn from sampling a state or action. Biological substrate: rostrolateral prefrontal exploration bonus (Daw et al. 2006 Nature). Sub-flavour of MECH-314 structured curiosity bonus. Active-inference framing: bonus equals epistemic value term in expected free energy decomposition (Friston 2010/2015).

learning_progress_curiosity_intrinsic_motivation_analog. A reward bonus that tracks the rate-of-improvement of the agent's predictive model (or any internal-state quantity); actions that produce a steepening learning curve receive a positive bonus. Most computationally instantiated in ML literature (Schmidhuber 1991, Pathak et al. 2017); least biologically anchored of the three MECH-314 sub-flavours -- no clean cellular or regional analog. Distinguishes from MECH-314a (recency-based) and MECH-314b (uncertainty-based) by tracking second-order signal (improvement rate) rather than first-order (count or uncertainty).

Epistemic commitment timing: the inference layer's decision of WHEN to stop gathering evidence and commit a trajectory is a governed control parameter (an urgency/threshold over the belief-state set), balancing pragmatic value (act now) against epistemic value (sample more). Its two failure poles are epistemic-freezing (epistemic value over-weighted / threshold too high -> the agent keeps sampling and never commits) and anti-epistemic-panic (under threat, the epistemic term collapses / urgency forced high -> the agent commits on too little evidence). This axis is NOT reducible to the MECH-126 state-abstraction failure taxonomy; it lives at the seam between the belief-state hypothesis set (MECH-385) / epistemic action pressure (MECH-388) and the commitment gate (MECH-061 / MECH-090), and has an inverted-U optimum rather than a monotone.

Persistent-process termination is a general architectural requirement, not a rule_state-closure special case: every family of persistent cognitive process REE can initiate (information-seeking, planning, memory retrieval, threat monitoring, goal pursuit, exploration, ethical counterfactual generation) needs its own instance of a shared termination-state taxonomy (completion / satiety / closure / disengagement / suspension / switching / interruption / reopening) that preserves WHY termination occurred, so that suspended/reopenable processes stay distinguishable from completed, satiated, or abandoned ones.

Vote count is not evidence count -- independence-aware convergence over heterogeneous evaluators: when several partly independent evaluators favour the same candidate, the epistemic weight of that agreement depends on how many EFFECTIVELY INDEPENDENT evidential routes produced it, and a bounded system that retains a COARSE representation of its evaluators' dependency TOPOLOGY -- which routes share upstream representation, training signal, ancestry, or residual error -- recovers materially more of the exact joint-inference answer than either (a) a marginal-reliability-only combiner, which counts one duplicated reason N times, or (b) a single global dependence scalar, which cannot separate a correlated coalition plus genuinely independent specialists from uniform moderate dependence. The claimed object is a TOPOLOGY, not a scalar convergence score: at minimum who supports what, how reliable each route is in the current domain, which routes share ancestry or error, which credible routes remain independent, and what structured dissent survives. Three bindings keep this from becoming a new scalar ruler. (1) CEILING BINDING: exact Bayesian aggregation over the true joint dependency model remains the normative ceiling and this claim explicitly does NOT assert that any convergence heuristic beats it -- the assertion is bounded-resource COMPRESSION, that coarse topology approaches the exact decision and confidence at materially lower structural cost and degrades gracefully when dependency estimates are stale or wrong. (2) NON-REPLACEMENT BINDING: independence correction is additive to, never a substitute for, evaluator reliability/relevance weighting and protected-veto structure -- independence-aware convergence is not majority rule and must not become more majority-dominated than a reliability baseline. (3) NON-TAUTOLOGY BINDING: a convergence quantity must be validated by an INDEPENDENT consequence (held-out decision accuracy, calibration, robustness under evaluator dropout or distribution shift), never by a transformation that forces agreement -- normalising every evaluator to equal scale and then observing equal contribution is not evidence.

difficulty_gated_proposal_entropy (controlled proposal-entropy widening under goal blockage). When goal progress stalls -- repeated failure to improve goal progress, high inter-candidate conflict, low E3 score margin, low committed-action diversity, plateau/stuck-state signal -- WITH goal salience preserved, the agent should transiently INCREASE proposal-generation entropy UPSTREAM of action selection (wider hippocampal/world-model rollout candidate set + higher within-class sampling temperature) while preserving goal/harm/constraint scoring and DELAYING commitment until one candidate clears the E3 score-margin / commitment threshold; entropy then NARROWS once a workable candidate is found -> committed action -> entropy decay. Asserted distinction (preserve this): a hard problem must trigger WIDER INTERNAL PROPOSALS -> more candidate diversity -> longer arbitration -> selective committed action (controlled entropy), NOT 'hard problem -> random behaviour' (noise). WORKING HYPOTHESIS -- no experimental evidence yet; not an established mechanism.

Continuation of a persistent process should be gated jointly on marginal expected return relative to available alternatives (Marginal Value Theorem framing) AND on the observed RATE of progress -- whether uncertainty, goal-distance, or informational yield is actually decreasing under continued investment, not only its current absolute level -- so that a process whose marginal progress has collapsed increasingly loses justification for further resource allocation even while absolute uncertainty/value remains high. This is the disengagement-direction complement to MECH-343/SD-061's difficulty-gated proposal-entropy WIDENING response to stall: it covers the case where widening the search ALSO fails to restore progress.

model_disagreement_directed_curiosity (RND / Plan2Explore analog). A mechanistic refinement of MECH-314's structured_curiosity_bonus: a PER-CANDIDATE, SELF-ANNEALING intrinsic curiosity signal derived from E2 FORWARD-MODEL DISAGREEMENT (an ensemble / dropout-variance proxy over E2 forward predictions) -- high where the forward model is uncertain, collapsing toward zero as a region is learned -- fed into E3 selection so it PROPAGATES per-candidate to the committed action, unlike the broadcast-novelty EMA channel found non-propagating in V3-EXQ-590a / EXQ-141b. The self-annealing-on-learning-progress property is the non-degeneracy guard against a cross-candidate-flat (degenerate) bonus. External analog: RND (Burda et al. 2018) predictor-error novelty; Plan2Explore (Sekar et al. 2020) ensemble model-disagreement. Maps to MECH-314c learning-progress / MECH-314b uncertainty-driven curiosity.
Irreducible uncertainty is an epistemological constraint that cannot be engineered away.

Play as emergent developmental information hunger: play-like behaviour emerges WITHOUT a dedicated play module when basic viability is secure, no urgent commitment dominates action selection, spare behavioural capacity is available, reachable states contain learnable (reducible) uncertainty, and exploration is predicted to produce learning progress -- and the FRONTIER of play MIGRATES across affordance spaces (bodily -> object -> compositional/causal -> social -> symbolic/counterfactual -> abstract) as learning progress in earlier spaces saturates, yielding an endogenous developmental curriculum rather than externally imposed stages. Mastery moves curiosity rather than extinguishing it; human neoteny is read as preservation of the developmental exploratory mode with progressively abstract objects. Explicitly NOT the strong equation play = information gain (play also serves bonding, practice, regulation, signalling).

created_claims.title: Evidence-dependency topology and downstream-leverage topology are SEPARATE, state-conditioned variables and conflating them misallocates information seeking: "how many genuinely independent reasons do I currently hold" (the evidence-source dependency graph) and "how many distinct consequential consumers would change if this uncertainty were resolved" (the downstream-leverage graph) are different relations over the same subsystems, so a policy that uses either as a proxy for the other allocates queries, rollouts or experiments badly -- five statistically independent routes can all update one downstream decision, and one correlated cluster can control several genuinely distinct consequences. Four bindings. (1) STRUCTURED DIVERGENCE IS NOT INFORMATION VALUE: disagreement earns allocation weight only after multiplication by expected REDUCIBILITY and decision CONSEQUENCE and correction for how much of the current evidence is genuinely independent; raw disagreement is attracted to irreducible noise and to broken or out-of-domain evaluators, and a divergence signal must separate useful, irreducible and broken-view divergence. (2) COMPETENCE IS DOMAIN-INDEXED: an evaluator must not carry one global trust weight when its competence depends on the current representational or behavioural domain. (3) UNCERTAIN PROVENANCE MUST BE REPRESENTED AS UNCERTAIN: treating noisy ancestry metadata as categorical dependency labels degrades worse than carrying soft dependency probabilities, and the soft form wins by making less COSTLY errors rather than by hitting the optimum more often. (4) BOTH GRAPHS ARE STATE-CONDITIONED: two routes redundant in one context can be independent in another, and two named downstream consumers can be functionally redundant in one state and distinct in another, so a static average relation graph is insufficient. As in MECH-558, exact value-of-information over the true joint model is the ceiling and is not contested.

hub_targets.title: F-dominance bounds committed-action diversity: the primary harm/goal score (F) monopolises ~88-89% of E3 committed-selection variance (V3-EXQ-571: 0.886 baseline, 0.894 with the full diversity stack -- the stack does not dent F's share), so modulatory, within-class, and rule-bias diversity channels cannot convert to committed-action diversity while F dominates -- they act only at near-ties. The committed-action-diversity conversion ceiling is therefore a SELECTION-VARIANCE problem (primary-vs-modulatory share), not (only) a candidate-pool geometry problem; a shortlist-then-modulate lever circumvents F locally but may cap committed entropy below the proposer ceiling unless F's variance share is itself rebalanced.

Basal-ganglia-like E3 selector constitution: committed-action selection should be governed by an explicit BG-mirroring eligibility-gating CONSTITUTION -- candidate actions pass through an eligibility mask, bounded Go (direct-pathway promotion) and No-Go (indirect-pathway suppression) pressures, a conflict-sensitive hold / threshold-raise / candidate-set widening (hyperdirect-STN), striatal-like parallel channel competition (rather than one scalar monarch), a pallidal-like permission-to-commit gate (rather than bare argmax), and a stable post-commit latch / de-commit -- so that an upstream signal's STRENGTH is necessary but not sufficient: it also needs LAWFUL ACCESS to committed action. The translation target is functional (a divergence-ledgered, falsifier-validated BG analogue), NOT anatomical mimicry.

The latent-access evidence ladder: a variable's status in a latent space is not one property but seven, which must never be collapsed -- encoded (statistically present) != decodable (recoverable by an external probe) != natively accessible (usable by the system's existing consumer) != bridgeable (usable through a constrained map between frozen endpoints) != pairing-specific (useful specifically when the correct sender state is paired with the correct receiver situation) != causally used (interventions on its content alter downstream computation) != behaviourally beneficial (that causal use improves adaptive performance). Two evidential consequences bind rather than advise: (1) a content-transmission claim about any internal channel or bridge REQUIRES correct-vs-mismatched-vs-zero-vs-moment-matched-random controls, because a channel can be strongly load-bearing while its example-specific content is barely load-bearing; (2) a null measured on a COMPRESSED representation requires a dimensionality-matched RANDOM-PROJECTION floor, not a zero floor, before it can be read as information loss.

Go/No-Go eligibility constitution for committed-action conversion: committed-action diversity is recovered not by any single louder channel but by an explicit eligibility CONSTITUTION -- bounded Go pressure (promote a channel when evidence/value/drive/rule/safety make it eligible) AND bounded No-Go pressure (suppress unsafe / stale / perseverative / irrelevant / low-viability channels) governing which candidates may compete for the pallidal-like permission-to-commit gate -- so that lawful, channel-specific access (not scalar dominance) decides the committed action. The full Go/No-Go eligibility-set governance is what converts when the minimal near-tie lever (MECH-447) does not and isolated F->eligibility demotion (MECH-448) is insufficient alone.

Global-scalar arousal channels are a VARIANCE AMPLIFIER of the already-dominant selection channel, not a source of behavioural differentiation: the three affective routes that modulate commitment globally (D1/D2 dopamine gain, harm-urgency threshold shrinkage, LC-NE/phasic-surprise temperature) apply one scalar uniformly across all K candidates and therefore cannot change an argmax, but DO change whether commitment fires and how sharply -- selecting for whichever channel already carries the most per-candidate score variance. Under F-dominance (MECH-439) this makes affective engagement ENTRENCH F rather than convert diversity, predicting that F's share of committed-selection variance RISES with arousal and FALLS under low urgency.

The cognitive contract: a unified mind built from heterogeneous engines (E1 / E2 / E3 / hippocampus and later specialists, differing in representational geometry, temporal scale, compression level, learning dynamics and uncertainty representation) requires not a common latent space but an INVARIANT-PRESERVING CONTRACT -- a small set of relations I such that for any lossy translation x_A -> C_A(x_A) -> T_AB -> D_B -> x'_B, I(x_A) ~ I(x'_B), even though x'_B = x_A is meaningless across different spaces. The contract is relational / semantic, not representational: each engine may encode an invariant differently (explicit scalar, trajectory position, recurrent-state relation, geometric direction, ordering relation) so long as the relation is recoverable at the boundary when needed. It sits ABOVE the translation machinery and ABOVE schemas (cognitive contract -> representation / translation machinery -> schemas -> particular concepts, memories and environmental models): a schema rewrite, including offline reorganisation during sleep, changes WHAT the organism knows; contract failure changes WHETHER its subsystems can still understand one another. The contract specifies RECOVERABLE RELATIONSHIPS, never a fixed data structure or ontology -- engines encode invariants differently, new representational systems can be added, schemas reorganise, and contract dimensions may be added or retired. Its two failure poles are representation collapse (one canonical latent forced on every engine, destroying the specialisation that makes multiple engines useful) and cognitive fragmentation (engines keep exchanging tensors while progressively losing shared meaning -- computationally active, no longer one mind). Unity does not require representational sameness; it requires preservation of the relations that keep representations about the same cognitive world.
Confidence channel (uncertainty-derived precision) must remain distinct from residual error.

Control plane must produce a coalition/topology control output -- a temporary functional interaction graph specifying which subsystems are recruited and how they communicate -- distinct from and complementary to parametric modulation (precision, gain, threshold, horizon).

Emotion-as-anti-collapse architecture: emotion-like systems are a set of GATED, PARTIALLY INDEPENDENT evaluators (is-this-harmful / is-this-safe / did-this-reduce-suffering / am-I-pursuing-something-I-want / did-I-merely-like-the-last-thing / am-I-stuck / am-I-overcommitted / is-this-goal-stale / should-I-explore / should-I-stop / should-I-sleep-and-consolidate / should-I-release-the-policy) whose collective effect is to prevent behaviour from collapsing onto the currently dominant gradient. Affect is therefore the architectural SOURCE of structured behavioural diversity -- not decoration on a rational optimiser and not random exploration noise, but native modulatory control (gates, biases, interrupts, salience shifts, persistence regulators, release conditions, credit-assignment signals) that produces STRUCTURED deviations from naive optimisation. A unifying MAP over REE's already-owned affect machinery, not a new substrate; an optimise-then-bolt-on-safety design fails because these evaluators must be native, not added afterward.

Loop-local eligibility traces under a globally-broadcast dopamine signal: even with a SINGLE shared dopaminergic teaching signal (ARC-108 delta_t), the credit traces that decide WHICH synapses/channels the signal updates must remain LOCAL and loop-specific -- effective update = shared delta_t x separate local eligibility trace x loop-specific active synapses -- rather than the current single globally-broadcast credit that updates every recently-active selector component. A too-broad or temporally-smeared eligibility trace would make learned gating appear ineffective (no committed conversion) even when the underlying dopamine learning rule is exactly correct, because the right teaching signal is delivered to the wrong synapses.

E3 trajectory selection is currently COMPENSATORY, not veto-based: candidates are ranked by a single weighted sum over goal, harm/residue, feasibility/resource, coherence and epistemic terms, and commitment is gated by one precision (PE-variance) threshold (ARC-016). No per-candidate, per-space veto exists in the V3 substrate, so a large cost in one space can be outweighed by gains elsewhere. Multi-constraint VETO viability (any one space independently rejecting a trajectory) is the intended biological design, not a description of V3.

uncertainty_reliability_weighting (Daw_2005_Lee_2014_dual_systems_arbitration_analog). Arbitration weight tracks the inverse-uncertainty / reliability of each candidate rule or policy mode; high-reliability sources receive higher arbitration weight. Biological substrate: model-based / model-free dual-systems arbitration (Daw et al. 2005 Nat Neurosci; Lee et al. 2014 Neuron). LOW divergence from existing literature; direct mapping. Sub-claim of MECH-312.

Parallel segregated cortico-BG-thalamic loops (motor / cognitive-set / motivational): committed-action selection should run through SEPARATE striatal loop channels -- a motor loop, an associative/cognitive-set loop, and a limbic/motivational loop -- each owning its own eligibility-and-gate, arbitrated AFTER within-loop competition, rather than collapsing all channels into ONE shared E3 selection arena where the dACC/lPFC/OFC analogs feed in only as additive biases. HYPOTHESIS (assembly-map A.2 / s.D): the F-dominance conversion ceiling (MECH-439) is partly an ARTEFACT of the single-arena collapse -- F monopolises 88-89% of committed-selection variance because every channel competes in one F-dominated arena; with segregated loops F could dominate only the motor loop and could not drown the limbic 'is this worth committing to' computation, which is a different loop with a different value. Translation target is FUNCTIONAL (the Alexander/DeLong/Strick parallel-loop organisation as a divergence-ledgered, falsifier-validated analogue), NOT anatomical mimicry.

created_claims.title: Vote count is not evidence count -- independence-aware convergence over heterogeneous evaluators: when several partly independent evaluators favour the same candidate, the epistemic weight of that agreement depends on how many EFFECTIVELY INDEPENDENT evidential routes produced it, and a bounded system that retains a COARSE representation of its evaluators' dependency TOPOLOGY -- which routes share upstream representation, training signal, ancestry, or residual error -- recovers materially more of the exact joint-inference answer than either (a) a marginal-reliability-only combiner, which counts one duplicated reason N times, or (b) a single global dependence scalar, which cannot separate a correlated coalition plus genuinely independent specialists from uniform moderate dependence. The claimed object is a TOPOLOGY, not a scalar convergence score: at minimum who supports what, how reliable each route is in the current domain, which routes share ancestry or error, which credible routes remain independent, and what structured dissent survives. Three bindings keep this from becoming a new scalar ruler. (1) CEILING BINDING: exact Bayesian aggregation over the true joint dependency model remains the normative ceiling and this claim explicitly does NOT assert that any convergence heuristic beats it -- the assertion is bounded-resource COMPRESSION, that coarse topology approaches the exact decision and confidence at materially lower structural cost and degrades gracefully when dependency estimates are stale or wrong. (2) NON-REPLACEMENT BINDING: independence correction is additive to, never a substitute for, evaluator reliability/relevance weighting and protected-veto structure -- independence-aware convergence is not majority rule and must not become more majority-dominated than a reliability baseline. (3) NON-TAUTOLOGY BINDING: a convergence quantity must be validated by an INDEPENDENT consequence (held-out decision accuracy, calibration, robustness under evaluator dropout or distribution shift), never by a transformation that forces agreement -- normalising every evaluator to equal scale and then observing equal contribution is not evidence.

hub_targets.title: The system maintains a functional distinction between simulation-mode content and real-experience content, such that simulation content does not accumulate in the viability map as committed experience; failures of this distinction produce confabulation (simulated events encoded as real).

Object identity is a cross-cutting representational primitive. An object is a token-bound identity representation that persists across time and perceptual gaps, generalising z_object/z_resource into an object-file/binding layer (ARC-006), defined by causal feature-coherence under intervention (MECH-278), and consumed by drive/goal (SD-057), hippocampal planning (MECH-262), and the self/other special-object cases. The four planned object capabilities -- (1) permanence, (2) self-as-object, (3) tools/affordances, (4) others-as-object -- are specialisations of one primitive, not four separate mechanisms.

Self-attribution is implemented by a forward-model comparator: for any reafferent latent stream z_x with an efference-copy-driven forward model E2_x, the residual (z_x_observed - E2_x(z_x_{t-1}, a_actual)) is the agency signal on that stream.

Dynamic interface compatibility: between PREDICTIVE systems, pointwise state correspondence across an interface is insufficient -- a mapping must additionally satisfy that receiver_transition(T(x_t), a_t) is compatible with T(x_(t+1)) under the relevant action/context, because a bridge can succeed pointwise while destroying transition geometry. The registered diagnostic separation is: map ONLY the initial state and let the receiver evolve natively, versus repeatedly mapping sender rollout states -- this distinguishes a bridge that supplies a compatible starting condition from one that must continually correct incompatible dynamics. Failure signature `good static + bad dynamic` routes to transition-geometry work rather than to representation work; `good one-step + degrading long-horizon` indicates compounding dynamics mismatch; `good dynamic but poor behaviour` routes downstream to valuation/selection.

Organism-relevant distinction preservation across representational compression: any compression, abstraction or consolidation step on the observation -> z_world -> E1/E2 path (and any offline schema-compression of episodes) must preserve, or leave recoverable through its dynamics, five classes of distinction consequential to the organism across time -- (1) consequence and opportunity/threat, (2) controllability and agency incl. internal-state consequence invisible in the scene, (3) persistence and temporal relation, (4) causal ancestry / intervention handles (agent identity, action class, preconditions, uncertainty over causal contribution), (5) independently evolving trajectories -- as PRESERVATION REQUIREMENTS, not latent dimensions; a step that destroys downstream access to one of them is a developmental regression regardless of reconstruction or prediction loss; auxiliary heads enforcing a class are removable SCAFFOLDS and the ontology within a class must remain free to split, merge and reweight over development.

Cognitive-contract invariant admissibility rule: a candidate contract invariant (ARC-142) acquires ARCHITECTURAL standing only by consilience -- independent support from at least two of six evidence domains: (1) cross-linguistic typology (recurrent, obligatorily encoded across unrelated languages), (2) pre-linguistic developmental cognition (present before language or explicit instruction), (3) neuroscience (modality- or subsystem-independent representation, or a known translation mechanism that retains it), (4) comparative cognition (present in species with different sensory / behavioural ecologies), (5) independently trained artificial agents (discovered without being specified; removal produces characteristic failure), and (6) REE-internal necessity (an engine boundary that cannot learn or translate around it). Every candidate must be CLASSIFIED architectural / embodied-ecological / human-linguistic-convention / uncertain, with the alternative explanation (embodiment, culture, task structure) recorded. Cross-linguistic universality ALONE is inadmissible as architectural evidence: shared bodies, sensory systems, ecology and phylogeny explain human universals without cognitive universality. Developmental precedence -- required before substantial learning can occur -- is the strongest single-domain signal. A negative finding (an apparently fundamental invariant shown unnecessary, or translatable-around) is a first-class preserved result, not a discard. The contract must be DERIVED INDEPENDENTLY of REE_assembly's own claims / evidence / provenance / dependency invariant machinery (docs/architecture/invariant_types.md, claim_evidence) -- deriving it from that machinery is circular -- and any structural convergence between the two is logged as an empirical clue under GOV-ANALOGY-1, never assumed. Each candidate carries a twelve-field evidence record (candidate, definition, linguistic, developmental, neural, comparative, artificial-agent, REE evidence, lesion prediction, alternative explanation, classification, confidence); the objective is the smallest defensible set, never the longest list.

Provenance-bearing one-way commit-status gate (V3 half of the 2026-09-24 split): imagined / simulated event representations carry an explicit committed_vs_imagined provenance label, and a ONE-WAY gate ensures they can be used for planning without ever acquiring committed-history status -- the reality-status signature MECH-545's contract-lesion assay targets. Scope: the label and gate on the event representations V3 already carries; the full unified-store event-token schema is MECH-365a (v4, on ARC-085).

A REE state must not be defined purely by sensory appearance; two perceptually identical situations that differ in temporal position, active commitment, goal/antigoal relation, social context, or operative constraints constitute distinct states.
Viability is defined relative to the agent's continuity in a shared world, not as a scalar reward.

The cognitive contract: a unified mind built from heterogeneous engines (E1 / E2 / E3 / hippocampus and later specialists, differing in representational geometry, temporal scale, compression level, learning dynamics and uncertainty representation) requires not a common latent space but an INVARIANT-PRESERVING CONTRACT -- a small set of relations I such that for any lossy translation x_A -> C_A(x_A) -> T_AB -> D_B -> x'_B, I(x_A) ~ I(x'_B), even though x'_B = x_A is meaningless across different spaces. The contract is relational / semantic, not representational: each engine may encode an invariant differently (explicit scalar, trajectory position, recurrent-state relation, geometric direction, ordering relation) so long as the relation is recoverable at the boundary when needed. It sits ABOVE the translation machinery and ABOVE schemas (cognitive contract -> representation / translation machinery -> schemas -> particular concepts, memories and environmental models): a schema rewrite, including offline reorganisation during sleep, changes WHAT the organism knows; contract failure changes WHETHER its subsystems can still understand one another. The contract specifies RECOVERABLE RELATIONSHIPS, never a fixed data structure or ontology -- engines encode invariants differently, new representational systems can be added, schemas reorganise, and contract dimensions may be added or retired. Its two failure poles are representation collapse (one canonical latent forced on every engine, destroying the specialisation that makes multiple engines useful) and cognitive fragmentation (engines keep exchanging tensors while progressively losing shared meaning -- computationally active, no longer one mind). Unity does not require representational sameness; it requires preservation of the relations that keep representations about the same cognitive world.

Imagination-learning constraint principle: simulated/imagined experience may license only LICIT forms of learning (consistency checking, plan optimisation, schema integration) and is FORBIDDEN from driving durable world-model updates, prediction validation, or novel-fact generation. The provenance gate (MECH-365 committed-vs-imagined field) is the mechanism that enforces this principle; the principle states WHAT learning imagination may and may not produce, independent of any single gate's implementation.
Harm and benefit signals have asymptotic proxy structure in world latent space.

Contract-lesion assays: the decisive test of a candidate cognitive-contract invariant (ARC-142) is not its presence in successful cognition but a BOUNDARY LESION -- a translation between two engines that preserves content but deletes one relation -- producing a predicted, invariant-specific fragmentation signature. Five pre-registered signatures: IDENTITY lesion (two representations cannot determine whether they concern the same entity) -> broken persistence, duplicated selves / objects, incoherent credit assignment, unstable memory integration; TEMPORAL lesion (content without temporal relation) -> cause / effect inversion, present-state vs anticipated-state confusion, confused planning, memory / prediction contamination; REALITY-STATUS lesion (observed, remembered, simulated and counterfactual states indistinct across the boundary) -> confabulation-like behaviour, false commitment to imagined states, impaired counterfactual learning, psychosis-like representational error; AGENCY lesion (events representable, controllability and actor relation lost) -> poor action learning, internal / external attribution errors, impaired responsibility assignment, failure of intentional planning; CONFIDENCE lesion (content translates, uncertainty does not) -> overcommitment, under-reaction to reliable predictions, inappropriate belief updating, failure of precision-sensitive integration. Predictions: each lesion applied at ONE inter-engine boundary yields a signature distinct from the other four and from generic information loss (scored against a dimensionality-matched random-projection floor, INV-105), and an invariant whose boundary lesion produces NO reproducible deficit is struck from the contract, with the negative result preserved (GOV-CONTRACT-1).

Reduction admissibility for the cognitive contract (the anti-cheating rule the pruning clause lacks): counting primitives is not minimality, and a proposed MERGE, demotion or derivation of one candidate from another counts only if it lowers TOTAL TRANSFERABLE COMPLEXITY rather than relocating it. The quantity to be reduced is minimal sufficient transferable information under CONSTRAINED encoders and receivers -- informally contract cost ~= information rate + encoder/decoder complexity + context or side-channel complexity + reconstruction distortion + computational and latency cost + robustness cost -- not the number of English nouns in the basis. A reduction is therefore INADMISSIBLE when the lost distinctions reappear inside the definition of the surviving relation, a more powerful decoder, hidden context tags, unconstrained numerical precision, recurrent hidden state, task-specific side channels, or expensive reconstruction machinery. Three requirements for any proposed collapse: (1) lower total description or rate cost under fixed assumptions about precision and decoder power; (2) preserve DISCRIMINATING predictions -- the reduced model must still predict distinct failure signatures when different information is corrupted; (3) improve transfer or efficiency relative to an unconstrained equivalent-capacity code. The standard of reducibility is OPERATIONAL, not logical: logical reducibility (a mathematician can derive it) and information-theoretic reducibility (the information exists somewhere) are both inadmissible, and only computational reducibility (the receiver can derive it with plausible resources) and operational reducibility (reliably and quickly enough for the behaviour in question) decide. Corollary that makes the rule bite: rewriting several candidates as one typed relational graph, one latent, or one universal relation is a RENAMING, not a reduction, and is refused unless all three requirements are demonstrated.

The cognitive contract is BOUNDARY-INDEXED, not one flat universal header: for a handoff from subsystem A to subsystem B the obligation is I_AB = the relations B requires that B cannot cheaply and reliably reconstruct locally, so the contract is properly written as a family of TYPED OBLIGATIONS, C = { A -> B : I_AB, tolerated distortion, receiver capability, fallback behaviour }, one entry per directed interface. A sensory-to-world-model handoff, a hippocampal replay handoff, an E1-to-E2 predictive handoff and a control-plane handoff need not carry the same relational payload, and a relation may be obligatory at one boundary while being locally reconstructable -- and therefore omissible -- at another. The consequence that makes this more than bookkeeping: a DEEP SHARED CORE, if one exists, is an EMPIRICAL OVERLAP to be measured across many heterogeneous interfaces, never a premise; candidates such as value, salience, confidence, commitment and priority may be crucial at particular boundaries without being universal invariants of every internal representation, and a universal reading of the contract systematically over-states their status. Falsifier for the contract programme itself: if useful obligations exist at each boundary but their OVERLAP across the cognitive graph is negligible, boundary-specificity defeats a shared core and the contract is a set of interface specifications rather than an architecture of cognition.
The REM sub-phase of offline mode recalibrates precision priors and tests world model hypotheses via unconstrained generative simulation, with commit gate fully suppressed.

Contract-invariant promotion ladder: GOV-CONTRACT-1's >= 2-of-6-domain consilience quorum is STAGE 1 of six, not the whole standard, and clearing it confers a LEDGER STATUS ("admitted") and nothing else -- in particular no claims.yaml entry, no architectural commitment, and no licence to implement. The ladder: Stage 0 named canonical candidate (the relation has a governed ledger record); Stage 1 cross-domain recurrence (the GOV-CONTRACT-1 quorum); Stage 2 transferable RECEIVER-ACCESSIBLE recoverability (the relation is recoverable by a plausible receiver, not merely by a researcher's probe, across held-out content, tasks or remappings -- graded on INV-105's ladder, never on external decodability alone); Stage 3 causal handoff dependence (selective, nuisance-controlled corruption at a relevant interface produces the predicted deficit, MECH-545); Stage 4 irreducibility under constrained reconstruction (a smaller already-supported basis cannot reproduce the function within the receiver's rate, decoder, context, latency and robustness budget -- adjudicated under the reduction-admissibility rule); Stage 5 adaptation-aware characterisation (compensation, alternative-pathway recruitment and rescue understood well enough to separate functional necessity from mechanism uniqueness, ARC-140); Stage 6 boundary scope established (which handoffs require the relation and which can reconstruct or omit it, ARC-144). A candidate becomes CLAIM-SHAPED at Stage 4 and eligible for architectural treatment only after Stage 5; before that its canonical home is its ledger record id. Composite candidates remain candidates however strong their recurrence, and a negative result at any stage is recorded in the ledger, never deleted.

created_claims.title: The 3 + 2 reduction hypothesis: the fourteen canonical cognitive-contract candidates (evidence/planning/cognitive_contract_invariant_ledger.v1.json) may not be fourteen independent primitives but may largely generate from THREE STRUCTURAL FAMILIES plus TWO ATTACHED WEIGHTING FIELDS. Structural: (A) CORRESPONDENCE / BINDING -- which token, event, state or relation in one representation corresponds to which in another or across time, with identity as correspondence plus continuity and persistence constraints, and equivalence as correspondence under a specified transformation (absorbing CCI-001, CCI-006); (B) DIRECTED EVENT / TRAJECTORY STRUCTURE -- event or token instances, ordered or partially ordered succession, reachable transition relations, persistence across transitions, and optional typed intervention edges, rather than a scalar clock plus a separate graph (absorbing CCI-002, CCI-007 and, if action-labelled edges suffice to reconstruct controllability, much of CCI-004); (C) GENERATIVE CONTEXT / ANCHORING / LINEAGE -- which process produced a representation, which branch it belongs to, whether that branch is anchored to the current sensory worldline, and how it relates to other generated alternatives, so that "actual" is a relation to the currently anchored worldline rather than a primitive category (absorbing CCI-003, CCI-012 and the unnumbered provenance/ownership hypotheses). Attached fields: (D) EPISTEMIC WEIGHT over states, edges or translations, obligatory only where the producer holds reliability information the receiver cannot cheaply reconstruct (reclassifying CCI-005 from content primitive to boundary-specific field); (E) REGULATORY / VIABILITY WEIGHT -- predicted relation to viable or preferred states plus direction of change plus horizon, from which signed value, goal relation and priority may derive (reclassifying CCI-009 and bearing on CCI-010, CCI-014). CROSSED PREDICTION, which is what makes this falsifiable rather than a re-labelling: structural families should survive object or world remapping when the world relation is unchanged despite altered surface features, whereas attached fields should vary strongly with current uncertainty, needs, goals, physiology and task regime AT FIXED STRUCTURE -- so holding structure fixed while changing confidence, holding structure fixed while changing viability, holding confidence fixed while changing branch lineage, holding value fixed while changing controllability, and holding sensory content fixed while changing generative path should dissociate along the structure/field boundary. If structural and weighting variables cannot be dissociated by that crossed design, the 3 + 2 model is wrong or too simple.

hub_targets.title: The latent-access evidence ladder: a variable's status in a latent space is not one property but seven, which must never be collapsed -- encoded (statistically present) != decodable (recoverable by an external probe) != natively accessible (usable by the system's existing consumer) != bridgeable (usable through a constrained map between frozen endpoints) != pairing-specific (useful specifically when the correct sender state is paired with the correct receiver situation) != causally used (interventions on its content alter downstream computation) != behaviourally beneficial (that causal use improves adaptive performance). Two evidential consequences bind rather than advise: (1) a content-transmission claim about any internal channel or bridge REQUIRES correct-vs-mismatched-vs-zero-vs-moment-matched-random controls, because a channel can be strongly load-bearing while its example-specific content is barely load-bearing; (2) a null measured on a COMPRESSED representation requires a dimensionality-matched RANDOM-PROJECTION floor, not a zero floor, before it can be read as information loss.

Integration does not require representational sameness, it requires selective mutual legibility: specialised cognitive subsystems may preserve distinct high-dimensional PRIVATE internal representations while coordinating through low-dimensional, context-sensitive communication subspaces and low-complexity transformations, so development can raise local specialisation and cross-system legibility AT THE SAME TIME rather than trading one against the other. Non-redundant prediction: a maturing REE shows rising local competence in E1/E2/hippocampus/E3 while GLOBAL representational similarity between them stays flat or falls, and increasing representational similarity between subsystems must therefore NOT be used as the default marker of maturation. This is an explicit ALTERNATIVE framing to ARC-121's shared epistemic-state object, not a refutation of it: one common object, specialised objects with a shared interface format, specialised objects joined by context-specific translation, and a hybrid invariant-core-plus-private-dimensions architecture all remain live, and ARC-121 must not be used to prejudge the question.

Communication-subspace routing failure -- encoded but not exposed: a task variable can be strongly encoded in the FULL sender latent while being weakly represented in the CONSUMER-FACING subspace, producing the phenotype `external probe succeeds -> native behaviour fails` with no information having been destroyed. This is a third failure category strictly between 'information absent from the sender' and 'information used by the receiver', and it is distinct from MECH-517 (the decoder collapses) and MECH-532 (the compression site has no trained decompression stage): routing failure requires neither a collapse nor a missing readout, because the consumer can be reading a perfectly healthy low-rank subspace that simply does not carry the distinction. Operationalised by cross-validated Reduced Rank Regression from sender activity to the ACTUAL consumer input tensor, comparing task decodability in the full sender, inside the estimated communication subspace, and in its orthogonal complement; the diagnostic signature is `target decodable from X` but `poorly decodable from P_comm X`.

Sleep as selective interface maintenance -- the third offline job: MECH-529 gives offline consolidation two functions, revising the representation (split/merge/reweight over equivalence classes) and re-indexing episodic traces so autobiographical addressability survives that revision. This claim adds a THIRD: adjusting or stabilising the INTERFACE -- the subspace through which another subsystem reads the revised representation. The prediction is explicitly NOT global alignment but a PLASTICITY/STABILITY DIVISION OF LABOUR across interfaces: some reconfigure because recent learning demands it, others remain stable because downstream continuity matters more, so the strongest test compares at least TWO interfaces with different predicted plasticity rather than asking whether all systems become more similar after sleep. Four distinguishable post-sleep signatures: S1 representational retuning (interface metrics move only because the sender moved), S2 interface recalibration (local competence stable, communication subspace or bridge complexity improves), S3 stable scaffold (representations move, mapping holds), S4 maladaptive homogenisation (similarity rises while local competence or task-specific differentiation worsens).

Recurrent interface stability: an interface can be statically useful yet recurrently unstable -- a bridge with one-step utility > 0 can fail repeated closed-loop application, and REE traverses most interfaces repeatedly over trajectories, episodes and recurrent prediction loops. Two mechanisms, to be distinguished experimentally: (a) OFF-MANIFOLD COMPOUNDING -- a bridge trained on native receiver states emits a slightly off-distribution receiver state, the next application treats it as ordinary input, and B_0 -> T(A_0,B_0) = B_1' -> T(A_1,B_1') = B_2' accumulates displacement into a regime the bridge never saw; (b) SEMANTIC DOUBLE-COUNTING -- content already injected is not recognised as present and is re-amplified, escalating gain. Design corollary: CUMULATIVE translation (each step operates on the previously translated receiver state) versus CLEAN-BASE translation (each step computed against an unmodified native receiver state, the residual held as a temporary gated overlay) -- translated information should first be tested as an overlay or gated read surface, never as an irreversible rewrite of the receiver's core latent state. Adds an EIGHTH rung to INV-105's ladder, RECURRENTLY STABLE: repeated use preserves receiver-state validity, information calibration and functional behaviour over the timescale the system actually uses the interface -- assessed BEFORE behavioural usefulness is read as architecturally meaningful in a dynamical system. Sleep corollary for MECH-540: offline interface recalibration must improve or preserve closed-loop stability when waking dynamics resume; a sleep-induced change that improves a static probe but destabilises the next waking trajectory is a failure, not consolidation. Signatures: one-step rescue + cumulative collapse + clean-base stability = recurrent interface instability; cumulative stability + correct-pair specificity = a functionally coherent recurrent bridge; both fixed and conditioned bridges failing while richer source information succeeds = upstream representation deficiency remains more likely.

Receiver-conditioned translation: what a sender should expose to a consumer is a function of the receiver's current state, not of the sender alone -- translated content = T(sender state, receiver state, receiver position / context) -- so the communication subspace (MECH-537) is CONTEXT-INDEXED rather than one globally fixed cross-system alignment. The sender may support several potential read surfaces, and which one is active may depend on receiver mode, current goal or task-loop context, uncertainty, the action or candidate under evaluation, retrieved episodic context, temporal phase and the receiver's current predicted state. CONSTRAINT that keeps this from becoming a hidden cognitive module: receiver-conditioning determines WHICH PART of already-present sender information is exposed and HOW it is expressed; it must not let the bridge solve the task independently. Confirming signature: T(A,B) > T(A) on held-out data at MATCHED capacity AND receiver-state permutation destroys the gain; if permutation barely matters, the gain is extra capacity, not conditioning, and the result is evidence about the bridge (MECH-538). Candidate REE loci: z_world -> E1 versus z_world -> E2 (different read surfaces of one sender), E1 <-> E2 conditioned on the candidate action / horizon under evaluation, hippocampal retrieval -> consumer conditioned on the consumer's present query state, ContextMemory -> downstream reader expressed relative to current context rather than injected as a fixed latent message, and waking versus offline interfaces using different receiver-conditioned geometry.

Theta-burst packet contains multi-content joint binding: each ~125ms theta cycle binds a {goal_latent, action_proposal, risk_estimate, state_summary} tuple within one phase-aligned window, with verisimilitude grounding the rollout step that must stay ahead of real time.

MECH-271 routing is state-gated. In waking, the anchor channel dominates the hippocampal fan-out: replay preferentially reaches consolidation and viability-map consumers to support decision-making. In sleep, the probe channel dominates: replay preferentially seeds Bayesian schema restructuring -- testing which action-outcome attributions held up across episodes, creating new buckets for non-fitting experiences, revising causal graphs. The informational needs of sleep (schema revision) and waking (decision support) are distinct, and the routing bias reflects that.
E1 updates are batched into theta-cycle summaries before reaching E3 (cross-frequency temporal packaging).
Salient events phase-reset the E3 heartbeat clock.
Thalamo-cortical spindle-equivalent bursts package E3/hippocampal replay content for z_theta delivery AND gate external sensory input, protecting the consolidation episode from interruption.
Temporal Coherence Loop (TCL): architecture must include a distributed loop responsible for maintaining phase alignment and temporal synchrony necessary for V(t) to be computable.

created_claims.title: Temporal-gate adequacy as a separable interface factor, and the mistimed-interface false negative: an inter-system mapping can be representationally adequate -- source content present, receiver-facing geometry adequate, bridge low-complexity, correct-pair specificity satisfied, receiver on-manifold -- and still produce NO downstream effect because it is engaged outside the phase in which the receiver is receptive, plastic, replaying the relevant episode, or evaluating the relevant candidate. This separates HAVING a compatible interface from ENGAGING it at the phase in which its content can alter another system. Registered failure class TG-F (a ninth entry in the location doc's F1-F7 routing table) and the binding evidential consequence that is this claim's real content, deliberately of the same shape as INV-105's two: a null measured at an interface whose engagement phase was NOT a controlled variable does not license the reading "the interface is semantically useless" or "the information was lost", until the same correctly paired content has been delivered at a target phase versus early-shifted, late-shifted and phase-shuffled conditions AT MATCHED communication energy, event count and update magnitude -- so that timing, not quantity, is what varied. Corollary that keeps this from licensing new machinery: the manipulation is expected to be expressible by REE's EXISTING wake / sleep / control-plane substrate, and a finding that it is not is itself the result -- do not add a gate mechanism to make the test runnable.

Communication-subspace routing failure -- encoded but not exposed: a task variable can be strongly encoded in the FULL sender latent while being weakly represented in the CONSUMER-FACING subspace, producing the phenotype `external probe succeeds -> native behaviour fails` with no information having been destroyed. Operationalised by cross-validated Reduced Rank Regression from sender activity to the ACTUAL consumer input tensor, comparing task decodability in the full sender, inside the estimated communication subspace, and in its orthogonal complement; the diagnostic signature is `target decodable from X` but `poorly decodable from P_comm X`.

Dynamic interface compatibility: between PREDICTIVE systems, pointwise state correspondence across an interface is insufficient -- a mapping must additionally satisfy that receiver_transition(T(x_t), a_t) is compatible with T(x_(t+1)) under the relevant action/context, because a bridge can succeed pointwise while destroying transition geometry. The registered diagnostic separation is: map ONLY the initial state and let the receiver evolve natively, versus repeatedly mapping sender rollout states -- this distinguishes a bridge that supplies a compatible starting condition from one that must continually correct incompatible dynamics. Failure signature `good static + bad dynamic` routes to transition-geometry work rather than to representation work; `good one-step + degrading long-horizon` indicates compounding dynamics mismatch; `good dynamic but poor behaviour` routes downstream to valuation/selection.

Minimum bridge complexity as the measure of mutual legibility: for systems A and B and a family of constrained mappings of increasing expressiveness (native readout -> orthogonal/Procrustes -> affine -> low-rank affine -> constrained nonlinear -> high-capacity upper bound), define L(A -> B) = the minimum bridge complexity achieving a predeclared HELD-OUT functional criterion between FROZEN endpoints; lower L means greater mutual legibility, and the simpler the bridge that works the stronger the evidence that the sender already held an appropriately structured representation -- a high-capacity bridge that succeeds may be performing new cognition and is therefore evidence about the bridge, not about the endpoints. L must never be read alone: two systems that became identical because one LOST its specialisation would show falling L with worsening cognition, so development is tracked on two axes (local specialisation/competence, and cross-system legibility). Non-redundant developmental prediction: sender and receiver each improve local competence WHILE global representational similarity stays flat or falls, task information concentrates in the consumer-facing subspace, and minimum bridge rank falls -- coordination without homogenisation.

The cognitive contract: a unified mind built from heterogeneous engines (E1 / E2 / E3 / hippocampus and later specialists, differing in representational geometry, temporal scale, compression level, learning dynamics and uncertainty representation) requires not a common latent space but an INVARIANT-PRESERVING CONTRACT -- a small set of relations I such that for any lossy translation x_A -> C_A(x_A) -> T_AB -> D_B -> x'_B, I(x_A) ~ I(x'_B), even though x'_B = x_A is meaningless across different spaces. The contract is relational / semantic, not representational: each engine may encode an invariant differently (explicit scalar, trajectory position, recurrent-state relation, geometric direction, ordering relation) so long as the relation is recoverable at the boundary when needed. It sits ABOVE the translation machinery and ABOVE schemas (cognitive contract -> representation / translation machinery -> schemas -> particular concepts, memories and environmental models): a schema rewrite, including offline reorganisation during sleep, changes WHAT the organism knows; contract failure changes WHETHER its subsystems can still understand one another. The contract specifies RECOVERABLE RELATIONSHIPS, never a fixed data structure or ontology -- engines encode invariants differently, new representational systems can be added, schemas reorganise, and contract dimensions may be added or retired. Its two failure poles are representation collapse (one canonical latent forced on every engine, destroying the specialisation that makes multiple engines useful) and cognitive fragmentation (engines keep exchanging tensors while progressively losing shared meaning -- computationally active, no longer one mind). Unity does not require representational sameness; it requires preservation of the relations that keep representations about the same cognitive world.

Receiver-conditioned translation: what a sender should expose to a consumer is a function of the receiver's current state, not of the sender alone -- translated content = T(sender state, receiver state, receiver position / context) -- so the communication subspace (MECH-537) is CONTEXT-INDEXED rather than one globally fixed cross-system alignment. The sender may support several potential read surfaces, and which one is active may depend on receiver mode, current goal or task-loop context, uncertainty, the action or candidate under evaluation, retrieved episodic context, temporal phase and the receiver's current predicted state. CONSTRAINT that keeps this from becoming a hidden cognitive module: receiver-conditioning determines WHICH PART of already-present sender information is exposed and HOW it is expressed; it must not let the bridge solve the task independently. Confirming signature: T(A,B) > T(A) on held-out data at MATCHED capacity AND receiver-state permutation destroys the gain; if permutation barely matters, the gain is extra capacity, not conditioning, and the result is evidence about the bridge (MECH-538). Candidate REE loci: z_world -> E1 versus z_world -> E2 (different read surfaces of one sender), E1 <-> E2 conditioned on the candidate action / horizon under evaluation, hippocampal retrieval -> consumer conditioned on the consumer's present query state, ContextMemory -> downstream reader expressed relative to current context rather than injected as a fixed latent message, and waking versus offline interfaces using different receiver-conditioned geometry.

Theta-burst packet contains multi-content joint binding: each ~125ms theta cycle binds a {goal_latent, action_proposal, risk_estimate, state_summary} tuple within one phase-aligned window, with verisimilitude grounding the rollout step that must stay ahead of real time.
Dual-stream observation routing sends exteroceptive input to both E1 and a dedicated harm detection pathway.

Sense-specific perceptual-manifold adaptor: each sensory modality requires its own adaptor transforming raw stimulus space into a perceptual-manifold (metric) space before shared-world-model entry; senses are not interchangeable raw streams.

created_claims.title: Reference-frame mediation as a separable interface factor: two systems can each contain a task distinction, expose it through a healthy communication subspace (MECH-537), and still fail to communicate because they index that distinction against INCOMPATIBLE RELATIONAL COORDINATES -- egocentric versus allocentric, current-position-relative versus trajectory-origin-relative, observation-time versus predicted-action-time, absolute location versus action-conditioned displacement, episode-identity versus elapsed-tick. The interface decomposition is therefore content x communication subspace x REFERENCE FRAME x receiver context x temporal gate, and the frame is a THIRD selection variable alongside which directions are exposed (MECH-537) and which read surface the receiver's state selects (MECH-547). Registered failure class RF-F (an eighth entry in the location doc's F1-F7 routing table): an external probe succeeds on sender AND receiver, the information is not missing and the subspace is not collapsed, yet native cross-system use fails -- routing to a relational re-indexing rather than to more sender capacity or a higher bridge rung. The DISCRIMINATOR that makes this more than a redescription is a frame permutation that preserves content: permute the frame labels or anchors between episodes or positions while holding sender-state distribution, marginal difficulty and content statistics fixed (intact >> frame-permuted, while the target stays decodable in both, is the confirming signature; intact ~= frame-permuted says the frame is incidental at that interface). Two non-redundant predictions: frame alignment should LOWER the minimum bridge rung L(A -> B) (MECH-538) without requiring a higher-capacity bridge, and a frame permutation may disrupt only ONE downstream consumer, in which case reference frames are consumer-specific rather than globally shared -- which forbids inferring one global workspace or one canonical coordinate system from several consumers sharing an indexing relation.

hub_targets.title: Sleep-consolidation priority from V_s residuals: during sleep-phase Bayesian aggregation (MECH-275) and sleep-dependent self-model aggregation (MECH-273), the order and weight of replay events is biased by the schema-staleness map produced by MECH-284. Replay is not uniform across schema and is not solely salience-driven (dopaminergic tagging); it is also prioritised by accumulated verisimilitude residuals. Schema regions with the most accumulated 'this is wrong' evidence get replayed first, more often, and with higher schema-update authority during sleep. PTSD-rumination has a clean architectural account here: MECH-285 priority loss co-occurring with MECH-094 hypothesis-tag dysfunction, locking the staleness tag from ever clearing.

policy_composition.sleep_replay_value_conditioned_chunking_consolidation -- narrow exception path that permits ARC-071 chunk formation from replayed (hypothesis_tag=True) sequences during designated sleep phase, IF the replayed sequence carries a value-tag from prior real-executed episodes AND the formed chunk carries a replay_origin=True audit flag with accelerated dissolution if not corroborated by real waking execution within N episodes. Resolves ARC-071 lit-pull R6 governance escalation (Option B carve-out, picked 2026-05-11).

Diffuse long-range competitive coupling is a generative stability requirement: stable, synergistic, hierarchical cognifold dynamics require signed competitive coupling -- specifically diffuse, long-range competition between distant fields with opposite profiles -- not merely local damping. An all-cooperative (all-positive) routed-field cognifold is unstable: every salient stream reinforces every other, producing runaway resonance / over-synchronisation / loss of modular segregation. Competition is the constructive ingredient that buys stabilisation, segregation, hierarchy, synergy, and subject-specificity.
Serotonergic withdrawal during REM actively defines the precision recalibration zero-point by removing the benefit gradient, not merely permitting recalibration
Quiescent E3 heartbeat cycles trigger hippocampal SWR-equivalent replay for viability map consolidation.

Dependency structure among evidence must be REPRESENTED and conditioned on, and independence must never be INFERRED from the absence of a recorded dependency. Any representation that can later influence belief, confidence, closure or action must carry enough (uncertain, compressed) causal genealogy that the descendants of a hypothesis cannot be counted as witnesses independent of it. The rule is binding in its NEGATIVE form only -- a hypothesis must not cite its own descendants as independent witnesses -- and is explicitly NOT the positive rule "descendants should be collapsed to one vote": where a structural dependency exists but the observations across it are partial or contradicting, dependent reports can support a hypothesis MORE than independent ones would, so maximal discounting is the larger error. The invariant therefore constrains the REPRESENTATION (dependency must be expressible and readable), not the arithmetic (no fixed discount is mandated). Unknown provenance is not independent provenance; uncertain source is not confidently external source.

False evidence multiplication: a provenance error can change the apparent CARDINALITY of evidence and not only its source label. One internally generated hypothesis H produces descendants through prediction, hippocampal replay, counterfactual simulation, retrieved memory and ambiguous perceptual interpretation; if shared ancestry is lost, those descendants are counted as several mutually corroborating observations and confidence in H rises with no corresponding increase in world evidence. Two consequences are asserted to be separable and must not be collapsed: a phenomenological branch (self-generated content losing evidence of self-generation acquires external/perceptual status) and an epistemic branch (descendants losing shared ancestry inflate posterior confidence and shorten information-seeking). LOCUS CORRECTION, carried in the claim rather than deferred: the operative variable is the READOUT'S DEFAULT FOR UNKNOWN ANCESTRY, not the corruption event itself -- an architecture that treats unrecorded dependency as independence will inflate whether or not any genealogy was ever corrupted.

Sleep-phase full-Bayesian aggregation is a general mechanism across attribution domains: given a waking-phase feedstock of counterfactual-backed attributions (produced by MECH-276), sleep phases aggregate across many episodes, correcting for delayed consequences, failed counterfactuals, and systematic attribution biases that single-episode attribution cannot catch. MECH-273 (self-model aggregation) and MECH-274 (other-model aggregation, V4) are specialisations. Object-schema revision is a further specialisation. INV-049 (offline phases mathematically necessary for model-building agents) is operationalised here: what sleep is mathematically necessary FOR is this cross-episode Bayesian aggregation of counterfactual-backed attribution.

created_claims.title: Recursive replay amplification of false independence: when genealogy is corrupted or absent, repeated replay / reinstatement of internally stored content converts remembered or simulated material into apparent new evidence, so confidence in a hypothesis rises monotonically with replay count while external evidence is held fixed, and the belief becomes self-maintaining. The dangerous signature is specifically an ancestry-by-replay-count INTERACTION, not a replay-count main effect: healthy replay must be able to improve retrieval fidelity and representation quality with the effective independent-source count staying flat. Admissible only under two controls -- replay stratified by kind (single-episode content rehearsal, cross-episode relational linking, prediction-generated descendants), and retrieval quality matched across ancestry conditions, since a corrupted-ancestry arm that also retrieves better yields a retrieval effect wearing a provenance label.

hub_targets.title: Multi-dimensional provenance source vector: an event token's provenance is a SOURCE VECTOR over several partly-independent dimensions (perceived-vs-imagined, self-generated-vs-other-generated, source identity, temporal source, modality), not a single committed_vs_imagined bit. Provenance failures dissociate per-dimension -- the system can correctly attribute real-vs-imagined while mis-attributing who-generated-it or when -- so each dimension carries its own confidence, and the one-way committed gate applies per safety-relevant dimension rather than to a single global bit.

Provenance-bearing one-way commit-status gate (V3 half of the 2026-09-24 split): imagined / simulated event representations carry an explicit committed_vs_imagined provenance label, and a ONE-WAY gate ensures they can be used for planning without ever acquiring committed-history status -- the reality-status signature MECH-545's contract-lesion assay targets. Scope: the label and gate on the event representations V3 already carries; the full unified-store event-token schema is MECH-365a (v4, on ARC-085).

Two-factor (tag-and-capture) write-eligibility: MECH-368's plasticity_eligibility is not a single instantaneous test but a TWO-STAGE process -- a local event sets a transient, input-specific eligibility TAG, and a durable model/policy write is consummated only if that tag CAPTURES a separately-gated plasticity/consolidation-resource signal within a time window. A tagged-eligible event can still fail to write if no capture signal arrives, and an arriving capture signal can rescue a recently-tagged weak event.

Unified autobiographical temporal event substrate: retrospective replay (ARC-007) and prospective simulation (ARC-018) draw on ONE self-tagged event-token store rather than two parallel memory machineries. Autobiographical memory is an identity-indexed event field -- personal events bound to perspective, emotion, residue, and self-state -- not neutral storage; future trajectory generation is forward re-composition of the same event tokens, while replay is their backward reinstatement.

created_claims.title: Compressed causal genealogy as the representation that discharges the dependency-representation invariant: provenance is a GRAPH over representations, not a vector of attributes on each one. The proposed structure is bounded rather than a full history -- shared-ancestor probability between any two evidence-bearing items, an externally-anchored-observation flag with its own confidence, a hypothetical / replay lineage marker, an already-counted-evidence-family marker recording whether an item has already contributed to the current belief update, and a context-conditioned dependency estimate -- and each genealogy edge carries its own confidence so that ancestry can be uncertain without being absent. This extends the per-token provenance source vector from attributes of one token to relations between tokens, which is the level at which evidence cardinality is defined.

hub_targets.title: The system maintains a functional distinction between simulation-mode content and real-experience content, such that simulation content does not accumulate in the viability map as committed experience; failures of this distinction produce confabulation (simulated events encoded as real).
