Recurrent interface stability: an interface can be statically useful yet recurrently unstable -- a bridge with one-step utility > 0 can fail repeated closed-loop application, and REE traverses most interfaces repeatedly over trajectories, episodes and recurrent prediction loops. Two mechanisms, to be distinguished experimentally: (a) OFF-MANIFOLD COMPOUNDING -- a bridge trained on native receiver states emits a slightly off-distribution receiver state, the next application treats it as ordinary input, and B_0 -> T(A_0,B_0) = B_1' -> T(A_1,B_1') = B_2' accumulates displacement into a regime the bridge never saw; (b) SEMANTIC DOUBLE-COUNTING -- content already injected is not recognised as present and is re-amplified, escalating gain. Design corollary: CUMULATIVE translation (each step operates on the previously translated receiver state) versus CLEAN-BASE translation (each step computed against an unmodified native receiver state, the residual held as a temporary gated overlay) -- translated information should first be tested as an overlay or gated read surface, never as an irreversible rewrite of the receiver's core latent state. Adds an EIGHTH rung to INV-105's ladder, RECURRENTLY STABLE: repeated use preserves receiver-state validity, information calibration and functional behaviour over the timescale the system actually uses the interface -- assessed BEFORE behavioural usefulness is read as architecturally meaningful in a dynamical system. Sleep corollary for MECH-540: offline interface recalibration must improve or preserve closed-loop stability when waking dynamics resume; a sleep-induced change that improves a static probe but destabilises the next waking trajectory is a failure, not consolidation. Signatures: one-step rescue + cumulative collapse + clean-base stability = recurrent interface instability; cumulative stability + correct-pair specificity = a functionally coherent recurrent bridge; both fixed and conditioned bridges failing while richer source information succeeds = upstream representation deficiency remains more likely.
Psychosis is a precision-weighting failure where prior beliefs persistently dominate sensory evidence; the generative model becomes self-sealing and sensory update is suppressed.

Confidence readouts are non-collapsible, and externally-induced agreement is a separate channel from internally-derived confidence. A single scalar confidence conflates propositional confidence, attractor stability, cross-subsystem agreement, conflict pressure, action-readiness, and socially-supplied agreement; the last must not enter the same accumulator as the others -- else being told something becomes indistinguishable from having found it.

Permeability pathology and source-fidelity loss: the same selective permeability that enables cultural learning (MECH-542) necessarily creates its failure modes, and this is NOT an accidental weakness but plausibly the unavoidable price of a system that can learn from counterfactual experience -- a fully impermeable hypothetical system learns nothing from imagination, a fully permeable one cannot distinguish imagination from reality, and the useful system lies between. Predicted routes: repeated fictional trajectories distorting perceived likelihood; emotionally powerful narratives acquiring inappropriate precision; propaganda altering other-agent models without adequate evidence; humour gradually reducing the effective cost of previously prohibited representations; imagined threats modifying expectations of groups never directly encountered; cultural availability mistaken for environmental frequency. REGISTERED SIGNATURE -- SOURCE-FIDELITY LOSS: source information becomes less reliable while narrative structure is retained, producing characteristic errors in which retained narrative becomes progressively harder to distinguish from experienced or testified information; the underlying mechanism (stored-tag decay vs reconstructed-at-retrieval misattribution, per Johnson, Hashtroudi and Lindsay 1993) is left open pending the D6 discriminating test. The architectural requirement is therefore NOT to prevent hypothetical material from influencing cognition, but to keep the KIND and MAGNITUDE of update appropriate to the epistemic status of the representation.

Waking confidence inflation as an asymmetric precision EMA: good news about one's own accuracy is incorporated fast and bad news slowly, so the running-variance estimate settles below the true error mean. Supplies the daytime precision-drift source that MECH-204's corrective function presupposes but which V3 did not have. ree_core E3 selector change, bit-identical by default.

hub_targets.title: Replay-driven rebucketing: accumulated consequential-divergence evidence -- typed insufficiency signals from decision outcomes (prediction/consequence mismatch, harm or goal error, repeated veto/conflict, divergent outcomes following apparently equivalent E1 states), never category labels -- drives split / merge / feature-reweighting / relation-discovery / event-boundary-revision / abstraction-change over E1's equivalence classes, via REPLAY of non-contiguous episodes under a common evaluative frame (retrospective representation learning: later experience revises how earlier experiences are bucketed). Candidate rebucketings are COUNTERFACTUALLY tested before adoption (does representing the distinction improve predictions under relevant alternative actions and contexts?), and consequential revisions preferentially complete in a decoupled/sleep phase whose job includes RE-INDEXING episodic traces so autobiographical addressability survives the representational change -- sleep as safe maintenance of the representational coordinate system itself. E3 must not become E1's teacher: downstream selection changes the learning conditions and evidence pressure on E1, never its truth content directly (non-oracular).

Sleep as selective interface maintenance -- the third offline job: MECH-529 gives offline consolidation two functions, revising the representation (split/merge/reweight over equivalence classes) and re-indexing episodic traces so autobiographical addressability survives that revision. This claim adds a THIRD: adjusting or stabilising the INTERFACE -- the subspace through which another subsystem reads the revised representation. The prediction is explicitly NOT global alignment but a PLASTICITY/STABILITY DIVISION OF LABOUR across interfaces: some reconfigure because recent learning demands it, others remain stable because downstream continuity matters more, so the strongest test compares at least TWO interfaces with different predicted plasticity rather than asking whether all systems become more similar after sleep. Four distinguishable post-sleep signatures: S1 representational retuning (interface metrics move only because the sender moved), S2 interface recalibration (local competence stable, communication subspace or bridge complexity improves), S3 stable scaffold (representations move, mapping holds), S4 maladaptive homogenisation (similarity rises while local competence or task-specific differentiation worsens).

Offline integration is a protected family of TYPED transformations, not a unitary replay update: retention/interference repair, representational reorganisation, recalibration/attribution repair, and behavioural-access repair are distinct offline OUTCOMES (a partition by what changed, not by which phase ran), and each requires its own declared WRITE TARGET, its own PROVENANCE CLASS for the content it may consume, and its own DISTAL WAKING READOUT. Replay is a transport and sampling operation shared by all four, never a sufficient description of the transformation any of them performs. Consequently a readout appropriate to one operation is not evidence about another: retention is shown by preserved or recovered competence after interference on old and transfer cases; reorganisation by changed relational transfer, equivalence-class behaviour, generalisation or state construction WITH trace/index continuity; recalibration by improved calibration or causal attribution under held-out outcomes, never by narrower uncertainty alone (a sharper but wrong posterior is a failure, and reduced ambivalence from attractor collapse or gate lockout must be separated from reduced ambivalence from evidence integration); and access repair by restored endogenous recruitment, fresh commitment, executed behaviour and ecological consequence while upstream content is held fixed.

Functional persistence, not weight magnitude, is the retention criterion for developmental capacity reduction: which relationships, mappings or routes survive a developmental reduction should be determined by repeated demonstrated usefulness under prediction, action, regulation and replay -- predictive contribution, reduction of persistent prediction error, harm/benefit relevance, controllability discrimination, counterfactual usefulness, action-selection contribution, replay recurrence, transfer across contexts, stability across developmental stages, utility to more than one downstream consumer, and maintenance of uncertainty where premature collapse would be dangerous. The prediction is comparative and has a named rival that must be run as a control rather than assumed away: relevance-guided reduction should outperform indiscriminate magnitude pruning at matched final capacity; if it does not, functional selection is not what the developmental reduction is doing and the effect reduces to capacity annealing.

Representation-version reindexing for episodic memory: when the representational primitives used to index memory change -- a bucket splits, several buckets merge, ContextMemory's effective dimensionality crystallises to a different count (MECH-496), or the underlying encoder is otherwise updated -- previously stored episodes must be explicitly reinstated and reindexed under the new scheme via an ADDITIVE, versioned relationship rather than an overwrite: the episode, its source, and its original indexing remain independently recoverable, the new indexing is created as a distinct version with provenance back to the change that produced it, and the episode should remain interpretable under both the historical and the current representational scheme.
The SWS sub-phase of offline mode performs global attractor flattening and residue field denoising (synaptic homeostasis analog), pruning weak noisy traces and restoring signal-to-noise ratio.

The DEVELOPMENTAL capacity envelope is a design variable distinct from the MATURE capacity envelope, and REE must not infer the first from the second: the connection count, the number of candidate mappings, the size of the accessible transformation repertoire and the permissiveness of an interface that a developing organism needs in order to DISCOVER a useful organisation may each legitimately exceed what the mature organism retains, so imposing the mature bottleneck at developmental time zero can prevent the organism from discovering which distinctions and interfaces deserve to survive. This generalises MECH-362's subtractive trajectory from RECURRENT MEMORY CONNECTIVITY to the whole set of REE loci the thought names -- z_world, the E1/E2 interfaces, the hippocampal/replay pathways, goal/directive influence and E3 selection -- and states the consequence as a curriculum-design discipline: a developmental programme must declare, per locus, its developmental search capacity SEPARATELY from its mature architectural constraint, and the two need not be identical.

created_claims.title: Capacity reduction concurrent with representational change is a COORDINATION problem, and offline replay is the proposed coordination site: while a representation is still being revised, a route can appear unnecessary only because its consumer has not yet adapted to the new representation, and an apparently useful route can be preserving an obsolete coding convention -- so the retention decision read online during representational change is systematically unreliable in both directions. The proposal is that offline/replay periods provide the safer setting for it, because they permit testing which old episodes remain reconstructable, comparing alternative candidate mappings without immediate behavioural cost, re-indexing memories after representational change, stabilising newly useful communication subspaces, weakening redundant routes, and checking that a reduction has not destroyed counterfactual or regulatory distinctions. Falsifiable prediction with its matched control stated: at equal aggressiveness of reduction AND matched update count, replay-coupled reduction should preserve more transfer and causal structure than online-only reduction; the strong form is that replay permits GREATER compression at equal or better transfer.

Organism-relevant distinction preservation across representational compression: any compression, abstraction or consolidation step on the observation -> z_world -> E1/E2 path (and any offline schema-compression of episodes) must preserve, or leave recoverable through its dynamics, five classes of distinction consequential to the organism across time -- (1) consequence and opportunity/threat, (2) controllability and agency incl. internal-state consequence invisible in the scene, (3) persistence and temporal relation, (4) causal ancestry / intervention handles (agent identity, action class, preconditions, uncertainty over causal contribution), (5) independently evolving trajectories -- as PRESERVATION REQUIREMENTS, not latent dimensions; a step that destroys downstream access to one of them is a developmental regression regardless of reconstruction or prediction loss; auxiliary heads enforcing a class are removable SCAFFOLDS and the ontology within a class must remain free to split, merge and reweight over development.

Subtractive developmental sparsification: mature sparse/structured memory connectivity emerges by pruning / down-weighting an initially over-connected, dense, near-random ('tabula plena') substrate, not by additively growing connections onto a sparse skeleton; correspondingly, mature recall requires convergent summation of several weak inputs rather than a single strong cue.

This generalises MECH-362's subtractive trajectory from RECURRENT MEMORY CONNECTIVITY to the whole set of REE loci the thought names -- z_world, the E1/E2 interfaces, the hippocampal/replay pathways, goal/directive influence and E3 selection -- and states the consequence as a curriculum-design discipline: a developmental programme must declare, per locus, its developmental search capacity SEPARATELY from its mature architectural constraint, and the two need not be identical.

Should REE distinguish an early over-connected exploratory developmental substrate from a mature sparse/structured substrate -- and is developmental sparsification best modelled as deletion, down-weighting, gating, or residue-tagged de-authorization?

created_claims.title: Functional persistence, not weight magnitude, is the retention criterion for developmental capacity reduction: which relationships, mappings or routes survive a developmental reduction should be determined by repeated demonstrated usefulness under prediction, action, regulation and replay -- predictive contribution, reduction of persistent prediction error, harm/benefit relevance, controllability discrimination, counterfactual usefulness, action-selection contribution, replay recurrence, transfer across contexts, stability across developmental stages, utility to more than one downstream consumer, and maintenance of uncertainty where premature collapse would be dangerous. The prediction is comparative and has a named rival that must be run as a control rather than assumed away: relevance-guided reduction should outperform indiscriminate magnitude pruning at matched final capacity; if it does not, functional selection is not what the developmental reduction is doing and the effect reduces to capacity annealing.

hub_targets.title: Matched-auxiliary-control and scaffold-removal admissibility rule: a result is admissible as evidence that a representation objective (auxiliary head, anchoring target, contrastive shaping, any added loss) ORGANISES a latent in a specific way -- rather than that extra supervision helps -- only if obtained against BOTH (1) a matched arbitrary-auxiliary control (same head capacity, loss budget, update frequency and training examples; target with learnable but organism-irrelevant structure; any entropy/difficulty mismatch REPORTED, never silently accepted) and (2) an evaluation with the auxiliary head removed, scored on downstream organism-level measures (rollout at consequential transitions, behavioural competence, transfer when consequences change but sensory statistics do not, counterfactual separability, perturbation recovery), never on the objective's own probe accuracy or loss; in its offline-mechanism form, a durable sleep/replay/compression mechanism is adopted only on held-out causal attribution, intervention choice, transfer or calibration, never on training loss or replay reconstruction.
REE requires staged developmental training with explicit curriculum gates.

Minimum bridge complexity as the measure of mutual legibility: for systems A and B and a family of constrained mappings of increasing expressiveness (native readout -> orthogonal/Procrustes -> affine -> low-rank affine -> constrained nonlinear -> high-capacity upper bound), define L(A -> B) = the minimum bridge complexity achieving a predeclared HELD-OUT functional criterion between FROZEN endpoints; lower L means greater mutual legibility, and the simpler the bridge that works the stronger the evidence that the sender already held an appropriately structured representation -- a high-capacity bridge that succeeds may be performing new cognition and is therefore evidence about the bridge, not about the endpoints. L must never be read alone: two systems that became identical because one LOST its specialisation would show falling L with worsening cognition, so development is tracked on two axes (local specialisation/competence, and cross-system legibility). Non-redundant developmental prediction: sender and receiver each improve local competence WHILE global representational similarity stays flat or falls, task information concentrates in the consumer-facing subspace, and minimum bridge rank falls -- coordination without homogenisation.

Does a later-capable REE architecture's eventual social- and language-mind outcomes depend on which solitary (V3-like) and enduring-individual (V4-like) developmental regime it actually passed through before other minds became cognitively meaningful -- i.e. does ONTOGENETIC ancestry (the developmental regime actually lived through) shape later social-mind development independent of ARCHITECTURAL ancestry (which mechanisms were inherited into the larger architecture) -- such that retained lower-version developmental regimes would become machinery required to build later organisms coherently, rather than merely historical artefacts kept for comparison?

created_claims.title: Developmental-history irreducibility at matched final capacity: some mature cognitive organisations may be historically inaccessible from their own final architecture -- a system that develops through a transiently larger capacity envelope and is progressively reduced to a target architecture can outperform an identical target architecture trained from initialisation under the identical curriculum, so developmental history contributes something the final architecture alone does not reproduce. The claim is stated with its own discriminating control and is confirmable ONLY by that control: a four-arm design of (A) mature size throughout, (B) overcapacity progressively reduced to the mature size, (C) overcapacity retained, and (D) arm B's final architecture, sparsity mask and interface structure REINITIALISED and trained from the start under the same curriculum. B > A alone is consistent with the rival "pruning found a better small architecture"; only B > D at architecture(B) ~= architecture(D) and final capacity(B) = final capacity(D) establishes the claim. Corollary: premature representational or interface compression should selectively impair distinctions whose relevance is revealed only later in the curriculum, even where the same compressed form works well after maturation.

hub_targets.title: The latent-access evidence ladder: a variable's status in a latent space is not one property but seven, which must never be collapsed -- encoded (statistically present) != decodable (recoverable by an external probe) != natively accessible (usable by the system's existing consumer) != bridgeable (usable through a constrained map between frozen endpoints) != pairing-specific (useful specifically when the correct sender state is paired with the correct receiver situation) != causally used (interventions on its content alter downstream computation) != behaviourally beneficial (that causal use improves adaptive performance). Two evidential consequences bind rather than advise: (1) a content-transmission claim about any internal channel or bridge REQUIRES correct-vs-mismatched-vs-zero-vs-moment-matched-random controls, because a channel can be strongly load-bearing while its example-specific content is barely load-bearing; (2) a null measured on a COMPRESSED representation requires a dimensionality-matched RANDOM-PROJECTION floor, not a zero floor, before it can be read as information loss.

Dynamic interface compatibility: between PREDICTIVE systems, pointwise state correspondence across an interface is insufficient -- a mapping must additionally satisfy that receiver_transition(T(x_t), a_t) is compatible with T(x_(t+1)) under the relevant action/context, because a bridge can succeed pointwise while destroying transition geometry. The registered diagnostic separation is: map ONLY the initial state and let the receiver evolve natively, versus repeatedly mapping sender rollout states -- this distinguishes a bridge that supplies a compatible starting condition from one that must continually correct incompatible dynamics. Failure signature `good static + bad dynamic` routes to transition-geometry work rather than to representation work; `good one-step + degrading long-horizon` indicates compounding dynamics mismatch; `good dynamic but poor behaviour` routes downstream to valuation/selection.

Sleep as selective interface maintenance -- the third offline job: MECH-529 gives offline consolidation two functions, revising the representation (split/merge/reweight over equivalence classes) and re-indexing episodic traces so autobiographical addressability survives that revision. This claim adds a THIRD: adjusting or stabilising the INTERFACE -- the subspace through which another subsystem reads the revised representation. The prediction is explicitly NOT global alignment but a PLASTICITY/STABILITY DIVISION OF LABOUR across interfaces: some reconfigure because recent learning demands it, others remain stable because downstream continuity matters more, so the strongest test compares at least TWO interfaces with different predicted plasticity rather than asking whether all systems become more similar after sleep. Four distinguishable post-sleep signatures: S1 representational retuning (interface metrics move only because the sender moved), S2 interface recalibration (local competence stable, communication subspace or bridge complexity improves), S3 stable scaffold (representations move, mapping holds), S4 maladaptive homogenisation (similarity rises while local competence or task-specific differentiation worsens).

Recurrent interface stability: an interface can be statically useful yet recurrently unstable -- a bridge with one-step utility > 0 can fail repeated closed-loop application, and REE traverses most interfaces repeatedly over trajectories, episodes and recurrent prediction loops. Two mechanisms, to be distinguished experimentally: (a) OFF-MANIFOLD COMPOUNDING -- a bridge trained on native receiver states emits a slightly off-distribution receiver state, the next application treats it as ordinary input, and B_0 -> T(A_0,B_0) = B_1' -> T(A_1,B_1') = B_2' accumulates displacement into a regime the bridge never saw; (b) SEMANTIC DOUBLE-COUNTING -- content already injected is not recognised as present and is re-amplified, escalating gain. Design corollary: CUMULATIVE translation (each step operates on the previously translated receiver state) versus CLEAN-BASE translation (each step computed against an unmodified native receiver state, the residual held as a temporary gated overlay) -- translated information should first be tested as an overlay or gated read surface, never as an irreversible rewrite of the receiver's core latent state. Adds an EIGHTH rung to INV-105's ladder, RECURRENTLY STABLE: repeated use preserves receiver-state validity, information calibration and functional behaviour over the timescale the system actually uses the interface -- assessed BEFORE behavioural usefulness is read as architecturally meaningful in a dynamical system. Sleep corollary for MECH-540: offline interface recalibration must improve or preserve closed-loop stability when waking dynamics resume; a sleep-induced change that improves a static probe but destabilises the next waking trajectory is a failure, not consolidation. Signatures: one-step rescue + cumulative collapse + clean-base stability = recurrent interface instability; cumulative stability + correct-pair specificity = a functionally coherent recurrent bridge; both fixed and conditioned bridges failing while richer source information succeeds = upstream representation deficiency remains more likely.

Offline integration is a protected family of TYPED transformations, not a unitary replay update: retention/interference repair, representational reorganisation, recalibration/attribution repair, and behavioural-access repair are distinct offline OUTCOMES (a partition by what changed, not by which phase ran), and each requires its own declared WRITE TARGET, its own PROVENANCE CLASS for the content it may consume, and its own DISTAL WAKING READOUT. Replay is a transport and sampling operation shared by all four, never a sufficient description of the transformation any of them performs. Consequently a readout appropriate to one operation is not evidence about another: retention is shown by preserved or recovered competence after interference on old and transfer cases; reorganisation by changed relational transfer, equivalence-class behaviour, generalisation or state construction WITH trace/index continuity; recalibration by improved calibration or causal attribution under held-out outcomes, never by narrower uncertainty alone (a sharper but wrong posterior is a failure, and reduced ambivalence from attractor collapse or gate lockout must be separated from reduced ambivalence from evidence integration); and access repair by restored endogenous recruitment, fresh commitment, executed behaviour and ecological consequence while upstream content is held fixed.

Receiver-local self-healing is the standing rival to every cross-system interface-repair result: a consumer can restore its use of a drifting sender WITHOUT any episodic pair identity, any cross-system label, or any offline replay, by adjusting afferent weights from presynaptic sender activity and its own postsynaptic output under homeostatic error against fixed pre-drift output statistics -- and because this produces the SAME observable as interface repair (downstream performance restored despite upstream change), any REE result attributing a rescue to correctly paired replay must beat a faithful implementation of it at a matched update budget. Its preconditions are its predictions, and they are what make it falsifiable rather than a residual explanation: it needs redundant smooth tuning that continues to tile the represented variable, incremental rather than abrupt change, plasticity at least as fast as drift, and enough sampling or reactivation to estimate the correlations and output statistics -- so its advantage is a function of the DRIFT-RATE-TO-MAINTENANCE-INTERVAL RATIO, and an unswept timescale silently chooses the winner. Three regimes weaken it and are where a genuine pairing effect should be sought: large infrequent drift, drift of the receiver's own scaffold or decoder, and continuous symmetries permitting an unanchored global rotation. Its more durable variants -- population response normalisation, and a stable recurrent predictive model supplying covariance structure -- are NOT free local plasticity: they assume a receiver scaffold that is fixed or changes far more slowly than the feed-forward representation, and that assumption is itself a testable architectural commitment, not a background condition.

A reproduced deterministic RECIPE is not a frozen ENDPOINT: re-running a documented training recipe reconstitutes an operating REGIME, which licenses a within-run paired comparison and nothing whatever about the identity of the artifact a PRIOR run measured. Any claim naming a specific earlier endpoint -- "decoded the 1002/1008 latent", "the same frozen encoder", "the banked representation" -- requires that endpoint's weights and observations to have been PERSISTED and LOADED, not re-derived; where they were re-derived, the admissible statement is bounded to the regime ("the consumer-width values fall in the declared band and the participation ratios match"), and the endpoint-identity claim must be withdrawn. The discriminator is mechanical and cheap: a recorded state hash at both endpoints, re-verified at every evaluation boundary, with a mismatch aborting rather than warning. A pinned substrate COMMIT is not a substitute -- it constrains the code that produced the endpoint, never the endpoint's realised weights, which is why a commit-pinned run can and does report substrate_stable_across_run false.

created_claims.title: The interface-repair adjudication standard: a claim that some maintenance process REPAIRED a cross-system mapping -- as opposed to strengthening a memory, triggering a completion, or riding a subspace that never broke -- is admissible only from a single design, or one tightly integrated series, that closes all six links itself, because the confounds differ across preparations and therefore do not cancel when rows are stacked: (1) MEASURED CHANGE in a transfer-relevant direction, which excludes unit turnover, registration noise, behavioural change, and any rotation preserving the receiver-potent subspace; (2) LOCAL PRESERVATION of sender information, sender-local use, and receiver-local memory and competence, at the moment of the cross-system test; (3) ACCESS LOSS measured by a causal receiver-dependent output, never by decodability or correlation; (4) PAIR-SPECIFIC MAINTENANCE, compared against a within-context permutation preserving event count, state occupancy, marginal content, firing and plasticity opportunity and breaking only which sender event pairs with which receiver state; (5) CAUSAL RESTORATION on held-out episodes; (6) RIVAL EXCLUSION at matched budgets. Two consequences bind. First, a GATE-0 LESION PROOF precedes every maintenance arm: the imposed change must degrade causal receiver use while leaving both endpoints locally intact AND be restorable by a known oracle inverse -- if the oracle cannot restore use the lesion is not an interface lesion and the drift model is invalid, if magnitude-matched null-subspace drift degrades use the subspace identification is invalid, and if task-relevant drift does not degrade use there is nothing to repair and the experiment stops. Second, the estimand is the correctly-paired arm beating the MAXIMUM of the permuted-pair, receiver-local-adaptation and local-rehearsal arms, never the unmaintained floor: a correct-pair advantage over the floor alone is equally explained by generic plasticity, extra rehearsal and homeostatic adaptation. Local-memory equivalence is a PROSPECTIVE constraint tested by equivalence tests, never a covariate regressed out afterwards, because conditioning on a treatment-affected memory score is a collider.

Receiver-conditioned translation: what a sender should expose to a consumer is a function of the receiver's current state, not of the sender alone -- translated content = T(sender state, receiver state, receiver position / context) -- so the communication subspace (MECH-537) is CONTEXT-INDEXED rather than one globally fixed cross-system alignment. The sender may support several potential read surfaces, and which one is active may depend on receiver mode, current goal or task-loop context, uncertainty, the action or candidate under evaluation, retrieved episodic context, temporal phase and the receiver's current predicted state. CONSTRAINT that keeps this from becoming a hidden cognitive module: receiver-conditioning determines WHICH PART of already-present sender information is exposed and HOW it is expressed; it must not let the bridge solve the task independently. Confirming signature: T(A,B) > T(A) on held-out data at MATCHED capacity AND receiver-state permutation destroys the gain; if permutation barely matters, the gain is extra capacity, not conditioning, and the result is evidence about the bridge (MECH-538). Candidate REE loci: z_world -> E1 versus z_world -> E2 (different read surfaces of one sender), E1 <-> E2 conditioned on the candidate action / horizon under evaluation, hippocampal retrieval -> consumer conditioned on the consumer's present query state, ContextMemory -> downstream reader expressed relative to current context rather than injected as a fixed latent message, and waking versus offline interfaces using different receiver-conditioned geometry.

Predictive-equivalence envelope for claim rotation (the checksum GOV-ROTATE-1 lacks): two representations of one canonical claim count as the SAME claim -- and may share one truth state -- only while the experimentally relevant predictions they license remain compatible over an EXPLICITLY DECLARED domain of contexts, interventions, observables, scales and auxiliary assumptions (the equivalence envelope); equivalence is earned by surviving discriminating interventions, never assumed from the wording reading as a paraphrase, and when a discriminating intervention reveals divergence the divergence MUST be classified (scope condition / hidden auxiliary assumption / underspecified parent claim / invalid rotation / genuinely new proposition) BEFORE any evidence is allowed to transfer between the two representations.

hub_targets.title: behavioral_diversity_generation_pathway (multi-substrate distributed: LC-NE tonic + frontopolar curiosity + striatal novelty + hippocampal trajectory sampling). Architectural commitment: a non-trivial behavioural diversity generation pathway is upstream-of and logically prior to both rule pathways (ARC-062 top-down rule-apprehension and ARC-064 bottom-up rule-discovery). Without it, neither pathway has anything to weight or cluster -- gradient descent on a parametric policy without diversity pressure collapses to the smoothest single regime, the predicted equilibrium MECH-309 identifies. The biology distributes diversity generation across at least four substrates: LC-NE tonic noise floor, frontopolar uncertainty-driven curiosity, striatal novelty bonus, and hippocampal trajectory sampling. REE registers this as a foundational architectural slot whose specific child mechanisms (MECH-313 noise-floor, MECH-314 structured-curiosity with three sub-flavours, and the MECH-315-absorbed proposal-diversity channel) are independently testable but jointly load-bearing.

Integration does not require representational sameness, it requires selective mutual legibility: specialised cognitive subsystems may preserve distinct high-dimensional PRIVATE internal representations while coordinating through low-dimensional, context-sensitive communication subspaces and low-complexity transformations, so development can raise local specialisation and cross-system legibility AT THE SAME TIME rather than trading one against the other. Non-redundant prediction: a maturing REE shows rising local competence in E1/E2/hippocampus/E3 while GLOBAL representational similarity between them stays flat or falls, and increasing representational similarity between subsystems must therefore NOT be used as the default marker of maturation. This is an explicit ALTERNATIVE framing to ARC-121's shared epistemic-state object, not a refutation of it: one common object, specialised objects with a shared interface format, specialised objects joined by context-specific translation, and a hybrid invariant-core-plus-private-dimensions architecture all remain live, and ARC-121 must not be used to prejudge the question.

Go/No-Go eligibility constitution for committed-action conversion: committed-action diversity is recovered not by any single louder channel but by an explicit eligibility CONSTITUTION -- bounded Go pressure (promote a channel when evidence/value/drive/rule/safety make it eligible) AND bounded No-Go pressure (suppress unsafe / stale / perseverative / irrelevant / low-viability channels) governing which candidates may compete for the pallidal-like permission-to-commit gate -- so that lawful, channel-specific access (not scalar dominance) decides the committed action. The full Go/No-Go eligibility-set governance is what converts when the minimal near-tie lever (MECH-447) does not and isolated F->eligibility demotion (MECH-448) is insufficient alone.

Monomodal policy collapse is the equilibrium of a parametric-policy agent without a rule-apprehension layer. Bayesian update and gradient descent revise weights over a hypothesis space they do not invent; without a non-Bayesian rule-creator that proposes discriminative policy modes ('near-hazard -> reef regime; else -> forage regime'), the trainer collapses to the smoothest single regime good-enough across the whole state space. Monostrategy is therefore not a bug of training but the predicted output of an architecture in which only updaters exist and no apprehender does. Falsifiable by the weak-reading rule-apprehension experiment (ARC-062): a gated-policy architecture trained on the same substrate should break the collapse where standard E3 does not.

Vote count is not evidence count -- independence-aware convergence over heterogeneous evaluators: when several partly independent evaluators favour the same candidate, the epistemic weight of that agreement depends on how many EFFECTIVELY INDEPENDENT evidential routes produced it, and a bounded system that retains a COARSE representation of its evaluators' dependency TOPOLOGY -- which routes share upstream representation, training signal, ancestry, or residual error -- recovers materially more of the exact joint-inference answer than either (a) a marginal-reliability-only combiner, which counts one duplicated reason N times, or (b) a single global dependence scalar, which cannot separate a correlated coalition plus genuinely independent specialists from uniform moderate dependence. The claimed object is a TOPOLOGY, not a scalar convergence score: at minimum who supports what, how reliable each route is in the current domain, which routes share ancestry or error, which credible routes remain independent, and what structured dissent survives. Three bindings keep this from becoming a new scalar ruler. (1) CEILING BINDING: exact Bayesian aggregation over the true joint dependency model remains the normative ceiling and this claim explicitly does NOT assert that any convergence heuristic beats it -- the assertion is bounded-resource COMPRESSION, that coarse topology approaches the exact decision and confidence at materially lower structural cost and degrades gracefully when dependency estimates are stale or wrong. (2) NON-REPLACEMENT BINDING: independence correction is additive to, never a substitute for, evaluator reliability/relevance weighting and protected-veto structure -- independence-aware convergence is not majority rule and must not become more majority-dominated than a reliability baseline. (3) NON-TAUTOLOGY BINDING: a convergence quantity must be validated by an INDEPENDENT consequence (held-out decision accuracy, calibration, robustness under evaluator dropout or distribution shift), never by a transformation that forces agreement -- normalising every evaluator to equal scale and then observing equal contribution is not evidence.

Emotion-as-anti-collapse architecture: emotion-like systems are a set of GATED, PARTIALLY INDEPENDENT evaluators (is-this-harmful / is-this-safe / did-this-reduce-suffering / am-I-pursuing-something-I-want / did-I-merely-like-the-last-thing / am-I-stuck / am-I-overcommitted / is-this-goal-stale / should-I-explore / should-I-stop / should-I-sleep-and-consolidate / should-I-release-the-policy) whose collective effect is to prevent behaviour from collapsing onto the currently dominant gradient. Affect is therefore the architectural SOURCE of structured behavioural diversity -- not decoration on a rational optimiser and not random exploration noise, but native modulatory control (gates, biases, interrupts, salience shifts, persistence regulators, release conditions, credit-assignment signals) that produces STRUCTURED deviations from naive optimisation. A unifying MAP over REE's already-owned affect machinery, not a new substrate; an optimise-then-bolt-on-safety design fails because these evaluators must be native, not added afterward.

Offline replay (MECH-121) must sample trajectory-diverse content -- including non-dominant and counterfactual paths -- to maintain multi-strategy viability; consolidation of only the dominant trajectory produces monostrategy in E1's world model even when SHY (MECH-120) is intact.

Plasticity crystallization necessity: any model-building agent whose internal scoring is dominated by a high-variance predictive pathway will converge to monostrategy under Hebbian-equivalent learning unless a time-bounded plasticity asymmetry allows competing diversity circuits to establish competitive weight before winner-take-all dynamics close off the option space; without this crystallization window, behavioral diversity is permanently suppressed regardless of diversity-signal magnitude.

e3_scoring_preserves_trajectory_class_diversity. E3 score aggregation over CEM-supplied candidates must preserve trajectory-class diversity rather than collapse a diverse candidate pool onto a single deterministic ranking. Without explicit diversity preservation at the scoring step, downstream action selection becomes deterministic regardless of proposal-layer diversity (ARC-065 SP-CEM child), making the whole distributed diversity pathway rate-limited by Layer B. Mechanism options (not yet committed): (1) entropy bonus over candidate first-action classes added to E3 score; (2) class- stratified argmax with within-class proportional sampling; (3) jittered tie-breaking when top-K E3 scores are within epsilon. Final design pending diagnostic data on whether E3 collapse is near-tie or large-gap (see behavioral_diversity_isolation_plan.md Phase P2).

Behavioural diversity is a structural prerequisite for ethical counterfactual evaluation. A system with monomodal policy cannot instantiate the counterfactual evaluation that ethical judgement requires, because the 'could have done otherwise' comparison demands that the agent's candidate trajectory pool contain at least two distinct trajectory classes with distinct harm profiles. The argument is mathematical-by-construction: if P(a|s) is monomodal, the CEM elite pool contains only trajectories beginning with a*, and MECH-257's evaluator-mode E2(z_t, a_cf) for a_cf != a* (prospective rollout-scoring; supersedes SD-003, 2026-04-18) is never evaluated in the on-policy candidate distribution. (Was proposed 2026-05-15 as INV-074 in behavioral_diversity_acceptance_criteria.md but never registered; the ID was subsequently taken 2026-05-17 by an unrelated plasticity-crystallization invariant. Re-registered under INV-076 with scientific content unchanged.)

created_claims.title: Convergence must be DETECTED over a preserved diversity, never TRAINED into the evaluators: any architecture that treats agreement among partly independent routes as evidence thereby creates a gradient toward making those routes agree, and acting on that gradient destroys exactly the independence that gave the agreement its evidential value -- agreement among clones is cheap, agreement among competent differences is not. The constraint therefore binds in five parts: (i) no agreement or consensus objective may be optimised into the evaluators themselves, and a convergence estimator must never become a teacher of its own evidence base; (ii) convergence is computed DIAGNOSTICALLY over evaluator outputs and is an EVENT over diversity, not an endpoint or a training target; (iii) dependency provenance and disagreement history must be preserved rather than compressed away, because they are what make a later agreement interpretable; (iv) a competent dissenting route must retain a protected path to attention that a confident majority cannot close, and protected-veto and irreversibility structure must not be purchasable by many weak agreeing votes; (v) the objective is preservation of COMPETENT NON-REDUNDANT routes -- unique predictive coverage, unique error detection, distinct failure sets, distinct causal paths -- and explicitly NOT maximum diversity, which is satisfiable by noise or contrarian output, nor maximum agreement. The diversity that matters for this purpose is ERROR and CAUSAL diversity, not geometric representational dissimilarity: two systems can differ geometrically and fail identically, or look similar and respond differently under intervention.

hub_targets.title: The system maintains a functional distinction between simulation-mode content and real-experience content, such that simulation content does not accumulate in the viability map as committed experience; failures of this distinction produce confabulation (simulated events encoded as real).

Multi-dimensional provenance source vector: an event token's provenance is a SOURCE VECTOR over several partly-independent dimensions (perceived-vs-imagined, self-generated-vs-other-generated, source identity, temporal source, modality), not a single committed_vs_imagined bit. Provenance failures dissociate per-dimension -- the system can correctly attribute real-vs-imagined while mis-attributing who-generated-it or when -- so each dimension carries its own confidence, and the one-way committed gate applies per safety-relevant dimension rather than to a single global bit.
Imagination must be possible without belief update.

Evaluation channels are evidence-producing boundaries, not world-state affordances: no agentic subsystem -- including an AI assistant developing REE -- may update architectural confidence directly from a performance score without provenance, review, and governance mediation. World feedback, evidence feedback, and governance feedback are distinct typed signal classes that must remain non-collapsible.

Confidence readouts are non-collapsible, and externally-induced agreement is a separate channel from internally-derived confidence. A single scalar confidence conflates propositional confidence, attractor stability, cross-subsystem agreement, conflict pressure, action-readiness, and socially-supplied agreement; the last must not enter the same accumulator as the others -- else being told something becomes indistinguishable from having found it.
Rehearsal traversal and irreversible durable write must remain separated.

created_claims.title: Dependency structure among evidence must be REPRESENTED and conditioned on, and independence must never be INFERRED from the absence of a recorded dependency. Any representation that can later influence belief, confidence, closure or action must carry enough (uncertain, compressed) causal genealogy that the descendants of a hypothesis cannot be counted as witnesses independent of it. The rule is binding in its NEGATIVE form only -- a hypothesis must not cite its own descendants as independent witnesses -- and is explicitly NOT the positive rule "descendants should be collapsed to one vote": where a structural dependency exists but the observations across it are partial or contradicting, dependent reports can support a hypothesis MORE than independent ones would, so maximal discounting is the larger error. The invariant therefore constrains the REPRESENTATION (dependency must be expressible and readable), not the arithmetic (no fixed discount is mandated). Unknown provenance is not independent provenance; uncertain source is not confidently external source.

hub_targets.title: Held-out validation for Assembly workflow and rule changes: a change to a workflow, skill, or standing rule should be validated against cases that did NOT generate it. Every layer of Assembly practice currently edits the artefact from the session that motivated the edit -- a workflow change judged by the cycle that produced it, a CLAUDE.md rule written by the session that hit the incident, an intake template revised by the intake that strained it. There is no held-out review anywhere in the loop.

Organism-level mechanism status is stage-qualified beyond ARC-120's competence-before-authority sequence: a mechanism becomes causally reachable only through an ordered audit projection of existence, representation, endogenous recruitment, local operation, competitive authority (non-zero influence is not necessarily competitive influence against the dominant arbitration term), committed throughput (survives any later selector, latch, commitment boundary, or stale-selection path), ecological consequence (the changed behaviour has a valid opportunity to matter in the environment), and retention/generalisation. Authority at one internal selection boundary does not by itself establish that authority reaches committed behaviour -- 'competence should precede authority, but authority must also demonstrate throughput.' The furthest stage actually demonstrated, not a flat implemented/not-implemented judgment, is the correct unit for recording mechanism status.

Failure-autopsy failure-location triage: before an experimental observation (a scored-criterion FAIL, or an unscored organism-level observation in a claim-free diagnostic) is described as evidence that REE itself failed, it must be explicitly classified against four non-exclusive failure-location buckets -- REE FAILED / THE MECHANISM FAILED / THE MEASURES FAILED / THE ENVIRONMENT FAILED -- and a REE-failed verdict may be reached only once mechanism instantiation, measurement adequacy, and environmental opportunity have each been separately established (or explicitly could not be, in which case the verdict is MIXED/uncertain, not REE-failed). SCOPE AMENDED 2026-09-16 (user-ratified, from the organism-level validation doctrine): the same four-bucket triage applies symmetrically to an apparent IMPROVEMENT -- before a change in experimental throughput, verdict pattern, evidence weight or front position is narrated as creature progress, classify its source as change in the CREATURE / the EXPERIMENT driver / the INSTRUMENT or measure / the GOVERNANCE or index interpretation, and label the latter three 'science-enabling infrastructure change', never 'creature improvement', unless the creature itself changed and was validated.

The latent-access evidence ladder: a variable's status in a latent space is not one property but seven, which must never be collapsed -- encoded (statistically present) != decodable (recoverable by an external probe) != natively accessible (usable by the system's existing consumer) != bridgeable (usable through a constrained map between frozen endpoints) != pairing-specific (useful specifically when the correct sender state is paired with the correct receiver situation) != causally used (interventions on its content alter downstream computation) != behaviourally beneficial (that causal use improves adaptive performance). Two evidential consequences bind rather than advise: (1) a content-transmission claim about any internal channel or bridge REQUIRES correct-vs-mismatched-vs-zero-vs-moment-matched-random controls, because a channel can be strongly load-bearing while its example-specific content is barely load-bearing; (2) a null measured on a COMPRESSED representation requires a dimensionality-matched RANDOM-PROJECTION floor, not a zero floor, before it can be read as information loss.

A run is not admissible as negative evidence for a claim unless the organism instantiated for that run was demonstrably able to express -- and, where the claim is learning- or development-dependent, to acquire -- the faculty under test. Each organism-level experiment must therefore DECLARE, and a preflight must machine-verify against the instantiated organism, at minimum: the canonical profile identity and every explicit deviation from it; the mechanisms and capabilities the hypothesis presupposes; whether those mechanisms were constructed, enabled and reached on the production path; whether their decisive readouts engaged often enough for the test to be non-vacuous; whether their output could compete at the relevant arbitration surface at the scale present in the run; which forms of change were permitted (parameters, policy/value, E1/E2 representations, memory state, residue/EMA state, offline updates); and, where online learning is load-bearing, whether gradients were enabled, whether the intended trainable parameters were in an optimizer, and whether a parameter-delta witness confirms an actual update path. A run failing any declared precondition self-routes to a capability-precondition diagnostic status and MUST NOT be recorded as evidence against the claim. 'It did not learn' and 'it could not have learned' are different scientific outcomes.

REE Assembly needs a dedicated behavioural-adjudication methodology/skill for organism-level behavioural experiment design and interpretation ("umpire, not ruler": observe, preserve the observation without embedding an explanation, generate competing explanations, derive predictions, construct discriminating perturbations, blind condition labels where practical, apply pre-specified hypothesis-directed measures, also run discovery-oriented analysis for structure not anticipated in advance, adjudicate across the pattern of evidence, replicate, and test generalisation under environmental change) -- because a fixed, pre-specified scalar-metric approach risks conflating stochasticity/exploration/noise with the behavioural organisation actually of interest, and risks Goodharting once a convenient metric becomes the de facto definition of the phenomenon.

REE:Assembly analogies must be LABELLED as analogies. REE (the cognitive architecture) and REE Assembly (the scientific-development and governance machinery) have strong structural parallels; any analogy between them must be marked as an analogy and must NEVER be used as evidence that REE operates the way Assembly does, or vice versa.

Canonical readiness umpire: REE maintains an explicit, inspectable process for recognising when a reproducible organism has become sufficiently coherent and competent that formal reference-organism review is warranted -- while remaining structurally unable to answer that question itself. The detector observes/derives/reports/escalates state transitions (NO_WARRANT / ADMISSION_PASS_WARRANTED / REFERENCE_ORGANISM_REVIEW_WARRANTED / USER_DECISION_REQUIRED / CANONICAL_OBSERVED) over explicit gates (identifiable organism; admission-doctrine candidate substrate; COEXISTENCE of mechanisms in the same animal; whole-organism non-degeneracy; behavioural evidence; reproducibility) -- never a readiness percentage, never self-canonisation. Warrants are withdrawable; profile-admission readiness and reference-organism readiness remain separate thresholds; for developmental REEs the reproducible object may be the developmental recipe and constitution rather than the adult state.

created_claims.title: Evidence-domain jurisdiction rule: evidence receives no broader jurisdiction than the experiment earned. Organism-level validation is a PROFILE over eight orthogonal evidence domains -- D0 instrument validity, D1 local mechanism validity, D2 local causal consequence, D3 closed-loop behavioural consequence, D4 ecological (world-family, not seed) generalisation, D5 developmental validity, D6 integrated compatibility and simplification, D7 adaptive recovery from a materially wrong internal model -- never a scalar ladder and never one "intelligence score". Whenever a result is promoted UPWARD -- into a roadmap or closure-plan node, an architectural recommendation, a milestone or progress summary (CURRENT_FRONT, insights_report, morning digest, a governance cycle's headline), a default-on decision, or any statement that REE itself has become more competent -- the promoting text MUST carry an explicit line of the form "Evidence domain reached: D? / Domains not tested: ..." naming the SPECIFIC untested domains that matter for that claim. A frozen-latent decoder result establishes at most D1; a live selection perturbation at most D2; seven seeds in one world family do not reach D4. Raw manifests and per-run autopsies are exempt; the rule binds the SUMMARY layer, where mechanism validity is most easily narrated as organismal progress.

Frozen hypothesis-set pre-registration rule (anti-Goodhart contract over the Narrow/Decide dashboard): the reduction ratio surviving/initial is Goodhart-able from the denominator side -- a campaign can improve its apparent narrowing by padding the initial hypothesis set after the discriminating evidence is already in. This rule pre-registers the contract that forbids it: the initial set is FROZEN at registration (initial_frozen_count_at_registration never moves), a hypothesis must be pre-registered before its adjudicating run resolves, and the ONE sanctioned way an already-adjudicated question's set may grow is LABELLED GOV-FANOUT-1 fan-out whose late legs clear only on GIT-WITNESSED provenance -- a self-reported pre_registered_utc is back-datable and is not evidence. The registry has a SINGLE producer (/failure-autopsy Step 9b); governance is derive-only over it. The audit is advisory and NEVER gates a cycle. Warn-only; PROMOTES/DEMOTES NOTHING.

Claim rotation (epistemic representation layer, not a second evidence ledger): REE's claim system may hold multiple explicit representations of one canonical claim -- architectural, transformation, behavioural, developmental, biological-analogue -- each exposing a different diagnostic question / observable / intervention point, while the canonical claim retains a SINGLE evidence and promotion state across all of them (multiple views, ONE truth state); when translating a claim into an alternative view exposes empirical content the original wording did not entail, that content becomes a NEW claim with its own evidence record and must NEVER inherit the parent claim's evidence.

Bottleneck fan-out escalation rule (constructive complement to GOV-CEIL-1 / GOV-DIAG-1 / the re-derive brake): the existing brakes DETECT that work is circling one root (N>=3 same-root ceiling or diagnostic-recurrence hits) and correctly REFUSE another same-question sequential letter -- but they prescribe no constructive next move, so the default is a single re-posed sequential probe that can itself inherit the prior confound and return a confident-but-wrong verdict. This rule supplies the missing response: when a brake fires AND the open question is a DISCRIMINATION (which-hypothesis, not a single named build), the standard escalates from sequential retry to a DIVERSE PARALLEL PORTFOLIO -- enumerate the live hypothesis space, design >=K probes each attacking a DIFFERENT design axis (not power-bumps), each declaring what a null result means, adversarially audit the portfolio for coverage gaps + verdict aliasing BEFORE queuing, and run them in parallel accepting some legs will be non_contributory. Warn-only routing signal; PROMOTES/DEMOTES NOTHING.

Granularity-debt recurrence rule: N or more structurally-DIFFERENT confirmed failures on one claim indicate the claim is mis-grained rather than merely unlucky, and it should be re-grained rather than re-run.

Substrate-ceiling exhaustion demotion rule: a claim that hits the substrate ceiling N>=3 times (>=3 confirmed failure-autopsy verdicts recommending substrate_ceiling) WITHOUT a single positive discrimination on any richer substrate is DEMOTED, not parked indefinitely. The competing null reading -- the mechanism is inert / doing no work -- is then carried co-equally with the hypothesis until a positive discrimination on a richer substrate exists. substrate_ceiling is honest but structurally lets a hypothesis never lose; this rule pre-registers the loss condition.

created_claims.title: H-other / model-misspecification route: every important hypothesis-space discrimination programme (a question in hypothesis_space_registry.v1.json) must preserve an explicit route OUTSIDE its registered partition -- "H-other: the pattern is not explained by any registered hypothesis and the partition itself may be wrong" -- so that a well-designed frozen hypothesis ledger does not become a closed ontology in which reality is assumed to choose among the enumerated legs. The route is NOT a catch-all after an ordinary null; it becomes salient on PATTERN-level signals: no registered leg explains the full outcome; different seeds or environments select incompatible explanations; the effect appears only in interaction with another subsystem; timing or developmental history omitted from the partition explains the variance; several registered legs are simultaneously required; or every surviving leg needs a rescue clause. When it fires, the required next action is to rotate the claim (GOV-ROTATE-1) or expand the partition as a LABELLED growth event (GOV-FROZEN-1 invariant 3a / failure-autopsy Mode C) BEFORE another rescue run is queued -- never "the same hypothesis with more compute".

Entity binding is continuously re-evaluated, not fixed: an established self-anchor <-> world-configuration binding is re-bound to a competing configuration when that competitor overtakes the currently-bound one under perturbation of the shared anchor. Rebinding is the ENTITY-LAYER analogue of MECH-269(b) anchor-reset -- it operates over self<->world-config bindings rather than proposer stream-anchors. The rebinding trigger is prediction-error / competitor-overtake driven (object-file updating; serial-dependence hysteresis; PE-driven perceptual switching), NOT a coherence-specific selection factor C(tau) (that coherence-SPECIFICITY question is settled NO-CLAIM by V3-EXQ-725a and is explicitly excluded from this claim).

created_claims.title: Seeds-versus-worlds reporting rule: random-seed replication and ecological (world-family) replication are different evidence and MUST be reported separately -- "stochastic replication: N seeds" and "world-family replication: N environment families / N orthogonal perturbation classes" -- and a result may not be described as general, robust or transferable solely because it survived more seeds. Seeds test robustness within ONE world family; ecological replication tests whether the mechanism survives when the world itself changes along a PREDECLARED axis (map geometry, hazard or resource prevalence and topology, cue-to-consequence mapping, transition dynamics, temporal delays, observation or sensor layout, action costs, affordance structure, partial observability, actor structure). Where such a suite is used as a promotion target it must be FROZEN before use, or it becomes another training distribution. Until a frozen ecological suite exists, world-family replication is a NAMED DEBT on every claim promoted on seeds alone, never an implied property.

Compensatory realizability -- recovery without restoration: an adaptive organism should not be REQUIRED to recover by reconstructing its former internal state; the target property is the capacity to preserve or recover a useful function by REORGANIZING CAUSAL RESPONSIBILITY across internal processes rather than returning to one canonical implementation. Operational criterion: after perturbation, recovered behaviour must be accompanied by a demonstrably ALTERED DISTRIBUTION OF CAUSAL IMPORTANCE, not a hidden reconstruction of the original pathway -- evidenced by the original route remaining observably impaired, a different internal process becoming NECESSARY (selective re-ablation removes the recovered competence), and later restoration of the original route producing competition/redundancy/reorganisation rather than revealing it had silently returned. Requires a four-arm design -- no-intervention, restorative-normalization analogue, compensatory-amplification analogue (lesion left in place, the recruited substitute selectively strengthened), and a CONTROL-AMPLIFICATION arm strengthening a comparably sized non-compensatory process -- because without the fourth arm 'generic added capacity' is an unexcluded explanation of any recovery.

Reduction admissibility for the cognitive contract (the anti-cheating rule the pruning clause lacks): counting primitives is not minimality, and a proposed MERGE, demotion or derivation of one candidate from another counts only if it lowers TOTAL TRANSFERABLE COMPLEXITY rather than relocating it. The quantity to be reduced is minimal sufficient transferable information under CONSTRAINED encoders and receivers -- informally contract cost ~= information rate + encoder/decoder complexity + context or side-channel complexity + reconstruction distortion + computational and latency cost + robustness cost -- not the number of English nouns in the basis. A reduction is therefore INADMISSIBLE when the lost distinctions reappear inside the definition of the surviving relation, a more powerful decoder, hidden context tags, unconstrained numerical precision, recurrent hidden state, task-specific side channels, or expensive reconstruction machinery. Three requirements for any proposed collapse: (1) lower total description or rate cost under fixed assumptions about precision and decoder power; (2) preserve DISCRIMINATING predictions -- the reduced model must still predict distinct failure signatures when different information is corrupted; (3) improve transfer or efficiency relative to an unconstrained equivalent-capacity code. The standard of reducibility is OPERATIONAL, not logical: logical reducibility (a mathematician can derive it) and information-theoretic reducibility (the information exists somewhere) are both inadmissible, and only computational reducibility (the receiver can derive it with plausible resources) and operational reducibility (reliably and quickly enough for the behaviour in question) decide. Corollary that makes the rule bite: rewriting several candidates as one typed relational graph, one latent, or one universal relation is a RENAMING, not a reduction, and is refused unless all three requirements are demonstrated.

created_claims.title: Deletion-pressure rule: construction earns a later obligation to attempt simplification. Once several individually validated local repairs coexist in one organism (representation-preservation objectives, routing bridges, selection-authority boosts, replay repair, provenance tracking, goal-anchor normalisation, compensatory control loops), the mature bundle must periodically be challenged by mechanism removal, low-complexity replacement, consolidation of redundant routes, reduction of bridge capacity, and removal of downstream compensation after an upstream repair -- and competence retained after removal is recorded as a POSITIVE architectural result, not as lost work. Two mechanisms do not both keep conceptual credit when one has become unnecessary; this is the architectural counterpart of not double-counting evidence. A mechanism is not protected from deletion by having once passed its own isolated assay.

Cognitive-contract invariant admissibility rule: a candidate contract invariant (ARC-142) acquires ARCHITECTURAL standing only by consilience -- independent support from at least two of six evidence domains: (1) cross-linguistic typology (recurrent, obligatorily encoded across unrelated languages), (2) pre-linguistic developmental cognition (present before language or explicit instruction), (3) neuroscience (modality- or subsystem-independent representation, or a known translation mechanism that retains it), (4) comparative cognition (present in species with different sensory / behavioural ecologies), (5) independently trained artificial agents (discovered without being specified; removal produces characteristic failure), and (6) REE-internal necessity (an engine boundary that cannot learn or translate around it). Every candidate must be CLASSIFIED architectural / embodied-ecological / human-linguistic-convention / uncertain, with the alternative explanation (embodiment, culture, task structure) recorded. Cross-linguistic universality ALONE is inadmissible as architectural evidence: shared bodies, sensory systems, ecology and phylogeny explain human universals without cognitive universality. Developmental precedence -- required before substantial learning can occur -- is the strongest single-domain signal. A negative finding (an apparently fundamental invariant shown unnecessary, or translatable-around) is a first-class preserved result, not a discard. The contract must be DERIVED INDEPENDENTLY of REE_assembly's own claims / evidence / provenance / dependency invariant machinery (docs/architecture/invariant_types.md, claim_evidence) -- deriving it from that machinery is circular -- and any structural convergence between the two is logged as an empirical clue under GOV-ANALOGY-1, never assumed. Each candidate carries a twelve-field evidence record (candidate, definition, linguistic, developmental, neural, comparative, artificial-agent, REE evidence, lesion prediction, alternative explanation, classification, confidence); the objective is the smallest defensible set, never the longest list.

Minimum bridge complexity as the measure of mutual legibility: for systems A and B and a family of constrained mappings of increasing expressiveness (native readout -> orthogonal/Procrustes -> affine -> low-rank affine -> constrained nonlinear -> high-capacity upper bound), define L(A -> B) = the minimum bridge complexity achieving a predeclared HELD-OUT functional criterion between FROZEN endpoints; lower L means greater mutual legibility, and the simpler the bridge that works the stronger the evidence that the sender already held an appropriately structured representation -- a high-capacity bridge that succeeds may be performing new cognition and is therefore evidence about the bridge, not about the endpoints. L must never be read alone: two systems that became identical because one LOST its specialisation would show falling L with worsening cognition, so development is tracked on two axes (local specialisation/competence, and cross-system legibility). Non-redundant developmental prediction: sender and receiver each improve local competence WHILE global representational similarity stays flat or falls, task information concentrates in the consumer-facing subspace, and minimum bridge rank falls -- coordination without homogenisation.

The cognitive contract: a unified mind built from heterogeneous engines (E1 / E2 / E3 / hippocampus and later specialists, differing in representational geometry, temporal scale, compression level, learning dynamics and uncertainty representation) requires not a common latent space but an INVARIANT-PRESERVING CONTRACT -- a small set of relations I such that for any lossy translation x_A -> C_A(x_A) -> T_AB -> D_B -> x'_B, I(x_A) ~ I(x'_B), even though x'_B = x_A is meaningless across different spaces. The contract is relational / semantic, not representational: each engine may encode an invariant differently (explicit scalar, trajectory position, recurrent-state relation, geometric direction, ordering relation) so long as the relation is recoverable at the boundary when needed. It sits ABOVE the translation machinery and ABOVE schemas (cognitive contract -> representation / translation machinery -> schemas -> particular concepts, memories and environmental models): a schema rewrite, including offline reorganisation during sleep, changes WHAT the organism knows; contract failure changes WHETHER its subsystems can still understand one another. The contract specifies RECOVERABLE RELATIONSHIPS, never a fixed data structure or ontology -- engines encode invariants differently, new representational systems can be added, schemas reorganise, and contract dimensions may be added or retired. The quantity to be reduced is minimal sufficient transferable information under CONSTRAINED encoders and receivers -- informally contract cost ~= information rate + encoder/decoder complexity + context or side-channel complexity + reconstruction distortion + computational and latency cost + robustness cost -- not the number of English nouns in the basis. A reduction is therefore INADMISSIBLE when the lost distinctions reappear inside the definition of the surviving relation, a more powerful decoder, hidden context tags, unconstrained numerical precision, recurrent hidden state, task-specific side channels, or expensive reconstruction machinery. Three requirements for any proposed collapse: (1) lower total description or rate cost under fixed assumptions about precision and decoder power; (2) preserve DISCRIMINATING predictions -- the reduced model must still predict distinct failure signatures when different information is corrupted; (3) improve transfer or efficiency relative to an unconstrained equivalent-capacity code. Contract-lesion assays: the decisive test of a candidate cognitive-contract invariant (ARC-142) is not its presence in successful cognition but a BOUNDARY LESION -- a translation between two engines that preserves content but deletes one relation -- producing a predicted, invariant-specific fragmentation signature.
