created_claims.title: Contract-invariant promotion ladder: GOV-CONTRACT-1's >= 2-of-6-domain consilience quorum is STAGE 1 of six, not the whole standard, and clearing it confers a LEDGER STATUS ("admitted") and nothing else -- in particular no claims.yaml entry, no architectural commitment, and no licence to implement. The ladder: Stage 0 named canonical candidate (the relation has a governed ledger record); Stage 1 cross-domain recurrence (the GOV-CONTRACT-1 quorum); Stage 2 transferable RECEIVER-ACCESSIBLE recoverability (the relation is recoverable by a plausible receiver, not merely by a researcher's probe, across held-out content, tasks or remappings -- graded on INV-105's ladder, never on external decodability alone); Stage 3 causal handoff dependence (selective, nuisance-controlled corruption at a relevant interface produces the predicted deficit, MECH-545); Stage 4 irreducibility under constrained reconstruction (a smaller already-supported basis cannot reproduce the function within the receiver's rate, decoder, context, latency and robustness budget -- adjudicated under the reduction-admissibility rule); Stage 5 adaptation-aware characterisation (compensation, alternative-pathway recruitment and rescue understood well enough to separate functional necessity from mechanism uniqueness, ARC-140); Stage 6 boundary scope established (which handoffs require the relation and which can reconstruct or omit it, ARC-144). A candidate becomes CLAIM-SHAPED at Stage 4 and eligible for architectural treatment only after Stage 5; before that its canonical home is its ledger record id. Composite candidates remain candidates however strong their recurrence, and a negative result at any stage is recorded in the ledger, never deleted.

hub_targets.title: The system maintains a functional distinction between simulation-mode content and real-experience content, such that simulation content does not accumulate in the viability map as committed experience; failures of this distinction produce confabulation (simulated events encoded as real).
Commit-boundary token reclassifies pre-commit vs post-commit error routing.

Verbal or symbolic representation of an undifferentiated affective action-pressure is itself a low-risk PARTIAL commit: it discharges the pressure into a cheap committed trajectory, and when that symbolic commit produces prediction mismatch (the articulated expectation fails) or social witnessing (another agent responds to it), the mismatch updates future trajectory-arbitration scoring for the affect's full-cost action alternatives -- which is the mechanism by which articulating an urge changes what the agent later does.

Rumination is a mismatchless symbolic-commit loop: repeated symbolic commits (verbal or imagined rehearsal of an affective pressure) that generate NO prediction mismatch and NO social witnessing fail to re-rank the candidate set, so the same trajectory is re-proposed and re-committed symbolically while arbitration never updates -- a perseveration signature distinct from over-persistence of an EMBODIED commitment, and the discriminator between therapeutic articulation and rumination is whether a symbolic commit changes subsequent arbitration scores.

The motivational-affective stream taxonomy (liking, wanting, suffering, threat, relief, frustration, curiosity, attachment/proximity, fatigue/cost, agency, prediction-error) is an open, extensible register of handles -- it must permit later split/merge/rename and must not be frozen into a final ontology.

created_claims.title: Commits are TYPED: REE's commitment machinery must distinguish at least symbolic, embodied, social-witnessed, repair, grief, boundary and rumination commit types, because each carries a different cost, a different mismatch source (or none), a different residue consequence and a different arbitration-update path -- a single untyped commit-boundary token cannot represent that a symbolic partial commit and an embodied full commit of the same trajectory carry different risk and teach different things.

hub_targets.title: Social cognition uses mirror modelling and coupling.
Language is a symbolic mediation and coordination layer.

Language and theory-of-mind/fast-empathy are implemented as partially-homologous but developmentally SEPARATE specialist systems over a shared self/world/action core -- distinct routing, input histories, representational pressures and gating -- not as one merged social-linguistic system that later differentiates.

Representational interference between language and fast empathy: discrete/reportable/sequential language representations and graded/affective/resonant empathy representations exert conflicting representational pressures, so forcing them into one shared workspace too early measurably degrades BOTH relative to separated systems at matched capacity.
E3 requires a structured latent goal representation (positive attractor in z_world or z_goal sub-space) distinct from harm avoidance.

A lightweight LanguageAffectAdaptor parses affect/emotion from user or agent LANGUAGE into the shared world model: a language-interface component that, when literal semantic content is insufficient to recover affect, converts text into PROBABILISTIC affect/emotion hypotheses (treated as uncertain latent-state estimates, NOT categorical emotion truths) and feeds those estimates into REE's wider agent-state and context modelling. It is an input/perception adaptor on the language channel -- distinct from REE's INTERNAL affective representation (Q-007 z_beta dimensions) -- supplying other-agent affect priors to the social/empathy modelling layer.

created_claims.title: Dorsal high-fidelity structured symbolic routing is architecturally distinct from the affective-coupling system, and a ventral interface binds affect to symbol: the pathway that carries language's structure and sequencing and the pathway that carries graded affective coupling are separate systems joined by a binding interface, so REE must not implement affect as a property of the symbolic route nor symbolic routing as a property of the affect stream. Operationalised by cross-validated Reduced Rank Regression from sender activity to the ACTUAL consumer input tensor, comparing task decodability in the full sender, inside the estimated communication subspace, and in its orthogonal complement; the diagnostic signature is `target decodable from X` but `poorly decodable from P_comm X`.

The registered diagnostic separation is: map ONLY the initial state and let the receiver evolve natively, versus repeatedly mapping sender rollout states -- this distinguishes a bridge that supplies a compatible starting condition from one that must continually correct incompatible dynamics. Failure signature `good static + bad dynamic` routes to transition-geometry work rather than to representation work; `good one-step + degrading long-horizon` indicates compounding dynamics mismatch; `good dynamic but poor behaviour` routes downstream to valuation/selection.

Authority field: the moment-to-moment functional conformation of L-space -- the effective directed distance / permeability / gain between representational regions, its asymmetry, persistence and decay, the compatibility of simultaneously active routes, and a local coalition's capacity to recruit wider participation -- is a STATE VARIABLE in its own right: continuous, graded, state-dependent, endogenously recruited from the organism's own prediction error, goal progress, residue and learned relevance, with its own competition and dynamics, and not identical to stored content, to the slow regulatory/neuromodulatory field, or to the final policy; falsifiable consequence: two runs with materially similar content state but different field state differ systematically in retrieval, commitment and distractor recovery, and an equally-parameterised static scalar or global gate cannot reproduce the same context-sensitive behaviour across matched tasks and seeds.

Three coupling modes: cooperative (binding, coherent trajectory, shared context), competitive (suppress incompatible trajectories, preserve boundaries, prevent runaway resonance, stop one field absorbing all others), gated-decoupling (isolate simulation / offline integration / unsafe candidates from release authority).

Organism-relevant distinction preservation across representational compression: any compression, abstraction or consolidation step on the observation -> z_world -> E1/E2 path (and any offline schema-compression of episodes) must preserve, or leave recoverable through its dynamics, five classes of distinction consequential to the organism across time -- (1) consequence and opportunity/threat, (2) controllability and agency incl. internal-state consequence invisible in the scene, (3) persistence and temporal relation, (4) causal ancestry / intervention handles (agent identity, action class, preconditions, uncertainty over causal contribution), (5) independently evolving trajectories -- as PRESERVATION REQUIREMENTS, not latent dimensions; a step that destroys downstream access to one of them is a developmental regression regardless of reconstruction or prediction loss; auxiliary heads enforcing a class are removable SCAFFOLDS and the ontology within a class must remain free to split, merge and reweight over development.

Every candidate must be CLASSIFIED architectural / embodied-ecological / human-linguistic-convention / uncertain, with the alternative explanation (embodiment, culture, task structure) recorded. Cross-linguistic universality ALONE is inadmissible as architectural evidence: shared bodies, sensory systems, ecology and phylogeny explain human universals without cognitive universality. Developmental precedence -- required before substantial learning can occur -- is the strongest single-domain signal. A negative finding (an apparently fundamental invariant shown unnecessary, or translatable-around) is a first-class preserved result, not a discard. The contract must be DERIVED INDEPENDENTLY of REE_assembly's own claims / evidence / provenance / dependency invariant machinery (docs/architecture/invariant_types.md, claim_evidence) -- deriving it from that machinery is circular -- and any structural convergence between the two is logged as an empirical clue under GOV-ANALOGY-1, never assumed. Each candidate carries a twelve-field evidence record (candidate, definition, linguistic, developmental, neural, comparative, artificial-agent, REE evidence, lesion prediction, alternative explanation, classification, confidence); the objective is the smallest defensible set, never the longest list.

Minimum bridge complexity as the measure of mutual legibility: for systems A and B and a family of constrained mappings of increasing expressiveness (native readout -> orthogonal/Procrustes -> affine -> low-rank affine -> constrained nonlinear -> high-capacity upper bound), define L(A -> B) = the minimum bridge complexity achieving a predeclared HELD-OUT functional criterion between FROZEN endpoints; lower L means greater mutual legibility, and the simpler the bridge that works the stronger the evidence that the sender already held an appropriately structured representation -- a high-capacity bridge that succeeds may be performing new cognition and is therefore evidence about the bridge, not about the endpoints. L must never be read alone: two systems that became identical because one LOST its specialisation would show falling L with worsening cognition, so development is tracked on two axes (local specialisation/competence, and cross-system legibility). Non-redundant developmental prediction: sender and receiver each improve local competence WHILE global representational similarity stays flat or falls, task information concentrates in the consumer-facing subspace, and minimum bridge rank falls -- coordination without homogenisation.

The cognitive contract: a unified mind built from heterogeneous engines (E1 / E2 / E3 / hippocampus and later specialists, differing in representational geometry, temporal scale, compression level, learning dynamics and uncertainty representation) requires not a common latent space but an INVARIANT-PRESERVING CONTRACT -- a small set of relations I such that for any lossy translation x_A -> C_A(x_A) -> T_AB -> D_B -> x'_B, I(x_A) ~ I(x'_B), even though x'_B = x_A is meaningless across different spaces. The contract is relational / semantic, not representational: each engine may encode an invariant differently (explicit scalar, trajectory position, recurrent-state relation, geometric direction, ordering relation) so long as the relation is recoverable at the boundary when needed. It sits ABOVE the translation machinery and ABOVE schemas (cognitive contract -> representation / translation machinery -> schemas -> particular concepts, memories and environmental models): a schema rewrite, including offline reorganisation during sleep, changes WHAT the organism knows; contract failure changes WHETHER its subsystems can still understand one another. The contract specifies RECOVERABLE RELATIONSHIPS, never a fixed data structure or ontology -- engines encode invariants differently, new representational systems can be added, schemas reorganise, and contract dimensions may be added or retired. Its two failure poles are representation collapse (one canonical latent forced on every engine, destroying the specialisation that makes multiple engines useful) and cognitive fragmentation (engines keep exchanging tensors while progressively losing shared meaning -- computationally active, no longer one mind). Unity does not require representational sameness; it requires preservation of the relations that keep representations about the same cognitive world.

Sleep as selective interface maintenance -- the third offline job: MECH-529 gives offline consolidation two functions, revising the representation (split/merge/reweight over equivalence classes) and re-indexing episodic traces so autobiographical addressability survives that revision. This claim adds a THIRD: adjusting or stabilising the INTERFACE -- the subspace through which another subsystem reads the revised representation. The prediction is explicitly NOT global alignment but a PLASTICITY/STABILITY DIVISION OF LABOUR across interfaces: some reconfigure because recent learning demands it, others remain stable because downstream continuity matters more, so the strongest test compares at least TWO interfaces with different predicted plasticity rather than asking whether all systems become more similar after sleep. Four distinguishable post-sleep signatures: S1 representational retuning (interface metrics move only because the sender moved), S2 interface recalibration (local competence stable, communication subspace or bridge complexity improves), S3 stable scaffold (representations move, mapping holds), S4 maladaptive homogenisation (similarity rises while local competence or task-specific differentiation worsens).

Receiver-conditioned translation: what a sender should expose to a consumer is a function of the receiver's current state, not of the sender alone -- translated content = T(sender state, receiver state, receiver position / context) -- so the communication subspace (MECH-537) is CONTEXT-INDEXED rather than one globally fixed cross-system alignment. The sender may support several potential read surfaces, and which one is active may depend on receiver mode, current goal or task-loop context, uncertainty, the action or candidate under evaluation, retrieved episodic context, temporal phase and the receiver's current predicted state. CONSTRAINT that keeps this from becoming a hidden cognitive module: receiver-conditioning determines WHICH PART of already-present sender information is exposed and HOW it is expressed; it must not let the bridge solve the task independently. Confirming signature: T(A,B) > T(A) on held-out data at MATCHED capacity AND receiver-state permutation destroys the gain; if permutation barely matters, the gain is extra capacity, not conditioning, and the result is evidence about the bridge (MECH-538). Candidate REE loci: z_world -> E1 versus z_world -> E2 (different read surfaces of one sender), E1 <-> E2 conditioned on the candidate action / horizon under evaluation, hippocampal retrieval -> consumer conditioned on the consumer's present query state, ContextMemory -> downstream reader expressed relative to current context rather than injected as a fixed latent message, and waking versus offline interfaces using different receiver-conditioned geometry.

Integration and protected non-equivalence are JOINTLY necessary: cross-stream similarity has a viable band. Too little shared organisation is fragmentation; too much is representational collapse. An adequate architecture must satisfy both constraints at once, with a measurable quantity in between -- not merely satisfy each on a separate axis.

Contract-lesion assays: the decisive test of a candidate cognitive-contract invariant (ARC-142) is not its presence in successful cognition but a BOUNDARY LESION -- a translation between two engines that preserves content but deletes one relation -- producing a predicted, invariant-specific fragmentation signature. Five pre-registered signatures: IDENTITY lesion (two representations cannot determine whether they concern the same entity) -> broken persistence, duplicated selves / objects, incoherent credit assignment, unstable memory integration; TEMPORAL lesion (content without temporal relation) -> cause / effect inversion, present-state vs anticipated-state confusion, confused planning, memory / prediction contamination; REALITY-STATUS lesion (observed, remembered, simulated and counterfactual states indistinct across the boundary) -> confabulation-like behaviour, false commitment to imagined states, impaired counterfactual learning, psychosis-like representational error; AGENCY lesion (events representable, controllability and actor relation lost) -> poor action learning, internal / external attribution errors, impaired responsibility assignment, failure of intentional planning; CONFIDENCE lesion (content translates, uncertainty does not) -> overcommitment, under-reaction to reliable predictions, inappropriate belief updating, failure of precision-sensitive integration. Predictions: each lesion applied at ONE inter-engine boundary yields a signature distinct from the other four and from generic information loss (scored against a dimensionality-matched random-projection floor, INV-105), and an invariant whose boundary lesion produces NO reproducible deficit is struck from the contract, with the negative result preserved (GOV-CONTRACT-1).

created_claims.title: The cognitive contract is BOUNDARY-INDEXED, not one flat universal header: for a handoff from subsystem A to subsystem B the obligation is I_AB = the relations B requires that B cannot cheaply and reliably reconstruct locally, so the contract is properly written as a family of TYPED OBLIGATIONS, C = { A -> B : I_AB, tolerated distortion, receiver capability, fallback behaviour }, one entry per directed interface. A sensory-to-world-model handoff, a hippocampal replay handoff, an E1-to-E2 predictive handoff and a control-plane handoff need not carry the same relational payload, and a relation may be obligatory at one boundary while being locally reconstructable -- and therefore omissible -- at another. The consequence that makes this more than bookkeeping: a DEEP SHARED CORE, if one exists, is an EMPIRICAL OVERLAP to be measured across many heterogeneous interfaces, never a premise; candidates such as value, salience, confidence, commitment and priority may be crucial at particular boundaries without being universal invariants of every internal representation, and a universal reading of the contract systematically over-states their status. Falsifier for the contract programme itself: if useful obligations exist at each boundary but their OVERLAP across the cognitive graph is negligible, boundary-specificity defeats a shared core and the contract is a set of interface specifications rather than an architecture of cognition.

REE requires staged developmental training with explicit curriculum gates.

Subtractive developmental sparsification: mature sparse/structured memory connectivity emerges by pruning / down-weighting an initially over-connected, dense, near-random ('tabula plena') substrate, not by additively growing connections onto a sparse skeleton; correspondingly, mature recall requires convergent summation of several weak inputs rather than a single strong cue.

Developmental hardening should be substrate-specific: social cognition, goal representation, and epistemic-ethical substrates should retain elevated plasticity throughout adulthood (selective neoteny), while procedural and motor substrates can fully harden.

REE's training curriculum must implement four sequential developmental phases: (1) innate coupling with a competent environment, (2) coupling consolidation with plasticity reduction, (3) play/exploration under a consolidated safety net, (4) language acquisition over a trusted channel. Skipping or reordering phases produces an agent with compromised social and ethical capabilities.

Should REE distinguish an early over-connected exploratory developmental substrate from a mature sparse/structured substrate -- and is developmental sparsification best modelled as deletion, down-weighting, gating, or residue-tagged de-authorization?

created_claims.title: The DEVELOPMENTAL capacity envelope is a design variable distinct from the MATURE capacity envelope, and REE must not infer the first from the second: the connection count, the number of candidate mappings, the size of the accessible transformation repertoire and the permissiveness of an interface that a developing organism needs in order to DISCOVER a useful organisation may each legitimately exceed what the mature organism retains, so imposing the mature bottleneck at developmental time zero can prevent the organism from discovering which distinctions and interfaces deserve to survive. This generalises MECH-362's subtractive trajectory from RECURRENT MEMORY CONNECTIVITY to the whole set of REE loci the thought names -- z_world, the E1/E2 interfaces, the hippocampal/replay pathways, goal/directive influence and E3 selection -- and states the consequence as a curriculum-design discipline: a developmental programme must declare, per locus, its developmental search capacity SEPARATELY from its mature architectural constraint, and the two need not be identical.

hub_targets.title: z_world P0 anti-collapse encoder-training recipe: a mini-batched P0 that trains the SD-005 split-encoder world path on STATIC scene-structure targets derived from world_obs alone (hazard/resource presence + bucketed nearest-Chebyshev distance), with class-balanced CE and a VICReg-style variance/covariance anti-collapse penalty, replacing the SD-009 event-contrastive + SD-018 P0 that was measured to COLLAPSE z_world to participation ratio ~1.06 at world_dim=128. Supplies the trained encoder that SD-031 / E2WorldForward P1 and V3-EXQ-783 both require.
z_gamma split into z_self (E2 motor-sensory domain) and z_world (E3/Hippocampus domain).

task_term_gradient_share_must_be_floored_not_weighted. Even when a task-aligned term is present in an encoder objective, transfer is gated by whether that term retains a non-trivial share of the GRADIENT against the preservation term; under fixed relative weights and no floor, raising the preservation weight monotonically starves it. REE has the crowding curve already measured on SD-106's own landing: mean held-out grounding lift 0.5702 (shipped) -> 0.4313 (w=50) -> 0.4064 (w=200, the arm V3-EXQ-1023a ran) -> 0.3982 (w=500), recorded there as a COST and never read as a mechanism. DreamerV3's corrective is a FLOOR rather than a weight: free bits, L = max(1, KL), contributes zero gradient below 1 nat, and the stated failure it prevents is exactly this one -- the regulariser wins, the code degenerates, the latent stops carrying task-relevant distinctions and 'the actor starves because the actor sees only the latent'. MuZero's analogue is per-head loss scaling by 1/K plus a 1/2 gradient scale at the dynamics entry. The general form this claim asserts: the protected quantity is the task term's gradient share, and it must be enforced by a SATURATING floor on the competing term, because a weight ratio must be re-tuned whenever anything else in the objective changes whereas a floor does not.

encoder_objective_must_carry_the_consumers_target / auxiliary_task_head_transfer. An encoder objective transfers to an action consumer only to the extent the objective itself contains a term whose target is the consumer's target, or an improvement on it. Task-agnostic variance preservation contains no such term, so its gradient is not systematically aligned with what the consumer reads and additional budget moves the encoder along directions the consumer does not use. MuZero is the limit case: the representation function receives gradients ONLY from policy, value and reward heads, and the paper explicitly refuses any requirement that the hidden state reconstruct the observation or match the true environment state. The ENABLING CONDITION, which is easy to miss and is load-bearing, is that MuZero's policy target is the MCTS-IMPROVED search policy rather than the network's own prior: an encoder trained toward a consumer's CURRENT output has a degenerate self-agreement fixed point, so 'train the encoder through its consumer' is incomplete without a policy-improvement operator. DreamerV3 is the affordable form and REE's correct template: task-relevant supervision enters the representation objective as AUXILIARY HEADS (reward and continue) on the same latent as the decoder at beta_pred = 1.0, while actor and critic gradients are STOPPED at the model state -- so the consumer's TARGET reaches the encoder and the consumer's GRADIENT does not. CORRECTION OF RECORD: the CDQ-010 row's premise that DreamerV3 carries actor/value gradients into the latent is wrong in the gradient sense, and that correction is the mechanism, because it is what lets a preservation objective transfer without any single consumer owning a SHARED latent.

objective_consumer_transfer_blocked_by_readout_reparameterisation_invariance. SD-106's preservation term is ||W f(x) - x||^2 / var with W a FREELY-TRAINED linear decoder optimised jointly with the encoder (ree-v3 ree_core/latent/zworld_p0.py:556-558, head_params joined to the same Adam). That loss is EXACTLY invariant to the general linear group acting on the 32-dim code: for any invertible A, the pair (A.f, W.A^-1) attains an identical loss. The objective therefore cannot distinguish two codes in the same GL(32) orbit and cannot prefer a well-conditioned representative over an arbitrarily ill-conditioned one. The consumer -- a fixed-capacity MLP trained by SGD on the FROZEN code -- is NOT invariant to A: its reachable solutions and sample efficiency depend on the code's spectrum. Transfer therefore fails not because information is missing but because the objective is structurally blind to the property that governs whether the consumer can use it. The substrate's own comment cites Baldi & Hornik (1989) as its anchor ('with a linear decoder the MSE optimum IS the principal subspace') -- and that theorem yields the principal SUBSPACE only up to an arbitrary invertible transformation, never the principal COMPONENTS. PCA-32 is the canonical orthonormal eigenvalue-ordered representative of that same orbit, which is why it clears the bar 3/3 at matched reconstruction (world_obs R^2 0.9984 vs SD-106's 0.9974) while SD-106 falls 0.1227 short at the consumer. The conditioning terms REE does carry bound the orbit only partially: the VICReg variance term is a ONE-SIDED floor, mean relu(gamma - std_j), with no cap on anisotropy above the floor, and the covariance term decorrelates without equalising, so the code's condition number is unconstrained.

created_claims.title: Generic bottleneck variance preservation at the observation->z_world encoder: a SCALE-NORMALISED reconstruction term (fraction-of-variance-unexplained, with its own linear decoder) plus a zero-initialised linear bypass around the world encoder's ReLU stack. The successor SHAPE to SD-018, which supervises ONE NAMED FEATURE (resource proximity) and returned NULL at V3-EXQ-978. Addresses the CONFIRMED H-F-content-discarded-at-encode verdict of V3-EXQ-1010: the shipped P0 objective supplies no gradient toward decision-relevant content, leaving the latent at or below its own random-initialisation quality.

REE's failure-mode taxonomy is indexed on TWO axes simultaneously: (1) named failure mode (the existing mechanistically-distinct entries -- psychosis/hypothesis-tag loss, confabulation, derealization, OCD, depressive attractor, catatonia subtypes, etc.) AND (2) a finite, named set of cross-cutting LATENT VULNERABILITY AXES that span the named entries (precision/confidence allocation; commitment-threshold/action-release authority; provenance/source tagging; agency attribution; residue/consequence persistence; goal/salience/incentive coupling; self-other coupling; offline integration/replay; social-contagion/cross-agent coupling; global instability). Named clinical syndromes are emergent clusters -- weighted combinations -- over these axes, not primitive natural kinds; comorbidity is overlapping axis activation and pleiotropy is one mechanism loading multiple axes. The axis layer is an INDEXING layer, never a merging layer: it does not collapse mechanistically-distinct failure modes into one another.

Permeability pathology and source-fidelity loss: the same selective permeability that enables cultural learning (MECH-542) necessarily creates its failure modes, and this is NOT an accidental weakness but plausibly the unavoidable price of a system that can learn from counterfactual experience -- a fully impermeable hypothetical system learns nothing from imagination, a fully permeable one cannot distinguish imagination from reality, and the useful system lies between. Predicted routes: repeated fictional trajectories distorting perceived likelihood; emotionally powerful narratives acquiring inappropriate precision; propaganda altering other-agent models without adequate evidence; humour gradually reducing the effective cost of previously prohibited representations; imagined threats modifying expectations of groups never directly encountered; cultural availability mistaken for environmental frequency. REGISTERED SIGNATURE -- SOURCE-FIDELITY LOSS: source information becomes less reliable while narrative structure is retained, producing characteristic errors in which retained narrative becomes progressively harder to distinguish from experienced or testified information; the underlying mechanism (stored-tag decay vs reconstructed-at-retrieval misattribution, per Johnson, Hashtroudi and Lindsay 1993) is left open pending the D6 discriminating test. The architectural requirement is therefore NOT to prevent hypothetical material from influencing cognition, but to keep the KIND and MAGNITUDE of update appropriate to the epistemic status of the representation.

Cross-model super-additivity: integrating predictive models over a shared latent yields capability gains that EXCEED the sum of the isolated models, because shared features let each model's prediction-error corrections propagate to the others. Integrated (E1 world-model + E2 affordance-model [+ object spine]) beats a param/compute-matched bag of isolated modules -- the 'cross-pollination turbo-charges development' claim, made falsifiable.

Substrate-independent cognifold primitives: REE specifies its single cognifold (one interacting state-space, not a modular stack) in a hardware-neutral primitive vocabulary -- persistent state, history-dependent deformation, multi-timescale field dynamics, oscillatory propagation, stochastic transition, attractor transitions, residue-as-deformation-of-the-future-action-landscape, commitment as a real boundary between simulated and released action, and offline reintegration -- so that any FUTURE physical substrate is evaluated by whether it can INSTANTIATE these dynamics, not merely execute modular software. The primitives remain software-expressible now while also being legible as future physical-substrate affordances.

created_claims.title: Cognifold versus braidling: at what point does invariant-preserving translation between cognitive systems constitute INTERNAL cognition (one cognifold) rather than communication between agents (a braidling)? Proposed discriminator, conceptual not yet formal: two systems form a BRAIDLING if each remains an independently coherent cognitive entity when communication is severed, however effective their coordination while joined; they are parts of ONE COGNIFOLD if their normal cognition depends on invariant-preserving transformations across the boundary and they jointly maintain one persistent self / world structure, so that severance degrades coherence on both sides rather than merely coordination. Does the cognitive contract (ARC-142) operationalise this -- through contract-dimension dependency, MECH-538 bridge complexity, or a severance assay -- and does the resulting criterion place REE's E1 / E2 / E3 / hippocampus on the cognifold side while placing two communicating REE agents on the braidling side?

hub_targets.title: world_goal_evaluator_bounded_by_z_world_differentiation

Candidate REE loci: z_world -> E1 versus z_world -> E2 (different read surfaces of one sender), E1 <-> E2 conditioned on the candidate action / horizon under evaluation, hippocampal retrieval -> consumer conditioned on the consumer's present query state, ContextMemory -> downstream reader expressed relative to current context rather than injected as a fixed latent message, and waking versus offline interfaces using different receiver-conditioned geometry.

created_claims.title: Recurrent interface stability: an interface can be statically useful yet recurrently unstable -- a bridge with one-step utility > 0 can fail repeated closed-loop application, and REE traverses most interfaces repeatedly over trajectories, episodes and recurrent prediction loops. Two mechanisms, to be distinguished experimentally: (a) OFF-MANIFOLD COMPOUNDING -- a bridge trained on native receiver states emits a slightly off-distribution receiver state, the next application treats it as ordinary input, and B_0 -> T(A_0,B_0) = B_1' -> T(A_1,B_1') = B_2' accumulates displacement into a regime the bridge never saw; (b) SEMANTIC DOUBLE-COUNTING -- content already injected is not recognised as present and is re-amplified, escalating gain. Design corollary: CUMULATIVE translation (each step operates on the previously translated receiver state) versus CLEAN-BASE translation (each step computed against an unmodified native receiver state, the residual held as a temporary gated overlay) -- translated information should first be tested as an overlay or gated read surface, never as an irreversible rewrite of the receiver's core latent state. Adds an EIGHTH rung to INV-105's ladder, RECURRENTLY STABLE: repeated use preserves receiver-state validity, information calibration and functional behaviour over the timescale the system actually uses the interface -- assessed BEFORE behavioural usefulness is read as architecturally meaningful in a dynamical system. Sleep corollary for MECH-540: offline interface recalibration must improve or preserve closed-loop stability when waking dynamics resume; a sleep-induced change that improves a static probe but destabilises the next waking trajectory is a failure, not consolidation. Signatures: one-step rescue + cumulative collapse + clean-base stability = recurrent interface instability; cumulative stability + correct-pair specificity = a functionally coherent recurrent bridge; both fixed and conditioned bridges failing while richer source information succeeds = upstream representation deficiency remains more likely.

hub_targets.title: The latent-access evidence ladder: a variable's status in a latent space is not one property but seven, which must never be collapsed -- encoded (statistically present) != decodable (recoverable by an external probe) != natively accessible (usable by the system's existing consumer) != bridgeable (usable through a constrained map between frozen endpoints) != pairing-specific (useful specifically when the correct sender state is paired with the correct receiver situation) != causally used (interventions on its content alter downstream computation) != behaviourally beneficial (that causal use improves adaptive performance). Two evidential consequences bind rather than advise: (1) a content-transmission claim about any internal channel or bridge REQUIRES correct-vs-mismatched-vs-zero-vs-moment-matched-random controls, because a channel can be strongly load-bearing while its example-specific content is barely load-bearing; (2) a null measured on a COMPRESSED representation requires a dimensionality-matched RANDOM-PROJECTION floor, not a zero floor, before it can be read as information loss.

Integration does not require representational sameness, it requires selective mutual legibility: specialised cognitive subsystems may preserve distinct high-dimensional PRIVATE internal representations while coordinating through low-dimensional, context-sensitive communication subspaces and low-complexity transformations, so development can raise local specialisation and cross-system legibility AT THE SAME TIME rather than trading one against the other. Non-redundant prediction: a maturing REE shows rising local competence in E1/E2/hippocampus/E3 while GLOBAL representational similarity between them stays flat or falls, and increasing representational similarity between subsystems must therefore NOT be used as the default marker of maturation. This is an explicit ALTERNATIVE framing to ARC-121's shared epistemic-state object, not a refutation of it: one common object, specialised objects with a shared interface format, specialised objects joined by context-specific translation, and a hybrid invariant-core-plus-private-dimensions architecture all remain live, and ARC-121 must not be used to prejudge the question.

Communication-subspace routing failure -- encoded but not exposed: a task variable can be strongly encoded in the FULL sender latent while being weakly represented in the CONSUMER-FACING subspace, producing the phenotype `external probe succeeds -> native behaviour fails` with no information having been destroyed. This is a third failure category strictly between 'information absent from the sender' and 'information used by the receiver', and it is distinct from MECH-517 (the decoder collapses) and MECH-532 (the compression site has no trained decompression stage): routing failure requires neither a collapse nor a missing readout, because the consumer can be reading a perfectly healthy low-rank subspace that simply does not carry the distinction. Operationalised by cross-validated Reduced Rank Regression from sender activity to the ACTUAL consumer input tensor, comparing task decodability in the full sender, inside the estimated communication subspace, and in its orthogonal complement; the diagnostic signature is `target decodable from X` but `poorly decodable from P_comm X`.

Matched-auxiliary-control and scaffold-removal admissibility rule: a result is admissible as evidence that a representation objective (auxiliary head, anchoring target, contrastive shaping, any added loss) ORGANISES a latent in a specific way -- rather than that extra supervision helps -- only if obtained against BOTH (1) a matched arbitrary-auxiliary control (same head capacity, loss budget, update frequency and training examples; target with learnable but organism-irrelevant structure; any entropy/difficulty mismatch REPORTED, never silently accepted) and (2) an evaluation with the auxiliary head removed, scored on downstream organism-level measures (rollout at consequential transitions, behavioural competence, transfer when consequences change but sensory statistics do not, counterfactual separability, perturbation recovery), never on the objective's own probe accuracy or loss; in its offline-mechanism form, a durable sleep/replay/compression mechanism is adopted only on held-out causal attribution, intervention choice, transfer or calibration, never on training loss or replay reconstruction.

Dynamic interface compatibility: between PREDICTIVE systems, pointwise state correspondence across an interface is insufficient -- a mapping must additionally satisfy that receiver_transition(T(x_t), a_t) is compatible with T(x_(t+1)) under the relevant action/context, because a bridge can succeed pointwise while destroying transition geometry. The registered diagnostic separation is: map ONLY the initial state and let the receiver evolve natively, versus repeatedly mapping sender rollout states -- this distinguishes a bridge that supplies a compatible starting condition from one that must continually correct incompatible dynamics. Failure signature `good static + bad dynamic` routes to transition-geometry work rather than to representation work; `good one-step + degrading long-horizon` indicates compounding dynamics mismatch; `good dynamic but poor behaviour` routes downstream to valuation/selection.

Minimum bridge complexity as the measure of mutual legibility: for systems A and B and a family of constrained mappings of increasing expressiveness (native readout -> orthogonal/Procrustes -> affine -> low-rank affine -> constrained nonlinear -> high-capacity upper bound), define L(A -> B) = the minimum bridge complexity achieving a predeclared HELD-OUT functional criterion between FROZEN endpoints; lower L means greater mutual legibility, and the simpler the bridge that works the stronger the evidence that the sender already held an appropriately structured representation -- a high-capacity bridge that succeeds may be performing new cognition and is therefore evidence about the bridge, not about the endpoints. L must never be read alone: two systems that became identical because one LOST its specialisation would show falling L with worsening cognition, so development is tracked on two axes (local specialisation/competence, and cross-system legibility). Non-redundant developmental prediction: sender and receiver each improve local competence WHILE global representational similarity stays flat or falls, task information concentrates in the consumer-facing subspace, and minimum bridge rank falls -- coordination without homogenisation.

The cognitive contract: a unified mind built from heterogeneous engines (E1 / E2 / E3 / hippocampus and later specialists, differing in representational geometry, temporal scale, compression level, learning dynamics and uncertainty representation) requires not a common latent space but an INVARIANT-PRESERVING CONTRACT -- a small set of relations I such that for any lossy translation x_A -> C_A(x_A) -> T_AB -> D_B -> x'_B, I(x_A) ~ I(x'_B), even though x'_B = x_A is meaningless across different spaces. The contract is relational / semantic, not representational: each engine may encode an invariant differently (explicit scalar, trajectory position, recurrent-state relation, geometric direction, ordering relation) so long as the relation is recoverable at the boundary when needed. It sits ABOVE the translation machinery and ABOVE schemas (cognitive contract -> representation / translation machinery -> schemas -> particular concepts, memories and environmental models): a schema rewrite, including offline reorganisation during sleep, changes WHAT the organism knows; contract failure changes WHETHER its subsystems can still understand one another. The contract specifies RECOVERABLE RELATIONSHIPS, never a fixed data structure or ontology -- engines encode invariants differently, new representational systems can be added, schemas reorganise, and contract dimensions may be added or retired. Its two failure poles are representation collapse (one canonical latent forced on every engine, destroying the specialisation that makes multiple engines useful) and cognitive fragmentation (engines keep exchanging tensors while progressively losing shared meaning -- computationally active, no longer one mind). Unity does not require representational sameness; it requires preservation of the relations that keep representations about the same cognitive world.

Sleep as selective interface maintenance -- the third offline job: MECH-529 gives offline consolidation two functions, revising the representation (split/merge/reweight over equivalence classes) and re-indexing episodic traces so autobiographical addressability survives that revision. This claim adds a THIRD: adjusting or stabilising the INTERFACE -- the subspace through which another subsystem reads the revised representation. The prediction is explicitly NOT global alignment but a PLASTICITY/STABILITY DIVISION OF LABOUR across interfaces: some reconfigure because recent learning demands it, others remain stable because downstream continuity matters more, so the strongest test compares at least TWO interfaces with different predicted plasticity rather than asking whether all systems become more similar after sleep. Four distinguishable post-sleep signatures: S1 representational retuning (interface metrics move only because the sender moved), S2 interface recalibration (local competence stable, communication subspace or bridge complexity improves), S3 stable scaffold (representations move, mapping holds), S4 maladaptive homogenisation (similarity rises while local competence or task-specific differentiation worsens).

hub_targets.title: Language is a symbolic mediation and coordination layer.

Cognitive-contract invariant admissibility rule: a candidate contract invariant (ARC-142) acquires ARCHITECTURAL standing only by consilience -- independent support from at least two of six evidence domains: (1) cross-linguistic typology (recurrent, obligatorily encoded across unrelated languages), (2) pre-linguistic developmental cognition (present before language or explicit instruction), (3) neuroscience (modality- or subsystem-independent representation, or a known translation mechanism that retains it), (4) comparative cognition (present in species with different sensory / behavioural ecologies), (5) independently trained artificial agents (discovered without being specified; removal produces characteristic failure), and (6) REE-internal necessity (an engine boundary that cannot learn or translate around it). Every candidate must be CLASSIFIED architectural / embodied-ecological / human-linguistic-convention / uncertain, with the alternative explanation (embodiment, culture, task structure) recorded. Cross-linguistic universality ALONE is inadmissible as architectural evidence: shared bodies, sensory systems, ecology and phylogeny explain human universals without cognitive universality. Developmental precedence -- required before substantial learning can occur -- is the strongest single-domain signal. A negative finding (an apparently fundamental invariant shown unnecessary, or translatable-around) is a first-class preserved result, not a discard. The contract must be DERIVED INDEPENDENTLY of REE_assembly's own claims / evidence / provenance / dependency invariant machinery (docs/architecture/invariant_types.md, claim_evidence) -- deriving it from that machinery is circular -- and any structural convergence between the two is logged as an empirical clue under GOV-ANALOGY-1, never assumed. Language emerges as functional self-representation, not a bolt-on.
Language is a high-bandwidth externalization of pre-existing functional states, not a separate cognitive system; the language bootstrap requires functional states as referents.
Language emergence and bootstrapping dynamics.

Language is an INTERFACE to reasoning, not its substrate: reasoning-like behaviour emerging from language alone (LLMs) does not establish language as the native substrate of reasoning. Language functions as compression, communication, coordination, long-horizon scaffolding, working-memory support and explanation -- and may COMPENSATE for weaknesses in other reasoning systems.

Language bootstraps from a grounded social ecology, not from grammar: given shared attention, partial observability, coordination pressure, a low-cost channel, and repair, proto-language partially bootstraps from grounded proto-communication. The grammar/LLM scaffold is a turbocharger, never the engine -- the engine is the V5 social ecology.

Grammar/LLM primitive-mining (not import) commitment: grammatical structure and LLMs are MINED for candidate pre-linguistic primitive cuts, never imported as architecture. A mined cut is grounded only if it changes perception, attention, action, memory, rule-availability, or coordination in the substrate. No imported transformer block; no LLM as authority.

created_claims.title: Grammar inherits the cognitive contract: some grammar-like relational structure -- agency / role marking, tense and aspect, modality and evidentiality, negation, reference and number, causation and conditionals -- emerges in a communication channel because external transmission between minds inherits the same relations that internal translation between engines must already preserve (ARC-142). Chain: cognitive invariants -> internal representational contracts -> repeated compression / translation pressure -> proto-grammatical relational structure -> external language. Two-directional test: (a) invariants derived from cognition or REE-internal necessity should be over-represented among recurrently grammaticalised distinctions; (b) recurrently grammaticalised distinctions lacking developmental, comparative or computational support should classify as embodied or cultural, not contract. Prediction: agents required to transmit invariant-rich cognitive states efficiently over a low-cost channel develop grammar-like structure for exactly the contract relations and not for schema content; agreement across (a) and (b) is the evidence, either direction alone is not.

hub_targets.title: The system maintains a functional distinction between simulation-mode content and real-experience content, such that simulation content does not accumulate in the viability map as committed experience; failures of this distinction produce confabulation (simulated events encoded as real).

Object identity is a cross-cutting representational primitive. An object is a token-bound identity representation that persists across time and perceptual gaps, generalising z_object/z_resource into an object-file/binding layer (ARC-006), defined by causal feature-coherence under intervention (MECH-278), and consumed by drive/goal (SD-057), hippocampal planning (MECH-262), and the self/other special-object cases. The four planned object capabilities -- (1) permanence, (2) self-as-object, (3) tools/affordances, (4) others-as-object -- are specialisations of one primitive, not four separate mechanisms.

Self-attribution is implemented by a forward-model comparator: for any reafferent latent stream z_x with an efference-copy-driven forward model E2_x, the residual (z_x_observed - E2_x(z_x_{t-1}, a_actual)) is the agency signal on that stream.

Provenance-bearing one-way commit-status gate (V3 half of the 2026-09-24 split): imagined / simulated event representations carry an explicit committed_vs_imagined provenance label, and a ONE-WAY gate ensures they can be used for planning without ever acquiring committed-history status -- the reality-status signature MECH-545's contract-lesion assay targets. Scope: the label and gate on the event representations V3 already carries; the full unified-store event-token schema is MECH-365a (v4, on ARC-085).

A REE state must not be defined purely by sensory appearance; two perceptually identical situations that differ in temporal position, active commitment, goal/antigoal relation, social context, or operative constraints constitute distinct states.

Diagnostic interventions used to localise a broken causal edge must be classified along two independent dimensions rather than one flat implemented/not-implemented judgment. (1) EPISTEMIC CONTENT: an ORACLE intervention imports privileged, target-correct information or competence under investigation (establishing achievable ceilings and downstream usability, as a positive control / ceiling test) versus a NON-ORACLE injection that perturbs a suspected causal variable without supplying the task's answer (establishing causal sensitivity/identification). (2) CONSTRUCTION: a SILKY intervention is a minimally disruptive, distribution-preserving perturbation of one suspected variable (diagnostic for threshold, scale, and timing failures) versus an ODDLY COMPOSED intervention that deliberately combines individually-plausible states that rarely co-occur naturally (a stress test for shortcut-dependence, hidden conjunctions, and factorisation, not evidence of ordinary competence). These axes are orthogonal -- a silky nudge can still be oracle-informed, and an oddly composed state can be wholly non-oracular -- and must not be collapsed into one enum. Provenance (which stage/variable/relation was altered, along both axes) must be recorded, and any effect demonstrated only under such an intervention must be attributed to that intervention condition, never silently treated as endogenous REE competence.

Compensatory realizability -- recovery without restoration: an adaptive organism should not be REQUIRED to recover by reconstructing its former internal state; the target property is the capacity to preserve or recover a useful function by REORGANIZING CAUSAL RESPONSIBILITY across internal processes rather than returning to one canonical implementation. Operational criterion: after perturbation, recovered behaviour must be accompanied by a demonstrably ALTERED DISTRIBUTION OF CAUSAL IMPORTANCE, not a hidden reconstruction of the original pathway -- evidenced by the original route remaining observably impaired, a different internal process becoming NECESSARY (selective re-ablation removes the recovered competence), and later restoration of the original route producing competition/redundancy/reorganisation rather than revealing it had silently returned. Requires a four-arm design -- no-intervention, restorative-normalization analogue, compensatory-amplification analogue (lesion left in place, the recruited substitute selectively strengthened), and a CONTROL-AMPLIFICATION arm strengthening a comparably sized non-compensatory process -- because without the fourth arm 'generic added capacity' is an unexcluded explanation of any recovery.

REE's failure-mode taxonomy is indexed on TWO axes simultaneously: (1) named failure mode (the existing mechanistically-distinct entries -- psychosis/hypothesis-tag loss, confabulation, derealization, OCD, depressive attractor, catatonia subtypes, etc.) AND (2) a finite, named set of cross-cutting LATENT VULNERABILITY AXES that span the named entries (precision/confidence allocation; commitment-threshold/action-release authority; provenance/source tagging; agency attribution; residue/consequence persistence; goal/salience/incentive coupling; self-other coupling; offline integration/replay; social-contagion/cross-agent coupling; global instability). Named clinical syndromes are emergent clusters -- weighted combinations -- over these axes, not primitive natural kinds; comorbidity is overlapping axis activation and pleiotropy is one mechanism loading multiple axes. The axis layer is an INDEXING layer, never a merging layer: it does not collapse mechanistically-distinct failure modes into one another.

MECH-094's hypothesis tag is realized as differential downstream routing of hippocampal replay, not as a source-side boolean. Anchored replay (trusted starting state, MECH-269) preferentially reaches subiculum -> entorhinal deep layers -> neocortex (E1 consolidation) and lateral PFC (SD-033a viability map); probe replay (low-verisimilitude seed, strengthened tag) preferentially reaches BLA (affective tagging without consolidation) and NAc (curiosity / novelty scaffolding). Tag loss presents as probe content reaching consolidation destinations it should not reach -- an auditable confabulatory-planning signature distinct from psychosis or hallucination.

created_claims.title: Contract-lesion assays: the decisive test of a candidate cognitive-contract invariant (ARC-142) is not its presence in successful cognition but a BOUNDARY LESION -- a translation between two engines that preserves content but deletes one relation -- producing a predicted, invariant-specific fragmentation signature. Five pre-registered signatures: IDENTITY lesion (two representations cannot determine whether they concern the same entity) -> broken persistence, duplicated selves / objects, incoherent credit assignment, unstable memory integration; TEMPORAL lesion (content without temporal relation) -> cause / effect inversion, present-state vs anticipated-state confusion, confused planning, memory / prediction contamination; REALITY-STATUS lesion (observed, remembered, simulated and counterfactual states indistinct across the boundary) -> confabulation-like behaviour, false commitment to imagined states, impaired counterfactual learning, psychosis-like representational error; AGENCY lesion (events representable, controllability and actor relation lost) -> poor action learning, internal / external attribution errors, impaired responsibility assignment, failure of intentional planning; CONFIDENCE lesion (content translates, uncertainty does not) -> overcommitment, under-reaction to reliable predictions, inappropriate belief updating, failure of precision-sensitive integration. Predictions: each lesion applied at ONE inter-engine boundary yields a signature distinct from the other four and from generic information loss (scored against a dimensionality-matched random-projection floor, INV-105), and an invariant whose boundary lesion produces NO reproducible deficit is struck from the contract, with the negative result preserved (GOV-CONTRACT-1).

hub_targets.title: Multi-dimensional provenance source vector: an event token's provenance is a SOURCE VECTOR over several partly-independent dimensions (perceived-vs-imagined, self-generated-vs-other-generated, source identity, temporal source, modality), not a single committed_vs_imagined bit. Provenance failures dissociate per-dimension -- the system can correctly attribute real-vs-imagined while mis-attributing who-generated-it or when -- so each dimension carries its own confidence, and the one-way committed gate applies per safety-relevant dimension rather than to a single global bit.
Imagination must be possible without belief update.

Source monitoring (frontoparietal network; Johnson-Raye tradition) is a candidate biological implementation of the simulation/real distinction required by MECH-094 -- distinguishing internally generated from externally received content at the level of memory encoding and attribution.

Culture as a distributed precommit workspace: culture functions partly as a shared precommit space in which many minds collectively generate, exchange, mutate and evaluate candidate beliefs, identities, norms and futures BEFORE those representations acquire full epistemic or behavioural commitment -- candidate trajectories need not originate within the individual organism, because another mind can construct a trajectory and transmit enough of its structure for a receiving predictive system to instantiate it. Fiction, drama, humour and science fiction are on this account not peripheral products of cognition but specialised cultural technologies for making otherwise costly regions of possibility space cognitively traversable, and the driver is that SEARCH IS MUCH CHEAPER THAN COMMITMENT. Proposed (explicitly non-universal, non-monotonic) cultural progression: unrepresentable -> representable only under protection -> hypothetically discussable -> socially negotiable -> propositionally credible -> behaviourally actionable -> committed. Science fiction is the clearest instance: externally generated long-horizon candidate trajectories reach E1/E3-like evaluation before the corresponding state has ever been directly sampled.

Source-sensitive selective permeability -- INV-011 decomposed: `imagination without belief update` must NOT be implemented as `hypothetical -> learning OFF`, because 'belief update' is too unitary a category applied literally across every representational layer. A hypothetical/fictional source should PROTECT one set of variables -- autobiographical occurrence (this happened to me), historical occurrence (this event actually occurred), source truth (the narrator's proposition describes reality), responsibility attribution (I performed this action), and responsibility-bearing residue -- while PERMITTING update of another: possibility estimates, causal expectations, representations of other agents and their possible motivations, policy repertoire, harm/benefit expectations, social contingencies, counterfactual vocabulary, and the range of trajectories available for later simulation. Three otherwise-conflated properties must be free to dissociate: REPRESENTABILITY (can this state enter the generative system at all), EPISTEMIC COMMITMENT (does the system treat it as describing the actual world), and BEHAVIOURAL COMMITMENT (has an action been selected and owned on its basis). REGISTERED FALSIFIER -- the prediction is explicitly NOT 'fiction causes no update' but 'epistemic framing determines WHICH components are authorised to update': inject semantically identical event content under different source frames (direct observation / testimony / fiction / counterfactual / prediction / joke / memory / committed experience) and measure DIFFERENTIAL change across world-state belief, source confidence, E1 expectations, E2 predictions, other-agent models, harm-benefit expectations, policy availability, hippocampal trajectory repertoire, E3 evaluation, precision allocation, residue and subsequent behaviour. created_claims.title: Permeability pathology and source-fidelity loss: the same selective permeability that enables cultural learning (MECH-542) necessarily creates its failure modes, and this is NOT an accidental weakness but plausibly the unavoidable price of a system that can learn from counterfactual experience -- a fully impermeable hypothetical system learns nothing from imagination, a fully permeable one cannot distinguish imagination from reality, and the useful system lies between. Predicted routes: repeated fictional trajectories distorting perceived likelihood; emotionally powerful narratives acquiring inappropriate precision; propaganda altering other-agent models without adequate evidence; humour gradually reducing the effective cost of previously prohibited representations; imagined threats modifying expectations of groups never directly encountered; cultural availability mistaken for environmental frequency. The architectural requirement is therefore NOT to prevent hypothetical material from influencing cognition, but to keep the KIND and MAGNITUDE of update appropriate to the epistemic status of the representation.

created_claims.title: Drama runs OWN generative machinery under another agent's boundary conditions, where fiction only simulates another's trajectory: reading about an agent primarily requires modelling its trajectory, whereas ENACTING a role may temporarily recruit parts of one's own action and social machinery under the constraints of another identity or situation. Architectural commitment: a non-trivial behavioural diversity generation pathway is upstream-of and logically prior to both rule pathways (ARC-062 top-down rule-apprehension and ARC-064 bottom-up rule-discovery). hub_targets.title: Replay-driven rebucketing: accumulated consequential-divergence evidence -- typed insufficiency signals from decision outcomes (prediction/consequence mismatch, harm or goal error, repeated veto/conflict, divergent outcomes following apparently equivalent E1 states), never category labels -- drives split / merge / feature-reweighting / relation-discovery / event-boundary-revision / abstraction-change over E1's equivalence classes, via REPLAY of non-contiguous episodes under a common evaluative frame (retrospective representation learning: later experience revises how earlier experiences are bucketed). Candidate rebucketings are COUNTERFACTUALLY tested before adoption (does representing the distinction improve predictions under relevant alternative actions and contexts?), and consequential revisions preferentially complete in a decoupled/sleep phase whose job includes RE-INDEXING episodic traces so autobiographical addressability survives the representational change -- sleep as safe maintenance of the representational coordinate system itself. E3 must not become E1's teacher: downstream selection changes the learning conditions and evidence pressure on E1, never its truth content directly (non-oracular).

Compensatory realizability -- recovery without restoration: an adaptive organism should not be REQUIRED to recover by reconstructing its former internal state; the target property is the capacity to preserve or recover a useful function by REORGANIZING CAUSAL RESPONSIBILITY across internal processes rather than returning to one canonical implementation. Operational criterion: after perturbation, recovered behaviour must be accompanied by a demonstrably ALTERED DISTRIBUTION OF CAUSAL IMPORTANCE, not a hidden reconstruction of the original pathway -- evidenced by the original route remaining observably impaired, a different internal process becoming NECESSARY (selective re-ablation removes the recovered competence), and later restoration of the original route producing competition/redundancy/reorganisation rather than revealing it had silently returned. Requires a four-arm design -- no-intervention, restorative-normalization analogue, compensatory-amplification analogue (lesion left in place, the recruited substitute selectively strengthened), and a CONTROL-AMPLIFICATION arm strengthening a comparably sized non-compensatory process -- because without the fourth arm 'generic added capacity' is an unexcluded explanation of any recovery.

created_claims.title: Maladaptive over-stabilized compensation as a distinct pathology mechanism: pathology may arise not only because an original mechanism is damaged, but because an ADAPTATION TO that damage becomes over-stabilized -- a workaround that was initially adaptive becomes over-strengthened, over-generalized or too persistent, trapping the organism in a distorted solution after the original problem has changed or resolved. Predicted routes: the compensatory pathway acquires excessive precision or gain, dominates ambiguous perception, becomes resistant to counterfactual correction, persists after the initiating lesion resolves, recruits memory and sleep processes that progressively stabilise the workaround, or reduces flexibility by making one emergency solution the default policy. REGISTERED DETECTION SIGNATURE: improved LOCAL performance accompanied by POORER generalization, flexibility, calibration or counterfactual revision -- a compensation that improves everything is not this failure mode. Diagnostic is hysteresis: the compensatory solution persisting even after the original route is restored.

hub_targets.title: Integration does not require representational sameness, it requires selective mutual legibility: specialised cognitive subsystems may preserve distinct high-dimensional PRIVATE internal representations while coordinating through low-dimensional, context-sensitive communication subspaces and low-complexity transformations, so development can raise local specialisation and cross-system legibility AT THE SAME TIME rather than trading one against the other. Non-redundant prediction: a maturing REE shows rising local competence in E1/E2/hippocampus/E3 while GLOBAL representational similarity between them stays flat or falls, and increasing representational similarity between subsystems must therefore NOT be used as the default marker of maturation. This is an explicit ALTERNATIVE framing to ARC-121's shared epistemic-state object, not a refutation of it: one common object, specialised objects with a shared interface format, specialised objects joined by context-specific translation, and a hybrid invariant-core-plus-private-dimensions architecture all remain live, and ARC-121 must not be used to prejudge the question.

Communication-subspace routing failure -- encoded but not exposed: a task variable can be strongly encoded in the FULL sender latent while being weakly represented in the CONSUMER-FACING subspace, producing the phenotype `external probe succeeds -> native behaviour fails` with no information having been destroyed. This is a third failure category strictly between 'information absent from the sender' and 'information used by the receiver', and it is distinct from MECH-517 (the decoder collapses) and MECH-532 (the compression site has no trained decompression stage): routing failure requires neither a collapse nor a missing readout, because the consumer can be reading a perfectly healthy low-rank subspace that simply does not carry the distinction. Operationalised by cross-validated Reduced Rank Regression from sender activity to the ACTUAL consumer input tensor, comparing task decodability in the full sender, inside the estimated communication subspace, and in its orthogonal complement; the diagnostic signature is `target decodable from X` but `poorly decodable from P_comm X`.

Minimum bridge complexity as the measure of mutual legibility: for systems A and B and a family of constrained mappings of increasing expressiveness (native readout -> orthogonal/Procrustes -> affine -> low-rank affine -> constrained nonlinear -> high-capacity upper bound), define L(A -> B) = the minimum bridge complexity achieving a predeclared HELD-OUT functional criterion between FROZEN endpoints; lower L means greater mutual legibility, and the simpler the bridge that works the stronger the evidence that the sender already held an appropriately structured representation -- a high-capacity bridge that succeeds may be performing new cognition and is therefore evidence about the bridge, not about the endpoints. L must never be read alone: two systems that became identical because one LOST its specialisation would show falling L with worsening cognition, so development is tracked on two axes (local specialisation/competence, and cross-system legibility). Non-redundant developmental prediction: sender and receiver each improve local competence WHILE global representational similarity stays flat or falls, task information concentrates in the consumer-facing subspace, and minimum bridge rank falls -- coordination without homogenisation.

created_claims.title: Sleep as selective interface maintenance -- the third offline job: MECH-529 gives offline consolidation two functions, revising the representation (split/merge/reweight over equivalence classes) and re-indexing episodic traces so autobiographical addressability survives that revision. This claim adds a THIRD: adjusting or stabilising the INTERFACE -- the subspace through which another subsystem reads the revised representation. The prediction is explicitly NOT global alignment but a PLASTICITY/STABILITY DIVISION OF LABOUR across interfaces: some reconfigure because recent learning demands it, others remain stable because downstream continuity matters more, so the strongest test compares at least TWO interfaces with different predicted plasticity rather than asking whether all systems become more similar after sleep. Four distinguishable post-sleep signatures: S1 representational retuning (interface metrics move only because the sender moved), S2 interface recalibration (local competence stable, communication subspace or bridge complexity improves), S3 stable scaffold (representations move, mapping holds), S4 maladaptive homogenisation (similarity rises while local competence or task-specific differentiation worsens).

created_claims.title: Dynamic interface compatibility: between PREDICTIVE systems, pointwise state correspondence across an interface is insufficient -- a mapping must additionally satisfy that receiver_transition(T(x_t), a_t) is compatible with T(x_(t+1)) under the relevant action/context, because a bridge can succeed pointwise while destroying transition geometry. The registered diagnostic separation is: map ONLY the initial state and let the receiver evolve natively, versus repeatedly mapping sender rollout states -- this distinguishes a bridge that supplies a compatible starting condition from one that must continually correct incompatible dynamics. Failure signature `good static + bad dynamic` routes to transition-geometry work rather than to representation work; `good one-step + degrading long-horizon` indicates compounding dynamics mismatch; `good dynamic but poor behaviour` routes downstream to valuation/selection.

hub_targets.title: The latent-access evidence ladder: a variable's status in a latent space is not one property but seven, which must never be collapsed -- encoded (statistically present) != decodable (recoverable by an external probe) != natively accessible (usable by the system's existing consumer) != bridgeable (usable through a constrained map between frozen endpoints) != pairing-specific (useful specifically when the correct sender state is paired with the correct receiver situation) != causally used (interventions on its content alter downstream computation) != behaviourally beneficial (that causal use improves adaptive performance). Diagnostic interventions used to localise a broken causal edge must be classified along two independent dimensions rather than one flat implemented/not-implemented judgment. These axes are orthogonal -- a silky nudge can still be oracle-informed, and an oddly composed state can be wholly non-oracular -- and must not be collapsed into one enum.
