The cognitive contract: a unified mind built from heterogeneous engines (E1 / E2 / E3 / hippocampus and later specialists, differing in representational geometry, temporal scale, compression level, learning dynamics and uncertainty representation) requires not a common latent space but an INVARIANT-PRESERVING CONTRACT -- a small set of relations I such that for any lossy translation x_A -> C_A(x_A) -> T_AB -> D_B -> x'_B, I(x_A) ~ I(x'_B), even though x'_B = x_A is meaningless across different spaces. The contract is relational / semantic, not representational: each engine may encode an invariant differently (explicit scalar, trajectory position, recurrent-state relation, geometric direction, ordering relation) so long as the relation is recoverable at the boundary when needed. It sits ABOVE the translation machinery and ABOVE schemas (cognitive contract -> representation / translation machinery -> schemas -> particular concepts, memories and environmental models): a schema rewrite, including offline reorganisation during sleep, changes WHAT the organism knows; contract failure changes WHETHER its subsystems can still understand one another. The contract specifies RECOVERABLE RELATIONSHIPS, never a fixed data structure or ontology -- engines encode invariants differently, new representational systems can be added, schemas reorganise, and contract dimensions may be added or retired. Its two failure poles are representation collapse (one canonical latent forced on every engine, destroying the specialisation that makes multiple engines useful) and cognitive fragmentation (engines keep exchanging tensors while progressively losing shared meaning -- computationally active, no longer one mind). Unity does not require representational sameness; it requires preservation of the relations that keep representations about the same cognitive world.

REE:Assembly analogies must be LABELLED as analogies. REE (the cognitive architecture) and REE Assembly (the scientific-development and governance machinery) have strong structural parallels; any analogy between them must be marked as an analogy and must NEVER be used as evidence that REE operates the way Assembly does, or vice versa.

created_claims.title: Cognitive-contract invariant admissibility rule: a candidate contract invariant (ARC-142) acquires ARCHITECTURAL standing only by consilience -- independent support from at least two of six evidence domains: (1) cross-linguistic typology (recurrent, obligatorily encoded across unrelated languages), (2) pre-linguistic developmental cognition (present before language or explicit instruction), (3) neuroscience (modality- or subsystem-independent representation, or a known translation mechanism that retains it), (4) comparative cognition (present in species with different sensory / behavioural ecologies), (5) independently trained artificial agents (discovered without being specified; removal produces characteristic failure), and (6) REE-internal necessity (an engine boundary that cannot learn or translate around it). Every candidate must be CLASSIFIED architectural / embodied-ecological / human-linguistic-convention / uncertain, with the alternative explanation (embodiment, culture, task structure) recorded. Cross-linguistic universality ALONE is inadmissible as architectural evidence: shared bodies, sensory systems, ecology and phylogeny explain human universals without cognitive universality. Developmental precedence -- required before substantial learning can occur -- is the strongest single-domain signal. A negative finding (an apparently fundamental invariant shown unnecessary, or translatable-around) is a first-class preserved result, not a discard. The contract must be DERIVED INDEPENDENTLY of REE_assembly's own claims / evidence / provenance / dependency invariant machinery (docs/architecture/invariant_types.md, claim_evidence) -- deriving it from that machinery is circular -- and any structural convergence between the two is logged as an empirical clue under GOV-ANALOGY-1, never assumed. Each candidate carries a twelve-field evidence record (candidate, definition, linguistic, developmental, neural, comparative, artificial-agent, REE evidence, lesion prediction, alternative explanation, classification, confidence); the objective is the smallest defensible set, never the longest list.

hub_targets.title: Representational dimensionality is an OUTCOME of a developmental plasticity schedule, not an a-priori architectural constant: the number and granularity of memory buckets (ContextMemory slots, and any analogous discrete representational partition) must itself be plastic during an open window and reduce in plasticity as the encountered environment's latent structure is resolved. The INV-074 / MECH-333 / MECH-334 critical-period shape -- open window, competitive establishment, closure / crystallisation -- is currently specified ONLY over the SCORING / POLICY plane (behavioural diversity vs winner-take-all capture); this claim asserts the same schedule is required over REPRESENTATIONAL STRUCTURE. Corollary bearing on measurement: a differentiation-family objective is not merely mis-targeted (MECH-495) but ILL-DEFINED under variable dimensionality, since separation can always be increased by adding buckets, so the objective degenerates into "use more slots"; and any fixed-N spread statistic (sws_slot_diversity over 16 slots, emitted by 29 experiment drivers) presupposes the very structure that should be the outcome. Substrate state at registration: ContextMemory(num_slots=16) at ree-v3/ree_core/predictors/e1_deep.py:36 is a fixed nn.Module buffer with no growth, no allocation policy and no environment conditioning.

The crystallisation TARGET is environment-conditional, not an architectural constant: for any agent whose representational structure crystallises on a developmental schedule (MECH-496), the structure it should crystallise TO is a function of the latent structure of the environment actually encountered, not a property of the architecture. It follows that a single hand-set dimensionality is wrong in BOTH directions -- over-provisioned relative to a simple world it produces spurious SPLITTING (behaviourally equivalent situations assigned distinct buckets), under-provisioned relative to a rich one it forces MERGING (behaviourally distinct situations collapsed into one) -- and that the same REE substrate deployed in environments of materially different latent complexity requires materially different resolved structures, with no single default correct across them. This is the LOAD-BEARING form of the assertion; the weak form ("different environments need different structures") is near-tautological for any learning system and is explicitly NOT what is claimed here.

Integration does not require representational sameness, it requires selective mutual legibility: specialised cognitive subsystems may preserve distinct high-dimensional PRIVATE internal representations while coordinating through low-dimensional, context-sensitive communication subspaces and low-complexity transformations, so development can raise local specialisation and cross-system legibility AT THE SAME TIME rather than trading one against the other. Non-redundant prediction: a maturing REE shows rising local competence in E1/E2/hippocampus/E3 while GLOBAL representational similarity between them stays flat or falls, and increasing representational similarity between subsystems must therefore NOT be used as the default marker of maturation. This is an explicit ALTERNATIVE framing to ARC-121's shared epistemic-state object, not a refutation of it: one common object, specialised objects with a shared interface format, specialised objects joined by context-specific translation, and a hybrid invariant-core-plus-private-dimensions architecture all remain live, and ARC-121 must not be used to prejudge the question.

Dynamic interface compatibility: between PREDICTIVE systems, pointwise state correspondence across an interface is insufficient -- a mapping must additionally satisfy that receiver_transition(T(x_t), a_t) is compatible with T(x_(t+1)) under the relevant action/context, because a bridge can succeed pointwise while destroying transition geometry. The registered diagnostic separation is: map ONLY the initial state and let the receiver evolve natively, versus repeatedly mapping sender rollout states -- this distinguishes a bridge that supplies a compatible starting condition from one that must continually correct incompatible dynamics. Failure signature `good static + bad dynamic` routes to transition-geometry work rather than to representation work; `good one-step + degrading long-horizon` indicates compounding dynamics mismatch; `good dynamic but poor behaviour` routes downstream to valuation/selection.

Organism-relevant distinction preservation across representational compression: any compression, abstraction or consolidation step on the observation -> z_world -> E1/E2 path (and any offline schema-compression of episodes) must preserve, or leave recoverable through its dynamics, five classes of distinction consequential to the organism across time -- (1) consequence and opportunity/threat, (2) controllability and agency incl. internal-state consequence invisible in the scene, (3) persistence and temporal relation, (4) causal ancestry / intervention handles (agent identity, action class, preconditions, uncertainty over causal contribution), (5) independently evolving trajectories -- as PRESERVATION REQUIREMENTS, not latent dimensions; a step that destroys downstream access to one of them is a developmental regression regardless of reconstruction or prediction loss; auxiliary heads enforcing a class are removable SCAFFOLDS and the ontology within a class must remain free to split, merge and reweight over development.

E1's persistent context should be reframed as an explicit RECIPROCAL compression/decompression bridge, not merely a latent representation with compression left implicit inside ordinary representation learning: high-dimensional experience, autobiographical history, and body state compress into a lower-dimensional organising state z_t, and z_t decompresses into higher- dimensional predictions and candidate sensorimotor futures. Compression is what makes different high-dimensional situations become functionally equivalent when they imply sufficiently similar action-relevant consequences; decompression is what turns that summary back into usable prospective content for downstream planning.

A REE state must not be defined purely by sensory appearance; two perceptually identical situations that differ in temporal position, active commitment, goal/antigoal relation, social context, or operative constraints constitute distinct states.

Minimum bridge complexity as the measure of mutual legibility: for systems A and B and a family of constrained mappings of increasing expressiveness (native readout -> orthogonal/Procrustes -> affine -> low-rank affine -> constrained nonlinear -> high-capacity upper bound), define L(A -> B) = the minimum bridge complexity achieving a predeclared HELD-OUT functional criterion between FROZEN endpoints; lower L means greater mutual legibility, and the simpler the bridge that works the stronger the evidence that the sender already held an appropriately structured representation -- a high-capacity bridge that succeeds may be performing new cognition and is therefore evidence about the bridge, not about the endpoints. L must never be read alone: two systems that became identical because one LOST its specialisation would show falling L with worsening cognition, so development is tracked on two axes (local specialisation/competence, and cross-system legibility). Non-redundant developmental prediction: sender and receiver each improve local competence WHILE global representational similarity stays flat or falls, task information concentrates in the consumer-facing subspace, and minimum bridge rank falls -- coordination without homogenisation.

At least one of REE's designated compression sites (MECH-523) must be paired with an explicit TRAINED decompression/readout stage before representational-ceiling nulls measured there are interpretable as capacity findings -- this is the v3-testable core of MECH-507's reciprocal compression/decompression bridge, independent of the full E1 reframing MECH-507 itself remains scoped to. Two site-specific halves of this pattern already exist as registered but unvalidated/unbuilt v3 work: SD-056 (E2.world_forward trained via a contrastive divergence-preservation loss, coded 2026-05-29 in ree_core/predictors/e2_fast.py, default OFF, never re-queued for validation) supplies the decompression half at the z_world site, paired with SD-070's anti-collapse encoder-training recipe for the compression half at the same site. Separately, the P4 training-debt cluster at E2.action_object_head/O -- SD-080's zero-gradient finding, MECH-518's dual-role variance contention, MECH-517's interface-collapse ordering -- names the same repair owed at a second, independent compression site. This claim asserts the general requirement and is satisfied by confirming it at either site.

Cross-model super-additivity: integrating predictive models over a shared latent yields capability gains that EXCEED the sum of the isolated models, because shared features let each model's prediction-error corrections propagate to the others. Integrated (E1 world-model + E2 affordance-model [+ object spine]) beats a param/compute-matched bag of isolated modules -- the 'cross-pollination turbo-charges development' claim, made falsifiable.

Substrate-independent cognifold primitives: REE specifies its single cognifold (one interacting state-space, not a modular stack) in a hardware-neutral primitive vocabulary -- persistent state, history-dependent deformation, multi-timescale field dynamics, oscillatory propagation, stochastic transition, attractor transitions, residue-as-deformation-of-the-future-action-landscape, commitment as a real boundary between simulated and released action, and offline reintegration -- so that any FUTURE physical substrate is evaluated by whether it can INSTANTIATE these dynamics, not merely execute modular software. The primitives remain software-expressible now while also being legible as future physical-substrate affordances.

hub_targets.title: behavioral_diversity_generation_pathway (multi-substrate distributed: LC-NE tonic + frontopolar curiosity + striatal novelty + hippocampal trajectory sampling). Architectural commitment: a non-trivial behavioural diversity generation pathway is upstream-of and logically prior to both rule pathways (ARC-062 top-down rule-apprehension and ARC-064 bottom-up rule-discovery). Without it, neither pathway has anything to weight or cluster -- gradient descent on a parametric policy without diversity pressure collapses to the smoothest single regime, the predicted equilibrium MECH-309 identifies. The biology distributes diversity generation across at least four substrates: LC-NE tonic noise floor, frontopolar uncertainty-driven curiosity, striatal novelty bonus, and hippocampal trajectory sampling. REE registers this as a foundational architectural slot whose specific child mechanisms (MECH-313 noise-floor, MECH-314 structured-curiosity with three sub-flavours, and the MECH-315-absorbed proposal-diversity channel) are independently testable but jointly load-bearing.
Imagination must be possible without belief update.

Humour has (among several distinct functions) a societal epistemic-update function: in domains of implied threat, the comic frame acts as a low-commitment, deniable PROBE that re-opens gridlocked ('blocked-node') norm conflicts which direct assertion only entrenches -- because a joke floats a heterodox interpretation without committing anyone to it, evading the defensive counter-opposition that a bald assertion triggers.

created_claims.title: Culture as a distributed precommit workspace: culture functions partly as a shared precommit space in which many minds collectively generate, exchange, mutate and evaluate candidate beliefs, identities, norms and futures BEFORE those representations acquire full epistemic or behavioural commitment -- candidate trajectories need not originate within the individual organism, because another mind can construct a trajectory and transmit enough of its structure for a receiving predictive system to instantiate it. Fiction, drama, humour and science fiction are on this account not peripheral products of cognition but specialised cultural technologies for making otherwise costly regions of possibility space cognitively traversable, and the driver is that SEARCH IS MUCH CHEAPER THAN COMMITMENT. Proposed (explicitly non-universal, non-monotonic) cultural progression: unrepresentable -> representable only under protection -> hypothetically discussable -> socially negotiable -> propositionally credible -> behaviourally actionable -> committed. Science fiction is the clearest instance: externally generated long-horizon candidate trajectories reach E1/E3-like evaluation before the corresponding state has ever been directly sampled.

hub_targets.title: Communication-subspace routing failure -- encoded but not exposed: a task variable can be strongly encoded in the FULL sender latent while being weakly represented in the CONSUMER-FACING subspace, producing the phenotype `external probe succeeds -> native behaviour fails` with no information having been destroyed. This is a third failure category strictly between 'information absent from the sender' and 'information used by the receiver', and it is distinct from MECH-517 (the decoder collapses) and MECH-532 (the compression site has no trained decompression stage): routing failure requires neither a collapse nor a missing readout, because the consumer can be reading a perfectly healthy low-rank subspace that simply does not carry the distinction. Operationalised by cross-validated Reduced Rank Regression from sender activity to the ACTUAL consumer input tensor, comparing task decodability in the full sender, inside the estimated communication subspace, and in its orthogonal complement; the diagnostic signature is `target decodable from X` but `poorly decodable from P_comm X`.

created_claims.title: Compensatory realizability -- recovery without restoration: an adaptive organism should not be REQUIRED to recover by reconstructing its former internal state; the target property is the capacity to preserve or recover a useful function by REORGANIZING CAUSAL RESPONSIBILITY across internal processes rather than returning to one canonical implementation. Operational criterion: after perturbation, recovered behaviour must be accompanied by a demonstrably ALTERED DISTRIBUTION OF CAUSAL IMPORTANCE, not a hidden reconstruction of the original pathway -- evidenced by the original route remaining observably impaired, a different internal process becoming NECESSARY (selective re-ablation removes the recovered competence), and later restoration of the original route producing competition/redundancy/reorganisation rather than revealing it had silently returned. hub_targets.title: stochastic_noise_floor (max_entropy_policy_regularisation_LC_NE_tonic_analog). A floor-level stochastic action-selection noise that prevents complete deterministic collapse of the policy. Biological substrate: locus coeruleus tonic firing producing baseline action-selection variability (Aston-Jones & Cohen 2005 adaptive-gain model). Computational analog: max-entropy policy regularisation / SAC entropy bonus (Haarnoja et al. 2018). Distinct from MECH-260 dACC anti-recency: MECH-313 is a state-independent noise floor, while MECH-260 is a state-dependent recency penalty. Both can contribute to anti-monostrategy pressure but operate via different mechanisms; whether they collapse into a single substrate or are mutually load-bearing is open (Q-045).

Trained-enough agent substrate for read-only control-plane telemetry probes: a warmup/checkpoint stage that brings the agent to a non-degenerate E3 action-value landscape BEFORE telemetry collection begins, and records the realised per-seed saturation distribution so informative-seed yield is auditable rather than inferred. Harness-level training-regime enrichment (experiments/_lib), NOT a ree_core mechanism change.

created_claims.title: Selection-entropy headroom floor: a TONIC behavioural-variability set-point on the E3 selection softmax temperature -- a one-sided integral controller in log-temperature that raises the effective tonic temperature only as far as needed to hold realised normalized selection entropy at a floor, never lowering it below the uncoalitioned value. Where MECH-313 noise_floor adds a state-INDEPENDENT constant lift, this is the state-dependent form that survives a warmup which has made the policy confident. Without it, the SD-074 warmup drives baseline selection entropy to 0.0195-0.153 (against 0.152-0.610 on a colder agent), pinning the R5 headroom gate at its 0.02 floor and leaving a SHARPENING manipulation ~2% of the readout's range to move into, so any null is uninterpretable.

hub_targets.title: Phasic surprise-burst regulator: a toggleable, event-triggered LC-NE phasic control lever (PhasicSurpriseBurst) that fires a transient softmax-temperature burst on a prediction-error surprise spike and decays it over a few ticks, routed into the E3 select() softmax at agent.select_action() as the PHASIC complement to MECH-313 stochastic_noise_floor (tonic) on the SAME temperature channel -- the substrate that makes MECH-063 sub-claim (ii) (each control axis carries independent tonic baseline AND phasic event-burst degrees of freedom) behaviourally testable without synthetic signals. Reuses the MECH-104 volatility-surprise lit basis (Aston-Jones & Cohen 2005 phasic mode) but routes to the SELECTION softmax, NOT the ARC-016 commit/de-commit gate that carries the MECH-104 volatility_interrupt claim.

Episode-boundary continuity for the SD-069 phasic surprise-EMA baseline, plus convergence-gated event accounting: carry the baseline across episode boundaries so it reflects the agent's surprise distribution rather than the current episode's first tick, and split event counts into pre-warmup vs converged so a short-episode cell reports honestly or declares itself uninformative instead of emitting a near-zero count that a MIN-across-cells precondition treats as a real measurement. ree_core regulator change, no-op by default.
Control plane retains orthogonal tonic/phasic axes rather than collapsing into one scalar.

created_claims.title: Phasic burst refractory duty bound: the SD-069 phasic_surprise_burst envelope must be given a REFRACTORY (event firing suppressed for N waking ticks after an event, while the envelope keeps decaying -- carry-mode decay) and an EXTINCTION LEVEL (a decayed envelope snaps to exactly 0.0), so that "the burst is active" is a regulator-side predicate rather than a floor each consumer picks for itself, and so that the realised burst duty cycle is bounded BY CONSTRUCTION -- A = 1 + floor(ln(extinction_level) / ln(1 - decay)); duty <= min(1, A / (refractory_ticks + 1)) -- rather than being a function of the surprise stream. Without this the burst is re-armed by max(decayed, drive) before it can decay on a warmed agent, and the MECH-063 (ii) tonic/phasic dissociation has no separable transient to measure.

hub_targets.title: Authority field: the moment-to-moment functional conformation of L-space -- the effective directed distance / permeability / gain between representational regions, its asymmetry, persistence and decay, the compatibility of simultaneously active routes, and a local coalition's capacity to recruit wider participation -- is a STATE VARIABLE in its own right: continuous, graded, state-dependent, endogenously recruited from the organism's own prediction error, goal progress, residue and learned relevance, with its own competition and dynamics, and not identical to stored content, to the slow regulatory/neuromodulatory field, or to the final policy; falsifiable consequence: two runs with materially similar content state but different field state differ systematically in retrieval, commitment and distractor recovery, and an equally-parameterised static scalar or global gate cannot reproduce the same context-sensitive behaviour across matched tasks and seeds.

Ephaptic/oscillatory field-level coherence functions as a fast, non-synaptic CONTENT-AGGREGATION mechanism -- not merely the confidence/eligibility readout MECH-270 already covers -- synthesising distributed oscillatory information (amplitude, phase, relative phase, frequency, synchrony, cross-frequency relationships) into the temporally-coherent 'actionable now' state that seeds hippocampal proposal generation. The field need not 'understand' anything; its attraction as a mechanism is that the physical substrate may perform part of the aggregation automatically, fast enough that proposal generation is not stale by the time candidate futures are produced.
L-space is a multi-timescale latent stack.

Event-relative coordination exceeds clock-relative coordination: cross-stream alignment measured around event boundaries, commitment onset, interruption, completion and offline transitions is stronger than alignment by wall-clock timestep. If so, the boundary stream is the coordination substrate for the whole federation, not merely a detector with a consumer.

created_claims.title: Routing-only or representational field: does the trajectory of L-space's coupling/authority state (MECH-534) itself carry task-relevant relational structure -- spatial relations, sequence, recent history -- beyond the instantaneous content state it gates, or does it only set eligibility, gain and topology over content stored elsewhere, or both? Pre-registered discriminator: on the SAME stored representations, controlled for parameter count and training exposure, an instantaneous decoder over r(t) versus a trajectory decoder over r(t-k:t) plus the authority variables; the representational branch is supported only if the trajectory decoder predicts current global structure, the appropriate retrieved path, or the next committed action better.

hub_targets.title: The system maintains a functional distinction between simulation-mode content and real-experience content, such that simulation content does not accumulate in the viability map as committed experience; failures of this distinction produce confabulation (simulated events encoded as real).

Organism-level mechanism status is stage-qualified beyond ARC-120's competence-before-authority sequence: a mechanism becomes causally reachable only through an ordered audit projection of existence, representation, endogenous recruitment, local operation, competitive authority (non-zero influence is not necessarily competitive influence against the dominant arbitration term), committed throughput (survives any later selector, latch, commitment boundary, or stale-selection path), ecological consequence (the changed behaviour has a valid opportunity to matter in the environment), and retention/generalisation. Authority at one internal selection boundary does not by itself establish that authority reaches committed behaviour -- 'competence should precede authority, but authority must also demonstrate throughput.' The furthest stage actually demonstrated, not a flat implemented/not-implemented judgment, is the correct unit for recording mechanism status.

Installability is a competence dissociable from isolated component-level validation: a mechanism that passes in isolation can still fail to express itself when composed into the whole organism, because the rest of the organism changes its operating conditions (input state distribution, scale/variance of competing signals, timing and frequency of relevant events, availability of competent upstream representations, downstream action-space and commitment dynamics, post-installation learning gradients, resource/mode occupancy, and the ecology in which it must demonstrate value). A component-level PASS establishes that an operation is possible; it does not establish that the whole agent can enter the states in which the mechanism operates, that the mechanism remains competitive once other mechanisms are enabled, or that later learning will preserve it. This is dissociable from, though related to, competence RETENTION (surviving subsequent learning/time): installability additionally covers SIMULTANEOUS composition, where a competence may never appear in the full-stack agent even absent any later learning event.
Offline consolidation is protected by typed authority/write boundaries.

created_claims.title: Can REE use internally generated (imagined, replayed, or model-generated) trajectories to preserve or repair BEHAVIOURAL ACCESS -- the route by which retained predictive or procedural knowledge again reaches proposal, competitive authority, selection, fresh commitment and execution -- by updating retrieval, readout, ranking or eligibility mappings, while those trajectories remain categorically barred from acquiring the autobiographical, residue-write, realized-reward, reinforcement and direct-authority status of experienced events; and if so, what is the safe update target and what provenance rules make the separation machine-checkable rather than conventional?

hub_targets.title: REE developmental training proceeds in three ordered stages: (1) self-as-object — action-space discovery via motor experimentation, producing the substrate MECH-256's comparator requires; (2) objects-as-patterns — object-schema formation via experimental action on the world; (3) others-as-special-objects — modelling other agents as objects with their own policies. The ordering is load-bearing: without a self-model the agent cannot distinguish self-produced from world-produced sensory change; without object-schemas the agent cannot recognise other-agents as a distinguished subclass of objects. Refines the generic ARC-019 curriculum-gates claim.

V4 prerequisite cut: the V3->V4 scientific cutover is gated by qualification of the smallest transitive set of V3 capabilities/claims whose truth or functional adequacy V4 actually assumes -- each either sufficiently demonstrated or bounded-and-instrumented (known failure mode detectable and distinguishable from V4-specific effects) -- adjudicated by a dedicated cutover review, never by a global closure percentage. Version labels name organism/design generations; closure describes validation state; version membership is not inheritance, and inheritance is not closure membership. After qualification the programme legitimately occupies two states at once: V3 as validated simple reference organism, V4 as active development organism.

Bridge-organism preservation: when a version-boundary substrate expansion bundles more than one boundary capacity together, checkpoint and retain intermediate 'bridge' organism states -- each adding one boundary capacity, or one coherent capacity cluster, on top of the prior generation -- as first-class comparison artefacts, not merely as engineering scaffolding discarded once the full expansion lands. Bridge organisms need not become public release numbers; their purpose is causal isolation, so that a downstream behavioural or substrate phenotype observed after a multi-capacity transition can still be attributed to the specific capacity that produced it, the way a knock-in or mutant strain isolates one genetic change in model-organism research.

created_claims.title: Does a later-capable REE architecture's eventual social- and language-mind outcomes depend on which solitary (V3-like) and enduring-individual (V4-like) developmental regime it actually passed through before other minds became cognitively meaningful -- i.e. does ONTOGENETIC ancestry (the developmental regime actually lived through) shape later social-mind development independent of ARCHITECTURAL ancestry (which mechanisms were inherited into the larger architecture) -- such that retained lower-version developmental regimes would become machinery required to build later organisms coherently, rather than merely historical artefacts kept for comparison?

hub_targets.title: Basal-ganglia-like E3 selector constitution: committed-action selection should be governed by an explicit BG-mirroring eligibility-gating CONSTITUTION -- candidate actions pass through an eligibility mask, bounded Go (direct-pathway promotion) and No-Go (indirect-pathway suppression) pressures, a conflict-sensitive hold / threshold-raise / candidate-set widening (hyperdirect-STN), striatal-like parallel channel competition (rather than one scalar monarch), a pallidal-like permission-to-commit gate (rather than bare argmax), and a stable post-commit latch / de-commit -- so that an upstream signal's STRENGTH is necessary but not sufficient: it also needs LAWFUL ACCESS to committed action. The translation target is functional (a divergence-ledgered, falsifier-validated BG analogue), NOT anatomical mimicry.

action_learning_as_first_class_actor_critic_substrate / rpe_driven_policy_learning. Competent action learning in REE requires a DEDICATED RPE-driven actor-critic policy-learning substrate (a dorsal-striatal analog: a parameterized actor trained on a reward-error teaching signal, with a value-baseline critic), architecturally distinct from -- and NOT reducible to -- the current thin bias_head REINFORCE readout over the prediction-trained (SD-056 e2 world-forward contrastive) encoder. The V3-EXQ-724 competence autopsy localized REE's foraging wall (integrated all-ON agent forages ~0 resources/episode vs a 1.0 floor) to exactly this un-varied invariant: action is learned only as a bias on a representation trained for SENSORY PREDICTION, never as a first-class policy object trained on RETURN. 'Prediction-rich, action-poor': REE trains a substantial world model but has no dedicated action-learning system -- in brains, action learning IS a substantial learning system (O'Doherty 2004 dorsal-striatum-as-actor; Schultz 1997 dopaminergic RPE teacher), not a bias term on a prediction model.

Asymmetric mode hysteresis in SalienceCoordinator: entering an operating mode uses a different threshold on the aggregate salience vector than exiting it, and the asymmetry is mode-specific. Schmitt-trigger extension of the existing SD-032a enter-threshold logic (currently enter-only / symmetric).

Direction-blind reactive ambitendency (catatonia route III): a memoryless reactive actor reading a state representation that carries goal PROXIMITY MAGNITUDE but not goal DIRECTION produces, from one frozen policy and selected only by initial condition, either a two-cell approach/withdraw limit cycle (ambitendency: one step toward the goal, one step away, repeated) or a boundary-press fixed point (stupor); the catatonic phenotype therefore has a REPRESENTATIONAL generative route that requires no commitment gate to malfunction and no harm-stream lock, distinct from MECH-202B (gate frozen at maximum threshold) and SD-036 subtype II (harm-stream lock-in upstream of an intact gate).
Pre-commitment mode manager commits with hysteresis and switching costs.

created_claims.title: Basal-ganglia-like action persistence (a post-commit latch / commitment hysteresis) is PROTECTIVE against representational degradation rather than NECESSARY for competence: with an adequate directional representation a memoryless greedy actor forages competently with no latch at all (V3-EXQ-978 local_view_greedy anchor, 45.75 res/ep), whereas with a direction-blind representation (MECH-535) a latch abolishes the ambitendency limit cycle but yields perseveration (straight runs into the boundary) with no rise in competence. Predicted dissociating signature: adding k>=2-step action persistence to the direction-blind actor removes the two-cell cycle AND leaves resources/episode flat; a competence rise under the latch would instead indicate a gating deficit.

hub_targets.title: world_goal_evaluator_bounded_by_z_world_differentiation

action_learning_as_first_class_actor_critic_substrate / rpe_driven_policy_learning. Competent action learning in REE requires a DEDICATED RPE-driven actor-critic policy-learning substrate (a dorsal-striatal analog: a parameterized actor trained on a reward-error teaching signal, with a value-baseline critic), architecturally distinct from -- and NOT reducible to -- the current thin bias_head REINFORCE readout over the prediction-trained (SD-056 e2 world-forward contrastive) encoder. The V3-EXQ-724 competence autopsy localized REE's foraging wall (integrated all-ON agent forages ~0 resources/episode vs a 1.0 floor) to exactly this un-varied invariant: action is learned only as a bias on a representation trained for SENSORY PREDICTION, never as a first-class policy object trained on RETURN. 'Prediction-rich, action-poor': REE trains a substantial world model but has no dedicated action-learning system -- in brains, action learning IS a substantial learning system (O'Doherty 2004 dorsal-striatum-as-actor; Schultz 1997 dopaminergic RPE teacher), not a bias term on a prediction model.

PAG-analog gates the freeze response: freeze commit when z_harm_a x duration exceeds threshold; exit requires z_harm_a to fall below an exit_threshold scaled by gaba_tone; failure of exit produces sustained immobility characteristic of stuporous catatonia.

REE's failure-mode taxonomy is indexed on TWO axes simultaneously: (1) named failure mode (the existing mechanistically-distinct entries -- psychosis/hypothesis-tag loss, confabulation, derealization, OCD, depressive attractor, catatonia subtypes, etc.) AND (2) a finite, named set of cross-cutting LATENT VULNERABILITY AXES that span the named entries (precision/confidence allocation; commitment-threshold/action-release authority; provenance/source tagging; agency attribution; residue/consequence persistence; goal/salience/incentive coupling; self-other coupling; offline integration/replay; social-contagion/cross-agent coupling; global instability). Named clinical syndromes are emergent clusters -- weighted combinations -- over these axes, not primitive natural kinds; comorbidity is overlapping axis activation and pleiotropy is one mechanism loading multiple axes. The axis layer is an INDEXING layer, never a merging layer: it does not collapse mechanistically-distinct failure modes into one another.

GABAergic regulatory layer applies cross-stream exponential decay (z_harm_s, z_harm_a, z_beta) modulated by tonic gaba_tone; missing-decay regulator is the proximal substrate cause of harm-stream lock-in (catatonia subtype II) observed in V3-EXQ-471.
Commitment gate developmental failure: undertrained gate from insufficient pretend play produces either impulsivity (gate fires without evaluation) or commitment paralysis (gate never fires).

The field need not 'understand' anything; its attraction as a mechanism is that the physical substrate may perform part of the aggregation automatically, fast enough that proposal generation is not stale by the time candidate futures are produced.

Selective cognitive coalition instantiation: the control plane converts typed control demands (e.g. PROVENANCE_CHECK, COUNTERFACTUAL_EXPANSION, SOCIAL_MODEL_CHECK) into temporary functional interaction graphs over E1/E2/hippocampal/reality-coherence/social/language/affective/E3 systems, recruiting only the subsystems relevant to the discrepancy type.

Content authority (which candidate future should win commitment -- already REE's existing architecture via MECH-090/MECH-341/ARC-003) and temporal/readiness authority (whether a candidate future has become sufficiently coherent, in the cross-system field-coherence sense, for commitment to be permitted to land AT ALL) are distinct constitutional questions that may require different mechanisms. Fast cross-system field coherence (extending MECH-499's content-aggregation function) is a candidate mechanism for the readiness axis specifically -- locating the moving frontier at which a previously branching predicted future becomes sufficiently well-predicted for commitment to land -- distinct from MECH-434's evidence/posterior-driven epistemic commitment timing at the inference layer, and distinct from MECH-090's beta-gated propagation of an already-decided commit.
L-space is a multi-timescale latent stack.

Diffuse long-range competitive coupling is a generative stability requirement: stable, synergistic, hierarchical cognifold dynamics require signed competitive coupling -- specifically diffuse, long-range competition between distant fields with opposite profiles -- not merely local damping. An all-cooperative (all-positive) routed-field cognifold is unstable: every salient stream reinforces every other, producing runaway resonance / over-synchronisation / loss of modular segregation. Competition is the constructive ingredient that buys stabilisation, segregation, hierarchy, synergy, and subject-specificity.
Path authority and interruptibility via norepinephrine-like control.

Typed signed cognifold coupling: the cognifold represents inter-field coupling as a typed, signed edge -- cognifold_edge = {source, target, sign, gain, precision, gate, timescale, write_authority} -- with competition (sign < 0) as a FIRST-CLASS GENERATIVE coupling mode alongside cooperation (sign > 0) and gated-decoupling, not an emergent by-product of selection softmaxes. Three coupling modes: cooperative (binding, coherent trajectory, shared context), competitive (suppress incompatible trajectories, preserve boundaries, prevent runaway resonance, stop one field absorbing all others), gated-decoupling (isolate simulation / offline integration / unsafe candidates from release authority).

Candidate-differentiated affect vector: for proto-affect to carve behaviour it must carry per-candidate (cross-candidate) range, not merely per-tick magnitude. Each E3 candidate trajectory carries a multi-channel affect vector (curiosity / safety / harm-sensory / harm-affective / effort / relief / blocked-agency) so the same world-state can support different candidate rankings (approach / inspect / retreat / persist / retry / rest / reorient) under different internal pressures. A scalar added equally to all K candidates cannot change an argmax; only a per-candidate-differentiated contribution can.

A content class that is stored and retrievable in the REE system is not thereby active in the navigable state used for trajectory evaluation; active participation requires a preparation substrate (vmPFC-analog) that converts stored content into live state components at evaluation time.
Precision is routed and depth-specific, not global.
Control plane routes precision and modes.

created_claims.title: Authority field: the moment-to-moment functional conformation of L-space -- the effective directed distance / permeability / gain between representational regions, its asymmetry, persistence and decay, the compatibility of simultaneously active routes, and a local coalition's capacity to recruit wider participation -- is a STATE VARIABLE in its own right: continuous, graded, state-dependent, endogenously recruited from the organism's own prediction error, goal progress, residue and learned relevance, with its own competition and dynamics, and not identical to stored content, to the slow regulatory/neuromodulatory field, or to the final policy; falsifiable consequence: two runs with materially similar content state but different field state differ systematically in retrieval, commitment and distractor recovery, and an equally-parameterised static scalar or global gate cannot reproduce the same context-sensitive behaviour across matched tasks and seeds.

hub_targets.title: Sleep-consolidation priority from V_s residuals: during sleep-phase Bayesian aggregation (MECH-275) and sleep-dependent self-model aggregation (MECH-273), the order and weight of replay events is biased by the schema-staleness map produced by MECH-284. Replay is not uniform across schema and is not solely salience-driven (dopaminergic tagging); it is also prioritised by accumulated verisimilitude residuals. Schema regions with the most accumulated 'this is wrong' evidence get replayed first, more often, and with higher schema-update authority during sleep. PTSD-rumination has a clean architectural account here: MECH-285 priority loss co-occurring with MECH-094 hypothesis-tag dysfunction, locking the staleness tag from ever clearing.

REE-v3 requires a minimal sleep-phase infrastructure: an SWS-analog phase (bidirectional hippocampus-to-cortex replay for schema/slot consolidation) and a REM-analog phase (causal attribution replay for slot-filling from co-correlational evidence ordering). Without these offline phases, hippocampal attribution mapping cannot converge and context representations remain globally undifferentiated.

Installability is a competence dissociable from isolated component-level validation: a mechanism that passes in isolation can still fail to express itself when composed into the whole organism, because the rest of the organism changes its operating conditions (input state distribution, scale/variance of competing signals, timing and frequency of relevant events, availability of competent upstream representations, downstream action-space and commitment dynamics, post-installation learning gradients, resource/mode occupancy, and the ecology in which it must demonstrate value). A component-level PASS establishes that an operation is possible; it does not establish that the whole agent can enter the states in which the mechanism operates, that the mechanism remains competitive once other mechanisms are enabled, or that later learning will preserve it. This is dissociable from, though related to, competence RETENTION (surviving subsequent learning/time): installability additionally covers SIMULTANEOUS composition, where a competence may never appear in the full-stack agent even absent any later learning event.

The self-model has a waking half and a sleep half. The waking half is SD-003 (single-episode counterfactual self-attribution via E2). The sleep half is full-Bayesian aggregation of single-episode SD-003 outputs across many episodes, routed by the anchored channel to E1 and SD-033a, correcting for delayed consequences, failed counterfactuals, and systematic attribution biases. Without the sleep half, REE has an episode-local causal signature but not a durable self-model.
Quiescent E3 heartbeat cycles trigger hippocampal SWR-equivalent replay for viability map consolidation.

A pre-childhood infant stage is developmentally necessary: prior to deliberate planning, the agent must accumulate a valence map, behavioral repertoire, and harm/benefit geography through novelty-driven, sleep-dominant, damage-protected exploration.

Sleep phase architecture is regulated by three distinct drives -- circadian timing, homeostatic synaptic pressure, and a learning/model-update demand drive proportional to daily prediction error accumulation (Model Error Load, MEL) -- and only the third drive determines whether the overnight update phase is sufficient for the error burden generated during waking.

Any agent that builds a model of the world, acts in that world, and learns from experience cannot safely update its world model while using it to navigate the world; it therefore requires periodic offline phases in which action is suspended and the model is reorganised via replay and simulation -- this is not a biological contingency but a general computational necessity for model-building agents.

created_claims.title: Developmental co-maturation of offline scheduling and offline competence: the benefit of frequent early offline phases is CONDITIONAL on the maturity of the offline machinery itself, so offline FREQUENCY and offline COMPETENCE develop together and cannot be substituted for one another. Early agents may need frequent protected windows precisely because traces are fragile and representations change rapidly, while their replay selection, sequence fidelity, cross-episode aggregation, and re-indexing competence are still immature -- so adding sleep cycles to an agent whose replay content, sequencing, or write-address discrimination is degenerate produces cycles without transformation. A developmental test must therefore CROSS frequency with competence and hold apart at least seven things that are routinely conflated: sleep-cycle frequency; amount and diversity of waking content; replay coverage and sequence fidelity; ContextMemory content discrimination; transformation competence; behavioural access after waking; and a stage-appropriate ecology in which the result can be expressed. Firing many empty or degenerate cycles is not developmental consolidation, and longer observation under no_grad() is not development if no relevant learning update occurs.

hub_targets.title: z_world P0 anti-collapse encoder-training recipe: a mini-batched P0 that trains the SD-005 split-encoder world path on STATIC scene-structure targets derived from world_obs alone (hazard/resource presence + bucketed nearest-Chebyshev distance), with class-balanced CE and a VICReg-style variance/covariance anti-collapse penalty, replacing the SD-009 event-contrastive + SD-018 P0 that was measured to COLLAPSE z_world to participation ratio ~1.06 at world_dim=128. Supplies the trained encoder that SD-031 / E2WorldForward P1 and V3-EXQ-783 both require.

E2.action_object_head receives zero gradient from every REE training path, so the action-object space O that SD-004's hippocampal map backbone navigates is a frozen random projection fixed at initialisation, not the learned world-effect compression SD-004 specifies. O is state-invariant rather than consequence-structured, and the hippocampal CEM searches and refits inside it.

Interface before representation: a representation improvement is undetectable through a collapsing interface, so representation-side experiments run before the consumer interface is fixed return nulls that cannot be interpreted. This is RIVAL to the standing differentiate-first ordering (differentiate z_world per INV-088, THEN apply diversity pressure). The two give opposite readings of the same result: V3-EXQ-817a verifiably improved O's consequence structure and produced no behavioural change, which differentiate-first reads as consequence structure does not help, and this claim reads as the measurement could not have detected help.

REE's designated compression sites are systematically UNTRAINED, so representational-ceiling results measured at them are uninterpretable as capacity findings. Verified 2026-08-26 at three independent sites: (a) E2.action_object_head, SD-004's action-object bottleneck that the hippocampal CEM searches inside, receives zero gradient from every REE training path and is a frozen random projection with ~99.5% of its variance explained by the action label (SD-080); (b) the ARC-004 higher-order latent stack -- beta_encoder, theta_encoder and delta_encoder appear ZERO times in agent.py, have no loss, no optimiser and no predictive head at any horizon, and are an untrained random-projection cascade smoothed by one hardcoded shared EMA (alpha_shared = 0.3); (c) no value-shaped objective reaches any encoder at all -- compute_benefit_eval_loss reads z_world.detach() and trains only E3.benefit_eval_head. The corollary is methodological: a null measured at an untrained compression site is evidence about the absence of a training signal, not about the representation's capacity or about the sufficiency of the architecture.

One tensor, two masters: E2.action_object_head's output O is simultaneously the semantic compression (what o_t means) and the search coordinate system the hippocampal CEM samples in (ao_mean + ao_std*noise, decoded to actions), so an objective that improves the first can degrade the second by reallocating a shared fixed budget -- O's variance. Measured in V3-EXQ-817a: ao_M5_r2_explained_by_action_alone fell from ~0.995 to ~0.721, moving roughly 28 percent of O's variance out of action-coding, while the consequence-ordering metric M6 remained weak and sign-unstable (mean ~+0.12, negative on 2 of 5 seeds). O stopped being a clean action code without becoming a reliable consequence code.

E2 world-forward action-conditional divergence preservation via auxiliary InfoNCE-style contrastive loss. Substrate-level fix for the V3-EXQ-571 root cause finding (2026-05-25): with world_dim=32 and action_dim=4, action contributes ~11% of world_forward input dimensionality, and reconstruction-shaped training collapses to the state-dominated local minimum where action effect is fitted to zero. Measurement: cand_world_pairwise_dist = 0.0000 across K=8 candidates differing only in first action. Same root cause as 2026-05-17 ARC-062 GAP-B autopsy; GAP-B fix was scoped only to GatedPolicy first-action one-hot bypass. SD-056 is the architecturally-faithful generalisation -- fixes the predictor's training objective rather than bypassing the predictor at each consumer. Option (ii) lever B (contrastive next-state, Srivastava et al. 2021 style) chosen over PLSM-style MI factorisation (lever A) and SWIRL-style MI maximisation (lever C) per 2026-05-28 lit-pull SYNTHESIS verdict and user AskUserQuestion confirmation.

created_claims.title: At least one of REE's designated compression sites (MECH-523) must be paired with an explicit TRAINED decompression/readout stage before representational-ceiling nulls measured there are interpretable as capacity findings -- this is the v3-testable core of MECH-507's reciprocal compression/decompression bridge, independent of the full E1 reframing MECH-507 itself remains scoped to. Two site-specific halves of this pattern already exist as registered but unvalidated/unbuilt v3 work: SD-056 (E2.world_forward trained via a contrastive divergence-preservation loss, coded 2026-05-29 in ree_core/predictors/e2_fast.py, default OFF, never re-queued for validation) supplies the decompression half at the z_world site, paired with SD-070's anti-collapse encoder-training recipe for the compression half at the same site. Separately, the P4 training-debt cluster at E2.action_object_head/O -- SD-080's zero-gradient finding, MECH-518's dual-role variance contention, MECH-517's interface-collapse ordering -- names the same repair owed at a second, independent compression site. This claim asserts the general requirement and is satisfied by confirming it at either site.

hub_targets.title: Object identity is a cross-cutting representational primitive. An object is a token-bound identity representation that persists across time and perceptual gaps, generalising z_object/z_resource into an object-file/binding layer (ARC-006), defined by causal feature-coherence under intervention (MECH-278), and consumed by drive/goal (SD-057), hippocampal planning (MECH-262), and the self/other special-object cases. The four planned object capabilities -- (1) permanence, (2) self-as-object, (3) tools/affordances, (4) others-as-object -- are specialisations of one primitive, not four separate mechanisms.
Entities are sparse, persistent, bindable structures.

The unit of PERCEPT is a dynamic representation, not a fixed primitive: perceptual grain rescales with circumstance, so that the same scene is individuated coarsely or finely depending on demand. This is the perceptual analogue of ARC-069's already-accepted policy-side commitment, and ARC-069's rationale transfers axis-independently -- a fixed grain is either too fine (combinatorial explosion in what must be tracked and bound) or too coarse (units fail to map onto the actual state). REE has made this commitment for policy (ARC-069/070/071) and for context slots offline (MECH-166) but never for online perception, where the unit remains fixed.

policy_decomposition_on_prediction_failure (zoom-in / re-segment imagined chains when chunks fail to ground at execution resolution). Child of ARC-069 dynamic-regranularisation parent commitment. Architectural commitment: when an imagined chunk's predicted outcome diverges from what its sub-elements would predict (or when MECH-269 V_s on the chunk's region drops), the chunk is broken into finer primitives in the rollout proposal stream. Trigger: simulation-side prediction failure. Direction: zoom in. Phenomenology anchor: 'I planned go-to-the-kitchen; turns out I need to plan the steps.'

Specific modes of REE state abstraction failure -- overmerge, oversplit, temporal context loss, valence mis-tagging, uncertainty collapse, and narrow representational capacity -- produce behavioral signatures that are structurally analogous to empirically described psychiatric conditions, sharing identifiable circuit-level mechanisms.
Object-file-like buffers provide minimal entity persistence across time.

created_claims.title: A merge/split operator over the existing EntityObservation boundary must exist and be corrigible by consequence evidence, at FIXED capacity -- no dynamic per-population regulation, no settling competition. This is the minimal P0 substrate floor ARC-134 and MECH-529 both name as currently absent: `ree_core/entities/object_file_buffer.py` has no merge or split of tokens anywhere, and matching is strict 1:1 greedy over a caller-built List[EntityObservation]. Distinguished from MECH-521/MECH-522: this claim asserts only that a corrigible operator exists and responds to consequence-divergence evidence (MECH-126's overmerge/oversplit taxonomy), not that occupancy is an emergent order parameter of a settling competition, and not that capacity itself is dynamically regulated -- those remain MECH-521/522's richer, explicitly v4/v5-deferred claims.

E3's decision-outcome signals to any downstream consumer (including a future rebucketing mechanism such as MECH-529) are typed, continuous insufficiency measures -- prediction/consequence mismatch, harm/goal cost, veto/conflict magnitude and count, commit/threshold state -- never semantic category labels. This is an interface contract on E3's EXISTING output surface (SelectionResult, harm_eval/benefit_eval, last_score_diagnostics), holding independently of whether a rebucketing consumer is ever built: E3 already emits only continuous/boolean/count-typed diagnostics keyed by descriptive strings, and preserving that property is what MECH-529's non-oracularity requirement needs to continue holding as more downstream consumers are added.

hub_targets.title: E1's persistent context should be reframed as an explicit RECIPROCAL compression/decompression bridge, not merely a latent representation with compression left implicit inside ordinary representation learning: high-dimensional experience, autobiographical history, and body state compress into a lower-dimensional organising state z_t, and z_t decompresses into higher- dimensional predictions and candidate sensorimotor futures. Compression is what makes different high-dimensional situations become functionally equivalent when they imply sufficiently similar action-relevant consequences; decompression is what turns that summary back into usable prospective content for downstream planning.

E1 functions as an addressable associative manifold with internal indexing structure supporting retrieval, traversal, ordering, pattern separation, and pattern completion; parietal cortical functions (spatial mapping, associative binding, attention routing) are properties of E1 connectivity and representational geometry, not a separate module.

REE has made this commitment for policy (ARC-069/070/071) and for context slots offline (MECH-166) but never for online perception, where the unit remains fixed.

An REE attractor is best formalised as a compressed, history-conditioned GENERATIVE DISPOSITION defining a family and probability distribution over possible sensorimotor trajectories -- not a stored proposition (e.g. "this is threat") and not a fixed memory object -- whose precision controls how strongly it constrains interpretation and future generation, and into which incoming precision-weighted evidence may select, modify, or (if sufficiently consequential) remodel or displace. Its pathology separates into two independent failure axes that can co-occur but must not be conflated: EXCESSIVE PRECISION (the attractor is treated as extremely certain, strongly constraining interpretation/retrieval/generation -- the "perceptual lens" failure, where material the attractor itself generates or biases gets counted as independent confirming evidence) and EXCESSIVE COMPRESSION (too many distinct situations are collapsed into one action-relevant equivalence class, independent of how confident the system is in that collapsed class).

Perceptual slot OCCUPANCY is an emergent order parameter of a coupling-versus-lateral-inhibition settling competition, bounded above by an independently-set CAPACITY -- so capacity and occupancy are two distinct regulators rather than one. Occupancy is not read off coherence by counting related coherencies, which is circular (the relatedness criterion IS the grain decision) and ill-posed (coherence nests rather than partitions). Mechanism-agnostic about what sets the coupling constant.
E1 is the persistent predictive substrate.

Distinguished from MECH-521/MECH-522: this claim asserts only that a corrigible operator exists and responds to consequence-divergence evidence (MECH-126's overmerge/oversplit taxonomy), not that occupancy is an emergent order parameter of a settling competition, and not that capacity itself is dynamically regulated -- those remain MECH-521/522's richer, explicitly v4/v5-deferred claims.

The level of abstraction / compression depth selected when compressing experience into an attractor or context representation is a MOMENTARY, functionally consequential control variable -- too much compression overgeneralises (distinct contexts collapsed into one action-relevant class); too little compression prevents useful generalisation and leaves the system overly concrete or uncertain. This momentary compression-depth axis is separable both from prediction confidence/precision (MECH-510) and from total representational CAPACITY -- distinguished explicitly from MECH-496/INV-101's slower DEVELOPMENTAL crystallisation of bucket COUNT: MECH-496/INV-101 concern how many buckets an architecture resolves to over a training-scale critical-period schedule; this claim concerns how much a GIVEN instance of compression discards versus retains at inference time, which could vary moment to moment even under a fixed bucket count.
Hippocampal systems store and replay paths through residue-field terrain.

created_claims.title: Replay-driven rebucketing: accumulated consequential-divergence evidence -- typed insufficiency signals from decision outcomes (prediction/consequence mismatch, harm or goal error, repeated veto/conflict, divergent outcomes following apparently equivalent E1 states), never category labels -- drives split / merge / feature-reweighting / relation-discovery / event-boundary-revision / abstraction-change over E1's equivalence classes, via REPLAY of non-contiguous episodes under a common evaluative frame (retrospective representation learning: later experience revises how earlier experiences are bucketed). Candidate rebucketings are COUNTERFACTUALLY tested before adoption (does representing the distinction improve predictions under relevant alternative actions and contexts?), and consequential revisions preferentially complete in a decoupled/sleep phase whose job includes RE-INDEXING episodic traces so autobiographical addressability survives the representational change -- sleep as safe maintenance of the representational coordinate system itself. E3 must not become E1's teacher: downstream selection changes the learning conditions and evidence pressure on E1, never its truth content directly (non-oracular).

hub_targets.title: uncertainty_driven_curiosity_frontopolar_analog. A reward bonus that tracks epistemic value -- how much the agent would learn from sampling a state or action. Biological substrate: rostrolateral prefrontal exploration bonus (Daw et al. 2006 Nature). Sub-flavour of MECH-314 structured curiosity bonus. Active-inference framing: bonus equals epistemic value term in expected free energy decomposition (Friston 2010/2015).

Stage-1 specialisation of MECH-276: the agent discovers its own action space via motor experimentation (motor babbling) before self-attribution (MECH-256, single-pass forward-model comparator; supersedes SD-003, 2026-04-18) is well-formed. The agent performs motor acts and observes which sensory changes covary with them; the output is the substrate MECH-256 requires -- a set of actions the agent has reason to believe are self-initiated, so the efference copy (a_actual) fed into the comparator is genuinely self-caused rather than confabulated. Without MECH-277, the self-initiated action representation is not well-defined and MECH-256's residual signal degenerates into noise.

The infant stage requires a reward-free Phase 0 motor babbling epoch, prior to any E3 scoring or reward-weighted learning, in which Hebbian sensorimotor mappings, basic z_self structure, and non-trivial residue gradients are established.
Curiosity drive: information-seeking bias in hippocampal trajectory scoring that favors regions of higher representational density in the RBF map.
Single-pass agency attribution on the z_self (motor-proprioceptive) reafferent stream: residual = z_self_observed - E2_self(z_self_{t-1}, a_actual).

Approach behavior toward reward locations emerges from the interaction of DA-mediated representational expansion (MECH-232) and an information-seeking (curiosity) drive operating on the hippocampal map. No explicit approach gradient or wanting field is required in hippocampal terrain.

created_claims.title: Self-relative affordance uncertainty: the model under calibration is P(outcome | self-state, world-state, action), not P(outcome | world-state, action) -- E1/E2 maintain uncertainty over action consequences conditional on the CURRENT SELF-STATE, so a change in the self (growth, capability change, damage) selectively makes previously learned environmental relations uncertain again and selectively reopens exploration of the AFFECTED affordance regions without a global novelty reset.

hub_targets.title: epistemic_deficit: a persistent, target-bound accumulator representing unresolved, consequential, potentially-resolvable model inadequacy -- distinct from raw novelty (MECH-314a), raw uncertainty (MECH-314b), transient prediction error, and learning-progress (MECH-314c). Rises with unresolved importance x uncertainty x expected_resolvability x persistence; falls with verified resolution, established irrelevance, or accepted irreducibility.

uncertainty_driven_curiosity_frontopolar_analog. A reward bonus that tracks epistemic value -- how much the agent would learn from sampling a state or action. Biological substrate: rostrolateral prefrontal exploration bonus (Daw et al. 2006 Nature). Sub-flavour of MECH-314 structured curiosity bonus. Active-inference framing: bonus equals epistemic value term in expected free energy decomposition (Friston 2010/2015).

stochastic_noise_floor (max_entropy_policy_regularisation_LC_NE_tonic_analog). A floor-level stochastic action-selection noise that prevents complete deterministic collapse of the policy. Biological substrate: locus coeruleus tonic firing producing baseline action-selection variability (Aston-Jones & Cohen 2005 adaptive-gain model). Computational analog: max-entropy policy regularisation / SAC entropy bonus (Haarnoja et al. 2018). Distinct from MECH-260 dACC anti-recency: MECH-313 is a state-independent noise floor, while MECH-260 is a state-dependent recency penalty. Both can contribute to anti-monostrategy pressure but operate via different mechanisms; whether they collapse into a single substrate or are mutually load-bearing is open (Q-045).

learning_progress_curiosity_intrinsic_motivation_analog. A reward bonus that tracks the rate-of-improvement of the agent's predictive model (or any internal-state quantity); actions that produce a steepening learning curve receive a positive bonus. Most computationally instantiated in ML literature (Schmidhuber 1991, Pathak et al. 2017); least biologically anchored of the three MECH-314 sub-flavours -- no clean cellular or regional analog. Distinguishes from MECH-314a (recency-based) and MECH-314b (uncertainty-based) by tracking second-order signal (improvement rate) rather than first-order (count or uncertainty).

state_conditioned_self_annealing_noise_floor (NoisyNet learned-parametric-weight-noise analog). A mechanistic refinement of MECH-313's tonic exploration noise floor. MECH-313 is registered as a STATE-INDEPENDENT floor (a post-softmax max-entropy/temperature analog); V3-EXQ-687 found that floor NON-PROPAGATING -- the temperature was invisible to the argmax/committed action (selected_action_entropy=0.0, the r1a_entropy_only_artefact the degeneracy gate caught). MECH-440 asserts the LC-NE tonic floor must instead be injected as LEARNED PER-PARAMETER (factorised-Gaussian) WEIGHT NOISE in the E3 selection pathway, so it (i) PROPAGATES into the committed action (it changes which action is argmax, not just a discarded pre-commit temperature), (ii) is STATE-CONDITIONED by construction (weight noise x state-dependent activations perturbs different states differently, with no hand-set per-state schedule), and (iii) SELF-ANNEALS (a gradient-trained per-parameter sigma falls where the policy is confident and stays up where exploration pays, so the floor does not wash out committed-action diversity uniformly). External analog: NoisyNet (Fortunato et al. 2018).

created_claims.title: Stuckness-triggered attractor-escape exploration: a triggered, organism-level annealing analogue in which persistent CONFIDENCE-WITHOUT-RESOLUTION (settled attractor, repeated failure to reduce the active need/goal error -- natural trigger substrate: MECH-482's epistemic_deficit accumulator) transiently injects variation ABOVE the immediate-action level -- perturbing candidate trajectories, strategy proposals, retrieved attractors, goal decompositions, and the precision/authority of the currently dominant attractor, with escalating breadth under continued stuckness -- to escape a false bottom (a locally stable but persistently inadequate basin), then decays after successful resolution. Distinct from tonic or near-tie action noise: the trigger is unresolvedness, not uncertainty; two well-understood, similarly-good actions warrant NO exploration, while a high-confidence failing strategy warrants it strongly.

hub_targets.title: z_world P0 anti-collapse encoder-training recipe: a mini-batched P0 that trains the SD-005 split-encoder world path on STATIC scene-structure targets derived from world_obs alone (hazard/resource presence + bucketed nearest-Chebyshev distance), with class-balanced CE and a VICReg-style variance/covariance anti-collapse penalty, replacing the SD-009 event-contrastive + SD-018 P0 that was measured to COLLAPSE z_world to participation ratio ~1.06 at world_dim=128. Supplies the trained encoder that SD-031 / E2WorldForward P1 and V3-EXQ-783 both require.

Multi-dimensional provenance source vector: an event token's provenance is a SOURCE VECTOR over several partly-independent dimensions (perceived-vs-imagined, self-generated-vs-other-generated, source identity, temporal source, modality), not a single committed_vs_imagined bit. Provenance failures dissociate per-dimension -- the system can correctly attribute real-vs-imagined while mis-attributing who-generated-it or when -- so each dimension carries its own confidence, and the one-way committed gate applies per safety-relevant dimension rather than to a single global bit.

Representational dimensionality is an OUTCOME of a developmental plasticity schedule, not an a-priori architectural constant: the number and granularity of memory buckets (ContextMemory slots, and any analogous discrete representational partition) must itself be plastic during an open window and reduce in plasticity as the encountered environment's latent structure is resolved. The INV-074 / MECH-333 / MECH-334 critical-period shape -- open window, competitive establishment, closure / crystallisation -- is currently specified ONLY over the SCORING / POLICY plane (behavioural diversity vs winner-take-all capture); this claim asserts the same schedule is required over REPRESENTATIONAL STRUCTURE. Corollary bearing on measurement: a differentiation-family objective is not merely mis-targeted (MECH-495) but ILL-DEFINED under variable dimensionality, since separation can always be increased by adding buckets, so the objective degenerates into "use more slots"; and any fixed-N spread statistic (sws_slot_diversity over 16 slots, emitted by 29 experiment drivers) presupposes the very structure that should be the outcome. Substrate state at registration: ContextMemory(num_slots=16) at ree-v3/ree_core/predictors/e1_deep.py:36 is a fixed nn.Module buffer with no growth, no allocation policy and no environment conditioning.

Self-attribution is implemented by a forward-model comparator: for any reafferent latent stream z_x with an efference-copy-driven forward model E2_x, the residual (z_x_observed - E2_x(z_x_{t-1}, a_actual)) is the agency signal on that stream.

The crystallisation TARGET is environment-conditional, not an architectural constant: for any agent whose representational structure crystallises on a developmental schedule (MECH-496), the structure it should crystallise TO is a function of the latent structure of the environment actually encountered, not a property of the architecture. It follows that a single hand-set dimensionality is wrong in BOTH directions -- over-provisioned relative to a simple world it produces spurious SPLITTING (behaviourally equivalent situations assigned distinct buckets), under-provisioned relative to a rich one it forces MERGING (behaviourally distinct situations collapsed into one) -- and that the same REE substrate deployed in environments of materially different latent complexity requires materially different resolved structures, with no single default correct across them. This is the LOAD-BEARING form of the assertion; the weak form ("different environments need different structures") is near-tautological for any learning system and is explicitly NOT what is claimed here.

Interface before representation: a representation improvement is undetectable through a collapsing interface, so representation-side experiments run before the consumer interface is fixed return nulls that cannot be interpreted. This is RIVAL to the standing differentiate-first ordering (differentiate z_world per INV-088, THEN apply diversity pressure). The two give opposite readings of the same result: V3-EXQ-817a verifiably improved O's consequence structure and produced no behavioural change, which differentiate-first reads as consequence structure does not help, and this claim reads as the measurement could not have detected help.

A REE state must not be defined purely by sensory appearance; two perceptually identical situations that differ in temporal position, active commitment, goal/antigoal relation, social context, or operative constraints constitute distinct states.

E2 world-forward action-conditional divergence preservation via auxiliary InfoNCE-style contrastive loss. Substrate-level fix for the V3-EXQ-571 root cause finding (2026-05-25): with world_dim=32 and action_dim=4, action contributes ~11% of world_forward input dimensionality, and reconstruction-shaped training collapses to the state-dominated local minimum where action effect is fitted to zero. Measurement: cand_world_pairwise_dist = 0.0000 across K=8 candidates differing only in first action. Same root cause as 2026-05-17 ARC-062 GAP-B autopsy; GAP-B fix was scoped only to GatedPolicy first-action one-hot bypass. SD-056 is the architecturally-faithful generalisation -- fixes the predictor's training objective rather than bypassing the predictor at each consumer. Option (ii) lever B (contrastive next-state, Srivastava et al. 2021 style) chosen over PLSM-style MI factorisation (lever A) and SWIRL-style MI maximisation (lever C) per 2026-05-28 lit-pull SYNTHESIS verdict and user AskUserQuestion confirmation.

Predictive obligation is the anti-collapse constraint on a value-carved representation: a representation compressed toward selection-relevance ALONE degenerates, because value is a near-scalar projection and a pure value-carving objective admits solutions that discard everything not currently useful. Requiring the higher-order latents to remain PREDICTIVE across the ARC-004 temporal spread supplies a constraint the value objective lacks -- cross-horizon prediction demands retained state structure that value alone does not -- so the combination holds perception open where value-carving alone would collapse it.
