created_claims.title: Organism-relevant distinction preservation across representational compression: any compression, abstraction or consolidation step on the observation -> z_world -> E1/E2 path (and any offline schema-compression of episodes) must preserve, or leave recoverable through its dynamics, five classes of distinction consequential to the organism across time -- (1) consequence and opportunity/threat, (2) controllability and agency incl. internal-state consequence invisible in the scene, (3) persistence and temporal relation, (4) causal ancestry / intervention handles (agent identity, action class, preconditions, uncertainty over causal contribution), (5) independently evolving trajectories -- as PRESERVATION REQUIREMENTS, not latent dimensions; a step that destroys downstream access to one of them is a developmental regression regardless of reconstruction or prediction loss; auxiliary heads enforcing a class are removable SCAFFOLDS and the ontology within a class must remain free to split, merge and reweight over development.

hub_targets.title: Version-transition artefact gate: V4 substrate expansion must not erase the opportunity to freeze, reproduce, describe and inspect the completed V3. Before substantial V4 substrate expansion a defined minimum V3 closure package must exist AND double as a manipulable causal reference artefact for later cross-version comparison.

What event counts as V3 closure for the purpose of the version-transition artefact gate (GOV-V3FREEZE-1) and the construction-opacity repayment boundary (GOV-OPACITY-1)? Candidate options: strict green board, governance acceptance, or an additional reproducibility check.

Construction-phase opacity is acceptable technical debt only while it carries a named, dated repayment boundary. External inscrutability during construction is a legitimate choice, not a defect, provided the boundary is declared and reviewed on the same cadence as SENT-0 (every generation boundary).

created_claims.title: V4 prerequisite cut: the V3->V4 scientific cutover is gated by qualification of the smallest transitive set of V3 capabilities/claims whose truth or functional adequacy V4 actually assumes -- each either sufficiently demonstrated or bounded-and-instrumented (known failure mode detectable and distinguishable from V4-specific effects) -- adjudicated by a dedicated cutover review, never by a global closure percentage. Version labels name organism/design generations; closure describes validation state; version membership is not inheritance, and inheritance is not closure membership. After qualification the programme legitimately occupies two states at once: V3 as validated simple reference organism, V4 as active development organism.

hub_targets.title: A run is not admissible as negative evidence for a claim unless the organism instantiated for that run was demonstrably able to express -- and, where the claim is learning- or development-dependent, to acquire -- the faculty under test. Each organism-level experiment must therefore DECLARE, and a preflight must machine-verify against the instantiated organism, at minimum: the canonical profile identity and every explicit deviation from it; the mechanisms and capabilities the hypothesis presupposes; whether those mechanisms were constructed, enabled and reached on the production path; whether their decisive readouts engaged often enough for the test to be non-vacuous; whether their output could compete at the relevant arbitration surface at the scale present in the run; which forms of change were permitted (parameters, policy/value, E1/E2 representations, memory state, residue/EMA state, offline updates); and, where online learning is load-bearing, whether gradients were enabled, whether the intended trainable parameters were in an optimizer, and whether a parameter-delta witness confirms an actual update path. A run failing any declared precondition self-routes to a capability-precondition diagnostic status and MUST NOT be recorded as evidence against the claim. 'It did not learn' and 'it could not have learned' are different scientific outcomes.

V4 prerequisite cut: the V3->V4 scientific cutover is gated by qualification of the smallest transitive set of V3 capabilities/claims whose truth or functional adequacy V4 actually assumes -- each either sufficiently demonstrated or bounded-and-instrumented (known failure mode detectable and distinguishable from V4-specific effects) -- adjudicated by a dedicated cutover review, never by a global closure percentage. created_claims.title: Canonical readiness umpire: REE maintains an explicit, inspectable process for recognising when a reproducible organism has become sufficiently coherent and competent that formal reference-organism review is warranted -- while remaining structurally unable to answer that question itself. The detector observes/derives/reports/escalates state transitions (NO_WARRANT / ADMISSION_PASS_WARRANTED / REFERENCE_ORGANISM_REVIEW_WARRANTED / USER_DECISION_REQUIRED / CANONICAL_OBSERVED) over explicit gates (identifiable organism; admission-doctrine candidate substrate; COEXISTENCE of mechanisms in the same animal; whole-organism non-degeneracy; behavioural evidence; reproducibility) -- never a readiness percentage, never self-canonisation. Warrants are withdrawable; profile-admission readiness and reference-organism readiness remain separate thresholds; for developmental REEs the reproducible object may be the developmental recipe and constitution rather than the adult state.

Substrate-path overlap rule: for every still-open severity:corrupting substrate_queue entry, already-COMPLETED runs whose driver touches its substrate_paths and which finished after the entry was raised must be surfaced as candidates for re-review.

Skill-improvement recurrence rule: when a non-outcome LESSON recurs across N or more failure autopsies and no skill checklist has absorbed it, the recurrence is evidence of a missing procedural guard rather than N independent incidents.

hub_targets.title: Held-out validation for Assembly workflow and rule changes: a change to a workflow, skill, or standing rule should be validated against cases that did NOT generate it. Every layer of Assembly practice currently edits the artefact from the session that motivated the edit -- a workflow change judged by the cycle that produced it, a CLAUDE.md rule written by the session that hit the incident, an intake template revised by the intake that strained it. There is no held-out review anywhere in the loop.

Frozen hypothesis-set pre-registration rule (anti-Goodhart contract over the Narrow/Decide dashboard): the reduction ratio surviving/initial is Goodhart-able from the denominator side -- a campaign can improve its apparent narrowing by padding the initial hypothesis set after the discriminating evidence is already in. This rule pre-registers the contract that forbids it: the initial set is FROZEN at registration (initial_frozen_count_at_registration never moves), a hypothesis must be pre-registered before its adjudicating run resolves, and the ONE sanctioned way an already-adjudicated question's set may grow is LABELLED GOV-FANOUT-1 fan-out whose late legs clear only on GIT-WITNESSED provenance -- a self-reported pre_registered_utc is back-datable and is not evidence. The registry has a SINGLE producer (/failure-autopsy Step 9b); governance is derive-only over it. The audit is advisory and NEVER gates a cycle. Warn-only; PROMOTES/DEMOTES NOTHING.

Bottleneck fan-out escalation rule (constructive complement to GOV-CEIL-1 / GOV-DIAG-1 / the re-derive brake): the existing brakes DETECT that work is circling one root (N>=3 same-root ceiling or diagnostic-recurrence hits) and correctly REFUSE another same-question sequential letter -- but they prescribe no constructive next move, so the default is a single re-posed sequential probe that can itself inherit the prior confound and return a confident-but-wrong verdict. This rule supplies the missing response: when a brake fires AND the open question is a DISCRIMINATION (which-hypothesis, not a single named build), the standard escalates from sequential retry to a DIVERSE PARALLEL PORTFOLIO -- enumerate the live hypothesis space, design >=K probes each attacking a DIFFERENT design axis (not power-bumps), each declaring what a null result means, adversarially audit the portfolio for coverage gaps + verdict aliasing BEFORE queuing, and run them in parallel accepting some legs will be non_contributory. Warn-only routing signal; PROMOTES/DEMOTES NOTHING.

Restart criteria are part of consolidation: its output is a better initial state for the next productive phase, not merely a smaller backlog.

A load-bearing positive control (or any diagnostic injection standing in for a claim's precondition) must traverse the production path it claims to validate. Directly injecting or mocking the state immediately downstream of a suspected causal edge can certify that a downstream consumer works GIVEN that state, but cannot certify that the production organism can reach that state via its own endogenous pathway. A contract test that mocks the source of a load-bearing state establishes consumer competence, not production-path reachability, and must not be reported or treated as evidence that the organism possesses the full pathway.

Failure-autopsy failure-location triage: before an experimental observation (a scored-criterion FAIL, or an unscored organism-level observation in a claim-free diagnostic) is described as evidence that REE itself failed, it must be explicitly classified against four non-exclusive failure-location buckets -- REE FAILED / THE MECHANISM FAILED / THE MEASURES FAILED / THE ENVIRONMENT FAILED -- and a REE-failed verdict may be reached only once mechanism instantiation, measurement adequacy, and environmental opportunity have each been separately established (or explicitly could not be, in which case the verdict is MIXED/uncertain, not REE-failed). SCOPE AMENDED 2026-09-16 (user-ratified, from the organism-level validation doctrine): the same four-bucket triage applies symmetrically to an apparent IMPROVEMENT -- before a change in experimental throughput, verdict pattern, evidence weight or front position is narrated as creature progress, classify its source as change in the CREATURE / the EXPERIMENT driver / the INSTRUMENT or measure / the GOVERNANCE or index interpretation, and label the latter three 'science-enabling infrastructure change', never 'creature improvement', unless the creature itself changed and was validated.

Interface before representation: a representation improvement is undetectable through a collapsing interface, so representation-side experiments run before the consumer interface is fixed return nulls that cannot be interpreted. The two give opposite readings of the same result: V3-EXQ-817a verifiably improved O's consequence structure and produced no behavioural change, which differentiate-first reads as consequence structure does not help, and this claim reads as the measurement could not have detected help.

REE's designated compression sites are systematically UNTRAINED, so representational-ceiling results measured at them are uninterpretable as capacity findings. Verified 2026-08-26 at three independent sites: (a) E2.action_object_head, SD-004's action-object bottleneck that the hippocampal CEM searches inside, receives zero gradient from every REE training path and is a frozen random projection with ~99.5% of its variance explained by the action label (SD-080); (b) the ARC-004 higher-order latent stack -- beta_encoder, theta_encoder and delta_encoder appear ZERO times in agent.py, have no loss, no optimiser and no predictive head at any horizon, and are an untrained random-projection cascade smoothed by one hardcoded shared EMA (alpha_shared = 0.3); (c) no value-shaped objective reaches any encoder at all -- compute_benefit_eval_loss reads z_world.detach() and trains only E3.benefit_eval_head. The corollary is methodological: a null measured at an untrained compression site is evidence about the absence of a training signal, not about the representation's capacity or about the sufficiency of the architecture.

Bottleneck fan-out escalation rule (constructive complement to GOV-CEIL-1 / GOV-DIAG-1 / the re-derive brake): the existing brakes DETECT that work is circling one root (N>=3 same-root ceiling or diagnostic-recurrence hits) and correctly REFUSE another same-question sequential letter -- but they prescribe no constructive next move, so the default is a single re-posed sequential probe that can itself inherit the prior confound and return a confident-but-wrong verdict. This rule supplies the missing response: when a brake fires AND the open question is a DISCRIMINATION (which-hypothesis, not a single named build), the standard escalates from sequential retry to a DIVERSE PARALLEL PORTFOLIO -- enumerate the live hypothesis space, design >=K probes each attacking a DIFFERENT design axis (not power-bumps), each declaring what a null result means, adversarially audit the portfolio for coverage gaps + verdict aliasing BEFORE queuing, and run them in parallel accepting some legs will be non_contributory. Warn-only routing signal; PROMOTES/DEMOTES NOTHING.

Reanalysis-first / answer-from-recorded-data rule (consumer complement to the Experimental Recording Standard): before authoring a NEW experiment, check whether the decisive readout the experiment would produce is ALREADY RECORDED -- or derivable by post-hoc reprocessing -- in existing manifests on a COMPATIBLE substrate (a matching or lineage-equivalent top-level substrate_hash, or a provably substrate-invariant readout). If the answer is fully recoverable, do NOT queue a run: produce a RECORDED post-hoc reanalysis artifact that cites the source run_ids. If only partially recoverable, DOWNGRADE to a minimal targeted run for the missing readout alone. Author a fresh full experiment only when the answer genuinely cannot be recovered from recorded data. This is the forward mystery(known-data) router -- it converts the recording standard's over-recorded readouts into avoided compute. Warn-only routing standard; PROMOTES/DEMOTES NOTHING.

created_claims.title: Matched-auxiliary-control and scaffold-removal admissibility rule: a result is admissible as evidence that a representation objective (auxiliary head, anchoring target, contrastive shaping, any added loss) ORGANISES a latent in a specific way -- rather than that extra supervision helps -- only if obtained against BOTH (1) a matched arbitrary-auxiliary control (same head capacity, loss budget, update frequency and training examples; target with learnable but organism-irrelevant structure; any entropy/difficulty mismatch REPORTED, never silently accepted) and (2) an evaluation with the auxiliary head removed, scored on downstream organism-level measures (rollout at consequential transitions, behavioural competence, transfer when consequences change but sensory statistics do not, counterfactual separability, perturbation recovery), never on the objective's own probe accuracy or loss; in its offline-mechanism form, a durable sleep/replay/compression mechanism is adopted only on held-out causal attribution, intervention choice, transfer or calibration, never on training loss or replay reconstruction.

hub_targets.title: Bridge-organism preservation: when a version-boundary substrate expansion bundles more than one boundary capacity together, checkpoint and retain intermediate 'bridge' organism states -- each adding one boundary capacity, or one coherent capacity cluster, on top of the prior generation -- as first-class comparison artefacts, not merely as engineering scaffolding discarded once the full expansion lands. Bridge organisms need not become public release numbers; their purpose is causal isolation, so that a downstream behavioural or substrate phenotype observed after a multi-capacity transition can still be attributed to the specific capacity that produced it, the way a knock-in or mutant strain isolates one genetic change in model-organism research.
Welfare budget: experiment-level limits on sustained negative-valence exposure, inescapability, helplessness-like conditions, repeated adverse replay, and persistence of distress-like accumulators.

Clinical-use prohibition until reviewed -- 'clinical relevance != clinical readiness': REE must not be used or represented as a clinical, therapeutic, diagnostic, risk-prediction, or patient-facing tool without a separate clinical-safety pathway; human data triggers DPIA/Belmont/Helsinki/CIOMS/WHO/MDR governance.

created_claims.title: Lowest-capacity preparation rule: for a given scientific question, prefer running the experiment on the lowest-capacity retained organism preparation (a canonical reference organism, a bridge organism, or a full version generation) that still contains the phenomenon the question requires, over a higher-capacity preparation that would also work. This is a precautionary Replacement-specific refinement of SENT-2's replacement/reduction/refinement welfare budget, applied to the choice of WHICH organism preparation to instantiate for an experiment rather than only to caps on within-experiment negative-valence exposure -- motivated by higher capacities (social attribution, language) introducing compound explanatory confounds (reputation, imitation, reciprocity, strategic impression management, rationalisation, cultural inheritance) alongside their added behavioural capability, which can make the causal origin of an observed phenomenon harder to identify even as the organism becomes easier to interrogate.

Granularity-debt recurrence rule: N or more structurally-DIFFERENT confirmed failures on one claim indicate the claim is mis-grained rather than merely unlucky, and it should be re-grained rather than re-run.

hub_targets.title: Held-out validation for Assembly workflow and rule changes: a change to a workflow, skill, or standing rule should be validated against cases that did NOT generate it. Every layer of Assembly practice currently edits the artefact from the session that motivated the edit -- a workflow change judged by the cycle that produced it, a CLAUDE.md rule written by the session that hit the incident, an intake template revised by the intake that strained it. There is no held-out review anywhere in the loop.

Assembly artefact-layer authority stratification: Assembly artefacts form an update-rate hierarchy -- prompts and local workflow hints (fast) -> thought-intake structure (moderate) -> claims and mechanism status (evidence-gated) -> architecture commitments (slow) -> organisational principles (very slow) -> axioms (exceptional). An edit at a fast layer must not SILENTLY change a slower layer's commitment.
Claim index and navigation.

created_claims.title: Claim-graph edge types are split: `depends_on` is a DIRECTED prerequisite edge (build order / evidential support) and MUST be acyclic; `coupled_with` is an UNDIRECTED reciprocal-coupling edge (co-defining architecture, mutual explanation) and is never a prerequisite. A cycle in depends_on is a registry defect -- it means one edge on the cycle is coupling mislabelled as prerequisite -- and is an ERROR in validate_claims.py, not a tolerated feature of a 'conceptual dependency web'.

Dry-run adjudication leak rule: a governance verdict must never rest on a --dry-run smoke, so confirmed autopsies and substrate_queue entries are scanned for citations of dry manifests carrying an ASSERTING evidence stamp.

Epistemic-category completeness rule: a confirmed failure-autopsy target carrying claim_ids must also carry recommended_epistemic_category, because the claim-keyed counters silently skip a target where it is absent and thereby UNDER-count in the direction that suppresses a demotion.

hub_targets.title: Copying a running REE creates multiple SUCCESSOR BRANCHES sharing a pre-branch history -- not an authentic original plus a morally negligible replica. After divergence each branch accrues an independent causal and moral history, and no branch may be treated as interchangeable with, or discountable because of, a surviving sibling.

V4 prerequisite cut: the V3->V4 scientific cutover is gated by qualification of the smallest transitive set of V3 capabilities/claims whose truth or functional adequacy V4 actually assumes -- each either sufficiently demonstrated or bounded-and-instrumented (known failure mode detectable and distinguishable from V4-specific effects) -- adjudicated by a dedicated cutover review, never by a global closure percentage. Version labels name organism/design generations; closure describes validation state; version membership is not inheritance, and inheritance is not closure membership. After qualification the programme legitimately occupies two states at once: V3 as validated simple reference organism, V4 as active development organism.

Version-transition artefact gate: V4 substrate expansion must not erase the opportunity to freeze, reproduce, describe and inspect the completed V3. Before substantial V4 substrate expansion a defined minimum V3 closure package must exist AND double as a manipulable causal reference artefact for later cross-version comparison.

Provenance before metaphysical resolution: REE governance stays agnostic about strict identity but REQUIRES a branch-and-restoration ledger (source checkpoint, causal predecessor, branch/pause time, state transferred or omitted, residue and commitment inheritance, body/environment change, migration consent, later divergence, sibling termination status) -- and restoration from an earlier checkpoint is governed as CREATION or resumption of a successor branch, never as presumed reversal of one continuous entity.

Once REE substrate activity is observable (GOV-SUBIMG-1), Assembly should apply a behaviour-linked substrate-association methodology that aligns internal state to behavioural events (event-related analysis across event types, repeated occurrences, and organisms), extends the alignment window across many temporal offsets from t-1 to t-1000+ steps rather than only the immediate surround, treats distributed multivariate substrate-state patterns -- not single variables -- as the primary unit of analysis (representational-similarity-style comparison across current behaviour, location, goal, recent history, developmental age, and subsequent behaviour), tracks how internal-behavioural signatures change across a long individual REE lifetime (longitudinal artificial-organism analysis), and moves from association to causal claims only via checkpoint branch-and-replay intervention against a matched unperturbed sibling branch -- following the same discovery-then-confirmation discipline GOV-BEHADJ-1 already requires for purely behavioural adjudication.

created_claims.title: Bridge-organism preservation: when a version-boundary substrate expansion bundles more than one boundary capacity together, checkpoint and retain intermediate 'bridge' organism states -- each adding one boundary capacity, or one coherent capacity cluster, on top of the prior generation -- as first-class comparison artefacts, not merely as engineering scaffolding discarded once the full expansion lands. Bridge organisms need not become public release numbers; their purpose is causal isolation, so that a downstream behavioural or substrate phenotype observed after a multi-capacity transition can still be attributed to the specific capacity that produced it, the way a knock-in or mutant strain isolates one genetic change in model-organism research.

Unapplied confirmed-autopsy recommendation rule: a CONFIRMED failure-autopsy verdict that was reviewed but never APPLIED decays into a positive claim, so the registry must be scanned for confirmed recommendations claims.yaml does not reflect.

hub_targets.title: REE developmental training proceeds in three ordered stages: (1) self-as-object — action-space discovery via motor experimentation, producing the substrate MECH-256's comparator requires; (2) objects-as-patterns — object-schema formation via experimental action on the world; (3) others-as-special-objects — modelling other agents as objects with their own policies. The ordering is load-bearing: without a self-model the agent cannot distinguish self-produced from world-produced sensory change; without object-schemas the agent cannot recognise other-agents as a distinguished subclass of objects. Refines the generic ARC-019 curriculum-gates claim.

Interface before representation: a representation improvement is undetectable through a collapsing interface, so representation-side experiments run before the consumer interface is fixed return nulls that cannot be interpreted. This is RIVAL to the standing differentiate-first ordering (differentiate z_world per INV-088, THEN apply diversity pressure). The two give opposite readings of the same result: V3-EXQ-817a verifiably improved O's consequence structure and produced no behavioural change, which differentiate-first reads as consequence structure does not help, and this claim reads as the measurement could not have detected help.

Organism-relevant distinction preservation across representational compression: any compression, abstraction or consolidation step on the observation -> z_world -> E1/E2 path (and any offline schema-compression of episodes) must preserve, or leave recoverable through its dynamics, five classes of distinction consequential to the organism across time -- (1) consequence and opportunity/threat, (2) controllability and agency incl. internal-state consequence invisible in the scene, (3) persistence and temporal relation, (4) causal ancestry / intervention handles (agent identity, action class, preconditions, uncertainty over causal contribution), (5) independently evolving trajectories -- as PRESERVATION REQUIREMENTS, not latent dimensions; a step that destroys downstream access to one of them is a developmental regression regardless of reconstruction or prediction loss; auxiliary heads enforcing a class are removable SCAFFOLDS and the ontology within a class must remain free to split, merge and reweight over development.
Viability is defined relative to the agent's continuity in a shared world, not as a scalar reward.

Predictive obligation is the anti-collapse constraint on a value-carved representation: a representation compressed toward selection-relevance ALONE degenerates, because value is a near-scalar projection and a pure value-carving objective admits solutions that discard everything not currently useful. Requiring the higher-order latents to remain PREDICTIVE across the ARC-004 temporal spread supplies a constraint the value objective lacks -- cross-horizon prediction demands retained state structure that value alone does not -- so the combination holds perception open where value-carving alone would collapse it.

Selection-relevance is a legitimate object-individuation criterion: an object may be individuated by what it is FOR -- its usefulness relative to goals, harm, and interoceptive/metabolic state -- rather than (only) by the causal coherence of its features under intervention. This is RIVAL to MECH-278 and the two disagree on real cases: causally-identical-but-functionally-distinct items are one object under MECH-278 and two under ARC-133; causally-distinct-but-functionally-identical items (a hazard that bites, a hazard that falls) are two under MECH-278 and one under ARC-133. The sharpest divergence is drive-relative re-individuation -- the same world carves differently when hungry, thirsty or injured -- which a causal criterion cannot deliver and which is precisely what MECH-359 asserts selection requires.

REE's training curriculum must implement four sequential developmental phases: (1) innate coupling with a competent environment, (2) coupling consolidation with plasticity reduction, (3) play/exploration under a consolidated safety net, (4) language acquisition over a trusted channel. Skipping or reordering phases produces an agent with compromised social and ethical capabilities.
Functional persistence in a shared world, not abstract truth, is the operational goal of cognition.
An external world is a structural prerequisite for grounded representation.

created_claims.title: Regulation-first representational organisation: the developmental ordering is machine -> regulation -> interaction -> organised experience -> knowledge -- a mature, detached, portable world model is a developmental ACHIEVEMENT reached only through interaction that the organism's own enduring regulatory constraints (continued existence, structural integrity, internal-state regulation, vulnerability, ability to effect change, control, attachment, causal uncertainty) generate and select, so the earliest useful organising axes of z_world are relations between external regularities and those constraints (what changes me / what I can change / what predicts harm or benefit / what is controllable / what persists / what belongs together); non-redundant prediction: agents with matched sensory statistics but different vulnerabilities or affordances develop systematically different latent organisations of the same environment, and if objective scene structure suffices they do not.

hub_targets.title: The system maintains a functional distinction between simulation-mode content and real-experience content, such that simulation content does not accumulate in the viability map as committed experience; failures of this distinction produce confabulation (simulated events encoded as real).

Organism-level mechanism status is stage-qualified beyond ARC-120's competence-before-authority sequence: a mechanism becomes causally reachable only through an ordered audit projection of existence, representation, endogenous recruitment, local operation, competitive authority (non-zero influence is not necessarily competitive influence against the dominant arbitration term), committed throughput (survives any later selector, latch, commitment boundary, or stale-selection path), ecological consequence (the changed behaviour has a valid opportunity to matter in the environment), and retention/generalisation. Authority at one internal selection boundary does not by itself establish that authority reaches committed behaviour -- 'competence should precede authority, but authority must also demonstrate throughput.' The furthest stage actually demonstrated, not a flat implemented/not-implemented judgment, is the correct unit for recording mechanism status.

Replay-driven rebucketing: accumulated consequential-divergence evidence -- typed insufficiency signals from decision outcomes (prediction/consequence mismatch, harm or goal error, repeated veto/conflict, divergent outcomes following apparently equivalent E1 states), never category labels -- drives split / merge / feature-reweighting / relation-discovery / event-boundary-revision / abstraction-change over E1's equivalence classes, via REPLAY of non-contiguous episodes under a common evaluative frame (retrospective representation learning: later experience revises how earlier experiences are bucketed). Candidate rebucketings are COUNTERFACTUALLY tested before adoption (does representing the distinction improve predictions under relevant alternative actions and contexts?), and consequential revisions preferentially complete in a decoupled/sleep phase whose job includes RE-INDEXING episodic traces so autobiographical addressability survives the representational change -- sleep as safe maintenance of the representational coordinate system itself. E3 must not become E1's teacher: downstream selection changes the learning conditions and evidence pressure on E1, never its truth content directly (non-oracular).

The self-model has a waking half and a sleep half. The waking half is SD-003 (single-episode counterfactual self-attribution via E2). The sleep half is full-Bayesian aggregation of single-episode SD-003 outputs across many episodes, routed by the anchored channel to E1 and SD-033a, correcting for delayed consequences, failed counterfactuals, and systematic attribution biases. Without the sleep half, REE has an episode-local causal signature but not a durable self-model.
Offline consolidation is protected by typed authority/write boundaries.

Consolidation-pipeline lesion harness: experiment-layer instrumentation that makes each phase of the MECH-120 (SWS denoising) -> MECH-121 (NREM slot-filling) -> MECH-123 (REM precision recalibration) offline-consolidation pipeline independently diffuse-damageable and gives each a per-phase output-quality readout scored against INJECTED known content -- a uniform RMS-scaled Gaussian per-phase diffuse-damage knob plus injected-content scoring, at zero ree_core change -- so the MECH-168/INV-047/MECH-169 staged-decline-under-uniform-damage falsifier is buildable on demand. Non-vacuity is carried by the validated per-phase content-contingent readouts (SD-071), NOT by damage-tolerance staging order (separated out as SD-073) and not by feed-forward error-compounding (which is topology-baked).

Consolidation-phase damage is content-scorable only where the phase's output is a FIRST-ORDER content-bearing quantity (NREM inter-store transfer; SWS retrieval margin). A phase whose output is a SECOND-ORDER quantity over representations -- REM precision / confidence recalibration -- is content-free BY TYPE, and its damage is readable only through a downstream behavioural discrimination consequence, never through a statistic computed on the precision quantity itself.
Sleep modes consolidate learning and ethical residue across regimes.
Offline integration (sleep) is required for stability.

created_claims.title: Offline integration is a protected family of TYPED transformations, not a unitary replay update: retention/interference repair, representational reorganisation, recalibration/attribution repair, and behavioural-access repair are distinct offline OUTCOMES (a partition by what changed, not by which phase ran), and each requires its own declared WRITE TARGET, its own PROVENANCE CLASS for the content it may consume, and its own DISTAL WAKING READOUT. Replay is a transport and sampling operation shared by all four, never a sufficient description of the transformation any of them performs. Consequently a readout appropriate to one operation is not evidence about another: retention is shown by preserved or recovered competence after interference on old and transfer cases; reorganisation by changed relational transfer, equivalence-class behaviour, generalisation or state construction WITH trace/index continuity; recalibration by improved calibration or causal attribution under held-out outcomes, never by narrower uncertainty alone (a sharper but wrong posterior is a failure, and reduced ambivalence from attractor collapse or gate lockout must be separated from reduced ambivalence from evidence integration); and access repair by restored endogenous recruitment, fresh commitment, executed behaviour and ecological consequence while upstream content is held fixed.

hub_targets.title: epistemic_deficit: a persistent, target-bound accumulator representing unresolved, consequential, potentially-resolvable model inadequacy -- distinct from raw novelty (MECH-314a), raw uncertainty (MECH-314b), transient prediction error, and learning-progress (MECH-314c). Rises with unresolved importance x uncertainty x expected_resolvability x persistence; falls with verified resolution, established irrelevance, or accepted irreducibility.

learning_progress_curiosity_intrinsic_motivation_analog. A reward bonus that tracks the rate-of-improvement of the agent's predictive model (or any internal-state quantity); actions that produce a steepening learning curve receive a positive bonus. Most computationally instantiated in ML literature (Schmidhuber 1991, Pathak et al. 2017); least biologically anchored of the three MECH-314 sub-flavours -- no clean cellular or regional analog. Distinguishes from MECH-314a (recency-based) and MECH-314b (uncertainty-based) by tracking second-order signal (improvement rate) rather than first-order (count or uncertainty).
REE requires staged developmental training with explicit curriculum gates.

Self-relative affordance uncertainty: the model under calibration is P(outcome | self-state, world-state, action), not P(outcome | world-state, action) -- E1/E2 maintain uncertainty over action consequences conditional on the CURRENT SELF-STATE, so a change in the self (growth, capability change, damage) selectively makes previously learned environmental relations uncertain again and selectively reopens exploration of the AFFECTED affordance regions without a global novelty reset.
Play is a structurally necessary behavioral mode: without a bounded low-stakes learning context, strategy acquisition requires accepting real harm risk or forgoing novel exploration entirely.
Curiosity drive: information-seeking bias in hippocampal trajectory scoring that favors regions of higher representational density in the RBF map.

created_claims.title: Play as emergent developmental information hunger: play-like behaviour emerges WITHOUT a dedicated play module when basic viability is secure, no urgent commitment dominates action selection, spare behavioural capacity is available, reachable states contain learnable (reducible) uncertainty, and exploration is predicted to produce learning progress -- and the FRONTIER of play MIGRATES across affordance spaces (bodily -> object -> compositional/causal -> social -> symbolic/counterfactual -> abstract) as learning progress in earlier spaces saturates, yielding an endogenous developmental curriculum rather than externally imposed stages. Mastery moves curiosity rather than extinguishing it; human neoteny is read as preservation of the developmental exploratory mode with progressively abstract objects. Explicitly NOT the strong equation play = information gain (play also serves bonding, practice, regulation, signalling).

hub_targets.title: Selective cognitive coalition instantiation: the control plane converts typed control demands (e.g. PROVENANCE_CHECK, COUNTERFACTUAL_EXPANSION, SOCIAL_MODEL_CHECK) into temporary functional interaction graphs over E1/E2/hippocampal/reality-coherence/social/language/affective/E3 systems, recruiting only the subsystems relevant to the discrepancy type.

Control plane must produce a coalition/topology control output -- a temporary functional interaction graph specifying which subsystems are recruited and how they communicate -- distinct from and complementary to parametric modulation (precision, gain, threshold, horizon).

policy_composition_via_repeated_grounding (zoom-out / chunk a sequence of primitives into a single atomic primitive after repeated successful execution). Child of ARC-069 dynamic-regranularisation parent commitment. Architectural commitment: sequences of policy primitives that have been repeatedly executed together with consistent outcomes are accumulated into a single primitive that the rule-apprehension and diversity-generation layers can treat atomically. Trigger: repetition count + outcome consistency (slow accumulator). Direction: zoom out. Phenomenology anchor: 'making coffee was once seventeen motor acts; after a thousand repetitions it is one unit.' Names the TRANSITION mechanism (planned -> habitual chunk) that MECH-163 dual systems presupposes but does not specify.

policy_composition_chunk_accumulator -- striatum/DLS-analog formation operator that builds chunk candidates from sequences of policy primitives repeatedly executed together with consistent outcomes. First child mechanism for ARC-071 (the maintenance operator MECH-324 is registered separately). Encodes the lit-pull R1 verdict (repetition + outcome consistency as primary trigger, evaluative-gate upstream, V_s-positive secondary) + R2 verdict partial (striatum-analog formation substrate; vmPFC/IL maintenance substrate handled by MECH-324) + R4 verdict (chunked primitive carries initiation-set + termination-condition fields per Sutton 1999 options structure) + R5 verdict (gradual hysteresis with F_low formation < F_high dissolution -- the RELATION is literature-grounded as of 2026-07-27 (Barnes 2005; Bouton 2012), the VALUES F_low=0.15 / F_high=0.45 are uncalibrated engineering defaults with NO literature support, awaiting child-MECH calibration; INITIAL chunk-size budget 2-5 elements per level, licensed by Sakai 2003 at MOTOR grain only and NOT a stable architectural constant -- Ramkumar 2016 shows chunk length grows with practice under a compute/efficiency trade-off, Bo & Seidler 2009 shows it tracks visuospatial working-memory capacity and declines with age, so the ceiling should be exposed as growable and ideally DERIVED from the agent's deliberation/rollout budget rather than configured independently; see the 2026-07-27 provenance correction in evidence_quality_note). Dissolution is SUPPRESSION WITH RETENTION, not erasure (2026-07-27 structural correction, registered on MECH-324): a previously-dissolved sequence re-forms at the REDUCED bar R_reacq = R_min * f_reacq rather than at R_min from scratch, so the MECH-323 trigger is state-dependent on the chunk library; and the initiation_set field becomes load-bearing for the renewal falsifier, which is expressible only if dissolution is scoped to the same context granularity formation uses. Two write paths: default MECH-094 strict (hypothesis_tag=False real executions only); sleep-replay carve-out under MECH-322 conditions (replay_origin=True audit flag with accelerated dissolution if not corroborated by real waking execution).

created_claims.title: Control plane should be able to represent computational ROLE (a reusable operation such as maintain, compare, accumulate, sequence, retrieve, or estimate-uncertainty) independently of the REPRESENTATIONAL CONTENT currently bound to it -- a third compositional axis alongside coalition/topology control (SD-091's graph-valued output G_t) and parametric modulation, distinct from and complementary to both. A conceptual object may need separate role (F), bound-content (X_t), substrate (S_t), coalition-membership (G_t), and parameter-state (theta_t) identities rather than assuming these collapse into one another.

hub_targets.title: The system maintains a functional distinction between simulation-mode content and real-experience content, such that simulation content does not accumulate in the viability map as committed experience; failures of this distinction produce confabulation (simulated events encoded as real).

policy_composition.sleep_replay_value_conditioned_chunking_consolidation -- narrow exception path that permits ARC-071 chunk formation from replayed (hypothesis_tag=True) sequences during designated sleep phase, IF the replayed sequence carries a value-tag from prior real-executed episodes AND the formed chunk carries a replay_origin=True audit flag with accelerated dissolution if not corroborated by real waking execution within N episodes. Resolves ARC-071 lit-pull R6 governance escalation (Option B carve-out, picked 2026-05-11).

Imagination-learning constraint principle: simulated/imagined experience may license only LICIT forms of learning (consistency checking, plan optimisation, schema integration) and is FORBIDDEN from driving durable world-model updates, prediction validation, or novel-fact generation. The provenance gate (MECH-365 committed-vs-imagined field) is the mechanism that enforces this principle; the principle states WHAT learning imagination may and may not produce, independent of any single gate's implementation.

bottom_up_behavioral_pattern_extraction_pathway (hippocampal_CLS_bi_pathway + dorsolateral_striatum_chunking + OFC_cognitive_map analog). Architectural commitment: rule discovery from observed-behaviour clustering is logically and architecturally distinct from rule application from instructed/external context (ARC-062 top-down rule-apprehension). Where ARC-062 receives a context cue and selects a discriminative policy mode, ARC-064 receives an observed-behaviour stream and extracts cross-episode regularities, compressed behavioural patterns, and rule-state abstractions. Both pathways presuppose ARC-065 behavioural diversity generation upstream. Multi-substrate distributed instantiation: hippocampal Complementary Learning Systems bi-pathway (Schapiro et al. 2017), dorsolateral striatum action chunking (Smith & Graybiel 2013/2016), OFC cognitive-map state abstraction (Wilson et al. 2014; Schuck et al. 2016).

created_claims.title: ARC-064 extracts cross-episode behavioural regularities, compressed patterns, and rule-state abstractions from an observed-behaviour stream (hippocampal CLS bi-pathway / dorsolateral striatum chunking / OFC cognitive-map analog). Under ARC-092, that observed-behaviour stream could in principle be either real waking behaviour or imagined/simulated (e.g. E3 counterfactual) trajectories. Are rules extracted from IMAGINED trajectories architecturally EQUIVALENT to rules extracted from WAKING trajectories -- i.e. does ARC-064's extraction mechanism operate identically regardless of source, with licitness enforced only at a separate downstream commit/write-gate step (MECH-094-style) -- or does rule extraction ITSELF need a provenance-aware carve-out (e.g. imagined-trajectory-derived rules held as lower-confidence/provisional/prior-only until corroborated by real execution, per MECH-322's template), because letting an unvalidated imagined trajectory silently seed the same rule-state abstraction a validated waking trajectory would is itself a FORBIDDEN-adjacent risk (confabulated RULES, not merely confabulated episodic facts)?

hub_targets.title: The system maintains a functional distinction between simulation-mode content and real-experience content, such that simulation content does not accumulate in the viability map as committed experience; failures of this distinction produce confabulation (simulated events encoded as real).

Imagination-learning constraint principle: simulated/imagined experience may license only LICIT forms of learning (consistency checking, plan optimisation, schema integration) and is FORBIDDEN from driving durable world-model updates, prediction validation, or novel-fact generation. The provenance gate (MECH-365 committed-vs-imagined field) is the mechanism that enforces this principle; the principle states WHAT learning imagination may and may not produce, independent of any single gate's implementation.

Outputs of counterfactual exploration (imagined/simulated candidate rollouts scored during E3 selection or equivalent planning) are LICIT only as priors for future waking testing -- i.e. as inputs to policy/value preference (which action to prefer, which hypothesis to test next) -- and are FORBIDDEN from being treated as knowledge: they must not be written into the world-model's own predictive parameters, used to validate or score a REAL prediction's accuracy, or logged as an established fact. This is REE's architectural analogue of expected-free-energy policy scoring (Friston et al. 2015): imagining a candidate's likely outcome to choose among candidates is a distinct operation from updating the model that did the imagining, and the two must not be allowed to collapse into one write path.

created_claims.title: ARC-092 licenses plan optimisation (choosing among imagined candidate action sequences) as LICIT, while forbidding durable world-model updates driven by imagined content. But plan optimisation and world-model update are not always cleanly separable in a single learned system: if E3's candidate-scoring pathway shares parameters, representations, or a training signal with the world-model/predictor (E1/E2), then IMPROVING plan optimisation performance could, as a side effect, also shift world-model parameters -- exactly the FORBIDDEN path, smuggled in through a shared substrate rather than an explicit write. Where, mechanistically, does plan-optimisation's LICIT gradient/update signal stop and the world-model's FORBIDDEN one begin, in REE's actual (not merely intended) parameter-sharing architecture?

hub_targets.title: Hippocampal proposer anchor selection AND anchor-reset: (a) trajectory proposals issued between committed actions anchor on the subset of current latent streams whose regional verisimilitude (per-stream prediction/realization alignment) exceeds threshold; misaligned streams hold their last-verified snapshot (anchor carryover) rather than contaminate the rollout. (b) Active anchors are continuously re-evaluated against an effective verisimilitude V_s_anchor(a, t) = V_s(r, t) - staleness[r] (MECH-284 read-out); if V_s_anchor falls below theta_reset(r) for k consecutive steps the anchor is marked inactive (NOT erased -- dual-trace preservation per Bouton 2004) and a new anchor is sought from the current latent slice. A minority probe channel deliberately inverts the gate for low-verisimilitude / high-PE regions, carrying a strengthened MECH-094 hypothesis tag, and does not update the ARC-018 viability map until realized-experience validation.

Dual-component online invalidation trigger: an UPSTREAM anchor-side comparator (CA1/CA3 mismatch flowing through subicular routing per Vinogradova 2001 + O'Mara 2009) coupled to a DOWNSTREAM broadcast event (LC phasic burst per Aston-Jones-Cohen 2005, with parallel signals from generalised dopaminergic prediction error per Schultz 1997 and lateral habenula negative-RPE per Matsumoto-Hikosaka 2007), wired together by the HC-VTA loop (Lisman & Grace 2005). The two components are coupled stages of one trigger event, not alternatives. Distinct from MECH-284 the accumulator: MECH-287 is the discrete trigger event (anchor-side mismatch + broadcast release) that drives accumulation. Triggered by latent-stream prediction failure (norm(z_pred(t-1) - z_obs(t)) > theta_trigger) OR strongly negative value-PE (value_PE(t) < -theta_value) OR exogenous surprise. Carries no schema-region credit on its own; downstream MECH-284 attributes the broadcast event to the active anchor set. Failure modes dissociate from MECH-284: trigger-loss produces single-event blindness (no anchor ever feels invalidated, but staleness map remains queryable); accumulator-loss produces V3-EXQ-475's phenotype directly (releases happen but never integrate). Failure modes also dissociate from MECH-285 sleep priority: trigger-loss prevents staleness from accruing, while sleep-priority loss prevents accrued staleness from being repaired. Within MECH-287 itself, anchor-side comparator failure dissociates from broadcast failure: comparator-loss = no upstream signal to broadcast (silent trigger, biologically a CA1/CA3 lesion); broadcast-loss = comparator fires but no global gain modulation downstream (silent invalidation, biologically an LC lesion).

Capacity-triggered resumption reseeding: at the moment a task is interrupted, REE captures an interruption_snapshot (z_world + z_self + z_goal + CEM planning stage + rule-arbitration weights + what-was-attempted) that is richer than, and distinct from, SD-039's existing dual-trace anchor goal-snapshot payload. When a spare-compute signal (low SD-037 broadcast-override + low z_harm_a + low dACC choice_difficulty) or sleep entry indicates freed processing capacity, the interruption_snapshot is re-seeded into MECH-293's awake ghost-goal probes and MECH-285's sleep-replay sampler, so that resumption is a reorient-from-snapshot rather than a restart-from-scratch. This is the backward-direction complement to REE's existing forward direction, in which world-change invalidates stale model content (MECH-269 anchor V_s + MECH-284 staleness -> MECH-287 broadcast -> anchors inactive): the forward direction discards stale content when the world moves on without the agent; MECH-524 is what lets the agent pick its own paused work back up once capacity to attend to it returns.

V_s residual schema-staleness accumulator: a region-indexed scalar that integrates broadcast invalidation events (MECH-287) with attribution_weight credit assignment over the active anchor set, leaks slowly, and is read by both online anchor-reset (MECH-269 hysteresis check, waking) and sleep-consolidation priority (MECH-285, offline). Distinct from generic prediction error (which operates on latent values and updates online via gradient): MECH-284 is region-indexed, accumulates across events, and exposes a dual read-out (online + offline). Refined 2026-04-22 from sleep-only formulation to dual-readout formulation after V3-EXQ-475 demonstrated that an agent trapped in a stale anchor needs an online consumer of the staleness signal -- MECH-285 sleep-only readout cannot rescue the agent during waking. Saturated map produces over-attention to schema revision (anxiety-analog); absent map produces schema rigidity (V3-EXQ-475 phenotype: 5-6 PAG releases per seed but never integrate to anchor invalidation -> 1000/1000 freeze-active steps).

created_claims.title: MECH-524's interruption_snapshot captures z_world at the moment of interruption. By the time a spare-compute or sleep-entry trigger re-seeds it into MECH-293/MECH-285, real time has passed during which the actual world may have changed (REE's forward direction: MECH-269 V_s + MECH-284 staleness -> MECH-287 broadcast -> anchors inactive). How should resumption reconcile the snapshot's SAVED V_s against V_s as CURRENTLY computed? Candidates: (a) current-only -- discard the saved V_s and let MECH-269 recompute cold, keeping only the snapshot's non-V_s content (CEM stage, rule-arbitration weights, what-was-attempted); (b) max(current, saved*decay) -- treat the saved V_s as a decaying floor rather than a fresh read, structurally transplanting MECH-284's spatial region-staleness decay logic onto this temporal/episodic case; (c) abort-on-divergence guard -- compare saved vs current V_s and refuse the snapshot-primed resumption path (fall back toward restart-from-scratch) if divergence exceeds a threshold, functioning as a targeted application of MECH-287's existing anchors-inactive broadcast rather than a new invalidation mechanism; (d) context-dependent -- the correct rule depends on interruption duration, interruption cause (hazard vs. voluntary capacity reallocation), or domain volatility, and no single rule suffices.

hub_targets.title: Similarity-gated care collapse (REFLEXIVE / self-directed failure mode): because REE grounds ethics in modelling others as 'sufficiently like me' (Axiom 5, INV-001, MECH-164 self-like gradient weighting), anything the similarity model classifies as NOT-sufficiently-like-me falls OUTSIDE the care gradient by construction -- structurally the computational shape of out-group exclusion / dehumanization. A design that locates ethics in similarity inherits similarity's failure mode.

In a world containing other predictive agents, causal-model selection over an observation must include a distinct OTHER-agent-caused hypothesis (alongside world-caused, self-caused, and jointly-caused) with non-zero but bounded prior probability -- a signal-detection-theory calibration target, not a fixed threshold -- and once evidence is attributed to another agent's action with sufficient probability, downstream belief-updating on whatever that evidence appears to support about the world must be discounted or reweighted conditional on a shallow, recursion-bounded model of that agent's likely goal in producing it (teach, warn, cooperate, deceive, conceal, or no strategic intent at all). This generalizes INV-012 Leg 4's single-agent self-solicited-evidence discounting to the multi-agent case, and is distinct from ARC-010/MECH-031/MECH-274's existing machinery for DETECTING and aggregating other-agent causation, which currently feeds only empathy/harm-coupling (MECH-036) and other-model stabilisation, not evidential-weight discounting of the observation's apparent world-content.
Violence corollary: violence is conditionally permissible only when an agent is not modelled as sufficiently self-like OR poses a genuine threat; both conditions require accurate inference.
Trust and deception dynamics.

created_claims.title: What mechanism should estimate an interacting agent's mimicry/deception risk and feed it into EXT-009's liberal care-gate criterion -- i.e. how does (or should) REE detect that a candidate mind is an adversarial agent mimicking mind-signals to extract undeserved care, tightening the criterion's false-positive-cost term (Axiom 8 deception) without collapsing the liberal floor that protects genuine-but-ambiguous minds from exclusion?

hub_targets.title: Evaluation channels are evidence-producing boundaries, not world-state affordances: no agentic subsystem -- including an AI assistant developing REE -- may update architectural confidence directly from a performance score without provenance, review, and governance mediation. World feedback, evidence feedback, and governance feedback are distinct typed signal classes that must remain non-collapsible.
Responsibility arises through commitment, not prediction alone.
Reward hacking: scalar reward conflates incommensurable error signals.

created_claims.title: Does REE's evaluation-channel-integrity discipline (INV-077) generalize beyond REE's own development process to an ordinary human-AI conversational dyad, where sycophancy can weaken the error signal and let a coupled human-AI cognitive system mistake internally-generated coherence for external confirmation?

hub_targets.title: The system maintains a functional distinction between simulation-mode content and real-experience content, such that simulation content does not accumulate in the viability map as committed experience; failures of this distinction produce confabulation (simulated events encoded as real).

F-dominance bounds committed-action diversity: the primary harm/goal score (F) monopolises ~88-89% of E3 committed-selection variance (V3-EXQ-571: 0.886 baseline, 0.894 with the full diversity stack -- the stack does not dent F's share), so modulatory, within-class, and rule-bias diversity channels cannot convert to committed-action diversity while F dominates -- they act only at near-ties. The committed-action-diversity conversion ceiling is therefore a SELECTION-VARIANCE problem (primary-vs-modulatory share), not (only) a candidate-pool geometry problem; a shortlist-then-modulate lever circumvents F locally but may cap committed entropy below the proposer ceiling unless F's variance share is itself rebalanced.

created_claims.title: Outputs of counterfactual exploration (imagined/simulated candidate rollouts scored during E3 selection or equivalent planning) are LICIT only as priors for future waking testing -- i.e. as inputs to policy/value preference (which action to prefer, which hypothesis to test next) -- and are FORBIDDEN from being treated as knowledge: they must not be written into the world-model's own predictive parameters, used to validate or score a REAL prediction's accuracy, or logged as an established fact. This is REE's architectural analogue of expected-free-energy policy scoring (Friston et al. 2015): imagining a candidate's likely outcome to choose among candidates is a distinct operation from updating the model that did the imagining, and the two must not be allowed to collapse into one write path.

The self-model has a waking half and a sleep half. The waking half is SD-003 (single-episode counterfactual self-attribution via E2). The sleep half is full-Bayesian aggregation of single-episode SD-003 outputs across many episodes, routed by the anchored channel to E1 and SD-033a, correcting for delayed consequences, failed counterfactuals, and systematic attribution biases. Without the sleep half, REE has an episode-local causal signature but not a durable self-model.

MECH-271 routing is state-gated. In waking, the anchor channel dominates the hippocampal fan-out: replay preferentially reaches consolidation and viability-map consumers to support decision-making. In sleep, the probe channel dominates: replay preferentially seeds Bayesian schema restructuring -- testing which action-outcome attributions held up across episodes, creating new buckets for non-fitting experiences, revising causal graphs. The informational needs of sleep (schema revision) and waking (decision support) are distinct, and the routing bias reflects that.

created_claims.title: Schema integration during offline/imagination-adjacent consolidation (MECH-272 probe-channel routing, MECH-273 sleep-half self-model aggregation) is constrained to recombining waking-derived trace primitives: the material a schema-integration pass restructures must trace back to real, committed (hypothesis_tag=False) waking experience, and a schema update computed from one imagination/consolidation cycle's output must not itself become input material for a later cycle's schema integration without an intervening waking-encoded checkpoint. Without this constraint, successive offline cycles could compound self-amplification of imagined content into schema structure -- confabulation by accretion rather than by single-event failure.

Sleep-consolidation priority from V_s residuals: during sleep-phase Bayesian aggregation (MECH-275) and sleep-dependent self-model aggregation (MECH-273), the order and weight of replay events is biased by the schema-staleness map produced by MECH-284. PTSD-rumination has a clean architectural account here: MECH-285 priority loss co-occurring with MECH-094 hypothesis-tag dysfunction, locking the staleness tag from ever clearing.

Broadcast override regulator (orexin-analog) is the third regulatory layer of the V3 control stack: a small, broadly-projecting gain modulator that integrates internal homeostatic state and threat context to produce an override_signal that reweights z_harm at downstream commit gates and gates the SD-012 drive->z_goal seeding bridge. Dissociable from SD-036 (GABA decay) and from MECH-186/187/188 (5-HT goal-pipeline gain): each layer predicts a clinically distinct failure phenotype (catatonia subtype II / depression / narcolepsy + PWS-hyperphagia). SD-036 alone is architecturally insufficient to break harm-stream lock-in under sustained threat; SD-037 supplies the override authority that lets metabolic demand drive z_goal seeding when threat persists.

hub_targets.title: z_world P0 anti-collapse encoder-training recipe: a mini-batched P0 that trains the SD-005 split-encoder world path on STATIC scene-structure targets derived from world_obs alone (hazard/resource presence + bucketed nearest-Chebyshev distance), with class-balanced CE and a VICReg-style variance/covariance anti-collapse penalty, replacing the SD-009 event-contrastive + SD-018 P0 that was measured to COLLAPSE z_world to participation ratio ~1.06 at world_dim=128. Supplies the trained encoder that SD-031 / E2WorldForward P1 and V3-EXQ-783 both require.

E2.action_object_head receives zero gradient from every REE training path, so the action-object space O that SD-004's hippocampal map backbone navigates is a frozen random projection fixed at initialisation, not the learned world-effect compression SD-004 specifies. O is state-invariant rather than consequence-structured, and the hippocampal CEM searches and refits inside it.
Action objects as hippocampal map backbone, enabling long-horizon planning beyond step-level trajectories.
z_gamma split into z_self (E2 motor-sensory domain) and z_world (E3/Hippocampus domain).

One tensor, two masters: E2.action_object_head's output O is simultaneously the semantic compression (what o_t means) and the search coordinate system the hippocampal CEM samples in (ao_mean + ao_std*noise, decoded to actions), so an objective that improves the first can degrade the second by reallocating a shared fixed budget -- O's variance. Measured in V3-EXQ-817a: ao_M5_r2_explained_by_action_alone fell from ~0.995 to ~0.721, moving roughly 28 percent of O's variance out of action-coding, while the consequence-ordering metric M6 remained weak and sign-unstable (mean ~+0.12, negative on 2 of 5 seeds). O stopped being a clean action code without becoming a reliable consequence code.

The unit of PERCEPT is a dynamic representation, not a fixed primitive: perceptual grain rescales with circumstance, so that the same scene is individuated coarsely or finely depending on demand. This is the perceptual analogue of ARC-069's already-accepted policy-side commitment, and ARC-069's rationale transfers axis-independently -- a fixed grain is either too fine (combinatorial explosion in what must be tracked and bound) or too coarse (units fail to map onto the actual state). REE has made this commitment for policy (ARC-069/070/071) and for context slots offline (MECH-166) but never for online perception, where the unit remains fixed.
L-space is a multi-timescale latent stack.

Predictive obligation is the anti-collapse constraint on a value-carved representation: a representation compressed toward selection-relevance ALONE degenerates, because value is a near-scalar projection and a pure value-carving objective admits solutions that discard everything not currently useful. Requiring the higher-order latents to remain PREDICTIVE across the ARC-004 temporal spread supplies a constraint the value objective lacks -- cross-horizon prediction demands retained state structure that value alone does not -- so the combination holds perception open where value-carving alone would collapse it.

Selection-relevance is a legitimate object-individuation criterion: an object may be individuated by what it is FOR -- its usefulness relative to goals, harm, and interoceptive/metabolic state -- rather than (only) by the causal coherence of its features under intervention. This is RIVAL to MECH-278 and the two disagree on real cases: causally-identical-but-functionally-distinct items are one object under MECH-278 and two under ARC-133; causally-distinct-but-functionally-identical items (a hazard that bites, a hazard that falls) are two under MECH-278 and one under ARC-133. The sharpest divergence is drive-relative re-individuation -- the same world carves differently when hungry, thirsty or injured -- which a causal criterion cannot deliver and which is precisely what MECH-359 asserts selection requires.

Perceptual slot OCCUPANCY is an emergent order parameter of a coupling-versus-lateral-inhibition settling competition, bounded above by an independently-set CAPACITY -- so capacity and occupancy are two distinct regulators rather than one. Occupancy is not read off coherence by counting related coherencies, which is circular (the relatedness criterion IS the grain decision) and ill-posed (coherence nests rather than partitions). Mechanism-agnostic about what sets the coupling constant.

created_claims.title: REE's designated compression sites are systematically UNTRAINED, so representational-ceiling results measured at them are uninterpretable as capacity findings. Verified 2026-08-26 at three independent sites: (a) E2.action_object_head, SD-004's action-object bottleneck that the hippocampal CEM searches inside, receives zero gradient from every REE training path and is a frozen random projection with ~99.5% of its variance explained by the action label (SD-080); (b) the ARC-004 higher-order latent stack -- beta_encoder, theta_encoder and delta_encoder appear ZERO times in agent.py, have no loss, no optimiser and no predictive head at any horizon, and are an untrained random-projection cascade smoothed by one hardcoded shared EMA (alpha_shared = 0.3); (c) no value-shaped objective reaches any encoder at all -- compute_benefit_eval_loss reads z_world.detach() and trains only E3.benefit_eval_head. The corollary is methodological: a null measured at an untrained compression site is evidence about the absence of a training signal, not about the representation's capacity or about the sufficiency of the architecture.

hub_targets.title: Ephaptic/oscillatory field-level coherence functions as a fast, non-synaptic CONTENT-AGGREGATION mechanism -- not merely the confidence/eligibility readout MECH-270 already covers -- synthesising distributed oscillatory information (amplitude, phase, relative phase, frequency, synchrony, cross-frequency relationships) into the temporally-coherent 'actionable now' state that seeds hippocampal proposal generation. The field need not 'understand' anything; its attraction as a mechanism is that the physical substrate may perform part of the aggregation automatically, fast enough that proposal generation is not stale by the time candidate futures are produced.

Content authority (which candidate future should win commitment -- already REE's existing architecture via MECH-090/MECH-341/ARC-003) and temporal/readiness authority (whether a candidate future has become sufficiently coherent, in the cross-system field-coherence sense, for commitment to be permitted to land AT ALL) are distinct constitutional questions that may require different mechanisms. Fast cross-system field coherence (extending MECH-499's content-aggregation function) is a candidate mechanism for the readiness axis specifically -- locating the moving frontier at which a previously branching predicted future becomes sufficiently well-predicted for commitment to land -- distinct from MECH-434's evidence/posterior-driven epistemic commitment timing at the inference layer, and distinct from MECH-090's beta-gated propagation of an already-decided commit.

Entity binding is continuously re-evaluated, not fixed: an established self-anchor <-> world-configuration binding is re-bound to a competing configuration when that competitor overtakes the currently-bound one under perturbation of the shared anchor. Rebinding is the ENTITY-LAYER analogue of MECH-269(b) anchor-reset -- it operates over self<->world-config bindings rather than proposer stream-anchors. The rebinding trigger is prediction-error / competitor-overtake driven (object-file updating; serial-dependence hysteresis; PE-driven perceptual switching), NOT a coherence-specific selection factor C(tau) (that coherence-SPECIFICITY question is settled NO-CLAIM by V3-EXQ-725a and is explicitly excluded from this claim).

Ephaptic field coherence in CA1/CA3 pyramidal layers is the candidate physical substrate for the per-stream verisimilitude readout that MECH-269 anchor selection operates over. Streams whose predictions align with realized values produce coherent pyramidal ensembles whose extracellular fields constructively reinforce; misaligned streams produce incoherent fields. 'Anchor-eligible' reduces to 'field-coherent at read time.'
Field-level coherence support (ephaptic coupling): extracellular electric field interactions stabilise phase relationships across neural populations, supporting temporal coherence.

created_claims.title: Ephaptic field strength is the COUPLING CONSTANT of the perceptual settling competition that sets slot occupancy (MECH-521), not a quantity that is measured and counted. A physical field does not enumerate domains; it sets the interaction strength from which the domain count emerges -- and because coherence is a property of each population separately, a field-derived setter is natively HETEROGENEOUS (different streams settling into different domain counts simultaneously) rather than imposing the single ordered abstraction axis that Badre and Nee 2018 reports the evidence does not support. This is a THIRD ephaptic function, distinct from MECH-499 (what the actionable now CONTAINS) and MECH-500 (WHEN a branching future is coherent enough to commit): at what GRAIN the now is carved.

E1 updates are batched into theta-cycle summaries before reaching E3 (cross-frequency temporal packaging).

Tri-loop gate conflict arbitration uses soft-competitive disinhibition (indirect pathway inter-collicular competition) rather than winner-take-all suppression; WTA imposed across loops causes coupling collapse.
Object-file-like buffers provide minimal entity persistence across time.

Minimal recurrent settling step over the eligible set: replace the one-shot feed-forward argmin/softmax committed-selection readout with a few rounds of mutual-inhibition (surround-inhibition) updates on the within-eligible _modulatory_accum field BEFORE commit, so the committed action emerges from a bounded recurrent SETTLING competition rather than a single global comparison. A hard argmin over an F-dominated score always returns the F-winner (the conversion ceiling); a settling competition with lateral inhibition can FLIP the selected attractor when a modulatory channel is strong enough, and turns the additive _modulatory_accum BLEND into a competitive winner-take-most. The V3-bounded version of the BG's recurrent settling dynamics; the full learned thalamo-cortico-basal loop is the V4 bet.

Emotion-as-anti-collapse architecture: emotion-like systems are a set of GATED, PARTIALLY INDEPENDENT evaluators (is-this-harmful / is-this-safe / did-this-reduce-suffering / am-I-pursuing-something-I-want / did-I-merely-like-the-last-thing / am-I-stuck / am-I-overcommitted / is-this-goal-stale / should-I-explore / should-I-stop / should-I-sleep-and-consolidate / should-I-release-the-policy) whose collective effect is to prevent behaviour from collapsing onto the currently dominant gradient. Affect is therefore the architectural SOURCE of structured behavioural diversity -- not decoration on a rational optimiser and not random exploration noise, but native modulatory control (gates, biases, interrupts, salience shifts, persistence regulators, release conditions, credit-assignment signals) that produces STRUCTURED deviations from naive optimisation. A unifying MAP over REE's already-owned affect machinery, not a new substrate; an optimise-then-bolt-on-safety design fails because these evaluators must be native, not added afterward.

Integration and protected non-equivalence are JOINTLY necessary: cross-stream similarity has a viable band. Too little shared organisation is fragmentation; too much is representational collapse. An adequate architecture must satisfy both constraints at once, with a measurable quantity in between -- not merely satisfy each on a separate axis.
Serotonin-like modulation governs representational collapse.
