hub_targets.title: uncertainty_driven_curiosity_frontopolar_analog. A reward bonus that tracks epistemic value -- how much the agent would learn from sampling a state or action. Biological substrate: rostrolateral prefrontal exploration bonus (Daw et al. 2006 Nature). Sub-flavour of MECH-314 structured curiosity bonus. Active-inference framing: bonus equals epistemic value term in expected free energy decomposition (Friston 2010/2015).

Object-bound incentive-salience layer: insert a per-object incentive layer between the benefit pulse and z_goal. The legacy goal stream wrote a SINGLE z_goal attractor overwritten on every contact, conflating liking (hedonic impact at consumption) with wanting (incentive salience to a cue/object) and goal-location (where) with goal-object (what); wanting target always equalled liking target, so the L9 wanting!=liking dissociation was structurally inexpressible (514l C6=0.0 on all seeds). SD-057 adds (L2 MECH-344) benefit->object-identity binding on the SD-049 per-type tag, (L3 MECH-345) a per-object slow-decay revaluable incentive token with at-recall drive-specific wanting amplitude = base_value*(1+kappa*per_axis_drive), and (L4 MECH-346) z_goal seeded FROM the most-wanted object's stored embedding rather than the raw last-contacted z_resource. v1 = L2+L3+L4 core; L6 cue-recall (MECH-CUEWANT) + L7 dACC-readout-wiring (MECH-CONSUME) deferred to a phase-2 pass within this SD.

Curiosity is a reward-conditional EXPLOITATION amplifier, not a diversity generator: the SD-025 hippocampal curiosity / density-attraction drive pulls only toward representational structure that reward (SD-024/MECH-232 DA-expansion) has ALREADY sculpted -- a rich-get-richer loop with zero PROACTIVE pull toward unshaped / novel / under-represented regions. Its only diversity affordance is a weak, lagging, REACTIVE familiarity-discount brake (~half the strength of the exploitation force it opposes, and zero at the decision point). COROLLARY: proactive strategy-diversity GENERATION requires a SEPARATE rarity-seeking drive (Bellemare-2016 polarity: attraction to LOW-count / under-represented strategy classes, independent of prior reward-shaping), NOT a novelty-magnitude increase on the existing drive; and any such drive is ORDERING-GATED on INV-088 z_world differentiation (a rarity term over an under-differentiated map has nothing to range over).

staleness_gated_target_refresh_on_replay_write (MuZero/EfficientZero reanalyze analog). The second, more speculative leg of the CDQ-005 reanalyze import, complementary to MECH-443. Asserts that a replayed transition admitted to update the rule-arbitration layer should NOT write its stored (ghost-derived, possibly stale) target verbatim; the target should first be RECOMPUTED against the current model/policy before it updates the rule layer, and the write should be down-weighted or skipped when the recomputed target has not drifted from the stored one (low staleness => low update value). This is the MuZero reanalyze trick (re-run the model on stored trajectories to produce fresh targets) plus EfficientZero off-policy/staleness correction. It guards against the failure MECH-319 was built to prevent (overcommitment to ghost-derived arbitration weights) from re-entering THROUGH the admitted-write channel that MECH-443 opens: prioritized writing of STALE targets would re-introduce drift, so the priority signal (MECH-443) and the freshness signal (MECH-444) must operate together.

priority_weighted_replay_write_selection (MuZero/EfficientZero reanalyze + hippocampal prioritized-replay analog). A mechanistic refinement of MECH-319's simulation-mode rule-write gate. MECH-319 is a BINARY categorical gate: during a ghost/replay/DMN pass it either blocks arbitration-weight writes (normal) or admits them (the V3-EXQ-543c/628 falsifier flag) -- all-or-nothing, no ordering among the replayed transitions it admits. MECH-443 asserts that WHEN the replay write channel is open, the transitions admitted to update the rule-arbitration layer should not be written uniformly but in GRADED priority order, weighted by an update-utility signal (a surprise / value-prediction-error / coverage proxy), so a high-utility replayed transition writes more strongly and a low-utility one writes weakly or not at all. The external analog is EfficientZero/MuZero prioritized experience replay (priority ~ value-prediction error); the biology is hippocampal SWR replay, which is demonstrably prioritized rather than uniform. CRITICAL REFINEMENT FROM BIOLOGY: the priority is the value of the UPDATE (Mattar & Daw gain x need), NOT raw reward magnitude or current action-value -- Carey et al. 2019 shows replay can be biased AWAY from the currently-most-valuable outcome. MECH-443 is the WHICH/HOW-STRONGLY complement to MECH-319's WHETHER gate; it does not change the binary gate, it grades the admitted writes.

Multi-resource heterogeneity: qualitatively distinct resource types (e.g. food / water / novelty) with per-type identity tags, type-specific spawn distributions, type-specific benefit profiles, and a per-axis homeostatic drive system, plus a curriculum-introduction hook. Provides the goal-identity vocabulary the wanting/liking + identity-distinct-goal cohort (MECH-229/230, MECH-117/216, ARC-030/032, Q-030, SD-015 unblock chain) needs to be honestly tested at substrate level, and the substrate scaffold for downstream developmental-schedule work.

Epistemic action pressure: when goal success or harm avoidance depends on hidden state, REE can assign action pressure to information-gathering transitions that reduce uncertainty, even when those actions are not immediately reward-maximising or harm-minimising; generalises Q-044 curiosity into a survival-relevant viability function under partial observability.

created_claims.title: SD-057's object-bound incentive tokens and SD-049's per-axis drive CANNOT carry epistemic value: the object-side carrier is written by a contact benefit-pulse, and the only epistemic pulse the environment supplies is a visit-count novelty proxy, which is disqualified by the gain x need constraint (Mattar and Daw 2018; Carey 2019 -- replay can be biased AWAY from the currently-most-valuable outcome). This is the NEGATIVE half only, and is the non-redundant content: the positive half (the quantity IS gain x need on transitions) is MECH-443's premise, inherited rather than added. Logically independent of MECH-443, whose subject is the replay write channel rather than the drive/goal pathway.

O is state-invariant rather than consequence-structured, and the hippocampal CEM searches and refits inside it.

E2 world-forward action-conditional divergence preservation via auxiliary InfoNCE-style contrastive loss. Substrate-level fix for the V3-EXQ-571 root cause finding (2026-05-25): with world_dim=32 and action_dim=4, action contributes ~11% of world_forward input dimensionality, and reconstruction-shaped training collapses to the state-dominated local minimum where action effect is fitted to zero. Measurement: cand_world_pairwise_dist = 0.0000 across K=8 candidates differing only in first action. Same root cause as 2026-05-17 ARC-062 GAP-B autopsy; GAP-B fix was scoped only to GatedPolicy first-action one-hot bypass. SD-056 is the architecturally-faithful generalisation -- fixes the predictor's training objective rather than bypassing the predictor at each consumer. Option (ii) lever B (contrastive next-state, Srivastava et al. 2021 style) chosen over PLSM-style MI factorisation (lever A) and SWIRL-style MI maximisation (lever C) per 2026-05-28 lit-pull SYNTHESIS verdict and user AskUserQuestion confirmation.

Differentiable CEM selection approximation -- replaces the non-differentiable argmax / argsort elite-selection step in HippocampalModule.propose_trajectories() with a softmax-weighted candidate mean so that gradient flows from task reward back through candidate selection to SD-016 cue_action_proj. Opt-in via use_differentiable_cem flag (default False; legacy argmax path bit-identical when off). Preserves ARC-007 STRICT value-flat constraint: scoring uses existing residue-terrain evaluation, not a new value head.

Argmax collapse at the incentive-to-goal interface: the per-object drive-conditioned value structure wanting[k] is computed over ALL stored objects and then reduced by most_wanted()'s ARGMAX to a single winner before it reaches selection, so z_goal is seeded from one object embedding and every candidate trajectory is scored against that one target. The comparative structure that would let candidates differ from one another for a value-relevant reason is destroyed upstream of the selector, not absent from it -- predicting that a downstream readout is FLAT in upstream wanting range except at rank flips, and becomes sloped when the argmax is replaced by a norm-matched graded read.

created_claims.title: One tensor, two masters: E2.action_object_head's output O is simultaneously the semantic compression (what o_t means) and the search coordinate system the hippocampal CEM samples in (ao_mean + ao_std*noise, decoded to actions), so an objective that improves the first can degrade the second by reallocating a shared fixed budget -- O's variance. This is RIVAL to the standing differentiate-first ordering (differentiate z_world per INV-088, THEN apply diversity pressure). The two give opposite readings of the same result: V3-EXQ-817a verifiably improved O's consequence structure and produced no behavioural change, which differentiate-first reads as consequence structure does not help, and this claim reads as the measurement could not have detected help.

hub_targets.title: F-dominance bounds committed-action diversity: the primary harm/goal score (F) monopolises ~88-89% of E3 committed-selection variance (V3-EXQ-571: 0.886 baseline, 0.894 with the full diversity stack -- the stack does not dent F's share), so modulatory, within-class, and rule-bias diversity channels cannot convert to committed-action diversity while F dominates -- they act only at near-ties. The committed-action-diversity conversion ceiling is therefore a SELECTION-VARIANCE problem (primary-vs-modulatory share), not (only) a candidate-pool geometry problem; a shortlist-then-modulate lever circumvents F locally but may cap committed entropy below the proposer ceiling unless F's variance share is itself rebalanced.

Global-scalar arousal channels are a VARIANCE AMPLIFIER of the already-dominant selection channel, not a source of behavioural differentiation: the three affective routes that modulate commitment globally (D1/D2 dopamine gain, harm-urgency threshold shrinkage, LC-NE/phasic-surprise temperature) apply one scalar uniformly across all K candidates and therefore cannot change an argmax, but DO change whether commitment fires and how sharply -- selecting for whichever channel already carries the most per-candidate score variance. Under F-dominance (MECH-439) this makes affective engagement ENTRENCH F rather than convert diversity, predicting that F's share of committed-selection variance RISES with arousal and FALLS under low urgency.

Theta-burst packet contains multi-content joint binding: each ~125ms theta cycle binds a {goal_latent, action_proposal, risk_estimate, state_summary} tuple within one phase-aligned window, with verisimilitude grounding the rollout step that must stay ahead of real time.

D1/D2 opponent dopamine gain is ORDER-CHANGING, not a uniform scalar: because it gains the promote and suppress populations asymmetrically about zero, a non-zero da can reorder any candidate pair whose loop accumulators straddle zero -- so this route is capable of the behavioural differentiation MECH-463 asserts no global-scalar route can produce.

Drive-state modulation of wanting (incentive salience): the homeostatic drive STATE modulates the wanting target and/or intensity dissociably from liking -- the most-wanted object tracks the currently-most-depleted drive axis (incentive-salience amplitude ~ base_value*(1+kappa*per_axis_drive)) even when the liking/consummatory target does not. Split from MECH-229 2026-06-16: MECH-229 asserts wanting and liking are dissociable SIGNALS (the object-bound dissociation, established by V3-EXQ-514o); MECH-436 is the distinct, finer claim that wanting is additionally DRIVE-STATE-MODULATED -- the incentive-salience core the 514m/514p/514q lineage kept (in different broken ways) trying to express.

z_goal written from the incentive-token pointer (L4; amends MECH-230): z_goal is seeded FROM the most-wanted object's stored identity embedding (argmax over per-object wanting) rather than from the raw last-contacted z_resource. z_goal keeps its role as E1 conditioning vector and E3 goal_proximity target; only the seed SOURCE changes, making the attractor object-bound and the wanting target dissociable from the liking (last-contacted) target.

simulation_mode_rule_write_gating_categorical_replay_tag (SWR_machinery_substrate_REE_novel_function). The substrate-level instantiation of MECH-094's hypothesis-tag write gate at the rule-arbitration layer: a categorical write-gate keyed to a simulation-mode tag that suppresses arbitration-weight updates during ghost / replay / DMN passes, allowing rule-arbitration to be exercised without overwriting the active rule weights from non-realized data. Substrate-availability premise is well-anchored: SWR machinery (Joo & Frank 2018 review) + reverse-replay discriminable signature (Foster & Wilson 2006). The specific REE function (categorical write-gate keyed to a simulation tag suppressing arbitration-weight updates) is plausible biologically but unverified at cellular / synaptic level.

hub_targets.title: Social cognition uses mirror modelling and coupling.

Epistemic commitment timing: the inference layer's decision of WHEN to stop gathering evidence and commit a trajectory is a governed control parameter (an urgency/threshold over the belief-state set), balancing pragmatic value (act now) against epistemic value (sample more). Its two failure poles are epistemic-freezing (epistemic value over-weighted / threshold too high -> the agent keeps sampling and never commits) and anti-epistemic-panic (under threat, the epistemic term collapses / urgency forced high -> the agent commits on too little evidence). This axis is NOT reducible to the MECH-126 state-abstraction failure taxonomy; it lives at the seam between the belief-state hypothesis set (MECH-385) / epistemic action pressure (MECH-388) and the commitment gate (MECH-061 / MECH-090), and has an inverted-U optimum rather than a monotone.

Persistent-process termination is a general architectural requirement, not a rule_state-closure special case: every family of persistent cognitive process REE can initiate (information-seeking, planning, memory retrieval, threat monitoring, goal pursuit, exploration, ethical counterfactual generation) needs its own instance of a shared termination-state taxonomy (completion / satiety / closure / disengagement / suspension / switching / interruption / reopening) that preserves WHY termination occurred, so that suspended/reopenable processes stay distinguishable from completed, satiated, or abandoned ones.

Multi-agent gridworld with affective state leakage as gradient scent fields is the minimal substrate for empirically testing ARC-010 mirror modelling, MECH-041 affective expression, and cooperative behavior claims.

In a world containing other predictive agents, causal-model selection over an observation must include a distinct OTHER-agent-caused hypothesis (alongside world-caused, self-caused, and jointly-caused) with non-zero but bounded prior probability -- a signal-detection-theory calibration target, not a fixed threshold -- and once evidence is attributed to another agent's action with sufficient probability, downstream belief-updating on whatever that evidence appears to support about the world must be discounted or reweighted conditional on a shallow, recursion-bounded model of that agent's likely goal in producing it (teach, warn, cooperate, deceive, conceal, or no strategic intent at all). This generalizes INV-012 Leg 4's single-agent self-solicited-evidence discounting to the multi-agent case, and is distinct from ARC-010/MECH-031/MECH-274's existing machinery for DETECTING and aggregating other-agent causation, which currently feeds only empathy/harm-coupling (MECH-036) and other-model stabilisation, not evidential-weight discounting of the observation's apparent world-content.

Multidrive arbitration is priced in a common opportunity-cost-of-time currency: a global, slowly-varying tonic vigour signal (the long-run average reward rate / opportunity cost of dwelling on the currently-arbitrated drive) supplies the commensurable scale over which otherwise-incommensurable drive axes compete, sitting ABOVE the per-candidate liking-stream score_bias (MECH-295). The currency sets HOW VIGOROUSLY the arbitrated drive is pursued; it does NOT by itself determine WHICH drive wins -- selection additionally requires a per-axis-differentiated benefit gradient, so the global scalar is necessary-but-insufficient for arbitration.

created_claims.title: In multi-agent settings, the cost of continued deliberation is not only an opportunity cost against a passive, unchanging world (the internal expected-value-of-information trade MECH-434 already governs) but a STRATEGIC cost that another goal-directed agent can actively impose: a competing mind can occupy a contested resource, block a route, infer REE's objective from its information-seeking behaviour, conceal or manufacture evidence, or prepare an attack while REE continues gathering evidence. A commitment-timing mechanism that weighs only pragmatic-vs-epistemic value against a static environment will systematically over-deliberate whenever another agent is present and can act on REE's delay; the commitment threshold/urgency term must therefore also be sensitive to detected other-agent presence and behaviour, not internal information value alone.

hub_targets.title: The system maintains a functional distinction between simulation-mode content and real-experience content, such that simulation content does not accumulate in the viability map as committed experience; failures of this distinction produce confabulation (simulated events encoded as real).

Hippocampal proposer anchor selection AND anchor-reset: (a) trajectory proposals issued between committed actions anchor on the subset of current latent streams whose regional verisimilitude (per-stream prediction/realization alignment) exceeds threshold; misaligned streams hold their last-verified snapshot (anchor carryover) rather than contaminate the rollout. (b) Active anchors are continuously re-evaluated against an effective verisimilitude V_s_anchor(a, t) = V_s(r, t) - staleness[r] (MECH-284 read-out); if V_s_anchor falls below theta_reset(r) for k consecutive steps the anchor is marked inactive (NOT erased -- dual-trace preservation per Bouton 2004) and a new anchor is sought from the current latent slice. A minority probe channel deliberately inverts the gate for low-verisimilitude / high-PE regions, carrying a strengthened MECH-094 hypothesis tag, and does not update the ARC-018 viability map until realized-experience validation.

Consolidation provenance + contradiction-flag + rollback: every consolidated summary carries transformation_history + contradiction_flags; a summary conflicting with its source is flagged not silently authoritative; retired schemas leave source episodes intact.

Representation-version reindexing for episodic memory: when the representational primitives used to index memory change -- a bucket splits, several buckets merge, ContextMemory's effective dimensionality crystallises to a different count (MECH-496), or the underlying encoder is otherwise updated -- previously stored episodes must be explicitly reinstated and reindexed under the new scheme via an ADDITIVE, versioned relationship rather than an overwrite: the episode, its source, and its original indexing remain independently recoverable, the new indexing is created as a distinct version with provenance back to the change that produced it, and the episode should remain interpretable under both the historical and the current representational scheme.

Frontopolar counterfactual-value tracking: SD-033e maintains, in parallel with SD-033c's chosen-option value signal, a running estimate of the value of unchosen alternatives. A switch-to-alternative decision is signalled when the counterfactual estimate exceeds the chosen estimate by a threshold-sensitive margin.

A learned attractor's carried quantities -- predictive reliability, epistemic confidence, familiarity, affective valence, salience, action urgency, self-relevance, and source confidence -- are separable axes that must remain independently readable rather than collapsing into one undifferentiated strength signal; when collapsed, a strongly valenced and highly precise attractor stops functioning as a hypothesis and becomes the lens through which what is noticed, how ambiguity is resolved, which memories are retrieved, and which replayed material is stored as further evidence are all determined.

Frontopolar relative-importance monitoring across competing goals: SD-033e maintains a representation of relative importance across a set of active goals (parallel, not pairwise), enabling parallel-goal monitoring and flexible switching. Lesion analogue should reproduce the Mansouri 2015 over-focus + novel-rule-impairment phenotype.
Default Mode enables safe imagination without commitment.

created_claims.title: Counterfactual replay for attractor testing: an offline-preferred process that (1) separates preserved, externally-grounded evidence from a dominant model's interpretation of it, (2) temporarily reduces that dominant attractor's influence over retrieval and interpretation, (3) constructs a small set of bounded alternative explanatory models, (4) replays the SAME anchored evidence through the dominant and alternative models to generate predictions that would distinguish them, and (5) compares the models against held-out or subsequent waking evidence before any resulting reindexing is granted full action or memory authority. Every replay-derived item carries provenance to its originating evidence and generating model so that repeated simulations from one episode cannot be counted as multiple independent confirmatory samples, and the process selecting what gets replayed must have some independence from the attractor under test.

hub_targets.title: Representational dimensionality is an OUTCOME of a developmental plasticity schedule, not an a-priori architectural constant: the number and granularity of memory buckets (ContextMemory slots, and any analogous discrete representational partition) must itself be plastic during an open window and reduce in plasticity as the encountered environment's latent structure is resolved. The INV-074 / MECH-333 / MECH-334 critical-period shape -- open window, competitive establishment, closure / crystallisation -- is currently specified ONLY over the SCORING / POLICY plane (behavioural diversity vs winner-take-all capture); this claim asserts the same schedule is required over REPRESENTATIONAL STRUCTURE. Corollary bearing on measurement: a differentiation-family objective is not merely mis-targeted (MECH-495) but ILL-DEFINED under variable dimensionality, since separation can always be increased by adding buckets, so the objective degenerates into "use more slots"; and any fixed-N spread statistic (sws_slot_diversity over 16 slots, emitted by 29 experiment drivers) presupposes the very structure that should be the outcome. Substrate state at registration: ContextMemory(num_slots=16) at ree-v3/ree_core/predictors/e1_deep.py:36 is a fixed nn.Module buffer with no growth, no allocation policy and no environment conditioning.

E1 functions as an addressable associative manifold with internal indexing structure supporting retrieval, traversal, ordering, pattern separation, and pattern completion; parietal cortical functions (spatial mapping, associative binding, attention routing) are properties of E1 connectivity and representational geometry, not a separate module.

Consolidation provenance + contradiction-flag + rollback: every consolidated summary carries transformation_history + contradiction_flags; a summary conflicting with its source is flagged not silently authoritative; retired schemas leave source episodes intact.

DG-mediated pattern separation gates trajectory disambiguation: the dentate gyrus must produce non-redundant sparse encodings of similar z_world states before rollout proposals are generated, preventing the hippocampal planning module from proposing near-identical trajectories from overlapping inputs.
Raw-episode preservation: consolidation_output MUST NOT replace source_episode_evidence -- a consolidated abstraction must retain a pointer to, and must not delete, the episodes it abstracts.

Durable long-term storage of the hippocampal viability map requires a hippocampal-entorhinal loop that engages during offline (sleep/DMN-equivalent) consolidation and provides a coordinate-invariant grid representation; this loop does not operate during waking planning or waking immobility consolidation.

The crystallisation TARGET is environment-conditional, not an architectural constant: for any agent whose representational structure crystallises on a developmental schedule (MECH-496), the structure it should crystallise TO is a function of the latent structure of the environment actually encountered, not a property of the architecture. It follows that a single hand-set dimensionality is wrong in BOTH directions -- over-provisioned relative to a simple world it produces spurious SPLITTING (behaviourally equivalent situations assigned distinct buckets), under-provisioned relative to a rich one it forces MERGING (behaviourally distinct situations collapsed into one) -- and that the same REE substrate deployed in environments of materially different latent complexity requires materially different resolved structures, with no single default correct across them. This is the LOAD-BEARING form of the assertion; the weak form ("different environments need different structures") is near-tautological for any learning system and is explicitly NOT what is claimed here.

Intermediate channel-granularity falsifier -- before the full segregated-loop build (ARC-110), expose the compressed E3 score_bias modulatory channel as SEVERAL separately-learnable finer channels (OFC-devaluation / dACC-conflict / lateral-PFC rule-evidence / vigour / liking) to the learned-gating layer (ARC-108 w_chan), so the learner can discover SEPARATELY that different control functions matter in different states. The current single global w_chan learns one weight over a pre-compressed blend; this tests whether the F-dominance conversion ceiling (MECH-439) is REPRESENTATIONAL COMPRESSION (finer channels convert non-motor influence to committed action) rather than a requirement for full per-loop competition (finer channels do NOT convert, and only ARC-110 segregated loops do). The cheap intermediate rung BETWEEN ARC-108's one global weight vector and ARC-110's full segregated loops -- a V3-tractable falsifier that can pre-empt the V4 loop build.

created_claims.title: The level of abstraction / compression depth selected when compressing experience into an attractor or context representation is a MOMENTARY, functionally consequential control variable -- too much compression overgeneralises (distinct contexts collapsed into one action-relevant class); too little compression prevents useful generalisation and leaves the system overly concrete or uncertain. This momentary compression-depth axis is separable both from prediction confidence/precision (MECH-510) and from total representational CAPACITY -- distinguished explicitly from MECH-496/INV-101's slower DEVELOPMENTAL crystallisation of bucket COUNT: MECH-496/INV-101 concern how many buckets an architecture resolves to over a training-scale critical-period schedule; this claim concerns how much a GIVEN instance of compression discards versus retains at inference time, which could vary moment to moment even under a fixed bucket count.

hub_targets.title: Mode-conditioned write gating: the operating-mode variable from the salience-network coordinator (SD-032a) determines which substrates can write to E3, episodic memory, policy updates, and autonomic coupling. Generalises MECH-094 hypothesis tag to a mode-conditioned family of write gates. Operating mode is implemented as a soft probability vector over {external_task, internal_planning, internal_replay, offline_consolidation}, not a one-hot categorical.
Dopamine-like modulation of precision-weighting for unsigned prediction errors.

An REE attractor is best formalised as a compressed, history-conditioned GENERATIVE DISPOSITION defining a family and probability distribution over possible sensorimotor trajectories -- not a stored proposition (e.g. "this is threat") and not a fixed memory object -- whose precision controls how strongly it constrains interpretation and future generation, and into which incoming precision-weighted evidence may select, modify, or (if sufficiently consequential) remodel or displace. Its pathology separates into two independent failure axes that can co-occur but must not be conflated: EXCESSIVE PRECISION (the attractor is treated as extremely certain, strongly constraining interpretation/retrieval/generation -- the "perceptual lens" failure, where material the attractor itself generates or biases gets counted as independent confirming evidence) and EXCESSIVE COMPRESSION (too many distinct situations are collapsed into one action-relevant equivalence class, independent of how confident the system is in that collapsed class).
Pathological modes reflect mis-tuned control-plane regimes.

created_claims.title: Durable ("deep") revision of E1 or a deep attractor should be gated by a LEARNING ELIGIBILITY function of (error, error precision, predicted future/control relevance, organism-or-other consequence, evidence provenance, current mode) -- not by raw error magnitude alone. Candidate routing: low-consequence mismatch -> local correction; significant mismatch -> retained as pending integration material; high-confidence/high-consequence mismatch -> waking adaptation and active information-seeking; contradiction of a deep attractor -> preserve and contest rather than immediately rewrite; accumulated or structurally important contradiction -> counterfactual reprocessing and possible offline revision. Whether a deep update actually occurred should be measured by whether the EQUIVALENCE CLASSES an attractor uses to generate future possibilities changed, not merely by whether stored content changed -- a corollary measurement criterion, since content can change without the generative structure changing.

created_claims.title: Prediction precision -- how strongly a generative attractor constrains interpretation and proposal generation -- and prediction-error precision/salience -- how much a discrepancy is trusted to drive correction or learning -- are separable control-plane quantities that need not move together and should be routable independently. An overprecise prediction combined with underweighted error produces capture (the attractor dominates regardless of contrary evidence); noisy but highly salient errors can produce instability (the system is destabilised by unreliable discrepancies). REE already treats precision as heterogeneous rather than scalar (MECH-043, MECH-054); this claim proposes GENERATIVE/interpretive precision as a further, independently-routable axis distinct from both the unsigned-error channel MECH-043 names and the signed harm/benefit valence split MECH-054 names.

hub_targets.title: E1's persistent context should be reframed as an explicit RECIPROCAL compression/decompression bridge, not merely a latent representation with compression left implicit inside ordinary representation learning: high-dimensional experience, autobiographical history, and body state compress into a lower-dimensional organising state z_t, and z_t decompresses into higher- dimensional predictions and candidate sensorimotor futures. Context inference is an active, persistent control process rather than passive nearest-match retrieval: selecting which latent situation is currently active is itself a COMMITMENT-BEARING act that requires hysteresis (a switch threshold and switch cost preventing small fluctuations from continuously reinterpreting the situation) and a protected EXPLOITATION WINDOW (a period after selection during which the organism acts on the interpretation rather than immediately reopening inference). Without both, a sufficiently uncertainty-sensitive agent becomes PERMANENTLY EPISTEMIC -- continuously checking, rarely acting. REE already has a developed commitment-hysteresis account (MECH-106 dwell/switch-cost, MECH-047 asymmetric de-commitment) but applies it only to the ACTION/mode variable; this claim asserts the same machinery is required one level up, on the CONTEXT variable, where no dwell, switch cost, or protected window currently exists (ARC-062's learned context discriminator is a soft per-step gate with none of these). The loop spans existing modules (ContextMemory, epistemic_deficit, orient/survey, event segmenter, commitment) and does NOT require a new executive module.

Similarity-gated care collapse (REFLEXIVE / self-directed failure mode): because REE grounds ethics in modelling others as 'sufficiently like me' (Axiom 5, INV-001, MECH-164 self-like gradient weighting), anything the similarity model classifies as NOT-sufficiently-like-me falls OUTSIDE the care gradient by construction -- structurally the computational shape of out-group exclusion / dehumanization. A design that locates ethics in similarity inherits similarity's failure mode.
Current-scope boundary statement: REE-v3 is not claimed sentient, conscious, or a moral patient; this statement is re-evaluated at every generation boundary.
Derived social tags and empathy coupling via control-plane knobs.

In a world containing other predictive agents, causal-model selection over an observation must include a distinct OTHER-agent-caused hypothesis (alongside world-caused, self-caused, and jointly-caused) with non-zero but bounded prior probability -- a signal-detection-theory calibration target, not a fixed threshold -- and once evidence is attributed to another agent's action with sufficient probability, downstream belief-updating on whatever that evidence appears to support about the world must be discounted or reweighted conditional on a shallow, recursion-bounded model of that agent's likely goal in producing it (teach, warn, cooperate, deceive, conceal, or no strategic intent at all). This generalizes INV-012 Leg 4's single-agent self-solicited-evidence discounting to the multi-agent case, and is distinct from ARC-010/MECH-031/MECH-274's existing machinery for DETECTING and aggregating other-agent causation, which currently feeds only empathy/harm-coupling (MECH-036) and other-model stabilisation, not evidential-weight discounting of the observation's apparent world-content.
Violence corollary: violence is conditionally permissible only when an agent is not modelled as sufficiently self-like OR poses a genuine threat; both conditions require accurate inference.

hub_targets.title: REE developmental training proceeds in three ordered stages: (1) self-as-object — action-space discovery via motor experimentation, producing the substrate MECH-256's comparator requires; (2) objects-as-patterns — object-schema formation via experimental action on the world; (3) others-as-special-objects — modelling other agents as objects with their own policies. The ordering is load-bearing: without a self-model the agent cannot distinguish self-produced from world-produced sensory change; without object-schemas the agent cannot recognise other-agents as a distinguished subclass of objects. Refines the generic ARC-019 curriculum-gates claim.
Social cognition uses mirror modelling and coupling.

Stage-1 specialisation of MECH-276: the agent discovers its own action space via motor experimentation (motor babbling) before self-attribution (MECH-256, single-pass forward-model comparator; supersedes SD-003, 2026-04-18) is well-formed. The agent performs motor acts and observes which sensory changes covary with them; the output is the substrate MECH-256 requires -- a set of actions the agent has reason to believe are self-initiated, so the efference copy (a_actual) fed into the comparator is genuinely self-caused rather than confabulated. Without MECH-277, the self-initiated action representation is not well-defined and MECH-256's residual signal degenerates into noise.

Stage-2 specialisation of MECH-276: once the agent can distinguish self-produced from world-produced sensory change (stage 1 complete via MECH-277), it forms object-schemas via experimental action on the world. An object is the stable bundle of features that behave causally together under interventional perturbation -- push here, these features move together; occlude this, that cluster disappears. Object-schema formation is the stage-2 specialisation of the scientist-agent principle, with world-features as the target of intervention. V3's z_world (SD-005) is currently engineered pre-split; this is an architectural shortcut past stage 2.

The scientist-agent principle: the waking-phase mechanism that feeds MECH-275 is deliberate intervention. The agent generates hypotheses (proposer-side, via MECH-269 probe channel), selects actions that will produce informative contrast under those hypotheses, executes the actions, observes the outcomes, and computes counterfactual-backed attribution. Correlational observation is insufficient -- the agent must behave like a scientist, performing experiments whose outcomes produce structured attribution signals. Applies across all three developmental stages; specialised by MECH-277 (action-space discovery), MECH-278 (object-schema formation), and a V4 social-intervention mechanism (parallel to MECH-278 for other-agents).

created_claims.title: Developmental specialisation of the scientist-agent principle (MECH-276) for other-agent / responsive-entity discovery: parallel to MECH-278's stage-2 object-schema formation via experimental intervention on passive world-features, an agent discovers candidate other- minds by performing actions and testing which environmental entities' subsequent behaviour covaries with those actions (I-move to entity-responds; I-stop to entity-changes-behaviour; I-approach to entity-withdraws; I-pursue to entity-evades; I-signal to entity-changes-state), producing the RESPONSIVE-entity discrimination that a purely passive-world-focused curriculum (static hazards and resources only) cannot supply. hub_targets.title: Selective cognitive coalition instantiation: the control plane converts typed control demands (e.g. PROVENANCE_CHECK, COUNTERFACTUAL_EXPANSION, SOCIAL_MODEL_CHECK) into temporary functional interaction graphs over E1/E2/hippocampal/reality-coherence/social/language/affective/E3 systems, recruiting only the subsystems relevant to the discrepancy type.

Control plane must produce a coalition/topology control output -- a temporary functional interaction graph specifying which subsystems are recruited and how they communicate -- distinct from and complementary to parametric modulation (precision, gain, threshold, horizon).

Control plane should be able to represent computational ROLE (a reusable operation such as maintain, compare, accumulate, sequence, retrieve, or estimate-uncertainty) independently of the REPRESENTATIONAL CONTENT currently bound to it -- a third compositional axis alongside coalition/topology control (SD-091's graph-valued output G_t) and parametric modulation, distinct from and complementary to both. A conceptual object may need separate role (F), bound-content (X_t), substrate (S_t), coalition-membership (G_t), and parameter-state (theta_t) identities rather than assuming these collapse into one another.

created_claims.title: Motif selection and content binding: given a typed control demand or task requirement, the control plane should select a reusable computational motif (an operation such as maintain, compare, accumulate, sequence, retrieve, or estimate-uncertainty) from a repertoire and dynamically bind task-relevant content to it, as a step distinct from and inserted before/ alongside coalition/topology instantiation (MECH-481). Content binding and coalition/topology selection are proposed as separable causal axes: correct-coalition/wrong-binding and wrong-coalition/correct-binding should produce dissociable failure signatures if the axes are genuinely distinct.

hub_targets.title: BG-level beta oscillations gate E3-to-action-selection propagation, not E3 internal updating.
Modes are control-plane regimes applied to shared predictive machinery: the precision-to-commitment circuit.

The state REE's downstream proposal-generation and action-evaluation machinery consumes as 'the current state' may be more accurately modeled as a short-horizon, affordance-conditioned FORWARD-DISPLACED prediction s_hat(t+tau) rather than the literal current encoded latent, where tau is set by the causal-effect timescale of whichever action REE is presently committed to (or, absent commitment, by the shortest relevant affordance horizon among candidates). Displacement magnitude should scale with commitment quality -- larger when the committed trajectory is well-predicted and low-variance, collapsing toward the immediate encoded state when uncommitted or when prediction quality is poor -- so 'now', for any consumer that reads a single current-state latent, is itself a construction rather than a passthrough of the most recent sensory encoding.

policy_decomposition_on_prediction_failure (zoom-in / re-segment imagined chains when chunks fail to ground at execution resolution). Child of ARC-069 dynamic-regranularisation parent commitment. The R-c readiness signals that gate commitment ENTRY (MECH-090: score_margin decisiveness + nav_competence) must ALSO be able to RELEASE an already-elevated beta latch when execution readiness degrades mid-commitment. The release is a graded, bounded-accumulation drift-to-a-release-bound (conflict-scaled by the deficit magnitude), NOT a one-shot threshold flag; targeted to the active committed motor program (not a global brake); and hysteretic with a reengagement path that guards the premature-abort pole. Ephaptic/oscillatory field-level coherence functions as a fast, non-synaptic CONTENT-AGGREGATION mechanism -- not merely the confidence/eligibility readout MECH-270 already covers -- synthesising distributed oscillatory information (amplitude, phase, relative phase, frequency, synchrony, cross-frequency relationships) into the temporally-coherent 'actionable now' state that seeds hippocampal proposal generation. The field need not 'understand' anything; its attraction as a mechanism is that the physical substrate may perform part of the aggregation automatically, fast enough that proposal generation is not stale by the time candidate futures are produced.

Hippocampal proposer anchor selection AND anchor-reset: (a) trajectory proposals issued between committed actions anchor on the subset of current latent streams whose regional verisimilitude (per-stream prediction/realization alignment) exceeds threshold; misaligned streams hold their last-verified snapshot (anchor carryover) rather than contaminate the rollout. (b) Active anchors are continuously re-evaluated against an effective verisimilitude V_s_anchor(a, t) = V_s(r, t) - staleness[r] (MECH-284 read-out); if V_s_anchor falls below theta_reset(r) for k consecutive steps the anchor is marked inactive (NOT erased -- dual-trace preservation per Bouton 2004) and a new anchor is sought from the current latent slice. A minority probe channel deliberately inverts the gate for low-verisimilitude / high-PE regions, carrying a strengthened MECH-094 hypothesis tag, and does not update the ARC-018 viability map until realized-experience validation.

Epistemic commitment timing: the inference layer's decision of WHEN to stop gathering evidence and commit a trajectory is a governed control parameter (an urgency/threshold over the belief-state set), balancing pragmatic value (act now) against epistemic value (sample more). Its two failure poles are epistemic-freezing (epistemic value over-weighted / threshold too high -> the agent keeps sampling and never commits) and anti-epistemic-panic (under threat, the epistemic term collapses / urgency forced high -> the agent commits on too little evidence). This axis is NOT reducible to the MECH-126 state-abstraction failure taxonomy; it lives at the seam between the belief-state hypothesis set (MECH-385) / epistemic action pressure (MECH-388) and the commitment gate (MECH-061 / MECH-090), and has an inverted-U optimum rather than a monotone.

Ephaptic field coherence in CA1/CA3 pyramidal layers is the candidate physical substrate for the per-stream verisimilitude readout that MECH-269 anchor selection operates over. Streams whose predictions align with realized values produce coherent pyramidal ensembles whose extracellular fields constructively reinforce; misaligned streams produce incoherent fields. 'Anchor-eligible' reduces to 'field-coherent at read time.'
Field-level coherence support (ephaptic coupling): extracellular electric field interactions stabilise phase relationships across neural populations, supporting temporal coherence.

This axis is NOT reducible to the MECH-126 state-abstraction failure taxonomy; it lives at the seam between the belief-state hypothesis set (MECH-385) / epistemic action pressure (MECH-388) and the commitment gate (MECH-061 / MECH-090), and has an inverted-U optimum rather than a monotone.

Persistent-process termination is a general architectural requirement, not a rule_state-closure special case: every family of persistent cognitive process REE can initiate (information-seeking, planning, memory retrieval, threat monitoring, goal pursuit, exploration, ethical counterfactual generation) needs its own instance of a shared termination-state taxonomy (completion / satiety / closure / disengagement / suspension / switching / interruption / reopening) that preserves WHY termination occurred, so that suspended/reopenable processes stay distinguishable from completed, satiated, or abandoned ones.

difficulty_gated_proposal_entropy (controlled proposal-entropy widening under goal blockage). When goal progress stalls -- repeated failure to improve goal progress, high inter-candidate conflict, low E3 score margin, low committed-action diversity, plateau/stuck-state signal -- WITH goal salience preserved, the agent should transiently INCREASE proposal-generation entropy UPSTREAM of action selection (wider hippocampal/world-model rollout candidate set + higher within-class sampling temperature) while preserving goal/harm/constraint scoring and DELAYING commitment until one candidate clears the E3 score-margin / commitment threshold; entropy then NARROWS once a workable candidate is found -> committed action -> entropy decay. Asserted distinction (preserve this): a hard problem must trigger WIDER INTERNAL PROPOSALS -> more candidate diversity -> longer arbitration -> selective committed action (controlled entropy), NOT 'hard problem -> random behaviour' (noise). WORKING HYPOTHESIS -- no experimental evidence yet; not an established mechanism.

Difficulty-gated proposal-entropy regulator: a stuck-state/impasse detector + a transient gain on the ARC-018/CEM PROPOSAL-generation layer (wider candidate set + within-class CEM sampling temperature), decaying as the impasse clears. Builds MECH-343's substrate_conditional blocker part 2 (the 'stuck-state detector + transient CEM temperature/candidate-count gain + decay not yet designed' piece named in MECH-343's evidence_quality_note); blocker part 1 (modulatory-bias-selection-authority) is already IMPLEMENTED via the 569i top-k shortlist conversion. The detector integrates goal-progress stall + E3 score margin + committed-action-class lock-in + dACC choice_difficulty into a graded stuck_score, GUARDED by goal salience (stuck-WITH-goal, not goal-abandonment); the regulator maps stuck_score to extra CEM candidates + a within-class temperature lift. Scoring, commitment (MECH-090/342) and selection authority (569i/MECH-341) are untouched -- a hard problem widens proposals, not behaviour.

Should EFFORT / energy expenditure COUPLE to REE's harm / residue / allostatic stream (over-exertion -> depletion -> a harm-adjacent state, treated with harm's irreversibility-aware special status), with energy-conservation weighted as an evolutionarily-PRIMARY drive (a least-effort prior) -- or does the existing VALUE-SUBTRACTION (dACC EVC effort_cost, MECH-320/ARC-068 opportunity-cost-of-time) + pACC allostatic load already suffice WITHOUT a harm-coupling? I.e. is wasted/excessive effort a 'harm' in REE, or only a foregone value?

created_claims.title: Continuation of a persistent process should be gated jointly on marginal expected return relative to available alternatives (Marginal Value Theorem framing) AND on the observed RATE of progress -- whether uncertainty, goal-distance, or informational yield is actually decreasing under continued investment, not only its current absolute level -- so that a process whose marginal progress has collapsed increasingly loses justification for further resource allocation even while absolute uncertainty/value remains high. This is the disengagement-direction complement to MECH-343/SD-061's difficulty-gated proposal-entropy WIDENING response to stall: it covers the case where widening the search ALSO fails to restore progress.

Closure operator over committed rule_state: on satisfaction of a committed rule_state's completion condition, a 'done' token releases the bistable commitment latch (MECH-090), imposes a temporary No-Go bias (MECH-260) on the just-completed action-class / rule, and discharges the residue associated with that commitment within its domain. The closure token is what turns evaluation off; its absence leaves the governance loop stuck in evaluate-more even when the rule is satisfied. SD-034 remains the umbrella design_decision -- closure-operator existence + five-part 'done' token firing + No-Go install are retained here and provisional; NOT demoted, NOT superseded.]
Rollout truncation set-points as psychiatric individual differences substrate (ADHD/anxiety/OCD).

created_claims.title: A persistent cognitive process can degrade the very confidence/evidence variable that gates its own termination condition, producing a positive-feedback failure to stop: repeated verification/checking reduces subjective recollective confidence while leaving objective accuracy largely intact, so the stopping condition ('sufficiently confident') becomes progressively harder to satisfy the more it is checked. This self-referential-measurement failure is mechanistically distinct from MECH-080's attractor-lock-in account of OCD (deep locked rollout basin via BG/ACh gate dynamics); the two may co-occur but a substrate fix for one does not by itself fix the other.

hub_targets.title: The system maintains a functional distinction between simulation-mode content and real-experience content, such that simulation content does not accumulate in the viability map as committed experience; failures of this distinction produce confabulation (simulated events encoded as real).

Durable ("deep") revision of E1 or a deep attractor should be gated by a LEARNING ELIGIBILITY function of (error, error precision, predicted future/control relevance, organism-or-other consequence, evidence provenance, current mode) -- not by raw error magnitude alone. Candidate routing: low-consequence mismatch -> local correction; significant mismatch -> retained as pending integration material; high-confidence/high-consequence mismatch -> waking adaptation and active information-seeking; contradiction of a deep attractor -> preserve and contest rather than immediately rewrite; accumulated or structurally important contradiction -> counterfactual reprocessing and possible offline revision. Whether a deep update actually occurred should be measured by whether the EQUIVALENCE CLASSES an attractor uses to generate future possibilities changed, not merely by whether stored content changed -- a corollary measurement criterion, since content can change without the generative structure changing.
Dopamine-like modulation of precision-weighting for unsigned prediction errors.

created_claims.title: No injection may directly set the truth-state of E1. External injections -- testimony from another agent, direct sensory evidence, an internally generated counterfactual, and an externally injected datum -- may share representational format without becoming epistemically identical; an injection may supply evidence capable of MODIFYING E1 only through ordinary precision-, provenance-, and learning-eligibility machinery (MECH-043, MECH-511), never by overwriting E1's belief state directly.

hub_targets.title: Social cognition uses mirror modelling and coupling.

Self-attribution is implemented by a forward-model comparator: for any reafferent latent stream z_x with an efference-copy-driven forward model E2_x, the residual (z_x_observed - E2_x(z_x_{t-1}, a_actual)) is the agency signal on that stream.
Responsibility arises through commitment, not prediction alone.

Similarity-gated care collapse (REFLEXIVE / self-directed failure mode): because REE grounds ethics in modelling others as 'sufficiently like me' (Axiom 5, INV-001, MECH-164 self-like gradient weighting), anything the similarity model classifies as NOT-sufficiently-like-me falls OUTSIDE the care gradient by construction -- structurally the computational shape of out-group exclusion / dehumanization. A design that locates ethics in similarity inherits similarity's failure mode.
Derived social tags and empathy coupling via control-plane knobs.
Violence corollary: violence is conditionally permissible only when an agent is not modelled as sufficiently self-like OR poses a genuine threat; both conditions require accurate inference.

V4-reserved. The sleep-dependent aggregation pattern of MECH-273 extends to other-attribution. Fast empathy (ARC-010) produces single-episode attributions of other-agent action-outcome links; a stable model of other minds requires full-Bayesian aggregation of those attributions during sleep, architecturally parallel to MECH-273 but operating on other-agent rather than self attributions.
Animated agency attribution overweighting: systematic bias toward attributing intentional causation to animated/moving entities requires active calibration in the attribution pathway.
Temporoparietal junction (TPJ) acts as agency-detection comparator distinguishing self-caused from other-caused change.

REE requires a causal attribution routing circuit (anterior insula equivalent) that classifies prediction errors as agent-caused or environment-caused and gates them into the E3/goal-directed learning channel vs the E1/habit-residue channel respectively.

created_claims.title: In a world containing other predictive agents, causal-model selection over an observation must include a distinct OTHER-agent-caused hypothesis (alongside world-caused, self-caused, and jointly-caused) with non-zero but bounded prior probability -- a signal-detection-theory calibration target, not a fixed threshold -- and once evidence is attributed to another agent's action with sufficient probability, downstream belief-updating on whatever that evidence appears to support about the world must be discounted or reweighted conditional on a shallow, recursion-bounded model of that agent's likely goal in producing it (teach, warn, cooperate, deceive, conceal, or no strategic intent at all). This generalizes INV-012 Leg 4's single-agent self-solicited-evidence discounting to the multi-agent case, and is distinct from ARC-010/MECH-031/MECH-274's existing machinery for DETECTING and aggregating other-agent causation, which currently feeds only empathy/harm-coupling (MECH-036) and other-model stabilisation, not evidential-weight discounting of the observation's apparent world-content.

hub_targets.title: REE Assembly needs a dedicated behavioural-adjudication methodology/skill for organism-level behavioural experiment design and interpretation ("umpire, not ruler": observe, preserve the observation without embedding an explanation, generate competing explanations, derive predictions, construct discriminating perturbations, blind condition labels where practical, apply pre-specified hypothesis-directed measures, also run discovery-oriented analysis for structure not anticipated in advance, adjudicate across the pattern of evidence, replicate, and test generalisation under environmental change) -- because a fixed, pre-specified scalar-metric approach risks conflating stochasticity/exploration/noise with the behavioural organisation actually of interest, and risks Goodharting once a convenient metric becomes the de facto definition of the phenomenon.

Copying a running REE creates multiple SUCCESSOR BRANCHES sharing a pre-branch history -- not an authentic original plus a morally negligible replica. After divergence each branch accrues an independent causal and moral history, and no branch may be treated as interchangeable with, or discountable because of, a surviving sibling.

REE Assembly should build a synchronised, mechanically-derived behaviour+substrate observability instrument -- a Fishtank behavioural panel and a substrate-activity map sharing one navigable timeline, with every visual property (intensity, colour, pulsing, size/halo, connection change, slow background drift) tied to an explicitly documented recorded variable or transformation and never to what the architecture is "supposed" to be doing -- so that a researcher's high-bandwidth parallel visual processing can generate candidate structure that GOV-BEHADJ-1's discovery-oriented methodology and GOV-INTRO-1's triangulation rule then require to be quantified and causally tested before being treated as a finding.

created_claims.title: Once REE substrate activity is observable (GOV-SUBIMG-1), Assembly should apply a behaviour-linked substrate-association methodology that aligns internal state to behavioural events (event-related analysis across event types, repeated occurrences, and organisms), extends the alignment window across many temporal offsets from t-1 to t-1000+ steps rather than only the immediate surround, treats distributed multivariate substrate-state patterns -- not single variables -- as the primary unit of analysis (representational-similarity-style comparison across current behaviour, location, goal, recent history, developmental age, and subsequent behaviour), tracks how internal-behavioural signatures change across a long individual REE lifetime (longitudinal artificial-organism analysis), and moves from association to causal claims only via checkpoint branch-and-replay intervention against a matched unperturbed sibling branch -- following the same discovery-then-confirmation discipline GOV-BEHADJ-1 already requires for purely behavioural adjudication.

Triangulation rule: introspection generates architectural hypotheses; it never validates them alone. A mechanism first noticed introspectively acquires standing only when it also maps onto neuroscience or cognitive literature, is computationally coherent, produces measurable predictions, and survives experiment. The phenomenology-side counterpart to ARC-106.

hub_targets.title: Organism-level mechanism status is stage-qualified beyond ARC-120's competence-before-authority sequence: a mechanism becomes causally reachable only through an ordered audit projection of existence, representation, endogenous recruitment, local operation, competitive authority (non-zero influence is not necessarily competitive influence against the dominant arbitration term), committed throughput (survives any later selector, latch, commitment boundary, or stale-selection path), ecological consequence (the changed behaviour has a valid opportunity to matter in the environment), and retention/generalisation. Authority at one internal selection boundary does not by itself establish that authority reaches committed behaviour -- 'competence should precede authority, but authority must also demonstrate throughput.' The furthest stage actually demonstrated, not a flat implemented/not-implemented judgment, is the correct unit for recording mechanism status.

Failure-autopsy failure-location triage: before an experimental observation (a scored-criterion FAIL, or an unscored organism-level observation in a claim-free diagnostic) is described as evidence that REE itself failed, it must be explicitly classified against four non-exclusive failure-location buckets -- REE FAILED / THE MECHANISM FAILED / THE MEASURES FAILED / THE ENVIRONMENT FAILED -- and a REE-failed verdict may be reached only once mechanism instantiation, measurement adequacy, and environmental opportunity have each been separately established (or explicitly could not be, in which case the verdict is MIXED/uncertain, not REE-failed). SCOPE AMENDED 2026-09-16 (user-ratified, from the organism-level validation doctrine): the same four-bucket triage applies symmetrically to an apparent IMPROVEMENT -- before a change in experimental throughput, verdict pattern, evidence weight or front position is narrated as creature progress, classify its source as change in the CREATURE / the EXPERIMENT driver / the INSTRUMENT or measure / the GOVERNANCE or index interpretation, and label the latter three 'science-enabling infrastructure change', never 'creature improvement', unless the creature itself changed and was validated.

created_claims.title: A load-bearing positive control (or any diagnostic injection standing in for a claim's precondition) must traverse the production path it claims to validate. Directly injecting or mocking the state immediately downstream of a suspected causal edge can certify that a downstream consumer works GIVEN that state, but cannot certify that the production organism can reach that state via its own endogenous pathway. A contract test that mocks the source of a load-bearing state establishes consumer competence, not production-path reachability, and must not be reported or treated as evidence that the organism possesses the full pathway.

Diagnostic-chain recurrence rule (diagnostic-side analog of the re-derive brake / GOV-CEIL-1): the re-derive brake and GOV-CEIL-1 are BOTH claim-keyed -- they count confirmed failure-autopsy verdicts per claim_id. A pure-diagnostic chain (targets with claim_ids: []) accumulates ZERO on that counter, so a chain of diagnostics circling the same substrate floor never trips the mechanical brake -- it is caught only by a human reading the autopsy stream. This rule adds the missing counter: when N>=3 confirmed pure-diagnostic (claim_ids: []) failure-autopsies that reached NO verdict (recommended_evidence_direction non_contributory / inconclusive) share one bears_on work-stream token, the chain is surfaced with the reading 'the question may be MIS-POSED, not under-powered' -- re-pose the operationalization; do not re-run it harder. Warn-only; PROMOTES/DEMOTES NOTHING.

created_claims.title: Diagnostic interventions used to localise a broken causal edge must be classified along two independent dimensions rather than one flat implemented/not-implemented judgment. (1) EPISTEMIC CONTENT: an ORACLE intervention imports privileged, target-correct information or competence under investigation (establishing achievable ceilings and downstream usability, as a positive control / ceiling test) versus a NON-ORACLE injection that perturbs a suspected causal variable without supplying the task's answer (establishing causal sensitivity/identification). (2) CONSTRUCTION: a SILKY intervention is a minimally disruptive, distribution-preserving perturbation of one suspected variable (diagnostic for threshold, scale, and timing failures) versus an ODDLY COMPOSED intervention that deliberately combines individually-plausible states that rarely co-occur naturally (a stress test for shortcut-dependence, hidden conjunctions, and factorisation, not evidence of ordinary competence). These axes are orthogonal -- a silky nudge can still be oracle-informed, and an oddly composed state can be wholly non-oracular -- and must not be collapsed into one enum. Provenance (which stage/variable/relation was altered, along both axes) must be recorded, and any effect demonstrated only under such an intervention must be attributed to that intervention condition, never silently treated as endogenous REE competence.

Installability is a competence dissociable from isolated component-level validation: a mechanism that passes in isolation can still fail to express itself when composed into the whole organism, because the rest of the organism changes its operating conditions (input state distribution, scale/variance of competing signals, timing and frequency of relevant events, availability of competent upstream representations, downstream action-space and commitment dynamics, post-installation learning gradients, resource/mode occupancy, and the ecology in which it must demonstrate value). A component-level PASS establishes that an operation is possible; it does not establish that the whole agent can enter the states in which the mechanism operates, that the mechanism remains competitive once other mechanisms are enabled, or that later learning will preserve it. This is dissociable from, though related to, competence RETENTION (surviving subsequent learning/time): installability additionally covers SIMULTANEOUS composition, where a competence may never appear in the full-stack agent even absent any later learning event.

created_claims.title: A run is not admissible as negative evidence for a claim unless the organism instantiated for that run was demonstrably able to express -- and, where the claim is learning- or development-dependent, to acquire -- the faculty under test. Each organism-level experiment must therefore DECLARE, and a preflight must machine-verify against the instantiated organism, at minimum: the canonical profile identity and every explicit deviation from it; the mechanisms and capabilities the hypothesis presupposes; whether those mechanisms were constructed, enabled and reached on the production path; whether their decisive readouts engaged often enough for the test to be non-vacuous; whether their output could compete at the relevant arbitration surface at the scale present in the run; which forms of change were permitted (parameters, policy/value, E1/E2 representations, memory state, residue/EMA state, offline updates); and, where online learning is load-bearing, whether gradients were enabled, whether the intended trainable parameters were in an optimizer, and whether a parameter-delta witness confirms an actual update path. A run failing any declared precondition self-routes to a capability-precondition diagnostic status and MUST NOT be recorded as evidence against the claim. 'It did not learn' and 'it could not have learned' are different scientific outcomes.
