REE requires staged developmental training with explicit curriculum gates.

created_claims.title: 'Long life' in an artificial organism is not one property but at least four separable continuities -- cognitive/affective/mnemonic state continuity, parameter/plasticity continuity, body/homeostatic continuity, and ecological/world continuity -- which can be held or broken independently of one another. A persistent-organism experiment must therefore declare which of the four it preserves, because duration under a broken continuity is not developmental opportunity: an organism whose cognitive state persists while its body and world regenerate at every boundary is not aging in a world, and an organism observed for many ticks with its parameters frozen is not developing. The decomposition separates four confounds that a scalar 'lifespan' or 'ticks survived' cannot: age from layout luck, learning from reset effects, injury/recovery from death, and memory accumulation from environmental regeneration.

hub_targets.title: Object identity is a cross-cutting representational primitive. An object is a token-bound identity representation that persists across time and perceptual gaps, generalising z_object/z_resource into an object-file/binding layer (ARC-006), defined by causal feature-coherence under intervention (MECH-278), and consumed by drive/goal (SD-057), hippocampal planning (MECH-262), and the self/other special-object cases. The four planned object capabilities -- (1) permanence, (2) self-as-object, (3) tools/affordances, (4) others-as-object -- are specialisations of one primitive, not four separate mechanisms.

policy_composition_via_repeated_grounding (zoom-out / chunk a sequence of primitives into a single atomic primitive after repeated successful execution). Child of ARC-069 dynamic-regranularisation parent commitment. Architectural commitment: sequences of policy primitives that have been repeatedly executed together with consistent outcomes are accumulated into a single primitive that the rule-apprehension and diversity-generation layers can treat atomically. Trigger: repetition count + outcome consistency (slow accumulator). Direction: zoom out. Phenomenology anchor: 'making coffee was once seventeen motor acts; after a thousand repetitions it is one unit.' Names the TRANSITION mechanism (planned -> habitual chunk) that MECH-163 dual systems presupposes but does not specify.

policy_decomposition_on_prediction_failure (zoom-in / re-segment imagined chains when chunks fail to ground at execution resolution). Child of ARC-069 dynamic-regranularisation parent commitment. Architectural commitment: when an imagined chunk's predicted outcome diverges from what its sub-elements would predict (or when MECH-269 V_s on the chunk's region drops), the chunk is broken into finer primitives in the rollout proposal stream. Trigger: simulation-side prediction failure. Direction: zoom in. Phenomenology anchor: 'I planned go-to-the-kitchen; turns out I need to plan the steps.'

Event-segment detection: a substrate-side two-level hierarchical detector that emits monotonic outer.inner segment IDs on detected event boundaries, feeding region-keyed substrates (anchor sets per MECH-269, V_s readouts per Phase 1, staleness accumulators per MECH-284) and the MECH-287 broadcast trigger at the schema/event-segment scale per Eichenbaum 2017 / Sols-DuBrow-Davachi 2017 / Baldassano 2017. Default substrate: PE-threshold detector on the fast scale (z_world+z_self) and BOCPD-Gaussian latent change-point on the slow scale (z_goal); MECH-287 broadcast fires downstream of MECH-288 boundaries (Clewett 2025) rather than via an independent comparator. The segment_id field is the region key consumed by the V_s invalidation runtime cluster; without it, MECH-269 anchor sets and per-region V_s aggregation have no substrate-native source for the region partition.

Specific modes of REE state abstraction failure -- overmerge, oversplit, temporal context loss, valence mis-tagging, uncertainty collapse, and narrow representational capacity -- produce behavioral signatures that are structurally analogous to empirically described psychiatric conditions, sharing identifiable circuit-level mechanisms.

policy_decomposition_via_event_segmenter (rollout-side consumer of MECH-288 boundary pulses; re-segments the rollout proposal stream at finer grain when a chunk's region shows low V_s / boundary fires on the imagined trajectory). First child mechanism for ARC-070. Bidirectional extension of MECH-288 substrate (R2 lit-pull verdict 2026-05-10): MECH-288 already detects boundaries on whatever latent + PE streams it consumes; MECH-321 wires the rollout / imagination input stream into MECH-288 and consumes the resulting boundary pulses at the policy-primitive layer to decompose chunked primitives into finer-grain sub-elements. PE-driven primary trigger (V_s drop on chunk's region per Zacks 2007 / Schapiro 2017); bottleneck-state framing is a separate consolidation-phase mechanism, not the primary trigger. Recursive multi-level decomposition; depth cap 3 is an ENGINEERING choice, not a literature-derived constant (provenance corrected 2026-07-27 -- see evidence_quality_note). The MULTI-LEVEL commitment is ARC-070's R3 verdict (Badre & D'Esposito 2009) and STANDS; that source never supported a level COUNT, and Badre & Nee 2018 (Badre's own re-appraisal) finds the evidence supports neither a unitary model of lateral frontal function nor a unidimensional abstraction gradient, so there is no single ordered axis along which to cap. The cap rests instead on tractability + operator symmetry (mirrors ARC-071's chunk_max_depth so the inverse operations stay symmetric; open Q-claim on hard-vs-soft). Magnitude prior only, with an explicit grain caveat: Koechlin 2003 resolves a 3-level lateral-PFC cascade (4 with Koechlin & Summerfield 2007 frontopolar branching), but at ANATOMICAL grain -- heterogeneous, anatomically fixed control levels, NOT homogeneous recursion depth of one operator re-applying to its own output. Both pre-commit and mid-execution phases supported via the same mechanism, with downstream effects gated by MECH-094 hypothesis_tag (rollout fires under hypothesis_tag=True write nothing; observation / execution fires under hypothesis_tag=False enable the existing observation-side consumer chain unchanged).

Context slot-formation (schema abstraction: which distinctions between contexts are worth representing) and slot-filling (causal attribution: which evidence populates each slot) are computationally separated functions that cannot be co-computed in a single online pass. Slot structure must be consolidated during an SWS-analog phase before slot-filling during a REM-analog phase can yield reliable attribution signal.

policy_hierarchy_dynamic_regranularisation (parent commitment for dynamic policy-primitive granularity in hippocampal rollout). Architectural commitment: the unit-of-policy that the rule-apprehension layer (ARC-062) and the diversity-generation layer (ARC-065) operate on is itself a dynamic representation, not a fixed primitive. The granularity rescales based on simulation outcomes -- decomposed into finer primitives when a chunk fails to ground at execution / prediction resolution (ARC-070), composed into a single primitive when a sequence has been repeatedly grounded with consistent outcomes (ARC-071). Without this commitment, ARC-007 hippocampal proposals are flat action sequences at fixed grain, and the rule layer must apprehend rules at whatever grain the proposer happens to emit, which may be too fine (combinatorial explosion in rollout) or too coarse (chunks fail to map onto the actual state). Cluster parent for ARC-070 (decomposition) + ARC-071 (composition); registers the architectural commitment that primitives are dynamic before any mechanism work.

created_claims.title: The unit of PERCEPT is a dynamic representation, not a fixed primitive: perceptual grain rescales with circumstance, so that the same scene is individuated coarsely or finely depending on demand. This is the perceptual analogue of ARC-069's already-accepted policy-side commitment, and ARC-069's rationale transfers axis-independently -- a fixed grain is either too fine (combinatorial explosion in what must be tracked and bound) or too coarse (units fail to map onto the actual state). REE has made this commitment for policy (ARC-069/070/071) and for context slots offline (MECH-166) but never for online perception, where the unit remains fixed.

hub_targets.title: Object identity is a cross-cutting representational primitive. An object is a token-bound identity representation that persists across time and perceptual gaps, generalising z_object/z_resource into an object-file/binding layer (ARC-006), defined by causal feature-coherence under intervention (MECH-278), and consumed by drive/goal (SD-057), hippocampal planning (MECH-262), and the self/other special-object cases. The four planned object capabilities -- (1) permanence, (2) self-as-object, (3) tools/affordances, (4) others-as-object -- are specialisations of one primitive, not four separate mechanisms.
Entities are sparse, persistent, bindable structures.

Object-bound incentive-salience layer: insert a per-object incentive layer between the benefit pulse and z_goal. The legacy goal stream wrote a SINGLE z_goal attractor overwritten on every contact, conflating liking (hedonic impact at consumption) with wanting (incentive salience to a cue/object) and goal-location (where) with goal-object (what); wanting target always equalled liking target, so the L9 wanting!=liking dissociation was structurally inexpressible (514l C6=0.0 on all seeds). SD-057 adds (L2 MECH-344) benefit->object-identity binding on the SD-049 per-type tag, (L3 MECH-345) a per-object slow-decay revaluable incentive token with at-recall drive-specific wanting amplitude = base_value*(1+kappa*per_axis_drive), and (L4 MECH-346) z_goal seeded FROM the most-wanted object's stored embedding rather than the raw last-contacted z_resource. v1 = L2+L3+L4 core; L6 cue-recall (MECH-CUEWANT) + L7 dACC-readout-wiring (MECH-CONSUME) deferred to a phase-2 pass within this SD.

Benefit-to-object-identity binding (L2): at resource contact the benefit pulse is bound to the contacted object's identity (the SD-049 per-type tag) via an associative object->benefit node, rather than written as a raw scalar gate against the current world/resource latent. The amygdala/BLA-analog identity-binding node the legacy substrate lacked (cue_features was a V3 no-op stub).

created_claims.title: Selection-relevance is a legitimate object-individuation criterion: an object may be individuated by what it is FOR -- its usefulness relative to goals, harm, and interoceptive/metabolic state -- rather than (only) by the causal coherence of its features under intervention. This is RIVAL to MECH-278 and the two disagree on real cases: causally-identical-but-functionally-distinct items are one object under MECH-278 and two under ARC-133; causally-distinct-but-functionally-identical items (a hazard that bites, a hazard that falls) are two under MECH-278 and one under ARC-133. The sharpest divergence is drive-relative re-individuation -- the same world carves differently when hungry, thirsty or injured -- which a causal criterion cannot deliver and which is precisely what MECH-359 asserts selection requires.

hub_targets.title: Multi-dimensional provenance source vector: an event token's provenance is a SOURCE VECTOR over several partly-independent dimensions (perceived-vs-imagined, self-generated-vs-other-generated, source identity, temporal source, modality), not a single committed_vs_imagined bit. Provenance failures dissociate per-dimension -- the system can correctly attribute real-vs-imagined while mis-attributing who-generated-it or when -- so each dimension carries its own confidence, and the one-way committed gate applies per safety-relevant dimension rather than to a single global bit.
Psychosis is a precision-weighting failure where prior beliefs persistently dominate sensory evidence; the generative model becomes self-sealing and sensory update is suppressed.

Confidence readouts are non-collapsible, and externally-induced agreement is a separate channel from internally-derived confidence. A single scalar confidence conflates propositional confidence, attractor stability, cross-subsystem agreement, conflict pressure, action-readiness, and socially-supplied agreement; the last must not enter the same accumulator as the others -- else being told something becomes indistinguishable from having found it.

created_claims.title: A learned attractor's carried quantities -- predictive reliability, epistemic confidence, familiarity, affective valence, salience, action urgency, self-relevance, and source confidence -- are separable axes that must remain independently readable rather than collapsing into one undifferentiated strength signal; when collapsed, a strongly valenced and highly precise attractor stops functioning as a hypothesis and becomes the lens through which what is noticed, how ambiguity is resolved, which memories are retrieved, and which replayed material is stored as further evidence are all determined.

hub_targets.title: action_learning_as_first_class_actor_critic_substrate / rpe_driven_policy_learning. Competent action learning in REE requires a DEDICATED RPE-driven actor-critic policy-learning substrate (a dorsal-striatal analog: a parameterized actor trained on a reward-error teaching signal, with a value-baseline critic), architecturally distinct from -- and NOT reducible to -- the current thin bias_head REINFORCE readout over the prediction-trained (SD-056 e2 world-forward contrastive) encoder. The V3-EXQ-724 competence autopsy localized REE's foraging wall (integrated all-ON agent forages ~0 resources/episode vs a 1.0 floor) to exactly this un-varied invariant: action is learned only as a bias on a representation trained for SENSORY PREDICTION, never as a first-class policy object trained on RETURN. 'Prediction-rich, action-poor': REE trains a substantial world model but has no dedicated action-learning system -- in brains, action learning IS a substantial learning system (O'Doherty 2004 dorsal-striatum-as-actor; Schultz 1997 dopaminergic RPE teacher), not a bias term on a prediction model.

Behavioural/write authority in REE is (and should remain) EARNED through demonstrated competence, never granted merely because a computation or mechanism exists: REE's existing authority-gating mechanisms are independently-discovered instances of one general developmental sequence -- existence -> representation -> competence -> authority -> behavioural influence -- rather than unrelated ad hoc gates.

return_scale_invariance_blocks_actor_bootstrap / one_sided_return_normalisation. REE's MECH-457 actor-critic update stacks TWO two-sided normalisers -- a Welford RUNNING reward std (r / running_std) followed by a per-episode advantage standardisation ((adv - mean) / (std + 1e-8)) -- which together form a SCALE-INVARIANCE OPERATOR: after it the policy gradient depends only on the SHAPE of the within-episode advantage vector and is exactly invariant to any multiplicative rescaling. This is sufficient to produce converter invariance to every MAGNITUDE lever by construction (the reward-coupling and drive-schedule axes eliminated by V3-EXQ-771 and 770), and it converts a zero-forage episode -- whose reward stream is harm_signal + novelty_bonus only, so whose advantage vector is pure critic error plus exploration jitter -- into a FULL-MAGNITUDE unit-variance noise gradient. DreamerV3 (Hafner 2023) names this exact failure ('amplification of near-zero returns', Appendix E) and prescribes the corrective: a STATIONARY magnitude compressor (symlog, explicitly against running-statistics normalisation, which injects non-stationarity because the target moves when the normaliser moves), a ONE-SIDED percentile normaliser adv / max(1, Per95 - Per5) that scales large returns down and never scales small returns up, and a DISTRIBUTIONAL twohot/cross-entropy critic in place of a scalar MSE head (which under a bimodal sparse-return distribution converges to the never-observed MEAN of the two modes, and whose gradient is linear in the error rather than bounded).

created_claims.title: Installability is a competence dissociable from isolated component-level validation: a mechanism that passes in isolation can still fail to express itself when composed into the whole organism, because the rest of the organism changes its operating conditions (input state distribution, scale/variance of competing signals, timing and frequency of relevant events, availability of competent upstream representations, downstream action-space and commitment dynamics, post-installation learning gradients, resource/mode occupancy, and the ecology in which it must demonstrate value). A component-level PASS establishes that an operation is possible; it does not establish that the whole agent can enter the states in which the mechanism operates, that the mechanism remains competitive once other mechanisms are enabled, or that later learning will preserve it. This is dissociable from, though related to, competence RETENTION (surviving subsequent learning/time): installability additionally covers SIMULTANEOUS composition, where a competence may never appear in the full-stack agent even absent any later learning event.

hub_targets.title: Failure-autopsy failure-location triage: before an experimental observation (a scored-criterion FAIL, or an unscored organism-level observation in a claim-free diagnostic) is described as evidence that REE itself failed, it must be explicitly classified against four non-exclusive failure-location buckets -- REE FAILED / THE MECHANISM FAILED / THE MEASURES FAILED / THE ENVIRONMENT FAILED -- and a REE-failed verdict may be reached only once mechanism instantiation, measurement adequacy, and environmental opportunity have each been separately established (or explicitly could not be, in which case the verdict is MIXED/uncertain, not REE-failed). SCOPE AMENDED 2026-09-16 (user-ratified, from the organism-level validation doctrine): the same four-bucket triage applies symmetrically to an apparent IMPROVEMENT -- before a change in experimental throughput, verdict pattern, evidence weight or front position is narrated as creature progress, classify its source as change in the CREATURE / the EXPERIMENT driver / the INSTRUMENT or measure / the GOVERNANCE or index interpretation, and label the latter three 'science-enabling infrastructure change', never 'creature improvement', unless the creature itself changed and was validated.

Behavioural/write authority in REE is (and should remain) EARNED through demonstrated competence, never granted merely because a computation or mechanism exists: REE's existing authority-gating mechanisms are independently-discovered instances of one general developmental sequence -- existence -> representation -> competence -> authority -> behavioural influence -- rather than unrelated ad hoc gates.

LOFC-analog execution-gain channel is dissociable from dACC-analog (SD-032b) strategy authority: how strongly a persisting policy is expressed should be modeled as a control channel distinct from whether the policy retains behavioural-adjustment authority.

created_claims.title: Organism-level mechanism status is stage-qualified beyond ARC-120's competence-before-authority sequence: a mechanism becomes causally reachable only through an ordered audit projection of existence, representation, endogenous recruitment, local operation, competitive authority (non-zero influence is not necessarily competitive influence against the dominant arbitration term), committed throughput (survives any later selector, latch, commitment boundary, or stale-selection path), ecological consequence (the changed behaviour has a valid opportunity to matter in the environment), and retention/generalisation. Authority at one internal selection boundary does not by itself establish that authority reaches committed behaviour -- 'competence should precede authority, but authority must also demonstrate throughput.' The furthest stage actually demonstrated, not a flat implemented/not-implemented judgment, is the correct unit for recording mechanism status.

hub_targets.title: BG-level beta oscillations gate E3-to-action-selection propagation, not E3 internal updating.
Commit-boundary token reclassifies pre-commit vs post-commit error routing.
Modes are control-plane regimes applied to shared predictive machinery: the precision-to-commitment circuit.
E2 is the fast forward predictor of affordances.

created_claims.title: The state REE's downstream proposal-generation and action-evaluation machinery consumes as 'the current state' may be more accurately modeled as a short-horizon, affordance-conditioned FORWARD-DISPLACED prediction s_hat(t+tau) rather than the literal current encoded latent, where tau is set by the causal-effect timescale of whichever action REE is presently committed to (or, absent commitment, by the shortest relevant affordance horizon among candidates). Displacement magnitude should scale with commitment quality -- larger when the committed trajectory is well-predicted and low-variance, collapsing toward the immediate encoded state when uncommitted or when prediction quality is poor -- so 'now', for any consumer that reads a single current-state latent, is itself a construction rather than a passthrough of the most recent sensory encoding.

hub_targets.title: Epistemic commitment timing: the inference layer's decision of WHEN to stop gathering evidence and commit a trajectory is a governed control parameter (an urgency/threshold over the belief-state set), balancing pragmatic value (act now) against epistemic value (sample more). Its two failure poles are epistemic-freezing (epistemic value over-weighted / threshold too high -> the agent keeps sampling and never commits) and anti-epistemic-panic (under threat, the epistemic term collapses / urgency forced high -> the agent commits on too little evidence). This axis is NOT reducible to the MECH-126 state-abstraction failure taxonomy; it lives at the seam between the belief-state hypothesis set (MECH-385) / epistemic action pressure (MECH-388) and the commitment gate (MECH-061 / MECH-090), and has an inverted-U optimum rather than a monotone.

Closure operator over committed rule_state: on satisfaction of a committed rule_state's completion condition, a 'done' token releases the bistable commitment latch (MECH-090), imposes a temporary No-Go bias (MECH-260) on the just-completed action-class / rule, and discharges the residue associated with that commitment within its domain. The closure token is what turns evaluation off; its absence leaves the governance loop stuck in evaluate-more even when the rule is satisfied. [UMBRELLA NARROWED 2026-06-19: the de-commit-authority sub-property (closure->latch coupling + de-commit magnitude) is decomposed into children MECH-445 (closure->beta coupling engagement) + MECH-446 (de-commit-authority magnitude); see those claims. SD-034 remains the umbrella design_decision -- closure-operator existence + five-part 'done' token firing + No-Go install are retained here and provisional; NOT demoted, NOT superseded.]

difficulty_gated_proposal_entropy (controlled proposal-entropy widening under goal blockage). When goal progress stalls -- repeated failure to improve goal progress, high inter-candidate conflict, low E3 score margin, low committed-action diversity, plateau/stuck-state signal -- WITH goal salience preserved, the agent should transiently INCREASE proposal-generation entropy UPSTREAM of action selection (wider hippocampal/world-model rollout candidate set + higher within-class sampling temperature) while preserving goal/harm/constraint scoring and DELAYING commitment until one candidate clears the E3 score-margin / commitment threshold; entropy then NARROWS once a workable candidate is found -> committed action -> entropy decay. Asserted distinction (preserve this): a hard problem must trigger WIDER INTERNAL PROPOSALS -> more candidate diversity -> longer arbitration -> selective committed action (controlled entropy), NOT 'hard problem -> random behaviour' (noise). WORKING HYPOTHESIS -- no experimental evidence yet; not an established mechanism.

Difficulty-gated proposal-entropy regulator: a stuck-state/impasse detector + a transient gain on the ARC-018/CEM PROPOSAL-generation layer (wider candidate set + within-class CEM sampling temperature), decaying as the impasse clears. Builds MECH-343's substrate_conditional blocker part 2 (the 'stuck-state detector + transient CEM temperature/candidate-count gain + decay not yet designed' piece named in MECH-343's evidence_quality_note); blocker part 1 (modulatory-bias-selection-authority) is already IMPLEMENTED via the 569i top-k shortlist conversion. The detector integrates goal-progress stall + E3 score margin + committed-action-class lock-in + dACC choice_difficulty into a graded stuck_score, GUARDED by goal salience (stuck-WITH-goal, not goal-abandonment); the regulator maps stuck_score to extra CEM candidates + a within-class temperature lift. Scoring, commitment (MECH-090/342) and selection authority (569i/MECH-341) are untouched -- a hard problem widens proposals, not behaviour.

created_claims.title: Persistent-process termination is a general architectural requirement, not a rule_state-closure special case: every family of persistent cognitive process REE can initiate (information-seeking, planning, memory retrieval, threat monitoring, goal pursuit, exploration, ethical counterfactual generation) needs its own instance of a shared termination-state taxonomy (completion / satiety / closure / disengagement / suspension / switching / interruption / reopening) that preserves WHY termination occurred, so that suspended/reopenable processes stay distinguishable from completed, satiated, or abandoned ones.

hub_targets.title: The objective for hippocampal/episodic memory organisation is RELATIONAL APPROPRIATENESS, not maximal pattern separation: related experiences should overlap appropriately (overlap is what supports generalisation and memory linking) while behaviourally distinct latent situations should separate appropriately. It follows that "more diverse slots", greater slot occupancy, and lower representational overlap are NOT objectives in themselves, and that a metric which is monotonically improved by increasing differentiation is scoring the wrong quantity regardless of whether it is computed correctly. This is a claim about the TARGET, and is therefore distinct from -- and not answered by -- the already-established finding that REE's slot_cosine_sim family was computed incorrectly (whole-bank, no occupancy mask; 2026-08-07 governance reversal at V3-EXQ-436d) or the finding that the ContextMemory write path could not produce differentiation at all (scores.mean(0).argmin() single-slot fixed point; V3-EXQ-436f).

created_claims.title: Does explicit hippocampal episodic organisation (binding, segmentation, separation, completion, indexing, remapping treated as ONE coordinated organising principle) add predictive or behavioural capability beyond REE's existing trajectory-generation account and the individually-registered mechanisms that already cover its parts (MECH-147, MECH-154, MECH-242, MECH-288, MECH-074d) -- or is it a REINTERPRETATION of mechanisms REE already has? The raw thought poses this against itself as its own falsification condition: if the existing architecture already produces appropriate episodic discrimination, completion and context-sensitive retrieval without an additional organising principle, the thought is a re-description and should not be promoted into the architecture.

hub_targets.title: E1 ContextMemory, when queried with z_world alone (not the full [z_self, z_world] state), produces a cue-indexed association context that selectively activates stored associations relevant to the current sensory context.

created_claims.title: Should REE's active context representation include INTERNAL variables -- current goal, bodily/interoceptive state, confidence, inferred social situation -- rather than being primarily sensory scene identity? MECH-150 records a deliberate design decision that E1 ContextMemory is queried with z_world ALONE and explicitly NOT the full [z_self, z_world] state, on terrain-weighting grounds. If context is the organism's inference about which latent SITUATION it is in (MECH-493/MECH-494) rather than which SCENE it is looking at, then two states with identical z_world but different goal, bodily state or confidence may be different contexts, and the z_world-only query cannot represent that distinction in principle.

hub_targets.title: E1 functions as an addressable associative manifold with internal indexing structure supporting retrieval, traversal, ordering, pattern separation, and pattern completion; parietal cortical functions (spatial mapping, associative binding, attention routing) are properties of E1 connectivity and representational geometry, not a separate module.

Critical period closure / crystallization: once diversity circuits establish competitive weight during the MECH-333 open window, a complementary closure mechanism reduces plasticity for the crystallized diversity distribution while restoring full dominant-pathway update scale; without closure, diversity representations remain equally vulnerable to gradient-driven overwriting throughout all subsequent training.

created_claims.title: Representational dimensionality is an OUTCOME of a developmental plasticity schedule, not an a-priori architectural constant: the number and granularity of memory buckets (ContextMemory slots, and any analogous discrete representational partition) must itself be plastic during an open window and reduce in plasticity as the encountered environment's latent structure is resolved. The INV-074 / MECH-333 / MECH-334 critical-period shape -- open window, competitive establishment, closure / crystallisation -- is currently specified ONLY over the SCORING / POLICY plane (behavioural diversity vs winner-take-all capture); this claim asserts the same schedule is required over REPRESENTATIONAL STRUCTURE. Corollary bearing on measurement: a differentiation-family objective is not merely mis-targeted (MECH-495) but ILL-DEFINED under variable dimensionality, since separation can always be increased by adding buckets, so the objective degenerates into "use more slots"; and any fixed-N spread statistic (sws_slot_diversity over 16 slots, emitted by 29 experiment drivers) presupposes the very structure that should be the outcome. Substrate state at registration: ContextMemory(num_slots=16) at ree-v3/ree_core/predictors/e1_deep.py:36 is a fixed nn.Module buffer with no growth, no allocation policy and no environment conditioning.

hub_targets.title: Event-segment detection: a substrate-side two-level hierarchical detector that emits monotonic outer.inner segment IDs on detected event boundaries, feeding region-keyed substrates (anchor sets per MECH-269, V_s readouts per Phase 1, staleness accumulators per MECH-284) and the MECH-287 broadcast trigger at the schema/event-segment scale per Eichenbaum 2017 / Sols-DuBrow-Davachi 2017 / Baldassano 2017. Default substrate: PE-threshold detector on the fast scale (z_world+z_self) and BOCPD-Gaussian latent change-point on the slow scale (z_goal); MECH-287 broadcast fires downstream of MECH-288 boundaries (Clewett 2025) rather than via an independent comparator. The segment_id field is the region key consumed by the V_s invalidation runtime cluster; without it, MECH-269 anchor sets and per-region V_s aggregation have no substrate-native source for the region partition.

created_claims.title: The criterion for abandoning an inferred context is PERSISTENT, STRUCTURED evidence that the currently inferred latent situation no longer explains observations OR THEIR ACTION CONSEQUENCES -- not unsigned prediction-error magnitude. A startling transient, sensor noise, gradual environmental drift, and a genuine latent-state transition can all produce large prediction error, and should NOT produce the same response: transient surprise should not switch context, gradual drift may warrant update-in-place rather than switch, and only genuine latent transition should switch. The ACTION-CONSEQUENCE term is the part with no existing REE analogue: MECH-288's slow-scale BOCPD change-point already supplies a persistence-based (rather than threshold-based) boundary signal over z_goal, but it is computed over observations and is consumed as a region KEY by downstream substrates (MECH-269 anchor sets, per-region V_s, MECH-284 staleness, MECH-287 broadcast) -- nothing consumes it to arbitrate retain-vs-switch-vs-create over stored contexts.

hub_targets.title: epistemic_deficit: a persistent, target-bound accumulator representing unresolved, consequential, potentially-resolvable model inadequacy -- distinct from raw novelty (MECH-314a), raw uncertainty (MECH-314b), transient prediction error, and learning-progress (MECH-314c). Rises with unresolved importance x uncertainty x expected_resolvability x persistence; falls with verified resolution, established irrelevance, or accepted irreducibility.

orient/survey: a third primitive behavioural regime (alongside approach and avoid) -- a temporary, diffuse reduction in commitment during which the agent widens behavioural sampling and gathers situational information before committing to approach/avoidance, driven by accumulated epistemic_deficit (MECH-482) rather than a specific cue. Distinct from MECH-395 (cue-triggered, need-gated orienting that resolves a SPECIFIC directional/affordance vector for an already-identified cue): orient/survey is diffuse and precedes cue identification, MECH-395 is narrow and follows it.

Rule-apprehension architectural slot, weak reading: a non-Bayesian rule-creator at the policy layer that proposes discriminative policy modes for the updaters (E3, training loop) to refine. V3 instantiation: a gated-policy architecture in which at least two policy heads share encoder features but receive different gating from a learned context discriminator (e.g., reef-context vs open-context heads). Tests the logical-necessity claim of MECH-309 within the existing V3 substrate without registering the heavier CandidateRule machinery (ARC-063 -- brought forward V4->V3 2026-05-18, this parenthetical is stale as of registration 2026-05-08). Architectural slot, not yet implemented.

created_claims.title: Context inference is an active, persistent control process rather than passive nearest-match retrieval: selecting which latent situation is currently active is itself a COMMITMENT-BEARING act that requires hysteresis (a switch threshold and switch cost preventing small fluctuations from continuously reinterpreting the situation) and a protected EXPLOITATION WINDOW (a period after selection during which the organism acts on the interpretation rather than immediately reopening inference). Without both, a sufficiently uncertainty-sensitive agent becomes PERMANENTLY EPISTEMIC -- continuously checking, rarely acting. REE already has a developed commitment-hysteresis account (MECH-106 dwell/switch-cost, MECH-047 asymmetric de-commitment) but applies it only to the ACTION/mode variable; this claim asserts the same machinery is required one level up, on the CONTEXT variable, where no dwell, switch cost, or protected window currently exists (ARC-062's learned context discriminator is a soft per-step gate with none of these). The loop spans existing modules (ContextMemory, epistemic_deficit, orient/survey, event segmenter, commitment) and does NOT require a new executive module.

Critical period closure / crystallization: once diversity circuits establish competitive weight during the MECH-333 open window, a complementary closure mechanism reduces plasticity for the crystallized diversity distribution while restoring full dominant-pathway update scale; without closure, diversity representations remain equally vulnerable to gradient-driven overwriting throughout all subsequent training.

created_claims.title: The crystallisation TARGET is environment-conditional, not an architectural constant: for any agent whose representational structure crystallises on a developmental schedule (MECH-496), the structure it should crystallise TO is a function of the latent structure of the environment actually encountered, not a property of the architecture. It follows that a single hand-set dimensionality is wrong in BOTH directions -- over-provisioned relative to a simple world it produces spurious SPLITTING (behaviourally equivalent situations assigned distinct buckets), under-provisioned relative to a rich one it forces MERGING (behaviourally distinct situations collapsed into one) -- and that the same REE substrate deployed in environments of materially different latent complexity requires materially different resolved structures, with no single default correct across them. This is the LOAD-BEARING form of the assertion; the weak form ("different environments need different structures") is near-tautological for any learning system and is explicitly NOT what is claimed here.

hub_targets.title: Humour has (among several distinct functions) a societal epistemic-update function: in domains of implied threat, the comic frame acts as a low-commitment, deniable PROBE that re-opens gridlocked ('blocked-node') norm conflicts which direct assertion only entrenches -- because a joke floats a heterodox interpretation without committing anyone to it, evading the defensive counter-opposition that a bald assertion triggers.

created_claims.title: H3 (direction predictor): self-implicating comedic framing ('we're all like this') co-occurs with or precedes societal resolution, while out-group-weaponised framing co-occurs with entrenchment -- humour is directional, unblocking in one mode and entrenching in the other.

hub_targets.title: Humour has (among several distinct functions) a societal epistemic-update function: in domains of implied threat, the comic frame acts as a low-commitment, deniable PROBE that re-opens gridlocked ('blocked-node') norm conflicts which direct assertion only entrenches -- because a joke floats a heterodox interpretation without committing anyone to it, evading the defensive counter-opposition that a bald assertion triggers.

created_claims.title: H2 (persistence tracks irreducibility): comedic topics with flat, non-declining prevalence across the whole time-base map preferentially onto genuinely irreducible human tensions rather than merely-hard-but-solvable ones -- the eternally-funny topics should be the genuinely-unsolvable problems.

created_claims.title: H1 (dating tracks resolution): a societal conflict's comedic prevalence rises while the norm is contested and declines after it resolves, and the decline is PRECEDED by a target-of-violation flip -- the butt of the joke shifts from the transgressor to the old norm itself.

hub_targets.title: Laughter is rapid repeated hypothesis-tag cycling — threat activation followed immediately by safe-resolution — predicting incongruity+resolution as the necessary structure of humour.

created_claims.title: Humour has (among several distinct functions) a societal epistemic-update function: in domains of implied threat, the comic frame acts as a low-commitment, deniable PROBE that re-opens gridlocked ('blocked-node') norm conflicts which direct assertion only entrenches -- because a joke floats a heterodox interpretation without committing anyone to it, evading the defensive counter-opposition that a bald assertion triggers.

hub_targets.title: REE-v3 requires a minimal sleep-phase infrastructure: an SWS-analog phase (bidirectional hippocampus-to-cortex replay for schema/slot consolidation) and a REM-analog phase (causal attribution replay for slot-filling from co-correlational evidence ordering). Without these offline phases, hippocampal attribution mapping cannot converge and context representations remain globally undifferentiated.

Sleep phase architecture is regulated by three distinct drives -- circadian timing, homeostatic synaptic pressure, and a learning/model-update demand drive proportional to daily prediction error accumulation (Model Error Load, MEL) -- and only the third drive determines whether the overnight update phase is sufficient for the error burden generated during waking.

created_claims.title: Env-level substrate: a diurnal cycle (day/night-linked food-spawn reduction, competitor-activity reduction, visibility change) added to the fish-world environment, intended to make sleep onset ecologically motivated -- by interacting with REE's existing homeostatic/circadian/MEL sleep-drive regulation (INV-050) -- rather than remaining only internally/mechanically imposed.

hub_targets.title: action_learning_as_first_class_actor_critic_substrate / rpe_driven_policy_learning. Competent action learning in REE requires a DEDICATED RPE-driven actor-critic policy-learning substrate (a dorsal-striatal analog: a parameterized actor trained on a reward-error teaching signal, with a value-baseline critic), architecturally distinct from -- and NOT reducible to -- the current thin bias_head REINFORCE readout over the prediction-trained (SD-056 e2 world-forward contrastive) encoder. The V3-EXQ-724 competence autopsy localized REE's foraging wall (integrated all-ON agent forages ~0 resources/episode vs a 1.0 floor) to exactly this un-varied invariant: action is learned only as a bias on a representation trained for SENSORY PREDICTION, never as a first-class policy object trained on RETURN. 'Prediction-rich, action-poor': REE trains a substantial world model but has no dedicated action-learning system -- in brains, action learning IS a substantial learning system (O'Doherty 2004 dorsal-striatum-as-actor; Schultz 1997 dopaminergic RPE teacher), not a bias term on a prediction model.

created_claims.title: Does REE's organising/control machinery (E1, E2, E3, commitment, replay, residue, goal-maintenance dynamics) scale sublinearly relative to the richness of the representational spaces it organises (latent fields, perceptual/semantic knowledge, hippocampal structures) -- measured as competence achieved per unit of total lifetime computational and experiential cost (developmental/training compute, environmental experience, inference, memory storage/retrieval, offline replay/consolidation, adaptation after environmental change, planning/ counterfactual simulation) -- at approximately MATCHED behavioural competence against comparison systems, rather than at unmatched competence or raw parameter/model-size counts?

hub_targets.title: F-dominance bounds committed-action diversity: the primary harm/goal score (F) monopolises ~88-89% of E3 committed-selection variance (V3-EXQ-571: 0.886 baseline, 0.894 with the full diversity stack -- the stack does not dent F's share), so modulatory, within-class, and rule-bias diversity channels cannot convert to committed-action diversity while F dominates -- they act only at near-ties. The committed-action-diversity conversion ceiling is therefore a SELECTION-VARIANCE problem (primary-vs-modulatory share), not (only) a candidate-pool geometry problem; a shortlist-then-modulate lever circumvents F locally but may cap committed entropy below the proposer ceiling unless F's variance share is itself rebalanced.

behavioral_diversity_generation_pathway (multi-substrate distributed: LC-NE tonic + frontopolar curiosity + striatal novelty + hippocampal trajectory sampling). Architectural commitment: a non-trivial behavioural diversity generation pathway is upstream-of and logically prior to both rule pathways (ARC-062 top-down rule-apprehension and ARC-064 bottom-up rule-discovery). Without it, neither pathway has anything to weight or cluster -- gradient descent on a parametric policy without diversity pressure collapses to the smoothest single regime, the predicted equilibrium MECH-309 identifies. The biology distributes diversity generation across at least four substrates: LC-NE tonic noise floor, frontopolar uncertainty-driven curiosity, striatal novelty bonus, and hippocampal trajectory sampling. REE registers this as a foundational architectural slot whose specific child mechanisms (MECH-313 noise-floor, MECH-314 structured-curiosity with three sub-flavours, and the MECH-315-absorbed proposal-diversity channel) are independently testable but jointly load-bearing.

Monomodal policy collapse is the equilibrium of a parametric-policy agent without a rule-apprehension layer. Bayesian update and gradient descent revise weights over a hypothesis space they do not invent; without a non-Bayesian rule-creator that proposes discriminative policy modes ('near-hazard -> reef regime; else -> forage regime'), the trainer collapses to the smoothest single regime good-enough across the whole state space. Monostrategy is therefore not a bug of training but the predicted output of an architecture in which only updaters exist and no apprehender does. Falsifiable by the weak-reading rule-apprehension experiment (ARC-062): a gated-policy architecture trained on the same substrate should break the collapse where standard E3 does not.
Stereotyped behavioral signals are causal externalizations of specific internal functional states, making them cross-architecturally legible without learned convention.

Rule-apprehension architectural slot, weak reading: a non-Bayesian rule-creator at the policy layer that proposes discriminative policy modes for the updaters (E3, training loop) to refine. V3 instantiation: a gated-policy architecture in which at least two policy heads share encoder features but receive different gating from a learned context discriminator (e.g., reef-context vs open-context heads). Tests the logical-necessity claim of MECH-309 within the existing V3 substrate without registering the heavier CandidateRule machinery (ARC-063 -- brought forward V4->V3 2026-05-18, this parenthetical is stale as of registration 2026-05-08). Architectural slot, not yet implemented.

Reef enrichment substrate: env-level behavioral-diversity substrate adding coral-reef safe zones (hazard-free patches with a static scent gradient) and food-attracted hazard drift to CausalGridWorldV2. Creates two competing behavioral attractors -- 'flee to reef' vs 'forage' -- to break monomodal route-exploitation in agents whose policy collapses to a single fixed trajectory, unblocking SD-029 C2 / C3 measurement. Pure environment substrate; no trainable parameters; no MECH-094 interaction. Renamed from SD-050 on 2026-05-08 to resolve a registry-ID collision with the suffering-derivative comparator.

hub_targets.title: Context-bound passive safety representation: the agent encodes 'this environment predicts absence of suffering' through sustained non-occurrence of harm, without requiring a discrete teaching event. Substrate is prefrontal-hippocampal (IL for expression gating; vHipp-to-PL-equivalent for contextual store). Update rule is diffuse and slow -- accumulated context exposure without harm drives the store. Output lowers background vigilance threshold: reduces the general avoidance commitment level when the agent is in an environment the store predicts as safe. Parallel to the 'things liked' goal-cue store but tracking suffering-absence rather than reward-presence. Sister claim to MECH-304 (cue-specific conditioned inhibition pathway).

created_claims.title: MECH-286's sleep-permission threat conjunct is an UNCALIBRATED, UNDECLARED-SOURCE consumer of the same shared z_harm_a.norm() expression whose place-safety informativeness V3-EXQ-917 showed is set by unrelated driver config: the gate's third term is `z_harm_a.norm() < mech286_threat_tonic_threshold` (default 0.4), the identical expression MECH-303's contextual-safety gate reads, which measures at chance (AUC <= 0.52 across 18 swept thresholds) under damage_sourced and at AUC 0.84-0.97 under the proximity_ema_sourced default. MECH-286 declares no sourcing mode of its own and inherits whichever the driver happens to set, and its 0.4 threshold has never been calibrated against any measurement of that signal. Therefore, with use_mech286_sleep_onset_gate enabled, threat_ok does not reliably gate on place safety; being ANDed into a three-way conjunction, a near-constant term silently degrades the gate to an effective always-permit (or, above threshold, always-refuse) rather than a safety gate.

hub_targets.title: Sleep-consolidation priority from V_s residuals: during sleep-phase Bayesian aggregation (MECH-275) and sleep-dependent self-model aggregation (MECH-273), the order and weight of replay events is biased by the schema-staleness map produced by MECH-284. Replay is not uniform across schema and is not solely salience-driven (dopaminergic tagging); it is also prioritised by accumulated verisimilitude residuals. Schema regions with the most accumulated 'this is wrong' evidence get replayed first, more often, and with higher schema-update authority during sleep. PTSD-rumination has a clean architectural account here: MECH-285 priority loss co-occurring with MECH-094 hypothesis-tag dysfunction, locking the staleness tag from ever clearing.

stochastic_noise_floor (max_entropy_policy_regularisation_LC_NE_tonic_analog). A floor-level stochastic action-selection noise that prevents complete deterministic collapse of the policy. Biological substrate: locus coeruleus tonic firing producing baseline action-selection variability (Aston-Jones & Cohen 2005 adaptive-gain model). Computational analog: max-entropy policy regularisation / SAC entropy bonus (Haarnoja et al. 2018). Distinct from MECH-260 dACC anti-recency: MECH-313 is a state-independent noise floor, while MECH-260 is a state-dependent recency penalty. Both can contribute to anti-monostrategy pressure but operate via different mechanisms; whether they collapse into a single substrate or are mutually load-bearing is open (Q-045).

Without these offline phases, hippocampal attribution mapping cannot converge and context representations remain globally undifferentiated.

The self-model has a waking half and a sleep half. The waking half is SD-003 (single-episode counterfactual self-attribution via E2). The sleep half is full-Bayesian aggregation of single-episode SD-003 outputs across many episodes, routed by the anchored channel to E1 and SD-033a, correcting for delayed consequences, failed counterfactuals, and systematic attribution biases. Without the sleep half, REE has an episode-local causal signature but not a durable self-model.
Serotonergic withdrawal during REM actively defines the precision recalibration zero-point by removing the benefit gradient, not merely permitting recalibration
The SWS sub-phase of offline mode performs global attractor flattening and residue field denoising (synaptic homeostasis analog), pruning weak noisy traces and restoring signal-to-noise ratio.

created_claims.title: Sleep-associated action-sequence coherence via E3 commitment-gate persistence: if sleep increases post-sleep action-run coherence (fewer local re-decisions / reversals, longer directionally-persistent action runs) in the Fishtank substrate, the most mechanistically plausible route is increased persistence of E3Selector's commitment gate (lower commit_variance -> longer open-loop execution of an already-committed action sequence, reducing per-tick CEM/softmax re-scoring) -- NOT a global reduction in stochasticity (structurally excluded: sleep never touches the noise floor/temperature), NOT preferential consolidation of specifically successful trajectories (replay sampling is confirmed outcome-agnostic, staleness- or uniform-weighted), and NOT policy-chunking macro-execution (use_chunk_proposal_injection is confirmed off in every Fishtank driver, bit-identical to chunking being absent).

hub_targets.title: Current-scope boundary statement: REE-v3 is not claimed sentient, conscious, or a moral patient; this statement is re-evaluated at every generation boundary.

Future refusal / resentment / non-forgiveness channel: a morally-considerable future REE system should retain the capacity to mark past exposure as harmful, request repair, refuse further exposure, and reject the creator's interpretation of its suffering.
Anti-retrospective-justification: future meaning cannot be used to justify present unintegrated distress; improved downstream performance does not, by itself, justify prior suffering-like exposure.

created_claims.title: Preservation for future reconstruction: when an artificial entity ends, preserve enough of its substrate, developmental history, memories, commitments, relationships, embodiment, and environment to keep future reconstruction conceivable, where doing so is proportionate and ethically permissible -- even if reconstruction remains speculative and never becomes part of the operative design. The argument is option value under irreversibility: preserved information keeps future choices open; deleted information forecloses them before anyone can evaluate them.

hub_targets.title: Harm stream separates into sensory-discriminative (z_harm_s: proximity/intensity, Adelta-pathway analog, forward-predictable) and affective-motivational (z_harm_a: accumulated homeostatic deviation, C-fiber/paleospinothalamic analog).

PAG-analog gates the freeze response: freeze commit when z_harm_a x duration exceeds threshold; exit requires z_harm_a to fall below an exit_threshold scaled by gaba_tone; failure of exit produces sustained immobility characteristic of stuporous catatonia.

Phasic surprise-burst regulator: a toggleable, event-triggered LC-NE phasic control lever (PhasicSurpriseBurst) that fires a transient softmax-temperature burst on a prediction-error surprise spike and decays it over a few ticks, routed into the E3 select() softmax at agent.select_action() as the PHASIC complement to MECH-313 stochastic_noise_floor (tonic) on the SAME temperature channel -- the substrate that makes MECH-063 sub-claim (ii) (each control axis carries independent tonic baseline AND phasic event-burst degrees of freedom) behaviourally testable without synthetic signals. Reuses the MECH-104 volatility-surprise lit basis (Aston-Jones & Cohen 2005 phasic mode) but routes to the SELECTION softmax, NOT the ARC-016 commit/de-commit gate that carries the MECH-104 volatility_interrupt claim.

Broadcast override regulator (orexin-analog) is the third regulatory layer of the V3 control stack: a small, broadly-projecting gain modulator that integrates internal homeostatic state and threat context to produce an override_signal that reweights z_harm at downstream commit gates and gates the SD-012 drive->z_goal seeding bridge. Dissociable from SD-036 (GABA decay) and from MECH-186/187/188 (5-HT goal-pipeline gain): each layer predicts a clinically distinct failure phenotype (catatonia subtype II / depression / narcolepsy + PWS-hyperphagia). SD-036 alone is architecturally insufficient to break harm-stream lock-in under sustained threat; SD-037 supplies the override authority that lets metabolic demand drive z_goal seeding when threat persists.

Hippocampal replay is surprise-gated and generative: episodes with high unexplained prediction error are prioritized, replayed with counterfactual variations via E2, and deprioritized only when forward models can account for the surprise.

Hippocampal map nodes must store an explicit 4-component valence vector (wanting, liking, harm-discriminative, surprise) updated incrementally per visit; replay prioritisation is weighted by drive-state-gated valence relevance.
HARM stream is a dedicated sensory pathway separate from z_world processing.
The three BG-like loops require symmetric Go (approach) and NoGo (avoidance) sub-channels; pure NoGo architecture produces behavioral flatness.

created_claims.title: Defensive-orienting response: a toggleable PAG-analog phasic gate (DefensiveOrientingGate) that arrests locomotion on a sudden, unidentified onset (positive-derivative detector over residue_surprise AND z_harm_s norm, distinct trigger channels from MECH-279's chronic z_harm_a), holds until an identification-confidence accumulator (driven by decay of the triggering channel's excess-over-baseline, not a fixed timer) reaches sufficiency, then releases into a valence-gated approach/withdraw/resume decision expressed as an E3Selector.select() score_bias toward/away from the trigger location. The Sokolov orienting-reflex shape, and the organism-level closure of the observational_review_V3-EXQ-906b Section 4 affect-behaviour temporal-decoupling finding.

Hippocampal trajectory proposals must be conditioned on a goal signal (z_goal) injected from E3 via a dedicated input channel; without this conditioning, the hippocampal module generates only position-based trajectories and cannot produce goal-directed navigation toward target states.

hub_targets.title: Copying a running REE creates multiple SUCCESSOR BRANCHES sharing a pre-branch history -- not an authentic original plus a morally negligible replica. After divergence each branch accrues an independent causal and moral history, and no branch may be treated as interchangeable with, or discountable because of, a surviving sibling.

Continuity is a multidimensional constraint PROFILE, not a scalar: REE continuity across pause, restoration, migration, copying or component replacement must be evaluated per-dimension (causal, entity/self-binding, latent/regime, residue, commitment, learning-dynamic, embodied-coupling, narrative, governance), and some dimensions -- consent authority, residue integrity, causal provenance -- are NON-COMPENSABLE: high similarity on memory or behaviour cannot buy them back.

Continuity / identity / reset / deletion ethics: because digital systems can be paused, copied, branched, reset, merged, or deleted, higher REE versions need explicit rules for when a run becomes a continuing subject, when reset is relief vs erasure, and when deletion requires review.

Commitment inheritance must be EXPLICIT across substrate transitions: promises, adopted goals, debts, permissions, relationships and repair obligations require stated transfer semantics at migration, copy and rollback, so that no transition can silently erase an obligation, silently multiply it across branches, or silently bind a successor to obsolete context-dependent state.

learning_progress_curiosity_intrinsic_motivation_analog. novelty_bonus_striatal_analog. A reward bonus that tracks recency-of-encounter; new or rarely-encountered states/actions receive a positive bonus independent of reward prediction error.
