Structural: (A) CORRESPONDENCE / BINDING -- which token, event, state or relation in one representation corresponds to which in another or across time, with identity as correspondence plus continuity and persistence constraints, and equivalence as correspondence under a specified transformation (absorbing CCI-001, CCI-006); (B) DIRECTED EVENT / TRAJECTORY STRUCTURE -- event or token instances, ordered or partially ordered succession, reachable transition relations, persistence across transitions, and optional typed intervention edges, rather than a scalar clock plus a separate graph (absorbing CCI-002, CCI-007 and, if action-labelled edges suffice to reconstruct controllability, much of CCI-004); (C) GENERATIVE CONTEXT / ANCHORING / LINEAGE -- which process produced a representation, which branch it belongs to, whether that branch is anchored to the current sensory worldline, and how it relates to other generated alternatives, so that "actual" is a relation to the currently anchored worldline rather than a primitive category (absorbing CCI-003, CCI-012 and the unnumbered provenance/ownership hypotheses). Attached fields: (D) EPISTEMIC WEIGHT over states, edges or translations, obligatory only where the producer holds reliability information the receiver cannot cheaply reconstruct (reclassifying CCI-005 from content primitive to boundary-specific field); (E) REGULATORY / VIABILITY WEIGHT -- predicted relation to viable or preferred states plus direction of change plus horizon, from which signed value, goal relation and priority may derive (reclassifying CCI-009 and bearing on CCI-010, CCI-014). CROSSED PREDICTION, which is what makes this falsifiable rather than a re-labelling: structural families should survive object or world remapping when the world relation is unchanged despite altered surface features, whereas attached fields should vary strongly with current uncertainty, needs, goals, physiology and task regime AT FIXED STRUCTURE -- so holding structure fixed while changing confidence, holding structure fixed while changing viability, holding confidence fixed while changing branch lineage, holding value fixed while changing controllability, and holding sensory content fixed while changing generative path should dissociate along the structure/field boundary. If structural and weighting variables cannot be dissociated by that crossed design, the 3 + 2 model is wrong or too simple.

Reference-frame mediation as a separable interface factor: two systems can each contain a task distinction, expose it through a healthy communication subspace (MECH-537), and still fail to communicate because they index that distinction against INCOMPATIBLE RELATIONAL COORDINATES -- egocentric versus allocentric, current-position-relative versus trajectory-origin-relative, observation-time versus predicted-action-time, absolute location versus action-conditioned displacement, episode-identity versus elapsed-tick. The interface decomposition is therefore content x communication subspace x REFERENCE FRAME x receiver context x temporal gate, and the frame is a THIRD selection variable alongside which directions are exposed (MECH-537) and which read surface the receiver's state selects (MECH-547). Registered failure class RF-F (an eighth entry in the location doc's F1-F7 routing table): an external probe succeeds on sender AND receiver, the information is not missing and the subspace is not collapsed, yet native cross-system use fails -- routing to a relational re-indexing rather than to more sender capacity or a higher bridge rung. The DISCRIMINATOR that makes this more than a redescription is a frame permutation that preserves content: permute the frame labels or anchors between episodes or positions while holding sender-state distribution, marginal difficulty and content statistics fixed (intact >> frame-permuted, while the target stays decodable in both, is the confirming signature; intact ~= frame-permuted says the frame is incidental at that interface). Two non-redundant predictions: frame alignment should LOWER the minimum bridge rung L(A -> B) (MECH-538) without requiring a higher-capacity bridge, and a frame permutation may disrupt only ONE downstream consumer, in which case reference frames are consumer-specific rather than globally shared -- which forbids inferring one global workspace or one canonical coordinate system from several consumers sharing an indexing relation.

Reduction admissibility for the cognitive contract (the anti-cheating rule the pruning clause lacks): counting primitives is not minimality, and a proposed MERGE, demotion or derivation of one candidate from another counts only if it lowers TOTAL TRANSFERABLE COMPLEXITY rather than relocating it. The quantity to be reduced is minimal sufficient transferable information under CONSTRAINED encoders and receivers -- informally contract cost ~= information rate + encoder/decoder complexity + context or side-channel complexity + reconstruction distortion + computational and latency cost + robustness cost -- not the number of English nouns in the basis. A reduction is therefore INADMISSIBLE when the lost distinctions reappear inside the definition of the surviving relation, a more powerful decoder, hidden context tags, unconstrained numerical precision, recurrent hidden state, task-specific side channels, or expensive reconstruction machinery. Three requirements for any proposed collapse: (1) lower total description or rate cost under fixed assumptions about precision and decoder power; (2) preserve DISCRIMINATING predictions -- the reduced model must still predict distinct failure signatures when different information is corrupted; (3) improve transfer or efficiency relative to an unconstrained equivalent-capacity code. The standard of reducibility is OPERATIONAL, not logical: logical reducibility (a mathematician can derive it) and information-theoretic reducibility (the information exists somewhere) are both inadmissible, and only computational reducibility (the receiver can derive it with plausible resources) and operational reducibility (reliably and quickly enough for the behaviour in question) decide. Corollary that makes the rule bite: rewriting several candidates as one typed relational graph, one latent, or one universal relation is a RENAMING, not a reduction, and is refused unless all three requirements are demonstrated.

Contract-invariant promotion ladder: GOV-CONTRACT-1's >= 2-of-6-domain consilience quorum is STAGE 1 of six, not the whole standard, and clearing it confers a LEDGER STATUS ("admitted") and nothing else -- in particular no claims.yaml entry, no architectural commitment, and no licence to implement. The ladder: Stage 0 named canonical candidate (the relation has a governed ledger record); Stage 1 cross-domain recurrence (the GOV-CONTRACT-1 quorum); Stage 2 transferable RECEIVER-ACCESSIBLE recoverability (the relation is recoverable by a plausible receiver, not merely by a researcher's probe, across held-out content, tasks or remappings -- graded on INV-105's ladder, never on external decodability alone); Stage 3 causal handoff dependence (selective, nuisance-controlled corruption at a relevant interface produces the predicted deficit, MECH-545); Stage 4 irreducibility under constrained reconstruction (a smaller already-supported basis cannot reproduce the function within the receiver's rate, decoder, context, latency and robustness budget -- adjudicated under the reduction-admissibility rule); Stage 5 adaptation-aware characterisation (compensation, alternative-pathway recruitment and rescue understood well enough to separate functional necessity from mechanism uniqueness, ARC-140); Stage 6 boundary scope established (which handoffs require the relation and which can reconstruct or omit it, ARC-144). A candidate becomes CLAIM-SHAPED at Stage 4 and eligible for architectural treatment only after Stage 5; before that its canonical home is its ledger record id. Composite candidates remain candidates however strong their recurrence, and a negative result at any stage is recorded in the ledger, never deleted.

Dynamic information governance: a complete inter-engine interface in REE requires THREE properties, not two -- (1) the decision-relevant content survives the sender's encoding, (2) sender and receiver are mutually legible so a constrained transformation between frozen endpoints exists (ARC-139 / MECH-537 / MECH-538), and (3) the exchange occurs under a routing state that grants the sender causal privilege over that receiver AT THAT MOMENT. Property (3) -- jurisdiction, or temporal/state ACCESS -- is a separate organisational level from content and from legibility, so a representation can be present, decodable, structurally connected to a downstream system, and still unable to affect it; and the corresponding repair is different in kind from an encoder fix or a bridge. The architectural consequence is that REE's effective interface graph is CONSTRUCTED rather than possessed: G_eff(t) is a function of wiring, representational geometry, control state and history, so the same computational substrate can belong to different effective networks at different times. SEPARABILITY FALSIFIER, which is the whole content of the commitment: if a static bridge between frozen endpoints restores the full behavioural phenotype irrespective of when the message is made available, level (3) is unnecessary and this commitment should be withdrawn in favour of ARC-139 plus MECH-539 alone.

The cognitive contract is BOUNDARY-INDEXED, not one flat universal header: for a handoff from subsystem A to subsystem B the obligation is I_AB = the relations B requires that B cannot cheaply and reliably reconstruct locally, so the contract is properly written as a family of TYPED OBLIGATIONS, C = { A -> B : I_AB, tolerated distortion, receiver capability, fallback behaviour }, one entry per directed interface. A sensory-to-world-model handoff, a hippocampal replay handoff, an E1-to-E2 predictive handoff and a control-plane handoff need not carry the same relational payload, and a relation may be obligatory at one boundary while being locally reconstructable -- and therefore omissible -- at another. The consequence that makes this more than bookkeeping: a DEEP SHARED CORE, if one exists, is an EMPIRICAL OVERLAP to be measured across many heterogeneous interfaces, never a premise; candidates such as value, salience, confidence, commitment and priority may be crucial at particular boundaries without being universal invariants of every internal representation, and a universal reading of the contract systematically over-states their status. Falsifier for the contract programme itself: if useful obligations exist at each boundary but their OVERLAP across the cognitive graph is negligible, boundary-specificity defeats a shared core and the contract is a set of interface specifications rather than an architecture of cognition.

Cognifold versus braidling: at what point does invariant-preserving translation between cognitive systems constitute INTERNAL cognition (one cognifold) rather than communication between agents (a braidling)? Proposed discriminator, conceptual not yet formal: two systems form a BRAIDLING if each remains an independently coherent cognitive entity when communication is severed, however effective their coordination while joined; they are parts of ONE COGNIFOLD if their normal cognition depends on invariant-preserving transformations across the boundary and they jointly maintain one persistent self / world structure, so that severance degrades coherence on both sides rather than merely coordination. Does the cognitive contract (ARC-142) operationalise this -- through contract-dimension dependency, MECH-538 bridge complexity, or a severance assay -- and does the resulting criterion place REE's E1 / E2 / E3 / hippocampus on the cognifold side while placing two communicating REE agents on the braidling side?

Receiver-conditioned translation: what a sender should expose to a consumer is a function of the receiver's current state, not of the sender alone -- translated content = T(sender state, receiver state, receiver position / context) -- so the communication subspace (MECH-537) is CONTEXT-INDEXED rather than one globally fixed cross-system alignment. The sender may support several potential read surfaces, and which one is active may depend on receiver mode, current goal or task-loop context, uncertainty, the action or candidate under evaluation, retrieved episodic context, temporal phase and the receiver's current predicted state. CONSTRAINT that keeps this from becoming a hidden cognitive module: receiver-conditioning determines WHICH PART of already-present sender information is exposed and HOW it is expressed; it must not let the bridge solve the task independently. Confirming signature: T(A,B) > T(A) on held-out data at MATCHED capacity AND receiver-state permutation destroys the gain; if permutation barely matters, the gain is extra capacity, not conditioning, and the result is evidence about the bridge (MECH-538). Candidate REE loci: z_world -> E1 versus z_world -> E2 (different read surfaces of one sender), E1 <-> E2 conditioned on the candidate action / horizon under evaluation, hippocampal retrieval -> consumer conditioned on the consumer's present query state, ContextMemory -> downstream reader expressed relative to current context rather than injected as a fixed latent message, and waking versus offline interfaces using different receiver-conditioned geometry.

Grammar inherits the cognitive contract: some grammar-like relational structure -- agency / role marking, tense and aspect, modality and evidentiality, negation, reference and number, causation and conditionals -- emerges in a communication channel because external transmission between minds inherits the same relations that internal translation between engines must already preserve (ARC-142). Chain: cognitive invariants -> internal representational contracts -> repeated compression / translation pressure -> proto-grammatical relational structure -> external language. Two-directional test: (a) invariants derived from cognition or REE-internal necessity should be over-represented among recurrently grammaticalised distinctions; (b) recurrently grammaticalised distinctions lacking developmental, comparative or computational support should classify as embodied or cultural, not contract. Prediction: agents required to transmit invariant-rich cognitive states efficiently over a low-cost channel develop grammar-like structure for exactly the contract relations and not for schema content; agreement across (a) and (b) is the evidence, either direction alone is not.

Contract-lesion assays: the decisive test of a candidate cognitive-contract invariant (ARC-142) is not its presence in successful cognition but a BOUNDARY LESION -- a translation between two engines that preserves content but deletes one relation -- producing a predicted, invariant-specific fragmentation signature. Five pre-registered signatures: IDENTITY lesion (two representations cannot determine whether they concern the same entity) -> broken persistence, duplicated selves / objects, incoherent credit assignment, unstable memory integration; TEMPORAL lesion (content without temporal relation) -> cause / effect inversion, present-state vs anticipated-state confusion, confused planning, memory / prediction contamination; REALITY-STATUS lesion (observed, remembered, simulated and counterfactual states indistinct across the boundary) -> confabulation-like behaviour, false commitment to imagined states, impaired counterfactual learning, psychosis-like representational error; AGENCY lesion (events representable, controllability and actor relation lost) -> poor action learning, internal / external attribution errors, impaired responsibility assignment, failure of intentional planning; CONFIDENCE lesion (content translates, uncertainty does not) -> overcommitment, under-reaction to reliable predictions, inappropriate belief updating, failure of precision-sensitive integration. Predictions: each lesion applied at ONE inter-engine boundary yields a signature distinct from the other four and from generic information loss (scored against a dimensionality-matched random-projection floor, INV-105), and an invariant whose boundary lesion produces NO reproducible deficit is struck from the contract, with the negative result preserved (GOV-CONTRACT-1).

Cognitive-contract invariant admissibility rule: a candidate contract invariant (ARC-142) acquires ARCHITECTURAL standing only by consilience -- independent support from at least two of six evidence domains: (1) cross-linguistic typology (recurrent, obligatorily encoded across unrelated languages), (2) pre-linguistic developmental cognition (present before language or explicit instruction), (3) neuroscience (modality- or subsystem-independent representation, or a known translation mechanism that retains it), (4) comparative cognition (present in species with different sensory / behavioural ecologies), (5) independently trained artificial agents (discovered without being specified; removal produces characteristic failure), and (6) REE-internal necessity (an engine boundary that cannot learn or translate around it). Every candidate must be CLASSIFIED architectural / embodied-ecological / human-linguistic-convention / uncertain, with the alternative explanation (embodiment, culture, task structure) recorded. Cross-linguistic universality ALONE is inadmissible as architectural evidence: shared bodies, sensory systems, ecology and phylogeny explain human universals without cognitive universality. Developmental precedence -- required before substantial learning can occur -- is the strongest single-domain signal. A negative finding (an apparently fundamental invariant shown unnecessary, or translatable-around) is a first-class preserved result, not a discard. The contract must be DERIVED INDEPENDENTLY of REE_assembly's own claims / evidence / provenance / dependency invariant machinery (docs/architecture/invariant_types.md, claim_evidence) -- deriving it from that machinery is circular -- and any structural convergence between the two is logged as an empirical clue under GOV-ANALOGY-1, never assumed. Each candidate carries a twelve-field evidence record (candidate, definition, linguistic, developmental, neural, comparative, artificial-agent, REE evidence, lesion prediction, alternative explanation, classification, confidence); the objective is the smallest defensible set, never the longest list.

top_dependency_targets.title: The cognitive contract: a unified mind built from heterogeneous engines (E1 / E2 / E3 / hippocampus and later specialists, differing in representational geometry, temporal scale, compression level, learning dynamics and uncertainty representation) requires not a common latent space but an INVARIANT-PRESERVING CONTRACT -- a small set of relations I such that for any lossy translation x_A -> C_A(x_A) -> T_AB -> D_B -> x'_B, I(x_A) ~ I(x'_B), even though x'_B = x_A is meaningless across different spaces. The contract is relational / semantic, not representational: each engine may encode an invariant differently (explicit scalar, trajectory position, recurrent-state relation, geometric direction, ordering relation) so long as the relation is recoverable at the boundary when needed. It sits ABOVE the translation machinery and ABOVE schemas (cognitive contract -> representation / translation machinery -> schemas -> particular concepts, memories and environmental models): a schema rewrite, including offline reorganisation during sleep, changes WHAT the organism knows; contract failure changes WHETHER its subsystems can still understand one another. The contract specifies RECOVERABLE RELATIONSHIPS, never a fixed data structure or ontology -- engines encode invariants differently, new representational systems can be added, schemas reorganise, and contract dimensions may be added or retired. Its two failure poles are representation collapse (one canonical latent forced on every engine, destroying the specialisation that makes multiple engines useful) and cognitive fragmentation (engines keep exchanging tensors while progressively losing shared meaning -- computationally active, no longer one mind). Unity does not require representational sameness; it requires preservation of the relations that keep representations about the same cognitive world.

source_claims.title: Triadic co-reference primitive (declarative joint attention / synchronic two-slot identification): the agent can hold its OWN slot and ONE OTHER agent's slot simultaneously bound to a SINGLE shared object referent, for no instrumental reason. This relational self-other-object binding -- not a stable self (ARC-081) and not a generic object-persistence buffer (ARC-080 PILLAR 1) -- is the developmental prerequisite otherness inference (ARC-083) and theory of mind actually run through. It sits on ARC-080's slot-allocation machinery as a binding operation over two concurrently-live slots plus one object token.

The OBJECT term in self -> object -> other is ROUTE-SPECIFIC, not universal: an object is constitutive of the mirror / action-understanding route (the mapping fires only when an inferable object-goal is present) but absent from the bodily-correspondence route (cross-modal self-other equivalence requires no object) -- so REE must not specify a single obligatory self -> object -> other pipeline.

Fast empathy BOOTSTRAPS cognitive empathy: the fast affective route is the developmental scaffold from which the slower mentalizing route differentiates, so the two are representationally dissociable in maturity while both remain live. Adult dissociation between self-pain and vicarious-pain codes is the PREDICTED endpoint of this bootstrapping, not evidence against ARC-094's stream-binding.

Verbal or symbolic representation of an undifferentiated affective action-pressure is itself a low-risk PARTIAL commit: it discharges the pressure into a cheap committed trajectory, and when that symbolic commit produces prediction mismatch (the articulated expectation fails) or social witnessing (another agent responds to it), the mismatch updates future trajectory-arbitration scoring for the affect's full-cost action alternatives -- which is the mechanism by which articulating an urge changes what the agent later does.

Dorsal high-fidelity structured symbolic routing is architecturally distinct from the affective-coupling system, and a ventral interface binds affect to symbol: the pathway that carries language's structure and sequencing and the pathway that carries graded affective coupling are separate systems joined by a binding interface, so REE must not implement affect as a property of the symbolic route nor symbolic routing as a property of the affect stream. The claim is limited to the DISSOCIATION, which has clinical anchors (conduction aphasia impairs structured repetition while preserving comprehension; right-hemisphere lesions impair affective prosody while sparing propositional language), and deliberately does NOT assert the broader "lateralisation = incompatible-regime separation" or precision-vs-flexibility principle.

In multi-agent settings, the cost of continued deliberation is not only an opportunity cost against a passive, unchanging world (the internal expected-value-of-information trade MECH-434 already governs) but a STRATEGIC cost that another goal-directed agent can actively impose: a competing mind can occupy a contested resource, block a route, infer REE's objective from its information-seeking behaviour, conceal or manufacture evidence, or prepare an attack while REE continues gathering evidence. A commitment-timing mechanism that weighs only pragmatic-vs-epistemic value against a static environment will systematically over-deliberate whenever another agent is present and can act on REE's delay; the commitment threshold/urgency term must therefore also be sensitive to detected other-agent presence and behaviour, not internal information value alone.

Developmental specialisation of the scientist-agent principle (MECH-276) for other-agent / responsive-entity discovery: parallel to MECH-278's stage-2 object-schema formation via experimental intervention on passive world-features, an agent discovers candidate other- minds by performing actions and testing which environmental entities' subsequent behaviour covaries with those actions (I-move to entity-responds; I-stop to entity-changes-behaviour; I-approach to entity-withdraws; I-pursue to entity-evades; I-signal to entity-changes-state), producing the RESPONSIVE-entity discrimination that a purely passive-world-focused curriculum (static hazards and resources only) cannot supply. This is the "V4 social-intervention mechanism (parallel to MECH-278 for other-agents)" MECH-276's own notes already name as a known specialisation but do not register.

In a world containing other predictive agents, causal-model selection over an observation must include a distinct OTHER-agent-caused hypothesis (alongside world-caused, self-caused, and jointly-caused) with non-zero but bounded prior probability -- a signal-detection-theory calibration target, not a fixed threshold -- and once evidence is attributed to another agent's action with sufficient probability, downstream belief-updating on whatever that evidence appears to support about the world must be discounted or reweighted conditional on a shallow, recursion-bounded model of that agent's likely goal in producing it (teach, warn, cooperate, deceive, conceal, or no strategic intent at all). This generalizes INV-012 Leg 4's single-agent self-solicited-evidence discounting to the multi-agent case, and is distinct from ARC-010/MECH-031/MECH-274's existing machinery for DETECTING and aggregating other-agent causation, which currently feeds only empathy/harm-coupling (MECH-036) and other-model stabilisation, not evidential-weight discounting of the observation's apparent world-content.

Representational interference between language and fast empathy: discrete/reportable/sequential language representations and graded/affective/resonant empathy representations exert conflicting representational pressures, so forcing them into one shared workspace too early measurably degrades BOTH relative to separated systems at matched capacity.

Language and theory-of-mind/fast-empathy are implemented as partially-homologous but developmentally SEPARATE specialist systems over a shared self/world/action core -- distinct routing, input histories, representational pressures and gating -- not as one merged social-linguistic system that later differentiates.

top_dependency_targets.title: Social cognition uses mirror modelling and coupling.

source_claims.title: Once each simultaneously active REE controller is individually validated, operating-point corrected (ARC-155) and given regime-surviving exit evidence (ARC-156), do the existing controllers compose without one removing the behavioural or informational substrate another needs (freeze removing the action freedom a safety veto acts over; threat mode suppressing the plasticity or exploration that model repair needs; commitment suppressing needed exploration and vice versa) -- or does destructive interference persist, so that REE needs an explicit DISTRIBUTED authority-regulation principle (reciprocal inhibition, precision or gain weighting keyed on the other controller's state, basal-ganglia-like lawful access, state-dependent routing) that is not a central executive?

Monostrategy has at least two separable etiologies that must be discriminated before any coordination remedy is admissible: REPERTOIRE ABSENCE (Type A -- behaviourally useful alternatives are never formed, proposed or represented in the tensors the evaluator consumes, so there is nothing to route) and REPERTOIRE-ACCESS COLLAPSE (Type B -- a useful alternative is proposed and represented at the evaluator's input yet repeatedly fails to reach committed, executed behaviour, and a change of ACCESS alone, with no retraining and no new content, re-exposes it). The two are separated by a staged chain read at matched decision states -- proposed -> represented -> evaluated -> committed -> executed -- under generation-side injection of the useful alternative at matched pool size: Type A is rescued by injection; Type B is not, and loses authority at a named later stage. ADMISSIBILITY CONSEQUENCE: a routing / dynamic-coordination / phase remedy is licensed only by a Type-B verdict obtained in an ecology where at least two strategies are each useful and a fixed strategy is measurably suboptimal, with a competence gate met, and against matched static-learned-bridge, existing-diversity-pressure, state-independent random-routing and content-ablation controls that all fail. OCCURRENCE FALSIFIER: if, in such an ecology, generation-side injection or the static bridge rescues every monostrategic seed, Type B does not occur in REE and the V3 synaptic approximation stands.

A control operating point (threshold, cap, saturation constant, or cost weight) that reads a LEARNED quantity -- a latent magnitude, prediction error, salience, effort, confidence or threat signal whose distribution moves across training, seeds, developmental stage and state -- must be denominated on an endogenous estimate of that quantity's own scale (or on a producer whose scale is anchored), not on an absolute raw constant; otherwise the regime it gates is determined by arbitrary numerical scale rather than information content, and degenerates to permanent crossing, permanent silence, saturation (a graded transform collapsing to a gain change), or scale-determined dominance between controllers. The denomination must preserve the condition-relevant discrimination of the signal: an operating point that stabilises regime occupancy by habituating to a chronically high signal (normalising real danger into 'baseline') violates this claim rather than satisfying it, and no denomination can restore information the producer has already lost.

Evidence-domain jurisdiction rule: evidence receives no broader jurisdiction than the experiment earned. Organism-level validation is a PROFILE over eight orthogonal evidence domains -- D0 instrument validity, D1 local mechanism validity, D2 local causal consequence, D3 closed-loop behavioural consequence, D4 ecological (world-family, not seed) generalisation, D5 developmental validity, D6 integrated compatibility and simplification, D7 adaptive recovery from a materially wrong internal model -- never a scalar ladder and never one "intelligence score". Whenever a result is promoted UPWARD -- into a roadmap or closure-plan node, an architectural recommendation, a milestone or progress summary (CURRENT_FRONT, insights_report, morning digest, a governance cycle's headline), a default-on decision, or any statement that REE itself has become more competent -- the promoting text MUST carry an explicit line of the form "Evidence domain reached: D? / Domains not tested: ..." naming the SPECIFIC untested domains that matter for that claim. A frozen-latent decoder result establishes at most D1; a live selection perturbation at most D2; seven seeds in one world family do not reach D4. Raw manifests and per-run autopsies are exempt; the rule binds the SUMMARY layer, where mechanism validity is most easily narrated as organismal progress.

Seeds-versus-worlds reporting rule: random-seed replication and ecological (world-family) replication are different evidence and MUST be reported separately -- "stochastic replication: N seeds" and "world-family replication: N environment families / N orthogonal perturbation classes" -- and a result may not be described as general, robust or transferable solely because it survived more seeds. Seeds test robustness within ONE world family; ecological replication tests whether the mechanism survives when the world itself changes along a PREDECLARED axis (map geometry, hazard or resource prevalence and topology, cue-to-consequence mapping, transition dynamics, temporal delays, observation or sensor layout, action costs, affordance structure, partial observability, actor structure). Where such a suite is used as a promotion target it must be FROZEN before use, or it becomes another training distribution. Until a frozen ecological suite exists, world-family replication is a NAMED DEBT on every claim promoted on seeds alone, never an implied property.

Can REE use internally generated (imagined, replayed, or model-generated) trajectories to preserve or repair BEHAVIOURAL ACCESS -- the route by which retained predictive or procedural knowledge again reaches proposal, competitive authority, selection, fresh commitment and execution -- by updating retrieval, readout, ranking or eligibility mappings, while those trajectories remain categorically barred from acquiring the autobiographical, residue-write, realized-reward, reinforcement and direct-authority status of experienced events; and if so, what is the safe update target and what provenance rules make the separation machine-checkable rather than conventional?

Offline integration is a protected family of TYPED transformations, not a unitary replay update: retention/interference repair, representational reorganisation, recalibration/attribution repair, and behavioural-access repair are distinct offline OUTCOMES (a partition by what changed, not by which phase ran), and each requires its own declared WRITE TARGET, its own PROVENANCE CLASS for the content it may consume, and its own DISTAL WAKING READOUT. Replay is a transport and sampling operation shared by all four, never a sufficient description of the transformation any of them performs. Consequently a readout appropriate to one operation is not evidence about another: retention is shown by preserved or recovered competence after interference on old and transfer cases; reorganisation by changed relational transfer, equivalence-class behaviour, generalisation or state construction WITH trace/index continuity; recalibration by improved calibration or causal attribution under held-out outcomes, never by narrower uncertainty alone (a sharper but wrong posterior is a failure, and reduced ambivalence from attractor collapse or gate lockout must be separated from reduced ambivalence from evidence integration); and access repair by restored endogenous recruitment, fresh commitment, executed behaviour and ecological consequence while upstream content is held fixed.

A load-bearing positive control (or any diagnostic injection standing in for a claim's precondition) must traverse the production path it claims to validate. Directly injecting or mocking the state immediately downstream of a suspected causal edge can certify that a downstream consumer works GIVEN that state, but cannot certify that the production organism can reach that state via its own endogenous pathway. A contract test that mocks the source of a load-bearing state establishes consumer competence, not production-path reachability, and must not be reported or treated as evidence that the organism possesses the full pathway.

A run is not admissible as negative evidence for a claim unless the organism instantiated for that run was demonstrably able to express -- and, where the claim is learning- or development-dependent, to acquire -- the faculty under test. Each organism-level experiment must therefore DECLARE, and a preflight must machine-verify against the instantiated organism, at minimum: the canonical profile identity and every explicit deviation from it; the mechanisms and capabilities the hypothesis presupposes; whether those mechanisms were constructed, enabled and reached on the production path; whether their decisive readouts engaged often enough for the test to be non-vacuous; whether their output could compete at the relevant arbitration surface at the scale present in the run; which forms of change were permitted (parameters, policy/value, E1/E2 representations, memory state, residue/EMA state, offline updates); and, where online learning is load-bearing, whether gradients were enabled, whether the intended trainable parameters were in an optimizer, and whether a parameter-delta witness confirms an actual update path. A run failing any declared precondition self-routes to a capability-precondition diagnostic status and MUST NOT be recorded as evidence against the claim. 'It did not learn' and 'it could not have learned' are different scientific outcomes.

'Long life' in an artificial organism is not one property but at least four separable continuities -- cognitive/affective/mnemonic state continuity, parameter/plasticity continuity, body/homeostatic continuity, and ecological/world continuity -- which can be held or broken independently of one another. A persistent-organism experiment must therefore declare which of the four it preserves, because duration under a broken continuity is not developmental opportunity: an organism whose cognitive state persists while its body and world regenerate at every boundary is not aging in a world, and an organism observed for many ticks with its parameters frozen is not developing. The decomposition separates four confounds that a scalar 'lifespan' or 'ticks survived' cannot: age from layout luck, learning from reset effects, injury/recovery from death, and memory accumulation from environmental regeneration.

top_dependency_targets.title: Organism-level mechanism status is stage-qualified beyond ARC-120's competence-before-authority sequence: a mechanism becomes causally reachable only through an ordered audit projection of existence, representation, endogenous recruitment, local operation, competitive authority (non-zero influence is not necessarily competitive influence against the dominant arbitration term), committed throughput (survives any later selector, latch, commitment boundary, or stale-selection path), ecological consequence (the changed behaviour has a valid opportunity to matter in the environment), and retention/generalisation. Authority at one internal selection boundary does not by itself establish that authority reaches committed behaviour -- 'competence should precede authority, but authority must also demonstrate throughput.' The furthest stage actually demonstrated, not a flat implemented/not-implemented judgment, is the correct unit for recording mechanism status.

source_claims.title: Monostrategy has at least two separable etiologies that must be discriminated before any coordination remedy is admissible: REPERTOIRE ABSENCE (Type A -- behaviourally useful alternatives are never formed, proposed or represented in the tensors the evaluator consumes, so there is nothing to route) and REPERTOIRE-ACCESS COLLAPSE (Type B -- a useful alternative is proposed and represented at the evaluator's input yet repeatedly fails to reach committed, executed behaviour, and a change of ACCESS alone, with no retraining and no new content, re-exposes it). The two are separated by a staged chain read at matched decision states -- proposed -> represented -> evaluated -> committed -> executed -- under generation-side injection of the useful alternative at matched pool size: Type A is rescued by injection; Type B is not, and loses authority at a named later stage. ADMISSIBILITY CONSEQUENCE: a routing / dynamic-coordination / phase remedy is licensed only by a Type-B verdict obtained in an ecology where at least two strategies are each useful and a fixed strategy is measurably suboptimal, with a competence gate met, and against matched static-learned-bridge, existing-diversity-pressure, state-independent random-routing and content-ablation controls that all fail. OCCURRENCE FALSIFIER: if, in such an ecology, generation-side injection or the static bridge rescues every monostrategic seed, Type B does not occur in REE and the V3 synaptic approximation stands.

Frontier-evidence doctrine: literature is evidence and constraint, never permission. After a documented, scoped, good-faith search, every mechanism claim may carry a literature_status of DIRECT (a sufficiently close mechanism exists and is adapted), ADJACENT (components or analogues constrain the design but no source supplies the required mechanism or coupling), or FRONTIER (no sufficiently close mechanism found; the requirement follows from a REE architectural or ethical question). A scoped search that finds no direct precedent is a SANCTIONED TERMINAL outcome of a literature pull ("no direct mechanism found; adjacent evidence constrains A, B, C; the remainder proceeds experimentally"), not a veto and not evidence against the mechanism -- unless a stated reason shows that the relevant literature should already contain the mechanism if it were viable. Adjacent literature is recorded as constraint, and its literature confidence must not be read as direct support. A frontier mechanism may be built (default-OFF) and promoted on REE experimental evidence alone, but absence of literature RAISES the experimental burden (pre-registered competing candidates, production-path causal reach, negative controls incl. channel-presence and proxy-reward, ablation, world-family replication, a non-compensable adjudication battery) rather than lowering it; frontier status is never itself evidence for a mechanism; and later literature convergence updates literature confidence without rewriting the claim's historical REE-frontier provenance.

Every candidate developmental prior in REE is classified on two INDEPENDENT axes -- candidate-necessary vs developmental accelerator (improves speed, stability or robustness but is dispensable or derivable in principle), and environment-general vs environment-specific -- with enabling architecture (plasticity, memory, temporal representation, an action interface, self/world state, a route from learned models to action selection) held out as a separate class that is not a prior; and when development fails, interventions are admitted in order of increasing environment-specificity (structured endogenous exploration, then general contingency / information-seeking mechanisms, then memory / plasticity mechanisms, and only then environment-specific priors), so that a required environment-specific prior is recorded as an ecological finding about that environment ('this world could not be reliably developed into under the current general set without additional ecological information') rather than as an innate requirement. Inherited structure is preferentially PROCEDURAL (how to discover a world: vary action enough to see its consequences, credit changes that follow one's own action, preserve regularities, reopen them when they stop predicting) rather than ONTOLOGICAL (what the world contains).

Governed selectivity beats transfer volume: competent integrated behaviour in REE tracks the SELECTIVITY, STABILITY, REPERTOIRE and causal TIMING of directed influence between engines, not the AMOUNT of inter-engine information transferred -- so the decisive experimental signature is a DISSOCIATION at matched traffic, in which endpoint-local content remains decodable, endpoint-local competence remains intact, total inter-module transfer is matched or INCREASED, and integrated behaviour nonetheless degrades in proportion to lost directional selectivity, route stability or motif repertoire. Three degradation modes are predicted to be distinguishable rather than one: FLATTENING (all channels similarly permissive, high volume, no selectivity), DOMINATION (one slow global mode monopolises routing authority, high coherence, low repertoire) and FRAGMENTATION (routes form but do not persist long enough to complete a multi-step transfer; local decodability intact, long-horizon coordination poor). PRIMARY FALSIFIER: if performance is fully explained by total transmitted activity or message count, and route selectivity adds nothing once traffic is matched, this claim is refuted and no routing layer is warranted. SECOND FALSIFIER: if total transfer always FALLS whenever behaviour falls, the high-traffic/low-tuning regime does not exist in REE and the claim's discriminating signature is unreachable.

Developmental-history irreducibility at matched final capacity: some mature cognitive organisations may be historically inaccessible from their own final architecture -- a system that develops through a transiently larger capacity envelope and is progressively reduced to a target architecture can outperform an identical target architecture trained from initialisation under the identical curriculum, so developmental history contributes something the final architecture alone does not reproduce. The claim is stated with its own discriminating control and is confirmable ONLY by that control: a four-arm design of (A) mature size throughout, (B) overcapacity progressively reduced to the mature size, (C) overcapacity retained, and (D) arm B's final architecture, sparsity mask and interface structure REINITIALISED and trained from the start under the same curriculum. B > A alone is consistent with the rival "pruning found a better small architecture"; only B > D at architecture(B) ~= architecture(D) and final capacity(B) = final capacity(D) establishes the claim. Corollary: premature representational or interface compression should selectively impair distinctions whose relevance is revealed only later in the curriculum, even where the same compressed form works well after maturation.

The interface-repair adjudication standard: a claim that some maintenance process REPAIRED a cross-system mapping -- as opposed to strengthening a memory, triggering a completion, or riding a subspace that never broke -- is admissible only from a single design, or one tightly integrated series, that closes all six links itself, because the confounds differ across preparations and therefore do not cancel when rows are stacked: (1) MEASURED CHANGE in a transfer-relevant direction, which excludes unit turnover, registration noise, behavioural change, and any rotation preserving the receiver-potent subspace; (2) LOCAL PRESERVATION of sender information, sender-local use, and receiver-local memory and competence, at the moment of the cross-system test; (3) ACCESS LOSS measured by a causal receiver-dependent output, never by decodability or correlation; (4) PAIR-SPECIFIC MAINTENANCE, compared against a within-context permutation preserving event count, state occupancy, marginal content, firing and plasticity opportunity and breaking only which sender event pairs with which receiver state; (5) CAUSAL RESTORATION on held-out episodes; (6) RIVAL EXCLUSION at matched budgets. Two consequences bind. First, a GATE-0 LESION PROOF precedes every maintenance arm: the imposed change must degrade causal receiver use while leaving both endpoints locally intact AND be restorable by a known oracle inverse -- if the oracle cannot restore use the lesion is not an interface lesion and the drift model is invalid, if magnitude-matched null-subspace drift degrades use the subspace identification is invalid, and if task-relevant drift does not degrade use there is nothing to repair and the experiment stops. Second, the estimand is the correctly-paired arm beating the MAXIMUM of the permuted-pair, receiver-local-adaptation and local-rehearsal arms, never the unmaintained floor: a correct-pair advantage over the floor alone is equally explained by generic plasticity, extra rehearsal and homeostatic adaptation. Local-memory equivalence is a PROSPECTIVE constraint tested by equivalence tests, never a covariate regressed out afterwards, because conditioning on a treatment-affected memory score is a collider.

Deletion-pressure rule: construction earns a later obligation to attempt simplification. Once several individually validated local repairs coexist in one organism (representation-preservation objectives, routing bridges, selection-authority boosts, replay repair, provenance tracking, goal-anchor normalisation, compensatory control loops), the mature bundle must periodically be challenged by mechanism removal, low-complexity replacement, consolidation of redundant routes, reduction of bridge capacity, and removal of downstream compensation after an upstream repair -- and competence retained after removal is recorded as a POSITIVE architectural result, not as lost work. Two mechanisms do not both keep conceptual credit when one has become unnecessary; this is the architectural counterpart of not double-counting evidence. A mechanism is not protected from deletion by having once passed its own isolated assay.

Reduction admissibility for the cognitive contract (the anti-cheating rule the pruning clause lacks): counting primitives is not minimality, and a proposed MERGE, demotion or derivation of one candidate from another counts only if it lowers TOTAL TRANSFERABLE COMPLEXITY rather than relocating it. The quantity to be reduced is minimal sufficient transferable information under CONSTRAINED encoders and receivers -- informally contract cost ~= information rate + encoder/decoder complexity + context or side-channel complexity + reconstruction distortion + computational and latency cost + robustness cost -- not the number of English nouns in the basis. A reduction is therefore INADMISSIBLE when the lost distinctions reappear inside the definition of the surviving relation, a more powerful decoder, hidden context tags, unconstrained numerical precision, recurrent hidden state, task-specific side channels, or expensive reconstruction machinery. Three requirements for any proposed collapse: (1) lower total description or rate cost under fixed assumptions about precision and decoder power; (2) preserve DISCRIMINATING predictions -- the reduced model must still predict distinct failure signatures when different information is corrupted; (3) improve transfer or efficiency relative to an unconstrained equivalent-capacity code. The standard of reducibility is OPERATIONAL, not logical: logical reducibility (a mathematician can derive it) and information-theoretic reducibility (the information exists somewhere) are both inadmissible, and only computational reducibility (the receiver can derive it with plausible resources) and operational reducibility (reliably and quickly enough for the behaviour in question) decide. Corollary that makes the rule bite: rewriting several candidates as one typed relational graph, one latent, or one universal relation is a RENAMING, not a reduction, and is refused unless all three requirements are demonstrated.

Receiver-conditioned translation: what a sender should expose to a consumer is a function of the receiver's current state, not of the sender alone -- translated content = T(sender state, receiver state, receiver position / context) -- so the communication subspace (MECH-537) is CONTEXT-INDEXED rather than one globally fixed cross-system alignment. The sender may support several potential read surfaces, and which one is active may depend on receiver mode, current goal or task-loop context, uncertainty, the action or candidate under evaluation, retrieved episodic context, temporal phase and the receiver's current predicted state. CONSTRAINT that keeps this from becoming a hidden cognitive module: receiver-conditioning determines WHICH PART of already-present sender information is exposed and HOW it is expressed; it must not let the bridge solve the task independently. Confirming signature: T(A,B) > T(A) on held-out data at MATCHED capacity AND receiver-state permutation destroys the gain; if permutation barely matters, the gain is extra capacity, not conditioning, and the result is evidence about the bridge (MECH-538). Candidate REE loci: z_world -> E1 versus z_world -> E2 (different read surfaces of one sender), E1 <-> E2 conditioned on the candidate action / horizon under evaluation, hippocampal retrieval -> consumer conditioned on the consumer's present query state, ContextMemory -> downstream reader expressed relative to current context rather than injected as a fixed latent message, and waking versus offline interfaces using different receiver-conditioned geometry.

Predictive sharpening is not a new claim (the over-splitting guard that pairs with GOV-ROTATE-1's smuggling guard): a rotated representation that makes a SHARPER prediction than the canonical claim -- a sign rather than a magnitude, a causal ordering, a conditional dependence, a timescale, a locus, a developmental window, a falsifiable inequality -- remains an inferential refinement of the SAME claim, sharing its truth state, when the sharper prediction follows from the canonical claim plus already-accepted background assumptions (C + B); it becomes a DISTINCT claim (C AND A), which must be split and must NOT inherit C's evidence, exactly when the sharper prediction requires a NEW empirical assumption A introduced during the rotation. The test is which auxiliary assumptions are needed to make the predictions agree, not how different the sentences sound or how much more precise the new one is.

top_dependency_targets.title: Matched-auxiliary-control and scaffold-removal admissibility rule: a result is admissible as evidence that a representation objective (auxiliary head, anchoring target, contrastive shaping, any added loss) ORGANISES a latent in a specific way -- rather than that extra supervision helps -- only if obtained against BOTH (1) a matched arbitrary-auxiliary control (same head capacity, loss budget, update frequency and training examples; target with learnable but organism-irrelevant structure; any entropy/difficulty mismatch REPORTED, never silently accepted) and (2) an evaluation with the auxiliary head removed, scored on downstream organism-level measures (rollout at consequential transitions, behavioural competence, transfer when consequences change but sensory statistics do not, counterfactual separability, perturbation recovery), never on the objective's own probe accuracy or loss; in its offline-mechanism form, a durable sleep/replay/compression mechanism is adopted only on held-out causal attribution, intervention choice, transfer or calibration, never on training loss or replay reconstruction.

source_claims.title: After an unexpected harm event, does the current V3 stack (SD-099 orienting + MECH-074d attribution + E1 / residue memory + E3 harm scoring) selectively strengthen the representation of the thing, action or context that caused it, such that that representation later changes prediction and action BEFORE harm recurs -- and if not, is the missing edge integration, an injury-vs-threat consumer split, a new credit mechanism (MECH-598 / MECH-599), or z_world cue identity itself?

Once each simultaneously active REE controller is individually validated, operating-point corrected (ARC-155) and given regime-surviving exit evidence (ARC-156), do the existing controllers compose without one removing the behavioural or informational substrate another needs (freeze removing the action freedom a safety veto acts over; threat mode suppressing the plasticity or exploration that model repair needs; commitment suppressing needed exploration and vice versa) -- or does destructive interference persist, so that REE needs an explicit DISTRIBUTED authority-regulation principle (reciprocal inhibition, precision or gain weighting keyed on the other controller's state, basal-ganglia-like lawful access, state-dependent routing) that is not a central executive?

Cue-specific conditioned threat predictor: a discrete predictive structure encodes 'this z_world prototype predicts that harm will follow', is taught by aversive-PE events with credit distributed over candidate causes, and is read by defensive consumers (SD-099 release, MECH-279 freeze entry, E3 harm scoring) as PREDICTED near-term threat -- so that defence can precede fresh damage and can fall when the predicted threat falls even while accumulated injury (z_harm_a) remains high. Threat-side mirror of MECH-304 / SD-051.

A strong regime that suppresses the organism's normal interaction or information gathering (freeze, defensive mode, exploit-only or monostrategic policy, habitual dominance, attentional fixation, frozen plasticity, strong commitment, a high-confidence attractor) must have at least one endogenous termination input that continues to change DURING the regime -- time- or interoception-integrating accumulators, exogenous change the organism can sense without acting, or internally generated probes -- because a regime whose exit condition is a function only of evidence produced by the behaviour it suppresses is absorbing in any environment that does not change on its own. This evidence-STARVATION route to termination failure is distinct from evidence CORRUPTION (a process degrading its own gating variable, MECH-497); the two can co-occur, and a fix for one does not fix the other.

A control operating point (threshold, cap, saturation constant, or cost weight) that reads a LEARNED quantity -- a latent magnitude, prediction error, salience, effort, confidence or threat signal whose distribution moves across training, seeds, developmental stage and state -- must be denominated on an endogenous estimate of that quantity's own scale (or on a producer whose scale is anchored), not on an absolute raw constant; otherwise the regime it gates is determined by arbitrary numerical scale rather than information content, and degenerates to permanent crossing, permanent silence, saturation (a graded transform collapsing to a gain change), or scale-determined dominance between controllers. The denomination must preserve the condition-relevant discrimination of the signal: an operating point that stabilises regime occupancy by habituating to a chronically high signal (normalising real danger into 'baseline') violates this claim rather than satisfying it, and no denomination can restore information the producer has already lost.

Direction-blind reactive ambitendency (catatonia route III): a memoryless reactive actor reading a state representation that carries goal PROXIMITY MAGNITUDE but not goal DIRECTION produces, from one frozen policy and selected only by initial condition, either a two-cell approach/withdraw limit cycle (ambitendency: one step toward the goal, one step away, repeated) or a boundary-press fixed point (stupor); the catatonic phenotype therefore has a REPRESENTATIONAL generative route that requires no commitment gate to malfunction and no harm-stream lock, distinct from MECH-202B (gate frozen at maximum threshold) and SD-036 subtype II (harm-stream lock-in upstream of an intact gate).

Defensive-orienting response: a toggleable PAG-analog phasic gate (DefensiveOrientingGate) that arrests locomotion on a sudden, unidentified onset (positive-derivative detector over residue_surprise AND z_harm_s norm, distinct trigger channels from MECH-279's chronic z_harm_a), holds until an identification-confidence accumulator (driven by decay of the triggering channel's excess-over-baseline, not a fixed timer) reaches sufficiency, then releases into a valence-gated approach/withdraw/resume decision expressed as an E3Selector.select() score_bias toward/away from the trigger location. The Sokolov orienting-reflex shape, and the organism-level closure of the observational_review_V3-EXQ-906b Section 4 affect-behaviour temporal-decoupling finding.

Defensive-orienting response: a phasic freeze-arrest -> orient/identify -> epistemic-sufficiency-override -> valence-gated approach/withdraw/resume behavioural chain triggered by a sudden, UNIDENTIFIED onset (positive-derivative spike in unsigned prediction-error surprise and/or sensory-discriminative harm), distinct from MECH-279 (chronic, accumulated-suffering freeze) and from MECH-482/MECH-483 (persistent target-bound epistemic_deficit accumulator and the diffuse orient/survey regime it drives -- the opposite end of the timescale from this PHASIC, transient trigger, which MECH-482 explicitly excludes by definition).

A selection-conflict signal (E3's per-candidate decision-gap, gap_norm) should feed the control plane as a distinct S6 class, driving K5 control-allocation escalation and K10 hard-veto threshold as a fast, conflict-triggered brake -- an STN-hyperdirect-style mechanism, complementary to (not a substitute for) the existing tonic Go/No-Go + lateral-inhibition selection machinery (MECH-449/MECH-450).

top_dependency_targets.title: PAG-analog gates the freeze response: freeze commit when z_harm_a x duration exceeds threshold; exit requires z_harm_a to fall below an exit_threshold scaled by gaba_tone; failure of exit produces sustained immobility characteristic of stuporous catatonia.

source_claims.title:
zworld_encoder_shaped_through_the_dynamics_keeps_action_caused_change. The z_world encoder keeps the
action-caused part of the observation's per-step change only if a transition objective reaches it: the
world-forward (or E1) loss must carry gradient into the encoder through the ONLINE input z_t while the
TARGET z_{t+1} stays stop-gradient, with an anti-collapse floor against trivially predictable codes. REE
detaches both ends (agent.py buffer write; SD-070 P0 trains the encoder on static single-frame targets),
so the encoder never learns which of its directions the action moves, and action information present
in world_obs (~0.69 of the per-step change is action-attributable at the observation) is lost before
z_world (~0.22-0.38 action-attributable in z_world with an untrained encoder).

task_term_gradient_share_must_be_floored_not_weighted. Even when a task-aligned term is present in an encoder objective, transfer is gated by whether that term retains a non-trivial share of the GRADIENT against the preservation term; under fixed relative weights and no floor, raising the preservation weight monotonically starves it. REE has the crowding curve already measured on SD-106's own landing: mean held-out grounding lift 0.5702 (shipped) -> 0.4313 (w=50) -> 0.4064 (w=200, the arm V3-EXQ-1023a ran) -> 0.3982 (w=500), recorded there as a COST and never read as a mechanism. DreamerV3's corrective is a FLOOR rather than a weight: free bits, L = max(1, KL), contributes zero gradient below 1 nat, and the stated failure it prevents is exactly this one -- the regulariser wins, the code degenerates, the latent stops carrying task-relevant distinctions and 'the actor starves because the actor sees only the latent'. MuZero's analogue is per-head loss scaling by 1/K plus a 1/2 gradient scale at the dynamics entry. The general form this claim asserts: the protected quantity is the task term's gradient share, and it must be enforced by a SATURATING floor on the competing term, because a weight ratio must be re-tuned whenever anything else in the objective changes whereas a floor does not.

encoder_objective_must_carry_the_consumers_target / auxiliary_task_head_transfer. An encoder objective transfers to an action consumer only to the extent the objective itself contains a term whose target is the consumer's target, or an improvement on it. Task-agnostic variance preservation contains no such term, so its gradient is not systematically aligned with what the consumer reads and additional budget moves the encoder along directions the consumer does not use. MuZero is the limit case: the representation function receives gradients ONLY from policy, value and reward heads, and the paper explicitly refuses any requirement that the hidden state reconstruct the observation or match the true environment state. The ENABLING CONDITION, which is easy to miss and is load-bearing, is that MuZero's policy target is the MCTS-IMPROVED search policy rather than the network's own prior: an encoder trained toward a consumer's CURRENT output has a degenerate self-agreement fixed point, so 'train the encoder through its consumer' is incomplete without a policy-improvement operator. DreamerV3 is the affordable form and REE's correct template: task-relevant supervision enters the representation objective as AUXILIARY HEADS (reward and continue) on the same latent as the decoder at beta_pred = 1.0, while actor and critic gradients are STOPPED at the model state -- so the consumer's TARGET reaches the encoder and the consumer's GRADIENT does not. CORRECTION OF RECORD: the CDQ-010 row's premise that DreamerV3 carries actor/value gradients into the latent is wrong in the gradient sense, and that correction is the mechanism, because it is what lets a preservation objective transfer without any single consumer owning a SHARED latent.

objective_consumer_transfer_blocked_by_readout_reparameterisation_invariance. SD-106's preservation term is ||W f(x) - x||^2 / var with W a FREELY-TRAINED linear decoder optimised jointly with the encoder (ree-v3 ree_core/latent/zworld_p0.py:556-558, head_params joined to the same Adam). That loss is EXACTLY invariant to the general linear group acting on the 32-dim code: for any invertible A, the pair (A.f, W.A^-1) attains an identical loss. The objective therefore cannot distinguish two codes in the same GL(32) orbit and cannot prefer a well-conditioned representative over an arbitrarily ill-conditioned one. The consumer -- a fixed-capacity MLP trained by SGD on the FROZEN code -- is NOT invariant to A: its reachable solutions and sample efficiency depend on the code's spectrum. Transfer therefore fails not because information is missing but because the objective is structurally blind to the property that governs whether the consumer can use it. The substrate's own comment cites Baldi & Hornik (1989) as its anchor ('with a linear decoder the MSE optimum IS the principal subspace') -- and that theorem yields the principal SUBSPACE only up to an arbitrary invertible transformation, never the principal COMPONENTS. PCA-32 is the canonical orthonormal eigenvalue-ordered representative of that same orbit, which is why it clears the bar 3/3 at matched reconstruction (world_obs R^2 0.9984 vs SD-106's 0.9974) while SD-106 falls 0.1227 short at the consumer. The conditioning terms REE does carry bound the orbit only partially: the VICReg variance term is a ONE-SIDED floor, mean relu(gamma - std_j), with no cap on anisotropy above the floor, and the covariance term decorrelates without equalising, so the code's condition number is unconstrained.

Generic bottleneck variance preservation at the observation->z_world encoder: a SCALE-NORMALISED reconstruction term (fraction-of-variance-unexplained, with its own linear decoder) plus a zero-initialised linear bypass around the world encoder's ReLU stack. The successor SHAPE to SD-018, which supervises ONE NAMED FEATURE (resource proximity) and returned NULL at V3-EXQ-978. Addresses the CONFIRMED H-F-content-discarded-at-encode verdict of V3-EXQ-1010: the shipped P0 objective supplies no gradient toward decision-relevant content, leaving the latent at or below its own random-initialisation quality.

At least one of REE's designated compression sites (MECH-523) must be paired with an explicit TRAINED decompression/readout stage before representational-ceiling nulls measured there are interpretable as capacity findings -- this is the v3-testable core of MECH-507's reciprocal compression/decompression bridge, independent of the full E1 reframing MECH-507 itself remains scoped to. Two site-specific halves of this pattern already exist as registered but unvalidated/unbuilt v3 work: SD-056 (E2.world_forward trained via a contrastive divergence-preservation loss, coded 2026-05-29 in ree_core/predictors/e2_fast.py, default OFF, never re-queued for validation) supplies the decompression half at the z_world site, paired with SD-070's anti-collapse encoder-training recipe for the compression half at the same site. Separately, the P4 training-debt cluster at E2.action_object_head/O -- SD-080's zero-gradient finding, MECH-518's dual-role variance contention, MECH-517's interface-collapse ordering -- names the same repair owed at a second, independent compression site. This claim asserts the general requirement and is satisfied by confirming it at either site.

Organism-relevant distinction preservation across representational compression: any compression, abstraction or consolidation step on the observation -> z_world -> E1/E2 path (and any offline schema-compression of episodes) must preserve, or leave recoverable through its dynamics, five classes of distinction consequential to the organism across time -- (1) consequence and opportunity/threat, (2) controllability and agency incl. internal-state consequence invisible in the scene, (3) persistence and temporal relation, (4) causal ancestry / intervention handles (agent identity, action class, preconditions, uncertainty over causal contribution), (5) independently evolving trajectories -- as PRESERVATION REQUIREMENTS, not latent dimensions; a step that destroys downstream access to one of them is a developmental regression regardless of reconstruction or prediction loss; auxiliary heads enforcing a class are removable SCAFFOLDS and the ontology within a class must remain free to split, merge and reweight over development.

REE's designated compression sites are systematically UNTRAINED, so representational-ceiling results measured at them are uninterpretable as capacity findings. Verified 2026-08-26 at three independent sites: (a) E2.action_object_head, SD-004's action-object bottleneck that the hippocampal CEM searches inside, receives zero gradient from every REE training path and is a frozen random projection with ~99.5% of its variance explained by the action label (SD-080); (b) the ARC-004 higher-order latent stack -- beta_encoder, theta_encoder and delta_encoder appear ZERO times in agent.py, have no loss, no optimiser and no predictive head at any horizon, and are an untrained random-projection cascade smoothed by one hardcoded shared EMA (alpha_shared = 0.3); (c) no value-shaped objective reaches any encoder at all -- compute_benefit_eval_loss reads z_world.detach() and trains only E3.benefit_eval_head. The corollary is methodological: a null measured at an untrained compression site is evidence about the absence of a training signal, not about the representation's capacity or about the sufficiency of the architecture.

Predictive obligation is the anti-collapse constraint on a value-carved representation: a representation compressed toward selection-relevance ALONE degenerates, because value is a near-scalar projection and a pure value-carving objective admits solutions that discard everything not currently useful. Requiring the higher-order latents to remain PREDICTIVE across the ARC-004 temporal spread supplies a constraint the value objective lacks -- cross-horizon prediction demands retained state structure that value alone does not -- so the combination holds perception open where value-carving alone would collapse it.

top_dependency_targets.title: z_world P0 anti-collapse encoder-training recipe: a mini-batched P0 that trains the SD-005 split-encoder world path on STATIC scene-structure targets derived from world_obs alone (hazard/resource presence + bucketed nearest-Chebyshev distance), with class-balanced CE and a VICReg-style variance/covariance anti-collapse penalty, replacing the SD-009 event-contrastive + SD-018 P0 that was measured to COLLAPSE z_world to participation ratio ~1.06 at world_dim=128. Supplies the trained encoder that SD-031 / E2WorldForward P1 and V3-EXQ-783 both require.

source_claims.title: Agreement-dependent timescale separation as the signature of reciprocal reconciliation: when two REE subsystems are reciprocally coupled through a learned selective correspondence, joint states in which the two are MUTUALLY COMPATIBLE should decay more slowly than equally-strong incompatible joint states -- tau_agree > tau_disagree -- so that the coupled dynamics progressively bias the pair toward mutually supportable states WITHOUT either system converging on the other's representation. Integration is thereby dynamical compatibility, not representational equality, and the terminal pair (A*, B*) is mutually supportable rather than identical. This proposes a FURTHER NAMED PROPERTY -- RECIPROCALLY RECONCILED -- which is deliberately NOT a numbered rung on INV-105's ladder. INV-105's seven rungs are each a property of ONE VARIABLE'S STATUS in a latent space and are monotone (reaching rung n entails 1..n-1); this property has a different subject (a COUPLED PAIR'S JOINT DYNAMICS) and dissociates from the ladder in BOTH directions -- generic recurrence can produce tau_agree > tau_disagree with nothing at rung 4 (bridgeable), which is exactly what falsifier (2) below concedes, and a purely feedforward bridge can reach rung 7 (behaviourally beneficial) with no reciprocal reconciliation whatever. Two properties that dissociate in both directions are not adjacent rungs on one monotone ladder. GOV-CONTRACT-3's 'stated here rather than as an eighth rung, to avoid a second ladder that would invite collapse with the first' is the governing precedent, and GFLAG-0235 (resolved, user-approved 2026-09-10) is the governing ruling: it chose forward-reference over amendment for MECH-548's eighth-rung proposal. THREE PRE-REGISTERED FALSIFIERS, each an ablation that must abolish the separation if the claim is true. (1) COUPLING-DIRECTION ABLATION: measure tau_agree and tau_disagree under intact bidirectional coupling, A->B only, B->A only, and both removed; if a unidirectional condition reproduces the separation, what is being measured is persistence, not reciprocal reconciliation, and the claim is refuted. (2) CORRESPONDENCE SCRAMBLE AT MATCHED COUPLING STRENGTH: preserve total coupling magnitude while permuting WHICH dimensions are connected; if the separation survives a scramble, it is generic recurrence rather than learned like-to-like correspondence, and the claim is refuted. (3) FALSE-CONSENSUS CHALLENGE: inject a shared but INCORRECT latent signal into both systems; if agreement alone stabilises it and independent environmental error cannot destabilise it, the mechanism manufactures coherence without correctness and must not be built. Perturbation magnitude must be matched across the agree and disagree conditions or the comparison is uninterpretable.

The 3 + 2 reduction hypothesis: the fourteen canonical cognitive-contract candidates (evidence/planning/cognitive_contract_invariant_ledger.v1.json) may not be fourteen independent primitives but may largely generate from THREE STRUCTURAL FAMILIES plus TWO ATTACHED WEIGHTING FIELDS. Structural: (A) CORRESPONDENCE / BINDING -- which token, event, state or relation in one representation corresponds to which in another or across time, with identity as correspondence plus continuity and persistence constraints, and equivalence as correspondence under a specified transformation (absorbing CCI-001, CCI-006); (B) DIRECTED EVENT / TRAJECTORY STRUCTURE -- event or token instances, ordered or partially ordered succession, reachable transition relations, persistence across transitions, and optional typed intervention edges, rather than a scalar clock plus a separate graph (absorbing CCI-002, CCI-007 and, if action-labelled edges suffice to reconstruct controllability, much of CCI-004); (C) GENERATIVE CONTEXT / ANCHORING / LINEAGE -- which process produced a representation, which branch it belongs to, whether that branch is anchored to the current sensory worldline, and how it relates to other generated alternatives, so that "actual" is a relation to the currently anchored worldline rather than a primitive category (absorbing CCI-003, CCI-012 and the unnumbered provenance/ownership hypotheses). Attached fields: (D) EPISTEMIC WEIGHT over states, edges or translations, obligatory only where the producer holds reliability information the receiver cannot cheaply reconstruct (reclassifying CCI-005 from content primitive to boundary-specific field); (E) REGULATORY / VIABILITY WEIGHT -- predicted relation to viable or preferred states plus direction of change plus horizon, from which signed value, goal relation and priority may derive (reclassifying CCI-009 and bearing on CCI-010, CCI-014). CROSSED PREDICTION, which is what makes this falsifiable rather than a re-labelling: structural families should survive object or world remapping when the world relation is unchanged despite altered surface features, whereas attached fields should vary strongly with current uncertainty, needs, goals, physiology and task regime AT FIXED STRUCTURE -- so holding structure fixed while changing confidence, holding structure fixed while changing viability, holding confidence fixed while changing branch lineage, holding value fixed while changing controllability, and holding sensory content fixed while changing generative path should dissociate along the structure/field boundary. If structural and weighting variables cannot be dissociated by that crossed design, the 3 + 2 model is wrong or too simple.

Reference-frame mediation as a separable interface factor: two systems can each contain a task distinction, expose it through a healthy communication subspace (MECH-537), and still fail to communicate because they index that distinction against INCOMPATIBLE RELATIONAL COORDINATES -- egocentric versus allocentric, current-position-relative versus trajectory-origin-relative, observation-time versus predicted-action-time, absolute location versus action-conditioned displacement, episode-identity versus elapsed-tick. The interface decomposition is therefore content x communication subspace x REFERENCE FRAME x receiver context x temporal gate, and the frame is a THIRD selection variable alongside which directions are exposed (MECH-537) and which read surface the receiver's state selects (MECH-547). Registered failure class RF-F (an eighth entry in the location doc's F1-F7 routing table): an external probe succeeds on sender AND receiver, the information is not missing and the subspace is not collapsed, yet native cross-system use fails -- routing to a relational re-indexing rather than to more sender capacity or a higher bridge rung. The DISCRIMINATOR that makes this more than a redescription is a frame permutation that preserves content: permute the frame labels or anchors between episodes or positions while holding sender-state distribution, marginal difficulty and content statistics fixed (intact >> frame-permuted, while the target stays decodable in both, is the confirming signature; intact ~= frame-permuted says the frame is incidental at that interface). Two non-redundant predictions: frame alignment should LOWER the minimum bridge rung L(A -> B) (MECH-538) without requiring a higher-capacity bridge, and a frame permutation may disrupt only ONE downstream consumer, in which case reference frames are consumer-specific rather than globally shared -- which forbids inferring one global workspace or one canonical coordinate system from several consumers sharing an indexing relation.
