stochastic_noise_floor (max_entropy_policy_regularisation_LC_NE_tonic_analog). A floor-level stochastic action-selection noise that prevents complete deterministic collapse of the policy. Biological substrate: locus coeruleus tonic firing producing baseline action-selection variability (Aston-Jones & Cohen 2005 adaptive-gain model). Computational analog: max-entropy policy regularisation / SAC entropy bonus (Haarnoja et al. 2018). Distinct from MECH-260 dACC anti-recency: MECH-313 is a state-independent noise floor, while MECH-260 is a state-dependent recency penalty. Both can contribute to anti-monostrategy pressure but operate via different mechanisms; whether they collapse into a single substrate or are mutually load-bearing is open (Q-045).

Sleep-consolidation priority from V_s residuals: during sleep-phase Bayesian aggregation (MECH-275) and sleep-dependent self-model aggregation (MECH-273), the order and weight of replay events is biased by the schema-staleness map produced by MECH-284. Replay is not uniform across schema and is not solely salience-driven (dopaminergic tagging); it is also prioritised by accumulated verisimilitude residuals. Schema regions with the most accumulated 'this is wrong' evidence get replayed first, more often, and with higher schema-update authority during sleep. PTSD-rumination has a clean architectural account here: MECH-285 priority loss co-occurring with MECH-094 hypothesis-tag dysfunction, locking the staleness tag from ever clearing.

The self-model has a waking half and a sleep half. The waking half is SD-003 (single-episode counterfactual self-attribution via E2). The sleep half is full-Bayesian aggregation of single-episode SD-003 outputs across many episodes, routed by the anchored channel to E1 and SD-033a, correcting for delayed consequences, failed counterfactuals, and systematic attribution biases. Without the sleep half, REE has an episode-local causal signature but not a durable self-model.

behavioral_diversity_generation_pathway (multi-substrate distributed: LC-NE tonic + frontopolar curiosity + striatal novelty + hippocampal trajectory sampling). Architectural commitment: a non-trivial behavioural diversity generation pathway is upstream-of and logically prior to both rule pathways (ARC-062 top-down rule-apprehension and ARC-064 bottom-up rule-discovery). Without it, neither pathway has anything to weight or cluster -- gradient descent on a parametric policy without diversity pressure collapses to the smoothest single regime, the predicted equilibrium MECH-309 identifies. The biology distributes diversity generation across at least four substrates: LC-NE tonic noise floor, frontopolar uncertainty-driven curiosity, striatal novelty bonus, and hippocampal trajectory sampling. REE registers this as a foundational architectural slot whose specific child mechanisms (MECH-313 noise-floor, MECH-314 structured-curiosity with three sub-flavours, and the MECH-315-absorbed proposal-diversity channel) are independently testable but jointly load-bearing.

Rule-apprehension architectural slot, weak reading: a non-Bayesian rule-creator at the policy layer that proposes discriminative policy modes for the updaters (E3, training loop) to refine. V3 instantiation: a gated-policy architecture in which at least two policy heads share encoder features but receive different gating from a learned context discriminator (e.g., reef-context vs open-context heads). Tests the logical-necessity claim of MECH-309 within the existing V3 substrate without registering the heavier CandidateRule machinery (ARC-063 -- brought forward V4->V3 2026-05-18, this parenthetical is stale as of registration 2026-05-08). Architectural slot, not yet implemented.

Monomodal policy collapse is the equilibrium of a parametric-policy agent without a rule-apprehension layer. Bayesian update and gradient descent revise weights over a hypothesis space they do not invent; without a non-Bayesian rule-creator that proposes discriminative policy modes ('near-hazard -> reef regime; else -> forage regime'), the trainer collapses to the smoothest single regime good-enough across the whole state space. Monostrategy is therefore not a bug of training but the predicted output of an architecture in which only updaters exist and no apprehender does. Falsifiable by the weak-reading rule-apprehension experiment (ARC-062): a gated-policy architecture trained on the same substrate should break the collapse where standard E3 does not.

E1 functions as an addressable associative manifold with internal indexing structure supporting retrieval, traversal, ordering, pattern separation, and pattern completion; parietal cortical functions (spatial mapping, associative binding, attention routing) are properties of E1 connectivity and representational geometry, not a separate module.

The objective for hippocampal/episodic memory organisation is RELATIONAL APPROPRIATENESS, not maximal pattern separation: related experiences should overlap appropriately (overlap is what supports generalisation and memory linking) while behaviourally distinct latent situations should separate appropriately. It follows that "more diverse slots", greater slot occupancy, and lower representational overlap are NOT objectives in themselves, and that a metric which is monotonically improved by increasing differentiation is scoring the wrong quantity regardless of whether it is computed correctly. This is a claim about the TARGET, and is therefore distinct from -- and not answered by -- the already-established finding that REE's slot_cosine_sim family was computed incorrectly (whole-bank, no occupancy mask; 2026-08-07 governance reversal at V3-EXQ-436d) or the finding that the ContextMemory write path could not produce differentiation at all (scores.mean(0).argmin() single-slot fixed point; V3-EXQ-436f).

Critical period closure / crystallization: once diversity circuits establish competitive weight during the MECH-333 open window, a complementary closure mechanism reduces plasticity for the crystallized diversity distribution while restoring full dominant-pathway update scale; without closure, diversity representations remain equally vulnerable to gradient-driven overwriting throughout all subsequent training.

epistemic_deficit: a persistent, target-bound accumulator representing unresolved, consequential, potentially-resolvable model inadequacy -- distinct from raw novelty (MECH-314a), raw uncertainty (MECH-314b), transient prediction error, and learning-progress (MECH-314c). Rises with unresolved importance x uncertainty x expected_resolvability x persistence; falls with verified resolution, established irrelevance, or accepted irreducibility.

orient/survey: a third primitive behavioural regime (alongside approach and avoid) -- a temporary, diffuse reduction in commitment during which the agent widens behavioural sampling and gathers situational information before committing to approach/avoidance, driven by accumulated epistemic_deficit (MECH-482) rather than a specific cue. Distinct from MECH-395 (cue-triggered, need-gated orienting that resolves a SPECIFIC directional/affordance vector for an already-identified cue): orient/survey is diffuse and precedes cue identification, MECH-395 is narrow and follows it.

Rule-apprehension architectural slot, weak reading: a non-Bayesian rule-creator at the policy layer that proposes discriminative policy modes for the updaters (E3, training loop) to refine. V3 instantiation: a gated-policy architecture in which at least two policy heads share encoder features but receive different gating from a learned context discriminator (e.g., reef-context vs open-context heads). Tests the logical-necessity claim of MECH-309 within the existing V3 substrate without registering the heavier CandidateRule machinery (ARC-063 -- brought forward V4->V3 2026-05-18, this parenthetical is stale as of registration 2026-05-08). Architectural slot, not yet implemented.

Event-segment detection: a substrate-side two-level hierarchical detector that emits monotonic outer.inner segment IDs on detected event boundaries, feeding region-keyed substrates (anchor sets per MECH-269, V_s readouts per Phase 1, staleness accumulators per MECH-284) and the MECH-287 broadcast trigger at the schema/event-segment scale per Eichenbaum 2017 / Sols-DuBrow-Davachi 2017 / Baldassano 2017. Default substrate: PE-threshold detector on the fast scale (z_world+z_self) and BOCPD-Gaussian latent change-point on the slow scale (z_goal); MECH-287 broadcast fires downstream of MECH-288 boundaries (Clewett 2025) rather than via an independent comparator. The segment_id field is the region key consumed by the V_s invalidation runtime cluster; without it, MECH-269 anchor sets and per-region V_s aggregation have no substrate-native source for the region partition.

E1 ContextMemory, when queried with z_world alone (not the full [z_self, z_world] state), produces a cue-indexed association context that selectively activates stored associations relevant to the current sensory context.

Representational dimensionality is an OUTCOME of a developmental plasticity schedule, not an a-priori architectural constant: the number and granularity of memory buckets (ContextMemory slots, and any analogous discrete representational partition) must itself be plastic during an open window and reduce in plasticity as the encountered environment's latent structure is resolved. The INV-074 / MECH-333 / MECH-334 critical-period shape -- open window, competitive establishment, closure / crystallisation -- is currently specified ONLY over the SCORING / POLICY plane (behavioural diversity vs winner-take-all capture); this claim asserts the same schedule is required over REPRESENTATIONAL STRUCTURE. Corollary bearing on measurement: a differentiation-family objective is not merely mis-targeted (MECH-495) but ILL-DEFINED under variable dimensionality, since separation can always be increased by adding buckets, so the objective degenerates into "use more slots"; and any fixed-N spread statistic (sws_slot_diversity over 16 slots, emitted by 29 experiment drivers) presupposes the very structure that should be the outcome. Substrate state at registration: ContextMemory(num_slots=16) at ree-v3/ree_core/predictors/e1_deep.py:36 is a fixed nn.Module buffer with no growth, no allocation policy and no environment conditioning.

The system maintains a functional distinction between simulation-mode content and real-experience content, such that simulation content does not accumulate in the viability map as committed experience; failures of this distinction produce confabulation (simulated events encoded as real).

Hippocampal proposer anchor selection AND anchor-reset: (a) trajectory proposals issued between committed actions anchor on the subset of current latent streams whose regional verisimilitude (per-stream prediction/realization alignment) exceeds threshold; misaligned streams hold their last-verified snapshot (anchor carryover) rather than contaminate the rollout. (b) Active anchors are continuously re-evaluated against an effective verisimilitude V_s_anchor(a, t) = V_s(r, t) - staleness[r] (MECH-284 read-out); if V_s_anchor falls below theta_reset(r) for k consecutive steps the anchor is marked inactive (NOT erased -- dual-trace preservation per Bouton 2004) and a new anchor is sought from the current latent slice. A minority probe channel deliberately inverts the gate for low-verisimilitude / high-PE regions, carrying a strengthened MECH-094 hypothesis tag, and does not update the ARC-018 viability map until realized-experience validation.

Epistemic commitment timing: the inference layer's decision of WHEN to stop gathering evidence and commit a trajectory is a governed control parameter (an urgency/threshold over the belief-state set), balancing pragmatic value (act now) against epistemic value (sample more). Its two failure poles are epistemic-freezing (epistemic value over-weighted / threshold too high -> the agent keeps sampling and never commits) and anti-epistemic-panic (under threat, the epistemic term collapses / urgency forced high -> the agent commits on too little evidence). This axis is NOT reducible to the MECH-126 state-abstraction failure taxonomy; it lives at the seam between the belief-state hypothesis set (MECH-385) / epistemic action pressure (MECH-388) and the commitment gate (MECH-061 / MECH-090), and has an inverted-U optimum rather than a monotone.
BG-level beta oscillations gate E3-to-action-selection propagation, not E3 internal updating.
Derived social tags and empathy coupling via control-plane knobs.

E2.action_object_head receives zero gradient from every REE training path, so the action-object space O that SD-004's hippocampal map backbone navigates is a frozen random projection fixed at initialisation, not the learned world-effect compression SD-004 specifies. O is state-invariant rather than consequence-structured, and the hippocampal CEM searches and refits inside it.

Failure-autopsy failure-location triage: before an experimental observation (a scored-criterion FAIL, or an unscored organism-level observation in a claim-free diagnostic) is described as evidence that REE itself failed, it must be explicitly classified against four non-exclusive failure-location buckets -- REE FAILED / THE MECHANISM FAILED / THE MEASURES FAILED / THE ENVIRONMENT FAILED -- and a REE-failed verdict may be reached only once mechanism instantiation, measurement adequacy, and environmental opportunity have each been separately established (or explicitly could not be, in which case the verdict is MIXED/uncertain, not REE-failed). SCOPE AMENDED 2026-09-16 (user-ratified, from the organism-level validation doctrine): the same four-bucket triage applies symmetrically to an apparent IMPROVEMENT -- before a change in experimental throughput, verdict pattern, evidence weight or front position is narrated as creature progress, classify its source as change in the CREATURE / the EXPERIMENT driver / the INSTRUMENT or measure / the GOVERNANCE or index interpretation, and label the latter three 'science-enabling infrastructure change', never 'creature improvement', unless the creature itself changed and was validated.

REE Assembly needs a dedicated behavioural-adjudication methodology/skill for organism-level behavioural experiment design and interpretation ("umpire, not ruler": observe, preserve the observation without embedding an explanation, generate competing explanations, derive predictions, construct discriminating perturbations, blind condition labels where practical, apply pre-specified hypothesis-directed measures, also run discovery-oriented analysis for structure not anticipated in advance, adjudicate across the pattern of evidence, replicate, and test generalisation under environmental change) -- because a fixed, pre-specified scalar-metric approach risks conflating stochasticity/exploration/noise with the behavioural organisation actually of interest, and risks Goodharting once a convenient metric becomes the de facto definition of the phenomenon.

Organism-level mechanism status is stage-qualified beyond ARC-120's competence-before-authority sequence: a mechanism becomes causally reachable only through an ordered audit projection of existence, representation, endogenous recruitment, local operation, competitive authority (non-zero influence is not necessarily competitive influence against the dominant arbitration term), committed throughput (survives any later selector, latch, commitment boundary, or stale-selection path), ecological consequence (the changed behaviour has a valid opportunity to matter in the environment), and retention/generalisation. Authority at one internal selection boundary does not by itself establish that authority reaches committed behaviour -- 'competence should precede authority, but authority must also demonstrate throughput.' The furthest stage actually demonstrated, not a flat implemented/not-implemented judgment, is the correct unit for recording mechanism status.
Social cognition uses mirror modelling and coupling.

Held-out validation for Assembly workflow and rule changes: a change to a workflow, skill, or standing rule should be validated against cases that did NOT generate it. Every layer of Assembly practice currently edits the artefact from the session that motivated the edit -- a workflow change judged by the cycle that produced it, a CLAUDE.md rule written by the session that hit the incident, an intake template revised by the intake that strained it. There is no held-out review anywhere in the loop.

Interface before representation: a representation improvement is undetectable through a collapsing interface, so representation-side experiments run before the consumer interface is fixed return nulls that cannot be interpreted. This is RIVAL to the standing differentiate-first ordering (differentiate z_world per INV-088, THEN apply diversity pressure). The two give opposite readings of the same result: V3-EXQ-817a verifiably improved O's consequence structure and produced no behavioural change, which differentiate-first reads as consequence structure does not help, and this claim reads as the measurement could not have detected help.

V4 prerequisite cut: the V3->V4 scientific cutover is gated by qualification of the smallest transitive set of V3 capabilities/claims whose truth or functional adequacy V4 actually assumes -- each either sufficiently demonstrated or bounded-and-instrumented (known failure mode detectable and distinguishable from V4-specific effects) -- adjudicated by a dedicated cutover review, never by a global closure percentage. Version labels name organism/design generations; closure describes validation state; version membership is not inheritance, and inheritance is not closure membership. After qualification the programme legitimately occupies two states at once: V3 as validated simple reference organism, V4 as active development organism.

learning_progress_curiosity_intrinsic_motivation_analog. A reward bonus that tracks the rate-of-improvement of the agent's predictive model (or any internal-state quantity); actions that produce a steepening learning curve receive a positive bonus. Most computationally instantiated in ML literature (Schmidhuber 1991, Pathak et al. 2017); least biologically anchored of the three MECH-314 sub-flavours -- no clean cellular or regional analog. Distinguishes from MECH-314a (recency-based) and MECH-314b (uncertainty-based) by tracking second-order signal (improvement rate) rather than first-order (count or uncertainty).

epistemic_deficit: a persistent, target-bound accumulator representing unresolved, consequential, potentially-resolvable model inadequacy -- distinct from raw novelty (MECH-314a), raw uncertainty (MECH-314b), transient prediction error, and learning-progress (MECH-314c). Rises with unresolved importance x uncertainty x expected_resolvability x persistence; falls with verified resolution, established irrelevance, or accepted irreducibility.
Curiosity drive: information-seeking bias in hippocampal trajectory scoring that favors regions of higher representational density in the RBF map.

Version-transition artefact gate: V4 substrate expansion must not erase the opportunity to freeze, reproduce, describe and inspect the completed V3. Before substantial V4 substrate expansion a defined minimum V3 closure package must exist AND double as a manipulable causal reference artefact for later cross-version comparison.

stochastic_noise_floor (max_entropy_policy_regularisation_LC_NE_tonic_analog). A floor-level stochastic action-selection noise that prevents complete deterministic collapse of the policy. Biological substrate: locus coeruleus tonic firing producing baseline action-selection variability (Aston-Jones & Cohen 2005 adaptive-gain model). Computational analog: max-entropy policy regularisation / SAC entropy bonus (Haarnoja et al. 2018). Distinct from MECH-260 dACC anti-recency: MECH-313 is a state-independent noise floor, while MECH-260 is a state-dependent recency penalty. Both can contribute to anti-monostrategy pressure but operate via different mechanisms; whether they collapse into a single substrate or are mutually load-bearing is open (Q-045).

uncertainty_driven_curiosity_frontopolar_analog. A reward bonus that tracks epistemic value -- how much the agent would learn from sampling a state or action. Biological substrate: rostrolateral prefrontal exploration bonus (Daw et al. 2006 Nature). Sub-flavour of MECH-314 structured curiosity bonus. Active-inference framing: bonus equals epistemic value term in expected free energy decomposition (Friston 2010/2015).

The unit of PERCEPT is a dynamic representation, not a fixed primitive: perceptual grain rescales with circumstance, so that the same scene is individuated coarsely or finely depending on demand. This is the perceptual analogue of ARC-069's already-accepted policy-side commitment, and ARC-069's rationale transfers axis-independently -- a fixed grain is either too fine (combinatorial explosion in what must be tracked and bound) or too coarse (units fail to map onto the actual state). REE has made this commitment for policy (ARC-069/070/071) and for context slots offline (MECH-166) but never for online perception, where the unit remains fixed.

Integration does not require representational sameness, it requires selective mutual legibility: specialised cognitive subsystems may preserve distinct high-dimensional PRIVATE internal representations while coordinating through low-dimensional, context-sensitive communication subspaces and low-complexity transformations, so development can raise local specialisation and cross-system legibility AT THE SAME TIME rather than trading one against the other. Non-redundant prediction: a maturing REE shows rising local competence in E1/E2/hippocampus/E3 while GLOBAL representational similarity between them stays flat or falls, and increasing representational similarity between subsystems must therefore NOT be used as the default marker of maturation. This is an explicit ALTERNATIVE framing to ARC-121's shared epistemic-state object, not a refutation of it: one common object, specialised objects with a shared interface format, specialised objects joined by context-specific translation, and a hybrid invariant-core-plus-private-dimensions architecture all remain live, and ARC-121 must not be used to prejudge the question.

Minimum bridge complexity as the measure of mutual legibility: for systems A and B and a family of constrained mappings of increasing expressiveness (native readout -> orthogonal/Procrustes -> affine -> low-rank affine -> constrained nonlinear -> high-capacity upper bound), define L(A -> B) = the minimum bridge complexity achieving a predeclared HELD-OUT functional criterion between FROZEN endpoints; lower L means greater mutual legibility, and the simpler the bridge that works the stronger the evidence that the sender already held an appropriately structured representation -- a high-capacity bridge that succeeds may be performing new cognition and is therefore evidence about the bridge, not about the endpoints. L must never be read alone: two systems that became identical because one LOST its specialisation would show falling L with worsening cognition, so development is tracked on two axes (local specialisation/competence, and cross-system legibility). Non-redundant developmental prediction: sender and receiver each improve local competence WHILE global representational similarity stays flat or falls, task information concentrates in the consumer-facing subspace, and minimum bridge rank falls -- coordination without homogenisation.

The latent-access evidence ladder: a variable's status in a latent space is not one property but seven, which must never be collapsed -- encoded (statistically present) != decodable (recoverable by an external probe) != natively accessible (usable by the system's existing consumer) != bridgeable (usable through a constrained map between frozen endpoints) != pairing-specific (useful specifically when the correct sender state is paired with the correct receiver situation) != causally used (interventions on its content alter downstream computation) != behaviourally beneficial (that causal use improves adaptive performance). Two evidential consequences bind rather than advise: (1) a content-transmission claim about any internal channel or bridge REQUIRES correct-vs-mismatched-vs-zero-vs-moment-matched-random controls, because a channel can be strongly load-bearing while its example-specific content is barely load-bearing; (2) a null measured on a COMPRESSED representation requires a dimensionality-matched RANDOM-PROJECTION floor, not a zero floor, before it can be read as information loss.

Communication-subspace routing failure -- encoded but not exposed: a task variable can be strongly encoded in the FULL sender latent while being weakly represented in the CONSUMER-FACING subspace, producing the phenotype `external probe succeeds -> native behaviour fails` with no information having been destroyed. This is a third failure category strictly between 'information absent from the sender' and 'information used by the receiver', and it is distinct from MECH-517 (the decoder collapses) and MECH-532 (the compression site has no trained decompression stage): routing failure requires neither a collapse nor a missing readout, because the consumer can be reading a perfectly healthy low-rank subspace that simply does not carry the distinction. Operationalised by cross-validated Reduced Rank Regression from sender activity to the ACTUAL consumer input tensor, comparing task decodability in the full sender, inside the estimated communication subspace, and in its orthogonal complement; the diagnostic signature is `target decodable from X` but `poorly decodable from P_comm X`.

The cognitive contract: a unified mind built from heterogeneous engines (E1 / E2 / E3 / hippocampus and later specialists, differing in representational geometry, temporal scale, compression level, learning dynamics and uncertainty representation) requires not a common latent space but an INVARIANT-PRESERVING CONTRACT -- a small set of relations I such that for any lossy translation x_A -> C_A(x_A) -> T_AB -> D_B -> x'_B, I(x_A) ~ I(x'_B), even though x'_B = x_A is meaningless across different spaces. The contract is relational / semantic, not representational: each engine may encode an invariant differently (explicit scalar, trajectory position, recurrent-state relation, geometric direction, ordering relation) so long as the relation is recoverable at the boundary when needed. It sits ABOVE the translation machinery and ABOVE schemas (cognitive contract -> representation / translation machinery -> schemas -> particular concepts, memories and environmental models): a schema rewrite, including offline reorganisation during sleep, changes WHAT the organism knows; contract failure changes WHETHER its subsystems can still understand one another. The contract specifies RECOVERABLE RELATIONSHIPS, never a fixed data structure or ontology -- engines encode invariants differently, new representational systems can be added, schemas reorganise, and contract dimensions may be added or retired. Its two failure poles are representation collapse (one canonical latent forced on every engine, destroying the specialisation that makes multiple engines useful) and cognitive fragmentation (engines keep exchanging tensors while progressively losing shared meaning -- computationally active, no longer one mind). Unity does not require representational sameness; it requires preservation of the relations that keep representations about the same cognitive world.

At least one of REE's designated compression sites (MECH-523) must be paired with an explicit TRAINED decompression/readout stage before representational-ceiling nulls measured there are interpretable as capacity findings -- this is the v3-testable core of MECH-507's reciprocal compression/decompression bridge, independent of the full E1 reframing MECH-507 itself remains scoped to. Two site-specific halves of this pattern already exist as registered but unvalidated/unbuilt v3 work: SD-056 (E2.world_forward trained via a contrastive divergence-preservation loss, coded 2026-05-29 in ree_core/predictors/e2_fast.py, default OFF, never re-queued for validation) supplies the decompression half at the z_world site, paired with SD-070's anti-collapse encoder-training recipe for the compression half at the same site. Separately, the P4 training-debt cluster at E2.action_object_head/O -- SD-080's zero-gradient finding, MECH-518's dual-role variance contention, MECH-517's interface-collapse ordering -- names the same repair owed at a second, independent compression site. This claim asserts the general requirement and is satisfied by confirming it at either site.

Organism-relevant distinction preservation across representational compression: any compression, abstraction or consolidation step on the observation -> z_world -> E1/E2 path (and any offline schema-compression of episodes) must preserve, or leave recoverable through its dynamics, five classes of distinction consequential to the organism across time -- (1) consequence and opportunity/threat, (2) controllability and agency incl. internal-state consequence invisible in the scene, (3) persistence and temporal relation, (4) causal ancestry / intervention handles (agent identity, action class, preconditions, uncertainty over causal contribution), (5) independently evolving trajectories -- as PRESERVATION REQUIREMENTS, not latent dimensions; a step that destroys downstream access to one of them is a developmental regression regardless of reconstruction or prediction loss; auxiliary heads enforcing a class are removable SCAFFOLDS and the ontology within a class must remain free to split, merge and reweight over development.

Dynamic interface compatibility: between PREDICTIVE systems, pointwise state correspondence across an interface is insufficient -- a mapping must additionally satisfy that receiver_transition(T(x_t), a_t) is compatible with T(x_(t+1)) under the relevant action/context, because a bridge can succeed pointwise while destroying transition geometry. The registered diagnostic separation is: map ONLY the initial state and let the receiver evolve natively, versus repeatedly mapping sender rollout states -- this distinguishes a bridge that supplies a compatible starting condition from one that must continually correct incompatible dynamics. Failure signature `good static + bad dynamic` routes to transition-geometry work rather than to representation work; `good one-step + degrading long-horizon` indicates compounding dynamics mismatch; `good dynamic but poor behaviour` routes downstream to valuation/selection.

The two give opposite readings of the same result: V3-EXQ-817a verifiably improved O's consequence structure and produced no behavioural change, which differentiate-first reads as consequence structure does not help, and this claim reads as the measurement could not have detected help.
Imagination must be possible without belief update.

Sleep as selective interface maintenance -- the third offline job: MECH-529 gives offline consolidation two functions, revising the representation (split/merge/reweight over equivalence classes) and re-indexing episodic traces so autobiographical addressability survives that revision. This claim adds a THIRD: adjusting or stabilising the INTERFACE -- the subspace through which another subsystem reads the revised representation. The prediction is explicitly NOT global alignment but a PLASTICITY/STABILITY DIVISION OF LABOUR across interfaces: some reconfigure because recent learning demands it, others remain stable because downstream continuity matters more, so the strongest test compares at least TWO interfaces with different predicted plasticity rather than asking whether all systems become more similar after sleep. Four distinguishable post-sleep signatures: S1 representational retuning (interface metrics move only because the sender moved), S2 interface recalibration (local competence stable, communication subspace or bridge complexity improves), S3 stable scaffold (representations move, mapping holds), S4 maladaptive homogenisation (similarity rises while local competence or task-specific differentiation worsens).

The system maintains a functional distinction between simulation-mode content and real-experience content, such that simulation content does not accumulate in the viability map as committed experience; failures of this distinction produce confabulation (simulated events encoded as real).

Receiver-conditioned translation: what a sender should expose to a consumer is a function of the receiver's current state, not of the sender alone -- translated content = T(sender state, receiver state, receiver position / context) -- so the communication subspace (MECH-537) is CONTEXT-INDEXED rather than one globally fixed cross-system alignment. The sender may support several potential read surfaces, and which one is active may depend on receiver mode, current goal or task-loop context, uncertainty, the action or candidate under evaluation, retrieved episodic context, temporal phase and the receiver's current predicted state. CONSTRAINT that keeps this from becoming a hidden cognitive module: receiver-conditioning determines WHICH PART of already-present sender information is exposed and HOW it is expressed; it must not let the bridge solve the task independently. Confirming signature: T(A,B) > T(A) on held-out data at MATCHED capacity AND receiver-state permutation destroys the gain; if permutation barely matters, the gain is extra capacity, not conditioning, and the result is evidence about the bridge (MECH-538). Candidate REE loci: z_world -> E1 versus z_world -> E2 (different read surfaces of one sender), E1 <-> E2 conditioned on the candidate action / horizon under evaluation, hippocampal retrieval -> consumer conditioned on the consumer's present query state, ContextMemory -> downstream reader expressed relative to current context rather than injected as a fixed latent message, and waking versus offline interfaces using different receiver-conditioned geometry.

There is no held-out review anywhere in the loop.

Matched-auxiliary-control and scaffold-removal admissibility rule: a result is admissible as evidence that a representation objective (auxiliary head, anchoring target, contrastive shaping, any added loss) ORGANISES a latent in a specific way -- rather than that extra supervision helps -- only if obtained against BOTH (1) a matched arbitrary-auxiliary control (same head capacity, loss budget, update frequency and training examples; target with learnable but organism-irrelevant structure; any entropy/difficulty mismatch REPORTED, never silently accepted) and (2) an evaluation with the auxiliary head removed, scored on downstream organism-level measures (rollout at consequential transitions, behavioural competence, transfer when consequences change but sensory statistics do not, counterfactual separability, perturbation recovery), never on the objective's own probe accuracy or loss; in its offline-mechanism form, a durable sleep/replay/compression mechanism is adopted only on held-out causal attribution, intervention choice, transfer or calibration, never on training loss or replay reconstruction.

Harm stream separates into sensory-discriminative (z_harm_s: proximity/intensity, Adelta-pathway analog, forward-predictable) and affective-motivational (z_harm_a: accumulated homeostatic deviation, C-fiber/paleospinothalamic analog).

Plasticity gates in REE are DEFAULT-BLOCKED (de-repression polarity), not admission windows: a teaching signal of any kind (reward prediction error, harm prediction error, novelty, salience, social or affective discrepancy) is a proposal whose only effect is to RELEASE a write that is already staged at, and carried by, its target -- it neither carries the write's content nor opens a window through which writes flow -- so the gate's specificity lives on the TARGET (what is staged there and what release it requires) rather than on a type assigned to the event. The gate family REE already registers at channel, event, tag and window grain (MECH-261, MECH-368, MECH-431, MECH-453, MECH-067) is to be read with this polarity, so that any gate-controller failure -- a missing, late or malformed release -- fails CLOSED (the write stays blocked), whereas an admission-phrased gate of the same nominal permeability can fail OPEN.

PAG-analog gates the freeze response: freeze commit when z_harm_a x duration exceeds threshold; exit requires z_harm_a to fall below an exit_threshold scaled by gaba_tone; failure of exit produces sustained immobility characteristic of stuporous catatonia.

Dynamic information governance: a complete inter-engine interface in REE requires THREE properties, not two -- (1) the decision-relevant content survives the sender's encoding, (2) sender and receiver are mutually legible so a constrained transformation between frozen endpoints exists (ARC-139 / MECH-537 / MECH-538), and (3) the exchange occurs under a routing state that grants the sender causal privilege over that receiver AT THAT MOMENT. Property (3) -- jurisdiction, or temporal/state ACCESS -- is a separate organisational level from content and from legibility, so a representation can be present, decodable, structurally connected to a downstream system, and still unable to affect it; and the corresponding repair is different in kind from an encoder fix or a bridge. The architectural consequence is that REE's effective interface graph is CONSTRUCTED rather than possessed: G_eff(t) is a function of wiring, representational geometry, control state and history, so the same computational substrate can belong to different effective networks at different times. SEPARABILITY FALSIFIER, which is the whole content of the commitment: if a static bridge between frozen endpoints restores the full behavioural phenotype irrespective of when the message is made available, level (3) is unnecessary and this commitment should be withdrawn in favour of ARC-139 plus MECH-539 alone.

REE-v3 requires a minimal sleep-phase infrastructure: an SWS-analog phase (bidirectional hippocampus-to-cortex replay for schema/slot consolidation) and a REM-analog phase (causal attribution replay for slot-filling from co-correlational evidence ordering). Without these offline phases, hippocampal attribution mapping cannot converge and context representations remain globally undifferentiated.
Confidence channel (uncertainty-derived precision) must remain distinct from residual error.

A load-bearing positive control (or any diagnostic injection standing in for a claim's precondition) must traverse the production path it claims to validate. Directly injecting or mocking the state immediately downstream of a suspected causal edge can certify that a downstream consumer works GIVEN that state, but cannot certify that the production organism can reach that state via its own endogenous pathway. A contract test that mocks the source of a load-bearing state establishes consumer competence, not production-path reachability, and must not be reported or treated as evidence that the organism possesses the full pathway.

Event-level write-authority gate: an explicit per-event transition from observed/represented to write-eligible over the DURABLE MODEL-UPDATE path (E1/E2 world-model and policy weights, not only episodic memory), conditioned on f(prediction_error, salience, pathway_state, residue_status, goal_relevance, plasticity_eligibility). The gate decides which individual events within an already-open write channel are licensed to durably deform the model; an event may be salient, real-provenance, and in a write-permitted mode yet still fail the gate. Without it, every prediction error in an open channel writes -- the undifferentiated-global-update / catastrophic-interference failure mode.

Salience-network coordinator: network-level module reading AIC-, dACC-, MCC-, PCC-analog subdivisions and outputting a discrete operating-mode variable (external_task / internal_replay / internal_planning / offline_consolidation) plus a mode-switch trigger.

Defensive-orienting response: a toggleable PAG-analog phasic gate (DefensiveOrientingGate) that arrests locomotion on a sudden, unidentified onset (positive-derivative detector over residue_surprise AND z_harm_s norm, distinct trigger channels from MECH-279's chronic z_harm_a), holds until an identification-confidence accumulator (driven by decay of the triggering channel's excess-over-baseline, not a fixed timer) reaches sufficiency, then releases into a valence-gated approach/withdraw/resume decision expressed as an E3Selector.select() score_bias toward/away from the trigger location. The Sokolov orienting-reflex shape, and the organism-level closure of the observational_review_V3-EXQ-906b Section 4 affect-behaviour temporal-decoupling finding.
